Akuyi kudla nantoni na ephuma kwisityalo seentyatyambo, angatshisa iwayini, nokuba yiyo nayiphi na into enomsindo; akuyi kudla nantoni na engcolileyo. Kuzo zonke izinto endiyamwisela umthetho ngazo, kufuneka azigcine.
Wathi uManawo kwisithunywa seNkosi, Nceda, hlala, siza kukulungiselela inkunzi yenkomo.

Wathi ke umbingeleli kaYehova kuye, Ukuba ndiya kuhlala, andizukudla isidlo sakho; kodwa ukuba ulungiselele idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, linikezele kuYehova. UManowayi akayazi ukuba yayiyimbingeleli kaThixo.
Wabuza ke uManawo isithunywa sikaYehova, esithi, Lithini igama lakho, ukuze sikwazi ukukuhlonipha, xa kwenziwe amazwi akho?
Wathi ke yena, Kutheni na ukuba ubuza igama lam? Kunzima kakhulu ukuliqonda.
Wathabatha ke uManowayi inkunzi yebhokhwe, nomnikelo wesonka, wamnikela kuYehova phezu kodonga. Ke kaloku iNkosi wenza into emangalisayo emehlweni kaManowayi nomyeni wakhe.
Ke kaloku, xa umnqamlezo esuka kwisibingelelo wanyuka waya esibhakabhakeni, isithunywa sikaYehova sanyuka esibhakabhakeni. Wakubona ke uManawo nomfazi wakhe loo nto, bawela emlonyeni wabo emhlabeni.
Ke kaloku isithunywa sikaYehova asibonakali kwakhona kuManawo nomfazi wakhe. Waqonda ke uManawo ukuba yayisisithunywa sikaThixo.
Wathi uAron kumfazi wakhe, Nceda, siya kufa; kuba sabona uThixo.

Waphendula ke umfazi wakhe, wathi, Ukuba iNkosi wayefuna ukusibulala, akazange athathe idini lethu eliqhutywa ngamanzi nomnikelo wethu wesonka; akazange asibonise zonke ezi zinto, akazange asixelele zonke ezi zinto ngoku.
Wazala umfazi umntwana, wabiza igama lakhe nguSamsoni. Wakhula ke uSamsoni; iNkosi wamsindisa.
Waqala uMoya kaYehova ukumvusa, waye eMahanaye-Dan, phakathi kweZora neEshtaoli.
Ke kaloku uSamsoni wenyuka waya eTimna, wabona khona indodakazi yeFilisti.
Wabuya ke, waxela utata wakhe nomama wakhe, esithi, Ndibone eTimna indoda yaseFilisti; ngokuninike yena ukuba abe ngumkakhe.

Waphendula utata wakhe nomama lakhe, wathi, Ingaba akukho mfana ofanelekayo phakathi kwabahlobo bakho, naphakathi kwabantu bethu bonke? Uya kungena kuBafilisti abangathotywanga, ukuze uthathe indoda? Wathi ke uSamsoni kuyise, Yinikele yena kum; kuba ulungile kum.
Abazali bakhe abazange bacinge ukuba le nto ivela kuYehova, ukuba ukhangela ithuba lokwenza into ngabaFilisti. Ke kaloku amaFilisti aye alawula kumaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uSamsoni wahla waya eTimna, yena noyise nodade wakhe. Bathe ke befika kwizityalo zewayini zaseTimna, kwathi ke ilili elincinci liphuma linyanzelisa kuye.
Wathi uMoya kaYehova kuSamsoni, wamisa ilili ngezandla zakhe ezimnyama, njengokuba emisa inkunzi yebhokhwe. Akawuxelela ubaba wakhe namama lakhe into awayeyenzayo.
Wahla ke, wathetha nomkakhe; wamthanda kakhulu unyana wakhe.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, xa wayebuyela ukuba ayise, wajika waya kujonga isiqu selili; yaye kwakukho ngaphakathi kwayo inkunzi yeenkomo, nenyama encinci.
Ke kaloku wathabatha umxube ngezandla zakhe, wayidla emehlweni akhe. Wafika ke kuyise nodade wakhe, wabanika nabo, babadla; kodwa awawazisa ukuba wathabatha umxube emlonyeni wale liyon.
Wahla ke uyise ukuba abone loo mfazi; waza uSamsoni wenza khona isidlo, njengokuba kuthethwa ngabantwana.
Ke kaloku, xa abantu bekubona, bakhetha oonyana abamashumi mathathu ukuba babe ngaye.
Wathi ke kubo uSamsoni, Ndiza kukuxelela intsingiselo; ukuba niyichaza kum imihla yesixhenxe yemikhosi, ndiza kuninika izihlangu ezimhlophe ezimashumi mathathu, nezigqoko ezilishumi elinambini.
Ukuba ke ningandixelelanga loo nto, mna ke nindinike nizigqoko zelinen ezimashumi mathathu, nezihlangu ezilishumi elinambini. Bathi ke kubo, Sitshoni ingxaki yenu, siyiva.
Waphendula ke wathi, Kwinto edlayo kwaphuma into edlayo; kwaye kwinto enamandla kwaphuma into emnandi. Baye bengenakukwazi ukuphendula loo nto iintsuku ezintathu.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe, bathi kumfazi kaSamsoni, Uncede umfazi wakho ukuba acacise kuthi intsingiselo yengcamango; okanye siza kukutshisa wena nosapho lwabazali bakho, ukuze nife. Uthi thina apha, ukuze nithule?

Umfazi kaSamsoni wayalela phambi kwakhe, wathi, Mna uyamthandazela; awundithandeli mna; ubeke isilingo kubomi bam, kodwa ungamxelela loo nto. Waphendula wathi, Andimxelela nabazali bam; ndingakuxelela ntoni na wena?
Ke kaloku, imihla esixhenxe yentlanganiso, wathandaza. Kwathi ngomhla wesixhenxe wamxelela; kuba wayemxelela ngokuqhubekayo; ke yena waphendula abantu bakhe.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe, phambi kokuba ilanga liphume, abantu bomzi bathi kuye, Yintoni emnandi kunamafutha? Yintoni enamandla kunaleli? Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ukuba ningabi nenyama yenkomo yam encinane yokulima, ningayi kuxela inyaniso yam.

Wathi uMoya kaYehova kuye, waya eAshkeloni, wabulala abantu abamashumi mathathu phakathi kwabo; wathabatha izinto zabo, wabanika iimpahla zabo abo bachazayo inyaniso. Wabuyela endlwini yoyise, ecinezelwe yintliziyo yakhe.
Ke kaloku umfazi kaSamsoni wanikezelwa kumnye wabahlobo bakhe, owayengumntu olungileyo kuye.

Ke kaloku, kwathi ke ngemihla yokuvuna ingqolowa, uSamsoni wathabatha inkunzi yebhokhwe, waya kutyelela umfazi wakhe. Wathi, Ndiya kungena endlwini kamfazi wam. Utata wakhe akawuvumelenga ukuba afike.
Wathi, Ndiyazi ukuba uyamxolela; ngoko ke ndimnika umhlobo wakho. Udade wakhe omncinane akabikho mhle na? Nceda uthathe yena endaweni yakhe.
Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ndiza kuhlala ndingekho mthethweni ngaloo mini, ukuba ndenze okubi kumaFilisti.
Waphuma ke, wathabatha iintaka ezilikhulu elinamashumi mathathu; waza wazingca unyawo olunye nolunye ngebini, wabeka umnquba kumqolo ngamnye.
Wazitshisa izithuthi, wazisa iintaka phakathi kweengqolowa ezihlala zimile zamadoda aseFilisti; waza watshisa imiqulu yengqolowa ethe tyaba, nengqolowa ethe tyaba, namagqabi eeolives.

Bathi ke abaFilisti, Yintoni eyenze loo nto? Baphendula besithi, USamsoni unyana-mntwana womntu waseTimna; ngokuba umkakhe wanikezelwa kumhlobo wakhe. Baya ke amaFilisti, bamcinezela yena noyise, bafa.
Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ngokuba niyenze loo nto, andiyi kuphumla, ndenze inyaniso kwenu.
Wabahlasela, wabulala abaninzi kubo; wahla ke, wahlala ekungeneni komngxuma welitye laseEtham.
Baya phezulu amaFilisti, bamisa iintaba eYudea, basasazeka eLehi.
Bathi ke abantu bakaYuda, Niza nini ukuhlasela nathi? Baphendula besithi, Siza kungena ukubopha uSamsoni, ukuze siyenze kuye njengokuba wayesenza kuthi.

Ke kaloku, amawaka amathathu amadoda aseYuda athabathela ekufumaneni umngxunya welitye laseEtam; bathi kuSamsoni, Awazi na ukuba abaFilisti baba ngukumkani kuthi? Uthini na owenzayo kuthi? Waphendula uSamuweli wathi, Ndibayenze ntoni na loo nto, njengokuba babendisenzayo?
Bathi kuye, Sithe safika ukukubopha, ukuze sikunike kumadoda aseFilisti. Wathi uSamsoni, Uthini na kum, ukuba ningandibulala nani?
Bathi ke kubo, Siyavuma; siza kukubopha nje, sizinikezele kubo, asiyi kukufa. Bawubopha ngoko ngentambo ezimbini ezintsha, bawukhupha phezulu emlanjeni.

Ke kaloku, efika eLehi, abaFilisti baphuma emveni kwakhe, bevuma. Wathi uMoya kaYehova waba phezu kwakhe; izibonda ezisemqolo yakhe zathi zifana neentyatyambo zelinen ezenziwe ngomlilo, zaba phantsi ezintloko zakhe.
Wafumanisa isisu seeseyile esitsha, wayithatha, wabulala ngaso amadoda amawaka.
Wathi ke uSamsoni, Ndiye ndazenza ngazo iinkunzi zeegusha, ndizibeke phezu kweegusha; ngazo iinkunzi zeegusha ndabulala amadoda amawaka.
Ke kaloku, xa egqibile ukuthetha, wathabatha isisu sakhe; kwathiwa igama lendawo leyo yiRamathe-lehi.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba wayethambileyo kakhulu, wayalela iNkosi wathi, Uwunika umkhonzi wakho lo xolo olukhulu; ngaba ke ngoku ndiya kufa ngethambileyo, ndifike esandla sabangathotywa?
Wawuvula uThixo umngxunya okwiLehi, amanzi aphuma kuwo; wasela ke uSamsoni, wabuya amandla akhe, waphila kwakhona. Ke kaloku kwathiwa igama lempu iEn-hakhore, eLehi; likhona kude kube ngoku.
Ke kaloku uSamsoni waba ngumgwebi wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mabini, ngemihla yamaFilisti.
Ke kaloku uSamsoni waya eGaza, wabona khona indoda enobuxoki; wesuka waya kuhlala naye.
Ke kaloku kwaziswa amadoda aseGaza, athi, USamsoni ukho apha. Bayijikelezisa ke loo ndawo, bamlinda yonke imini emnyango wedolophu; baphumla yonke imini, besithi, Xa kuvuka ubusuku siza kumbulala.

Ke kaloku uSamsoni wahlala khona kude kube liphakathi kwemini. Wavuka ke, wathabatha izivalo zesango ledolophu, nezingcango ezibini, waza wazikhupha, namakhonkco nawo onke; wazisa phezu kwemilenze yakhe, wabathwala phezulu komnqamlezo ojonge eHebroni.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, wathandana nomfazi omnye eNtaba kaSoreki; igama lakhe lalinguDelaya.

Baya kuye abathetheli bakaFilisti, bathi kuye, Khangela, ukuba ungamxolela, ukuze akuxelele ntoni na amandla akhe amakhulu, nokuba singawuphumelela njani, ukuze sikwazi ukumbophelela, ukwenze angasebenzi; siya kukunika thina ngamnye iisekeli zesilivere ezilishumi elinanye.
Wathi ke uDalilaya kuSamsoni, Nceda ndixelele ukuba yintoni amandla akho amakhulu, nokuba ungabandlululwa njani, ukuze ungabikho.
Waphendula uSamsoni wathi kuye, Ukuba umntu undibophelela ngeentambo ezisixhenxe ezitsha, ezingatshiyi, ndiya kuba mncinane njengokuba ngumntu onke.
Ke kaloku abathetheli bakaFilisti bamnika izibonda ezisixhenxe ezitsha, ezingabi zitshizi; wamtyhila ngazo.

Ke kaloku amadoda afihlakele egumbini. Wathi kuye, USamsoni, abaFilisti baya kuwe! Wayiphulaphula ke intambo zesithunywa sakhe, njengokuba iphuca intambo xa ifika kumlilo; ngoko ke, isitshixo sobukrelekrele bakhe asifumaneki.
Wathi ke uDalilaya kuSamson, Mna uyayixolela intliziyo yakho; mna uyayixolela intliziyo yakho. Nceda ndixelele ngoku ukuba ungabithwa njani.
Wathi kuye, Ukuba umntu uyandibophelela ngokuqinileyo ngentambo entsha engasebenziswanga, mna ndiya kuba mkhulu njengaye nabani na.

Wathabatha ke uDalilaya iintsontelo ezintsha, wamnqula ngazo. Wathi kuye uDalilaya, emehlweni emadoda afihlakeleyo endlwini yakhe: AbaFilisti baya kuwe, uSamsoni! Ke kaloku watsala izithontsi ezisuka emqolo wakhe, zathi ziyimisonto.

Wathi ke uDalilaya kuSamsoni, Uye wandixhalabisa ngelo xesha liphela, wathetha ndim ubuxoki; ndizazise ukuba ungatywinwa njani. Wathi yena kuye, Ukuba uza kuzibopha iinwele zam ezisixhenxe zibe yintyatyambo yoboya bakho, uze uzicinezele ngentambo, mna ndiya kuba mncinane njengendoda enye.

Ke kaloku, xa wayelala, wabeka iinwele zakhe emgqubeni, waza wazigxininisa ngentambo. Wathi kuye ke, Bathe abaFilisti baya kuwe, uSamsoni! Wavuka ke ephupheni lakhe, wasusa intambo, nobhedu, kunye nomgqubi.
Wathi kuye, Ungathi njani ke, Ndikuthanda, xa ungamthobeli mna? Lo ngumhla wesithathu ungenzi mntu olungileyo kum, ungandixelela into efihlakeleyo yobukrelekrele bakho obukhulu.
Ke kaloku wayemxelela ubusuku nemini, de waba nesifo sokufa ngenxa yayo.

Wathi ke kuye, Akukho mqengqelelo luye lwafika ekhanda lam; kuba ndinguNazireli kaThixo ukususela ekuzalwa kwam; ukuba kwenziwe umqengqelelo ekhanda lam, unamandla am aya kumshiya, ndibe mncinci njengabanye bonke amadoda.

Ke kaloku, xa uDalilayi ebona ukuba wamxelela zonke izinto zakhe, wathumela kumadoda amakhulu amaFilisti, esithi, Yiya nibuye kwakhona; ngokuba amxelela zonke izinto zakhe. Bafika ke amadoda amakhulu amaFilisti, bethwala isilivere ngezandla zabo.
Wayimisa ukuba aphumle, ibe intloko yakhe iphantsi komqolo wakhe; yabiza umfazi, waza wamisa iziqhamo ezisixhenxe zeenwele zakhe. Waqala ke uDavide ukuwuxhaphaza, yaye amandla akhe amshiya.
Wathi ke yena, USamsoni, abaFilisti baya kuwe. Wavuka uSamuweli ephupheni lakhe, wathi, Ndiya kuphuma njengokuba ndaphuma ngaphambili, ndizikhusele. Akakwazi ke ukuba iNkosi wamshiya;
Bathi ke abaFilisti, bathabathela kuye, bakhupha amehlo akhe; bamthabatha waya eGaza, bamnqamlelisa ngamakhonkco entsimbi, wamisa ingqolowa kwindlu yokugcina.
Ke kaloku iinwele zeκεφαλi yakhe zaqala ukukhula kwakhona, emva kokuba zixutywe.
Ke kaloku abathetheli bakaFilisti bahlangana, ukuba benze isibingelelo esikhulu kuDagon uThixo wabo, ukuze baphumle; bathi ke, UThixo wethu wanikela uSamsoni, umkhosi wethu, esandla sam.
Ke kaloku, xa abantu bekubonayo, bawuthandazela uThixo wabo; bathi, UThixo wethu wanikela emlonyeni wethu umkhosi wethu, lowo wawulahla ilizwe lethu, wababulala abaninzi bethu.
Ke kaloku, xa ingqondo yabo yaba phezulu kakhulu, batsho besithi, Nxibelelaniseni uSamsoni ukuba adlala nathi. Babiza ke uSamsoni ebhedini, wadlala kubo; bamisa phakathi kwemithi.
Wathi ke uSamsoni kunyana wakhe owawumqhuba ngesandla, Nceda undibeke apho ndikwazi khona ukuva iithayile ezixhasayo indlu kaThixo, ukuze ndenze inkxaso kuzo.
Ke kaloku indlu yayigcwele amadoda nabasetyhini; bonke abathetheli bakaFilisti babekhona; kwathi phezu kwetafile kwaba ngamawaka amathathu amadoda nabasetyhini, ebona uSamsoni edlala.
Wathandaza ke uSamsoni kuYehova, wathi, Nkosi yam uThixo, khumbula mna; nceda, Thixo wam, ndininike ubutyebi obunye kuphela, ukuze ndiphindele ngamehlo am onke amabini kumaFilisti ngento enye.

Ke kaloku uSamsoni waphakamisa isandla sakhe, waya kumatye amabini aphakathi, ahleli phezu kwendlu kaThixo; wabeka icala lakhe elikunene elilodwa, necala lakhe elingasekhohlo elilodwa, waza watsala ngazo.

Wathi uSamsoni, Ndifa kunye nabaFilisti. Wabetha ke ngesandla sakhe samandla onke; indlwini yawela phezu kwabathetheli nangaphezulu kwabantu bonke abakhoyo kuyo. Wabulala abantu abaninzi emehlweni akhe, kunabo ayewabulala ephilayo.

Bathi ke abazalwana bakhe, nosapho lonke loyise, bathabathela kuye; bamthabatha, bamfihla phakathi kweZora ne-Eshtaoli, ekungeneni komkakhe uManowa. USamsoni waba ngumgwebi wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mabini.
Ke kaloku kwabakho umntu okuthiwa nguMika, wayehlala ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfraim.

Wathi kuyise, Kuthe kwathabatha umntu ekholweni lakho iingelosi ezilishumi elinanye zesilivere; ndakuva ke ukuba uthetha ngaye lo mkhweli. Yabona, le golide ndinayo; ndayithatha. Wathi uyise, UYehova akubhaptize wena, mwana wam.

Wazibuyisela umyeni wakhe ezo shekeli zesilivere ezilishumi elinanye ezilikhulu; wathi umfazi wakhe, Ndizinika lemali kuYehova, kumntwana wam, ukuba yenze idini eliqingqiweyo, ligqitywe ngesilivere; ngoko ke ngoku ndiyibuyisela kuwe.
Wazibuyisela isilivere kumyeni wakhe; umyeni wakhe wathabatha iishekeli ezimakhulu amabini, waza wazisa kumenzi wesilivere, waya kwenza ngazo isibingelelo; sabekwa endlwini kaMika.
Ke kaloku uMika wayenebhedi ephakamileyo, wayenza i-ephod, neentyatyambo zendlu kaThixo; wamisa omnye wabo oonyana bakhe ukuba abe ngumbingeleli wakhe.
Ngaloo mihla, kwabakho amaSirayeli angakumkani; umntu ngamnye wayesenza oko kwakulungileyo emehlo akhe.
Ke kaloku kwabakho uLevi omncinci osuka eBhetelehem yaseYuda, osuka kusapho lukaYuda, wayehlala khona.
Washiya uBetheleyimu waseYuda, wafuna indawo yokuhlala kuyo; waya endlwini kaMika, ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfraim.
Wathi kuye uMika, Uvela phi na? Waphendula wathi, NdingumLevi osuka eBhetelehem yaseYuda, ndifuna indawo yokuhlala kuyo.
Wathi kuye uMika, Uhlale nam, ube ngumzali wam, ube ngumbingeleli wam; ndiza kukunika ishekeli ezilishumi zesilivere ngonyaka, nempahla ethe tyaba, nesonka sakho. Wafika ke lo mLevi.
Wavuma uLevi ukuba ahlale naye; waba lo mntwana njengomnye wabantwana bakhe.
Ke kaloku uMika wamisa lowo mLevi; lo mntwana waba ngumbingeleli wakhe, wayehlala endlwini yakhe.
Wathi uMika, Namhlanje ndiyazi ukuba iNkosi uya kundilungisa, ngokuba lo mLevi ungumbingeleli wam.
Ngazo ezo mihla amaSirayeli akazange abe nokumkani; ngazo ezo mihla isizukulwana samaDan safuna indawo yokuhlala kuso; ngokuba besingayifumananga inxalenye yabo phakathi kwezizukulwana zamaSirayeli.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaDan, bathumela amadoda amahlanu anamandla eentsapho zabo, ukusuka eZora nase-Eshtaoli, ukuba ajonge ilizwe, ukuba alibone; bathi kubo, Yiya nilibone ilizwe. Bafika abo madoda emazantsi entlango kaEfraim, balala ekhaya likaMika.

Ke kaloku, bafika ecaleni kwendlu kaMika, bayazi ilizwi lendodakazi yeLevi. Baye badlula, bambuza wathi kuye, Uthini na owenza ukuba ufike apha? Ukwenza ntoni na kule ndawo? Ngaba ukhona ngenxa yokuba ukho apha?
Wathi ke kubo into ayenze ngayo uMika kuye, wathi, Umqeshile mna; ndaba ngumbingeleli wakhe.
Bathi ke kuye, Nceda ubuze uThixo kuthi, ukuba ihambe njani indlela yethu.
Waphendula ke umbingeleli, wathi kubo, Yiya niphumle; iNkosi ijonge indlela yenu.

Bahamba ke abo madoda amahlanu, bafika eLayishe; bababona abantu abakhoyo khona, ukuba behlala ngokukhuselekileyo, ngokwemimiselo yamaSidoni, bephumle, bekhuselekile; babenazo zonke izinto ezifunekayo kubo, kwakungekho mntu ubalaseleyo phakathi kwabo; behlala kude namaSidoni, bengenakuthethwa ngabanye.
Ke kaloku abo madoda babuyela eTsora neEshtaoli; bababuza oonyana babo, bathi, Nifumane ntoni na?
Bathi ke kubo, Yiya, sihlasele; siyazibona ilizwe, yaye lilungileyo kakhulu. Nihlala njani? Musani ukulibazisa; phumani niyithathe ilizwe.
Ke kaloku, xa nifika khona, niza kufumana abantu abangaziyo nto, nelizwe libanzi; uThixo walinika isandla sam, ilizwe elinokuthethwa ngazo zonke izinto ezifunayo intliziyo yenu.
Basuka ke eSora nase-Eshtaoli, amadoda angamakhulu amathandathu aseSizwe sikaDan, alungiselelwe ukulwa.
Ke kaloku, behamba ngendlela, bamisa inqaba eKiriyati-yearimi, eYuda; ngenxa yoko igama lendawo esemantla yeKiriyati-yearimi libizwa ngokuba yiMahanayi-dan, ngelo xesha.
Basuka apho bahamba besiya ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfraim, bafika endlwini kaMika.

Ke kaloku abo madoda amahlanu, ajonge ilizwe laseLayishe, baphendula kubazalwana babo, besithi, Niyazi na ukuba esinye sezindlu zintathu sine-ephod, neentyatyambo zasekhaya, nemifanekiso engumqondiso egqunywe ngesilivere? Namhlanje niyazi into oza kuyikwenza.
Basuka ke khona, bafika endlwini yomntwana waseLevi, endlwini kaMika, bamsikelela.
Amadoda angamakhulu amathandathu eDan, alungiselelwe ukulwa, aye ekungeneni kwesango.

Ke kaloku abo madoda amahlanu, ajonge ilizwe, aye ngaphakathi, wathabatha isibingelelo, ne-ephod, nezithixo zendlu kaThixo; umbingeleli ke waya ekungeneni kwesango, namadoda angamakhulu amathandathu anezithunywa.
Bathi ke abo madoda, bafika endlwini kaMika, bathabathe imifanekiso engumqondiso, ne-ephod, namadini asekhaya, nemifanekiso engumqondiso yesilivere; wathi kubo umbingeleli, Yintoni niyenzayo?

Bathi kuye, Utshime, ungathethi nto; ndiza nathi, ube ngutata wethu nombingeleli wethu. Akufanelekanga na ukuba ube ngumbingeleli wesizwe sonke sakwaSirayeli, kunokuba ube ngumbingeleli wendlu yomntu omnye?
Ke kaloku umbingeleli wamthanda kakhulu; wathabatha i-ephod, neentyatyambo zendlu kaThixo, nomfanekiso ongumqondiso, waya phakathi kwabantu.
Ke kaloku babuyela, basuka, bebeka abantwana babo, nezinto zabo eziphilayo, nezithuthi zabo phambi kwabo.
Ke kaloku, bathe bedlula kude kakhulu endlwini kaMika, abantu abahlala phantsi kwendlu kaMika babizwa ndawonye, babaphulaphule ooDani.
Ke kaloku, xa besithi emva kwabo, abantu bakaDan babuyela, bathi kuMika, Kuthini na okukubi kuwe, ukuba ubize amadoda akho empilweni?
Waphendula wathi, Nizithabatha izithixo zam endizenzayo, nombingeleli wam, nisuka; ndinayo ntoni na eninzi? Ungathi njani ke, Yintoni engalunganga kuwe?
Baphendula abantu bakaDan, besithi, Musani ukungqubana nathi, ukuze kungabikho nabani na otyhafayo kuwe, wena nosapho lwakho niphele ubomi.
Bahamba ke oonyana bakaDan ngendlela yabo. Wabona uMika ukuba banamandla kunaye, wabuyela waya endlwini yakhe.
Bathabatha ke loo nto uMika ayenzeyo, nombingeleli wakhe, bafika eLayisi, kubantu abakhuselekileyo, abangaziyo into; bathabathela phezu kwabo ngeqhwa, bacinezela umzi wabo.
Akukho namnye wabakhusela; ngokuba behlala kude neSidon, bengenakuthethwa nomnye umntu; lo mzi wawukwilali ecaleni kweBhethe-rehobhi. Bawulungisa umzi, bafudukela kuwo oonyana bakaDan.
Bathi igama lakhe nguDan, ngokwegama likaDan utata wabo, owayengunyana kaSirayeli; ke kaloku ngaphambili igama lomzi lalinguLayish.
Amadoda aseDan amisa khona idini labo; uYonathan, unyana kaGershoni, unyana kaMoses, naye nonyana bakhe babe ngababingeleli kwisizukulwana samaDan, de kube lixesha lokuthwala eli lizwe.
Basebenzisa imifanekiso engumqondiso kaMika, awayeyenzayo, zonke iintsuku zokuba indlu kaThixo eSilo.
Ke kaloku, ngale mihla, akubikho ukumkani kuSirayeli. Kwabakho umLevi omnye, wayehlala emazantsi entaba kaEfrayim, wathabatha umfazi wesifazane waseBhetelehem yaseYuda, waba ngumfazi wakhe wesibini.
Waye, ke, ekhohlakele kuye; wayishiya, wabuyela endlwini yoyise, waya eBhetelehem yaseYuda. Wahlala khona iinyanga ezine.

Wafika kuye umfazi wakhe, ukuba athethe naye ngothando, ukuze amthumele kwakhona; wathabatha nomkhonzi wakhe, neesile ezimbini, waza wamzisa endlwini yoyise. Yabona ke yena udade wayo, wayithandazela.
Ke kaloku unyana wakhe, uyise womfana, wamxelela ukuba ahlale; waba naye iintsuku ezintathu, edla, esela, ehlala khona.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe, bavuka kuqala; wamisa unyana wakhe ukuba ahambe. Wathi ke uyise wendodakazi yakhe kumyeni wakhe, Yidla kuqala, ukuze ube nobuchule; emva koko uya kuhamba.
Bahlala ke bobabini, bedla basela ndawonye. Wathi uyise wendodakazi yakhe, Nceda uhlale le busuku, ube nesondlo.
Ke kaloku lo mntu wavuka ukuba ahambe; umyeni wakhe wamnyanzela ukuba ahlale khona; waba khona naleyo busuku.
Ke kaloku, ngemini yesihlanu, wavuka ekuseni ukuba ahambe. Wathi ke uyise wendodakazi yakhe kuye, Yidla ukutya, ukuze uqiniseke; uhlale kude kube lixesha lobusuku. Badla ke bobabini ndawonye.

Wavuka ke lo mntu ukuba ahambe, yena nomfazi wakhe, nomkhonzi wakhe. Wathi unyana wakhe-mntwana, uyise wowesifazane: Yabona, sele kugqityiwe isidlo sangokuhlwa; ndiza kukucela ukuba uhlale apha ngemini, kuba imini idlulile; hlala uphumle, ube nesonka esimnandi, uze ufike endlwini yakho ngoLwesibini kusasa.
Ke kaloku lo mntu akathandabuzi ukuhlala busuku obunye; wavuka, waphuma, waya eYebhusi (leyo yiYerusalem), naye neenkomo zakhe ezibini ezenziwe isikhephe, nomyeni wakhe.
Ke kaloku, befike eJebushe, ubusuku buphelelwe lixesha. Wathi umkhonzi kunkosi wakhe, Yiya, sihlale kuloo mzi wamaYebhusi, siphumle kusasa.
Wathi ukumkani wakhe, Akunjalo; asiyi kungena kumzi wamaSirayeli, apho abantu abakhoyo bebengabaSirayeli; siya kudlula eGibeha.
Wathi ke, Yiya, sifike eGibeha, okanye eRama, sihlale ekuseni kwelinye lawona makhaya.
Bahamba ke; ilanga laphuma, bafika eGibeha, elikwiBhenjamin.
Bahlala khona eGibheha, baphumla khona; bafika ke, baphumla emgwaqweni womzi; kwakungekho mntu wabafumanayo endlwini yabo ukuba baphumle.
Ke kaloku, ngobusuku obuthile, kwafika umntu omdala osuka ekwenzeni umsebenzi wakhe emasimini; lo mntu wayevela kwintlambo kaEfrayim, wahlala eGibeha; abantu baloo ndawo babenguBhenjamin.
Ke kaloku, xa ejonge, wabona lo mkhweli kwindawo evulekileyo yomzi. Wathi umfazi omdala kuye, Uyaphi na? Uvela phi?

Wathi kuye, Sihamba sisuka eBhetelehem yaseYuda, siye emazantsi elizwe eliphakamileyo laseEfraim, apho ndihlala khona; ndafika ke eBhetelehem yaseYuda, ngoku ndiya endlwini kaYehova; akukho namnye uyamthabatha ekhaya.
Sinayo ingqolowa, nesonka seebhokhwe zethu; sinesonka nesiselo sewayini nathi, nam, umkhonzi wakho, nomntwana ohamba nathi; asifuni nantoni na.
Wathi ke lo mntu omdala kuye, Uyamkelekile endlwini yam; ndiza kukulungiselela yonke into oyifunayo; kodwa musa ukuchitha imini kwindawo yomhlaba.
Wamthabatha ke waya endlwini yakhe, waza wazisa iinkunzi zebhokhwe; bahlamba izinyawo zabo, badla, basela.

Ke kaloku, ngelixa bedlala, bona abantu ababi balo mzi bagubungela indlu; babetha umngxunya, batsho nomntu omdala, umnini wendlu, bathi, Thola ngaphandle lo mfazi owafika endlwini yakho, ukuze sithethe naye.
Waphuma ke umnini wendlu, wathi kubo, Hayi, bazalwana bam! Musani ukwenza okubi; lo mntu ungumkhenkethi wam; musani ukwenza loo nto ibuhlungu.
Khangela, kukho intombi yam eyimfanakazi, nenkosikazi yakhe; ndiya kubazisa ngaphandle kuwe ngoku; uyenze kubo konke okunqwenelekayo emlonyeni wakho; kodwa kumntu lowo ungayenzanga loo nto ibuhlungu.
Ke kaloku amadoda awathandabuzi ukumxelela. Wathabatha ke uLevi umkakhe, wamthumela phandle kubo; babemxolela, beyamnqula yonke imini; xa kuvuka ubusuku, bavumela ukuba ahambe.
Ke kaloku, xa kuvuka ubusuku, wabuyela lo mfazi endlwini apho umphathi wakhe ehlala khona; wawela emngxunyeni wendlu, walala khona, de kube limini.
Wavuka ke unyana wakhe ekuseni, wavula isango lendlu, ukuba ahambe indlela yakhe; yabona loo mkakhe-mkakhe phantsi emnyango, enezandla zakhe emngxunyeni wesango.
Wathi kuye, Yiya, sihambe. Ke kaloku akukho mntu waphendulayo; wamthabatha ke phezu kweebhokhwe zakhe, waya ekhaya.
Wafika ke endlwini yakhe, wathabatha isikebhe, wammisa ibe ziinxalenye ezilishumi elinambini, ngamalungu ngamalungu; wabathumela kuwo onke amasango kaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku bonke abakubonayo bathi omnye komnye, Akukho nto injalo ibonakeleyo, nayenziweyo, ukususela ngemini abaSirayeli baphuma ngayo eYiputa; sithi ke, kufuneka siyenze into; sithi ke.
Baphuma ke bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, besuka eDan ukuya eBher-shebha, nelizwe laseGiliyadi, bahlangana ndawonye njengendoda enye phambi koYehova eMizpa.
Ke kaloku, abathetheli bonke abantu beentsapho zakwaSirayeli bathatha indawo yabo engqungqutheleni yabantu bakaThixo; kwaba ngamawaka angamakhulu amane, amadoda ahamba ngeenyawo, asebenzisa ikrele.
Babeva oonyana bakaBhenjamin ukuba amaSirayeli afike eMizpa, basithi ke amaSirayeli, Sixelele ukuba kwenzeka ntoni na loo nto ibuhlungu.
Wathi uLevi, umfazi wowesifazane obulawayo, Ndafika eGibeha kaBhenjamin, mna nenkosikazi yam, ukuba sihlale kusasa.
Ke kaloku, ngobusuku, bafika emva kwam abantu baseGibeha, bagubungela ikhaya, befuna ukundibulala; babhinqa umfazi wam othile, waza wafa.
Ndamthabatha, ndayamquma ngamacandelo, ndazithumela kumaphondo onke ehlabathini lakwaSirayeli; ngokuba bayenze loo nto ingalunganga nenyanzelekayo kuSirayeli.
Ke ngoko, mna oonyana bakaSirayeli bonke, thethani, nindixelele ukuba nicinga ntoni.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bavuka, bethi ngamnye njengomntu omnye: Akukho namnye kuthi oza kungena endlwini yakhe; akukho namnye wethu oza kubuyela endlwini yakhe.
Le nto siza kuyisenza eGibeha; siya kukhupha kuyo, njengokuba kuthethwa ngazo.

Siza kuthatha abantu abalishumi kumakhulu, kuzo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, namadoda amawaka amakhulu, namadoda amawaka amaninzi, ukuba bathuthe izinto zokutya kumkhosi; ukuze, xa umkhosi efika eGibeha kaBhenjamin, abe nethuba lokuwagweba onke amabinzana anobuxoki awenziwe kumaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseSirayeli aye endlwini kaThixo, ahlanganisene njengendoda enye.
Izizwe zakwaSirayeli zathumela amadoda kuzo zonke izizukulwana zikaBhenjamin, zisithi, Yintoni le nto inobungozi obugqithisileyo eya kwenzeka phakathi kwenu?
Ke ngoko, nikelani namadoda amabi eGibeha, ukuze siwafile, sisuse ububi phakathi kwabaSirayeli. Babantu bakaBhenjamin ke abazange baphulaphule oonyana babo abaSirayeli;
Ke kaloku baphuma emizini yabo, bahlangana eGibeha, ukuba babhideke nabaSirayeli.

Ke kaloku amadoda aseBhenjamin ahlanganisane ngaloo mini, esuka emizini yabo, amawaka angamashumi mabini anesithandathu asebenzisa ikrele; kwakunye namadoda anamakhulu asixhenxe akhethiweyo, abahlali baseGibeha.
Ngabo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, kwakukho amadoda angamakhulu asixhenxe akhethiweyo, esebenzisa isandla esisekhohlo; ngamnye wabo wayekwazi ukutshisa iithayile phantsi kweenwele, akabi necala.
Ke kaloku, ngaphandle kukaBhenjamin, amaSirayeli ahlanganisene amadoda angamakhulu amane amawaka, asebenzisa ikrele; onke la madoda aqeqeshiwe.
Baye ke oonyana bakaSirayeli benyuka bafika eBheteli, babuza uThixo, bathi, Nguwuphi oza kuqala phakathi kwethu ukuhlasela abantu bakaBhenjamin? Waphendula iNkosi wathi, UYuda uya kuqala.
Bavuka ke amaSirayeli emveni kwemini, bamisa inqaba eGibeha.
Baphuma oonyana bakaSirayeli, bahlasela oonyana bakaBhenjamin, bamisa isikhundla sokulwa nabo eGibheya.
Baphuma oonyana bakaBhenjamin eGibheha, babulala kumaSirayeli amawaka amashumi mabini anesibini emkhosini ngaloomini.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseSirayeli athabathe intliziyo yakhe, wabuyela endlwini yabo apho ayehlala khona mhla wokuqala.

Baye ke oonyana bakaSirayeli benyuka, bathandaza phambi koYehova, de kube sebusuku; babuza iNkosi, bathi, Siya kuphinda sikhuphe ukuhlasela abazalwana bethu, oonyana bakaBhenjamin? Waphendula iNkosi wathi, Nikhuphe nithabathele kubo.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesibini, bafika amadoda aseSirayeli ahlasela uBhenjamin.
Ke kaloku amaBhenjamin aphuma eGibeha, adibana nabo; babulala abantu abalishumi elinambini elinamawaka kumaSirayeli, bonke besebenzisa ikrele.

Baye ke bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, iqela lonke, banyuka beya eBheteli; bahlala khona, bathandaza phambi koYehova; baphumla ngaloo mini de kube semini, banikela izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo kuYehova.
Babebuza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli iNkosi ukuba bayenze ntoni na. Yaye ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaThixo yayikhona ngaloo mini,

Wathi ke uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Eleazar, unyana ka-Aron, ekhonza phambi kwayo: Bathi ke, Siya kuphinda sikhuphe ukuhlasela oonyana bakaBhenjamin, abazalwana bethu, okanye siya kuyeka? Waphendula iNkosi wathi, Yiya; ngokuba namhlanje ndiya kubanika isandla sakho.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli abeka abantu abafihlakeleyo phezu kweGibheya.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesithathu, benyuka bahlasela oonyana bakaBhenjamin, bamisa isikhundla eGibheya, njengokuba babeyenze ngaphambili.

Baphuma ke oonyana bakaBhenjamin ukuba bahlangane nabo, baqhutywa besuka kumzi; baqalisa ukubulawa kwabaSirayeli, njengokuba kwangaphambili, ezindaweni ezivulekileyo, nakwiindlela, enye ihamba eBheteli, enye ihamba eGibheya, amadoda angamashumi mathathu.
Bathi oonyana bakaBhenjamin, Siyababetha njengangaphambili. Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Siye sihambe, siyabatsala kude kumzi, ukuba bafike kwiindawo zendlela.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseSirayeli asuka endawo yawo, aye eBhayi-thamari; ke amaSirayeli afihlakeleyo aphuma ezweni lakhe, afike eGibheya.
Ke kaloku amawaka alishumi elineshumi, abantu abakhethiweyo bakaSirayeli, bahlasela iGibheya; ukulwa ke kwaba lukhulu kakhulu. Amadoda aseBhenjamin awayazi ukuba isihlwele safika.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wabetha amaBhenjamin phambi kwaSirayeli; oonyana bakaSirayeli babulala ngaloo mini kumaBhenjamin amadoda angamashumi mabini anesihlanu amawaka anamakhulu mahlanu, onke asebenzisa ikrele.
Babona ke oonyana bakaBhenjamin ukuba bahlaselwe; kuba amadoda aseSirayeli athathe indawo phambi kweeBhenjamin, ngenxa yokuba amaSirayeli ayewabalalisa abantu ababebafihla eGibheha.
Ke kaloku abo bafihlakeleyo basuka befika eGibeha, basasazeka, babulala bonke abakwidolophu ngeqhosha.
Ke kaloku madoda aseSirayeli athethe nabafihlakeleyo, ukuba bakhuphe umphunga omkhulu osuka kumzi, ukuze kube ngumqondiso.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseSirayeli abuyela umva emfazweni. Bathi oonyana bakaBhenjamin baqala ukuwabulala amaSirayeli, abamalunga namathathu; bathi ke, Siyawabetha njengakwimfazwe yokuqala;
Ke kaloku, xa umnqamlezo womphunga wawuqala ukunyuka ukusuka kuloo mzi, abantu bakaBhenjamin babuyela ngasemva, babebona umlilo wale dolophu iphela ukhuphuka ezulu.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseSirayeli abuyela kubo; abantu bakaBhenjamin baphoxeka, ngokuba babebona ukuba ingozi ifike kubo.
Babaleka ke phambi kwamadoda aseSirayeli, besuka ezweni elimnyama; abakwazi ukushiya ukulwa. Amadoda aseSirayeli aphuma emadolophini, ayewabulala apho.
Bazijikelezisa oonyana bakaBhenjamin, bathabathela ngaphaya kwabo, babatyhala phantsi ngento elula, emazantsi-mpuma eGibheha.
Bafa ooBhenjamini amawaka alishumi elinamithandathu, bonke abemi abanamandla.

Amanye amaSirayeli ajikeleze, abaleka esiya emhlabathini omnyama, waya kumthi ka-Rimon. AmaSirayeli ke ayewabulala amadoda amawaka amahlanu kwiindawo zendlela; bayawalandela befika eGidomu, wababulala amawaka amabini.
Ke kaloku, bonke ooBhenjamin abafayo ngaloo mini babe ngamawaka amashumi amabini anesixhenxe, abantu abathabatha ikrele; bonke abo bamadoda amakhulu.
Ke kaloku amawaka anamanci mane amadoda abuyela, asuka esiya emlilweni, waya kumthi kaRimon; bahlala khona iinyanga ezine.

Ke kaloku babuyela amadoda aseSirayeli ezweni likaBhenjamin, wabulala onke la madolophu ngesandla sekhephu, namadoda, nezinto eziphilayo, nazo zonke izinto ababezifumana; nawo onke la madolophu abawafika kuwo, wabatshisa umlilo.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseSirayeli aye eMizpa, athi, Akukho namnye kuthi oza kunika intombi yakhe umfazi kumntu waseBhenjamin.
Baye ke abantu bafika eBheteli, behlala khona phambi koThixo kude kube sebusuku, belilindela ngelizwi elikhulu, nolilindela ngokubi.
Bathi, Nkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, kutheni na ukuba kubekho oku kuSirayeli? Kutheni na ukuba kubekho isizukulwana esiseSirayeli namhlanje?
Ke kaloku abantu bavuka kusasa, balungisa khona isibingelelo, banikela ngeentyatyambo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, neentyatyambo zoxolo.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Nguwuphi na umntu phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaSirayeli, ongafikanga engqungqutheleni phambi koYehova? Baye basenza isibingelelo, esithi, Wonke lowo angafikanga phambi koYehova eMizpa, kufuneka aphele.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bakhathazeka ngenxa yabazalwana babo, oonyana bakaBhenjamin; bathi, Namhlanje kuthethwa isizukulwana esinye eSirayeli.
Siza kubafumana njani amadoda abo abaseleyo? Kuba sithe sathi ngelizwi likaYehova, ukuba asibanike nabantwana bethu ukuba babe ngamadoda.
Bathi ke, Zithini na izizwe zakwaSirayeli ezingafikanga kuYehova eMizpa? Bafumanisa ukuba akukho namnye osuka eYabhesi-gileyadi afike emkhosini, ukuze ahlangane.
Babala ke abantu, bafumanisa ukuba akukho namnye kumadoda aseYabhesi eGiliyadi akhona.
Ke kaloku ibandla lathumela amawaka amabini anamashumi mabini, amadoda akhethiweyo phakathi kwabo, bethi, Yiya eYabhesi-gileyadi, nibulala bonke abakhoyo kuyo ngeqhwa, namadoda nabantwana.
Bathi, Le nto niyenzayo; bulala onke amabhinqa namabhinqa onke, asele entliziyweni yomfazi.
Bafumanisa phakathi kwabahlali baseYabheshi eGiliyadi, amabhinqa angamakhulu amane, amadodakazi, angazange ahlangane nomfazi; bathabathela ke kubo emkhosini waseShilo, ezweni laseKanan.
Ke kaloku ibandla lonke lathumela izilumkiso zoxolo kubafazi bakaBhenjamin, elunxwemeni lweRimon.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseBhenjamin abuyela ngaloo xesha, ayewafumana amabhinqa aseYabhesi eGiliyadi, abo bashiyeke; ke kaloku abazange babe nenani labo bonke.
Ke kaloku abantu bakhathazeka ngenxa kaBhenjamin, ngokuba iNkosi wenza umngxunya phakathi kwezizwe zakwaSirayeli.
Bathi amadoda amakhulu ebandla, Abafazi bakaBhenjamin babulawa; siza kubafumana njani amabhinqa abo bantu abaseleyo?
Bathi ke, Kufuneka kubekho ooyise abaseleyo kuBhenjamin, ukuze kungabikho isizukulwana esiseSirayeli silahlekile.
Ke thina asikwazi ukubanika oonyana bethu ukuba babe ngabafazi; ngokuba sithe sathi, AbaSirayeli, Kubikele umntu onika umfazi kumntu waseBhenjamin.
Ke kaloku, bona, kukho isikhumbuzo sonyaka sikarhulumente eShilo, esentshona yeBheteli, ngasentshonalanga yendlela iphumayo eBheteli iye eShekem, emzantsi weLebona.
Bathi ke kumadoda aseBhenjamin, Yiya, ufihlakele ezityeni zewayini.

Uthe ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses: Yabona, xa iinkunzi zeenkomo zaseShilo ziphuma zidlale, niphumeni ngaphaya kwezityalo zewayini; nithatheni ngamnye kuni indoda phakathi kwabafazi baseShilo, niye ezweni likaBhenjamin.

Ke kaloku, xa abazali babo, nabazalwana babo, besiya kuthi, bethi, Nceda, zinikele kubo ngenxa yethu; ngokuba asibathatheli amadoda abo emfazweni, nize nizinike abantwana benu kubo; ngoko ke, akuyi kubakho monakalo kuwe.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaBhenjamin oko, bathabathe ngamnye umfazi omtshakazi, xa bedlala, bamthabatha ukuba abe ngumfazi wakhe; babuyela ezweni labo, babezilungisa iidolophu zabo, babehlala kuzo.
Ke kaloku basuka oonyana bakaSirayeli kuloo xesha, babuyela ezweni labo, ngamadodakazi abo, ngamachibi abo, ngamnye ezweni lakhe.
Ngaloo mihla, kwabakho amaSirayeli angakumkani; umntu ngamnye wayesenza oko kwakulungileyo emehlo akhe.
Ruth: Kwiintsuku apho abagwebi belawula khona amaSirayeli, kwabakho indlala ezweni; waphuma umfazi omnye waseBhetelehem yaseYuda, waza waya esixekweni samaMowabhi, yena nomkakhe nabantwana bakhe ababini.
Igama lomntu lalinguElimeleki, igama lomfazi wakhe linguNaomi; amagama oonyana bakhe ababini nguMahlone noKilyone: babeziEfrati abasuka eBhetelehem yaseYuda. Baye bafika kumaMowabhi, baba khona apho.
Wafa ke uElimeleki, umfazi kaNaomi; washiya yena oonyana bakhe ababini.
Bathe bazala amadoda aseMowabhi; igama elinye lalinguOrfa, elinye linguRuthi. Bahlala khona iminyaka elishumi.
Bafa nabo bobabini, uMahlone noKilyone; washiya uNaomi oonyana bakhe ababini nomfazi wakhe.
Wathi ke uNaomi, xa waye eMowabhi, wava ukuba iNkosi waya kusindisa abantu bakhe, wabanika isonka; waza wavuka yena neentombi zakhe zomtshana, aze abuye eMowabhi.
Ke kaloku waphuma endlwini yakhe apho wayehlala khona, waya kwindlela yokubuyela ezweni likaYuda, yena neentombi zakhe ezibini zendodana.
Wathi uNaomi kumadodakazi akhe amabini, Yiya mnye niye endlwini yomyeni wenu; iNkosi anibonise ububele, njengokuba nani nabanikele ububele oomfazi benu abafileyo, nam.
UYehova aninike niphumle, ngamnye kuni endlwini yomyeni wakhe. Wabaphola ke, wabashiya; bathandaza ngelizwi elikhulu;
bathi kuye, Hayi; thina siza kubuyela nawe kubomi bakho.
Wathi ke uNaomi, Yiya, zintathu zam. Niza kuphi na ukuba nihambe nam? Ndiza kuba nonyana abaninzi na ukuba babe ngabafazi benu?
Yiya, zintathu zam; kuba mna ndikhulu ngokwaneleyo ukuba ndingatshatanga. Nakuba ndithi ke ukuba kukho ithemba kum, nakuba ndenze umtshato namhlanje, ndazala oonyana,
Ingaba ulinde ukuba bakhule? Ingaba uhlale ungatshati ngenxa yabo? Hayi, zintathu zam! Intliziyo yam ibuhlungu kakhulu kunenu; ngokuba isandla sikaYehova sitshintshile kum.
Ke kaloku baqhubeka belilingisa ngelizwi elikhulu; uOrfa ke wamxolela umyeni wakhe-mbi, kodwa uRute wahlala naye.
Wathi ke uNaomi, Yabona, umyeni wakho-mkakhe ubuyela kubomi bakhe noThixo wakhe; buyela naye.

Waphendula ke uRuthi, wathi, Musa kundicela ukuba ndikushiye, ndibuyele emva kwakho; apho uya kungena khona ndiya kungena; apho uhlala khona ndiya kuhlala; abantu bakho babe ngabantu bam, iNkosi yakho ibe yiNkosi yam.
Ndiza kufa apho ufa khona, ndiza kufa khona, ndiza kuvulwa khona. UYehova andigwebe, amnike ngaphezu kwayo yonke loo nto, ukuba akukho nto imisa phakathi kwam nowe, ngaphandle kokufa.
Ke kaloku, uNaomi ebona ukuba uRute umiselwe ngokuqinileyo ukuba ahambe naye, wayeka ukumncoma.
Bahamba ke abo madoda amabini, bafika eBheteli. Ke kaloku, befika apho, umzi wonke waqhutywa ngenxa yabo; bathi ke oomfazi, NguNaomi na lo?
Wathi kubo, Musani kundibiza ngokuba nguNaomi; mnikele igama elithi Mara; kuba uThixo Onamandla onke wamnika ubomi bam umsindo omkhulu.
Ndaphuma ndigcwele, ke iNkosi wandibuyisela ungenanto. Kutheni le nto nindibiza ngokuba nguNaomi? UYehova wathetha kum, lowo unamandla onke wamnika umonakalo.
Wabuyela ke uNaomi eMowabhi, naye noRuthi umMowabhi, intombi yakhe yomtshato; bafika eBhetelehem, xa kwaqala ukuvuna iswele.
Ke kaloku uNaomi wayenenkosikazi ecaleni lomyeni wakhe, igama layo nguBowazi; lo mntu waba ngumntu onamandla, umhle, owasuka kusapho lukaElimeleki.
Wathi uRuthi, umMowabhi, kuNaomi, Ndiya kuphuma ezweni, ndiyikhuphe ingqolowa eyonwabisayo, emva komntu ondiyelayo kum. Wathi uNaomi kuye, Yiya, intombi yam.
Waphuma ke, wathabatha iziqhamo ezindaweni ezisemva kwabathethwayo; kwathi xa wayesendaweni yoBowazi, osuka kusapho luka-Elimeleki, waya kwenza umsebenzi wakhe.
Ke kaloku, uBowazi wafika eBhetelehem, wababulali abavunayo, wathi, UYehova abe nani. Baphendula bathi, UYehova akubhaleleni.
Wathi uBhowabhi kumphathi wakhe, Uthini na lo mntwana?
Waphendula lo mntu, wathi, Lowo ngumfazi waseMowabhi, owabuya noNaomi eMowabhi.

Wathi, Nceda, ndiya kuthatha iziqhamo ezishiyekileyo phakathi kweengxowa ezingxamisweni zabasebenzi. Wafika ezweni, wasebenza ukususela emveni kwemini ukuya kuthi ga ngoku, ngaphandle kokuphumla kancinci kwindlu yokuhlala.
Wathi ke uBowazi kuRuthi, Ndimxelele, intombi yam; musa ukuya kukhupha iziqhamo esinye isiqhamo; musa ukushiya le ndawo; hlala apha namabhinqa am asebenza kum.

Khangela apho amadoda eqokelela khona, ulandele emva kwabafazi; kuba ndathi kumadoda ukuba angakuxhathisi. Ke kaloku, xa nithe ninethamsanqa, phumani nisele emanzini emabhotileni abo amadoda agcweleyo.
Ke kaloku, uRakeli wahlangula ngobuso bakhe ehlabathini, wathi kuye, Kutheni na ukuba uyayiqonda le nto, ukuba ndimnye umntu othile?

Waphendula ke uBowashi, wathi, Kuthe kwathiwa kum zonke izinto ozenzayo kuyisekazi wakho, ukususela ekufeni komyeni wakho; ukuba ushiye ubaba wakho nomama wakho, nelizwe lakho elizalisekileyo, wafika phakathi kwabantu ongawaziyo ngaphambili.
UYehova akuhlawulele oko wakwenzayo; ube mkhulu umvuzo wakho kuYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, owafika ukuba uhlale phantsi kwamaphiko akhe.
Wathi ke yena, Ndifumane inceba phambi kwakho, nkosi yam; usindisele mna, wathetha ngomphefumlo wam umkhonzi wakho, nakuba andinguye mnye wabakhonzi bakho.

Wathi kuye uBowabhi, ngexesha lokutya, Yiya apha, uthathe isonka, uyitshise kulo mxube. Waye ehlala phakathi kwabathethwayo; wamnika iziqhamo eziphekiweyo; wadla konke okumnqwenelayo, washiya nantoni na.
Wavuka ke uBowazi ukuba athabathe imbewu, wathi kumadoda akhe, Avumeleke ukuba athabathe imbewu phakathi kweengxowa; musa ukumnqula.
Ke kaloku, uthabathe kuye iziqhamo ezithile ezisuka kwiintyatyambo, uzishiye aze azikhuphe; musa ukumxelela ukuba ahambe.
Wathi ke uRuthi, wathabatha ingqolowa entlango, waya kusasa; waza watywina isiqhamo sakhe esithe sathabathayo, safika sakuba ziitoni ezilishumi elinazine.
Wazithwala waya edolophini; wabona unyana wakhe-mntwana ukuba mkhulu kangakanani na umsebenzi wakhe. URute ke wamthabatha, wamnika okuseleyo kwakhe, emva kokuba ephekile.

Wathi kuye umyeni wakhe, Uphi na apho usebenzele khona namhlanje? Uphi na apho usebenzele khona? Mhle lowo mntu wambonayo wena! Wathi ke uRuthi kumyeni wakhe ngowo wayesebenza naye; wathi, Igama lomntu endisebenzela naye namhlanje nguBowazi.

Wathi uNaomi kunyanakazi wakhe, UYehova amsindise; kuba akazange asuse ububele bakhe kubo bonke abaphilayo nabafayo. Yathi ke yena, Lo mntu ungumhlobo wethu osondeleyo, ungumnye wabakhokelayo bethu, ukuba asikhuphe.
Wathi ke uRuthi, umMowabhi, Wathi nam, Uhlale kunye nabasebenzi bam, de bagqibe ukuvuna yonke ingqolowa yam.
Wathi uNaomi kuRute, inkosikazi yakhe, Kulungile kuwe, intombi yam, ukuba uhambe kunye nabafazi abasebenza kuye; ukuze ungabi necala ezweni lenye.
Wahlala ke uRute phantsi kwamadodana kaBowazi, eqokelela iziqhamo, de kube kugqityiwe ukuvuna ingqolowa nengqolowa. Wahlala noyisekazi wakhe.
Wathi uNaomi, umkakhe uRuthi, kuye, Intombi yam, ndiza kukufumanisa indawo yokuhlala, ukuze uhlale khona.
UBhowabhi, oonyana bakhe abaye basebenza naye, ngukumkani wethu; ke yena namhlanje ubusuku uya kuhlukanisa ingqolowa nebhokhwe kwigumbi lokutyisa.
Ke ngoko, hlamba, usebenzise ivumba lakho, ugqoke izihlangu zakho ezilungileyo; uyeke ke uthabathe umthi wokukhulisa iziqhamo; angazi ukuba ukhona, de aphele ekudleni kwakhe nokusela.
Ke kaloku, xa ehleli, qaphela indawo apho ehleli khona; uye ke ke, uvule izitulo zakhe, uhlele; yena uya kukuxelela into omele uyiyenze.
Waphendula uRute wathi, Ndiza kwenza konke okuthethayo.
Wahla ke, wenyuka waya esidlangalaleni, wazenza zonke izinto ebemxelela ngazo umkakhe-mbi.
Ke kaloku, xa uBowashe egqibile ukudla nokusela, ingqondo yakhe ihlelekile, waphuma waya kuhlala ecaleni lomthi weentyatyambo. Wafika ke uRute ngelizwi elincinci, waveza izinyawo zakhe, wahlala.
Ke kaloku, ephakathi kobusuku, kwathi ke, kubekho into eyaphazamisa lo mntu; wajika, yabona indoda ilala emadolo akhe.
Wathi kuye, Ubani na wena? Wathi yena, NdinguRute umkhonzi wakho. Yathi ke uRuthe, Nciphisa phezu kwam isiqingatha sempahla yakho; ngokuba ungumntu othembekileyo, ukuze undisindise;
Wathi kuye, UYehova akubhaptize wena, intombi yam! Lo mnqamlezo mkhulu kunalowo wangaphambili; awuzange uhambe emva kwamadoda amancinci, nokuba maninzi nakuba ambalwa.
Ke ngoko, intombi yam, musa ukukhathazeka; yonke into oyithethayo ndiya kuyenza kuwe; kuba bonke abantu bedolophu yam bayazi ukuba umfazi olungileyo.
Ngokuqinisekileyo ndingumntu okhuselayo usapho lwam, onokukundisindisa; kodwa kukho umntu omnye oneentliziyo ezifana nam.

Uhlale apha kusasa; ukuba unqwenela ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe wokugcina ikhaya lakho, kulungile, aze akuhlawulele. Ke ukuba akathandabuzi ukukwenza loo nto, njengokuba iNkosi ephilayo, ndiya kukulungisa; uphumle apha kude kube mhla.
Wahlala ke enyawo lwakhe de kube kusasa; wavuka ke phambi kokuba umntu akwazi ukuwaqonda. Uthe ke, Akukho namnye oza kukwazi ukuba umfazi ufike kwigumbi lokuhlamba.
Wathi ke, Yazisa kum intyatyambo yakho, uyibeke phambi kwam. Wayibeka phambi kwakhe. Wathi ke yena, Iintonga ezintandathu zesoya azithele kuyo, wazisa phezu kwayo; wabuyela edolophini.
Wafika ke uRute kumkakhe, wathi uNaomi kuye, Kubekho ntoni na, intombi yam? Yathi yena kuye zonke izinto azenzayo kuye uBowashe.
Wathi ke, Wandinika le milinganiselo emihlanu yesonka, wathi, Musa ukubuyela kumyeni wakho-mbi ngesandla esingenanto.
Wathi ke uNaomi, Yima, intombi yam, de wazi ukuba kwenzeka ntoni na; kuba lo mntu akayi kuphumla, ukuze le nto igqibeke namhlanje.

Ke kaloku uBhohazi wanyuka waya emnyango wedolophu, wahlala khona. Yathi ke, ngelo xesha, wafika umphathi-ndlu, owathetha ngawo; wathi ke uBhohazi, Yiya apha, mhlobo wam, uhlale. Wafika ke, wahlala khona.
Ke kaloku uBowazi wathabatha amadoda amakhulu edolophini, wathi kubo, Nxibele apha. Bathi ke ngoko.
Wathi ke kuye uNaomi, umphathi wendlu, UNaomi, obuyayo eMowabhi, uthengisa inxalenye yehlabathi, eya kuElimeleki, umzalwana wethu.

Ke kaloku ndithi, Ndiya kukuxelela ukuba uyithengise phambi kwamadoda ahlala apha, nangaphambili kwabakhulu belizwe lam; ukuba ufuna ukuyithenga, uyenze; kodwa ukuba awufuni ukuyithenga, sithi, ukuze ndiyazi; kuba akukho namnye onelungelo lokuyithenga ngaphandle kwakho, mna ke ndilandelayo. Wathi, Ndiza kuyithenga.
Wathi ke uBowazi, Ngomhla wokuba uthengise loo mhlaba kuNaomi, uya kuthatha noRuthi umMowabhi, indodana yomfazi, ukuze igama lomfazi ligcinwe kwimpahla yakhe.
Ke kaloku unyana wosapho wathi, Andiyi kuyikhupha ke ngoko, ukuze ndize ndiyimise engozini iimpahla zam; uyikhuphe wena ngokwakho; mna andikwazi ukuyilungisa.

Ke kaloku, kwabakho ngaphambili eSirayeli isithethe esinjalo sokubuyiselwa, nokutshintshiselana ngempahla: umntu omnye wayewukhupha umnqamlezo wakhe, waya kumnye, ukuze kuqinisekiswe. Yaye loo nto yayiyimimiselo yomthetho eSirayeli.
Wathi ke umphathi wendlu kuBowazi, Yithengise wena. Wayikhupha ke intloko yakhe.
Wathi ke uBowazi kubakhulu nabantakwabo bonke abantu, Niyimaxhoba namhlanje, ukuba ndizithengise zonke izinto zikaElimeleki, noKiliyon noMahlon, kumkaNaomi.

Ke kaloku ndithathe uRuthi, umMowabhi, indodakazi kaMahloni, ukuba abe ngumfazi wam; ukuze igama lomfazi ligcinwe kwipropathi yakhe; ukuze igama lakhe lingacimi phakathi kosapho lwakhe, nakwidolophu yakhe. Niyimaxhoba namhlanje.

Bathi ke abakhulu, nabo bonke abantu emnyango, Siyishukumisa loo nto; iNkosi ayenze loo ndoda iphumayo ekhaya lakho ibe njengoRakeli noLeya, abo babini abasunguli bosapho lwakwaSirayeli; ube nempumelelo eEfrata, ube negama eBhetelehem.
Usapho lwakho lube lufana nosapho lukaPerezi, owawuzala uThamari kuYuda, ngenxa yabantwana abaya kukunika wona iNkosi kulo mntwana.
Wathabatha ke uBowazi uRuthi, waba ngumfazi wakhe; wathandana naye; iNkosi wamvumela ukuba akhulelwe, waza wazala umntwana.
Bathi amabhinqa kuNaomi, Lukhululwe iNkosi, owenza ukuba ungabikho mntu wosapho kuwe namhlanje; abe ngumnqamlezo eSirayeli.
Uya kukuvuselela uphefumlo lwakho, nawe uya kukuzilungisa izihlwele zakho; ngokuba umyeni wakho wenkosikazi, okuthanda wena, wamzala yena, lowo ungcono kuwe kuneenyana ezisibhozo.
Wathi ke uNaomi, wamthabatha lo mntwana emlonyeni wakhe, wamzala.
Bathi amadoda ahlala khona apho, UNaomi unenyana; babiza igama lakhe ngokuba nguObedi. Waye utata kaYese, utata kaDavide.
Lezo ziintsapho zikaPerezi: uPerezi waba nguyise kaHeshroni;
uHeshron waba nguyise kaRam, uRam waba nguyise kaAmminadab;
uAminadabi waba nguyise kaNahshon, uNahshon waba nguyise kaSalmon,
uSalmon waba nguyise kaBhohazi, uBhohazi waba nguyise kaObedi,
uObedi waba nguyise kaYese, uJese waba nguyise kaDavide.
1Sam: Ke kaloku kwabakho umntu okuthiwa nguElkana, waseRamathaim-zofim, ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim; waba ngunyana kaYeroham, unyana kaElihu, unyana kaTohu, unyana kaSufe, wesizwe sikaEfrayim.
Wayenabafazi ababini, uHanna noPhenina. UPhenina wayenezingane; uHanna ke akabikho.
Ke kaloku uElkana waya minyaka le emzini wakhe, ethandaza, enikela izibingelelo kuYehova wemikhosi eShilo; oonyana ababini bakaEli, uHofeni noPhenehasi, babe ngababingeleli beNkosi.
Ke kaloku, xa uElkana enikela idini lakhe, wayemnika umkakhe uPhenina, nabantwana bakhe bonke, neentsana zakhe zonke, inxenye.
UHannah ke wamnika inxenye ephindwe kabini, ngokuba wayemthanda; kodwa iNkosi wamthintela ukuba angazali.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba iNkosi wamthintela ukuba angabi nabantwana, uPhenina, umncinane wakhe, wayemxelela ngezinto ezibuhlungu, ukuze amxolele.
Yathi loo nto iminyaka ngeminyaka; xa uHanna enyuka waya endlwini kaYehova, uPhenina wayemxolela, de wagula, akayi kudla.
Wathi kuye uElkana, umfazi wakhe, UHanna, kutheni na ulilindela? Kutheni na ungadlanga? Kutheni na ukhathazekile kakhulu? Andiyi kuba ndingcono kuwe kuneenyana ezilishumi?
Ke kaloku, xa begqibile ukutya nokusela eShilo, wavuka uHanna. UEli umbingeleli wayehlala kwisitulo sakhe, ecaleni komngxunya wesango lendlu kaYehova.
Ke kaloku uHanna wathandaza kuYehova, ephefumla kakhulu.

Wathi, UYehova wamaSirayeli, ukuba ujonge ububi bomkhonzi wakho, undikhumbulayo, ungamlibali umkhonzi wakho, ubemnika unyana wesifazane, ndiya kumnikela kuYehova yonke imihla yakhe; ayisayi kungena intsontelo ekhanda lakhe ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku, xa wayeqhubeka ethandaza kuYehova, uEli wayejonga umlomo wakhe.
Ke kaloku uHanna wayethandaza entliziyweni yakhe; imilenze yakhe yayihamba, kodwa ingoma yayo ayithethiswanga. Wathi ke uEli ukuba uHanna usele.
Wathi kuye, Uza kuhlala usela ixesha elingakanani? Nciphisa iwayini yakho.
Waphendula ke uHanna, wathi, Akunjalo, nkosi yam; mna ngumfazi othambileyo kakhulu; andikhe ndisele iwayini namanzi abandayo; ndenzakele umphefumlo wam kuYehova.
Musa ukucinga ukuba umkhonzi wakho ungumfazi olungileyo; kuba ndithandaza apha ngenxa yoxinzelelo lwam olukhulu, nobuhlungu bam.
Waphendula ke uEli, wathi, Yiya ngoxolo; uThixo kaSirayeli akunike isipho sakho osicelayo kuye.
Wathi ke yena, Mna umkhonzi wakho ndifumane inceba emehlweni akho. Wahamba uYosefu ngendlela yakhe, wadla isidlo; ibuso bakhe abuzange bube buhlungu.
Ke kaloku bavuka kusasa, bathandaza phambi koYehova, babuyela ekhaya labo eRama. UElkana wathanda uHanna, indoda yakhe; ke iNkosi wamkhumbula.
Wathi ke uHanna, emva kwexesha elithile, wakhulelwa, waza wazala unyana; wathi igama lakhe nguSamuweli, esithi, Ngokuba ndiwucela kuYehova.
Ke kaloku uElkana, umfazi wakhe, waya phezulu, yena nosapho lwakhe lonke, ukuba anikezele kuYehova idini lemihla ngemihla, nedini lakhe.
UHanna ke akayeki; wathi kumfazi wakhe, Xa unyana ephelelwe ngumntwana, ndiya kumthabatha, ndimbonise phambi koYehova, aze ahlale khona ubomi bonke.
Wathi kuye uElkana, umfazi wakhe, Yenza oko kulungileyo emehlo akho; hlala apha, de umnqule. Ke kaloku iNkosi akwenze ilizwi lakhe. Yahlala ke, yanomnqula unyana wayo, de wamnqule.

Ke kaloku, emva kokuba ephumile, wamthabatha lo mntwana naye, kuba wayemncinci, nenyama yenkomo eneminyaka emithathu ubudala, namashumi asixhenxe eetoni zomgubo, nebhotile yewayini; wamthabatha waya endlwini kaYehova eShilo.
Ke kaloku, babhiyozela inkunzi yenkomo, bamthabatha lo mntwana kuye uEli.
Wathi ke uHanna kuye, Nceda, nkosi yam; njengokuba ubomi bakho buphilayo, mna ndiwo lomfazi ohlala apha ecaleni kwakho, ethandaza kuYehova.
Ndathandaza ngonyana lowo; iNkosi wandinika into endiyicelayo kuye.
Ke ngoko, ngoku ndimnika iNkosi; kuzo zonke iintsuku zobomi bakhe uya kunikezelwa kuYehova. Bawukhonza khona iNkosi.
Wathandaza ke uHanna, wathi, Intliziyo yam igcwele uthando kuYehova; ngenxa yokuba iNkosi wandinika amandla; ndiya kuthandazela abathunywa bam; ngokuba ndiyavuya, kuba usindise.
Akukho namnye ongcwele njengoYehova; akukho namnye ngaphandle kwakho. Akukho mlilo ufana noThixo wethu.
Mhlawumbi iNkosi nguThixo owaziyo zonke izinto, Uyivavanya indlela yomsebenzi womntu.
Iziqhamo zabanqolobi abanamandla ziqhutywa; kodwa abo baphazamisayo bafumana amandla.
Bathi ke abaninzi basebenzela ukutya; kodwa abo babenandlala bangabi nandlala. Umbhinqa ongayizali, wazala amadoda asixhenxe; kodwa umbhinqa oneenyana ezininzi, uphelelwe luthando.
UYehova ubangela ukufa, uphilalisa; Wabakhupha abantu emazulwini, wababeka phantsi.
UYehova wenza abafazi nabafazi, akhupha abafazi, akhupha abafazi, aphakama abafazi.
Uwukhupha umhlwempu emthethweni, Uwuphakamisa umfazi engqondweni; Wabamisa phakathi kwabakhulu, Wabanika indawo yobudumo. Iziseko zehlabathi ziye kuYehova, Wabeka phezu kwazo ihlabathi liphela.
Uya kuzikhusela izikhokelo zabantu bakhe abathembekileyo; Ke kaloku ababi baya kutshisa emthunzini; Akukho namnye ophumelela ngomandla akhe.
Abachaphazelayo iNkosi baya kuqhutywa; uya kubathutha ngethutyana ezulu kubo. UYehova uza kugweba ihlabathi liphela; uya kumnika amandla ukumkani wakhe, uyamqinisa okhethiweyo wakhe.
Wabuyela uElkana ekhaya lakhe, eRama; lo mntwana ke wahlala ekhonza iNkosi phambi koEli ukumkani.
Ke kaloku oonyana bakaEli babe ngabantu ababi; bengenakumhlonela iNkosi.
Ke kaloku kwaba njalo ababingeleli besenza kubo abantu; xa umntu enikela idini, wayefika umkhonzi wombingeleli, ngelixa lishushu inyama, enesiqhamo esithathu.
Wayitshisa kwibhotile, okanye kwisitya sokutya, okanye kwisitya sokupheka; nantoni na eyanyukayo nge-fork, umbingeleli wayeyithatha yena. Bakwenza njalo kubo bonke ooSirayeli abafika eShilo.
Ke kaloku, phambi kokuba batshise utywala, wayefika umkhonzi wombingeleli, wathi kulowo wanikelayo, Ninikele umbingeleli inyama yokupheka; akuyi kuthatha kuwe inyama ecocekileyo, kodwa ishushu.

Ke kaloku, xa wayethi kuye loo mntu, Nceda kuqhutywe kuqala utywala, ke emva koko uthathe konke okufunayo; waphendula lo mkhonzi wathi, Hayi, ndininike ngoku; ukuba ungandiniki, ndiya kukuthabatha ngesandla.
Ke kaloku idini laba madoda amancinci likhulu kakhulu ngamehlo kaYehova; ngokuba baphulaphule umnikelo kaYehova.
Ke kaloku uSamuweli wayekhonza phambi koYehova; waba ngumntwana, egqoke i-ephod yelinen, nebhanti yo sacerdote.
Waye uyise eyenza kuye ibhanti elincinane, wayithabatha kuye ngonyaka ngamnye, xa ehamba phezulu nomfazi wakhe, ukunikela isibingelelo sonyaka.
UEli wayebhaptiza uElkana no zazhla wakhe, esithi, UYehova akunike wena abantwana kuloo mfazi, endaweni yonyana awayewucela uThixo, ayemnika iNkosi. Ke kaloku babuyela ekhaya labo.
UYehova wamthanda uHanna; wakhulelwa, waza wazala oonyana abathathu neentombi ezimbini. Ke kaloku lo mntwana uSamuweli wayekhula phambi koYehova.
Ke kaloku uEli waba mkhulu kakhulu; wava ke zonke izinto abazenzayo oonyana bakhe kubo bonke amaSirayeli, nokuba balele nabafazi abasebenza emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana.
Wathi kubo, Yintoni na le nto niyenzayo loo zinto? Ndiziva kubantu bonke izinto ezibi nizenzayo.
Hayi, oonyana bam! Ilizwi endilifumeneyo phakathi kwabantu bakaYehova alilunganga; nibakhokelelani ekubeni babenesono.

Xa umntu ephelelwa ngumphefumlo ngumfazi wakhe, uThixo uya kumlungisa; ke kaloku xa umntu epheliswa ngumphefumlo nguYehova, ngubani na oza kuthetha kuye? Ke kaloku oonyana bakhe abawuphulaphuli umlomo kayise wabo; ngokuba iNkosi wayethe wagqiba ukuwafa.
Ke kaloku lo mntwana uSamuweli wayekhula, waqhubeka ethandeka kuYehova, nakwaba bantu.
Ke kaloku kwafika umntu kaThixo kuEli, wathi kuye, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Andizange ndibonakaliswe ntoni na endlwini yoyise wakho, xa babe ngabakhonzi bakaFaro eYiputa?

Ndiwakhethela utata wakho phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaSirayeli, ukuba abe ngumbingeleli wam, ukuba athabathe isibingelelo sam, aze amsindise umnqamlezo, agqoke i-ephod phambi kwam; ndazinika ke indlu yotata wakho zonke izipho zokutya zabaSirayeli.

Ngoko ke, kutheni na ukuba nizithobele izibingelelo zam, nezinikezelo zam, endiziwiselayo indlu yam? Kutheni na ukuba nizihloniphe oonyana benu ngaphezu kwam, nize ningabi neentyatyambo ezilungileyo kuzo zonke izinikezelo zabantu bam uSirayeli?

Utsho ke iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, Ndithe ndathi, Intsapho yakho iya kuba ngababingeleli bam ngonaphakade; kodwa ngoku utsho iNkosi, Akuyi kuqhubeka njalo; ndiya kunika ubukumkani kubo abanika ubukumkani kum; bona abandixhaphazelayo baya kugwetywa.
Ngokuba ziya kufika iintsuku, xa ndiza kukucinezela amandla akho, namandla endlu yakho; ukuze akukho namnye kusapho lwakho oza kuba mkhulu.
Uya kubona ubuhlungu endlwini yam, xa kuthe kwenziwa izinto ezilungileyo kumaSirayeli; akuyi kubakho mntu kwindlu yakho oza kuhlala ixesha elide.

Nabani na phakathi kwenu, endiyi kucima, ukuba angasebenzisi isibingelelo sam, amehlo akho aya kuba neentyatyambo kuphela, intliziyo yakho iya kuba neentyatyambo; zonke iziqhamo zakho ziya kufa ekufumaneni ubomi.
Kwaye oku kuza kuba nguphawu kuwe, oko kuza kwenzeka oonyana bakho ababini, uHofeni noPinehasi; baya kufa bobabini ngaloo mini.
Ndiza kumphakamisa umbingeleli othembekileyo, onokuzenza zonke izinto ezikwingqondo yam; ndiya kumnika indlu eqinileyo; baya kukhonza ukumkani endiwukhethileyo ngonaphakade.

Ke kaloku bonke abaseleyo endlwini yakho baya kungena, bathabathele phambi kwakhe, befuna isiqingatha sesilivere, nesiqingatha sesonka; baza bathi, Nceda, ndininike umsebenzi wombingeleli, ndidlale ukudla.
Ke kaloku lo mntwana uSamuweli wayekhonza iNkosi ecaleni kukaEli. Ngaloo mihla, ilizwi likaYehova lalingabikho rhoqo, akukho maphupha amaninzi.
Ke kaloku, ngobusuku obuthile, uEli wayelele endlwini yakhe; amehlo akhe ayemdaka kakhulu, ukuba angabona.
Ke kaloku ilanga likaThixo alizange litshiswe; uSamuweli wayelele endlwini kaYehova, apho kukho khona itekisi yomnqophiso kaThixo.
Wabiza iNkosi uSamuweli; waphendula uSamuweli wathi, Ndikho apha.
Ke kaloku wabaleka waya kuEli, wathi, Ndikho apha; mna ke ndimbiza. Wathi ke uEli, Andikukubizanga; buyela uphumle. Waphuma ke, waphumla.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wabiza kwakhona, wathi, USamuweli! Wavuka ke uSamuweli, waya kuEli, wathi, Ndikho apha; mna ke ndimbiza. Wathi uEli, Unyana wam, andikumbiza; buyela uphumle.
Ke kaloku uSamuweli wayesengumntu owaziyo iNkosi; ilizwi likaThixo alizange livele kuye.
UYehova wambiza uSamuweli kathathu; wavuka ke uSamuweli, waya kuEli, wathi, Ndikho apha; mna uyayibiza. Waqonda ke uEli ukuba nguYehova owamwisela lo mntwana.
Wathi ke uEli kuSamuweli, Yiya uphumle; ukuba akubiza, uthi, Utsho, Nkosi yam; kuba umkhonzi wakho uthetha. Waphuma ke uSamuweli, waphumla endlwini yakhe.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waya, wahlala khona, wabiza njengokuqala, esithi, USamuweli, uSamuweli! Wathi ke uSamuweli, Bhala; kuba umkhonzi wakho uthetha.
Wathi iNkosi kuSamuweli, Yabona, ndiza kwenza into ezweni laseSirayeli, ukuba wonke lowo uyivayo, indlebe yakhe iya kuba yintlungu.
Ngelo xesha ndiya kuzilungisa phezu kukaEli zonke izinto endizithethayo malunga nendlu yakhe, ukusukela ekuqalekeni kuye kukuphela.
Ndamxelela ukuba ndiya kuxolela intsapho yakhe ngonaphakade, ngenxa yesono sakhe ebesaziyo; ke kaloku oonyana bakhe babeka ubomi babo emlonyeni, akawathinteli.
Ke kaloku ndathi ngesandla sam kusapho luka-Eli, Ndithi, Isono sosapho luka-Eli asiyi kuthotywa ngomnikelo, nokuba ngumnikelo wokudla.
Walala ke uSamuweli kude kube kusasa, wavula ke iindonga zendlu kaYehova; waxoka ukuba acacise kuEli loo mzekeliso.
Ke kaloku uEli wambiza, wathi, USamuweli, unyana wam. Waphendula uSamuweli, esithi, Ndikho apha.
Wathi ke uEli, Yintoni loo nto athethe ngayo kuwe? Uthe ke uEli, Musa ukufihla kum; Thixo akuyenze njalo-njalo nawe, ukuba ungazifihla kum nantoni na ethethayo kuwe.
Wathi ke uSamuweli kuye zonke izinto, angazifihlanga nto kuye. Wathi ke uEli, NguYehova yena; ayenze into elungileyo emlonyeni wakhe.
Waye iNkosi noSamuweli. Wakhula ke uSamuweli, wawenza ukuba aphumeze onke amazwi kaSamuweli.
Bayazi ke bonke amaSirayeli, ukusuka eDan waya eBher-shebha, ukuba uSamuweli nguprofeti kaYehova.
Waqhubeka iNkosi ebonakalalisa eShilo, wavela khona kuSamuweli ngelizwi lakhe.
Lafika ke igama likaSamuweli kumaSirayeli onke. Baphuma amaSirayeli, bahlasela amaFilisti; amaSirayeli athabathe inqaba eEben-ezer, amaFilisti ke eAfek.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti balungiselela ukulwa nabaSirayeli; ke kaloku umfazwe wasasazeka, wabanjwa amaSirayeli phambi kwabaseFilisti, babulala kumawaka amane ehlabathini.

Ke kaloku, babuyela amajoni esixekweni, abakhulu bakaSirayeli bathi, Kutheni na ukuba iNkosi athabathe iinkunzi zeegusha zethu namhlanje? Nceda siyingenise apha eShilo itekisi yomnqophiso kaYehova, ukuze ihambe nathi, ibe sisikhusela kumagosa ethu;

Bathumela ke abantu eShilo, babuyisele ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova wemikhosi, ohlala kwitrone yakhe phakathi kweekerubi; babekho khona oonyana ababini bakaEli, uHofeni noPhinehasi, nebhokisi yomnqophiso kaThixo.
Ke kaloku, xa ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova yafika emkhosini, bonke amaSirayeli babhica ngezwi elikhulu, de kube litshisa umhlaba.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti beva ilizwi, bathi, Yintoni loo msindo onke ekamelweni lamaHebhere? Bathe ke bakwazi ukuba isithunywa sikaYehova sifike kumkhosi.
Baboyika ke abaFilisti, bathi, UThixo ufike endlwini yabo. Hayi! Akukho nto injalo eya kwenzeka ngaphambili.
Sikwingozi; ngubani na oza kusikhusela kumandla ala madini anamandla? La madini ayewabulala amaYiputa ngeentlungu zonke esiqwini.
Babe namandla, niBafilisti, ningamadoda, ukuze ningabi ngamagqwetha amaHebhere, njengokuba bebengamagqwetha enu; ningamadoda, nife.
Bathi ke amaFilisti, bahlaselwa amaSirayeli; wabuya umntu ngamnye endlwini yakhe. Kwabakho ukuhlasela okukhulu kakhulu; kwalahleka kumaSirayeli amawaka amashumi mathathu abantu abahamba ngeenyawo.
Ibhokisi kaThixo yaqhutywa; bafa oonyana ababini bakaEli, uHofeni noPhenehasi.
Ke kaloku umntu omnye waseBhenjamin wabaleka emkhosini ngaloo mini, waya eShilo; izihlangu zakhe zazirhoxisiwe, kwakukho uthuli phezu kweentloko zakhe.

Wafika, ke kaloku uEli ehlala esihlalweni sakhe, ngasecaleni kwendlela, ejonge; kuba intliziyo yakhe yayikhathaza ngenxa yesakhelo sikaThixo. Ke kaloku wafika lo mntu emzini, wayixelela loo nto ithile. Yathi ke yonke imimandla yomzi,
Ke kaloku uEli wayeva lo msindo, wathi, Yintoni loo msindo wonke? Umntu lowo wakhawuleza waya kuEli
wayeminyaka imashumi asithoba anesibhozo ezelwe; amehlo akhe ayethe nkqo, akakwazi ukubona.
Wathi kuEli, Mna ndithe ndaphuma kumkhosi; mna ke ndabaleka kumkhosi ngaloo mini. Wathi uEli, Yintoni eya kwenzeka, ntwana wam?
Wayiphendula loo mntu, wathi, AbaSirayeli babaleka phambi kwabaFilisti, kwathikho nokufa okukhulu emkhosini; nabantwana bakho ababini, uHofeni noPhenehasi, babafa; ibhokisi kaThixo yathabatha.

Ke kaloku, xa ethetha ngesiquphe sikaThixo, uEli wawela ngasemva esihlalweni sakhe, ngasecaleni kwesango; yaphuka intamo yakhe, wafa; ngokuba wayekhulu, waba mkhulu. Waye wayilungisa iSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mane.

Ke kaloku inkosikazi yakhe, umfazi kaPhenehasi, wayesele ekhulelwe, wafika umhla wokuzala; ke kaloku, xa wayeva iindaba ezilungileyo, ukuba ibhokisi kaThixo ithathelwe, nokuba uyise womyeni wakhe nomfazi wakhe bafa, waqala ukuzalwa, waza wazala, ngenxa yobuhlungu bakhe.
Ke kaloku, ekufeni kwakhe, bathi kubo amadoda asebenza naye, Musa ukuxoka; kuba uzalisele unyana. Wayiphendula ke loo nto, ayivumeli intliziyo.
Wayibiza igama lonyana uIkabhodi, esithi, Uzuko luye kuSirayeli. Yathi loo nto ngenxa yokuba ibhokisi kaThixo yaqhutywa, yaye uyise womyeni wakhe nomfazi wakhe babefile.
Wathi, Ubuhle buphuma kuSirayeli; ngokuba ibhokisi kaThixo ithathelwe.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti bathatha ibhokisi kaThixo, bayithabatha evela eEben-ezer iye eAshdodi.
Bayifaka ibhokisi kaThixo endlwini kaDagon, uThixo wabo, bayibeka phantsi komfanekiso kaDagon.
Ke kaloku amaAshdodi avuka ekuseni ngemini elandelayo, ke bona uDagon, ehleli emehlweni akhe phezu komhlaba phambi kwebhokisi kaYehova. Bawuphakamisa uDagon, bawubeka endaweni yakhe.

Ke kaloku, xa bevuka kusasa, bona uDagon elungiswe ngobuso bakhe phezu komhlaba phambi kwebhokisi kaYehova; intloko yakhe nezandla zakhe ziqhutywe, zibekwe emngxunyeni wesango; igazi lakhe kuphela elisele.
Ngenxa yoko ababingeleli bakaDagon, nabo bonke abaphumayo endlwini kaDagon eAshdodi, bangangeni emngxunyeni womnyango, kude kube namhlanje.
Ke kaloku isandla sikaYehova sathi sinzima kubo abahlali baseAshdodi, nakwiidolophu ezijikelezayo; wabeka phezu kwabo intlungu, wababulala ngeentlungu ezibi.
Bathe ke amadoda aseAshdodi ebona oko kwenzekayo, wathi, Isithunywa soThixo kaSirayeli asiyi kuhlala nathi; ngokuba isandla sakhe sinzima kuthi, nakwiDagon uThixo wethu.

Babiza ke bonke abakumkani bakaFilisti, basithi kubo, Siyenze ntoni na isiqwenga seNkosi kaSirayeli? Baphendula bathi, Nciphisa isiqwenga seNkosi kaSirayeli ukuya eGati. Bayikhupha khona isiqwenga seNkosi kaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, emva kokuba bayikhuphe, isandla sikaYehova safika kuloo mzi, sawuphazamisa kakhulu; wabetha abantu baloo mzi, abancinci nabadala, ngemikhukula ephumayo.
Bathuthela ke ibhokisi kaThixo e-Ekron. Yathi, ifike e-Ekron, abantu base-Ekron batsho, besithi, Ibhokisi kaThixo kaSirayeli bayithumelele kuthi, ukuba sibulala thina nabantu bethu;

Babiza ke bonke abathetheli bakaFilisti, besithi, Yisuseni isithunywa soThixo kaSirayeli, sibuye endlwini yayo, ingabi siyathisa nathi nabantu bethu. Uthe ke lo mzi ugcwele inkanuko yokufa; isandla sikaThixo sakuba sikhulu kakhulu phezu kwawo.
Abo abazange bafa, bahlaselwa ziintsholongwane; ilizwi ledolophu lanyuka lifike ezulu.
Ke kaloku ibhokisi kaYehova yaba ezweni lakwaFilisti iminyaka esixhenxe.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti babiza ababingeleli babo, nabamangali babo, bathi kubo, Siyenze ntoni na isiqwenga seNkosi? Siyazise ukuba siyibuyisele phi indawo yayo.

Bathi ke kubo, Ukuba niyibuyisela ibhokisi kaThixo kaSirayeli, musa ukuyithumela ingabikho nto kuyo; qiniseka ukuba niyamthumelela umnikelo wesono; ngoko niza kuphiliswa, niyazi ukuba kutheni na ukuba isandla sakhe asiyi kubuyela kuwe.

Bathi ke abaFilisti, Siyamthumelela ntoni na isonka sesono? Baphendula bathi, Iinwele zegolide ezintandathu, neentlanzi zegolide ezine, ngazo zonke izikumkani zakwaFilisti ezilishumi; ngokuba ubhubho ofanayo ukho kuwe nakumakumkani bakho.

Niyenze imifanekiso yeentyatyambo, neentyatyambo zeenkomo ezibulalayo ilizwe, ninike uzuko uThixo kaSirayeli; mhlawumbi uya kususa isandla sakhe phezu kwenu, naphezu kwamadini enu, naphezu kwelizwe lakho.

Uthini na ukuba niziqinise intliziyo zenu, njengokuba bakwenze abaYiputa noFaro? Bathi, xa uThixo esebenza nabo ngokuxhaphakileyo, bangawavumela njani oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba bahambe ngendlela yabo?
Namhlanje ke, lungiselela imoto entsha, neentlanzi ezimbini ezitshatileyo, ezingabikho kwingxowa-mali; zibeke iintlanzi kwimoto, uze uthathe iintlanzi zazo, uzibambe.
Niyithathe ibhokisi kaYehova, niyinqumle kwimoto; niyibeke ecaleni kwayo ibhokisi eneempahla zegolide, nizithumelele kuye njengesonka esibi; niyithumelele indlela yayo.

Yabonani, ukuba iyanyuka ifike ezweni layo, eBhete-shemesi, ngoko ke iNkosi wazisa phezu kwethu loo monakalo omkhulu; kodwa ukuba akunjalo, ngoko ke siza kwazi ukuba alibanga lisandla sakhe esithuthayo. Kuye kwathiwa ngandlela thile.
Bathi ke ngoko, bathabathe iinkomo ezimbini ezikhulelweyo, bazibophelela kwimoto, zazikhusela iinkomo zabo.
Babeka ibhokisi kaYehova phantsi kwemoto, nebhokisi equlethe izidumbu zegolide, nezibophelelo zeentyatyambo.

Ziye iinkomo zihamba ngokuthe ngqo, zifike eBhete-shemesi; zahlala phantsi kwendlela, zivutha yonke indlela, zingaguquki ngasekunene nakwesobunxele. Abakumkani bakaSirayeli balandela emva kwazo, bafika kumda weBet-shemesi.
Ke kaloku abahlali baseBhat-shemesh babethe bavuna ingqolowa yabo emlanjeni; baphakamisa amehlo abo, babona isiqulathi, bayavuya kakhulu.
Imoto yafika ezweni likaYoshuwa, umBethe-shemeshi; yahlala khona phantsi kwelitye elikhulu. Bathi ke abantu bathabathe imithi yemoto, banikela iinkomo zibe ngumnikelo womlilo kuYehova.

Ke kaloku abaLevi bakhupha ibhokisi kaYehova, nebhokisi equlethe izinto zegolide, bazibeka phezu kodonga olukhulu. Amadoda aseBhat-shemesh anikela ngeempawu zomlilo ngaloo mini, anikela izibingelelo kuYehova.
Ke kaloku abathetheli abahlanu bakaFilisti bakubona loo nto yonke, babuyela eEkroni ngaloo mini.
Lezi ziintshukumo zegolide, abaFilisti abazithumelele umnikelo wokubulala kuYehova: iAshdodi, neGaza, neAshkeloni, neGati, neEkron, nganye nganye.

Inani lazo iintaka zegolide lalingana nenani leedolophu zakwaFilisti, zabalawuli abahlanu, nakwiidolophu ezinqamlekileyo, nakwiintsapho ezisemaphandleni. Ilitye elikhulu, apho bamise khona ibhokisi kaYehova, lihlala liyimvuzo kude kube ngaloo mini, elunxwemeni lukaYoshuwa waseBhat-shemesi.

Ke kaloku uThixo wabulala abantu baseBhat-shemesi, ngenxa yokuba babejonga ibhokisi kaYehova; wababulala amadoda angamashumi amahlanu amawaka amashumi asixhenxe. Bathi ke abantu, ngenxa yobubi obukhulu obukunikele lona iNkosi.
Bathi ke abantu baseBhat-shemesi, Nguwuphi na umntu okwaziyo ukuhlala phambi koYehova, lo Thixo ungcwele? Ibhokisi iya kudlula phi na?
Bathumela ke abathunywa kubomi baseKiriyati-yearimi, besithi, AbaFilisti babuyisele isiqwenga seNkosi; nise phantsi, niyikhuphele edolophini yenu.
Bafika ke amadoda aseKiriyati-yearimi, athabathe ibhokisi kaYehova, bayisa kwindlu kaAbinadibhi, emnqamlezweni; bamisa uEleyazare, unyana wakhe, ukuba agcine ibhokisi kaThixo.
Ke kaloku ibhokisi yahlala eKiriyati-yearimi iintsuku ezininzi, iminyaka emashumi mabini yonke; bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli babuyela kuYehova besonwabile.

Wathi ke uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, Ukuba ngokuqinisekileyo nibuyela kuYehova ngentliziyo yenu yonke, nizisuse phakathi kwenu izitha zakwamanye amazwe, nezithembiso zeAshtoreth; zinikele ngokupheleleyo kuYehova, nikhonza yena kuphela; naye uya kukusindisa ebusweni bamaFilisti.
Bathabathela ke oonyana bakaSirayeli amaBaali abo, neAshtorethi zabo, bakhonza iNkosi kuphela.
Wathi ke uSamuweli, Zihlanganiseni bonke amaSirayeli eMizpa, ndithandaza kuYehova kuni.
Bathe bahlangana eMizpa, bathabathela amanzi, bawukhupha phambi koYehova; baphumla ngaloo mini, besithi, Siphelele kuYehova. USamuweli ke waba ngumgwebi kumaSirayeli eMizpa.
Ke kaloku, abaFilisti beva ukuba amaSirayeli ahlanganisene eMizpa, banyuka oonyana babo ukuwahlasela. Bathi ke amadoda aseSirayeli akubona loo nto, bakhathazeka ngenxa yamaFilisti.
Bathi ke kubo uSamuweli, Musa ukuyeka ukuthandaza kuthi kuYehova uThixo wethu, ukuba asisindise kumaFilisti.
Wathabatha ke uSamuweli inkunzi yenkomo, wayinikela yonke ibe ngumnikelo womlilo kuYehova; wathandaza kuYehova ngenxa kaSirayeli, iNkosi wamphendula.

Ke kaloku, xa uSamuweli enikela idini eliqhutywa limlilo, bafika amaFilisti ukuba ahlasele amaSirayeli. Wathi ke iNkosi, ngaloo mini, wathutha ngethutyana elikhulu phezu kwamaFilisti, wabaphazamisa; babanjwa phambi kwaSirayeli.
Baphuma ke amadoda aseSirayeli eMizpa, balandela abaFilisti, bababulala yonke indlela eya phantsi kweBhete-kare.
Wathabatha ke uSamuweli ityuwa, wayimisa phakathi kweMizpa neShen; wathi igama layo nguEbenha-ezer, esithi, UYehova usinceda kude kube ngoku.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti bahlaselwa, besiya kungena kwakhona ezweni likaSirayeli. Isandla sikaYehova sakuba phezu kwabaFilisti zonke iintsuku zokuphila kukaSamuweli.

Iidolophu abaFilisti babezithathe kuSirayeli, zabuyiselwa kumaSirayeli, ukusuka eEkron ukuya eGati; nabaSirayeli babuyisela ilizwe labo elijikelezayo kwizandla zesiSirayeli; kwakukho uxolo phakathi kukaSirayeli namaAmori.
Ke kaloku uSamuweli waba ngumgwebi kumaSirayeli zonke iintsuku zokuphila kwakhe.
Wahamba unyaka nonyaka, wajikeleza ukusuka eBheteli waya eGalgali, waya eMizpa; waba ngumthetho kumaSirayeli kuzo zonke ezo ndawo.
Ke kaloku wayebuya eRama, apho kwakuyindlu yakhe; wayalela ke amaSirayeli ukuba ahambe khona. Wakha khona isibingelelo iNkosi.
Ke kaloku, xa uSamuweli eneminyaka emininzi, wenza oonyana bakhe ukuba babe ngabagwebi kumaSirayeli.
Igama lonyana wakhe omkhulu nguYoweli, negama lonyana wakhe wesibini nguAbiya; babe ngabagwebi eBher-sheba.
Ke kaloku oonyana bakhe abazange bahambe ngendlela yakhe; babe ziintyatyambo zemali, bethabatha intlawulo, beziguqula imithetho.
Bahlangana ke bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli, bafika kuSamuweli eRama.
Bathi kuye, Ukhulule ubudala, oonyana bakho abaphila ubomi obungunaphakade; ke ngoko, sinike ukumkani ukuba athethe nathi, njengokuba kukho kwazo zonke iintlanga.
Ke kaloku basithi, Sinike ukumkani ukuba athethe nathi. USamuweli wakhathazeka kakhulu; wathandaza kuYehova.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Lindela zonke ezi zinto abantu abathethayo kuwe; akukubi ukuba bakufumaneni wena, kodwa bafuni kumfumene mna ukuba ndibe ngukumkani wabo.
Ngokungafaniyo nazo zonke izinto abazenzayo, ukususela ngemini endiyikhupha ngayo eYiputa, kuze kube ngoku, baya kwenza kuwe; bendishiya, bakhonza amadini athile.
Ke ngoko, phulaphula kubo; kodwa ubaxelele ngokunyanisekileyo, ubaxelele into oza kuyisenza ukumkani olawulayo phezu kwabo.
Ke kaloku uSamuweli wathetha amazwi onke kaYehova kubo bonke abantu ababemcela ukumkani.
Wathi, Le nto uya kuyikwenza ukumkani oza kulawula phezu kwenu: uthabathe oonyana benu, abeke kubo izithuthi zakhe zokulwa, namahashe akhe; bahambe phambi kwezithuthi zakhe.

Uya kubabeka abanye kubo ngabaphathi bamawaka zaz, nabenabaphathi beshumi elinesihlanu; abanye babo baya kulima izityalo zakhe, bathabathe iziqhamo zakhe; abanye babo baya kwenza iinqanawa zokulwa, nezixhobo zeenqwelomoya zakhe.
Uza kuzithatha iintombi zenu, ukuba zisebenzele ukwenza ivumba, nokupheka, nokubhaka.
Uya kuzithatha izityalo zenu ezilungileyo, nezityalo zeziqhamo zenu, neentyatyambo zeolivini zenu, azinike abaphathi bakhe.
Uza kuthatha ishumi lembewu yenu, newayini yenu, aze azinike abaphathi bakhe nabaphathi bakhe.
Abakhonzi benu, nabafazi benu, nabantwana benu abalungileyo, neesile zenu, uya kuzithatha, aze azisebenzise ekwenzeni umsebenzi wakhe.
Uya kuthatha ishumi elinanye leebhokhwe zenu; niza kuba ngabakhonzi bakhe.
Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini, niza kuthandaza ngenxa yokumkani owazikhethileyo; kodwa iNkosi akayi kuniphendula loo mini.
Ke kaloku abantu abazange baphulaphule uSamuweli. Bathi, Hayi, sifuna ukumkani phezu kwethu.
Siya kuba ngoko njengazo zonke iintlanga, sibenekumkani ukuba ahambe phambi kwethu, aze aphume phambi kwethu, abe ngumkhosi wethu.
Wava ke uSamuweli onke amagama abantu, waphendula uSamuweli iNkosi.
Wathi ke iNkosi, Yiva ilizwi labo, ubanike ukumkani. Wathi ke uSamuweli kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Yiya mntu ngamnye edolophini yakhe.
Ke kaloku kwabakho umntu wesizwe sikaBhenjamin, igama lakhe lalinguKishi, unyana ka-Abiyeli, unyana kaZerori, unyana kaBekorati, unyana kaAfiya; lo mntu wayengumntu onamandla amakhulu.
Ke kaloku uKishi ubenonyana, igama lakhe nguSawule, umfana othandekayo; kwakungekho namnye eSirayeli othandekayo kunaye; waphakama indlebe enye ngaphezulu kwabanye bonke.
Ke kaloku, kwafika usuku, iinkunzi zebhokhwe zikaKishi uyise kaSawule zalahleka. Wathi ke uKishi kuSawule, unyana wakhe, Yithathe nawe omnye wabakhonzi bakho, uye ujonge iibhokhwe.

Ke kaloku uSawule wadlula ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim, nakwiindawo ezijikeleze iShalisha; abazange bazifumane. Baye bafika ezweni laseShaalim, yaye izibhokhwe azikho apho. Wadlula ke ezweni lakwaBhenjamin, kodwa abazange zifune.
Ke kaloku, befika ezweni laseSufe, uSawule wathi kumkhonzi wakhe: Yiya, sihambe, ukuze uyise wam angaze athathele ingqalelo iinkunzi zeegusha, abe neentloni thina.
Wathi kuye, Yabona, kukho umntu kaThixo kuloo mzi; ungumntu othandekayo kakhulu; zonke izinto athethayo zivela. Nceda senze ke ukuba sihambe khona; mhlawumbi uya kusixelela indlela esiya kuyo.
Wathi uSawule kumkhonzi wakhe, Ukuba siza, siya kunikela ntoni na kumntu lowo? Ngokuba isonka sethu ezingxoweni zethu siphelile; asikho nesipho sokuthatha kumntu kaThixo. Sinesiphi na?
Waphendula ke umkhonzi, wathi, Jonga, ndinesiqingatha seshekeli yesilivere; ndiya kuyinika kumntu kaThixo, ukuze acacise indlela esihamba ngayo.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu esiya eSirayeli ukuba abuze uThixo into ethile, wayethi, Yiya, siye kumbonayo; kuba umprofeti wosuku lwangoku wabizwa ngokuba ngumbonayo.
Wathi uSawule kumkhonzi wakhe, Kulungile; ndiza, sihambe. Basuka ke besiya emzini apho umntu kaThixo wayehlala khona.
Ke kaloku, besuka benyuka phezulu emzini, badibana namadoda amancinci aphumayo ukutsala amanzi. Bathi kubo, Ingaba lo mhleli ukho apha?
Bathi ke kubo, Nguye; ajonge phambi kwakho; khawuleza, kuba sele efika kuloo mzi namhlanje; ngokuba abantu banomnqophiso kwindawo yokukhonza, entliziyweni.

Ke kaloku, xa nifika edolophini, niza kumfumana phambi kokuba afike phezulu emnqamlezweni ukuba abe nesonka; kuba abantu abazange baqale ukutya ngaphambi kokuba afike; ngokuba yena uya kubhaptiza isibingelelo; ke emva koko baya kudla abo bamkelweyo. Yiya phezulu ngoku; mna ke ndiya kumfumana ngaloo mini.
Baye ke benyuka bafike edolophini. Ke kaloku, xa befika kuloo dolophu, uSamuweli waphuma waya kuhlangatyezwana nabo, esiya phezulu kwindlu kaThixo.
Wathi iNkosi kuSamuweli, imini phambi kokuba afike uSawule, esithi,

Ngomhla wesibini ngaloo xesha ndiya kukuthumela umntu ezweni likaBhenjamin; umxube ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bam bakaSirayeli; naye uya kubasindisa abantu bam kumadoda aseFilisti. Ndibajonge abantu bam, ngokuba uxolo lwabo lufike kum.
Wabona ke uSamuweli uSawule, wathi kuye iNkosi, Lo ngumntu ndithi kuwe ngawo; yena uya kuba ngukumkani kwaba bantu bam.
Wafika ke uSawule kuSamuweli emnyango, wathi, Nceda ndixelele ukuba liphi ikhaya lomboniso.
Waphendula uSamuweli, wathi, Ndiye mhleli. Yiya phambi kwam endlwini kaThixo; kuba namhlanje uya kudla nam; emveni kwemini ndiza kukushiya uhambe, ndikuxelele zonke izinto ezikwingqondo yakho.

Ngokuba iinkunzi zeebhokhwe ozilahlekileyo iintsuku ezintathu ezidlulileyo, musa ukukhathazeka ngazo; kuba zafunyanwa. Baphi na ke ooSirayeli bonke abafunayo? Akunjalo wena nosapho lonke loyise wakho?
Waphendula uSawule, wathi, Ke mna ndinguBhenjamini, mkhulu kunazo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli; intsapho yam incinci kunazo zonke iintsapho zakwaBhenjamini; kutheni na ke uthetha nam izinto ezinjalo?
Ke kaloku uSamuweli wayalela uSawule nomkhonzi wakhe ukuba bafike endlwini, wababeka phezulu kumadoda aphezu kweshumi elinamashumi mathathu.
Wathi ke uSamuweli kumpheki, Thola elo candelo lenyama endikulenzileyo, endithe ndakusithiyo, Uyigcine.

Wathabatha ke umpheki intamo, nento eyayiyo, wayibeka phambi kukaSawule. Wathi uSamuweli, Yaye le nto igcinwe kuwe; dle; kuba yagcinwa kuwe ngaloo mini, ukusukela xa ndathi, Ndizamile abakhenkethi. Wadla ke uSawule noSamuweli loo mini.
Ke kaloku, bathe behla ukusuka endlwini kaThixo baya kumzi, uSamuweli wathetha noSawule phezu kwendlu yakhe.
Ke kaloku bavuka ngobusuku, waza uSamuweli wayalela uSawule phezu kwendlu, esithi, Yiya phantsi, ndiya kukuvumela ukuba uhambe. USawule ke waphuma endlwini yakhe, yena noSamuweli behamba ndawonye.

Ke kaloku, behla bafika esiphelweni somzi, uSamuweli wathi kuSawule, Utsho kumkhonzi wakho ukuba ahambe phambi kwethu. Wakwenza ke lo mkhonzi; wathi uSamuweli, Nceda ulinde apha, ndiza kukuxelela amazwi kaThixo.
Wathabatha ke uSamuweli ibhotile encinci yeoyile, wayitywina phezu kweκεφαλi kaSawule; wamxolela wathi, UYehova uyayiphakisa ukuba ube ngukumkani abantu bakhe.

Ke kaloku, xa usiya kum namhlanje, uya kudibana namadoda amabini esibhedlele sikaRakeli, eZilsa, emda kaBhenjamin; baya kukuxelela bathi, Iinkunzi zeegusha oza kuzifuna zafunyanwa; ngoko ke, uyise wakho washiya ukuzibuza ngazo, wakhathazeka ngenxa yenu, wathi, Ndiyakwenza ntoni ngonyana wam?

Uya kuhamba khona, uze ufike kwi-oyile enkulu yaseTabori; apho uya kudibana namadoda amathathu aphumayo eBheteli ukukhonza uThixo: omnye ethwala iinkunzi zeegusha ezintathu, omnye ethwala iziqholo ezithathu zesonka, omnye ethwala isitya sewayini.
Baya kukubulela, baya kukunika iziqholo ezimbini zesonka; uya kuzifumana kubo.
