Emva koko uza kungena eGibeha kaThixo, apho kukho isibhedlele somkhosi wamaFilisti. Xa ufika umzi, uya kudibana neqela leempawu ziphumayo emnqamlezweni, zidlala ngeebhayisikile, nezidumbu, neziphenyane, neziqhamo, ziprofetisa.
UMoya kaYehova uya kungena kuwe, nawe uza kuprofetisana nabo; uza kuguqulwa ube ngumntu owonakele.
Ke kaloku, xa ezi mqondiso zithe zenzeke, zinikele konke okufunekayo; ngokuba uThixo uya kuba nawe.

Yiya phantsi phambi kwam eGalgali; ndiya kuhla kuwe, ndilungiselele izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo. Umele ulinde iintsuku ezisibhozo, de ndifike kuwe, ndikuxelele into omele uyiyenze.
Ke kaloku, xa uSawule ejikelezile ukuba ahambe noSamuweli, uThixo wamguqula intliziyo kaSawule; zathi zonke ezo impawu ziphume ngaloo mini.
Ke kaloku, xa uSawule nomkhonzi wakhe befika eGibheha, bona, iqela lamaprofeti lidibana naye; waphuma umoya kaThixo kuye, waba nento yokuprofeta phakathi kwabo.
Ke kaloku bonke ababemthanda ngaphambili, bakubona ukuba uprofetisa phakathi kwabaprofeti, bathi omnye komnye, Kuthe kwenzeka ntoni na kunyana kaKishi? Ngaba noSawule ungumprofeti?
Waphendula umntu ohlala khona, wathi, Ngubani na ubaba wabo? Ke kaloku kwathiwa, USawule naye ungumprofeti?
Ke kaloku, xa uSawule egqibile ukuprofetisa, wafika kwindawo yokuthandaza.
Wathi umyeni kaSawule kuye, nomkhonzi wakhe, Niye naphi? Wathi ke uSawule, Sikhangela iinkunzi zeegusha; sabona ke ukuba azifumaneki, safika kuSamuweli,
Wathi umyeni kaSawule, Ndixelele ukuba uSamuweli wathetha ntoni kuni.
Waphendula uSawule, wathi, Wathi kuthi ngokucacileyo ukuba iinkunzi zeegusha zifunyenwe. Ke kaloku loo nto uSamuweli ethetha ngayo ukuba uya kuba ngukumkani, akazange amxelele umyeni wakhe.
Ke kaloku uSamuweli wababiza bonke abantu bakaSirayeli phambi koYehova eMizpa.
Wathi kubo, Utsho iNkosi uThixo zazdoli kaSirayeli ukuthi, Ndiwakhuphe amaSirayeli eYiputa, ndabasindisa emkhosini wamaSirayeli, nakuzo zonke izikumkani eziphazamisayo.

Ke nina namhlanje ningamthobeli uThixo wenu, owenza ukuba nisindiswe kuzo zonke iintlungu zenu nezigulana zenu; nithi ke, Akukho nto, misela ukumkani phezu kwethu. Ngoko ke, nise phambi koYehova ngezizwe zenu neentsapho zenu.
Ke kaloku uSamuweli wazisa zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, sathi isizukulwana sikaBhenjamin sithathelwe inqaba.
Ke kaloku wazisa isizwe samaBhenjamin, safika isizukulwana ngasizukulwana; sathathwa isizukulwana sikaMatri; kwagqitywa ke sathathwa uSawule unyana kaKishi. Baye bamkhangela, akafumanekanga.
Baye babuza iNkosi, besithi, Ngaba lo mntu sele efike apha? Wathi iNkosi, Ewe, ufihlakele phakathi kwezinto.
Ke kaloku bahamba, bamthabatha waya ngaphandle. Wahlala ke phakathi kwamadoda, ephakame indlebe enye ngaphezulu kwabo bonke.
Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu, Ndibonani na lo mntu iNkosi awakhethayo? Akukho namnye ofana naye phakathi kwabantu bonke. Bathi ke abantu, Uphile ukumkani!
Ke kaloku uSamuweli wabaxelela abantu imithetho yokumkani, wabhala kuyo incwadi, wayibeka phambi koYehova. USamuweli ke wayalela bonke abantu ukuba bahambe, ngamnye endlwini yakhe.
Ke kaloku uSawule waya ekhaya lakhe, eGibhebha, naye namadoda amaninzi anamandla, entliziyweni yawo uThixo ebemxelela.
Ke kaloku abanye abantu ababi bathi, Uza kusikhusela njani lo mntu? Bathi ke ke, bamangalisa uSawule, bangamnika nasiphi na isipho; uSawule ke wanyamalala.
Ke kaloku wanyuka uNahashe, umAmoni, waya eYabhesi-gileyadi. Bathi kuye bonke amadoda aseYabhesi, Yenza umnqophiso nathi, siza kukukhonza.
Waphendula ke uNahashe, umAmoni, wathi, Ngento enye kuphela ndiza kwenza intsebenziswano nani: ukuba ndikhuphe iliso lenu lonke elasekunene; ukuze kubekho ukucaphukisa kumaSirayeli onke.
Bathi kuye amadoda amakhulu aseYabheshi, Sivumele iintsuku ezisixhenxe, sithumelele abathunywa kuwo onke amaSirayeli; ukuba akukho namnye oza kusikhusela, siya kuthethwa kuwe.
Bafika ke abathunywa eGibhebha, apho uSawule wayehlala khona, bathetha kubo bonke abantu loo magama; nabo bonke bavuma ngelizwi elikhulu.
Yabona ke uSawule efika emasimini, elandela iinkomo zakhe; wabuza wathi, Kuthini na okubi kubo bonke abantu? Kutheni belilindela? Bathi ke kuye amazwi amadoda aseYabheshi.
Ke kaloku, xa uSawule ephulaphule amazwi abo, umphefumlo kaThixo wafika phezu kwakhe, waza waqhutywa yintliziyo.

Wathabatha iinkunzi zebhokhwe ezimbini, wazenza iziqhoboshi, waza wazisa iziqhoboshi ngesandla somthunywa kuwo onke amaSirayeli, esithi, Ubani na oza kumlandela uSawule noSamuweli, kuya kwenziwa loo nto ngeenkomo zakhe. Uzuko lukaYehova lwafika kubo bonke abantu, baphuma ndawonye njengalowo mnye.
Ke kaloku uSawule wababala eBezeki; kwaba ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu amathathu amadoda aseSirayeli, namawaka mathathu amadoda aseYuda.

Bathi kubo abathunywa abaye bafika, Nithi kumadoda aseYabhesi eGiliyadi, Nithi, Ngomhla olandelayo, xa ilanga litshisa, niza kusindiswa. Baye ke abathunywa beya kubaxelela amadoda aseYabhesi loo nto; bayakuthanda kakhulu.
Bathi ke kubo oonyana baka-Ammon, Ngomso siza kungena kuni; nikwenze kuthi konke okulungileyo engqondweni yenu.

Yathi imini elandelayo, uSawule wahlula abantu bakhe yaba ziintloko ezintathu; bafika emkhosini wama-Ammon phambi kwelanga, bababulala, de kube lixesha elishushu lemini. Abaseleyo baphazamiseka, kungekho mntu omnye wababini ohlala ndawonye.
Bathi ke abantu kuSamuweli, Nguwuphi na lowo wathiyo, USawule uya kuba ngukumkani kuthi? Yazisa apha, siza kuwabulala.
Wathi ke uSawule, Akukho namnye oza kufa namhlanje; ngokuba namhlanje iNkosi wasindisa amaSirayeli.
Wathi ke uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu, Nceda, sihambe siye eGilgal, siphinde simisele khona uSawule njengomkumkani.

Ke kaloku bonke abantu bafika eGalgali, bakwenza uSawule waba ngukumkani phambi koYehova; bamnikela khona izibingelelo zoxolo phambi koYehova. USawule namadoda onke aseSirayeli baba nothando olukhulu.
Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke amaSirayeli, Ndiye ndaphulaphula zonke izinto zenu ebenisithi kum, ndininike ukumkani.

Ke mna, ndikhulule iinwele zam, ndiza kuba ngukumkani phakathi kwenu; ke mna, ndikhulule iinwele zam, ndiza kuba ngukumkani phakathi kwenu; ke mna, ndingumlawuli wenu ukususela ebantwini bam, ukuya ngoku.

Mna apha ndihlala; mxeleleni kum phambi koYehova, nokumkani wakhe okhethiweyo: Yintoni enkonzweni yam endiyithatheleyo? Yintoni inkunzi yam endiyithatheleyo? Yintoni endiyikhohlisayo? Yintoni eniyiphazamisayo? Yintoni endinyamkela ngayo umvuzo, ukuze ndijonge ngaphaya kwendlela? Ukuba ndenza naziphi na ezi zinto, ndizibuyisele.
Bathi ke kubo, Akukho mntu uthuthuzelayo thina, nakuphi na ukudubula kuthi; awuthathenga nto kumntu.
Wathi kubo uSamuweli, UYehova ube ngumshushisi kuni, nokumkani wakhe okhethiweyo abe ngumshushisi namhlanje, ukuba ningafumani nto esandla sam. Bathi ke, UYehova abe ngumshushisi.
Wathi uSamuweli kubo bonke abantu, NguYehova lowo wamisa uMoses noAron, wabakhupha ooyiseni benu eYiputa.
Ke ngoko, hlalani apha; kuba ndiza kukuxelela inkundla yenu phambi koYehova, ngezinto zonke ezilungileyo iNkosi awazenzayo kuni, nababukumkani benu.
Ke kaloku, xa uYakobi efike eYiputa, abazalwana benu bathandaza kuYehova; wathumela iNkosi uMoses noAron, babakhupha abazalwana benu besuka eYiputa, babebamisa kule ndawo.
Ke kaloku balibala iNkosi uThixo wabo. Wabathengisa ke kuSisera, umphathi womkhosi waseHazori, nakumaFilisti, nokumkani wakwaMowabi; babahlasela ke.
Ke kaloku bathandaza kuYehova, besithi, Siphelele; sishiye iNkosi, sakhonza amaBhaali namaAshtorethi; kodwa ngoku nceda usikhusele kumagosa ethu, siza kukukhonza.
Wathumela ke iNkosi uYerubahali, noBhedan, noYefeta, noSamuweli; wawasindisa ebantwini benu abakhohlakeleyo abakwindawo zonke ezijikelezileyo kwenu, nihlala nikhuselekile.
Ke kaloku, nibona ukuba uNahashe ukumkani wama-Ammon ufika kuni, nithi kum, Hayi, kufuneka kubekho ukumkani ukuze abe ngukumkani wethu; nakuba iNkosi uThixo wenu ungukumkani wenu.
Ke kaloku, apha ukumkani owazikhethela wona, owawucelayo; bona, iNkosi wamisa ukumkani phezu kwenu.
Ukuba nimthanda iNkosi, niyamkhonza, nakumthobela; ukuba ningawuphulaphuli umyalelo wakhe; ukuba nilandela iNkosi uThixo wenu, nina nokumkani olawulayo phezu kwenu, ke kuya kuba ngcono.
Ke kaloku, ukuba ningamthobeli iNkosi, nakuba niyixolela imimiselo yakhe, isandla sakhe siza kuba nani, njengokuba kwabikho kubazalwana benu.
Ke ngoko, hlalani ngoku, nibone le nto inkulu iNkosi oza kuyisenza phambi kobuso benu.
Ingaba asikuko na ngoku unyaka wokuvuna ingqolowa? Ndiza kubiza iNkosi, aze anike inkungu nemvula; niyazi ke ukuba yintoni na into enobubi eyenzayo phambi kobuso bukaThixo, yokuba nicela ukumkani.
Wabiza uSamuweli iNkosi; wathumela iNkosi iinkwenkwezi nemvula ngaloo mini; bonke abantu bakhathazeka ngoYehova, noSamuweli.
Bathi ke bonke abantu kuSamuweli, Lungisa iNkosi uThixo wakho ngezikhonzi zakho, ukuze singafa; kuba sithe sadibanisa nezono zethu zonke isono esibi sokufuna ukumkani.
Wathi uSamuweli, Musani ukukhathazeka; nakuba niyenze loo nto ilungileyo yonke, ke ngoko, musa ukubuyela umva kuYehova; khonzani iNkosi intliziyo yenu yonke.
Musani ukubuyela emva kwezinto ezingalunganga; azikwazi kukuncedisa, azikwazi kukusindisa, ngokuba zizinto ezingalunganga.
UYehova akaze ashiye abantu bakhe, ngenxa yegama lakhe elikhulu; ngokuba iNkosi wathandazela ukuba anibe nento yakhe.
Ke mna, andizukwenza isono kuYehova, ndiyeke ukuthandaza kuni; ndiza kukuxelela indlela elungileyo nenyanisiweyo.
Ke ngoko, qiniseka ukuba iNkosi uyakukhathalela, niwusebenzele ngokuqinisekileyo intliziyo yenu yonke; niziqaphele zonke izinto ezikhulu azenzayo kuni.
Ke kaloku, ukuba niqhubekani nokwenza okubi, mna nokumkani wenu niza kususwa.
USawule ubeminyaka imashumi mathathu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mane anesibini.

USawule wakhetha amadoda amawaka amathathu kumaSirayeli; amawaka amabini aye naye eMikmasi, nasentlango yaseBheteli; namawaka amabini aye noYonatan unyana wakhe eGibeha kaBhenjamin. Amanye amadoda awayisa ekhaya lakhe.
Ke kaloku uYonatan wahlasela ikhosi yamaFilisti eGibeha; bakwazi loo nto amaFilisti. Wathi ke uSawule ukuba kuqhutywe isidumbu ezweni lonke, esithi, Baziva amaHebhere!
Ke kaloku bonke amaSirayeli bafumanisa into ethethwayo, ethi, USawule wahlasela iqela lakwaFilisti; namaSirayeli ke abaye bengathandekiyo kumaSirayeli. Babizwa abantu ukuba babe noSawule eGalgali.

Bathe ke abaFilisti bahlangane, ukuba babulele amaSirayeli, namawaka amashumi mathathu eemoto zemfazwe, namawaka amathandathu amatye, namadoda amaninzi njengengca ekumgama wolwandle. Baya phezulu, bamisa iintaba eMikmasi, emazantsi eBhete-aven.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli ebona ukuba aphelelwe lithemba, kuba iqela labo laphazamiseka kakhulu; bafihla ke amaSirayeli kumagquma, namagquba, namatye, neembumbulu, neengcango zehlabathi.
Ke kaloku kwadlula amaHebhere eYordan, waya ezweni likaGadi noGiliyadi. USawule wahlala eGalgali; bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli ababenoye, baphoxeka.
Walinde iintsuku ezisixhenxe, ngokwexesha elimiselwe nguSamuweli; ke kaloku uSamuweli akafikanga eGilgal. Ke kaloku amadoda kaSawule aqala ukushiya kuye.
Wathi ke uSawule, Ninikele kum idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo. Wanikela umnikelo oqhutywa ngamanzi.
Ke kaloku, xa egqibile ukunikela, kwafika uSamuweli; waphuma ke uSawule ukuba abule.
Wathi uSamuweli kuSawule, Ukwenze ntoni na loo nto? Waphendula uSawule wathi, Xa ndabona ukuba abantu baphuma kum, nawe ungafikanga kwixesha elimiselweyo, nabaFilisti ke behlangana eMikmasi;
Ndathi ke, Namhlanje abaFilisti baya kukhupha kum eGilgal; ke mna andizange ndibuze iNkosi. Wathi ke umphefumlo wam, Ndiya kunikela idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi.
Wathi uSamuweli kuye, Ukwenzele into engaphaya kwengqondo; awugcinenga umyalelo kaYehova uThixo wakho owakuwisela wona. Ke kaloku wayemqinisa ubukumkani bakho phezu kwaSirayeli ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku ubukumkani bakho abuyi kuhlala; iNkosi wafuna umntu ngokwentliziyo yakhe, wamkhetha ukuba abe ngukumkani kubo bonke abantu bakhe; ngokuba awugcini umyalelo kaYehova.
Waphuma ke uSamuweli eGalgali, wanyuka waya eGibeha kaBhenjamin. USawule wababala amadoda aye naye; babe ngamawaka alishumi elinanye.
Ke kaloku uSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe, namadoda abo ahamba nabo, bahlala eGibeha kaBhenjamin; amaFilisti ke aye eMikmasi.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma amaqela ahlaselayo esibhedlele samaFilisti, esuka emaqelani amathathu; elinye lajika liya eOfra, elunxwemeni lweShuali.
enye ifike eBhete-horoni, enye ifike kumda ojonge uLwandle lweTseboyim, ujonge emlanjeni.
Ke kaloku, kwakungekho namnye umnqamlezi wafunyanwa ezweni lonke likaSirayeli; ngokuba abaFilisti bathi, Kuba bangabi namadoda amaHebhere azenza iiklabhu okanye iibhombu.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseSirayeli aye phantsi kumaFilisti, ukuba aqinise iziqhamo zakhe, neengxowa-mali zakhe, neebhokhwe zakhe, neziqhamo zakhe.
Ixabiso layo yayiyishumi elinambini leshekeli, ukuthambisa iziqhamo neentyatyambo; neshumi elinesibini leshekeli, ukuthambisa iiforki neengxowa-mali, nokuthambisa iinkomo.
Ke kaloku, ngemini yemfazwe, kwakungekho mntu nanye kubo bonke abantu abakhoyo noSawule noYonatan, onekrele namaqhekeza esandla sakhe; kwakukho uSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe kuphela abanezo.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma iqela lamadoda amaFilisti, lafika elunxwemeni eMikmasi.
Wathi ke uYonatan, unyana kaSawule, ngosuku oluthile kumntwana wakhe othwala izithuthi zakhe, Yiya, sihambe siye emkhosini wamaFilisti okwicala elinye. Ke kaloku akawuxelela uyise.
Ke kaloku uSawule wayehlala esiphelweni seGibheya, phantsi komthi wegranate eMigron; kwabakho naye amadoda angamakhulu amathandathu.

Ke kaloku phakathi kwabo kwakukho uAhiya, ogqoke i-ephod; waba ngunyana ka-Ahitubhi, umzalwana ka-Ikabhodi, unyana kaPhinehasi, unyana kaEli, ukumkani kaYehova eShilo. Akukho namnye owayesazi ukuba uYonatan waphuma.
Kwabakho intaba ephakamileyo ngapha nangapha komngxunya, apho uYonatan wayefuna ukudlula khona, ukuba afike kwisibhedlele samaFilisti; igama elinye lalinguBozese, elinye lilinguSene.
Umqolo omnye ubekwe kwelaseNtshona, eMikmash; omnye ke ubekwe kwelaseMpuma, eGibeha.

Wathi uYonatan kunyana wakhe othwala izithunywa zakhe, Yiya, sihambe sifike kwisiqithi salaba bantu abangenakuthotywa; mhlawumbi iNkosi uya kusinceda. Akuyi kubakho into enokuthintela iNkosi ekusindiseni, nokuba kuninzi nakuba kuncinane.
Wathi ke umthwalo wezixhobo zakhe kuye, Yenza konke okusengqondweni yakho. Yiya; mna ndikhona nawe intliziyo nomoya.
Wathi uYonatan, Yiya ke ngoko, sihambe sifike kubo abantu abo, siboneke kwabo.
Ukuba besithi kuthi, Nceda nilinde apha, de sifike kuni; siya kuhlala apho sihlala khona, asiyi kunyuka siye kubo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba bathi kuthi, Nyukeni kuthi, siya kukhupha; kuba oko kuya kuba ngumqondiso wethu, ukuba iNkosi wabanika esandla sam.
Bonke bobabini babonakalisa iqela labaFilisti. Bathi amaFilisti, Yabona, abaHebhere bephuma ezindaweni ezifihlakeleyo apho babefihle khona.

Ke kaloku amadoda ekamva avakalisa uYonatan nomthwalo wezithuthi zakhe, athi, Yiya phezulu kuthi, siza kukuxelela into. UYonatan wathi kumthwalo zezithuthi zakhe, Yiya phezulu emva kwam; ngokuba iNkosi wabanika esandla samaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uYonathan wanyuka ngezandla zakhe nezinyawo zakhe, umthwalo-zithuthi wakhe ecaleni kwakhe; abaFilisti bawela phambi kukaYonathan, umthwalo-zithuthi wakhe wababulala emva kwakhe.
Kulo hlaselo lokuqala uYonatan nomthwalo wezixhobo zakhe babulala malunga nabantu abamashumi amabini kwindawo emalunga nengxenye yobungakanani bendawo encinane.

Ke kaloku kwabakho uxinzelelo kum zazdoli wonke wamaFilisti, emkhosini nasentlango; kwabakho noxinzelelo phakathi komkhosi namaqela ahlaselayo. Kwabakho noxinzelelo ehlabathini lonke, kuba kwakukho uxinzelelo oluvela kuThixo.
Iindawo zokujonga zikaSawule eGibhebha, eBhenjamin, zabona iqela lihamba ngaphaya.
Wathi ke uSawule kubomi bakhe, Babala abantu, nibone ukuba ngubani na osuka kuthi. Ke kaloku xa bebala, bafumanisa ukuba uYonatan nomthwalo wezithuthi zakhe abakho.
Wathi uSawule ku-Ahiya, Yazisa apha ibhokisi kaThixo. Wayikhona ngaloo mihla phakathi kwabaSirayeli;
Ke kaloku, ngelixa uSawule ethetha nombingeleli, kubonakala ngathi ingqumbo emkhosini wamaFilisti ikhula ikhula. Wathi ke uSawule kumbingeleli, Sukwenza into oyenzayo.
Ke kaloku uSawule namadoda akhe onke bahlangana, befika emfazweni; bafumana amaFilisti ephazamisekile kakhulu, abulalana ngekrebe.
Ke kaloku abanye abaHebhere, ababebakho nabaFilisti ngelo xesha lidlulileyo, bafike nabo emkhosini wabo, batshintshe izandla, bathabathela kumaSirayeli, babe noSawule noYonatan.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseSirayeli afihlakeleyo emnqamlezweni kaEfrayim, ekubona ukuba abaFilisti babaleka, waqala ukulwa nabo, wabaphulaphula.
Wasindisa ke iNkosi amaSirayeli ngaloo mini; umkhosi wadlula eBhete-aven.

Ke kaloku amadoda aseSirayeli aye ethambileyo ngaloo mini; ngokuba uSawule wabatyhila inkosi, esithi, Kubekho umntu oza kutya inyama phambi kokuba kube mhlwa, ngaphambi kokuba ndenze umonakalo kumagosa am. Akukho namnye kulo lonke elaseSirayeli owadla inyama.
Ke kaloku iqela lonke lafika elunxwemeni, kwakukho inkukhu emhlabathini.
Ke kaloku, befika emthini, babona inkukhu iphuma phantsi; kodwa akukho namnye wakwazi ukuyibeka emlonyeni wakhe, ngenxa yobundlobongela balo mthi.

Ke kaloku uYonathan wayesazi, xa uyise esenza iqela libhiyozele. Wamisa ngoko umda wentsimbi esesandlani sakhe, wayitshisa emlonyeni wenkukhu; wabeka isandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe, zakhanya amehlo akhe.
Wathetha kuye omnye wabakhonzi, esithi, Ubaba wakho wabeka umnqamlezo kumkhosi, wathi, Kubekho inyaniso kubo bonke abantu abadla inyama namhlanje; ngenxa yoko ke abantu balahleka.
Wathi uYonatan, Ubaba wam waphazamisa eli lizwe; ningaboni ukuba amehlo am anqabile kangakanani na, ngenxa yokuba ndadla isonka esincinane salo.
Kungcono kangakanani na, ukuba abantu babesele bedla namhlanje isonka abasithathele kumagosa abo? Ke kaloku siza kubulala amaFilisti amaninzi.
Ke kaloku, abaSirayeli babulala amaFilisti ngaloo mini, besuka eMikmasi besiya eAyaloni; ke kaloku, balahleka.
Basuka bathabathela kwizinto ezilahlekileyo, bathabatha iinkomo, nezimvu, neenkunzi zeegusha; bazibulala phezu komhlaba, badla inyama negazi layo.
Ke kaloku kwathiwa kuSawule, Yabona, abantu basenza isono kuYehova, bedla inyama enegazi. Wathi ke uSawule, Uthe waphula umthetho; jikeleziseni apha ngokukhawuleza ityuwa enkulu.

Wathi ke, Yiya phakathi kwamadoda, nithi kubo, Ninikele kum ngamnye inkomo yakhe, nomntwana wakhe, nizifile apha, nizidle; ningabi nesono kuYehova, nize nidle inyama enegazi kuyo. Wazisa ngoko umntu ngamnye inkomo yakhe ngaloo busuku, wayibulala khona.
Ke kaloku uSawule wakha isibingelelo kuYehova; kwaba ngukuqala kwakhe ukukha isibingelelo kuThixo.

Wathi uSawule, Siyikhuphele phantsi emva kwabaFilisti ngobusuku, sithabathe iimpahla zabo de kube limini; asishiyenga mntu omnye phakathi kwabo. Baphendula bathi, Yenza konke okulungileyo engqondweni yenu. Wathi ke umbingeleli, Siyakubuza uThixo apha kuqala.
Wabuza ke uSawule uThixo, esithi, Ndiya kuhla ndilandele abaFilisti? Ngaba uya kuwanikela esandla samaSirayeli? Ke kaloku uThixo akawuphenduli ngaloo mini.
Wathi ke uSawule, Nceda nifike apha, nina bonke abathetheli bemikhosi, sibone ukuba yintoni na isono esithe senziwa namhlanje.
Ngokuqinisekileyo, uphila iNkosi, umsindisi wakwaSirayeli, ukuba, nokuba nguYonatan unyana wam, uya kufa. Ke kaloku akukho namnye wamadoda athetha lizwi.
Wathi uSawule kubo bonke amadoda aseSirayeli, Nceda nihlale apha; mna noYonatan unyana wam siya kuhlala apha. Baphendula abantu bathi, Niyenze into elungileyo entliziyweni yenu.
Wathandaza ke uSawule kuYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Sibonise impendulo elungileyo. Wathi uYonatan noSawule, baqhutywa ngekhefu; abo madoda bacoceka.
Wathi uSawule, Nqumle umlo phakathi kwam noYonatan unyana wam. UYonatan waqhutywa.
Wathi ke uSawule kuYonatan, Ndixelele ukuba wenze ntoni na? UYonatan wamphendula wathi kuye, Ndidlale nje inkukhu encinci ngesiphelo sombhoxo wam; ngoku ndiya kufa.
Wathi uSawule, UThixo akwenze njalo nangakumbi kum, ukuba ungafanga, uYonatan.

Bathi ke abantu kuSawule, UYonathan uya kufa na, lowo wawenza lo msindiso omkhulu kumaSirayeli? Akuyi kubakho nto; njengokuba iNkosi ephilayo, akukho nwele enye yeκεφαλi yakhe eya kutsho emhlabathini; ngokuba wenza oku ngaloo mini ngoThixo. Ke kaloku aba bantu bakhusela uYonatan, akafanga.
Ke kaloku uSawule wayeka ukuwalandela amaFilisti; babuyela ezweni labo.
Waba ngukumkani uSawule phezu kwaSirayeli, wahlasela ooonodoli bakhe abajikelezayo: amaMowabhi, nabantwana baka-Ammon, neEdom, nabakumkani baseTsoba, nabaFilisti; apho ejika khona, wabaphulaphulela.
Wabhiyozela ngobukrelekrele, wahlasela ama-Amaleki, wawakhusela amaSirayeli ebusweni babo abawaxolelayo.
Oonyana bakaSawule: uYonatan, noIshivi, noMalkhi-shuwa; igama lonyana wakhe omkhulu nguMerabhi, negama lonyana wakhe omncinane nguMikayeli.
Umfazi wakhe waba nguAhinoam intombi ka-Ahimahazi. Umphathi womkhosi kaSawule wayenguAbheri unyana kaNeri, umyeni kaSawule.
UKishi uyise kaSawule, noNere uyise kaAbheri, babe oonyana bakaAbiyeli.
Kwabakho ukulwa olukhulu nabaFilisti zonke iintsuku zobomi bukaSawule; ke kaloku, xa uSawule ebona umntu onamandla, okanye umkhosi omkhulu, wayewuthatha waya kumkhonza.
Wathi uSamuweli kuSawule, Ndiye mna othunyelwe nguYehova ukuba ndikukhonze ukumkani phezu kwabantu bakhe bakaSirayeli; ke ngoko, thetha ngoku ilizwi likaThixo.
Utsho iNkosi wamaSirayeli, Ndiya kuzisa ityala kuma-Amaleki, ngenxa yento abayenzayo kumaSirayeli, xa bethabathela kubo, bephuma eYiputa.
Yiya ke ngoku, uhlasele ama-Amaleki, uthabathe zonke izinto zakhe; musa ukuzixolela; bulala amadoda namabhinqa, nabantwana nabafazi abakhulelweyo, neenkomo nezimvu, neeenkunzi zeegusha, neebhokhwe.
Ke kaloku uSawule wahlanganisa inkosi eTelayim, wababala: amawaka amakhulu mabini eenyawo, namawaka amahlanu ooYuda.
Ke kaloku uSawule waya kumzi ka-Amaleki, wamisa iinqwelo emlanjeni.

Wathi ke kuKeni, Yiya, shiya ama-Aamaleki, ukuze ndingakulahli nani kunye nabo; ngokuba nizenzile ubulungisa kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, xa bephuma eYiputa. Basuka ke abaKeni phakathi kwama-Amalekhi.
Wahlasela ke uSawule amaAmaleki, esuka eHavila waya eShure, elunxwemeni lwaseYiputa.
Wathatha uAgagi, ukumkani wama-Amaleki, ephilayo; wababulala bonke abantu bakhe ngeqhwa.

Ke kaloku uSawule namadoda ayemkhusela uAgagi, nezinto ezilungileyo zeentyatyambo, neebhokhwe, neenkomo ezincinane, nezimvu, nazo zonke izinto ezilungileyo; abazange banqwenele ukuzibulala. Zonke ke izinto ezingalunganga, nezonwabile, zabazibulala.
Kwafika ke ilizwi likaYehova kuSamuweli, lisithi,
Wathi uSamuweli kuYehova, Ndizixolele ukuba ndenza uSawule waba ngukumkani; ngokuba wabuyela umva kum, akazange aphumeze imiyalelo yam. USamuweli wakhathazeka, wayalela iNkosi loo busuku lonke.
Wavuka ke uSamuweli emveni kwemini, waya kuhlangana noSawule. Bathi kuye, USawule wafika eKarmele, wabeka khona isibonda sakhe; waphuma ke waya eGalgali.
Wafika ke uSamuweli kuye, wathi uSawule, UYehova akubhiyozele; ndawenza umthetho kaYehova.
Wathi ke uSamuweli, Yintoni na loo msindo weentyatyambo ezindlebeni zam? Yintoni na loo msindo wenkomo endiwuvayo?
Waphendula uSawule wathi, Bazithabatha zisuka kuma-Amaleki; kuba bagcine iinkomo ezilungileyo nezimvu, ukuze bazisondeze kuYehova uThixo wakho; kodwa ezo zinye sizibulala.
Wathi ke uSamuweli kuSawule, Kulungile; ndiza kukuxelela into ebesithiyo kum iNkosi ngobusuku obudlulileyo. Waphendula uSawule wathi, Ndixelele.

Wathi ke uSamuweli, Uthe ke wena, nakuba wabonakala ngathi ungumntu omncinane engqondweni yakho, awusazi ukuba uya kuba yintloko yezizukulwana zakwaSirayeli? UYehova wakwenza ube ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
Wakuthumela ke iNkosi, esithi, Yiya, uthabathe ngokugqithisileyo abo balungisa bakaAmaleki; hlaselana nabo, de nibakhulule.
Kutheni na ke ukuba ungamthobeli iNkosi? Kutheni na ke ukuba uthabathe isithunywa, wenze okubi emehlweni kaThixo?
Wathi uSawule, Ndiye ndaphulaphula ilizwi likaYehova; ndahamba ngenkonzo kaYehova endiyenzileyo, ndawabulala ooAmaleki, ndawabuyisela uAgagi ukumkani wabo.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli bathabathe izimvu neentlanzi ezilahlekileyo, ezona zinto zilungileyo zazo zonke iinkomo, ukuba bazinikela kuYehova uThixo wakho eGalgali.

Waphendula ke uSamuweli wathi, UYehova uthanda njani izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi nezibingelelo, njengokuba uthanda ukuthobela iNkosi? Ukuthobela kungcono kunazo zonke izibingelelo, nokuthobela kungcono kunamafutha omnquma.
Ukunyaniseka kufana nobuxoki, nokuxhaphaza kufana nokukhonza imifanekiso engumqondiso; ngenxa yokuba uthabathe isigqibo soYehova, nawe wathabatha isigqibo sokuba ungukumkani.
Wathi uSawule kuSamuweli, Ndiphelele; ndawuphula umyalelo kaYehova namalungiselelo akho; ndabaxolela ke abantu, ndazinikela kubo.
Ke ngoko, nceda usindise isono sam, ubuyisele nam, ndimkhonze kuYehova.
Wathi ke uSamuweli kuye, Andiyi kubuyela nawe; kuba uthathe isigqibo sokumkani kaYehova, naye uThixo wathatha isigqibo sakho, ukuze ungabi ngukumkani kumaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, xa uSamuweli ejikeleza ukuba ahambe, uSawule wathabatha umqolo womqamelo wakhe, waba mkhulu.
Wathi ke uSamuweli kuye, UYehova unqumle ubukumkani bukaSirayeli kuwe namhlanje, wawunike umhlobo wakho ongcono kunawe.
Ubuhle bukaSirayeli abuxoki, abuguquki; ngokuba akanguye umntu oguqukayo.
Wathi ke uSawule, Ndiphelele; kodwa mna, nceda, ndihloniphe phambi kwamadoda amakhulu elizwe lam, nangaphambili kwabaSirayeli; buyela nam, ndikukhonze iNkosi uThixo wakho.
Wabuyela ke uSamuweli noSawule; wathandaza uSawule kuYehova.
Wathi ke uSamuweli, Ninikele kum uAgagi ukumkani wama-Amaleki. UAgagi wafika kuye ngethemba, esithi, Ngokuqinisekileyo ibuhlungu bokufa buphelile.
Wathi ke uSamuweli, Ngokuba ikrele lakho lisenza amadoda angabantwana, ngoko ke unyana wakho uya kuba angabantwana phakathi kwamabhinqa. USawule wabulala uAgagi phambi koYehova eGilgal.
Ke kaloku uSamuweli waya eRama; uSawule ke wanyuka waya ekhaya lakhe, eGibeha kaSawule.
Ke kaloku uSamuweli akayeki kwakhona ukubona uSawule, kuze kube yimini yokufa kwakhe; waza uSamuweli wesaba uSawule. UYehova waxolela ukuba wenza uSawule waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.

Wathi iNkosi kuSamuweli, Uza kuhlala ixesha elingakanani ungamlindela uSawule, xa ndiyenzile ukuba angabi ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli? Nciphisa intsimbi yakho ngeoyile, uye; ndiya kukuthumela kuYese waseBhetelehem; ngokuba mna ndenza omnye wabo oonyana bakhe abe ngumkani.
Wathi ke uSamuweli, Ndiya kuhamba njani? Ukuba uSawule uya kuziqonda izinto ezinjalo, uya kundibulala. Wathi iNkosi, Yiba nenyosi encinci nawe, uthi, Ndiza ukunikela idini kuYehova.
Ke kaloku, mncede uYese kwidini elingcwele; ndiya kukuxelela ukuba kufuneka wenze ntoni na; uya kumnyamekela lowo ndiya kukuxelela wona.
Wakwenza ke uSamuweli njengoko wathi iNkosi. Ke kaloku, xa efika eBetheleyimu, baphuma abakhulu bomzi, belumkisana naye, besithi, Ufika njani ngoxolo?
Waphendula uSamuweli, wathi, Kulungile; mna ndithe ndafika ukuba ndilungiselele idini likaYehova; zinikeleni, nifike nam kwidini. Wazinikela ke uYese neentombi zakhe, wababiza esinikeni esi.
Ke kaloku bafika, uSamuweli ebona uEliyaba, wathi, Nguye ke yena okhethiweyo nguYehova ukuba ahlale phambi koYehova.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wathi kuSamuweli, Musa ukujonga ubume bakhe obuhle, nobude bakhe; ngokuba ndimthubisele. UYehova akajongi izinto azibonayo umntu; ngenxa yokuba umntu uyajonga okungaphandle, kodwa iNkosi ujonge intliziyo.
Wabiza ke uYese uAbinadadi, wamvumela ukuba ahambe phambi kukaSamuweli; wathi ke uSamuweli, UYehova akawukhethi nalowo.
Ke kaloku uYese wahamba noShama; wathi ke uSamuweli, UYehova akawukhethenga lo mntu.
Ke kaloku uYese wamisa oonyana bakhe abasibhozo ukuba bahambe phambi kukaSamuweli; wathi ke uSamuweli kuye, UYehova akawakhethi abo.

Wathi ke uYese, Ingaba abo bonke oonyana bakho? Waphendula uJese, wathi, Akukho mncinane; yena ugcina iinkomo. Wathi uSamuweli, Yithutha, uyibize; kuba asiyi kuhlala sidla isidlo sangokuhlwa, de afike.
Wathumela ke uYese, wamthabatha. Yathi iinwele zakhe zihle, zikhanyayo, namehlo akhe aqaqambileyo, nobuso bakhe buhle; wathi iNkosi kuye, Yiya, umqulethe; kuba lo nguye.
Ke kaloku uSamuweli wathabatha intonga yeoli, wamnquma phambi kwabazalwana bakhe. Wathi ke uMoya kaYehova waba phezu kukaDavide ukusukela kuloo mini nangaphezulu; uSamuweli ke waya eRama.
Ke kaloku uMoya kaYehova waphuma kuSawule; umphefumlo ombi osuka kuYehova wamxolela.
Bathi kuye abakhonzi bakaSawule, Yabona, umphefumlo ombi osuka kuThixo ubuhlungu kuwe.
Ukumkani wethu athethe abakhonzi bakhe, ukuba bafune umntu odlala kakuhle i-harpa; ukuze, xa umphefumlo olungileyo osuka kuThixo efika kuwe, abe ngumdlali wayo, nawe uhlale ngcono.
Wathi ke uSawule kubakhonzi bakhe, Fumaniseni mntu odlala kakuhle, nimkhokele.
Waphendula omnye wabakhonzi, wathi, Ndibone unyana kaYese waseBhetelehem okwaziyo ukubhema i-harpa, naye ungumntu onamandla, ngumkhosi, nothetha kakuhle, nomfana onemilo entle; iNkosi ke unguye.
Wathumela ke uSawule abathunywa kuYese, esithi, Yithumelele kum uDavide, unyana wakho, ohlala neentyatyambo.
Wathabatha ke uYese inkunzi yegusha, yayithwala isonka, nomgqomo wewayini, nebhokhwe encinci, wayithumela kuSawule ngoDavide unyana wakhe.
Wafika uDavide kuSawule, wasebenza kuye. USawule wamthanda kakhulu uDavide; waba ngumnye wabathwali bezixhobo zakhe.
Wathumela ke uSawule impendulo kuYese, esithi, Athi uDavide ahlale endlwini yam; kuba ndimthanda.
Ke kaloku, xa umphefumlo osuka kuThixo efika kuSawule, uDavide wayethabatha i-harpa, wadlala; ke kaloku uSawule waba noxolo, waba ngcono, wamshiya lo mphefumlo.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti bahlanganisana imikhosi yabo, ukuba babe ngumfazwe; bahlangana eSoko, eYuda, bamisa iintaba phakathi kweSoko noAzeka, e-Efese Dammim.
Ke kaloku uSawule namadoda aseSirayeli bahlangana, bamisa itente eNtaba kaEla; balungiselela ukubhiyozela, bejongene nabaFilisti.
Bathi amaFilisti abekwe phezulu komnqamlezo omnye, namaSirayeli ebekwe phezulu komnqamlezo owodwa; uLwandle lwaluphakathi kwabo.
Ke kaloku waphuma umnqobi, igama lakhe nguGoliyathi, waseGati, esuka emkhosini wamaFilisti; ubude bakhe buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini.
Wagqoka isigqubuthelo sebronzi, nempahla yokulwa eyenziwe ngemilinganiselo yebronzi, eyisisindo esimalunga namawaka amane anesibhozo eekhilogram.
Wathi, Iinqanawa zentsimbi zikwimithambo yakhe; isikhongo sentsimbi siqhutywa ngasemva wakhe.
Intsontelo yesithuthi sakhe yaba mkhulu, njengentsontelo yomzi-mveliso; intonga yayo yentsimbi yayikumakhulu asixhenxe eetoni. Umntu othwala imiyalelo wayehamba phambi kwakhe.

Ke kaloku uGoliyati wahlala, wathi kumaSirayeli: Yintoni na le nto nilungiselela ukubhiyozela? NdinguFilisti mna, nina ke ningabakhonzi bakaSawule; khetheni umntu omnye phakathi kwamadoda enu, umkhuphele kum.
Ukuba akwazi ukulwa, ambulala mna, siya kuba ngabakhonzi benu; kodwa ukuba ndimnqobe ndimbulala, niya kuba ngabakhonzi bethu, ningasikhonza.
Wathi ke uFilisti, Namhlanje ndiye ndazibulala iinqanawa zakwaSirayeli; nikelani nam umntu, sithethene.
Wava ke uSawule, namadoda onke aseSirayeli, amazwi alo mFilisti; baphoxeka, baba namandla aphantsi.
Ke kaloku uDavide waba ngunyana kaYese, umEfrati waseBhetelehem yaseYuda. UJese wayeneentombi ezisibhozo; waza ke emihla kaSawule wayeneminyaka emikhulu kakhulu.
Ke kaloku oonyana ababini abakhulu bakaYese balandela uSawule emfazweni; waba nguEliyaba omkhulu kubo, waba nguAbinadadi owokuqala kubo, waba nguShama wothathu.
UDavide wayeyintombi. Abakhulu abathathu balandela uSawule,
Ke kaloku uDavide wayebuya esuka kuSawule, ukuba agcine iintombi zoyise eBheteli.
Lo mFilisti wayefika ekuseni nakusihlwa, ehlala khona iintsuku ezimashumi mane.
Wathi uYese kuDavide, unyana wakhe, Yithathe le bhokisi yeziqhamo ezitshiziweyo, nale mifuno elishumi yesonka, uyiqhubele abazalwana bakho emakhayeni.
Yazisa ezi keysi ezilishumi kumphathi weqela labo, ubone ukuba baphilile abazalwana bakho, uze ubathumelele izimvo.
USawule namadoda onke aseSirayeli bakwiNtaba kaEla, behlasela abaFilisti.

UDavide washiya iinkomo ekuseni, wazisa umntu ukuba ajonge emva kwazo, waza wazisa, waphuma, njengokuba uYese wamxelela. Wafika esixekweni xa umkhosi esuka ezindaweni zakhe zokulwa, etsho uzuko lomfazwe.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli namadoda aseFilisti aye ecaleni, ajongene.
Ke kaloku uDavide washiya izinto zakhe kumntu ophethe izithuthi, wabaleka waya ecaleni lemfazwe, wababuza abazalwana bakhe ukuba baphile njani.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa ethetha nabo, uGoliyati, umnqobi wamaFilisti osuka eGathi, waphuma emehlweni akhe, wayalela ngelizwi lakhe eliqhelekileyo; uDavide wamva.
Ke kaloku, xa amaSirayeli ebona lo mntu, bonke babaleka phambi kwakhe, bekhathazeka kakhulu.

Ke kaloku amaSirayeli ayethi, Ubona na lo mntu ophumayo? Uphuma ukutshabalalisa amaSirayeli; lowo umbulalayo, ukumkani uya kumnika ubutyebi obukhulu, naye uya kumnika intombi yakhe ukuba ibe ngumfazi wakhe, nendlu yakhe ingabi nayo inzala eSirayeli.

Wathi uDavide kubafazi abasecaleni kwakhe, Kuza kwenziwa ntoni na kumntu obulala lo mFilisti, ukuze asuse isono esisuka kuSirayeli? Lo mFilisti ongathotywanga ngubani na, ukuba aphucule amaqela kaThixo ophilayo?
Bathi kuye into ekufuneka yenziwe ngumntu owambulalayo.

UEliyaba, unyana omkhulu kaDavide, wayemva ethetha namadoda, wagwetywa nguEliyabhi, wathi kuye, Kutheni na ukuba uye phantsi apha? Ngubani na owazishiya naye ezo nkomo ezincinane emlilweni? Ndiyazi intloko yakho, nobubi bentliziyo yakho; uye phantsi nje ukubukela umkhosi.
Wathi uDavide, Yintoni na endiyenzayo ngoku? Ndingathetha ntoni?
Ke kaloku wajika waya kumnye umntu, wambuza ngento efanayo; babemphendula ngokunjalo nangaphambili.
Ke kaloku, kwavakala amazwi kaDavide, waziswa kuSawule; ke uSawule wamthumela wambiza.
Wathi uDavide kuSawule, Akukho namnye oza kuphelelwa ngumphefumlo ngenxa yalo mFilisti; umkhonzi wakho uya kuhamba aze amfazele.
Waphendula uSawule wathi, Awunakukwazi ukutyelela lo mFilisti wokulwa naye; kuba wena ungumntwana, yena ke ungumkhosi onamandla ukusukela ekubeni ngumntwana.
Wathi uDavide kuSawule, Umkhonzi wakho wayezikhusela izimvu zomyeni wakhe; xa befika ilili, okanye umnquba, bathabathe isibhozo kwisibhozo,
Ndaya emva kwayo, ndayibetha, ndayikhusela inkomo emlonyeni wayo; yabuyela kum, ndayitsala ngeenwele zayo, ndayibetha, ndayibulala.
Umkhonzi wakho wabulala ilili, wabulala nebhokhwe; lo mFilisti ongathotywanga uya kuba njengenye yazo, ngokuba waphucula amaqela kaThixo ophilayo.
UYehova, ondisindileyo emlonyeni welili, nemlonyeni womnquba, yena uya kundisindisa emlonyeni walo mFilisti. Wathi uSawule kuDavide, Yiya; iNkosi abe nawe.
Ke kaloku uSawule wamnxiba uDavide iimpahla zakhe, wamisa phezu kwakhe izithuthi zokulwa, wayibeka inqanawa yentsimbi embindini weqhina lakhe.

Ke kaloku uDavide wabeka ikrele likaSawule phezu kwempahla yakhe, wazama ukuhamba; kuba wayesazi ukuba ahambe ngazo. Wathi kuSawule, Andikwazi ukuhamba ngazo, ngokuba andiyazi ukuba ndihambe ngazo. Wazikhupha ke.

Wathabatha intonga yakhe yomgcini-bhokhwe esandla sakhe, wakhetha iithayile ezintlanu ezithambileyo emlanjeni, waza wazisa kwisakhelo sebhegi yakhe yomgcini-bhokhwe; wabeka umnquba wakhe esandla sakhe, waya kumFilisti.
Ke kaloku lo mFilisti, umthwalo wesikhuselo sakhe engaphambili kwakhe, wafika waya kuDavide.
Ke kaloku uSirayeli wambona uDavide, wakubona ukuba ungumntu omncinci, oqinileyo, nobuhle bobuso bakhe; wambona ke.
Wathi ke uBhenjamin kuDavide, Ndiye ndaba yinja na mna, ukuba ungene kum ngeebhokhwe? UBhenjamin waphulaphula uDavide ngamadini akhe;
Wathi ke, Yiya apha, ndininike inyama yakho izimvu neentlanzi zehlabathi.
Wathi uDavide kuloo mFilisti, Ufika kum ngekrele, nomqolo, nombhobho; ke mna ndiya kuwe ngegama likaYehova wemikhosi, nguThixo wamajoni kaSirayeli, owawuxhaphazelayo.

Namhlanje iNkosi uya kukunikela esandla sam; ndiya kukubetha, ndiyitshise intloko yakho; namhlanje ke ndiya kuzinika izidumbu zomkhosi wamaFilisti izimvu neentlanga; ukuze ihlabathi lonke likwazi ukuba kukho uThixo kuSirayeli.
Bayazi bonke abakhoyo apha, ukuba iNkosi akasindisi ngekrele nasenqanaweni; lo mfazwe nguwo iNkosi, yena uya kuninikela esandla sethu.
Ke kaloku lo mFilisti efika, athabathele kuye; uDavide wahamba ngesantya, waya kumqolo wokulwa, ukuba amfumane.
Ke kaloku wamisa isandla sakhe, wathabatha ngaphakathi kwempahla yakhe itye, wamthutha, wambetha lo mFilisti emlonyeni wakhe; lathi itye litshisa emlonyeni wakhe, waba phantsi ngobuso bakhe emhlaba.
Ke kaloku uDavide waphumelela phezu kwalo mFilisti, ngebhombu nelitye; kwakungekho nkqo esandla sakhe; wambetha lowo Mfilisti, wambulala.

Wabaleka uDavide, wahlala phezu kwakhe; wathabatha ikrele loMfilisita, wamsusa emlonyeni wakhe, wambulala, wamisa intloko yakhe ngekrele. Bathe ke abaFilisti bebona ukuba umnqobi wabo ufile, babuyela baya kuphuma.

Bavuka ke amadoda aseSirayeli naaseYuda, bakhupha umsindo, balandela abaFilisti, befike ekungeneni kweGati, nezingcango zeEkroni; iinkunzi zeeFilisti zaphazamisa indlela yaseShaaraim, ziye eGati naseEkroni.
Ke kaloku babuya amaSirayeli, basuka belandela abaFilisti, bathabathe isixeko sabo.
UDavide wathabatha intloko yalo mFilisti, wayithabatha waya eYerusalem; izithuthi zalo mFilisti zazibeka kwitente yakhe.

Ke kaloku, xa uSawule ebona uDavide ephuma emveni komFilisti, wathi kuAbheri, umphathi womkhosi: UAbheri, lo mntwana ngunyana wentoni? Waphendula uAbheri wathi, Kuphila intliziyo yakho, nkosi yam, andiyazi.
Wathi ukumkani, Yazi ukuba lo mntwana ngunyana womnye na.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide ebuyela emfazweni walo mFilisti, uAbheri wamthabatha, wamzisa phambi kukaSawule; uDavide wayesengqondweni yaloo Mfilisti.
Wathi ke uSawule kuye, Unyana wento na wena, mntwana? Wathi uDavide, Ndiye unyana kaYese umkhonzi wakho waseBetheleyimu.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide egqibile ukuthetha noSawule, lo mphefumlo kaYonatan wafana nomphefumlo kaDavide; wamthanda njengothando lwakhe.
Wathi ke uSawule, ukususela kuloo mini, wamgcina uDavide kuye; akawuvumelenga ukuba abuye endlwini kayise.
Ke kaloku uYonatan wenza umnqophiso noDavide, ngokuba wayemthanda njengomphefumlo wakhe.
Ke kaloku uYonatan wakhupha iingubo zakhe, waza wamnika uDavide, kunye nempahla yakhe, nayo isigwebo sakhe, nenqanawa yakhe, nomqolo wakhe.
Naphi na apho uSawule wamthumela khona uDavide, wayephumelela kakhulu; ngoko ke uSawule wambeka phezu kwamadoda amaninzi. Kwaba luncedo kubo bonke abantu, nabaphathi bakaSawule.

Ke kaloku, xa abantu bebuyela endlwini yabo, emva kokuba uDavide wabulala loo mFilisti, kwaphuma amabhinqa kuwo onke amadolophu kaSirayeli, ukuhlangabezana nokumkani uSawule, benengoma, benemidaniso, neengxowa-ntloko, neentlobo zonke zezixhobo zokudlala.
Ke kaloku bedlala, bethi, USawule wabulala amawaka akhe, ke uDavide amashumi amawaka akhe.

Ke kaloku uSawule waxhaphaza kakhulu, waza lo mculo wamxhalabisa. Wathi ke uSawule: Baye bamnika uDavide amawaka amaninzi; mna ke ndibanika amawaka amaninzi; angazifumana ntoni na enye into ngaphandle kobukumkani?
Wathi ke uSawule, ukusukela ngaloo mini, amehlo akhe ayemthanda uDavide.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla olandelayo, umphefumlo ombi osuka kuThixo wahlasela uSawule; waza ke uDavide edlala i-harp yakhe, njengoko wayesoloko eyenza; uSawule ke wayenebhombu esandla sakhe.
Wayikhupha, wathi engqondweni yakhe, Ndiya kutshixa uDavide emgangathweni. UDavide waphuma kuye kabini.
USawule wamxolela uDavide; ngokuba iNkosi waye noDavide, ke kaloku uSawule washiya.
Ke kaloku uSawule wayalela uDavide ukuba ahambe naye, wammisa waba ngukumkani wamawaka amadoda. UDavide wayehamba ngamandla emfazweni.
Kwazo zonke izinto azenzayo, waphumelela kakhulu; ngokuba iNkosi waye naye.
Ke kaloku uSawule, xa ebona ukuba waphumelela kakhulu, wamxolela ngakumbi.
Ke kaloku bonke abaSirayeli nabaYuda babemthanda uDavide, ngokuba wayehamba nabo emfazweni.

Wathi uSawule kuDavide, Yabona ke intombi yam enkulu, uMerabhi; ndiya kukunika yena ukuba ube ngumfazi wakho; zinikele kum kuphela, nibe ngamadoda anamandla, nife imibhiyozo kaYehova. Wathi uSawule, Andiyi kuphakamisa isandla sam kuye; bayenze loo nto amaFilisti.
Wathi ke uDavide kuSawule, Ndibani na mna? Ngubani na intsapho yam, nosapho loyise wam kumaSirayeli, ukuba ndibe ngumkakhe ukumkani?
Ke kaloku, xa kwafika ixesha lokuba uMerab, intombi kaSawule, anikezelwe kuDavide, wanikezelwa ukuba abe ngumfazi kaAdriyeli waseMehola.
Ke kaloku uMikayeli, intombi kaSawule, wayemthanda uDavide. Bathi ke kuSawule ngaloo nto, wavuya.
Wathi ke uSawule, Ndiya kumnika yena, ukuze abe ngumqolo wakhe, ukuba abulawa ngabaFilisti. Wathi ke uSawule kuDavide, Namhlanje uya kuba ngunyana wam womkakhe ngomhla wesibini.
Wathi uSawule kubakhonzi bakhe, Nithethe noDavide ngokufihlakeleyo, nisithi, Yabona, ukumkani uyakuthanda wena, nabakhonzi bakhe bonke bayakuthanda; ngoko ke, ube ngumyeni wakhe.
Bathi ke kubo uDavide loo mazwi. Wathi ke uDavide, Yinto encinci na kuwe ukuba ube ngunyana womyeni wokumkani? Ndinguye nje umntu omncinane, ndingaziwa.
Bathi ke abakhonzi bakaSawule kuye amazwi kaDavide,

Waphendula ke uSawule, wathi, Nithi kuDavide, Ukumkani akafuni nantoni na ngaphandle kwempahla yomtshato, kodwa iinwele zangaphambili zeSirayeli ezilikhulu, ukuze agweme izitha zakhe. USawule wayefuna ukuba amaSirayeli amfasele uDavide;
Bathi ke abakhonzi bakaDavide ngaloo nto, wathandazela uDavide ukuba abe ngunyana womyeni kakumkani. Ke kaloku, phambi kokuba imihla iphele,

UDavide wathabatha amadoda akhe, waya, wabulala amaFilisti angamakhulu mabini; wazisa iinwele zabo zesibeleko, wababala bonke kukumkani, ukuze abe ngunyana womyeni kakumkani. Wamnika ke uSawule uMikayeli intombi yakhe ukuba ibe ngumfazi.
Wabona ke uSawule ukuba iNkosi unguDavide, yaye uMikayeli intombi yakhe wayemthanda.
Wathi ke uAbhimeleki, Ndimxolele kakhulu uDavide; waba ngumthandi kaDavide zonke iintsuku zakhe.
Baphuma abathetheli bakaFilisti emfazweni; xa bephuma khona, uDavide waphumelela kakhulu kunabo bonke abazalwana bakaSawule; igama lakhe lafika lidumileyo.
Ke kaloku uSawule wathetha noYonatan, unyana wakhe, namakhonzi akhe onke, ukuba babulala uDavide. UYonatan ke, unyana kaSawule, wamthanda kakhulu uDavide.
Wathi kuDavide, USawule uyise wam ukhangela indlela yokukubulala; qaphela ke namhlanje kusasa, uye kwindlu efihlakeleyo, ube khona.
Ke mna ndiya kuphuma, ndihlale nobaba wam ezweni apho uza kuba khona; ndiza kuthetha naye ngento yakho, nokuba ndiyifumana ntoni na, ndiya kukuxelela.
Ke kaloku uYonatan wathetha ngokulungileyo ngoDavide kuSawule, uyise, wathi kuye, Ukumkani angabi nento embi kumkhonzi wakhe uDavide; akubi nantoni na embi kuwe; into ayenzayo iye yakunceda kakhulu.

Wabeka ubomi bakhe entliziyweni yakhe, wabulala loo mFilisti. UYehova wenza usindiso olukhulu kuwo onke amaSirayeli; wena ke wawubona, waba mnandi; kutheni na ke ukuba uyenze into embi kuDavide, umntu ongenatyala, ukumbulala ngaphandle kwesizathu?
Ke kaloku uSawule wamthobela uYonatan, wamisa isibingelelo esithi, Uphila iNkosi, uDavide akafanga.
Ke kaloku uYonatan wambiza uDavide, wamxelela zonke izinto, wamthabatha waya kuSawule; wakhonza ke uDavide uSawule njengokuba kwangaphambili.
UDavide waphuma, waya kulwa nabaFilisti; wababulala ngokubulala okukhulu, babaleka phambi kwakhe.
Wafika uMoya oyiNtombikazi osuka kuYehova kuSawule, xa wayehlala endlwini yakhe, enesikhephe sakhe esisesandlani; ke kaloku uDavide edlala nge-harpa.
Ke kaloku uSawule wazama ukumnqula umbhoxo wakhe edonga; ke uDavide wamgxeka, waza umbhoxo wakhe waba ngumbhoxo edonga. UDavide wabaleka ngaloo busuku, wayalela.

Ke kaloku uSawule wathumela abantu endlwini kaDavide, ukuba bayijonge, bayambulala emveni kwemini. Wathi ke uMikayeli, umfazi kaDavide, kuye, esithi, Ukuba awusayi kuphuma namhlanje ukukhusela ubomi bakho, ngoMgqibelo uya kubulawa.
Ke kaloku uMikayeli wamkhupha uDavide phantsi ngefestile; waya, wabaleka.
Wathabatha ke uMikayeli i-teraphim, wayibeka phezu kwebhedi; wayigubungela ngeempahla, wazisa iinwele zeentyatyambo phantsi komlenze.
Ke kaloku, xa uSawule ethumela abantu ukuba bathabathe uDavide, uMikayeli wathi, Unesifo.
Ke kaloku uSawule wathumela amadoda ukuba ajonge uDavide, esithi, Niyikhuphele kum ebhedini yakhe, ukuze ndimfa.
Bafika ke abo madoda, babone ukuba idini likwibhedi, nezinwele zeentyatyambo ziphantsi komlomo.
Wathi uSawule kuMikayeli, Kutheni na ukuba uyayixolela loo nto, wamisa umkhosi wam, waphuma? UMikayeli wathi kuye, Wathi kum, Yiya ndihambe; ndingakubulala njani?
Ke kaloku uDavide wabaleka, waphuma, waya kuSamuweli eRama, wamxelela zonke izinto azenzayo uSawule kuye. Waya ke yena noSamuweli eNayot, bahlala khona.
Ke kaloku kwaziswa uSawule, besithi, Yabona, uDavide eNayothi eRama.

Wathumela ke abantu ukuba athabathe uSawule. Bathe babona iqela labaprofeti lithetha ngento ephosakeleyo, noSamuweli ehlala khona njengomphathi wabo; wafika uMoya kaThixo kumadoda kaSawule, babethetha ngento ephosakeleyo nabo.
Ke kaloku kwathiwa kuSawule, wathumela abantu abaninzi; Erdoğana nabo baprofetisa. Wathumela uSawule amadoda kathathu, baya profetiza nabo.
Ke kaloku yena waphuma waya eRama, wafika esibhedlele esikhulu esiseSeku; wathi, Nguphi uSamuweli noDavide? Bathi ke kubo: ENayoti eRama.
Ke kaloku uSawule waya eNayothi, eRama. UMoya kaThixo waba phezu kwakhe; wahamba ke, eprofetisa, de kwafika eNayothi.
Ke kaloku wasusa iingubo zakhe, waprofetisa naye phambi kukaSamuweli; walala emnyama ngaloo mini yonke, nobusuku bonke. Ngoko ke bathi, USawule na ungumprofeti?
Ke kaloku uDavide wabaleka eNayo zaz, eRama, waya kuYonathani; wathi kuye, Ndiyenze ntoni na? Ndiyenze ntoni na inkohlakalo? Ndamenza ntoni na uyise wakho, ukuba afuna ukundibulala?
Waphendula uYonatan wathi, Akunjalo; awuyi kufa. Yabona, uyise wam ayenzenga nto, inkulu okanye incinane, angandixelela yona; kutheni na ke ukuba andifihla loo nto? Akunyanzelekanga!

Ke kaloku uDavide wabhiyozela, wathi, Ubaba wakho uyazi kakuhle ukuba ndimthanda kakhulu; ke yena wathi engqondweni yakhe, Akufanele akwazi loo nto uYonathan, ukuze angabi neentloni; kodwa ngokuqinisekileyo, njengobomi bukaYehova nobomi bakho, ndiza kudlula nje isiqingatha senyawo phambi kokuba ndifa.
Wathi uYonatan kuDavide, Nantoni na oyifunayo ukuba ndiyenze kuwe, ndiya kuyikwenza.
Wathi ke uDavide, Yabona, namhlanje limini yenyanga entsha; ndimele ndidla nesonka nokumkani. Ke mna ndiya kufihla ezweni, kude kube kusasa ngeveki elandelayo.
Ukuba utata wakho undifuna, uthi kuye, UDavide wandicela ukuba amvumele ahambe ngokukhawuleza eBhetelehem, edolophini yakhe; kuba kukho khona idini leminyaka yonke losapho lonke.
Ukuba uthi, Kulungile; ke ngoko ndikhuselekile; kodwa ukuba atshintshe umphefumlo wakhe, ke ngoko uqiniseke ukuba ugqibile ukunibulala.
Ke wena, zinikele kum uthando, kuba ukwenze umnqophiso nam phambi koYehova; ukuba ndinobulungisa, msindise ngokwakho; kutheni na ukuba ndimnike kuyise?
Wathi uYonatan, Akukho nto; ukuba ndiyazi into encinci, ukuba ubaba wam wagqiba ukukwenza okubi kuwe, ndingakuxelela na?
Wathi uDavide, Nguwuphi oza kundixelela, ukuba uyise wakho akuphendule ngento ebuhlungu?
Wathi uYonatan, Yiya, siphume ezweni. Bahamba ke khona ndawonye.

Wathi uYonatan kuDavide, Ndizamile ngoYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, ukuba mna ndiya kwazi ngaloo mini, okanye ngemini elandelayo, into enokucinga ngayo utata wam; ukuba ibonakele kuwe, ndingawuthumeli na umyalezo, ndikuxelele?

Ukuba utata wam efuna ukukwenza ntoni na embi kuwe, iNkosi andixelele njalo nangokungakumbi, ukuba andikwazi kukuxelela, ndikushiye uhambe ngokukhuselekileyo; iNkosi abe nawe, njengokuba ube notata wam.
Ndithi ke, Xa ndiphila, zinikele kum inyaniso yobulungisa bukaYehova, ukuze andifa.
Musa ke ukuyeka ububele bakho kusapho lwam ngonaphakade, nalapho iNkosi egqibileyo zonke iintshaba zikaDavide phezu komhlaba wonke.
Ke kaloku uYonatan wenza umnqophiso nendlu kaDavide, esithi, UYehova ahlawule izitha zikaDavide.
Ke kaloku uYonatan wamenza uDavide aphinde atsho loo nto, ngokuba wayemthanda uDavide njengokuba wayemthanda yena.
Wathi ke uYonatan kuDavide, Namhlanje ngumhla wenyanga entsha; uya kufunwa, ngokuba indawo yakho iya kuba yinqaba.
Ngomhla wesibini emva kwemini, ngobusuku obungamashumi amabini anesihlanu, uhambe uye kwindawo ofihlakele kuyo, xa kwaqala ukusilela oku; uhlale ecaleni kwelitye elibizwa ngokuba yi-Ezel.
Ndiya kutyhila imiyalelo emithathu kwicala layo, njengokuba ndityhila kwinto endinokuyibetha.

Ndiza kumthumela unyana wam, ndithi kuye, Yiya, ufumane amasuntswana. Ukuba ndithi kuye, Bona, amasuntswana alapha ngaphaya kwakho; zisa apha; ke uya kufika; kuba, njengokuba iNkosi ephilayo, uya kukhuseleka; akukho nto ingoziyo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba ndithi kunyana, Jonga, amasuntswana angaphandle kwakho; ke ngoko uya kuhamba; ngokuba iNkosi ukuthumelele.
Ke kaloku, xa sithe sathetha ngamnye nomnye, khumbula ukuba iNkosi ngumqondiso phakathi kwam nowe kude kube sekupheleni.
Wafihla ke uDavide emaphandleni. Yafika imini yenyanga entsha, ukumkani wahlala edla.
Wahlala kwindawo yakhe eqhelekileyo, ngasedonga, phambi kukaYonatan; wahlala uAbheri phantsi kwesandla sikaSawule; indawo kaDavide ke yayingenanto.
USawule akathethi nto ngaloo mini; ngokuba wathi, Kuye kwathiwa kuye uDavide into ethile, ukuba abe mnyama; ngokuqinisekileyo umnyama.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga, imini elandelayo, indawo kaDavide yahlala phantsi. Wathi uSawule kuYonatan unyana wakhe, Uthini na ukuba unyana kaYese akafikanga emdlalweni, nokuba ngeveki ephelileyo okanye namhlanje?
Waphendula uYonatan, wathi, UDavide wandicela ukuba amvumele ahambe eBhetelehem.

Wathi, Nceda ndiyalele; kuba usapho lwethu lunomnikelo womnqophiso kulo mzi, umzalwana wam wathetha nam. Ukuba ungumhlobo wam, nceda uncede ndiye ndibone abazalwana bam. Yiyo loo nto akafikanga ekhitshini likakumkani.

Ke kaloku uSawule wabetha umsindo wakhe kuYonatan, wathi kuye, Unyana womntu okhohlakeleyo, nomthandi wobuxoki! Andiyazi na ukuba uthathe isandla somntwana kaYeshaya, ukuze ube nguxhala lwakho, noxhala lomzali wakho.
Xa unyana kaYese ephila kuloo mhlaba, awuyi kukhuseleka wena nakumkani wakho; thumela ke ngoku, umthwale kum, ngokuba uya kufa.
Wathi ke uYonatan kuyise, Kutheni na ukuba afunyanwe? Ukwenze ntoni na?
Ke kaloku uSawule wamthabatha umnqamlezo wakhe, ukuba amfa. Waqonda ke uYonathani ukuba uyise wagqiba ekubeni abulala uDavide.
Wavuka ke uYonatan esuka emehlweni, entolongweni enkulu. Ke kaloku ngomhla wesibini wosuku lwesikhumbuzo akayi kudla; ngokuba wayemthubi ngenxa yokuba uyise wamkhaba uDavide.
Ke kaloku uYonatan waphuma emveni kwemini, waya esizweni ukuhlangabezana noDavide, ngomhla omiselweyo; wayenendodana encinci naye.
Wathi kunyana wakhe, Yiya, ufumane amasuntswana endiwatshisayo. Ke kaloku unyana wayehamba, waza uYonatan watshisa umqolo ngaphezu kwakhe.
Ke kaloku, xa umntwana efika kwindawo apho imiyalelo kaYonathan yawela khona, uYonathan wayalela emva kwakhe, wathi, Imiyalelo ayikho ngaphezu kwakho?
Wathi ke, Yiya ngokukhawuleza, uhambe ngokukhawuleza; musa ukuphumla. Wathabatha lo mntwana umqolo, wabuyela kukumkani wakhe.
Lo mntwana awazi nto ngazo zonke ezi zinto; uYonatan noDavide kuphela abawazi.
Ke kaloku uYonathan wamnika umntwana izithuthi zakhe, wathi, Yiya, uzibuyisele edolophini.

Ke kaloku, xa lo mntwana ephelelwe lixesha, uDavide wavuka ecaleni lomnqamlezo welitye, waya phantsi phambi kukaYonatan kathathu, ngobuso bakhe ehlabathini; baqhawulana, bamlilela bonke. UDavide ke wayelilila kakhulu.

Wathi uYonatan kuDavide, Yiya ngoxolo; thina naloo mntu sithe savuma ngegama likaYehova, sisithi, UYehova abe ngumqondiso phakathi kwam nowe, phakathi kwembewu yakho nembewu yam, kude kube sekupheleni. Waphuma ke uDavide, wabuyela uYonatan emzini.
Wafika uDavide eNobhi, kuAhileleki umbingeleli. Wadibana naye uAhileleki, watsho, Uthini na ukuba usoloko phantsi? Ngaba akukho namnye nawe?

Waphendula uDavide kuAhileleki ukumkani, wathi, Ukumkani wandithumela, wathi kum, Akukho namnye oza kwazi nantoni na malunga nento endiyithumelelayo, okanye malunga nemimiselo yam; kodwa abantu bam ndibathethele ukuba bafike kum kwindawo ethile.
Ke ngoko, ntoni na oyinayo apha? Nceda undinike izitya ezintlanu zesonka, okanye into oza kuyifumanayo.
Waphendula ke umbingeleli kuDavide, wathi, Akukho ntlama eqhelekileyo ndinayo apha; kodwa kukho intlama engcwele, ukuba ngaba amadoda athabathe isandla sakhe kumabhinqa.

Waphendula ke uDavide, wathi, Ewe, bazalwana basisithintelo sethu, njengakuzo zonke iintsuku endihamba ngazo; kuba iinwele zabafazi zingcwele, nakwiintlanganiso zemihla ngemihla, yaye ngoku kubaluleke kangakanani na?
Wamnika ke umbingeleli isonka esingcwele; kuba kwakungekho sisono apho, ngaphandle kwesonka sokubonisa; sakhutshwa phambi koYehova, safakwa isisono esitsha ngaloo mini sasuswa khona.
Ke kaloku kwakukho umntu omnye phakathi kwabakhonzi bakaSawule ngaloo mini, ehlala khona phambi koYehova; waba nguDogeki umEdomi, owayengumphathi weemvumi zikaSawule.
Wathi uDavide ku-Ahileleki, Ingaba unayo apha inqanawa, okanye ikrele? Andiyi kuthatha ikrele lam nantoni na, ngenxa yokuba umyalelo wokumkani wawukhawuleza.

Waphendula umbingeleli, wathi, Ikhephu likaGoliyati umFilisti, owawubulala eNtshona yeEla, likho apha, lifutywe ngempahla ngasemva kwe-ephod; ukuba uyifunayo, uyithathe. Akukho kephebhu enye apha. Wathi uDavide, Akukho nanye ifana nayo; ndiyinike.
UDavide wabaleka uSawule ngaloo mini, waya kuAkishi ukumkani waseGati.

Bathi ke abakhonzi baka-Akishi kuye, Lo mntu akanguye na uDavide ukumkani wale lizwe? Akawuphi na lowo bewudlala ngawo emdlalweni wabo, besithi, USawule wabulala amawaka akhe, noDavide amashumi amabini amawaka akhe?
UDavide wabeka ezi zinto engqondweni yakhe, wakhathazeka kakhulu uAkishi ukumkani waseGati.

Wathi ke yena, Ndizamile ukuba mntu ongenangqondo phambi kwabo. Yaye, xa wayekhona nabo, wazama ukuba ngumntu ongenangqondo, ebhala izitshixo zomngxunya wesango, evumela utywala luhambe phantsi kweenwele zakhe.
Wathi ke uAkishi kubakhonzi bakhe, Yabonani lo mntu; kubonakala ngathi unenkanuko; kutheni na ukuba umnike?
Ingaba andizange ndibe neentliziyo ezibi ngokwaneleyo kum, ukuba nithi mnikele lo mntu apha, ukuba abe ngumphefumlo ombi phambi kwam? Uza kungena na lo mntu endlwini yam?
UDavide waphuma eGati, wabaleka waya kwimpucuko ka-Adulam. Bayazi loo nto abazalwana bakhe nendlu yoyise, bahla kuye khona.
Bahlangana kuye bonke abasengxakini, nabanezityala, nabenobuxoki; waba ngukumkani wabo. Kwabakho naye amadoda angamakhulu amane.
Waphuma khona uDavide waya eMizpa yamaMowabi; wathi kukumkani wamaMowabi, Nceda ukuba ubaba wam nomama wam bahlale kuni, de ndibone ukuba uThixo uza kundisenza ntoni.
Wabashiya ke kuye ukumkani wakwaMowabi; bahlala naye zonke iintsuku ebezikho uDavide esiqwini.
Wathi ke uGadi umprofeti kuDavide, Musa ukuhlala kuloo ndawo ikhuselekileyo; uye ezweni likaYuda. UDavide waphuma, waya kumthi waseHerethi.

Ke kaloku uSawule wava ukuba uDavide namadoda akhe bafunyanwa. USawule ke wayehlala phantsi komthi wetamarike, eGibeha, enesikhephe sakhe esikwisandla sakhe; bonke abaphathi bakhe babemi phambi kwakhe.
Wathi ke uSawule kubo, Ncokolani, nimadoda aseBhenjamini! Unyana kaYese uya kukunika na izityalo nezilimo zewayini? Uya kukukwenza njani ukuba ube ngukumkani wamawaka, nokumkani wamawaka?

Nguwuphi na lo mzekeliso niwenzayo kuni bonke kum? Akukho namnye wamxelela, xa unyana wam esenza umnqophiso nonyana kaYese. Akukho namnye kuni wamxelela, xa unyana wam ekhumbuza umkhonzi wam ukuba ahlale entolongweni, ukuze amgwebe, njengokuba kwenzeke namhlanje?
Waphendula ke uDogeki, umEdomi, ohlala phakathi kwabakhonzi bakaSawule, wathi, Ndabona unyana kaYeshaya efika kuAhileleki, unyana ka-Ahitubhi, eNobi.
Ke kaloku uAkhimeleki wabuza iNkosi ukuba angakwenza ntoni uDavide. Wamnika ke uAkhimeleki isonka, nekrele likaGoliyati umFilisti.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathumela waza wambiza uAhileleki, unyana ka-Ahitubhi, umbingeleli, nosapho lwakhe lonke, ababingeleli baseNobi. Bafika bonke kukumkani,
Wathi uSawule, Yiva ngoku, mna unyana ka-Ahitubhi. Waphendula wathi, Ewe, nkosi yam.

Wathi ke uSawule kuye, Kutheni na ukuba nani nonyana kaYeshaya nithethwa ngesandla kum? Nimnike isonka nekrele, nicela uThixo ukuba amncede; ukuze ahambe ndimi, abe ngumxoki wam, njengokuba kunjalo namhlanje.
Waphendula uAhileleki ukumkani, wathi, Nguwuphi na phakathi kwabakhonzi bakho bonke othembekileyo njengaye uDavide? Unyana womyeni kakumkani ke yena, nomkhuluwa wakho, nodume kakhulu endlwini yakho.

Ingaba ndaqala ntoni na ukuthandaza kuThixo ngenxa yakhe? Ngokungafaniyo; mna, mna umkhonzi wakho, ndicela ukuba ungamxelela intombi yakho nabani na endlwini yam; ngokuba mna umkhonzi wakho andikwazi nto ngale nto yonke.
Wathi ukumkani, Uya kufa ngokuqinisekileyo, uAhileleki, wena nosapho lonke loyise.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wabawisela imiyalelo abakhuseli bakhe, wathi, Nxibelelaniseni, bulala oombingeleli bakaYehova; ngokuba nabo bathabathe isiqalo noDavide. Bayazi ukuba ubaleka, kodwa bangandixelela nto. Ke kaloku abakhonzi bakakumkani abazange baphakamise isandla sabo ukuwabetha oombingeleli bakaThixo.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi kuDoge, Ujikeleze uhlasele oombingeleli. Wabuyela ke uDoge, umEdomi, wababulala; wabulala amadoda angamashumi asibhozo anesihlanu agqoka i-ephod yelinen ngaloo mini.
Wahlasela noNobhi, umzi wababingeleli, ngeqhina lekrele; wabulala amadoda ayo, namabhinqa ayo, nabantwana ayo, neentlanzi zayo, neebhokhwe zayo, neenkomo zayo, neemvu.
Ke kaloku uAbhiyatare, unyana ka-Ahileleki, unyana ka-Ahitubhi, wabaleka, waya kuDavide.
Wathi kuDavide, USawule wabulala ababingeleli bakaYehova.
Wathi uDavide kuAbhiyatare, Ndazi ngaloo mini, xa wayekho khona uDoge, umEdomi, ukuba ngokuqinisekileyo uya kumxelela uSawule; mna ke ndiyingozi yokufa kosapho lonke lukayise.
Musa ukukhathazeka, uhlale nam; kuba lowo efuna ukumbulala wena, ufuna nokumbulala mna; nawe uya kukhuseleka kum.
Ke kaloku kwaziswa uDavide, kusithiwa, Bona, abaFilisti bahlasela iKeyila, baya kutshabalalisa iziqhamo ezityeni.
Wabuza ke uDavide iNkosi, esithi, Ndiya kuhamba ndihlasele ooFilisti abo? Waphendula iNkosi wathi kuye, Yiya uhlasele ooFilisti, usindise iKehila.
Bathi ke amadoda kaDavide kuye, Siyaxoka nathi apha eYuda; nokuba siza kuphi na ukuba siye eKeyila ukuhlasela amaSirayeli?
UDavide wabuza iNkosi kwakhona. Waphendula iNkosi wathi kuye, Yiya eKeyila; ngokuba ndiya kubanika abaFilisti phantsi kwesandla sakho.
Waye ke uDavide namadoda akhe eKeyila, wahlasela amaFilisti; wathabatha iinkomo zazo, wababulala ngokubulala okukhulu. UDavide wawakhusela abantu baseKeyila.
Ke kaloku uAbhiyatare, unyana ka-Ahileleki, wabaleka waya kuDavide eKeyila; wathabatha i-ephod emlonyeni wakhe.
Waxelela uSawule ukuba uDavide wafika eKeyila; wathi ke uSawule, UThixo wamnikela kum; ngokuba uDavide wabeka isandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe, esiya kumzi oneengcango nezitshixo.
Ke kaloku uSawule wathabatha wonke umkhosi wakhe, ukuba athabathe intshayelelo yokulwa, ukuba ahambe eKeyila, abambe uDavide namadoda akhe.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide eyazi ukuba uSawule ucinga okubi kuye, wathi kuAbhiyatare ukumkani, Thola i-ephod.
Wathi uDavide, Nkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, umkhonzi wakho wafunda ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba uSawule ucinga ukuba uya kufika eKeyila, aphulaphule lo mzi ngenxa yam.
Ingaba abaphathi baseKeyila baya kundi zaza kuye? Ingaba uSawule uya kuhla, njengokuba umkhonzi wakho efundile? UYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, nceda usixelele umkhonzi wakho. Wathi iNkosi, Uza kuhla.
Wathi ke uDavide kwakhona, Ingaba abathetheli baseKeyila baya kundinikela mna namadoda am kuSawule? UYehova wathi, Baya kundinikela.
Waphuma ke uDavide namadoda akhe, amawaka angamakhulu amathandathu, waya eKeyila; bahamba besuka kwindawo ukuya kwindawo. Bathi ke kuSawule, ukuba uDavide wabaleka eKeyila, akazange ahambe khona.
Wahlala ke uDavide ezindaweni ezikhuselekileyo zesihlabathi, nakwiinduli zesihlabathi sikaZipho. USawule wamfuna mihla le; kodwa uThixo akawunikelanga uDavide emlonyeni wakhe.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide ekho eHoreshi, emasikweni aseZipho, waqonda ukuba uSawule waya kumbulala.
Ke kaloku uYonatan, unyana kaSawule, waya kuDavide eHoreshi, wamnceda ukuba aqiniseke kuThixo.
Wathi kuye, Musa ukuxoka; uSawule uyise wam akayi kunyusa isandla sakhe kuwe; wena uya kuba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli, mna ke ndiya kuba ngumva wakho; noSawule uyise wam naye uyazi oko.
Bathi ke bobabini besenza umnqophiso phambi koYehova. Wabuyela uYonathan endlwini yakhe; uDavide ke wahlala eHoresh.
Baya ke amaZiphethi kuSawule eGibheha, besithi, UDavide akafihli na phakathi kwethu, ezindaweni ezikhuselekileyo zaseHoreshi, emnqamlezweni weHakila, emazantsi eJesimoni?
Ke ngoko, nkosi yam, zula xa kulungile kuwe; siza kuba noxanduva lwethu lokumnika ukumkani.
Wathi uSawule, UYehova akubulele ngenxa yobubele bakho kum.
Yiya ufumane ulwazi oluninzi. Fumana apho uDavide ehlala khona nabani na okhe wambona khona. Ndixelela ukuba ungumntu onobuchule kakhulu.
Ziboneni zonke iindawo zakhe ezifihlakeleyo, nibuye kuni nento eqinisekileyo; ndiya kuhamba nani; ukuba ukhona kuloo ndawo, ndiya kumfumanisa phakathi kwezizwe zonke zikaYuda.
Basuka ke, bafika eZiphi phambi kukaSawule; uDavide namadoda akhe babesesizweni sama-Maon, eArava, emazantsi eJeshimoni.
Ke kaloku uSawule namadoda akhe baqala ukubuza. Bathi ke kubo uDavide, wahla waya esityeni, wahlala emasikweni aseMaoni. Xa uSawule ekwazile loo nto, wafika emasikweni aseMaoni, efuna uDavide.

Ke kaloku uSawule wayehamba ngasecaleni elinye lenduli; uDavide namadoda akhe ke aye ngasecaleni elinye, ekhawuleza ukushiya uSawule. Ke kaloku uSawule nenceba yakhe besiya kuDavidi namadoda akhe ukuba bathabathe.
Kwafika umthunywa kuSawule, esithi, Yiya ngokukhawuleza; kuba amaFilisti athabathe ilizwe.
Ke kaloku uSawule wayeka ukumlandela uDavide, waya kulwa nabaFilisti; ngenxa yoko kwabizwa igama lendawo leyo ngokuba yiSela-hamahlekothi.
Ke kaloku uDavide wanyuka waya apho, wahlala kwiindawo ezikhuselekileyo zeEngedi.
Ke kaloku, xa uSawule ebuyela ekufumaniseni amaFilisti, kwathiwa kuye, Yabona, uDavide usembindini weEngedi.
Ke kaloku uSawule wathabatha amawaka amathathu madoda akhethiweyo kuwo onke amaSirayeli, waya ekufumaneni uDavide nabasetyhini bakhe, ezityeni zeenkomo.
Ke kaloku wafika ekufumaneni iinkunzi zeegusha, ecaleni kwendlela, apho kwakukho intaba. Waza uSawule waya kuphumla; ke uDavide nabafazi bakhe babe ngasemva kwintaba.

Bathi ke amadoda kaDavide, Le yimini iNkosi athetha ngayo kuwe, esithi, Ndiya kunikela umkhosi wakho esandla sakho, ukuze wenze ngokwezinto ezilungileyo entliziyweni yakho. Wavuka ke uDavide ngoxolo, wamisa isiphelo sempahla kaSawule.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, uDavide wavakalelwa kukuba unetyala, ngenxa yokuba wamisa isiphelo sempahla kaSawule.
Wathi kumadoda akhe, UYehova andivumelekanga ukuba ndiyenze loo nto kumphathi wam, ukumkani okhethiweyo nguYehova, ndimise isandla sam phezu kwakhe; kuba ungumkhonzi kaYehova.
Ke kaloku uDavide wamisa amadoda akhe ngamagama la mazwi, akawavumelanga ukuba ahlasele uSawule. Waphuma ke uSawule emlanjeni, waya endlela yakhe.
Waphuma ke uDavide emlanjeni, wabiza uSawule, wathi, Inkosi yam, ukumkani. USawule ebona ngasemva kwakhe, uDavide wehla ngobuso bakhe phantsi.
Wathi kuSawule, Kutheni na ukuba uphulaphule abantu besithi, UDavide ufuna ukukwenza okubi?

Ubona ngamehlo akho namhlanje, ukuba iNkosi wamnika wena esandla sam kuloo mlambo; kwathi ke, besithi kum ukuba ndikufile; kodwa ndakukhusela; ndathi, Andiyi kuphakamisa isandla sam kukumkani wam, ngokuba ungumkhonzi kaYehova.

Yabona, uyise wam, yabona lo mqolo womqamelo wakho esandla sam; ndenza isiphelo somqamelo wakho, kodwa andikubulalanga. Ke ngoko, qaphela ke, ubone ukuba akukho monakalo nakuphi na ukuxhatshazwa kum. Andikukhohlisile, wena ke undifuna, ukuze ndiwuthathe umzimba wam.
UYehova abe ngumgwebi phakathi kwam nowe; iNkosi akubuyisele wena, ngenxa yobubi obundiyenzileyo kum; kodwa isandla sam asiyi kukuxhamla.
Njengoko kusithiwa ngaphambili, Izinto ezibi zivela kubo bazenzayo izinto ezingalunganga; ngoko ke isandla sam asiyi kukutshisa.
Waphuma njani ukumkani wakwaSirayeli? Ulandela nani na? Ingaba iinkunzi zeegusha ezifileyo? Ingaba iinkomo ezifileyo?
UYehova abe ngumgwebi wethu, agqibe phakathi kwethu; ajonge inkundla yam, amkhusele, amsindise esandla sakho.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide egqibile ukushumayela loo nto, uSawule wathi, Yilizwi lakho na elo, unyana wam uDavide? Wavuya ngovuyo.
Wathi ke, Ulungile wena ngaphezu kwam; wena ukwenzele kakuhle, mna ke ndikwenzele kakubi.
Uthe ke ngoku uthetha kum ngento elungileyo oyenzayo kum; iNkosi wandinikela emlonyeni wakho, awundibulalanga.
Xa umntu efumana umkhosi wakhe, angamvumela na ukuba ahambe ngokukhuselekileyo? UYehova akuhlawulele ngcono ngenxa yokwenza kwakho kum namhlanje.
Ndiyazi ke ukuba uya kuba ngukumkani, nokuba ubukumkani bukaSirayeli buza kuqiniswa esandla sakho.
Ke ngoko, zinikele mna intliziyo yakho ngoYehova, ukuba awuyi kubulala iziqhamo zam, nokuba awuyi kulisusa igama lam endlwini yoyise wam.
Wathi uDavide kuye uSawule: wabuyela uSawule endlwini yakhe; ke uDavide namadoda akhe banyuka beya kwindawo ekhuselekileyo.
Wafa ke uSamuweli; bahlangana bonke amaSirayeli, bamlingisa, bamzika endlwini yakhe, eRama. UDavide wahla waya emlanjeni waseParan.
Kwakukho mntu omnye eMaoni, owayenezinto zakhe eKarmele; waba mkhulu kakhulu; wayenazo izimvu ezilishumi elinambini, neenkomo ezilishumi elinambini. Waye eKarmele, enxiba iinkomo zakhe.

Igama lakhe lalinguNabhali, igama lesifazane sakhe linguAbhigayeli. Waye ngumfazi owaziyo, obukekayo; ke kaloku umfazi wakhe waba ngumfazi onzima, ongaqhelekanga ekwenzeni izinto; wayengumntwana kaKalebe.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide wayesesizweni, waqonda ukuba uNabhali ushiya iinkomo zakhe.
Wathumela ke oonyana abalishumi, wathi kubo, Yiya kuNabhali eKarmele, mhlelele ngegama lam.
Nithi kuye, Uphile ubomi obude; uxolo noxolo kuwe, nendlu yakho, nazo zonke izinto zakho.
Ndiva ke ukuba lixesha lokusika iinkomo. Ke kaloku, xa abaphathi bakho babe nathi, asibabikhombi; mihla yonke ababe eKarmele, akukho nto yabo yalahleka.

Ubuze abakhonzi bakho, baya kukuxelela. Ke ngoko, nceda ubone ububele kubo babantwana bam; kuba sithe safika kwixesha elimnandi lokudla; ke ngoko, nceda unike abakhonzi bakho, noDavide unyana wakho, konke okuseleyo.
Bafika ke abantu bakaDavide, bathetha kuNabhali ngaloo nto ngegama likaDavide; balinde.
Waphendula uNabhali abakhonzi bakaDavide, wathi, Nguwuphi loDavide? Nguwuphi lonyana kaYese? Abakhonzi abaninzi baphuma kumantwane abo kule mihla.
Ndiyithathe ntoni na isonka sam, namanzi am, nenyama yam endiyifileyo kubaqhoboshi bam, ndizinike abantu abavela apho andiyaziyo?
Ke kaloku abantu bakaDavide bajikeleza, babuyela. Bafika ke, bamxelela amazwi onke.

Wathi uDavide kumadoda akhe, Nciphisa wonke umntu ikhephu lakhe. Bakwenza njalo; uDavide naye wagqobhoza ikhephu lakhe. Kwaba ngamawaka amane amadoda aye phezulu noDavide, amawaka mabini ke ahlala nempahla.
Wathi omnye wabakhonzi kuAbhigayeli, umfazi kaNabhali, esithi, UDavide wathumela abathunywa ukusuka engqongileyo, ukuba babule inkosi yethu; yena ke wabaphucula.
Ke kaloku abo madoda babelungileyo kuthi kakhulu; asikubi nantoni na, sakuba sihlala ndawonye emasimini yonke imihla, asifumane nto.
Baye baba ngudonga lwethu ubusuku nemini, zonke iintsuku zethu sazikhusela khona iinkomo zethu.
Ke ngoko, qaphela ngoku, ubone ukuba ungayenza ntoni na; ngokuba ingozi ifikile kukumkani wethu nosapho lwakhe lonke; yena ke ngumntu olungileyo kakhulu, akukho mntu unokuthetha naye.

Wakwenza ke uAbhigayeli ngokukhawuleza, wathabatha imifuno emakhulu amabini, neebhotile ezimbini zewayini, neenkomo ezintandathu ezilungiselelwe ukupheka, nebhokisi enkulu yeentyatyambo ezitshiziweyo, neziqhamo ezikhulu zeziqhamo, neziqhamo ezikhulu ezilishumi, waza wazisa ezi zinto phezu kweesile.
Wathi ke kubo abakhonzi bakhe, Yiya phambi kwenu; ndiza kukulandelela. Ke kaloku akawuxelela uNabhali umfazi wakhe.
Ke kaloku, ekuhambeni kwakhe ngeeseyile zakhe, esiya phantsi emlanjeni wenduli, kwabona uDavide namadoda akhe esiya ezantsi kuye; wabafumana.
Ke kaloku uDavide wathi, Kuyimfuneko ukuba ndizikhusele zonke izinto zalowo mntu entlango, ukuze kungabikho nanye into yakhe elahlekile; wandisela kum okubi ngokuhle.
UThixo andixolele njalo nanjalo, ukuba ndiya kushiya ephilile ibhinqa elilodwa kubo bonke abakhoyo kuye.
Ke kaloku, xa uAbhigayeli ebona uDavide, wakhawuleza waphuma phezu kweeseyile zakhe, wamgxeka phambi kwakhe ngobuso bakhe phantsi.
Wathi, Nceda, nkosi yam, uvumele umkhonzi wakho ukuba athethe nawe; udibanise nelizwi lomkhonzi wakho; ndimnye mna kuphela oza kuba ngumqobo.

Nceda, nkosi yam, uNabhali, lo mntu olungileyo, ungamthobeli; kuba njengokuba lisithi igama lakhe, ke yena. Igama lakhe lithetha ukuba: Umngcipheko, kwaye umngcipheko uhamba naye. Ke mna, umkhonzi wakho, andibonanga abantu abathunyelwe ngukumkani wam.

Ke ngoko, mna nkosi yam, njengobomi bukaYehova uThixo wakho, nobomi bakho, ukuba iNkosi wakuthintela ukuba ungabi ngumfazi, ukuba ungamxolela ngesandla sakho; ke bona abathunywa bakho, nabo bonke abafuna ukukwenza okubi mna nkosi yam, babe njengeNabali.
Ke kaloku lo msitho, umkhonzi wakho awiselayo kukumkani wam, unikezelwe abantu abalandelayo.

Nceda, usindise ububi bomkhonzi wakho; kuba iNkosi uya kukunika inkosi yam indlu yamakumkani ehlala ixesha elide, ngenxa yokuba ubhiyozela iimfazwe zikaYehova; asifumaneki kuwe into engalunganga zonke iintsuku zobomi bakho.

Ke kaloku, xa kukho umntu oza kukulandelela ukuba akuthathele umphefumlo wakho, uphefumlo lwakho luya kuhlala lukhuselekile engqondweni yabantu abaphilayo nguYehova uThixo wakho; kodwa uphefumlo lwabathunywa bakho luya kuqhutywa ngaphandle, njengokuba kuqhutywa ilitye phantsi kwebhombu.
Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi esenza kukumkani wam zonke izinto ezilungileyo awathethayo, akwenza ukuba ube ngukumkani kumaSirayeli,

ke akuyi kubakho engqondweni yakho intlungu enkulu, ukuba ubulala ngaphandle kwesizathu, okanye ukuba unyanzelisa wena ngokwakho. Ke xa iNkosi esenza isigqibo esilungileyo kukumkani wam, khumbula umkhonzi wakho.
Wathi uDavide ku-Abhigayeli, Ungcwele iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, owawuthumelele namhlanje ukudibana nam.
Ndiya kuthandaza kuwe, ngenxa yobulumko bakho obulungileyo, ngokuba ugcinele mna namhlanje ukuba ndisuse umphefumlo wam, ukuze ndizikhusele ngesandla sam.

Ke kaloku, uphila iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, owayendithintela ukuba ndikwenze ntoni na engalunganga kuwe, ukuba ungabikho wakhawuleza ukudibana nam, akuyi kubakho mntu omnye ohlalayo kuNabali kude kube limini.
Wathabatha ke uDavide esandla sakhe oko amnikeleyo, wathi, Yiya ekhaya lakho ngoxolo; ndeva amagama akho, ndakunikela.

Wafika ke uAbhigayeli kuye uNabhali, ke kaloku endlwini yakhe wayesenza isidlo esifana nesidlo somkumkani; waba mkhulu umphefumlo wakhe, waza wasela kakhulu. Ke kaloku akazange amxelele nantoni na kude kube limini.
Wathi ke uNabhali kusasa, xa ephumile, umfazi wakhe wamxelela onke la mazwi; yaphuma kuye intliziyo yakhe, waba njengelitye.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezilishumi, wabetha iNkosi uNabali, wafa.

Ke kaloku, xa uDavide efundile ukuba uNabhali ufile, wathi, Ungcwele iNkosi, owenza icala lam kuNabhali, ngenxa yobuxoki bakhe kum; wakhusela umkhonzi wakhe ekubeni ayenze into engalunganga, waza wabuyisela intlungu kaNabhali phezu kweentloko zakhe. Wathumela ke uDavide amazwi kuAbhigayeli, esithi, Umele abe ngumfazi wam.
Bafika abakhonzi bakhe eKarmele, bathetha noAbhigayeli, besithi, UDavide usithumelele kuwe, ukuze akuthathe ube ngumfazi wakhe.
Wathi ke uRakeli, wahlangula ngobuso bakhe phantsi ehlabathini, wathi, Yabona, umkhonzi wakho ukhona ukuba akusebenzele, ahlamba izandla zabasebenzi benkosi yam.
Ke kaloku uAbhigayeli wakhawuleza, wanyuka esinye isilwanyana, waya namadoda amakhulu akhe amahlanu, alandele abathunywa bakaDavide, waba ngumfazi wakhe.
Ke kaloku uDavide wayesele emtshatweni noAhinoam waseYizreyeli; babe ngabafazi bakhe bonke.
Ke kaloku uSawule wamnika uMikayeli intombi yakhe, indodana kaDavide, kuPalethiyeli unyana kaLayisi, waseGalli.
Bafika amaZiphethi kuye uSawule eGibheya, besithi, UDavide akafihli na emnqamlezweni weHakila, ojongene neJeshimon?
Ke kaloku uSawule wahla waya emasikweni kaZipho, namadoda amawaka amathathu akhethiweyo kumaSirayeli, ukuba afune khona uDavide.
Ke kaloku uSawule wamisa isikhephe ecaleni kwendlela, entliziyweni yeHakila, ejonge iJeshimoni; ke uDavide wayehlala emlilweni. Wabona ke ukuba uSawule uya kumlandela apho,
wathumela amagwebu, wafumanisa ukuba uSawule sele efika ngokuqinisekileyo.

Waphuma ke uDavide, waya kwindawo apho uSawule ethembise khona; wabona apho uSawule noAbhineeri unyana kaNeri, umthetheli womkhosi, belele khona. Ke kaloku uSawule wayelele phantsi kwethafa, namadoda ayethembisa phezu kwakhe.
Wathi ke uDavide kuAhileleki, umHeti, noAbhiyasi unyana kaSeruya, umzalwana kaYowabhi, esithi, Nguwuphi na oza kuphuma nam ekamelweni likaSawule? Waphendula uAbhiyasi wathi, Ndiya kungena nawe;

Wafika ke uDavide noAbhishayhi kumajoni ngobusuku; ke kaloku, uSawule wayelele ephumle ngaphakathi kwekhabhathi-mlilo, nesikhongo sakhe sitshiziwe ehlabathini phantsi komlenze wakhe. UAbheri namadoda amaninzi ayelele emveni kwakhe.
Wathi uAbhishayhi kuDavide, Namhlanje uThixo wanikela umkhonzi wakho esandla sakho; ngoko ke, ndiya kwenza ukuba aqhutywe ehlabathini ngecala elinye lemilenze yam; andizukufuna ukuwubetha kabini.
Wathi ke uDavide kuAbhishai, Musa ukumbulala; ngubani na oza kubeka isandla sakhe kumthethweni kaYehova, angabi netyala?
Wathi ke, Uphila iNkosi, ukuba iNkosi ngokwakhe uya kumbetha; nokuba imini yakhe iya kufika, aze aphele, okanye ahambe emfazweni, aze abulawe.
Ke kaloku, iNkosi andivumelenga ukuba ndibeke isandla sam kumtshiswa kaYehova. Namhlanje ke, thabathe isithunywa nebhotile yamanzi ecaleni kwengcambu yakhe, sihambe.

Wathabatha ke uDavide isikhephe, nebhotile yamanzi, ecaleni komlomo kaSawule, basuka; akukho namnye wababonayo, akukho namnye wabawaziyo, akukho namnye wabavukayo; bonke babelala; ngokuba iNkosi wabatyhila umphefumlo onzima.
Wadlula ke uDavide kwelinye icala, wahlala phezulu komnqamlezo wenduli kude; kwakukho indawo ebanzi phakathi kwabo.
Wabiza iqela, noAbheri unyana kaNere, wathi, UAbheri, awundiphenduli na? Waphendula ke uAbhere, esithi, Yintoni wena othethayo kukumkani?
Wathi uDavide, Unyana womntu wena, akunjalo? Nguwuphi na umntu ofana nawe eSirayeli? Kutheni le nto ungamkhuseli ukumkani ukumkani wakho? Kuthe ke kwafika umntu ukuwubulala umkani ukumkani wakho.

Le nto uyenze ayiyiyo into elungileyo. Ngokuba uphila iNkosi, wena namadoda akho niyindoda yokufa; ngokuba ningamkhuseli ukumkani wenu, umchwethezayo kaYehova. Yabonani, apho likhona isithunywa sikakumkani, nebhotile yamanzi, eyayisengqondweni yakhe?
Wayazi uSawule ilizwi likaDavide, wathi, Yizwi lakho na elo, unyana wam uDavide? UDavide waphendula wathi, Lilizwi lakho, nkosi yam ukumkani.
Wathi ke, Kutheni na ukuba inkosi yam ilandele umkhonzi wayo? Ndiyenze ntoni na? Ndinenyameko ntoni na?

Ke ngoko, nkosi yam ukumkani, athethe amazwi womkhonzi wakhe; ukuba nguYehova owenzayo ukuba uxinzelelo kum, ke amkele isonka; kodwa ukuba abantu bakwenza njalo, bangabikho emlonyeni kaYehova. Bamkhupha mna namhlanje kwinxalenye yam ezweni likaYehova, besithi, Yiya, ukhonza amadini amanye.
Ke ngoko, musa ukuba igazi lam lihlambuluke ehlabathini, kude nobuso bukaYehova; kuba ukumkani wakwaSirayeli uphuma ekhangela isidumbu, njengokuba umntu efuna iintaka ezincinane emaphandleni.

Wathi ke uSawule, Ndiphelele; buyela, unyana wam uDavide; ngokuba namhlanje umphefumlo wam ube ngumsebenzi omkhulu kuwe, mna ndiya kukwazi ukukwenza nantoni na. Ngokuba ndenze into engaqhelekanga, ndazenza izinto ezingalunganga.
Waphendula uDavide, wathi, Namhlanje kukho isikhephe sikakumkani; nafika omnye wabakhonzi bakho, ayise.
UYehova uyayihlawula inyaniso yomntu ngamnye, nokholo lwakhe. UYehova wamnika wena esandla sam namhlanje; ke mna andifuni ukubeka isandla sam kulowo wamachitywa nguYehova.
Ngokuba, njengokuba mna namhlanje ndenza ubomi bakho bube luhle, ke ngoko iNkosi ayenze ubomi bam lube luhle, amsindise emngciphekweni wonke.
Wathi ke uSawule kuDavide, Uhlale ubhaptizwa, uDavide, unyana wam; uza kwenza izinto ezinkulu, uya kuphumelela ngokuqinisekileyo. Wahamba ke uDavide kwindlela yakhe, wabuyela uSawule endlwini yakhe.

Wathi ke uDavide engqondweni yakhe, Ndiza kubulawa nguSawule ngelo xesha elizayo. Kungcono ukuba ndihambe ndiye ezweni lakwaFilisti; ngoko ke uSawule uya kuyeka ukundifuna kuwo onke amaSirayeli, mna ke ndiya kuphuma esandla sakhe.
Wasuka ke uDavide, namadoda angamakhulu amathandathu ahamba naye, waya kuAkishi unyana kaMahoki, ukumkani waseGati.

Wahlala ke uDavide namadoda akhe eGati noAkishi; umntu ngamnye wathabatha intsapho yakhe naye; uDavide wathabatha amadoda akhe amabini, nguAhinoam waseYizreyeli, no-Abihayile umkakhe kaNabali waseKarmele.
Ke kaloku kwathiwa nguSawule, ukuba uDavide wabaleka waya eGati; wayeka ukumfuna.
Wathi uDavide ku-Akishi, Ukuba ndifumene inceba ngamehlo akho, ndinikezwe indawo esinye sezixeko zesizwe, ndihlale khona; kutheni na ukuba umkhonzi wakho ahlale nawe kumzi wakwakumkani?
Ke kaloku uAkishi wamnika ngaloo mini iTsikelage; yaba ngukumkani baseYuda ukususela ngoko.
Wahlala ke uDavide ezweni lakwaFilisti iminyaka emibini neentsuku ezine.
Waya ke uDavide namadoda akhe, wahlasela amaGeshuri, namaGerhazi, namaAmaleki; aba bantu babemi kule lizwe ukusukela ekuqaleni, besiya eShure, bafika eYiputa.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide ehlasela ilizwe, akashiyanga umntu ophilayo, nokuba ngumfazi nakuba ngumntu; wathabatha izimvu neentyatyambo, neebhokhwe, neeshelufu, neenkomo, nezigqomo. Wabuyela kuAkishi.
Ke kaloku, xa uAkishi esithi zaz, Niye phi na namhlanje? UDavide wayethi, Kwilizwe laseNtshona likaYuda, okanye kwilizwe laseNtshona lakwaYerahmeyeli, okanye kwilizwe laseNtshona lakwaKeni.

UDavide akashiyanga mntu ophilayo, indoda nawesifazane, ukuba afike eGati; ngokuba wathi, Ingaba baya kusixelela, besithi, Yiloo nto uDavide ayenzeyo? Yaye loo nto yaba yintsebenziswano yakhe zonke imihla awayehlala kuyo imihlaba yamaFilisti.
Ke kaloku uAkishi wakholwa kuDavide, wathi engqondweni yakhe, Wakwenza ukuba athotywe ngabantu bakhe, oonyana bakaSirayeli; ngoko ke uya kuba ngumkhonzi wam ubomi bonke.
Ke kaloku, ngale mihla, abaFilisti bahlanganisela iinzame zabo, ukuba badibane nabaSirayeli. Wathi uAkishi kuDavide, Yazi ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba uya kuphuma nam emkhosini wena namadoda akho;
Wathi uDavide, Uza kubona wena ngokwakho ukuba unokukwenza ntoni na umkhonzi wakho. Waphendula uAkishi wathi, Kulungile; ndiya kukusenza ube ngumgcini-ntloko wam yonke imihla.
Ke kaloku uSamuweli wayefile; bonke amaSirayeli babemlingisa, bamzika emzini wakhe, eRama. USawule wabakhupha kwilizwe labo abamangali, nabaprofeti.
Bathe ke abaFilisti bahlangana, bafika, bamisa itente eShunem; uSawule wahlanganisa bonke amaSirayeli, wamisa itente eGilboa.
Ke kaloku uSawule, ebona umkhosi wamaFilisti, wakhathazeka; intliziyo yakhe yaqhuma.
Wabuza iNkosi ukuba athethe naye; kodwa iNkosi akawuphendulanga ngondoto, nokuba yi-Urim, nokuba ngabaprofeti.
Ke kaloku uSawule wathi kubakhonzi bakhe, Nifunani kum indoda enobulumko, ndiya kungena ndiyibuze. Bathi ke kubo, Kukho enye eEndori.

Ke kaloku uSawule watshintsha iimpahla zakhe, wagqoka iingubo ezahlukeneyo; waya kumfazi ngobusuku, yena namadoda amabini. Wathi ke uSawule, Ndibuze umphefumlo wam, niyikhuphele phezulu into endiyaziyo.

Wathi ke umfazi kuye, Uyazi ngokuqinisekileyo into awayeyenza uSawule, ukuba athabathe ezweni abo bathetha ngezinto ezifihlakeleyo, nabamangali; kutheni na ukuba ubeke intliziyo yam emlonyeni, ukuze ndifa?
Wathi ke uSawule kuye ngesalathiso ngoYehova, esithi, Uphila iNkosi, akuyi kubakho ukuxhaphaza kuwe ngenxa yaloo nto.
Wathi ke umfazi, Ngubani na omele ndiwukhuphe kuwe? Wathi, Ukhupha uSamuweli;
Wabona uSamuweli lo mfazi, watsho ngelizwi lakhe eliphezulu, wathi kuSawule, Uthini na ukuba undixolele? USawule wena.
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Musa ukukhathazeka; ubona ntoni na? Wathi umfazi, Ndibona umphefumlo unyuka ehlabathini.
Wathi, Ubonakala ngantoni na? Yathi ke yena, Umntu omdala uphuma, egqoke ibhanti. Waqonda ke uSawule ukuba nguSamuweli; wahlangula ngobuso bakhe phantsi.

Wathi ke uSamuweli kuSawule, Uyini na loo nto undixhalabisayo ngokundikhupha phezulu?
