Wathi uSawule, Ndinoxinzelelo olukhulu; kuba abaFilisti bathini na kum, yaye uThixo uthathe isigqibo sokundishiya; akawuphendulanga mna, nokuba ngemiprofeti, nokuba ngeenyembezi. Ndakubiza ngoko, ukuba undicacisele into endingayenzayo.
Wathi uSamuweli, Yintoni na leyo oyibuzayo kum, xa iNkosi esuka kuwe, waba ngumkhosi wakho?
Ke kaloku iNkosi wenza, njengoko wathi ngesandla sam; ke iNkosi watshisa ubukumkani esandla sakho, wamnika umhlobo wakho uDavide.
Ngokuba iNkosi akawuphulaphulanga umlomo wakhe, ukuba aphumeze intliziyo yakhe yobuxoki ebantwini baka-Amaleki; ngoko ke iNkosi wakwenza kuwe oku namhlanje.
UYehova uya kukunika wena noSirayeli esandla samaFilisti; nawe, nabantwana bakho, niya kuba nam namhlanje; iNkosi uya kukunika iqela lakwaSirayeli esandla samaFilisti ke.

Ke kaloku uSawule wawela emlonyeni wakhe wonke ehlabathini, waza wakhathazeka kakhulu ngenxa yale magama kaSamuweli; kwaphuma amandla akhe kuye; kuba wayesasele engadla nto ngaloo mini nobusuku bonke.
Wafika ke lo mfazi kuSawule, wabona ukuba uxakekile kakhulu, wathi, Yabona, umkhonzi wakho waphulaphula amazwi akho; ndabeka ubomi bam emngciphekweni wam, ndenza njengokuba wandixelele.
Ke ngoko, mna ke, nceda, ndimxelele umkhonzi wakho, ndininike isonka, nidle, nibe nobuchule bokuhamba endlwini yenu.
Ke kaloku wayeka, wathi, Andiyi kudla. Bathi ke amadoda akhe, badibana nowesifazane, babemxelela; wabaphulaphula, wavuka emhlaba, wahlala kwibhedi.
Ke kaloku umfazi wayenenyama yenkomo ethe nkqo endlwini, wayibulala ngokukhawuleza; waza wathabatha isonka, wasigquma, wapheka iziqhamo ezingabikho manzi.
Wazibeka phambi kukaSawule namadoda akhe; badla. Bavuka ngobusuku balo, besuka.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti bahlanganisana yonke imikhosi yabo e-Afek; amaSirayeli ke athabathela isikhephe, aye emlanjeni waseYizreyeli.
Ke kaloku abathetheli bakaFilisti baphuma, ngamakhulu abo, namawaka abo; ke uDavide namadoda akhe asuka ekugqibeleni noAkishi.

Bathi ookumkani bakaFilisti, Zithini na ezo ziHebhere? Waphendula uAkishi, wathi, Akunjalo lo nguDavide, umkhonzi kaSawule ukumkani wakwaSirayeli? Ube nam iminyaka emininzi; ukususela ngemini awayemshiya ngayo uSawule waya kuthi ke ngoku, andifumani nto embi kuye.

Amadoda amakhulu amaFilisti acamngca kuye, athi, Yibuyisele lo mntu, aze abuye kwindawo owawumnike yona; akusayi kungena nathi emfazweni, ukuze angathi, xa kuqhutywa umfazwe, atshintshe isandla sakhe kuthi. Ingaba ungenza ntoni na elungileyo phambi kokumkani wakhe, ngaphandle kokuthabatha iintloko zamadoda ethu?
UDavide akawuphi na loo mntu, abawudlalayo emlonyeni wabo, besithi, Wabulala uSawule amawaka akhe, ke uDavide amashumi amabini amawaka akhe?

Wathi ke uAkishi kuDavide, wathi kuye, Uphila iNkosi, ngokuqinisekileyo wena ungumntu othembekileyo, yaye ndiyakuthanda ukuba ube nam emkhosini; ukususela ngemini yokungena kwakho kum, kude kube namhlanje, andifumani nantoni na engalunganga kuwe; kodwa abathetheli akuthandabuzi.
Ke ngoko, buyela uhambe ngoxolo; musa ukwenza into engathandekiyo kubalawuli bakaFilisti.

Wathi ke uDavide, Ndiyenze ntoni na? Ufumene ntoni na kumkhonzi wakho ukususela ngemini endiyifika ngayo kuwe, ukuya kuthi ga ngoku? Kutheni na ukuba andikwazi ukuya ndibhiyozele iintshaba zenkosi yam ukumkani?
Waphendula ke uAkishi, wathi, Ndiyazi ukuba ulungile ngamehlo am, njengokuba ngumthunywa kaThixo; kodwa abathetheli bakaFilisti bathi, Akufanele afike nathi emfazweni.
Ke ngoko, vuka ubusuku bonke, nawe nabazalwana bokumkani wakho abathe bafika nawe; nihambe ngoLwesibini, xa kucace.
Wavuka ke uDavide namadoda akhe emveni kwemini, ukuba abuyele ezweni lamaFilisti; amaFilisti ke anyuka waya eYizreyeli.
UDavide namadoda akhe bafika eTsikalagi ngemini yesithathu. Ke kaloku amaAmaleki athabathe ilizwe laseNtshona, neTsikalagi; bahlasela iTsikalagi, bayitshisa,
Abafazi, nabafazi bonke abakhoyo kuloo ndlu, babebathathe njengengxowa-mali; ababulalanga nabani na kubo, bathabathe nabo behamba ngendlela.
Bafika ke uDavide namadoda akhe eSikelegi, babona ukuba iqhutywe, nabafazi babo, noonyana babo, neentombi zabo, zithathwe njengengxowa.
Ke kaloku uDavide namadoda akhe balala ngelizwi elikhulu, de kwangaphumeleli ukuba nenceba yokulala.
Abafazi ababini bakaDavide bathathwe, uAhinoam waseYizreyeli, noAbihayeli, umkakhe uNabhali waseKarmele.

Ke kaloku uDavide waxinwa kakhulu, zaz kunene; ngokuba abantu babethetha ukuba bamwise amatye; ke kaloku wonke umntu waba neentlungu emphefumlweni wakhe ngenxa yabantwana bakhe nabentombi zakhe. UDavide ke wamandla kuYehova uThixo wakhe.
Wathi ke uDavide kuAbhiyatare, unyana ka-Ahileleki, ukumkani, Yini le ephod. Wayinika uAbhiyatare.
Wabuza ke uDavide iNkosi, esithi, Ndiyilandele na loo mkhosi wokubulala? Ndingawafumana na? Uphendule wathi, Yilandele; uya kuwafumana ngokuqinisekileyo, uza kuphumelela ukusindisa bonke.
Wafika ke uDavide, namadoda angamakhulu amathandathu ahamba naye, waya emlanjeni kaBesoro; kwathi kukho abanye abaseleyo.
Ke kaloku abalishumi elinambini babo babethe xhaxhe kakhulu, ukuba bangadlula emlanjeni; ke uDavide namakhulu amane aye elandela.
Bafumane umntu waseYiputa emasimini, bamthabatha waya kuDavide; bamnika amanzi ukuba asele, bamnika isonka ukuba asele.
Wadla ke, waphefumla; kuba wayengenakutya namanzi iintsuku ezintathu neentlanga ezintathu. Uthe ke uYakobi: "Ndiya kwenza into endiyifunayo."
Wathi ke uDavide kuye, Uwuphi na wena? Uvela phi? Wathi yena, NdingumYiputa, umkhonzi womntu waseAmaleki; inkosi yam yandishiya, ndagula ngemihla emithathu edlulileyo.
Siye sahlasela ilizwe laseNtshona lakwaKerethi, elikwiYudiya, nelizwe laseNtshona likaKalebe; satshisa ke iSikelagi.

Wathi uDavide kuye, Ingaba ungandikhupha phantsi kulowo mkhosi wokubulala? Waphendula ke yena wathi, Uthini kum ngelizwi likaThixo, ukuba awuyi kundibulala, nakuba awundinikezeli engqondweni yomphathi wam, ndiza kukukhupha phantsi kubo.
Wamkhupha ke uDavide phantsi. Bathe ke, bathabathela ezweni lonke, bedla, besela, bebhiyozela, ngenxa yezilwanyana zasekhaya ezikhulu kakhulu ababezithabatha kwilizwe lamaFilisti, naseYuda.
Ke kaloku uDavide wabahlasela, ukususela emini ukuya emveni kwemini. Akukho namnye kubo owaphuma, ngaphandle kwamadoda amabini anamakhulu asixhenxe, athabathela kwiinkunzi zeegusha, abaleka.
Wazibuyisela ke uDavide zonke izinto abaAmaleki babezithathe, namadodana akhe onke amabini.
Akukho nto yalahleka, nabantwana, namadoda amakhulu, nabantwana abancinci, namadoda amancinci, nazo zonke izinto ababezithabatha; uDavide wazisa zonke.
Wathabatha zonke iinkomo nezimvu, abantu bakhe bahamba ngazo phambi kwezinto eziphilayo, besithi, Le yimikhosi kaDavide.

Ke kaloku uDavide wafika kumadoda angamakhulu amabini, asele ethambileyo kakhulu ukuba amlandele, ayewashiya emlanjeni kaBesoro; baphuma bedibana noDavide namadoda akhe. Wafika ke uDavide namadoda akhe, wababulali.

Ke kaloku bonke abantu ababi, nabenzi bobubi phakathi kwabakhonzi bakaDavide, baphendula bathi, Ngokuba abaye baphuma nathi, asiyi kudibana nabo kwizinto ezilahlekileyo esizibuyisele; ke kaloku mntu ngamnye athathe umfazi wakhe noonyana bakhe, ahambe.
Wathi ke uDavide, Hayi, bazalwana bam! Musani ukwenza njalo ngento awayesininika yona iNkosi; yena wasisikhusela, wayimisa phambi kwethu iqela eliya kuthi.
Nguwuphi na umntu oza kukuxelela into oyithethayo? Inxalenye yomntu ohlala nezinto zokutya kufuneka ibe njengenxalenye yomntu osele ehla emfazweni; bonke baya kuthatha inxalenye efanayo.
Wayenza loo nto nguDavide ibe yimiyalelo nomthetho kumaSirayeli, ukususela ngaloo mini de kube ngoku.
Wafika ke uDavide eSikelegi, wathumela ezinye zezinto ezilahlekileyo kwabakhulu baseYuda, abahlobo bakhe, esithi, Apha kukho isipho kuni, ezilahlekileyo kumadodana kaYehova.
Wayithumela kubo eBheteli, naseRamoti eseNtshona, naseYatiri;
abo baseAroere, naseShifmoth, naseEshtemoa
noRakali; kubo abasemadolophini amaJerameyeli, nabaKenithi;
abo baseHorma, eBor Ashan, eAthak
naseHebroni, nakwazo zonke iindawo apho uDavide nomadoda akhe babehamba khona.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti bahlasela amaSirayeli; amaSirayeli abaleka phambi kwabo, babulawa abantu abaninzi emnxwemeni weGilboa.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti balandela uSawule noonyana bakhe, babulala oonyana bakhe uYonathani noAbinadadi noMalki-shuha.
Ke kaloku, ukulwa lwaba lunzima kakhulu phezu kukaSawule; abathuthi-makhwenkwe bafika kuye, bamvutha.

Wathi ke uSawule kumthwalo wezixhobo zakhe, Sula ikrele lakho, ndizalise, ukuze bangangeni abo bantu abangathotywanga, ndizalise, bandise. Ke kaloku umthwalo wezixhobo zakhe wakhathazeka, akayi kuyenza loo nto; ke uSawule wathabatha ikrele lakhe, waya kuyo.
Ke kaloku, xa umthwalo-zithuthi wakhe ebona ukuba uSawule ufile, wabetha ke yena ngekhefu lakhe, wafa naye.
Wafa ke uSawule, oonyana bakhe abathathu, nomthwalo wezithuthi zakhe, namadoda akhe onke nganye nganye ngaloomini.

Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseSirayeli asentshonalanga yeJordan, akubona ukuba amaSirayeli ayela, nokuba uSawule noonyana bakhe bafile, washiya oonyana bakaSirayeli imimandla yabo, waya. Bafika ke abaFilisti, bahlala kuyo.
Ke kaloku, kwathi ke ngemini elandelayo, befika amaFilisti ukuba athabathe iimpahla ezibiweyo, bafumana uSawule nonyana bakhe abathathu bewela emnqamlezweni kaGilboa.
Bathabathe intloko yakhe, basusa izithuthi zakhe, bathumela abathunywa ezweni lonke lakwaFilisti, ukuba bashumayele iindaba ezilungileyo endlwini yemifanekiso yabo emihle, phakathi kwabantu babo.
Babeka izithuthi zakhe endlwini ka-Ashtoreth, bamisa isiqu sakhe kudonga lweBhete-shan.
Ke kaloku abahlali baseYabhesi eGiliyadi beva into abaFilisti ababeyenza kuSawule.
bahamba bonke amadoda abo anamandla ngobusuku, befika eBhat-shan; bakhupha iziqu zikaSawule nezonka zakhe emngxunyeni, bafike eYabheshi, bazibhaka khona.
Bathabatha amathambo abo, bawafihla phantsi kwethamsanqa eYabheshi; bathandaza iintsuku ezisibhozo.
2Sam: Ke kaloku, emva kokufa kukaSawule, uDavide wabuya ehlasela ama-Amaleki; waba mihla mibini eSikelagi.
Kwathi ngomhla wesithathu, kwafika umntu esixekweni sikaSawule, enezigqomo zakhe zirhoxisiwe, nothuli ebusweni bakhe; wafika ke kuDavide, wahlangula phantsi ehlabathini.
UDavide wambuza wathi kuye, Uvela phi na? Wathi ke yena, Ndisuka kumkhosi wakwaSirayeli.

Wathi uDavide, Kuthe kwenzeka ntoni na? Nceda ndixelele. Waphendula ke wathi, Iqela lemikhosi lithule emfazweni; kwathi namadoda amaninzi ahlasele, aphele; noSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe nabo bafile.
Wathi uDavide kulowo mntu omncinane owazisa iindaba, Uyazi njani ukuba uSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe bafile?
Wathi lo mntu omncinci, Ndiye ndabona ukuba ndisenyuvesi yaseGilboya; ndabona uSawule enqumle emlonyeni wakhe; iinqanawa namagqwetha amaninzi ayemnyanzela.
Wajonga ngasemva kwakhe, wambona, wambiza; ndaphendula ndithi, Mna apha.
Wathi kum, Ubani na wena? Ndathi kuye, NdingumAmaleki.
Wathi kum, Nceda uhlale phantsi kwam, usindise; kuba ndinomkhuhlane omkhulu, kodwa ndiphila.

Ndathi ke, ndifike kuye, ndawubulala; kuba bendiyazi ukuba akakwazi ukuphila emva kokuba ewela phantsi; ndathabatha isigqubuthelo esingentla kwekhanda lakhe, nesikhongozeli esisuka emqolo wakhe, ndazizisa apha kuwe, nkosi yam.
Wathabatha ke uDavide iimpahla zakhe, waza wazingca; namadoda onke ahamba naye ayenjalo.
Bathi ke, babhiyozela, balilixabisa isonka sabo kude kube kusasa, ngenxa kaSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe, ngenxa yabantu bakaYehova, ngenxa yamaSirayeli; ngokuba babefa ngeqhwa.
Wathi uDavide kulowo mntu omncinane ozisa izithunywa, Uvela phi na wena? Waphendula wathi, Ndiye ngunyana womkhenkce, umAmaleki;
Wathi uDavide kuye, Kutheni na ukuba awukhoyi ukuphakamisa isandla sakho, ukubulala ukumkani okhethiweyo nguYehova?
Waza uDavide wabiza omnye wabahlobo bakhe, wathi, Yiya, umhlasele; wamhlasela ke, waza wafa.
Wathi uDavide kuye, Igazi lakho libe phezu kweentloko zakho; umlomo wakho wathetha kuwe, esithi, Ndimbulala ukumkani okhethiweyo nguYehova.
Ke kaloku uDavide wavuma lo msindo ngoSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe.
Wathi, Bafundiswe abantu bakaYuda ingoma leyo, ebizwa ngokuba yiNgoma yeNtsontelo. Ibhalwe kwincwadi kaYashar:
Ubuhle bakho, uSirayeli, bufa phezu kweentaba zakho! Kuhle kangakanani na ukuwa kwamadoda anamandla.
Musani ukuxelela eGati, musani ukuxelela ezidolophini zaseAshkeloni, ukuze zingamkani iintombi zakwaFilisti, zingamkani iintombi zabakhenkethi abo.

Iintaba zeGilboa, kungabikho umsi namanzi aphumayo phezu kwenu; kungabikho izityalo ezivelisa umnikelo wokudla; kuba khona apho isigqubuthelo somkhosi saphazamiseka, sithunyelwe kude; isigqubuthelo sikaSawule asiyi kutywina ngeoli.
Umqolo kaYonatan wawungenakubuya, esuka kwigazi labo abafayo, nenyama yamadoda anamandla; ikrele likaSawule lwangenakubuyela lingekho.
USawule noYonatan, abathandekayo, abanobubele ubomi babo bonke, nokufa kwabo bebengahlukaniswanga; babekhawuleza kuneentaka, babenamandla kunaleli.
USawule, mna oonyana bakaSirayeli, lizani; Wazigqoka iingubo ezibomvu, waza wazisa izityalo zegolide kumaleko enu.
Kuthini na ukuba abadumileyo, abo banamandla, bawela phakathi kokulwa? UYonatan ulele emehlweni akho.
Ndinqunyulwa yintliziyo ngenxa yakho, mkhuluwa wam uYonathani. Uyithande kakhulu ingqondo yam; Uthando lwakho kum lwaluhle kakhulu, lungaphezu kothando lwamadoda.
Bawela njani abo banamandla anamandla? Zikhululwe njani izithuthi zabo zemfazwe!
Emva koko uDavide wabuza iNkosi, esithi, Ndiya nyuka ndifike esinye sezixeko zaseYuda? Wathi iNkosi, Yiya phezulu. UDavide wathi, Ndiye phi na? Wathi iNkosi, EHebron.
Waya khona uDavide, naye nabasetyhini bakhe ababini, nguAhinoam waseYizreyeli, no-Abhigayile umfazi kaNabali waseKarmele.
Ke kaloku uDavide wazisa namadoda aye naye, ngamnye nosapho lwakhe; bahlala emizini ejikeleze iHebron.
Bafika ke amadoda aseYuda, wamisa uDavide ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu kwamadoda aseYuda; baxela uDavide, besithi, Amadoda aseYabhesi eGiliyadi abulawe nguSawule.
Wathumela ke uDavide abathunywa kumadoda aseYabhesi eGiliyadi, athi kubo, UYehova akubuleleni; ngokuba niwenza lo msebenzi olungileyo kuSawule, inkosi yenu, ngokumfihla.
Ke ngoko, iNkosi anibonise ubulumko bakhe nobuxoki bakhe; mna ke ndiya kuba nawe ngokulungileyo, ngokuba niyenze loo nto.
Ke ngoko, nihlale ninamandla, ningamabhinqa anamandla; inkosi yenu uSawule ufile, namadoda aseYuda andiyiphazamisa ukuba ndibe ngukumkani wabo.
Ke kaloku uAbheri, unyana kaNere, umphathi womkhosi kaSawule, wathabatha uIshoboshethi, unyana kaSawule, waya eMahanayim.
Wakwenza khona ukumkani phezu kweGiliyadi, namaAshuri, neYezreyeli, noEfrayim, noBhenjamin, nabo bonke amaSirayeli.
UIshboshethi, unyana kaSawule, ubeminyaka imashumi mane ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli; waba neminyaka emibini engukumkani. Abantu bakaYuda ke balandela uDavide.
Ke kaloku uDavide waba ngukumkani eHebron phezu kwamadoda aseYuda, iminyaka esixhenxe neentsuku ezisibhozo.
Waphuma ke uAbheri, unyana kaNeri, nabasebenzi bakaIshboshethi, unyana kaSawule, besuka eMahanayim baya eGibheyon.
Waphuma ke uYowabhi, unyana ka-Seruya, nabakhonzi bakaDavide, wadibana nabo elwandle lwaseGibheyon; iqela elinye lahlala kwelinye icala lolwandle, neqela elinye lahlala kwelinye icala.
Wathi ke uAbheri kuYowabhi, Nceda baphakame oonyana abancinci, bafe phambi kwethu. Wathi uYowabhi, Nceda baphakame.
Bavuka ke, babalwa: abalishumi elinambini kuBhenjamin, noIshboshethi unyana kaSawule; nabalishumi elinambini kwabakhonzi bakaDavide.

Ke kaloku umntu ngamnye watsala intloko yomncinane wakhe, wabeka ikrele lakhe ecaleni lomncinane wakhe; bawela bonke ndawonye. Ngoko ke kwabizwa igama lendawo leyo eGibheyon ngokuba yiHelekathi-ha-Zurim.
Ke kaloku umkhosi wawunzima kakhulu ngaloo mini; uAbheri nabafazi bakaSirayeli bahlaselwa ngamadoda kaDavide.
Bakhona apho oonyana bakaSeruya abathathu: uYowabhi, noAbhishayhi, noAsayeli. UAsayeli wayehamba ngokukhawulezayo njengokuba kuqhutywa iintaka.
Ke kaloku uAsayeli walandela uAbheri; akazange atshintshe ngasekunene nakwesobunxele, elandela.
Ke kaloku uAbheri wabuyela umva, wathi, Nguwe na, Asayeli? Waphendula wathi, Nguwe.
Wathi ke kuye uAbheri, Yiya ngasekunene kwakho, okanye ngasekhohlo kwakho; uthathe omnye wabafazi, uthabathe izithuthuthu zakhe kuwe. Ke kaloku uAsayeli akayi kuyeka ukumlandela.
Wathi ke uAbhineeri kuAsayeli, Yiya ngasemva kwam; ndingakubulala ntoni na? Ndiza kudibana njani noYowabhi umzalwana wakho?

Ke kaloku uAsayeli akafuni ukubuyela. Wathi ke uAbhineeri wamdubula emlonyeni ngecala elisemva lomqolo wakhe, waphuma umqolo kumqolo wakhe; waba phantsi, wafa khona apho. Wonke umntu ofika kwindawo apho uAsayeli ewela khona, waza wafa khona, waya phantsi, wayehlala khona.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi noAbhishayhi balandela uAbheri; kwathi xa ilanga lithe laphuma, bafika edolophini yaseAmma, ekwiGiya, ekungeneni kwesiqithi saseGibeyon.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseBhenjamin ahlangana emva kuka-Abheri, abe liqela elinye; bahlala phezulu komthi.
Wathi uAbheri kuYowabhi, Ingaba ikrele liya kubulala ngonaphakade na? Awuyazi na ukuba oku kuya kugqitywa ngamanzi abandayo? Uza kuba uthi njani abantu bakho ukuba bayeke ukuthobela abazalwana babo?
Wathi uYowabhi, Uphila uThixo, ukuba ungabithelanga ulwimi, abakhonzi bam baya kuba belandela abazalwana babo kude kube ngusuku.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi waphucula isidumbu, bonke abantu bakhe bamisa; abazange baqhubeke nokulandela amaSirayeli, bamisa ukuhlasela.
Ke kaloku uAbhineeri namadoda akhe bahamba ngeendawo eziphakamileyo zomhlaba wonke loo busuku bonke; badlula iJordan, badlula yonke indawo yaseBitron, bafika eMahanayim.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi wabuyela ekufumaneni uAbheri, wahlanganisa bonke abantu bakhe; kwakukho amadoda angamashumi asithoba aphesheya kukaDavide, noAsayeli.
Ke kaloku abakhonzi bakaDavide babulala amadoda ka-Abheri eBhenjamin, amakhulu amathathu, anamashumi amathandathu.
Bathabathela uAsayeli, bawufihla kwisibhedlele sikayise eBhetelehem. Wahamba ke uYowabhi namadoda akhe yonke imini, wafika eHebron xa kuvuka umsi.
Waqhubeka ke umkhosi phakathi kwendlu kaSawule nendlu kaDavide imihla emide; uDavide waqhubeka enamandla, waqhubeka enamandla; ke indlu kaSawule yaqhubeka ibuhlungu.
Wazalwa ke uDavide oonyana eHebron. Ukumkani wakhe wayengu-Amnon; umzali wakhe waba nguAhinoam waseYizreyeli.
Unyana wakhe wesibini uKilabhi, owaziwa ngokuba nguAbhigayeli, umfazi kaNabhali waseKarmele; wesithathu uAbsalom, unyana kaMahaka, intombi kaTalmai ukumkani wakwaGeshuri.
wesixhenxe nguAdoniya unyana kaHagithi; wesisihlanu nguShefatiya unyana kaAbital.
wesixhenxe uYitreyam, owazalwa nguEgla, umfazi kaDavide. Bazalwa nguDavide eHebhere.
Ke kaloku kwakuqhubeka umkhosi phakathi kwendlu kaSawule nendlu kaDavide; uAbhineeri ke wakhula waza waba mkhulu endlwini kaSawule.
USawule wayenenkosikazi, igama layo nguRispa, intombi ka-Ahiya. Wathi uIshboshethi kuAbheri, Kutheni na ukuba ube nenkosikazi yoyise?

Ke kaloku uAbhineeri waxoka kakhulu ngamazwi kaIshboshethi. Waphendula wathi, Ndiye ndiba iinkunzi zeegusha ezweni laseYuda? Ndiye ndenza ngokulungileyo kwindlu kaSawule uyise wakho, nabazalwana bakhe, nabangani bakhe, kude kube ngaloo mini; andikundinika wena kuDavide; ke mna namhlanje uthetha kum ukuba ndenze into engalunganga ngowomfazi lowo.
UThixo ayenze le nto kum, amnike ngaphezu kwayo yonke loo nto, ukuba andizange ndikwenze kuDavide, njengokuba iNkosi ewisele kuye;
ukuba athabathe ubukumkani endlwini kaSawule, abeke isithsaba sikaDavide phezu kwaSirayeli nakwaYuda, ukusuka eDan waya eBher-sheba.
Akakwazanga uIshboshethi ukuqhubeka ethetha noAbheri, ngokuba wayemxolela.
Wathumela ke uAbheri abathunywa kuDavide, ukuba bathethe kuye; bathi, Lithini na eli lizwe? Yenza umnqophiso nam, ndiya kukuncedisa ukuba uthabathe bonke amaSirayeli kuwe.
Wathi uDavide, Kulungile; ndiya kwenza umnqophiso nawe. Ke kaloku ndicela kuwe into enye: Musa ukubuya ubone imehlo am, ukuba ungamkholela kuqala uMikayeli intombi kaSawule, xa ufika.
Wathumela ke uDavide abathunywa kuIshboshethi, unyana kaSawule, esithi, Ndininike umfazi wam uMikayeli; kuba ndimthengise ngeenwele zangaphambili zamaFilisti ezilikhulu.
Wathumela ke uIshboshethi abantu, wamthabatha kumyeni wakhe, uPalethiyeli unyana kaLayisi.
Wahamba naye umfazi wakhe, ecula yonke indlela, walandela kuye waya eBhahurim. UAbheri wathi kuye, Yiya ekhaya lakho. Wabuyela ke.
Wathetha ke uAbheri nabathetheli bakaSirayeli, esithi, Niye nakwixesha elidlulileyo nifuna ukuba uDavide abe ngukumkani wenu.
Ke ngoko, yenzani; ngokuba iNkosi uthi ngoDavide, Ndiya kusindisa abantu bam bakaSirayeli kumaFilisti, nakuzo zonke izitha zabo, ngesandla somkhonzi wam uDavide.
Wathetha ke uAbheri namadoda aseBhenjamin; wafika ke uAbheri eHebron, ukuba athethe kuDavide zonke izinto ezithe zathiwa nguSirayeli nosapho lonke laseBhenjamin.
Wafika ke uAbheri kuDavide eHebron, namadoda amashumi mabini naye. UDavide wamlungiselela idini uAbheri namadoda akhe.

Wathi ke uAbheri kuDavide, Ndiya kuhamba ngoku, ndiyihlanganise kuwe iSirayeli yonke, nkosi yam ukumkani, ukuba benze umnqophiso nawe; ube ngukumkani wakho kuwo onke amathandabuzo akho. UDavide wamisa uAbheri, waya exoloni.

Ke kaloku babuyela abakhonzi bakaDavide, noYowabhi, besuka ekufumaneni iinqanawa, benezinto ezininzi ezilahlekileyo. UAbhineeri ke akakwakho na kuDavide eHebron; ngokuba uDavide wamshiya, waya exoloni.
Wafika ke uYowabhi nomkhosi wakhe wonke, kwathiwa nguYowabhi, UAbheri unyana kaNeri waya kukumkani; wamvumela ukumkani ukuba ahambe, waphuma exoloni.
Wafika ke uYowabhi ukumkani, wathi, Ukwenze ntoni na? UAbhineeri wafika kuwe; kutheni na ukuba umyalele? Ngokuba sele ephuma.
Uyazi uAbheri, unyana kaNere; wafika ukuba akuxhoboze, ukuze akwazi zonke izithuthi zakho, nokuphuma kwakho nokungena kwakho, aze afunde zonke izinto ozizenzayo.
Waphuma ke uYowabhi kuDavide, wathumela abathunywa emva kuka-Abhineeri; bayambuyisela emzini kaSira. UDavide akazange akwazi.

Wabuya ke uAbheri waya eHebron, waza uYowabhi wamtsala ngasecaleni kwesango, ukuze athethe naye ngokufihlakeleyo; wabetha khona uAbhere emlonyeni wakhe, wafa. UYowabhi wenza njalo ngenxa yokufa kukaAsaheli umzalwana wakhe.
Wazi ke uDavide emva koko, wathi, Ndinobulungisa mna nobukhosi bam phambi koYehova ngobomi buka-Abheri unyana kaNeri.

UYowabhi, nosapho lonke loyise, luza kungena kuloo nto. Kubekho endlwini kaYowabhi umntu oneentlungu ezihambayo, nomkhuhlane wesikhumba, nomnye ohamba ngentambo, nomnye ofa ngesikhephe, nomnye ongenakutya okuninzi.
Wabulala ke uYowabhi noAbhishai, umzalwana wakhe, uAbheri, ngokuba wabulala uAsayeli, umzalwana wabo, emfazweni eGibeyon.

Wathi ke uDavide kuYowabhi, nabantu bonke ababe naye, Rapha iimpahla zenu, nizigqoke izihlangu ezingwevu, nihambeni phambi kokufa kuka-Abheri. Ke kaloku ukumkani uDavide wayehamba emva kwebhedi ethwala isisu.
Ke kaloku, babulala uAbheri eHebron. Ukumkani walila ngelizwi elikhulu emlilweni ka-Abhereri; nalo lonke uluntu lwalila.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wayalela lo msindo ngo-Abheri, esithi, Wakufa na u-Abheri njengokufa komntu ongaziyo?

Izandla zakho zathi zingabi zidityanisiwe, neenyawo zakho zathi zingabi ziqhoboshelwe; wawela njengokuba ehla umntu phambi kwamadoda akhohlakeleyo. Baye ke bonke abantu baqhubeka belilindela phezu kwakhe.

Ke kaloku bonke abantu bafika becela uDavide ukuba afune ukudla, ngelixa likhona ilanga; ke uDavide wamisa isibingelelo esithi, UThixo andixolele njalo nangakumbi, ukuba ndidla inkukhu okanye into enye phambi kokuba ilanga liphume.
Ke kaloku abantu bonke bayazi loo nto, yaba mnandi kubo; kuba yonke into awayeyenza ukumkani yaba ntle kubo bonke abantu.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu, nabo bonke amaSirayeli, bayazi ngaloo mini, ukuba akunguye ukumkani owabulala uAbheri unyana kaNeri.
Wathi ukumkani kubakhonzi bakhe, Awazi na ukuba namhlanje wawela umphathi omkhulu eSirayeli?
Ke mna, nokuba ndingumkumkani okhethiweyo, namhlanje ndibuthathaka; oonyana bakaSeruyiya aba banzima kakhulu kum; iNkosi ambuyisele lowo wenzayo okubi, ngokwento elungileyo ayenze.
Ke kaloku, uIshboshethi, unyana kaSawule, efundile ukuba uAbheri wafa eHebron, isandla sakhe saphazamiseka; bonke amaSirayeli bakhathazekile.

Unyana kaSawule wayenamadoda amabini, abe ziinqanawa zokulwa; elinye igama lakhe lalinguBhahana, elinye igama lakhe linguRekabhi, oonyana bakaRimon waseBherothi, wesizwe sikaBhenjamin. Ke kaloku iBherothi yaba yinxalenye kaBhenjamin.
Ke kaloku abantu baseBherothi babaleka baya eGitayim, baba ngabakhenkethi apho, behlala khona kude kube ngaloo mini.

Ke kaloku uYonatan, unyana kaSawule, wayenenkosikazi eyimfama ezinyawo zonke. Wayeminyaka emihlanu ezelwe, xa ilizwi likaSawule noYonatan lifika eYizreyeli. Wathabatha ke umxolisi wakhe, wabaleka; ke kaloku, ekuhambeni kwakhe ngokukhawuleza, wagwa, waba ngumxolisi. Igama lakhe lalinguMephiboshethi.
Ke kaloku uRekabhi noBhana, oonyana bakaRimon waseBherothi, baphuma, befika endlwini ka-Ishboshethi, xa kushushu imini; yena ke wayephumla kusasa.
Baya kungena endlwini, bethi bafuna ukuthatha ingqolowa; bawutshisa emlonyeni. Waphuma ke uRekabu noBhaana unyana wakhe.

Bafika endlwini, ke kaloku wayelele kwibhedi yakhe, egumbini lakhe lokuhlambela; bamvutha, bambulala, bamisa intloko yakhe; bathabatha intliziyo yakhe, bahamba ngendlela yolwandle lweArabha yonke imini.

Bayalela uDavide eHebron intloko kaIshboshethi, bathi kukumkani, Yakho intliziyo kaIshboshethi, unyana kaSawule, umqolo wakho, ofuna ukukubulala; namhlanje iNkosi wambuyisela uSawule nosapho lwakhe kuwe, nkosi yam ukumkani.
Waphendula ke uDavide, wathi kuRehabhi noBhaana umzalwana wakhe, oonyana bakaRimon waseBherothi, Uphila iNkosi osindiseleyo emngciphekweni wonke,
Ke kaloku, xa umntu wamxelela, esithi, USawule ufile; wacinga ukuba uzisa iindaba ezilungileyo. Ndamthabatha ke, ndambulala eSikelagi; le yayiyimali yam endiyenzileyo ngenxa yeendaba zakhe.
Ingaba ke ndiya kwenza ntoni na ngoku abantu ababi, abo babulala umntu ongenatyala kwibhedi yakhe, endlwini yakhe? Andiyi kukuhlawulisani na igazi lakhe, ndikucime phezu komhlaba?

Wathi ke uDavide kubantwana bakhe, bababulala; bathabathela izandla zabo neengcambu zabo, bayitshisa imiphefumlo yabo ecaleni kolwandle lwaseHebron. Bathabatha ke intloko kaIshboshethi, bayifihla kwisibingelelo sikaAbheri eHebhon.
Zathi zonke iintsapho zakwaSirayeli zifika kuDavide eHebron, zisithi, Yabona, thina sinyama yakho negazi lakho.

Ke kaloku ngelo xesha lidlulileyo, xa uSawule wayekumkani wethu, waba nguwe owenzayo ukuba baphume amaSirayeli emfazweni, ubabuyisele; wathi ke iNkosi kuwe, Uya kuba ngumlawuli wabo bonke abantu bam bakaSirayeli, uya kuba ngukumkani wabo.
Bafika ke bonke abathetheli bakaSirayeli kukumkani eHebron; ukumkani uDavide wamenza khona umnqophiso nabo phambi koYehova; bawuphakisa uDavide ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
UDavide ubeminyaka imashumi mathathu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba ngukumkani iminyaka emashumi mane.
Waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda eHebron iminyaka esixhenxe, neenyanga ezisibhozo; waba ngukumkani kwabaSirayeli bonke nakwaYuda eYerusalem iminyaka emashumi mathathu anesihlanu.

Ke kaloku ukumkani namadoda akhe bafika eYerusalem, behlasela amaJebhusi ahlala khona. Bathi ke amaJebusi kuDavide, Uza kungena apha kangako; baya kukuthintela abamnyama nabaphelelwe lithemba; bathi ke, Akuyi kungena apha uDavide.
Ke kaloku uDavide wathabatha isixeko esiqinileyo, iSiyon; sakuba nguMzi kaDavide.

Wathi uDavide ngaloo mini, Nabani na ohlasela abaYebhusi, kufuneka athabathe umbhobho wamanzi, afike kubo abo bakhohlakeleyo nabakhubazekileyo, abo uDavide abathandana nabo; ngenxa yoko kusithiwa, Abakhohlakeleyo nabakhubazekileyo bangangeni kule ndlu.
Wahlala ke uDavide kuloo mmandla, wabiza igama lakhe ngokuba nguMzi kaDavide; waza wayenza indawo ejikelezileyo, ukususela kuMilo ukuya ngaphakathi.
UDavide waqhubeka ekhula, waza waba mkhulu; kuba iNkosi, uThixo wamaSirayeli, waye naye.
UHiram ukumkani waseTire wathumela abathunywa kuDavide, neengcango zeediliya, nabaqulunqi bezinto zokwakha, nabakhonzi bezitayile; bakwakha indlu uDavide.
Waqonda ke uDavide ukuba iNkosi wammisa njengomkumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, waza wakwenza ubukumkani bakhe bukhulu ngenxa yabantu bakhe bakaSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide, emva kokuhamba kwakhe eHebhere waya eYerusalem, wathabatha amanye amakhonzi namabhinqa aseYerusalem; kwazalwa ke kuDavide amanye oonyana neentombi.
Lawona magama azalwa kuye eYerusalem: uShamua, noShobhab, noNathan, noSolomon,
uIbhare, noElishuwa, noNefegi, noYafiya,
uElishama, noEliyada, noElifeleti.
Ke kaloku, beva amaFilisti ukuba uDavide waphucuka waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, banyuka bonke abaFilisti bafuna uDavide. UDavide ke wayiqonda loo nto, wehla waya kwindlu ekhuselweyo.
Ke kaloku bafika amaFilisti, basasazeka eNtshonalanga yeRefayim.

UDavide wabuza iNkosi, esithi, Ndiya kuhamba ndibethe abaFilisti? Ingaba uya kubanikela esandla sam? Waphendula iNkosi uDavide, wathi, Yiya; ngokuba ndiya kubanikela ngokuqinisekileyo abaFilisti esandla sakho.

Wafika ke uDavide eBhayi-perazim, wababulala khona. Wathi uDavide, UYehova waphula iintshaba zam phambi kwam, njengokuba amanzi aqhutywa ngamanzi; ngoko kwabizwa igama lendawo leyo ngokuba yiBhayi-perazim.
Bashiya khona amaSirayeli izithixo zabo; uDavide namadoda akhe ayewathatha.
Baphinde banyuka amaFilisti, basasazeka emlanjeni wamaRefayim.
Wabuza uDavide iNkosi, waphendula wathi, Musa ukuwahlasela phambi kwabo; jikelezisa emva kwabo, uwahlasele phambi kwezityalo zeziqhamo.
Ke kaloku, xa uziva ilizwi elifana nokuhamba kwelasebunzini bemithi ye-mullet, uhambe ngokukhawuleza; kuba iNkosi uphuma phambi kwakho, ukuba ahlasele amaFilisti.
Wakwenza ke uDavide njengoko wamwiselayo iNkosi; wababulala amaFilisti, esuka eGibeha waya eGezere.
Ke kaloku uDavide waphinda wahlanganisa bonke abakhethiweyo bakaSirayeli, amadoda amawaka amashumi mathathu.

Ke kaloku uDavide waya, yena namadoda akhe onke, eBhaale-Yuda, ukuba athabathe khona ibhokisi kaThixo; le bhokisi ibizwa ngegama likaYehova wamaSirayeli, ohlala kwitrone yakhe phezu kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo.
Babeka isithunywa sikaThixo kwisithuthi esitsha, basithabatha endlwini ka-Abhinadadi esenqanaweni; uUza noAhiyo, oonyana baka-Abhinadadi, baqhuba isithuthi esitsha.
Yayithabatha yaphuma endlwini ka-Abinadabu, esenqanaweni; ibhokisi kaThixo yaba phezulu kuyo; uAhiyo wayehamba phambi kwebhokisi.
Ke kaloku uDavide, namadoda onke aseSirayeli, bedlala phambi koYehova ngezinto zonke zokudlala eziyenziwe ngomthi we-cypress, zii-harps, nezi-lyras, nezi-tamburins, nezi-rattles, nezi-cymbals.
Ke kaloku, bafika befike esidlangalaleni sikaNakhoni, iinkunzi zebhokhwe zathi ziqhekeka; ke uUza waphakamisa isandla sakhe, wathabatha itsimbi kaThixo.
Ke kaloku, intliziyo kaYehova yaqhuma ngoUza; wabetha khona uThixo ngenxa yobuxoki bakhe; wafa khona ecaleni kwebhokisi kaThixo.
Ke kaloku uDavide wakhathazeka, ngokuba ilizwi likaYehova lazalela ku-Uza; wathi igama lendawo leyo nguPerezi-u-Uza, de kube mhla.
UDavide wakhathazeka ngoYehova ngaloo mini, wathi, Iza kungena njani kum ibhokisi kaYehova?
Ke kaloku uDavide akathandabuzi ukuyithabatha ibhokisi kaYehova iye kumzi kaDavide, ukuba ibe naye; wayisa endlwini kaObedi-Edom waseGati.
Ibhokisi kaYehova yahlala endlwini ka-Obedi-edomo waseGathi, iinyanga ezintathu; iNkosi wabambisa u-Obedi-edomo nosapho lwakhe lonke.

Ke kaloku kwaziswa ukumkani uDavide, kusithiwa, UYehova ubambise ikhaya lika-Obedi-edomo, nazo zonke izinto zakhe, ngenxa yebhokisi kaThixo. Wahamba ke uDavide, wanyusa ibhokisi kaThixo ukusuka endlwini ka-Obedi-edomo waya kumzi kaDavide, entliziyweni enkulu.
Ke kaloku, xa abantu abathabatha ibhokisi kaYehova behamba ngeenyawo ezintandathu, uDavide wanikela inkunzi yenkomo, nenkunzi yenkomo ethambileyo.
Ke kaloku uDavide wadansa phambi koYehova ngamandla akhe onke, egqoka i-ephod yelinen, ibhanti yombingeleli.
Ke kaloku uDavide, namadoda onke aseSirayeli, bakhupha phezulu itekisi kaYehova ngemibhiyozo, nelizwi leebhokhwe.
Ke kaloku, xa ibhokisi kaYehova yafika eMzini kaDavide, uMikayeli intombi kaSawule wajongana ngefestile, wabona ukumkani uDavide enqumla edlala phambi koYehova; wamchukumisa ke intliziyo yakhe.
Bayingenisa ibhokisi kaYehova, bayibeka kwindawo yayo, ngaphakathi kwetenki kaDavide, awayeyithumele kuyo; wanikela uDavide izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo phambi koYehova.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide egqibile ukunikela izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo, wabambisa abantu ngegama likaYehova wemikhosi.

Wabanika ke isonka bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, amadoda nabasetyhini; umntu ngamnye wafumana intonga yesonka, nekhekhe leentyatyambo, nekhekhe leentyatyambo zomnquma. Ke kaloku bonke abantu babuyela endlwini yabo.

Ke kaloku, xa uDavide ebuyela ekhaya lakhe ukubhaptiza iindwendwe zakhe, waphuma uMikayeli intombi kaSawule wamfumana; wathi ke: Kuhle kangakanani na ubume bukakumkani bakaSirayeli namhlanje! Wazibonakalisa phambi kwamehlo eenkosikazi zabakhonzi bakhe, njengokuba umntu ongenakulibazisa.

Wathi uDavide kuMikayeli, Mna ndakwenza phambi koYehova; yena wandikhethela ngaphezu kukayise wakho nosapho lwakhe lonke, wammisa ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bakaYehova abaSirayeli. Ndiya kuba mhle phambi koYehova.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba ndibonakale ndingenangqondo kunale nto, ndize ndibe mncinane ngamehlo am; kodwa abo bafazi-mnqamlezo owathetha ngabo baya kundihlonipha.
Ke kaloku uMikayeli intombi kaSawule, akazange abe nonyana zonke imihla yakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wayehlala endlwini yakhe, ke iNkosi wamnika uxolo kuzo zonke iintshaba zakhe ezijikelezayo.
Wathi ukumkani kuNathani umprofeti, Yabona, mna ndihlala kwindlu eyenziwe ngeediliya; ke itempu kaThixo ikwitente.
Wathi uNathani kukumkani, Yiya, wenze konke okusemandleni akho; ngokuba iNkosi unguwe.
Ke kaloku ngaloo busuku kwafika ulizwi likaYehova kuNathani, lisithi,
Yiya, uthethe kumkhonzi wam uDavide, uthi, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Ngaba wena uya kwakha indlu yam ukuba ndihlale kuyo?

Andihlali endlwini, ukususela ngemini endiyikhupha ngayo ibandla lamaSirayeli kwelaseYiputa, kuze kube ngaloo mini; ndahamba ndisuka kwindawo enye ukuya kwenye, ndisuka kwitentile iye kwintentile engcwele.

Naphi na apho ndahamba khona nabantu bonke bakaSirayeli, ndithethe ntoni na nomnye wabaphathi bam, endiwawisela umthetho ukuba abe ngumbingeleli kubo bonke abantu bam bakaSirayeli, ndithi, Ningathini na ukuba ningangeni nam indlu yesedari?
Ngoku ke, utsho kumkhonzi wam uDavide, uthi, Utsho iNkosi wamaSirayeli ukuthi, Ndikuthathele embukweni wokutya iinkomo, ukuba ube ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bam bakaSirayeli.
Ndaba nawe naphi na apho wahamba khona, ndawacima bonke abathunywa bakho phambi kwakho; ndakwenza igama lakho libe likhulu, njengegama lamadoda amakhulu asehlabathini.

Ndiya kubanika ilizwe abantu bam bakaSirayeli, ndiyabaqhayisa; baya kuhlala endlwini yabo, bangaphazanyiswanga kwakhona. Amadoda akhohlakeleyo angawaphulaphuli ngokuphindaphindiweyo, njengokuba ayewenza ekuqaleni,

ukususela ngemihla endiyimisela ngayo abagwebi ukuba bathethe abantu bam, ooSirayeli; ndiya kukunika uxolo kuzo zonke iintshaba zakho. Utsho ke iNkosi kuwe, ukuba yena uya kwakha indlu kuwe, ikhaya lamakumkani.
Xa ubomi bakho buphele, nawe ufile, ube neentsapho zakho zangaphambili, ndiya kuvusa umntwana wakho oza kuba ngukumkani emva kwakho, ndiyiqinise ubukumkani bakhe.
Lo mntu uya kwakha indlu igama lam; ndiya kuqinisa isitulo sokumkani wakhe kude kube sexesha elide.
Ndiya kuba ngumzali wakhe, yena uya kuba ngunyana wam; xa esenza into engalunganga, ndiya kumxolela ngentambo, njengokuba umntu emxolela unyana wakhe, ngomqolo wesandla somntu.
Ke uxolo lwam aluyi kususwa kuye, njengokuba ndilususe kuSawule, owamsusayo ukuba alungise indawo kuwe.
Usapho lwakho nobukumkani bakho baya kuhlala phambi kwam ngonaphakade; isithsaba sakho siza kuqiniswa ngonaphakade.
Wathi uNathani kuDavide onke amagama kaYehova, naloo mzekeliso wambonisa wona.
Wafika ke ukumkani uDavide, wahlala phambi koYehova, wathi, Ndibani na mna, Nkosi yam uThixo? Yintoni ikhaya lam, ukuba ndinikhokele kude kuthi.
Ke kaloku, ukuba oku akubi nto kuwe, Nkosi iNkosi, wena ke wathetha ngendlu yomkhonzi wakho ngonaphakade. Ingaba le yinto oyenzayo kumadoda, Nkosi uThixo?
Ndithi ntoni na wena, uDavide? Uyazi umkhonzi wakho, Nkosi yethu iNkosi.
Ngenxa yelizwi lakho, ngenxa yobubele bakho, wenza zonke ezi zinto zikhulu, ukuze uzibonise kumkhonzi wakho.
Ngoko ke, Thixo kaYehova, umkhulu wena; akukho namnye ofana nawe, akukho Thixo ngaphandle kwakho. Siyakuxelela ngeendlebe zethu.

Nguwuphi na lo mmandla uthile emhlabeni ofana nabantu bakho bakaSirayeli? Uthe waphuma, Thixo, ukuwasindisa, ukuba abe ngabantu bakho, ukuze libonakaliswe igama lakho; wenze izinto ezinkulu nezimangalisayo ezweni lakho phambi kwabantu bakho, owabasindileyo eYiputa, ukususa iintlanga kunye neentliziyo zazo.
Wakwenza abantu bakho, uSirayeli, babe ngabantu bakho bokwenyaniso; waba nguThixo wabo, wena, Nkosi.
Ke ngoko, Nkosi yethu uThixo, ilizwi lakho elithethayo kumkhonzi wakho nosapho lwakhe, ligcinele kude kube sekupheleni, wenze njengoko uthe wathi.
Ke ngoko igama lakho liza kuba likhulu kude kube sethutyeni, basithi, UYehova wamaSirayeli nguThixo phezu kwaSirayeli; nendlu yomkhonzi wakho uDavide iya kubekwa phambi kwakho.
UYehova wemikhosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, wena wabonisa umkhonzi wakho, wathi, Ndiza kukuxhobisa indlu; ngenxa yoko lo mkhonzi wakho wafumanisa intliziyo yakhe yokuthandaza kuwe ngaloo mini.
Ke ngoko, Nkosi yethu iNkosi, wena unguThixo; amazwi akho ayinyaniso; uye wathetha loo nto ilungileyo kumkhonzi wakho.

Namhlanje ke, nceda ubhaptize indlu yomkhonzi wakho, ukuba ihlale phambi kwakho ngonaphakade; ngokuba wena, Nkosi yethu iNkosi, wathetha, yaye ngokubhaptiza kwakho ikhaya lomkhonzi wakho liya kuba libhaptizwa ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, uDavide wababulala amaFilisti, wabeka phantsi isandla sakhe; wathabatha iMethegi-amma, umzi wabo omkhulu, esandla samaFilisti.

Wawahlasela amaMowabhi, wamisa abagwetywe ehlabathini, wabalinganisela ngentambo; iinqanawa ezimbini zentambo zabulawa, inqanawa enye epheleleyo yagcinwa iphila. AmaMowabhi ke aye yaba ngabakhonzi bakaDavide, anikela umnikelo kuye.
UDavide wabetha uHadarezere, unyana kaRehobhi, ukumkani waseZobha, xa esiya uHadarezere ukubuyisela umkhosi wakhe kumlambo iEfrata.

UDavide wathabatha kuye amawaka alishumi elinamakhulu asixhenxe eemahashe, namawaka angamashumi mabini eengqekembe. Wazitshixa zonke iihashe zezinto ezihamba ngeemoto; wagcina kuphela izithuthi ezingamakhulu.
Bafika ke abaAram baseDamasko ukuncedisa uHadarezere ukumkani waseTsoba; uDavide wabulala kumaSirayeli amawaka amashumi mabini anesibini.
Wabeka ke uDavide amaqela emkhosini wamaSirayeli eDamasko; baba ngabakhonzi bakhe amaSirayeli, benika umvuzo kuye. UYehova wamkhusela uDavide kuwo onke amagama awayehamba kuwo.
UDavide wathabatha izikhuselo zegolide, zabasebenzi bakaHadarezere, waza wazisa eYerusalem.
Ukumkani uDavide wathabatha isinyithi esininzi eBhatha, naseBherothai, emizini kaHadarezere.
Ke kaloku uToyi ukumkani waseHamati wafunda ukuba uDavide wawubulala lonke iqela likaHadarezere.

Wathumela ke uToyi uYoram, unyana wakhe, kukumkani uDavide, ukuba amhlelele, amthande, ngokuba wahlasela uHadarezere; kuba uHadarezere wayeyintombi kaToyi. UYoram wazisa izipho zesilivere, negolide, nentsimbi.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uDavide wanikela kuYehova, kunye nesilivere negolide awayeyithathe kuzo zonke iintlanga azenza ukuba zikhulule:
waza wanikela iimpahla ezilahlekileyo, awazithabathayo kuHadarezere unyana kaRehobhi, ukumkani waseZobha.
Ke kaloku uDavide waba negama, xa wayebuya ehlasela amaSirayeli amawaka alishumi linamithandathu, eNtaba yeSalt.
Wabeka amaqela emazweni onke aseEdom; bonke aba Edomu babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide. UYehova wamkhusela uDavide apho aye khona.
Ke kaloku uDavide waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli onke, esenza inyaniso nomthetho kubo bonke abantu bakhe.
UYowabhi unyana kaSeruhiya waba ngukumkani womkhosi; uYesafati unyana kaAhilodi waba ngumbhali.
USadoko unyana ka-Ahitubhi, noAhileleki unyana ka-Abhiyatare babe ngababingeleli; uSeraya waba ngumbhali wokumkani.
UBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada waba ngukumkani weeKerethi, neePelethi, abakhuseli bakakumkani; oonyana bakaDavide babe ngabaphathi bakhe.
Wathi uDavide, Ingaba kukho umntu oseleyo endlwini kaSawule, ukuba ndimnike ububele ngenxa kaYonatan?
Ke kaloku kwabakho umkhonzi endlwini kaSawule, igama lakhe nguTsiba; bamwisela kuye uDavide. Wathi kuye ukumkani, Ngaba wena uTsiba? Waphendula wathi, Ndingumkhonzi wakho.
Wathi ukumkani, Ingaba kukho umntu osele ephilayo kusapho lukaSawule, ukuze ndimsebenzele ububele bukaThixo? Waphendula uTsiba ukumkani wathi, UYonatan unaye unyana ophelelwe zinyawo.
Wathi ukumkani, Uphi na? Wathi uTsiba, Ewe, endlwini kaMakiri, unyana kaAmmiel, eLo-Debari.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uDavide wathumela, wamthabatha endlwini kaMakiri unyana ka-Ammiel, eLodebha.
Wafika ke uMephiboshethi, unyana kaYonathani, umntwana kaSawule, kuDavide, wahlangula ngobuso bakhe emhlabeni. UDavide wathi, UMephiboshethi? Waphendula wathi, Ndingumkhonzi wakho.
Wathi kuye uDavide, Musa ukuxoka; kuba ndiya kukwenza ububele kuwe ngenxa kaYonatan uyise wakho; ndiza kukubuyisela yonke imithi kaSawule, udade wakho; nawe uza kuhlala ukutya emehlweni am, mihla le.
UMephiboshethi wahlangula, wathi, Ndibani na mkhonzi wakho, ukuba ujonge iinkomo ezifileyo ezifana nam?
Ke kaloku ukumkani wambiza uTsiba, umkhonzi kaSawule, wathi kuye, Zonke izinto zikaSawule nezindlu zakhe ndizinika kunyana wokumkani wakho.

Ke wena, noonyana bakho, nabakhonzi bakho, bamele banikele imbewu, niyingenise, ukuze kubekho ukutya kunyana kakumkani wakho; ke yena uMephiboshethi uya kuhlala edla emehlweni am. USiba wayeneentombi ezilishumi elinazine, nabazalwana abamashumi mabini.
Wathi uTsiba kukumkani, Yonke into oyitshoyo nkosi yam ukumkani, umkhonzi wakho uya kuyilungisa. Wadla ke uMephiboshethi emehlweni kaDavide, njengenye yabantwana bakakumkani;
UMephiboshethi wayenonyana omncinci, igama lakhe nguMika; bonke abahlali endlwini kaTsiba babe ngabakhonzi bakaMephiboshethi.
Wahlala ke uMephiboshethi eYerusalem, ngokuba wayedla mihla le emehlweni kakumkani. Waye waphelelwe zinyawo zakhe zombini.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, wafa ukumkani wamaAmmoniti; waba ngukumkani uHanun unyana wakhe endaweni yakhe.

Wathi uDavide, Ndiya kwenza ubulungisa kuHanun, unyana kaNahashi, njengokuba uyise wenza ubulungisa kum. Wathumela ke uDavide abakhonzi bakhe, ukuba bamxolele uHanun ngenxa yokufa kukayise. Bafika ke abakhonzi bakaDavide ezweni labantwana baka-Amon;

Bathi abathetheli baka-Ammon kuHanun, umphathi wabo, Ingaba ucinga ukuba uDavide uyamhlonela uyise, ekuthumeleni abantu ukuxolela wena? Hayi! UDavide wathumela abo bantu ukuba bajikeleze lo mzi, ukuze bawubone, bawulahle;
Wathi ke uHanun, athabathe abakhonzi bakaDavide, wamisa isiqingatha seentloko zabo, wamisa izihlangu zabo phakathi kweenkomo zabo, wabathumela.

Wathi ke uDavide, xa kwathiwa loo nto kuye, wathumela abathunywa ukuba badibana nabo; ngokuba abo madoda babengenakulibaziseka kakhulu. Wathi ukumkani kubo, Bahlale eYeremiya, de iinwele zenu zikhule kwakhona; emva koko niye.

Babona ke oonyana baka-Ammon ukuba bawenza uDavide abe ngumthandi wabo; ke kaloku bathumela, baqesha amaSirayeli asuka eBhethe-rehobhi, abantu abamashumi mabini amawaka abahamba ngeenyawo, noSobha ukumkani waseMahaka, namadoda amawaka amathathu, namaSirayeli aseTob.
Wava ke uDavide, wathumela uYowabhi nomkhosi wakhe wonke, oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Baphuma ke oonyana baka-Ammon, balungiselela ukulwa ekungeneni kwesango ledolophu yabo; amaAram aseZobha, namaRehobhi, namadoda aseTobhe neMahaka, bahlala icala elinye emzini.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi, xa ebona ukuba kukho umkhosi phambi kwakhe nosemva kwakhe, wakhetha abantu abakhethiweyo kuSirayeli, wabamisa emgceni phambi kwabaseAram.
Ke kaloku amanye amadoda awabeka phantsi komyalelo kaAbhishai, unyana wakhe; wamisa ke amaqela abo phambi kwabantwana baka-Amon.
Wathi uYowabhi, Ukuba amaSirayeli anamandla ngaphezu kwam, uya kumnceda; ukuba ke oonyana baka-Ammon banamandla ngaphezu kwakho, mna ndiya kukunceda.
Yiba namandla, sihlale sinamandla ngenxa yabantu bethu, nakwiidolophu zoThixo wethu; iNkosi akwenze oko kulungileyo emehlo akhe.
Wahamba ke uYowabhi namadoda akhe, bahlasela amaSirayeli; amaSirayeli aye emveni kwakhe.
Bathe ke oonyana baka-Ammon bebona ukuba abaAram babaleka, babeya nabo phambi kuka-Abhishai, babuyela emzini wabo. Wabuya uYowabhi ekulwa oonyana baka-Ammon, wabuyela eYerusalem.
Bathe ke abaAram bebona ukuba bahlaselwe nguSirayeli, baphinde bahlangane.
Ke kaloku uHadarezere wathumela, wababiza amaAram asentshonalanga yomlambo iEfrayim; bafika eHelam; noShobhaki, umphathi womkhosi kaHadarezere, wayephambili kwabo.
Ke kaloku, xa kuthe kwaziswa uDavide ngaloo nto, wathabatha ooSirayeli bonke, wadlula umlambo iJordan, waya eHelam. Balungiselela amaAram ukuba ahlangane noDavide, bahlasela.

Ke kaloku abaAram babaleka phambi kwaSirayeli. Wabulala uDavide kuma-Aram abantu abangamakhulu asixhenxe abaqhuba iinqanawa, namawaka anamanci mane ahamba ngeenyawo; wabetha noShobhaki, umthetheli womkhosi wabo, wafa khona.
Bonke ookumkani abakhonzayo uHadarezere, bebona ukuba amaSirayeli ayewabetha; basenza uxolo namaSirayeli, babe ngabakhonzi babo. Baye ke abaAram bakhathazeka ukuba bangabanceda nabantwana baka-Amon.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wokuvuka kwelanga, ngexesha abakumkani besiya emfazweni, uDavide wathumela uYowabhi, namagqwetha akhe, neqela lonke lamaSirayeli; babulala oonyana baka-Ammon, bajikelezisa iRabha. UDavide ke wayehlala eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku, ngobusuku obuthile, uDavide wavuka ebhedini yakhe, wahamba phezu kophahla lwendlu kakumkani. Wabona phantsi kophahla ibhinqa lihlamba; laliyibhinqa elithandekayo kakhulu.
Ke kaloku uDavide wathumela umntu ukuba ambuze ukuba ngubani? Wathi ke lo mntu, Akunjalo ke loo Bathsheba intombi kaEliyam, indoda kaUriya umHeti?
Wathumela ke uDavide abathunywa, wamthabatha. Wafika kuye, walala naye; wayesele egqibile ukuhlamba kwakhe, ukuba acocekile, emva kokuphuma kwegazi lakhe. Wabuyela ekhaya.
Ke kaloku lo mfazi wakhulelwa; wamthumela uDavide, esithi, Ndikhulelwe.
Wathumela ke uDavide umyalezo kuYowabhi, esithi, Thumela kum uUriya, umHeti. UYowabhi wathumela uUriya kuDavide.
Wafika ke uUri, uDavide wambuza ukuba uYowabhi ungubani na, nokuba banjani oonyana bakaSirayeli, nokuba uthini umkhosi.
Wathi ke uDavide kuUriya, Yiya ekhaya lakho, hlamba izinyawo zakho, uphumle. Waphuma ke uUriya endlwini kakumkani; ukumkani wathumela umvuzo emva kwakhe.
Ke kaloku uUri akayi kungena endlwini yakhe; walala emehlweni emnyango wendlu kakumkani, namakhonzi onke enkosi yakhe.
Ke kaloku kwaziswa uDavide, besithi, UUri akazange ahambe endlwini yakhe. Wathi ke uDavide kuUriya, Uthe wabuya uhamba; kutheni na ukuba awuhambi endlwini yakho?

Wathi uUriya kuDavide, Ibhokisi nemiyalelo kaSirayeli noYuda ihlala emakhayeni; ukumkani wam uYowabhi, nabakhonzi bakho, bamisa amasango ehlabathini elivulekileyo. Ndiza kungena njani ekhaya ndidla, ndisele, ndihlale nomkakhe? Uphila mna umphefumlo wakho, andizukwenza loo nto.
Wathi ke uDavide kuUriya, Uhlale apha umhla omnye; namhlanje ndiya kukushiya uhambe. Wahlala ke uUriya eYerusalem ngaloo mini, nomhla olandelayo.

Ke kaloku uDavide wamxelela ukuba asele naye, asele newayini. Wathi ke uDavide wathi kuye ukuba asele; waphuma ke uUriya emini, waya kuhlala kwibhedi yakhe phakathi kwabakhonzi bakakumkani wakhe; wayesengumntu ophantsi ekhaya.
Wathi ke uDavide emini, wabhala incwadi kuYowabhi, wayithumela ngoUriya.
Wabhala kuloo ncwadi, esithi, Nceda nimise uUriya phambi kokulwa, apho kunzima khona ukulwa; ke ngoko niyisuse isandla sam kuye, ukuze ahlaselwe aze afe.
Ke kaloku, xa uYowabhi ejikeleza umzi, wabeka uUriya kwindawo apho wayeyazi ukuba kukho oonyana bakaSirayeli abanamandla.
Baphuma ke amadoda edolophini, ahlasela uYowabhi; bafa abanye abakhonzi bakaDavide; wafa ke noUriya umHeti.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi wamthumela uDavide, wamxelela yonke into yokulwa.
Wathi kuye umthunywa, Xa ugqibile ukuxelela ukumkani yonke into yemfazwe,
ukuba ke ukumkani acamngce, akuxelele ukuthi, Niya kungena njani kuloo mzi ukubhiyozela? Awazi na ukuba baya kutyhila amagwebu edonga?

Nguwuphi lowo wambulalayo uAbhimeleki, unyana kaYerubheshethi? Umfazi akawuthuthanga na phezu kwakhe iithayile ezinkulu zomqolo ukusuka edonga, waza wafa eThebez? Kutheni na ke ukuba nifikeni kude kakhulu nodonga? Ukuba uya kubuza njalo, sithi kuye, Umkhonzi wakho uUriya, umHeti, naye wafa.
Waye ke umthunywa, wamxelela uDavide yonke into awayemthumela yona uYowabhi.
Wathi lo mthunywa kuDavide, Umkhosi wawunamandla kunaye; waphuma ke ukulwa nathi emaphandleni, sawubuyisela umva, sawushiya ekungeneni kwesango ledolophu.
Ke kaloku, abathuthi-makhwenkwe bathabathela emgangathweni, batyhala abakhonzi bakho; kwakufa namadoda amaninzi ekumkani; wafa ke nomkhonzi wakho uUriya, umHeti.

Wathi uDavide kumthunywa, Utsho oku kuYowabhi, Ndithi, Musa ukukhathazeka ngaloo nto; kuba ikrele libulala umntu ngamnye njengokufa komnye; khawuleza uhlasele lo mzi, uyicaphuke; uqinise uYowabhi ngamazwi ala.
Wava ke umfazi ka-Uriya ukuba umyeni wakhe, u-Uriya, wafa, wamlingisa.
Ke kaloku, ziphelile iintsuku zesibingelelo, uDavide wathumela waza wamtsala waya endlwini yakhe; waba ngumfazi wakhe, waza wazala unyana kuye. UYehova akathandabuzi into awayeyenze uDavide.
Wathumela iNkosi uNathani kuDavide. Wafika ke uNathani kuye, wathi kuye, Kwabakho amadoda amabini emzini omnye; omnye waba mkhulu, owona mncinci.
Umfazi lowo omneleyo wayenazo iintombi nezimvu ezininzi kakhulu.

Ke kaloku lo mfazi akazange abe nento, ngaphandle konyana omncinane omtshakazi, awayewuthengile, waza wamzala; waba mkhulu kuye nabantwana bakhe; wadla emlonyeni wakhe, wasela kwisitya sakhe, walala emehlweni akhe; waba njengonyana wakhe.

Ke kaloku, kwafika umntu ohambayo kuye lo mntu omtyebi; ke lowo mntu umtyebi akazange athathe enye yeentyatyambo zakhe, okanye iinkomo zakhe, azilungiselele loo mntu wamkelayo; kodwa wathabatha inkunzi yenkomo yomngxunya, wayilungiselela lo mntu wamkelayo.
Ke kaloku uDavide waxhaphaza kakhulu lo mntu, wathi kuNathane, Uphila iNkosi, ukuba umntu owenza loo nto ngumfazi ofanele ukufa.
Umele abuyisele iinkunzi zeenkomo ezine ngenxa yaloo nto, ngokuba wenza into enjalo, akabi nesonka!
Wathi ke uNathani kuDavide, Uwo nalowo mntu. Utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Ndakutywina ukuba ube ngukumkani phezu kukaSirayeli, ndakukhusela esandla sikaSawule.
Ndaninika indlu yokumkani wakho, ndazibeka izibini zokumkani wakho emlenzeni wakho; ndaninika oonyana bakaSirayeli nakwaYuda; ukuba oko kwakungabi nto, ndiya kukunika okuninzi.

Ke ngoko, kutheni na ukuba ukhohlise igama likaYehova, wenze okubi emehlweni akhe? Wabulala uUriya umHeti ngekhephu, wathabatha umfazi wakhe ube ngumfazi wakho; wambulala ngekhephu labantwana baka-Amon.
Ke ngoko ke, ikrele aliyi kushiya ikhaya lakho ngonaphakade; ngokuba undixhaphazile, wathabatha umfazi kaUriya umHeti, abe ngumfazi wakho.
Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Yabona, ndiya kukuzisa ububi endlwini yakho; ndiya kuzithabatha izibhinqa zakho phambi kwamehlo akho, ndizinike kumyeni wakho, aze ahlale nezibhinqa zakho emveni kwelanga.
Ukwenzele isono sakho ngokufihlakeleyo; ke mna ndiya kwenza oku ngaphaya phambi kwamadoda aseSirayeli onke, emini.
Wathi ke uDavide kuNathani, Ndikhe ndenze isono phambi koYehova. Waphendula uNathani uDavide, wathi, Ke kaloku iNkosi wasusa isono sakho; awuyi kufa.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba ukwenzele izitha zikaYehova isizathu sokuba zithethe ngaye ngento oyenzeyo; ngoko ke lo mntwana ozalwa kuwe uya kufa.
Ke kaloku uNathane waya endlwini yakhe. Wathi ke iNkosi wambetha lo mntwana, owamzala uDavide loo ndoda yowesifazane ka-Uriya; lo mntwana wagula kakhulu.
Ke kaloku uDavide wathandaza kuThixo ngenxa yonyana. Wathi ke uDavide, ahambe aphe isonka; waya endlwini yakhe, waphumla phantsi ehlabathini.
Ke kaloku abakhulu bendlu yakhe bafika kuye, ukuba amkhuphe ehlabathini; wayeka ke, akayi kudla nantoni na nabo.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe, wafa unyana. Abakhonzi bakaDavide bakhathazeka ukuba bamxelele ukuba unyana ufile; bathi ke, Xa unyana ephilayo, sathetha noDavide, naye akazange athethe nathi; siya kumxelela ntoni na ukuba unyana ufile? Mhlawumbi uya kwenza into yokusibulala.

Ke kaloku uDavide wabona ukuba abakhonzi bakhe betshixisa phakathi kwabo, waqonda ke uDavide ukuba lo mntwana ufile. Wathi ke uDavide kubakhonzi bakhe, Lo mntwana ufile na? Baphendula bathi, Ewe, ufile.
Wavuka ke uDavide ehlabathini, wahlamba, wamisa, watshintsha iimpahla zakhe; waya endlwini kaYehova, wathandaza. Ke kaloku wabuyela ekhaya, wacela ukudla; bayamnikela, wadla.
Bathi kuye abakhonzi bakhe, Yintoni le nto uyenzayo loo nto? Xa lo mntwana ephilayo, wathandaza, wawulingisa; ke ngoku ufile lo mntwana, uvuka usele.
Waphendula uDavide, wathi, Xa lo mntwana wayephila, ndathandaza, ndalilela; ndathi ke, Nguwuphi na owaziyo? Kungenzeka ukuba iNkosi angandikhathalela, aphile lo mntwana.
Ke kaloku ngoku ufile; ngaba ndiya kuhamba ndingenakutya? Ndingambuyisela na? Ndiza kumya kuye ngemini, kodwa akazukubuya kum.
Wamxolela uDavide uBhatshebha, indodana yakhe; wahlala naye, waza wazala unyana, wathi uDavide igama lakhe nguSolomon. UYehova wamthanda lo mntwana.
wathumela amagama ngesandla sikaNathani umprofeti, esithi, Libizwa igama lakhe ngokuba nguYedidiya; ngokuba iNkosi wamthanda.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi waya kulwa neRabha, idolophu enkulu yama-Ammon; wathabatha isixeko esikhuselekileyo sokumkani.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi wathumela abathunywa kuDavide, esithi, Ndiye ndahlasela iRabha, ndiyithathe imiyalelo yamanzi yayo.
Ke ngoko, hlanganisana namanye amajoni, ujikeleze lo mzi, uyithathe; ukuba kungenjalo ndiya kuwuthatha, ibe ligama lam.
Ke kaloku uDavide wahlanganisa iqela lonke, waya eRabha, wayihlasela, wayithatha.

Wathabatha isithsaba esisuka ebusweni bukakumkani wabo, wayibeka phezu kobuso bakhe; ibe yayiyegolide, isisindo sayo saba ziikhilogram ezilishumi elinambini; kwakukho iintyatyambo ezintsonkothileyo kuyo. UDavide wathabatha nakwidolophu impahla enkulu.

Wabakhupha abantu abahlala khona, wabaphatha ngamagqabi, neengcongconi zentsimbi, neengxowa zentsimbi, wabaphatha ngokwenza iithayile; wenza njalo kuwo onke amadolophu eAmmon. Wabuyela ke uDavide nomkhosi wakhe wonke eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, u-Amnon, unyana kaDavide, wathanda uTamari; waba ngudade othandekayo kaAbsalom, omnye unyana kaDavide.
Ke kaloku u-Amnhon wathandana naye, waza waba nesifo ngenxa kaTamari, umzalwana wakhe; ke yena wayeyindodakazi, kwathiwa kunzima ku-Amnhon ukuba akwenze nantoni na kuye.
Ke kaloku uAmnhon wayenenkosi, igama lakhe linguYonadabu, unyana kaShimeha, umzalwana kaDavide; uYonadabu ke wayengumntu owaziyo kakhulu.
Wathi ku-Amnhon, Unyana wokumkani wena; kutheni na ukuba ubona iinwele zakho zibuhlungu mihla le? Ingaba awufuni kundixelela? Wathi u-Amnhon kuye, Ndimthanda uThamari, umzalwana ka-Absalom udade wam.

Wathi kuye uYonadabu, Yihla phantsi kwibhedi yakho, uyeke ukuba unesifo; ke xa uyise wakho efika ukukubona, uthi kuye, Nceda, afike uTamari, umzalwana wam, amnike into yokuba ndidle; alungiselele isonka phambi kwam, ukuze ndiyibone, ndikulelise ngesandla sakhe.

Walala ke uAmnhon, wafuna ukuba ngumgulane. Ke kaloku ukumkani waya kumbona, wathi uAmnhon kukumkani, Nceda, afike uTamari, umyeni wam, amlungiselele phambi kwam iziqholo ezibini, ndizidle ngasesandla sakhe;
Wathumela ke uDavide kuThamari, endlwini kakumkani, esithi, Yiya, nceda, endlwini ka-Amnon, umzalwana wakho, uyilungiselele isonka.
Wafika ke uThamari endlwini ka-Amnhon, umzalwana wakhe; wayelele apho; wathabatha ingqolowa, wayixuba, waza wenza iziqhobosha phambi kwakhe, waza wazenza.
Wathabatha ke umkhenkce, wamnika iziqhoboshi; wayeka ukuba azile. Wathi uAmnhon, Nciphisa bonke abaphumayo apha. Baphuma ke bonke abaphumayo.
Wathi ke uAmnhon kuThamari, Thola isonka egumbini lam lokuhlambela, ndidla ngesandla sakho. Wathabatha uThamari iziqholo azenzayo, waza wazisa ku-Amnon unyana wakhe egumbini lokuhlambela;
Ke kaloku, xa wayezinikela kuye ukuba azidle, wamthabatha, wathi, Yiya ulele nam, nkosikazi yam.
Wathi kuye, Hayi, mkhuluwa wam! Musa ukumxolela; kuba akukho nto injalo ekufuneka yenziwe kuSirayeli; musa ukwenza loo nto inobungozi.
Ndiya kuhamba phi, ndize ndenze intlungu yam? Uza kuba njengonye weentloko ezibi kakhulu eSirayeli. Nceda uthethe nokumkani; akuyi kukuthintela ukuba ungandifazi.
Wathi ke yena, Andiyi kumxelela; kuba wayenamandla kunaye; wamnyamekela, wamnqula.
Ke kaloku u-Amnhon wamchukumisa kakhulu; wamchukumisa ngaphezu kokuba amthanda. Wathi kuye u-Amnhon, Yiya, uyeke!
Wathi kuye, Hayi; ukuba uyandikhupha ngoku, kubuhlungu ngaphezu kokwenzayo kum ngaphambili. Ke kaloku akafuni ukumphulaphula.
Waza wabiza umkhonzi wakhe, wathi, Yikhuphe loo ndoda phambi kwam, utshixe intliziyo yakhe.
Ke kaloku wayegqoke ibhanti elinobude bemilenze; ngokuba abafazi bakakumkani abatshabalalayo bagqoka njalo. Waphuma ke umkhonzi wakhe, watshixa intliziyo emva kwakhe.
Ke kaloku uTamari wabeka inkunkuma phezu kweentloko zakhe, wayirhoxisa ibhanti yakhe; wabeka sandla sakhe phezu kwentloko yakhe, waya, ephuma elilingisa ngelizwi elikhulu.

Wathi kuye uAbhisalom, umzalwana wakhe, U-Amnhon, umzalwana wakho, wayekho nawe na? Kuba ngoku, nkosikazi yam, ulumke ngale nto; yena ngunyana wakho; musa ukuba le nto iphazamise intliziyo yakho. Wahlala ke uThamari endlwini ka-Abhisalom, umzalwana wakhe, ezolileyo, emthubi.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uDavide wayeva ngazo zonke ezi zinto, waxoka kakhulu.
Ke kaloku uAbhisalom akathethi nto ku-Amnhon, nokuba yinyani okanye inyaniso; ngokuba uAbhisalom wamnyamekela u-Amnhon, ngenxa yokuba wamisa uTamari, umyeni wakhe.
Ke kaloku, emva kweminyaka emibini iphela, kwathi ke uAbhisalom emisa izimvu zakhe eBhahali-hazori, entliziyweni kaEfrayim; wabiza uAbhisalom onke oonyana bakakumkani.
Wafika ke uAbsalom ukumkani, wathi, Iinkomo zam zineentyatyambo; ngaba ukumkani namagqwetha akhe baya kumya kum?

Wathi ukumkani kuAbhisalom, Hayi, unyana wam; asiyi kungena bonke; siza kuba ngumthwalo kuwe. Ke kaloku uAbhisalom wayemxelela, kodwa ukumkani waqhubeka engathandanga ukuba ahambe; wabambisa uAbhisalom.
Wathi ke uAbhisalom, Ukuba akunjalo, nceda ukuba uAmnhon, umzalwana wam, ahambe nathi. Ukumkani wathi kuye, Ngaba kufuneka ahambe nani?
Ke kaloku uAbhisalom wamnyanzela; ukumkani ke wavumela uAmnhon nabantwana bakhe bonke ukuba bahambe noAbhisalom.

Ke kaloku uAbhisalom wabawisela umthetho abakhonzi bakhe, wathi, Khumbulani uAmnhon; kuba xa ethandazela iwayini, mna ndithi kuni, Ugwebe uAmnhon, niwufakele yena. Musani kukhathazeka; mna ndiya kukuwisela umyalelo; zinikele, ningamahlwempu.
Bathi ke abakhonzi baka-Absalom ku-Amnhon, njengokuba wathi u-Absalom. Bavuka bonke oonyana bakakumkani, bathabathe izimvu zabo, babaleka.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa behamba ngendlela, kwafika umyalezo kuDavide, usithi, UAbsalom wabulala oonyana bonke bakakumkani; akukho namnye wabo oseleyo.
Wavuka ke ukumkani, warhoxa iimpahla zakhe, waya phantsi ehlabathini; bonke abakhonzi bakhe babesecaleni kwakhe, nabo barhoxa iingubo zabo.

Waphendula ke uYonadabu, unyana kaShimeha, umzalwana kaDavide, wathi, Inkosi yam, musa ukucinga ukuba babulala bonke oonyana bakakumkani abancinci; nguAmnhon kuphela owafa. UAbhisalom wayesele efuna oku ukusukela ngaloo mini apho uAmnhon wamisa khona uTamari, udade wakhe.
Ke ngoko, nkosi yam ukumkani, musa ukucinga ukuba oonyana bakho bonke bafile; u-Amnon kuphela ophile.
Ke kaloku uAbhisalom wabaleka. Unyana omncinane ohlala engqongileyo waphakamisa amehlo akhe, wathi, Ndibona abantu abaninzi besiya phantsi kwendlela ngasemngciphekweni womnqamlezo emva kwakhe.
Wathi uYonadabu kukumkani, Yabona, bafika oonyana bakakumkani; njengoko umkhonzi wakho etshoyo, ke ngoko.
Ke kaloku, xa egqibile ukuthetha, bafika oonyana bakakumkani, belilindela ngelizwi elikhulu; ke kaloku ukumkani nabazalwana bakhe bonke balilindela ngelizwi elikhulu.
Ke kaloku uAbhisalom wabaleka, waya kuTalmai, unyana ka-Amihudi, ukumkani waseGeshure. UDavide wayemlindela unyana wakhe mihla le.
Ke kaloku uAbhisalom wabaleka waya eGeshuri, waba khona iminyaka emithathu.
Ke kaloku intliziyo kakumkani uDavide yafuna ukuphuma kuAbhisalom; ngokuba wayevumile ngokufa kuka-Amnon.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi, unyana kaSeruya, wazi ukuba intliziyo yokumkani ifuna uAbhesalom.

Wathumela ke uYowabhi eTekoa, wazisa khona indoda enobulumko; wathi kuye, Nceda, yenza ukuba ungumkakhe, ugqoke iimpahla zokumkakhe, ungasebenzisi nantoni na yokuthambisa; yenza ukuba ungumkakhe, ube ngumkakhe umntu owafa ixesha elide.
Ke kaloku, ungaye ukumkani, uthethe kuye la mazwi. Wathi ke uYowabhi kuye yonke into athethayo.
Wafika ke umfazi waseTekoya kuye ukumkani, wahlangula ngobuso bakhe ehlabathini, wanikela, wathi, Ndincede, ukumkani wam.
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Yintoni loo nto? Waphendula wathi, Ndiyindoda eyimfama; umfazi wam ufile.
Mna, umkhonzi wakho, ndaba nonyana ababini; babhidekela emehlweni ehlabathini, kwakungekho mntu ubalazelayo phakathi kwabo; omnye wabetha omnye, wambulala.

Ke kaloku, intsapho yonke iguqukile kumkhonzi wakho, besithi, Nceda unikezele lo mzalwana obulalayo umzalwana wakhe, ukuze siwufune ngenxa yokufa komzalwana wakhe; ngoko ke, siya kususa nomnini. Bafuna ukucima isiqhamo sethemba elisiseleyo kum, ukuba bashiye umfazi wam ngaphandle kwegama, nokuba akukho namnye oza kuthatha intsapho yakhe phezu komhlaba.
Wathi ukumkani kumkakhe, Yiya ekhaya lakho; ndiza kukunika imiyalelo yokulinda.
Wathi umfazi waseTekoya kukumkani, Nkosi yam, ukumkani, intlungu ihlale kum, nendlu yoyise wam; ke ukumkani nobhedu lwakhe bahlale bekhululekile.
Wathi ukumkani, Ukuba umntu uthetha nawe ntoni na, mnikele kum; akazukukuxhaphaza ukundi kwakhona.

Wathi ke yena, Nceda ukuba ukumkani abize iNkosi uThixo wakho, ukuze lo mntu ofuna ukuxolela angaphinde asuse umphefumlo wakhe, amfaze unyana wam. Wathi ukumkani, Ngokuqinisekileyo, uphila iNkosi, iinwele zesiphelo somntwana wakho aziyi kugwa ehlabathini;
Wathi ke umfazi, Nceda ukuba umkhonzi wakho athethe olunye ulwimi nokumkani ukumkani wam. Wathi, Yiya.
Wathi umfazi, Kutheni na ke ukuba uthathe isigqibo esinjalo kubo bonke abantu bakaThixo? Ukuba uthetha loo nto, wena uya kugweba ngokwakho; ngokuba awuzange uyise unyana wakho, owawuthutha.

Ke kaloku, thina bonke siya kufa; sifana namanzi aqhutywa phezulu ehlabathini, angafunyanwa kwakhona; kodwa uThixo akawususanga umphefumlo wakhe ngokulula; ke yena usenza iindlela, ukuze umntu othunyelwe ahlale engaphelelanga kum.
Ndiye ndafika nditsho naloo nto kukumkani, nkosi yam; kuba abantu baya kundixhalabisa. Ndathi ke, Ndiya kuthetha nokumkani; mhlawumbi uya kwenza oko ndisithiyo.
Kungenzeka ukuba ukumkani uya kumxelela, amkhusele kumntu ofuna ukunicima mna nonyana wam kuloo mhlaba uThixo awise kuthi.
Ndathi ke, Ilizwi lenkosi yam ukumkani liza kumnika uxolo; kuba iNkosi yam ukumkani ifana nesithunywa sikaThixo, ekwaziyo ukuchaza okulungileyo nokubi. UYehova uThixo wakho abe nawe.
Wathi ukumkani kumfazi, Musa ukufihla kum nantoni na endiya kukubuza yona. Wathi umfazi, Utsho nkosi yam ukumkani.

Wathi ukumkani, UYowabhi na owenza ezi zinto zonke kuwe? Waphendula umfazi wathi, Ngokuba ubomi bakho buphilayo, nkosi yam ukumkani, akukho mntu unokutshintshela ngasekunene okanye ngasekhohlo kuzo zonke izinto ozithethayo; kuba nguYowabhi umkhonzi wakho lowo wamxelela ukuba ndikwenze oku, wabeka amazwi onke emlonyeni wam.
Umkhonzi wakho uYowabhi wenza loo nto, ukuze atshintshe izinto; kodwa inkosi yam inengqondo efana nesithunywa sikaThixo; wena uyazi zonke izinto ezibangelwa emhlabeni.
Wathi ukumkani kuYowabhi, Kulungile; ndiya kwenza oko. Yiya uyambuyisele lo mntwana uAbhisalom.

Ke kaloku uYowabhi wehla ngobuso bakhe phantsi ehlabathini, wathandaza, wabambisa ukumkani. Wathi uYowabhi, Namhlanje ndiyazi ukuba unenhlanhla kum, nkosi yam ukumkani, ngokuba wenze into endithenzileyo.
Wavuka ke uYowabhi, waya eGeshuri, wambuyisela uAbsalom eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi, Ahambe endlwini yakhe; asiyi kumbona mna. Waphuma ke uAbhisalom endlwini yakhe, akawuboni ukumkani.
Ezweni lonke likaSirayeli, kwakungekho namnye obizwa ngokuba nguAbhisalom ngenxa yobuso bakhe obuhle; ukususela phantsi kweenyawo zakhe ukuya phezulu kwentloko yakhe, akukho mntu wayebi kuwo.

Ke kaloku wamisa iinwele zakhe ngomnyaka mnye, ekugqibeleni konyaka ngamnye; ngokuba zazinzima kakhulu kuye. Wazilinganisela ke iinwele zakhe awazilungisayo, zathi ziyishumi elinambini leeshekeli, ngokwesiqhelo sokumkani, ezimalunga neekhilogram ezilishumi elinambini.
UAbhisalom wayeneentombi ezintathu nendodana enye; igama lenkosikazi yakhe nguThamari, waba ngumkakhe omhle.
Wahlala ke uAbhisalom eYerusalem iminyaka emibini iphela, angabonanga ukumkani.
Wathumela ke uAbhisalom wabiza uYowabhi, ukuba amthumeli kukumkani; kodwa uYowabhi akazange afike kuye. Wathumela ke uAbhisalom wambiza kwakhona, naye akazange afike.
Wathi uAbhisalom kubakhonzi bakhe, Khangelani, indawo kaYowabhi ikwindawo yam, nalapho ekhula khona iswele; niyifake emnqamlezweni. Babeka ke abakhonzi bakaAbhazilomu emnqamlezweni emnqamlezweni.
Wafika ke uYowabhi endlwini ka-Abhesalom, wathi kuye, Kutheni na ukuba abakhonzi bakho batshise imithi yam?

Waphendula uAbhisalom uYowabhi, wathi, Ndithumelele umyalezo, ndithi, Yiya apha; ndathi ndikuthumelele kukumkani, ndithi kuye, Kutheni na ukuba ndabuya ukusuka eGeshuri? Kungcono kum ukuba ndihlale khona. Ke ngoko, vumelani ndibone ukumkani; ukuba kukho nantoni na endinokuyenza, amfaze.
Wafika ke uYowabhi ukumkani, wamxelela. Ukumkani wabiza uAbhisalom; waya ke uAbhisalom, wenyuka phantsi ngobuso bakhe ehlabathini phambi kokumkani; ukumkani wamxolela uAbhisalom.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, uAbhisalom walungiselela izithuthi zokulwa, namakhwenkwe, nabafazi abamashumi mahlanu abahamba phambi kwakhe.

Wavuka ekuseni, wahlala ecaleni kwendlela yokungena emzini. Ke kaloku, xa umntu efika nomthetho kukumkani, uAbhisalom wambiza wathi kuye, Uvela kumzi phi na wena? Waphendula ke lo mntu wathi, Ndisuka kwintsapho yamaSirayeli.
Wathi ke uAbhisalom kuye, Yabona, imeko yakho ilungileyo nenyaniso; kodwa akukho namnye kukumkani oza kukuxelela.
Wathi ke uAbhisalom, Ndinqwenele ukuba ndibe ngumgwebi kuloo lizwe; ukuze wonke umntu onetyala, necala, afike kum, ndimnike ilungelo lakhe.
Ke kaloku, xa kungekho mntu wafika ekumhlangula, uAbhisalom wayalela isandla sakhe, wamthabatha, wamxolisa.
Wakwenza njalo uAbhisalom kuwo onke amaSirayeli, afikayo kukumkani ukuba agwetywe; waza wahlambalaza intliziyo yabantu bakaSirayeli ngale ndlela.
Ke kaloku, emva kweminyaka emashumi mane, uAbhisalom wathi kukumkani, Nceda, ndiye eHebron, ndifeze idini endilile iNkosi.
Ke mna, umkhonzi wakho, xa ndihlala eGeshure, eAram, ndenze idini elisithi, Ukuba iNkosi uya kundibuyisela eYerusalem, ndiya kumkhonza iNkosi.
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Yiya ngoxolo; wavuka ke, waya eHebron.
Ke kaloku uAbhisalom wathumela abathunywa ngokufihlakeleyo kuzo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, esithi, Xa niza kuva isandi sebhokhwe, nitshoni, UAbhisalom ungukumkani eHebron.
Kwaya noAbhisalom amadoda angamakhulu amabini eYerusalem; babethethwa ukuba batyelele, baye besuka bekhululekile, bangazi nto ngaloo nto.

Ke kaloku, xa uAbhisalom esenza izibingelelo, wathumela uAhitofele waseGilo, umcebisi kaDavide, ukuba afike emzini wakhe, eGilo. Waqhubeka ke lo mzekeliso unamandla, abantu benyuka benyuka besuka kuAbhisalom.
Ke kaloku kwafika umthunywa kuDavide, esithi, Intliziyo yabantu bakaSirayeli itshintshile ekumkani uAbsalom.

Wathi ke uDavide kubo bonke abakhonzi bakhe ababe naye eYerusalem, Nciphisani, sihambe; kuba akusayi kubakho namnye kuthi oza kuphulukana noAbhisalom. Yiya khawuleza, ukuze asikufikele ngokukhawulezayo, anikele ilahleko phezu kwethu, abulala abantu bedolophu ngeqhwa.
Baphendula ke abakhonzi bakakumkani, besithi, Nantoni na ithethayo inkosi yethu ukumkani, bona abakhonzi bakho.
Waphuma ke ukumkani, nosapho lwakhe lonke lwamlandela; washiya amadoda amakhulu akhe alishumi, ukuba agcine indlu yakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani waphuma, namadoda onke amlandelayo; bamisa ekhayeni elincinane.

Bonke abaphathi bakhe badlula phambi kwakhe, nabo bonke amaKherethi, namaPhelethi, oovimba bakakumkani; nabo bonke abakwaGiti abangamakhulu amathandathu, ababemlandela eGathi, badlula phambi kukakumkani.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi kuItayi waseGiti, Uza kuphi na ukuba uhambe nathi? Yiya, uhlale nokumkani omtsha; wena ungumkhenkce, uthunyelwe ezweni lakho. Yiya kwindawo yakho.

Uthe wafika namhlanje; ndingakushiya njani ukuba uhambe nathi namhlanje, xa andiyazi na apho ndiya kungena khona? Buyela uthabathe nabo abazalwana bakho nawe; iNkosi akubonise ububele bakhe nobuxoki bakhe.

Waphendula ke uItayi ukumkani, wathi, Uphila iNkosi, nokuphila iNkosi yam ukumkani, ukuba naphi na apho iNkosi yam ukumkani ekhoyo khona, nokuba kukuphila, nokuba kukufa, umkhonzi wakho uya kubakhona.
Wathi uDavide kuItayi, Yiya ngaphambili, uhambe. Wahamba ke uItayi waseGethi, naye wonke umntu wakhe, nabantwana bonke ababenoye;
Ke kaloku bonke abantu belizwe bavuma ngelizwi elikhulu, xa bonke abantu bedlula. Ukumkani wadlula emlanjeni weKidron; bonke abantu ke badlula ekungeneni kwesiqithi.

Ke kaloku uTsadoki wayekhona, nabaLevi bonke naye, bethwala ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaThixo; babeka phantsi ibhokisi kaThixo, uAbhiyatare ke wanikela izibingelelo, de bonke abantu bagqibe ukuphuma emzini.
Wathi ukumkani kuTsadoki, Yibuyisele isithunywa sikaThixo kumzi; ukuba iNkosi ethandazela kum, uya kundibuyisela, andibonise isithunywa sakhe nendawo yayo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba uthi, Andithandabuzi ngawe; ngoko ke, apha mna; akwenze kum oko kulungileyo emehlo akhe.
Wathi ke ukumkani kuTsadoki umbingeleli, Awunguye na umbona, umntu obona izinto azenzayo uThixo? Yiya ubuyela emzini ngoxolo, wena noAhimahazi unyana wakho, noYonathani unyana kaAbhiyatare.
Ndiya kuphumla kumngxunya womlambo, entlango, de ndifumane umyalezo kuwe, ndindixelele into ekhoyo."
Ke kaloku uSadoko noAbhiyatare babuyisela ibhokisi kaThixo eYerusalem, babehlala khona.

Ke kaloku uDavide wanyuka waya emnqamlezweni weeOyile, ecula xa wayehamba; ikhanda lakhe laliqhotywa, waya emehlweni avulekileyo. Nabo bonke abantu ababenoye baliqhotywa iinwele zabo, bathandaza behamba.
Ke kaloku kwathiwa kuDavide, esithi, UAhitofele ungumnye wale ndoda ifuna ukubulala noAbsalom. Wathandaza ke uDavide, wathi, Nkosi, nceda uyenze inyaniso ingcebiso kaAhitofele.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide efike esiphelweni senduli, apho abantu bethandaza khona kuThixo, yabona uHushayi umArki ufika ukuhlangabezana naye, iingubo zakhe zirhoxisiwe, nethutyana liphezulu kwakhe.
Wathi uDavide kuye, Ukuba uya kuhamba nam, uya kuba ngumthwalo kum.

Ke ukuba ubuyela emzini, usithi kuAbhisalom, Ndiya kuba ngumkhonzi wakho, ukumkani wam; ndandisebenza kuyise wakho, kodwa ngoku ndiya kusebenza kuwe; ngoko ke uya kundinceda wena, ube yingozi kwicebiso lika-Ahitofele.
Bakho nawe apho uTsadoki noAbhiyatare, oombingeleli; thetha nabo zonke izinto ozivayo endlwini kakumkani.
Bona, oonyana babo ababini bakhona nabo: nguAhimahazi unyana kaSadoko, noYonathan unyana kaAbhiyatare; bathumelele kuni nantoni na niyivayo.
Wafika ke uHushai, umhlobo kaDavide, emzini, xa uAbhisalom efika eYerusalem.

Ke kaloku, xa uDavide egqithile ngaphezu komgangatho womnqamlezo, yafika iTsiba, umkhonzi kaMephiboshethi, wamfumana, eneeeseyile ezimbini eziqengqelelwe phezu kwazo, zithabatha izitya zesonka ezingamawaka amabini, neentyatyambo zamatye angamawaka amabini, neziqhamo zasehlotyeni ezingamawaka amabini, nesakhelo esigcwele iwayini.

Wathi ukumkani kuTsiba, Zithini ezi? Waphendula uTsiba wathi, Iinkunzi zeegusha ziye zaba yindlu kakumkani ukuba zihambe kuyo; isonka neentyatyambo zasebusika ziye zaba ngukutya kwamadoda amancinci; iwayini ke ibe yintyatyambo yomntu onyukileyo emlanjeni ukuze asele.
Wathi ukumkani, Uphi unyana wenkosi yakho? Waphendula uTsiba ukumkani wathi, Yabona, uhlala eYerusalem; kuba uthi, Namhlanje abantwana bakaSirayeli baya kundibuyisela ubukumkani bukayise wam.
Wathi ukumkani kuTsiba, Zonke izinto zikaMephiboshethi zinikwe kuwe. Wathi uTsiba, Ndiyakunqula phambi kwakho; mna ke ndize ndenze intliziyo yakho ithande, nkosi yam ukumkani.
Wafika ke ukumkani uDavide eBhahurim, yaphuma kumzi indoda yendlu kaSawule; igama layo nguShimehi, unyana kaGera; wayala uDavide xa wayephuma.
Wabetha amatye uDavide, nabaphathi bonke bakakumkani uDavide; ke bona bonke abantu, namadoda anamandla, aye ngasekunene nokwesokudla kukaDavide.
Ke kaloku, uShimeyi ecula, wathi, Phezu, phezu, mntu obulalayo, mntu ongenasono!

UYehova uyasibuyisela kuwe igazi lonke lendlu kaSawule; nawe wathatha indawo yakhe, waba ngukumkani; ngoko ke iNkosi wamnika ubukumkani uAbhisalom unyana wakho. Yabona ke, uphelile ngenxa yobubi bakho, ngokuba ungumfazi!
Wathi uAbhishai, unyana kaSeruya, kukumkani, Yintoni na loo ndoda ifileyo, ukuba inqumle inkosi yam, ukumkani? Ndize ndihambe ndiyitshise intliziyo yakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi, Kuthini na oku kuni, nina oonyana baka-Seruya? Ukuba mna uyamcaphukisa, ngokuba iNkosi wamxelela ukuba amcaphukele uDavide, ngubani na oza kumbuza, Uyenza njani le nto?

Wathi uDavide kuAbhishayhi, nakwamadoda akhe onke, Unyana wam, igazi lam nenyama yam, ufuna ukundibulala; ngoko ke, ngaphezu koko, lo mntu waseBhenjamin unesizathu sokwenza oku. Musani ukumnqula; kuba iNkosi wathi kuye.
Kungenzeka ke ukuba iNkosi abone isono sam, amnike izinto ezilungileyo ngenxa yesalathiso sam ngale mini.
Wahamba ke uDavide namadoda akhe ngendlela. UShimehi wayehamba ngaphaya komthi ecaleni lakhe, ecula, ehamba, ebetha iithayile kuye, ebetha umgubo emanzini.
Wafika ukumkani, namadoda onke ahamba naye, ethambileyo kakhulu; waza waphumla khona.
Ke kaloku uAbhisalom, namadoda onke aseSirayeli, bafika eYerusalem; noAhitofele naye.
Wafika ke uHushai, umhlobo kaDavide, waseArki, kuAbsalom, wathi kuye, Ukumkani uphile; ukumkani uphile.
Wathi uAbhisalom kuHushayi, Ingaba le yindlela oyibonisa ngayo inyaniso kumhlobo wakho? Kutheni na ukuba awuhambenga nomhlobo wakho?
Wathi uHushai kuAbhisalom, Hayi; mna ndiya kuba ngumntu okhethiweyo nguYehova, ngale ndoda, namadoda onke aseSirayeli; ndiya kuba naye.
Ke kaloku, ndiwukhonze ngubani na? Ndiwukhonze njani unyana? Ngokuba ndimkhonze ubaba wakho, ndiya kukukhonza nawe.
Wathi ke uAbhisalom ku-Ahitofele, Ucebise kuthi; siyenze ntoni na?

Wathi uAhitofele kuAbsalomu, Yibele nabafazi-ngcobo bakayise wakho, awashiyayo ukuba bagcine indlu; ke baya kufunda bonke amaSirayeli ukuba uya kuba ngumsindo kuyise wakho; nabo bonke abakhoyo kuwe baya kuhlala benamandla.
Bamisa ke uAbhisalom itente phezu kophahla lwendlu kakumkani; walala ke uAbhisalom nabafazi-mkhosi bakayise, phambi kwamehlo ooSirayeli bonke.
Ke kaloku icebiso lika-Ahitofele, elifumeneyo ngaloo mihla, lathathwa njengelizwi livela kuThixo; ngoko kwathiwa nguDavide noAbsalom ngazo zonke iincam zika-Ahitofele.
Wathi ke uAhitofele kuAbsalom, Ndiya kukhetha amadoda amawaka amabini anamashumi mabini, ndihambe ndimlandele uDavide ngaloo busuku.
Ndiya kungena kuye, xa elahlekile, ethambileyo; ndiya kumkhulisa; bonke abantu bakhe baya kubaleka; ndimbulala ukumkani kuphela.
Ndiya kukubuyisela abantu bonke kuwe; xa umntu ohamba emva kwakho efile, baya kubuyela bonke abantu; abantu bonke baya kuhlala bephumle.
Ke kaloku le nto yabonakalisa uAbhisalom, namadoda amakhulu onke aseSirayeli.
Wathi ke uAbhisalom, Nceda nimwise noHushayi umArki; siza kuva into athethayo.
Wafika ke uHushai, wathi kuye uAbhisalom, UAhitofele wanikela isigqibo esinjalo; kufuneka siyenze ntoni na? Ukuba akunjalo, siyazise isigqibo sam.
Wathi uHushai kuAbsalom, Icebiso elinike lona uAhitofele ngalo mzuzu alulungile.

Wathi ke uHushayhi, Uyazi uyise wakho namadoda akhe, ukuba banamandla okulwa; baba ngamandla amakhulu, njengokuba iinkunzi zeegusha zilahliwe; noyise wakho ungumntu ozimeleyo; akayi kuphumla nomkhosi.

Ke kaloku, mhlawumbi ngoku sele efihlakele entolongweni, okanye kwelinye ilizwe; ukuba ke bafa abantu bakho ekuqaleni kokulwa, umntu owaziyo loo nto uya kuthetha wathi, Abakhonzi baka-Absalom babulawa.
Ke kaloku umkhosi onamandla, onobubele obufana nelili; ngenxa yokuba bonke amaSirayeli bayazi ukuba ubaba wakho ungumntu onamandla, namadoda akhe anamandla.
Ke kaloku, ndicebisa oku: Zihlanganiseni kuni bonke amaSirayeli, ukususela eDan ukuya eBher-shebha, njengengxowa yentlabathi ecaleni kolwandle ngokuninzi kwayo; nibaqhubele wena emfazweni.
Siya kuhlasela uDavide apho afumaneka khona, siza kungena kuye njengokuba umhlwa ehla emazulwini; akukho namnye kubo oza kuhlala, uDavide namadoda akhe onke.
Ke kaloku, ukuba efika emzini na, bonke amaSirayeli baya kuzisa iintsontelo kumzi lowo, siwukhuphele phantsi emlanjeni, ukuze ashiye khona iithayile ezincinci.

Wathi ke uAbhisalom, namadoda onke aseSirayeli, Icebiso likaHushai umArkiya lingcono kunecebiso lika-Ahitofele. Ke kaloku iNkosi wagqiba ukuba aphucule icebiso elilungileyo lika-Ahitofele, ukuze iNkosi aphumeze intlungu ku-Abhisalom.
Wathi ke uHushai kuTsadoki noAbhiyatare ababingeleli, UAhitofele wacebisa uAbhisalom namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli ukuba bakwenze oku; mna ndabacebisa ukuba benze oko.

Ke ngoko, thumela ngokukhawuleza umyalezo kuDavide, usithi kuye, Musa ukuphumla ngemini ezindaweni zokudlula emlanjeni, ezweni elimnyama; vuka udlule umlambo ngokukhawuleza, ukuze kungaphelelanga oko ukumkani nabantu bakhe bonke.
Ke kaloku uYonathani noAhimahazi babelindela eEn-rogeli; ke kaloku wayeya umkhonzi, wabaxelela; ke kaloku babeya bamxelela ukumkani uDavide; ukuze bangabonakali befika emzini.
Wababona ke umntu omncinci, wamxelela uAbhisalom. Bahamba ke bona ababini ngamandla, bafika endlwini yomntu othile eBhahurim; wayenamanzi acocekileyo entlango yakhe, baba phantsi kuwo.
Wathabatha umfazi waloo mntu isikhuseli, wasithambisa phezu komngxunya wevundla, wasithambisa ingqolowa ngaphaya kwayo; akukho namnye wayeyazi ukuba kukho.

Bafika ke abakhonzi baka-Abhisalom kumkakhe endlwini, besithi, Aphi na uAhimahazi noYonathani? Waphendula umkakhe wathi, Baye badlula emlanjeni. Baya kukhangela amadoda abo, awawafumananga; baya kubuyela eYerusalem.

Ke kaloku, emva kokuba amadoda ahambe, uAhimahazi noYonathan baphuma kwimpumlo, beya kubaxelela ukumkani uDavide. Bathi kuye, Yiya uxelele umlambo ngokukhawuleza; ngokuba uAhitofele wenza icebiso kuwe.
Wavuka ke uDavide, namadoda onke ahamba naye, wadlula umlambo iYorodani; kwathi xa ilanga liphuma, bonke bafikelela eJordana.

Ke kaloku, xa uAhitofele ebona ukuba icebiso lakhe alisebenziswanga, wamisa isikhephe sakhe esinqeni, waya ekhaya lakhe, emzini wakhe; walungisa izinto zakhe, wabanjwa; waza wafa, wafunyanwa entlango kayise.
UDavide waya eMahanayim; uAbhisalom ke wadlula umlambo iJordan, yena namadoda onke aseSirayeli.

Ke kaloku uAbhisalom wamisa uAmasa waba ngukumkani womkhosi, endaweni kaYowabhi. UAmasa ke wayengumntwana womntu okuthiwa nguYitra, umSirayeli, owayenomkakhe uAbihayeli; yena wayeyintombi kaNahashi, inkosikazi kaSeruhiya, uyise kaYowabhi.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli noAbhisalom bamisa isikhephe ezweni laseGiliyadi.
Wafika ke uDavide eMahanayim, noShobhi unyana kaNahashi osuka eRabha yamaAmoni, noMakiri unyana kaAmiyeli osuka eLodebari, noBarzilayi osuka eRogelem yaseGiliyadi.
bathabatha izibhedi, nezitya, neengxowa zomhlaba; bathabatha ingqolowa, nesheyile, nesonka, nesiqhamo esitshiziweyo, neentyatyambo, neentyatyambo ezishiziweyo,

ingqolowa, nebhotolo, neentyatyambo, nekheyi yenyama yenkomo, ukuze uDavide namadoda aye naye aphile. Bathi ke: Kulungile ukuba abantu babe nesifo sokutya, babe buhlungu, babe noxinzelelo olukhulu lwegazi kuloo mfula.
Ke kaloku uDavide wababala amadoda aye naye, wabeka abathetheli kumawaka, namawaka amakhulu.

Wathumela amaqela amathathu; uYowabhi waba ngukumkani weqela elinye, noAbhisaya unyana kaSeruya, umzalwana kaYowabhi, waba ngukumkani weqela elinye, noItayi waseGiti waba ngukumkani weqela elinye. Ukumkani wathi kubo, Ndiza kuphuma ndihamba nani.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuye, Musa ukuphuma; kuba ukuba sihambe, baya kusikhathalela; nokuba isiqingatha sethu sifa, baya kusikhathalela; kodwa wena ufana namawaka amabini ethu. Kungcono ke kuwe ukuba uhlale kuloo mzi, ulungiselele ukusithumela uncedo.
