Wathi kubo ukumkani, Ndiya kwenza oko kulungileyo emehlweni am. Ukumkani ke wahlala ecaleni kwesango ledolophu; lonke ilizwe laphuma ngamakhulu namakhulu amawaka.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wamisa uYowabhi, noAbhishai, noItayi, wathi, Mna ngenxa yam, mnikele lo mntwana uAbhazimeleki. Bava oonyana bonke bakakumkani besithi, Ukumkani ubeka loo myalelo kumadoda amakhulu ngoAbhazimeleki;
Ke kaloku iqela likaDavide laphuma ezweni, lihlasela amaSirayeli; lo mdlalo waqhutywa emthini kaEfraim.
Ke kaloku iqela lakwaSirayeli lahlaselwa khona ngamadoda kaDavide; kwabulawa abantu abaninzi kakhulu ngaloo mini, amadoda amawaka amashumi mabini.
Ke kaloku ukulwa lwasasazeka phezu kwelizwe lonke; umthi wabulala abantu abaninzi ngaloo mini, kunaleyo ikrele labulala ngayo.

Ke kaloku kwathiwa uAbhisalom wadibana namadoda kaDavide. Wahamba uAbhisalom ngengulube yakhe, ingulube yafika phantsi kweengcango eziqinileyo zemithi enkulu ye-oak; ikhanda likaAbhisalom lalibanjwa emthini, waza washiyakaliswa entliziyweni yenqanawa, ibe ingulube yayihamba.
Wakubona umntu omnye, waxela uYowabhi, wathi, Ndabona uAbhisalom ethe tyaba emthini we-oyile.
Wathi uYowabhi kulowo wamxelela loo nto, Wakubona na? Ngoko ke, kutheni na ukuba ungamtyhila khona phantsi ehlabathini? Ndiya kukunika iisekeli ezilishumi zesilivere nobukhoboka.

Wathi lo mntu kuYowabhi, Nakuba ndinikezwe amawaka eeshekeli zesilivere, andiyi kuphakamisa isandla sam kumntwana kakumkani; thina sonke sazi ukuba ukumkani wamwisela umthetho wena noAbhishayhi noItayi, esithi, Musani nabani na ukumbulala lo mntwana uAbsalom.
Ukuba ndenza ntoni na kukumkani, ndibulala unyana wakhe, ngoko ke ukumkani wayeza kuyiqonda loo nto; kuba akukho nto ifihlakeleyo kumkani; nizange mncede.
Wathi uYowabhi, Andiyi kuchitha ixesha nawe. Ke kaloku wathabatha iinqanawa ezintathu esandla sakhe, waza wazisa entliziyweni ka-Abhisalom; wayesephila ke, ehleli emnqamlezeni.
Ke kaloku amantombazana alishumi, anesithuthi sikaYowabhi, ajikeleze uAbhisalom, ambetha, wambulala.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi waphucula isidumbu; abantu bakhe babuyela ekufumaniseni amaSirayeli, ngokuba uYowabhi wabathintela.
Bathabatha uAbhisalom, bawuthutha emthini, ekungeneni komngxunya omkhulu, bewumisa phezu kwakhe umquba omkhulu weetafile; ke bonke amadoda aseSirayeli athabathela endlwini yawo.

UAbhisalom, xa wayephila, wamisa isibonda selitye kuye, eNtaba kakumkani; wathi ke, Andinayo intombi yokugcina igama lam liphilile. Wabiza ngoko igama lesibonda ngegama lakhe; ibizwa ngokuba yi-Eloyim-abhesalom, ukuya kusasa.
Wathi ke uAhimaazi, unyana kaTsadoki, Ndiya kuhamba ndithuthe iindaba ezilungileyo kukumkani, ukuba iNkosi wamsindise ebantwini bakhe.
Wathi kuye uYowabhi, Awunakuba ngumthunywa weendaba namhlanje; ungayenza ngenye imini, kodwa akunjalo namhlanje, ngokuba unyana kakumkani wafa.
Wathi ke uYowabhi kumntu waseKushi, Yiya, uxelele ukumkani into oyibonayo. Uthe lo mntu waseKushi wehla phambi kukaYowabhi, wabaleka.

Ke kaloku uAhimahazi, unyana kaTsadoki, waphinda wathi kuYowabhi, Nakuba kwenzeka ntoni na, mna ke ndiya kuhamba emva komntu waseKushi. Wathi uYowabhi, Unyana wam, kutheni na ukuba uhambe? Akuyi kubakho umvuzo kuwe ngenxa yeendaba ezi.
Waphendula wathi, Nakuba kwenzeka ntoni na, ndiya kubaleka. Wathi uYowabhi, Uhambe! Wahamba ke uAhimahazi ngendlela yesiqithi, wadlula umntu waseKushi;

Ke kaloku uDavide wayehlala phakathi kweengcango zangaphakathi zesixeko, neengcango zangaphandle. Umgcini-ntloko wanyuka waya ephahleni lesango elunxwemeni, wajonge, wathi, Yabona umntu ohamba phantsi.
Watsho umgcini, wamxelela ukumkani. Wathi ukumkani, Ukuba ungumntu othile kuphela, ngoko ke uya kuzisa iindaba ezilungileyo. Wafika ke lo mqhubi, waqhubeka ehamba.
Ke kaloku umgcini wesango wabona umntu omnye ehamba; wambiza ke umgcini wesango, wathi, Yabona, kukho umntu omnye ehamba ngokwakhe. Wathi ukumkani, Ngokuqinisekileyo yena uzisa iindaba.
Wathi umgcini, Ndicinga ukuba lo mntu ophambili ubaleka njengoAhimahazi unyana kaTsadoki. Wathi ukumkani, Ngumfazi olungileyo; ngokuqinisekileyo uya kuzisa iindaba ezilungileyo.

Ke kaloku uAhimahazi wabiza ukumkani, wathi, Kulungile. Wagquma phambi kokumkani ngobuso bakhe ehlabathini, wathi, Usindise iNkosi uThixo wakho; ngenxa yokuba wanikela abantu abasuka emlonyeni womlawuli wam.
Wathi ukumkani, Umntwana uAbhisalom uphilile na? Waphendula uAhimahazi wathi, Ndabona umsindo omkhulu, xa umkhonzi wakho uYowabhi wayemthumela; kodwa andiyazi ukuba yintoni.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi, Yiya ngaphaya, uhlale apha. Wahamba ke, wahlala khona.
Wafika ke lo mntu waseKushi, wathi, Izindaba ezilungileyo kukumkani nkosi yam; namhlanje iNkosi ukusindise ebusweni bakho bonke abavukayo kuwe.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi kumntu waseKushi: UAbsalom, lo mntwana uphilile na? Waphendula umntu waseKushi, esithi, Bonke abagxeki benkosi yam ukumkani, nabo bonke abavukayo ukukwenza okubi kuwe, babe ngaye loo mntwana.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakhathazeka kakhulu, wanyuka waya egumbini elingaphezulu kwesango, watshola; wayehamba ke wathi, Unyana wam uAbhisalom! Unyana wam, unyana wam uAbhisalom! Ndiyakuthanda ukuba ndifa endaweni yakho! UAbhazilomo, uyise wam, uyise wam!
Ke kaloku kwaziswa uYowabhi, kwathiwa, Itsho ukumkani ukuba ulilila, ulele ngoAbhesalom.
Ke kaloku uzuko lwaluguquka lube ngumbulelo kulo lonke iqela ngaloo mini; kuba abakhonzi babeva abantu besithi, Ukumkani ubulawe ngunyana wakhe.
Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini, abakhonzi bafika edolophini bephumla, njengabakhonzi abaxhaphakileyo, ngenxa yokuba baphume emfazweni.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wafihla ubuso bakhe, wayalela ngelizwi elikhulu, esithi, Unyana wam uAbhisalom, uAbhisalom, unyana wam, unyana wam.

Wafika ke uYowabhi endlwini kukumkani, wathi, Uye waphazamisa namhlanje bonke abantu bakho; nabo basindise ubomi bakho namhlanje, nempilo yabantwana bakho, nempilo yeentombi zakho, nempilo yamabhinqa akho, nempilo yabakhonzi bakho.

Uthanda abo bakuxolelayo, uthobela abo bakuxolelayo; nawe wabonisa namhlanje ukuba abathetheli bakho namagqwetha akho bengabikho nto kuwe. Ndiyabona ke, ukuba uAbhisalom wayephila namhlanje, thina sonke sifile, uya kuba mnandi.

Ke ngoko, vuka ngoku, uphume, uncede abantu bakho; kuba ndithi ngeNkosi, ukuba awusayi kuphuma, akuyi kubakho namnye umntu ohlala nawe ngaloo busuku. Oku kuzakuba kukubi kuwe kunazo zonke iintlungu ozifumanayo ukususela ekubeni ungumntwana wakho de kube ngoku.

Wavuka ukumkani, wahlala emnyango wedolophu. Bathi ke kubo bonke abantu, besithi, Ukumkani uhlala emnyango wedolophu; bafika kuye bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli. Ke kaloku bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli babethuka baya kumakhaya abo.

Bathi ke abantu, ngazo zonke iintlanga zakwaSirayeli, bethetha phakathi kwabo, besithi, Ukumkani usindisile ebantwini bethu ababi; wasisikhusela kumadoda aseFilisti; kodwa ngoku waphuma ezweni ngenxa ka-Abhisalom.
Ke kaloku uAbhisalom, owathi sawuphakisa ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu kwethu, wafa emfazweni; ngoko ke, kutheni na ukuba akukho namnye othethayo ukubuyisela ukumkani?

Ke kaloku ukumkani uDavide wathumela kuTsadoko noAbhiyatare, ababingeleli, esithi, Nibuze oonyana bakaYuda, nithi, Yintoni na ukuba ningaba bagqibeleleyo ekubuyeni kukakumkani endlwini yakhe? Ndiziva zonke izinto athetha ngazo amaSirayeli onke, zokubuya kukakumkani ekhaya lakhe.
Niyindodana yam, ninyama yam, nigazi lam; kutheni na ke ukuba nibe bagqibelele ekubuyiseleni ukumkani?
Nithi ku-Amasa, Uyinyama yam negazi lam wena; uThixo akwenze njalo, amnike okungakumbi, ukuba ndiya kukumisa ubukumkani bomkhosi wam, endaweni kaYowabhi.
Ke kaloku uDavide watsala intliziyo yamadoda onke aseYuda, babe ngamalungu eqela elinye; bathumela kukumkani, besithi, Yiya kwakhona, wena nabasebenzi bakho bonke.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wabuyela, waya kumlambo iJordan. Bafika ke amadoda kaYuda eGalgali, ukuba ahlangane nokumkani, ukuze amqhubele ngaphezu kweYordana.
Ke kaloku uShimeyi, unyana kaGera, wesizwe sikaBhenjamin, owayehlala eBhahurim, wakhawuleza waya phantsi namadoda aseYuda, ukudibana nokumkani uDavide.

Waye naye amadoda amawaka eBhenjamin; noTsiba, umkhonzi wendlu kaSawule, wayekhona naye, naye oonyana bakhe abalishumi elinamihlanu, nabakhonzi bakhe ababini namashumi mabini. Baye bakhawuleza befika eYordan, ukuba bahlangane nokumkani.
Ke kaloku, xa ukumkani efuna ukudlula iYordan, uShimeyi unyana kaGera waba phantsi phambi kwakhe. Wathi ke uSirayeli: "Ukumkani uya kudlula iYordan, kodwa akayi kubakho into enokuyenza."

Wathi kukumkani, Mna nkosi yam, mnikele uThixo, ungandikholele nto; musa ukukhumbula ukuba umkhonzi wakho wenza ntoni na embi ngaloo mini waphuma ngayo eYerusalem. Nceda unciphise loo nto emlonyeni wakho.
Mna umkhonzi wakho ndiyazi ukuba ndenze isono; ngoko ke, mna namhlanje ndiya kuqala phakathi kwezizukulwana zonke zikaYosefu, ukuba ndikhuphe ndihlangane nokumkani unkosi wam.
Wathi ke uAbhishai, unyana kaSeruya, Akufanelekanga na ukuba uShimehi afile ngaloo nto? Wayiphulaphula inyaniso ukumkani okhethiweyo nguYehova.
Wathi uDavide, Kuthini na oku kuni, nina oonyana bakaSeruya? Kutheni nisebenza njengabathunywa bam namhlanje? Ingaba mna ndiyazi ukuba namhlanje ndiya kuba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli?
Wathi ke ukumkani kuShimeyi, Awuyi kufa ngokuqinisekileyo. Ukumkani ke wamnikela umnqophiso.

Ke kaloku uMephiboshethi, unyana kaSawule, waya phantsi ukuhlangabezana nokumkani; akazange ahlanze izandla zakhe, agcine inwele yakhe, ahlamba izihlangu zakhe, ukususela ngaloo mini awayephuma kuyo ukumkani, waya kuloo mini wabuya ekhuselekile.
Ke kaloku, xa efika eYerusalem ukuhlangabezana nokumkani, ukumkani wathi kuye, UMephiboshethi, kutheni na ukuba ungabi nam?
Waphendula ke wathi, Inkosi yam ukumkani, umkhonzi wam wandixolela; ndathi, Yibangeni isikhephe sebhokhwe, ndihambe nokumkani; ngokuba mna, umkhonzi wakho, ndenzakele.
Ke kaloku, nkosi yam ukumkani, uSiba wamxelela ubuxoki malunga nam; kodwa nkosi yam ukumkani ufana nesithunywa sezulu sikaThixo; wenze oko kulungileyo emehlo akho.

Wonke usapho lukayise wam alufanelekanga ngaphezu kokufa phambi kwenkosi yam, ukumkani; ke wena wawundibeka phakathi kwabo bedla ekhitshini lakho. Ndinelungelo ntoni na ukuba ndifune okuninzi kukumkani?
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Uthetha ntoni na ngoku? Ndithe ndagqiba ukuba wena noTsiba nihlukanise ilizwe phakathi kwenu.
Wathi uMephiboshethi kukumkani, Athabathe onke la mandla; kuba mna ndinelanga ukuba inkosi yam ukumkani iye endlwini yakhe ngoxolo.
Ke kaloku uBarzilayi waseGiliyadi waya phantsi eRogelim, wafika nokumkani eYordan, ukuba ahambe naye.
Ke kaloku uBarzilayi waba mkhulu kakhulu, eneminyaka esibhozo asibhozo. Waye walungiselela ukumkani isonka, xa wayehlala eMahanayim; ngokuba wayengumntu onamandla kakhulu.
Wathi ukumkani kuBarzilayi, Yiya nam eYerusalem; ndiya kukukhonza khona.
Waphendula ke uBarzilayi ukumkani, Wathi, Yintoni inani leminyaka yobomi bam, ukuba ndiyalele nokumkani eYerusalem?

Ndineminyaka engamashumi asibhozo ndiphilayo namhlanje; ndingathi na ukuba ndiyazi into elungileyo nento ebi? Ingaba umkhonzi wakho unokuzonwabisa isonka sakhe nesiselo sakhe? Ndingathi na ukuba ndiyiva ingoma yabafazi nabafazi? Ngaba umkhonzi wakho kufuneka abe ngumthwalo omkhulu kukumkani, nkosi yam?
Umkhonzi wakho uya kudlula ngento encinci iJordan nokumkani; kutheni ke ukuba ukumkani amnike umvuzo onjalo?

Nceda uvumele umkhonzi wakho ukuba ahambe, ukuze ndifa edolophini yam, phantsi kwengqungquthela yoyise wam nodade wam. Ke kaloku, mna umkhonzi wakho uKimham; yena ahambe nokumkani ukumkani wam, wenze kuye oko kulungileyo phambi kwakho.
Waphendula ukumkani wathi, UKimham uya kuhamba nam; ndiya kukwenza kuye konke okulungileyo entliziyweni yakho; nantoni na oyicelayo kum, ndiya kukuyenza.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu badlula iJordan, ukumkani ke wadlula. Ukumkani wamxolela uBarzilayi, wamsindisa; wabuyela uBarzilayi endlwini yakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani waya eGalgali, wahamba naye uKimham; bonke abantu bakaYuda, nengxenye yabantu bakaSirayeli yahamba nokumkani.

Bathe ke bonke amadoda aseSirayeli afika kukumkani, athi kuye: Kutheni na ukuba bazalwana bethu, amadoda aseYuda, athabathe ukumkani? Kutheni na ukuba athabathe ukumkani nosapho lwakhe, naye onke amadoda kaDavide, adlule iJordan?

Baphendula amadoda onke aseYuda amadoda aseSirayeli, bathi, Ngokuba ukumkani ungumhlobo wethu; kutheni na ke ukuba nixhaphake ngaloo nto? Siye sadla ntoni na isonka sikakumkani? Usinike ntoni na umvuzo?

Baphendula oonyana bakaSirayeli oonyana bakaYuda, besithi, Siyinxalenye yesixhenxe yokumkani, siyinxalenye kaDavide ngaphezu kwenu; kutheni na ke ukuba nithuthuzele nathi? Asikubi na thina abakuqala ukuthetha ngokubuyisa ukumkani wethu? Ke kaloku oonyana bakaSirayeli bathetha ngamandla kakhulu kunamadoda aseYiputa.

Ke kaloku, kwathikho khona umntu owenza umonakalo, igama lakhe nguSheba, unyana kaBikri, wesizwe sikaBhenjamin; waphucula intonga, wathi, Asinanxalenye nathi kuDavide, asinanxalenye nonyana kaYese. Yiya endlwini yenu, niSirayeli.
Basuka ke bonke amadoda aseSirayeli eDavide, balandela uSheba unyana kaBikri. Ke kaloku amadoda aseYuda ahlala nokumkani wabo, ukususela eJordan waya eYerusalem.

Ke kaloku, xa uDavide ebuyela ekhaya lakhe eYerusalem, wathabatha oonyana bakhe abalishumi abewashiya ukuba bagcine indlu yakhe, wababeka endlwini yokhuselo; wabanika isonka, kodwa akazange abuyele kubo. Bagcinwa befihlakele kude kube yimini yabo yokufa, bephila njengeenkosikazi.
Wathi ke ukumkani kuAmasa, Zibophelela amadoda aseYuda ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezintathu, nawe ube apha.
Wahamba ke uAmasa, ukuba abambe amadoda aseYuda; wathatha ixesha elide kunaleyo ukumkani wamwisela.
Wathi uDavide kuAbhishai, USheba, unyana kaBhikri, uya kwenza nathi okubi kakhulu kunaye uAbsalom; chukua abantu bam, uye emva kwakhe, ukuze angangeni emizini enezindlu eziqinileyo, aze aphume kuthi.
Baphuma ke amadoda kaYowabhi, namaKherethi, namaPhelethi, namadoda amakhulu onke eYerusalem noAbhishai, ukuba alandele uSheba unyana kaBikri.

Ke kaloku, bafika befike kwilitye elikhulu eGibheyon, kwathi uAmasa waya kudibana nabo. UYowabhi ke wayegqoke iimpahla zakhe zemfazwe, nebhanti emqolo wakhe, nekrele elincamathela emlonyeni wakhe; xa wayehamba phambili, ikrele laphuma.
Wathi uYowabhi kuAmasa, Uthini na, ndodakazi yam? Wathabatha ke uYowabhi ngesandla sakhe sokunene iinwele zikaAmasa, ukuba azame ukumxola.

Ke kaloku uAmasa akazange aqaphele isigwebo esikwisandla esisodwa sikaYowabhi; ke uYowabhi wambetha emlonyeni wakhe, zaphuma izitho zakhe ehlabathini. UYowabhi akaphinde ambetha, waza wafa uAmasa. Walandela ke uYowabhi noAbhishai umzalwana wakhe uSheba unyana kaBikri.
Ke kaloku, omnye wabafazi bakaYowabhi wahlala ecaleni kukaAmasa, wathi, Nabani na osuka kuYowabhi, nabani na osuka kuDavide, alandele uYowabhi.

Ke kaloku uAmasa wayelele ephakathi kwendlela, ejikeleza emlonyeni wakhe. Wabona ke lo mntu ukuba bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli bahlala bejonge; wathabatha ngoko umzimba ka-Amasa waya kumgama wendlela, waya kwisiqithi, wabeka phezu kwawo iingubo; kuba bonke abahambayo babehlala.
Ke kaloku, xa beyikhuphe ecaleni kwendlela, bonke amadoda alandela uYowabhi, alandele uSheba unyana kaBikri.
Ke kaloku uSheba wadlula kuzo zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, waya eAbeli naseBhat-maakani; wadlula kuwo wonke ummandla wamaBheriti; badibana bonke, bamlandela.
Bafika oonyana bakaYowabhi, bagubungela uSheba eAbeli yeBhete-Maaka; balungiselela umngxunya womhlaba phezu kodonga lomzi. Baqala bonke oonyana bakaYowabhi ukubetha lodonga, ukuba lugwebe.
Ke kaloku, kwaphuma umbhinqa owaziyo esuka emzini, wathi, Ncokolani! Ncokolani! Nithi kuYowabhi ukuba afike apha, ndithethe naye.
Wafika ke uYowabhi, wabuza umfazi wathi, Ingaba wena uYowabhi? Waphendula wathi, Ndiye. Yathi kuye, Yiva into ethetha ngayo umkhonzi wakho. Waphendula wathi, Ndiyiva.
Wathi, Kuye kwathiwa ngelo xesha lidlulileyo, Yiya, ubuze uAbhiyele; ke ngoko bagqibezela ingxaki yabo.
Sibantu abathembekileyo, abanobulungisa eSirayeli; ke nina nifuna ukucima lo mzi, onokuba ngumama eSirayeli. Nifuna ntoni na ukuba nesonka esiyindlu kaYehova?
Waphendula uYowabhi wathi, Akuyi kubakho nto; andinakukutya nantoni na, andizukucima nantoni na.

Ayikho loo nto; kuba umntu okuthiwa nguSheba, unyana kaBhikri, ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim, wahlasela ukumkani uDavide; mnikeni yena nje, ndiya kuphuma kumzi. Wathi lo mfazi kuYowabhi, Intloko yakhe iya kuthuthwa kuwe ngapha kwedonga.

Waye ke loo mfazi kubo bonke abantu, esebenzisa ubulumko bakhe; bathabathe intloko kaSheba unyana kaBhikri, bayithutha kuYowabhi. UYowabhi waphucula intsimbi, amadoda akhe aphuma emzini, aye ekhaya lakhe. Wabuyela uYowabhi kumkani eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi waba ngukumkani kumkhosi wonke wamaSirayeli; noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada waba ngukumkani kumaKherethi namaPeleti.
Ke kaloku uAdoniram waba ngukumkani wemisebenzi yomsebenzi; uYoshafati unyana ka-Ahilodi waba ngumphathi weencwadi.
USheva wayengumbhali wokumkani; uSadoko noAbhiyatare babe ngababingeleli.
Ke kaloku uIra waseYaire waba ngumbingeleli kaDavide, umphathi omkhulu.

Ke kaloku, ngexesha lokumkani uDavide, kwabakho indlala iminyaka emithathu elandelelanayo. Wabuza ke uDavide iNkosi ngaloo nto; wathi iNkosi, NguSawule nosapho lwakhe le nto, kuba babulala abantu, ngokuba uSawule wababulala abaGibeyoniti.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wababiza abaGibheyoniti, wathetha nabo. (AbaGibheyoniti ababengabaSirayeli; babesisihlwele sabaAmori; ke kaloku amaSirayeli ayewatyhila ngenyameko ukuba awashiye; kodwa uSawule wayefuna ukuwacima, ngenxa yobubele bakhe bokunceda ooSirayeli noYuda.
Wathi uDavide kubo abaGibheyoniti, Ndingakwenza ntoni na kuni? Ndiyilungise njani loo nto ingalunganga, ukuze nibhaptize abantu bakaThixo?
Baphendula ke abaGibheyoniti kuye, bathi, Asifuni isilivere okanye igolide kuSawule nosapho lwakhe; asifuneki na ukuba sibulala umntu eSirayeli. Wathi uDavide, Ndiya kwenza konke okuthethayo.
Baphendula ke ukumkani, bathi, USawule wayefuna ukusibulala; wacinga ukuba asiphelise, ukuze singabikho ndawo naphi na eYiputa.
Nceda ke, ninikele kuthi amadoda akhe asixhenxe; siza kuwatshisa phambi koYehova eGibhebha, emzini kaSawule, emzini womntu iNkosi awiseleyo. Wathi ukumkani, Ndiya kubanikela.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wamkhusela uMephiboshethi, unyana kaYonathani, unyana kaSawule, ngenxa yegunya labo lababini, likaDavide noYonatan, elingaphambili kukaThixo.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wamthabatha uArmoni noMephiboshethi, oonyana ababini bakaRispa intombi kaAhiya, ababemzala uSawule; wabathwala nabo oonyana abahlanu bakaMerab intombi kaSawule, ababemzala uAdriyeli unyana kaBarzilayi waseMehola.
Wabanikela engqondweni yabaseGibheyoni, babatshisa emnqamlezweni phambi koYehova. Bafa bonke aba sababini ngaxeshanye; bafa ngemihla yokuqala yokuvuna, xa kuqaliswa ukuvuna iswele.

Ke kaloku uRispa intombi ka-Ayiya, wathabatha isakhelo, wayimisa phezu kodonga. Wahlala khona ukususela ekuqalekeni kwexesha lokuvuna, de kube lihla imvula phezu kwabo; akazange azivumele iintlanzi ukuba zihlale phezu kwabo mihla le, namadoda amabi entlango afike kubo ngemini.
Ke kaloku kwathiwa kuDavide into ayenzeyo uRispa, intombi kaAhiya, umkhonzi-mfazi kaSawule.

waya, wazisa kumaSirayeli abahlala eYabheshi-gileyadi iinwele zikaSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe; kuba babezikhupha ngokufihlakeleyo ezindleleni zeBhete-shan, apho abaFilisti bebazikhonze khona, emva kokuba babulala uSawule emnxwemeni weGilboa.
Wazisa khona uDavide iinwele zikaSawule noYonatan, unyana wakhe; bathabathe nakwiinwele zamadoda asixhenxe athengisiweyo.

Bazifihla iinwele zikaSawule noYonatan unyana wakhe, kwisibingelelo sikaKishi uyise kaSawule, eTsela, ezweni likaBhenjamin; basenza konke oko ukumkani wabawisela umthetho ngawo. Ke kaloku waphendula uThixo imithandazo yabo ngelizwe.
Waqhubeka umkhosi phakathi kwamaFilisti namaSirayeli; wahla uDavide, yena namadoda akhe, ukuba ahlasele amaFilisti; waza walahleka kakhulu.
Ke kaloku uIsbhi-benob, omnye wabafazi bakaRafayeli, wayenombhobho wesikhephe sentsimbi obunzima bayo buyishumi elinambini leshekeli; wagqoka izithuthi ezintsha, waza wafuna ukumbulala uDavide.

Ke kaloku uAbhishai, unyana kaSeruya, waya kumkhusela uDavide; wabetha lo mFilisti, wambulala. Bathi ke abantu bakaDavide kuye, Uza kuphuma nathi emfazweni ngonaphakade; kuba wena ungusibane samaSirayeli, asiyi kutshisa isibane saso.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, kwabakho ukulwa kwakhona nabaFilisti eGobhi. Wathi ke uSibhekayi waseHusha wabulala uSafe, omnye wabafazi abakhulu.

Ke kaloku, kwabakho ukulwa kwakhona namaFilisti eGobhi, uElhanan unyana kaYare-oregim waseBhetelehem wabulala umzalwana kaGoliyathi waseGathi; isithunywa sakhe sakuba siqinile, safana nentambo yoboya.

Kwabakho ukulwa kwakhona eGathi; kwakukho khona umntu omde, obeneempawu ezisixhenxe ngesandla ngasinye, nezixhenxe ngenyawo ngalinye, ezimashumi mabini anane zonke. Waye ke lowo waba ngumntwana wamaGhathi.
Ke kaloku, xa wayemxolela uSirayeli, uYonathan, unyana kaShimehi, umzalwana kaDavide, wambulala.
Aba bane bazalwa ngamagqwetha eGati; wababulala ke uDavide namadoda akhe.
UDavide wayalela iNkosi amazwi alo ingoma, ngaloo mini iNkosi wamsindisa kuwo onke amaxhama akhe, noSawule.
Wathi, UYehova ngudonga lwam, Inqaba yam, Umsindisi wam.
UThixo ngudonga lwam, ndiya kubaleka kuye; Umgquba wam, umsindisi wam onamandla, Inqaba yam ephakamileyo, indawo yam yokhuselo. Umsindisi wam, uyandikhusela kumntu onegunya.
Ndiya kubiza iNkosi, Owufanele wonke umnqamlezo; Ndiye ndakhuselwa kumagosa am.
Iinqanawa zokufa zandijikelezisa, Iilwandle zezinto ezinobungozi zathi zimi phezu kwam, Zandikhathaza.
Izibophelelo zesibhedlele zazingqubuthela phantsi kwam; Iintaka zomphefumlo zabekwa phambi kwam.
Kwingxowa-mali yam, ndabiza iNkosi; KwaThixo wam, ndatsho; Esuka endlwini yakhe wava lizwi lam; Uxolo lwam lwafika ezindlebeni zakhe.
Ke kaloku ihlabathi latshixiwa, lajika-jika; Iziseko zezulu zatshixiwa, zajika-jika, ngokuba waxoka.
Umlilo wawuphuma emlonyeni wayo, Umnxeba womlilo wawuphuma emlonyeni wakhe; Iikhabhoni zomlilo zaphuma kuye.
Wavula izulu, wahla; Iimvula ezimnyama zaphantsi kweenyawo zakhe.
Wahamba phezu kwezinto eziphilayo, wabaleka; Wanyuka phezu kwamaphiko omoya.
Wazigubungela ngokwakhe ngokukhanya, njengokuba yitentile, Ngeenkungu ezimnyama zemvula, neengqungquthela zomoya.
Ukusuka kukukhanya okujikeleze kuye, iinkuni zomnqamlezo ezitshisayo zaphuma.
UYehova wabetha ngethutyana emazulwini, Ilizwi likaThixo oNkulu laziwa.
Wakhupha amasuntswana akhe, wabaphazamisa abathunywa bakhe; Wathumela umbane, wabaphazamisa.
Ke kaloku kwabonakala phantsi kolwandle, zafunyanwa iziseko zehlabathi; Xa iNkosi ethetha ngesandla sakhe esiqinileyo, Ngomoya womoya osuka emlonyeni wakhe.
Wamisa isandla sakhe ukusuka phezulu, wamthabatha; Wamtsala elwandle olukhulu.
Wamkhusela kumnqamlezo wam onamandla, Kubo abandichukumisayo; Kuba babenamandla ngaphezu kwam.
Bendihlasela ngemini yam yoxinzelelo, Ke kaloku iNkosi wandixhasa.
Wamkhupha kwindawo ebanzi nevulekileyo, Wamkhulula ngenxa yokuba wayethandana nam.
UYehova wandihlawulela, ngokuba ndenze okulungileyo; Wandibuyisela ngenxa yokuba izandla zam zicocekile.
Kuba ndizilandele iindlela zikaYehova; Andiyi kwenza into elungileyo, Ndisuka kuThixo wam.
Ndizigcina zonke izigqibo zakhe phambi kwam; Andisukanga kwimimiselo yakhe.
Ndiye ndaba mkhulu phambi kwakhe, Ndazikhusela kude nesono.
Ke kaloku, iNkosi undihlawulela ukuba ndiyenze into elungileyo; ngokuba wabona ukuba izandla zam zicocekile.
Kubo bakholwayo, nibonisa ukuba nithembekile; kubo abangenangxakini, nibonisa ukuba ningenangxakini.
Kubantu abacocekileyo, ubonisa ukuba ucocekile; Ke kubantu abakhohlakeleyo, ubonisa ukuba unobulumko.
Usindisa abantu abaphantsi; Amehlo akho ajonge abo baphakamileyo, ukuze ubakhuphe ezantsi.
UYehova, wena ungusibane sam; iNkosi uya kuqaqambisa ubumnyama bam.
Ndiya kuhlasela umkhosi ngesandla sakho; Ndiya kukhupha idonga ngoThixo wam.
Indlela kaThixo igqibelele, Ilizwi likaYehova licocekile, libe yinyani; Uyisigqubuthelo kubo bonke abahamba kuye ukuba bakhuselwe.
Kuba ngubani na uThixo, ngaphandle kukaYehova? Naphi na ilitye, ngaphandle koThixo wethu?
UThixo ngudonga lwam olunamandla, Uyenza indlela yam igqibelele.
Iinyawo zam zenza ukuba ziqiniseke, njengeenyawo zemvu; Ndizibeka ndikhuselekile kwiindawo eziphakamileyo.
Uqeqesha izandla zam ukuba zidlale ukulwa, ukuze imisipha yam ibambe umtya wentsimbi.
Wandinika isikhuselo sakho esisindisayo; Uncedo lwakho oluhle lwamenza ndikhulu.
Wayenza indlela ebanzi imilenze yam; Akukho mqolo wam oza kuphuma.
Ndazilandela iintshaba zam, ndaziphelisa; Andiyi kubuya, ndenza ukuba ziphele.
Ndiya kubasusa, ndibakhupha phantsi, ukuze bangavumi ukuvuka; bawela phantsi kweenyawo zam.
Undinika amandla empilweni, Ukwenza ukuba abo baphulaphuli bam baphumle phantsi kwam.
Wababuyisela ngasemva abathunywa bam, bahambe; Ndawacima abo bendimxolelayo.
Bafuna uncedo, kodwa akukho mntu ubasindileyo; bathandaza kuYehova, kodwa akawaphendulanga.
Ndabatyhila ngathi ngumgubo wehlabathi, ndabatyhala phantsi, ndabatyhola phantsi, njengamabala edolophini.
Uyandikhusela, xa abantu bam bendihlasela; Wamgcina ndibe ngukumkani weemfazwe; Abantu endibangawaziyo basebenza kum.
Iintlanga zihlambulule phambi kwam; Xa zithe zazi ukuba ndikhona, zandithobela.
Amazwe aphezu komhlaba aphulukana nobubele babo, Baphuma ezindaweni zabo ezifihlakeleyo.
Uphila iNkosi, libe lihle ilitye lam; Lihlolwe uThixo, ilitye losindiso lwam.
UThixo lowo uyambuyisela kum abachasi bam, Wabeka iintlanga phantsi kwam.
Uyamkhulula kum abathunywa bam, Wamkhupha phezulu ngaphaya kwabo bendihlaselayo; Wamkhusela ebantwini abanobuxoki.
Ke mna ndiya kukubonga, Yehova, phakathi kwezizwe; Ndiza kuvuma igama lakho.
Uyamnika ukumkani wakhe ukusindisa okukhulu, Ukwenza ububele kumkumkani wakhe okhethiweyo, KuDavide nosapho lwakhe kude kube xesha elide.
Ezi zizinto zakutshanje zikaDavide. Ilizwi likaDavide, unyana kaYese, lo mntu uphakamileyo kuThixo, ukumkani okhethiweyo kuThixo kaYakobi, umbhali wengoma emnandi kaSirayeli:
Umphefumlo kaYehova uthetha phantsi kwam, Ilizwi lakhe lisenelwimi lwam.
UThixo kaSirayeli uthetha, Ilitye likaSirayeli lithi kum, Ngukumkani olawula ngenyameko abantu, olawula ngokholo kuThixo;
njengokukhanya kwemini, xa liphuma ilanga, kusasa ngaphandle kwamafu; njengokukhanya kwemini emva kwemvula, okubangela ukuba kukhule iziqhamo ezitsha ehlabathini.

UThixo akazange enze njalo kusapho lwam? Wakwenza nam umnqophiso ohlala ixesha elide, ulungelelaniswe ngokugqibeleleyo, uqinisekileyo; wagqiba ukusindisa kwam, wamnika zonke izinto endizifunayo. Akayi kuzikhula na?
Ke kaloku abantu ababi bafana neentyatyambo eziqhutywayo, Akukho mntu unokuzikhupha ngezandla zakhe.
Nabani na oza kuwatshisa, kufuneka asebenzise isixhobo sentsimbi, okanye umbhobho wesikhephe; baya kuqhutywa emnqamlezweni apho belala khona.
Lemi ke amagama amadoda amakhulu kaDavide: uYoshebhi-bhashebhethi, umTakemoni, waba ngukumkani wamapolisa; igama lakhe lalinguAdino umEzeniti. Wabulala amadoda amawaka asibhozo ngaxeshanye.

Ke kaloku ecaleni kwakhe uEleyazare, unyana kaDodayi, umAhohiya; yena wayeyenye yamadoda anamandla amathathu abe noDavide, xa bedibana nabaFilisti abathe bahlangane ukubhiyozela intshayelelo. Amanye amaSirayeli ke ayemva.

Ke kaloku uEleyazare wamisa isandla sakhe, wababulala amaFilisti, de kube lixakekile isandla sakhe, sathi sithethwa nekrele lakhe. Wakwenza iNkosi usindiso olukhulu ngaloo mini. Baye babuyela kuye kuphela ukuba bathathe abafayo.
Ecaleni kwakhe kwakukho uShama, unyana ka-Agaye, umHariti. Ke kaloku abaFilisti bahlangana ndawonye, apho kukho isiqhamo esigcwele iinkomo; amaSirayeli ke abaleka phambi kwabo.
Ke kaloku uShama wahlala phantsi phakathi kwesiqithi, wayikhusela; wababulala abaFilisti. UYehova wamnika usindiso olukhulu.
Ke kaloku, ngexesha lokuvuna, bahla abathathu phakathi kwabathetheli abamashumi mathathu, bedibana noDavide ekufumaneni ibhotwe lika-Adullam; kwathi amaFilisti athabathe inqaba emlanjeni wamaRefayim.
Ke kaloku uDavide wayesesikhuselweni; abaFilisti ke bagcina iBhetelehem.
Ke kaloku uDavide wafuna kakhulu, wathi, Kungenjalo ukuba kubekho umntu oza kumnika amanzi okusela ebhedini yaseBhetelehem ekwisango.

Ke kaloku, abo bantu bathathu abanamandla anamandla baphucula umkhosi wamaFilisti, bathabathe amanzi emlanjeni okwisango laseBhetelehem, bamthabatha waya kuDavide. Wathi ke uDavide akafuni ukuwasela, wawutywina umnikelo kaYehova.

Wathi, Nkosi yam, andizukuyisela loo nto; kuba iyafana negazi laba bantu, abathe bamisela ubomi babo ukuba bayithathe. Ke kaloku akayikeli loo nto. Lezo zezinye zeempawu zobulungisa zamadoda amakhulu amathathu.
UAbhishai, umzalwana kaYowabhi, unyana kaSeruya, waba ngukumkani wabo bathathu. Wasebenzisa isigwebo sakhe, wahlasela abantu abamakhulu mathathu; waba negama phakathi kwabo bathathu.
Waba ngudumo olukhulu kubo bathathu, waba ngukumkani wabo; ke kaloku akazange abe ngumnye kubo bathathu.

Ke kaloku uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada, waba ngumntu onamandla eKabseyeli, wakwenza izinto ezikhulu; waza wabulala amadoda amabini anamandla eMowabhi. Wawela ke emngxunyeni ngemini yekhephu, wabulala ilili.
Wabulala ke umYiputa omkhulu kakhulu; wayenesikhongo esikwisandla sakhe. Waye yena uBhenaya, ephethe intambo kuphela; wathabatha isikhongo esikwisandla somYiputa, wambulala ngesikhongo sakhe.
Ezi zizinto ezinamandla azenzayo uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada; waba negama phakathi kwabalinganiswa abathathu.
Waye mkhulu kunabo bamashumi mathathu, ke kaloku akazange abe ngabanye abathathu. UDavide wambeka phezu kwabakhuseli bakhe.
Aba bathathu: uAshayeli, umzalwana kaYowabhi; noElhanan, unyana kaDodo waseBetheleyimu;
uShama waseHarodi, noElika waseHarodi;
uHelezi wasePhati, noIra unyana ka-Ikeshe waseTekoya;
noAbhiezer waseAnathothi, noMebunnai waseHushathi,
uSalmon waseAhohini, noMaharayi waseNetofa,
uHelebe unyana kaBhana waseNetofa, noItayi unyana kaRibhai waseGibeha eBhenjamin;
uBhenaya wasePirathoni, noHidayai osuka kumagqabi eGashe,
uAbhi-Albon waseArbati, noAzmawete waseBarhumi,
uEliyaba waseShaalboni; oonyana bakaYashen, noYonatan;
uShama, umHarithi; uAhiyamu, unyana kaShera, umHariti;
uElifeleti, unyana kaHashabhayi, umMaakathi; uEliyam, unyana kaAhitofele, waseGilo;
uHezero waseKarmele, noPahari umArbiti,
uIgali unyana kaNathane waseZobha, noBani umGadi;
uSeleki umAmoni, noNaharayi waseBherothi, othwala izithuthuthu zikaYowabhi unyana kaZeruya;
uIra umYithrithi, noGarebhi umYithrithi,
noUriya, umHeti; bonke babe ngamathathu anamashumi asixhenxe anesibhozo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waqhubeka eqaqamba ngamadoda aseSirayeli, wamkhumbuza uDavide ngaye; wathi kuDavide, Yiya ubabala amadoda aseSirayeli neYuda.
Wathi ke ukumkani kuYowabhi, umphathi womkhosi, owakho naye, Yiya uhambe zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli, ukususela eDan ukuya eBher-shebha, ubabalo abantu, ndikwazi ukuba bangaphi.
Wathi uYowabhi kukumkani, UYehova, uThixo wakho, azidibanise abantu ngamashumi amawaka; ibe ubomi bokumkani, mna ukumkani, buphila; kodwa kutheni na ukuba umkani, mna ukumkani, afune ukwenza oku?
Ke kaloku umyalelo kakumkani wawunamandla kunaye uYowabhi, namadoda amakhulu emkhosini. Waphuma ke uYowabhi namadoda amakhulu emkhosini phambi kokumkani, waya kubala abantu bakaSirayeli;
Badlula umlambo iYorodani, bamisa iintombi eAroyeri, emzantsi-ntshona womzi, phakathi kwelali kaGadi; bafika ke eYazeri.
Ke kaloku bafika eGiliyadi, nelizwe lamaTathimi amaHodshi; badlula ke eDani-Yaani, bejikeleza iSidon.
Baye bafika kwindlu ekhuselekileyo yaseTire, nakwiidolophu zonke zabaHivi, nabaKanani; bafika ke eBher-shebha, elunxwemeni lwaseYuda.
Ke kaloku, emva kokuba behambe ilizwe lonke, babuyela eYerusalem, emva kweentsuku ezisibhozo neentsuku ezimashumi mabini.
Wathi uYowabhi kukumkani inani lamadoda; kwaba ngamaSirayeli amawaka angamakhulu asibhozo, anamandla okulwa ngekrele; kwaba ngamaYuda amawaka anamanci amahlanu.

Ke kaloku, emva kokuba uDavide ebala abantu, intliziyo yakhe yaphazamiseka. Wathi uDavide kuYehova, Ndiphelele kakhulu ngaloo nto ndiyenzeyo; ke ngoku, Nkosi yam, mna, mna, mna, mna, mna, mna, mna, mna, mna, mna, mna, mna, mna!
Ke kaloku, phambi kokuba uDavide akhulele kusasa, kwafika ulizwi likaYehova kuGadi umprofeti, umbona kaDavide, lisithi,
Yiya, uthethe noDavide, usithi, Itsho iNkosi ukuba, Ndikunikela phambi kwakho izinto ezintathu; khethe enye yazo, ndiyikwenze kuwe.

Wafika ke uGadi kuDavide, wathi kuye, Ingaba kufuneka kubekho iminyaka esixhenxe yobhubhane ezweni lakho? Ingaba kufuneka uhambe inyanga ezithathu phambi kwamagosa akho, aze akulandelele? Ingaba kufuneka kubekho imihla emithathu yentsholongwane ezweni lakho? Nceda ucinge ngoku, ubone ukuba ndiya kumphendula njani lowo wandithumelelayo.
Wathi uDavide kuGadi, Ndikwimeko engalunganga; sithi, sithabathele esandlani sikaYehova; ngokuba ububele bakhe buninzi; ke mna ndithabathele esandlani komntu.
Wathumela iNkosi izifo ezibulalayo kumaSirayeli, ukusukela ngaloo mhla, waya kwixesha awayelibeka; bafa abantu abamashumi asixhenxe amawaka, ukusuka eDan ukuya eBheshireba.

Ke kaloku, xa isithunywa sakhupha isandla sakhe sokuvala iYerusalem, iNkosi waxolisa ngenxa yale ngozi; wathi ke esithunywani esivalayo abantu, Kulungile! Nciphisa isandla sakho. Iingelosi zikaYehova zaye zikwindawo yokuhlambela ka-Aronwa umYebhusi.

Wathi uDavide kuYehova, xa ebona isithunywa esibulala abantu, Ndiye mna owenzayo isono, ndiya kwenza into engalunganga; ke bona abantu bafana neentyatyambo. Bayenze ntoni na? Nceda, usindise mna nosapho lwam!
Wafika uGadi kuDavide ngaloo mini, wathi kuye, Yiya phezulu, ugxininise isibingelelo kuYehova kwindawo yokuhlambela ka-Aronha umYebhusi.
Wanyuka ke uDavide, njengoko wathethayo uGadi kuye, njengokuba iNkosi wamwiselayo.
Ke kaloku u-Aronah ejonge, wabona ukumkani nabasebenzi bakhe befika kuye. Waphuma ke u-Aronah, waba phantsi phambi kokumkani ngobuso bakhe phezu kwehlabathi.

Wathi ke uAronah, Yintoni eyenza ukuba inkosi yam ukumkani ifike ibone umkhonzi wakhe? Waphendula uDavide wathi, Ukuthenga indawo yakho yokuhlamba iziqhamo, ukuze ndenze isibingelelo kuYehova, ndithintele lo mkhuhlane obulala abantu.

Wathi uAronwa kuDavide, Inkosi yam, ukumkani, thathe konke okunqwenelekayo engqondweni yakho, uyilungiselele; jonga, iinkunzi zeenkomo zomnikelo wokufa; jonga, iibhodi zokutyisa, neengxowa-ntliziyo zeenkunzi zeenkomo zokusetyenziswa njengemithi.
Ukumkani wam, mna uAronah, ndizinika zonke ezi zinto kukumkani. Wathi ke uAronah kukumkani, UYehova uThixo wakho athande idini lakho.

Wathi ke ukumkani ku-Aronah, Hayi, ndiya kukuhlawula; andizukunikela kuYehova uThixo wam izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, ezingabikho xabiso kum. UDavide wathenga igumbi lokuhlambela, neenkomo, ngeshekeli zesilivere ezimashumi mahlanu, ezimalunga neshumi elinanye legram.
Wakha uDavide khona isibingelelo kuYehova, wanikela khona izipho eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezipho zoxolo. Waphendula ke iNkosi umthandazo wakhe ngenxa yelizwe; isifo sayeka ukufa kwabaSirayeli.
1Kgs: Ke kaloku ukumkani uDavide waba mkhulu kakhulu; abakhonzi bakhe bamgubungela izitya, akakwazi ukufudumeza.

Bathi ke kuye abakhonzi bakhe, Sifunane nomphathi wethu ukumkani umfazi omncinci, ongatshatanga, ukuba asebenze phambi kokumkani, amkhathalele, aze aphumle phantsi kwakho, ukuze umphathi wethu ukumkani ashushuke.
Ke kaloku bafuna umkakhe omhle kuwo onke amaSirayeli; bafumanisa uAbhisaga, umShunemi, bamthabatha kuye ukumkani.
Ke kaloku unyana womfazi wayemhle kakhulu; wamkhathalela ukumkani, wayamkhonza; kodwa ukumkani akazange amfumane.

Ke kaloku uAdoniya, unyana kaHagithi, umkakhe uDavide, waba mkhulu, wathi, Ndiya kuba ngukumkani. Wazilungiselela ke izithuthi zokulwa, nabaqhubi bamabhayisikili, namadoda amashumi amahlanu ahamba phambi kwakhe.
Ke kaloku utata wakhe akazange amxelele, esithi, Yintoni le into oyenzayo? Waye nobuso obuhle kakhulu; waza wazalwa emva kuka-Absalom.
Wathetha ke uAdoniya noYowabhi, unyana ka-Seruya, noAbhiyatare umbingeleli; balandela yena, banceda.
Ke kaloku uSadoko umbingeleli, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, noNathan umprofeti, noShimehi noReyi, namadoda amakhulu kaDavide, akazange abe nguAdoniya.

Ke kaloku uAdoniya wanikela iinkomo, nezimvu, neenkomo ezityebileyo, phantsi kwelitye likaZoheleti, elunxwemeni lwaseRogeli; wababiza bonke abazalwana bakhe, oonyana bakakumkani, nabakhonzi bonke bakakumkani baseYuda.
Ke kaloku uNathane umprofeti, noBhenaya, namadoda amakhulu, noSolomon unyana wakhe, awawabizanga.
Wathetha ke uNathane kuBhatshebha, umzali kaSolomon, esithi, Awazi na ukuba uAdoniya, unyana kaHagithi, wenza ngokwakhe ukumkani; inkosi yethu uDavide akayazi nto?
Ke ngoko, ndiza kukunika ingcebiso, ukuze usindise ubomi bakho, nokuphila kukaSolomon unyana wakho.

Yiya ungene kukumkani uDavide, usithi kuye, Nkosi yam, ukumkani, awuzange uthini na umnqophiso kum, uthi, USolomon unyana wakho uya kuba ngukumkani emva kwam, yena athabathe isithsaba sam? Kutheni ke ukuba uAdoniya abe ngukumkani?
Ke kaloku, xa ukhona uthetha khona nokumkani, mna ke ndiya kungena emva kwakho, ndikuxelele into oyithethayo.
Ke kaloku uBhatshebha waya kukumkani ekamelweni lakhe. Ukumkani ke waba mkhulu kakhulu; uAbhisaga, umShunemi, wayemkhonza.
Ke kaloku uBhatshebha wahlangula, waya kumkumkani. Wathi ukumkani kuye, Ufuna ntoni?
Wathi kuye, Mna nkosi yam, uthini na? Uthi, USolomon, unyana wakho, uya kuba ngukumkani emva kwam; yena uza kuphumla kwisithsaba sam.
Ke kaloku ngoku, bona, uAdoniya ungukumkani; wena ke, nkosi yam ukumkani, awuyazi loo nto.
Wabhiyozela iinkomo, neenkunzi zeegusha, nezimvu, ezininzi Usisono; wabiza bonke oonyana bakakumkani, noAbhiyatare umbingeleli, noYowabha umphathi womkhosi; kodwa umkhonzi wakho uSolomon akawubiza.
Ke kaloku, nkosi yam ukumkani, iinwele zakwaSirayeli zonke zijonge kuwe, ukuba ubaxelele ukuba ngubani na oza kuphumla kwisitulo sakho sokumkani emva kwakho.
Ke kaloku, xa inkosi yam ukumkani efa, ibe ifunyanwa kunye nabafazi bakhe, mna noSolomon unyana wam siza kuba ngabaphulaphuli.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa ethetha nokumkani, wafika uNatan,, umprofeti.
Ke kaloku kwaziswa ukumkani, besithi, UNathan umprofeti ukho apha. Wafika ke, wahlangula phambi kokumkani ngobuso bakhe emhlaba.
Wathi uNathani, Nkosi yam ukumkani, uthi na wena, UAdoniya uya kuba ngukumkani emva kwam, aze ahlale kwisitulo sam?

Ke kaloku namhlanje waya phantsi, wanikela ngeenkomo ezininzi, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezityebileyo, neentyatyambo; wabiza bonke oonyana bakakumkani, nabathetheli beqela, noAbhiyatare umbingeleli; bona ngoku badla besela phambi kwakhe, besithi, Uphile ukumkani uAdoniya.
Ke mna umkhonzi wakho, noTsadoki umbingeleli, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, nomkhonzi wakho uSolomon, awazibizanga.
Ukumkani, inkosi yam, wenze ntoni na loo nto, angazixelela abakhonzi bakho ukuba ngubani na oza kuphumla kwisithsaba sakhe emva kwakhe?
Wathi ukumkani uDavide, Nceda nimwisele apha uBhatshebha. Wafika ke, wahlala phambi kokumkani.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wenza isibingelelo, esithi, Uphila iNkosi, owayendisindise kumngcipheko onke;

Ndiya kukwenza namhlanje, njengokuba ndikubhiyozela ngoYehova uThixo kaSirayeli, ndithi, USolomon unyana wakho uya kuba ngukumkani emva kwam; yena uya kuhlala kwitrone yam endaweni yam. Ngokuqinisekileyo ndiza kuyilungisa namhlanje.
Ke kaloku uBhatshebha wehla ngobuso bakhe ehlabathini, wahlangula ukumkani wathi, INkosi yam ikumkani uDavide ahlale ubomi obungunaphakade.
Wathi ukumkani uDavide, Nceda nimwise uSadoko ukumkani, noNathan umprofeti, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada. Bafika ke phambi kokumkani;
Wathi kubo, Nciphisaneni nabakhonzi bam nani, niyimise uSolomon, unyana wam, phezu kwengulube yam, niyikhuphe phantsi eGihoni.
Athi khona ke uSadoko umbingeleli, noNathani umprofeti, bambethe kuye ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli; niphume ngentsimbi, nitsho, USolomon ukumkani uphile.
Ke mna niya phezulu naye; aze afike, ahlale kwitrone yam, abe ngukumkani endaweni yam; kuba ndimkhethile ukuba abe ngukumkani kumaSirayeli namaYuda.
Waphendula ke uBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada ukumkani, wathi, Amen! UYehova, uThixo wenkosi yam, ukumkani, athethe njalo.
Ngokuba iNkosi ube nenkosi yam ukumkani, abe noSolomon ke; ayenze itrone kaSolomon ibe mkhulu kunetrone yenkosi yam ukumkani uDavide.
Wahla ke uSadoko umbingeleli, noNathani umprofeti, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, nabaKherethi, nabaPhelethi; bamisa uSolomon phezu kwengulube yokumkani uDavide, bamthabatha waya eGihon.
UTsadoki, umbingeleli, wathabatha isidumbu seoli yase-olive esisuka endlwini yendlu kaThixo, wamthisa uSolomon; baphucula intsimbi, bonke abantu besithi, Kuhlale ubomi ukumkani uSolomon.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu babuyela phezulu emva kwakhe, bedlala iipilisi, bezithandazela ngovuyo olukhulu; bethetha ngelizwi elikhulu kakhulu, de kube liqhutywa ihlabathi ngomsindo.
Ke kaloku uAdoniya, naye onke amakhonzi akhe, wava lo msindo, xa begqibile ukupheka; ke kaloku uYowabhi, ekubona umsindo webhokhwe, wathi, Yintoni le nto ingqumbo yomzi?
Ke kaloku, ngelixa ethetha, uYonatan unyana ka-Abhiyatare ukumkani wafika. Wathi uAdoniya, Yiya; ngokuba ungumntu olungileyo, ke uya kuba neendaba ezilungileyo.
Waphendula urokên/waphendulela uYonatan kuAdoniya, wathi, Akukho nto; inkosi yethu ukumkani uDavide wenza uSolomon ukumkani.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wamthumela uTsadoki umbingeleli, noNathan umprofeti, noBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada, nabaKherethi, nabaPhelethi, naye; bamthabatha phezu kwengulube yokumkani.
UTsadoki umbingeleli, noNathane umprofeti, bayamthisa waba ngukumkani eGihoni. Baphuma khona bebhiyozela; lo mzi wonke uqhutywa ngumsindo wabo; yiyo loo nto niyivayo ilizwi labo.
Ke kaloku, uSolomon sele ehlala kwitrone yokumkani.

Ke kaloku, abakhonzi bakakumkani bafika bebhaptiza iNkosi yethu uKumkani, besithi, UThixo wakho akwenze igama likaSolomon libe likhulu kunegama lakho, netrone yakhe ibe mkhulu kunetrone yakho. Wathi ke ukumkani wahlangula, wathandaza ebhedini lakhe.
Wathi ukumkani ke, Kukhululwe iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, owenza ukuba namhlanje amehlo am abone umntwana wam ehlala kwisitulo sam.
Ke kaloku bonke abamelwane baka-Adoniya bakhathazeka; bevuka, babehamba ngamnye indlela yakhe.
Ke kaloku uAhiya wakhathazeka ngenxa kaSolomon; wavuka, waya, wehla ngeendlebe zesibingiselo.
Bathi ke kuSolomon, Yabona uAdoniya uyaxoka kukumkani uSolomon; bona, ubambe izikhonkwane zesibingelelo, esithi, Ukumkani uSolomon athini na namhlanje, ukuba akawufazi umkhonzi wakhe ngeqhosha?
Wathi uSolomon, Ukuba uya kuba ngumntu olungileyo, akukho nwele enye yeentloko zakhe eza kugwa ehlabathini; kodwa ukuba kukho okubi kuye, uya kufa.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uSolomon wathumela, bawukhupha uAdoniya ukusuka kwisibingelelo. Wafika ke, waba ngukumkani uSolomon; uSolomon wathi kuye, Yiya ekhaya lakho.
Yafika ke imihla kaDavide yokufa, wamisa uSolomon, unyana wakhe, esithi,
Ndiya kuhamba ngendlela ekufuneka ihambe wonke umntu ehlabathini; ngoko ke, ube namandla, ube ngumntu.zi.

Yenza njengoko iNkosi uThixo wakho akuxelelayo, uhambe ngeendlela zakhe, ugcine imimiselo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, nezigqibo zakhe, nezithethe zakhe, njengokuba kubhalwe emthethweni kaMoses; ngoko ke uza kusebenza kakuhle kuzo zonke izinto ozenzayo, naphi na apho uya khona.

Ke kaloku iNkosi uya kwenza ilizwi lakhe, elithethayo kum, esithi, Ukuba iziqhamo zakho ziyazikhusela zihambe phambi kwam ngokuqinisekileyo intliziyo yabo yonke nomphefumlo wabo wonke, ngoko akuyi kubakho mntu wakho ohlala phezu kwetrone kaSirayeli.

Uyazi naloo nto umnikele yona uYowabhi, unyana kaSeruya: ukuba wabulala ookumkani ababini bemikhosi yamaSirayeli, nguAbheri, unyana kaNere, noAmasa, unyana kaYetere; wababulala ngexesha loxolo, njengexesha lemfazwe; igazi labo lasasazeka em عمومeni wakhe, nezihlangu ezirophini zakhe.
Yenza kuye ngokobulumko bakho; Akuyi kuba mkhulu, aze athabathe umphefumlo wakhe exolo.
Ke oonyana bakaBarzilayi, umGiliyadi, yenza kubo ububele; bahlale bedla emehlweni akho; ngokuba baya kundixhasa, xa ndiyalela uAbhisalom umzalwana wakho.

Ukhumbula ke uShimeyi, unyana kaGera, umBhenjamini osuka eBahurim, owakho nawe; yena wathetha kum ulwimi olubi kakhulu ngaloo mini ndaye ndiya eMahanayim. Ke kaloku, xa wayesa kumnqamlezela emlanjeni waseYordana, ndathi kuye ngelizwi likaYehova, Ndiza kukubulala ngeklabhu.
Ke ngoko, mna, musa ukumshiya engagwetywanga; kuba wena ungumntu owaziyo, uya kwazi ukuba ukwenze ntoni na kuye, ukuze aphele ngegazi ebantwini bakhe.
Wafa ke uDavide, wabanjwa nabazalwana bakhe eMzini kaDavide..
Ke kaloku uDavide waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mane; eHebron iminyaka esixhenxe, eYerusalem iminyaka emashumi mathathu anesihlanu.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wahlala kwisithsaba sikaDavide, uyise; ubukumkani bakhe babuqiniswa kakhulu.
Wafika ke uAdoniya, unyana kaHagithi, kuBhatshebha, umzali kaSolomon; wathi kuye, Uvela njani ngoxolo? Waphendula wathi, Ndiya kufika ngoxolo.
Wathi ke, Ndinento endiyithethayo kuwe. Wathi yena, Yiya ngaphambili.
Wathi, Uyazi ukuba ubukumkani bebube buye kum; bonke amaSirayeli balinde ukuba ndibe ngukumkani. Ke kaloku izinto zaguquka, ubukumkani babuye kunyana wam; kuba iNkosi wamnika wona.
Ndinento enye ndiyicelayo kuwe; mna, nceda, ungandithinteli. Wathi yena, Yiya.
Wathi, Nceda uthethe nokumkani uSolomon, ukuba andinike uAbhisaga waseShunem ukuba abe ngumfazi wam; akakuxolanga.
Wathi ke uBhatshebha, Kulungile; ndiya kuthetha nawe kukumkani.

Ke kaloku uBhatshebha waya kukumkani uSolomon, ukuba athethe naye ngoAdoniya. Wavuka ke ukumkani, wadibana naye, wamgqubuthela; wesuka ehlala kwisitulo sakhe, waza wabanika isitulo sokuba ngumama kakumkani; wayehlala ngasekunene kwakhe.
Wathi yena, Ndinento enye encinci endiyicelayo kuwe; nceda ungandixoli. Ukumkani wathi kuye, Yixelele utata wam, andikuxoleli.
Wathi, UAbhisaga waseShunem anikezelwe kuDavide unyana wakho ukuba abe ngumfazi wakhe.

Waphendula ukumkani uSolomon, wathi kunina: Kutheni na ukuba ucele uAbhisaga waseShunemi ukuba abe ngukumkani ka-Adoniya? Umele ucele naye ukumkani; kuba ungunyana wam omkhulu, noAbhiyatare umbingeleli, noYowabhi unyana weZeruya.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uSolomon wenza isibingelelo kuYehova, esithi, UThixo athini na kum, amnike ngaphezu kwayo yonke loo nto, ukuba uAdoniya angawucela lo msebenzi ngobomi bakhe?
Ke kaloku iNkosi wandibeka ngokuqinisekileyo kwisithsaba sikaDavide uyise, wamnika indlu yokumkani, njengoko wathi; ngoko ke, njengobomi bukaThixo, uAdoniya uya kufa namhlanje.
Wathi ukumkani uSolomon kuBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada; wabulala ke uAdoniya, waza wafa.

Wathi ukumkani kuAbhiyatare umbingeleli, Yiya eAnathothi, kwilizwe lakho; kuba ungumntu ofanele ukufa; kodwa mna ndiza kukufa namhlanje; ngokuba wathabatha ibhokisi kaYehova uThixouThixo kaDavide, uyise wam, waba nenxalenye yezo zinto zonke azenzayo uyise.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wamsusa uAbhiyatare, ukuba angabi ngumbingeleli kaYehova; ukuze kuhlangatyezwane nelizwi likaYehova, elithethayo eShilo ngendlu kaEli.
Yathi loo nto ifike kuYowabhi, waya etentweni kaYehova, wathabatha izikhonkwane zesibingelelo. Ke kaloku uYowabhi wayemxhasa uAdoniya, kodwa akawuxhasi uAbhazileli.

Ke kaloku kwathiwa kukumkani uSolomon, wathi, UYowabhi wabaleka waya etentweni kaYehova, nabona, uhlala ngasecaleni kwesibingelelo. Wathumela ke uSolomon uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada, esithi, Yiya, umfakele.

Wafika ke uBhenaya endlwini kaYehova, wathi kuYowabhi, Utsho ukumkaniaukumkani uthi, Yikhuphe. Waphendula uYowabhi wathi, Hayi, ndiya kufa apha. Wabuyela uBhenaya kumkani, wamxelela, esithi, Oku kuthethayo nguYowabhi, oku ndiluphenduleleyo.
Wathi ukumkani kuBhenaya, Yenza njengoko atshoyo; umkhombe, umzibele; ukuze kungabikho mna nosapho lwabahlobo bam igazi elingenanto eliqhutywa nguYowabhi.

UYehova uya kumbuyiselela igazi lakhe, apho wahlasela khona amadoda amabini angcono, anobulungisa kunaye, wambulala, uDavide uyise wam angaziyo loo nto; nguAbheri unyana kaNere, umkhosi wakwaSirayeli, noAmasa unyana kaYetere, umkhosi wakwaYuda.
Igazi labo libe nguYowabhi nosapho lwakhe ngonaphakade; kuDavide ke, nosapho lwakhe, nendlu yakhe, netrone yakhe, iNkosi amnike uxolo ngonaphakade.
Waya ke uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada, wabetha uYowabhi, wambulala; waza wabanjwa endlwini yakhe, emlilweni.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wammisa uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada, ukuba abe ngukumkani womkhosi endaweni kaYowabhi; wammisa ke uSadoko, umbingeleli, endaweni kaAbhiyatare.
Wathumela ukumkani, wabiza uShimeyi, wathi kuye, Ukwakha kuwe indlu eYerusalem, uhlale khona; ungaphumenga naphi na.
Ke kaloku, xa uphuma ngaloo mini, udlula umlambo weKidron, qiniseka ukuba uya kufa; igazi lakho liya kuba phezu kwentloko yakho.
Waphendula uShimeyi ukumkani wathi, Kulungile loo nto; njengokuba uthi nkosi yam ukumkani, umkhonzi wakho uya kwenza njalo. Wahlala ke uShimeyi eYerusalem ixesha elide.
Ke kaloku, emva kweminyaka emithathu, abakhonzi ababini bakaShimeyi babaleka baya ku-Akishi unyana kaMahaka, ukumkani waseGati. Bathi ke kubo uShimeyi, Yabona, abakhonzi bakho baseGati.
Wavuka ke uShimeyi, wamisa isikhephe sakhe, waya eGati kuye uAkishi, ukuba afune abakhonzi bakhe. Waye, wababuyisela abakhonzi bakhe eGati.
Waxelela uSolomon ukuba uShimehi waphuma eYerusalem waya eGati, wabuya.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wathumela wambiza uShimeyi, wathi kuye, Andikubekenga ntoni na emnqamlezweni kaYehova? Andikuxelela ntoni na, ndithi, Ngomhla wokuphuma kwakho, ukuba uhambe apho naphi na, uya kufa ngokuqinisekileyo? Wathi kum, Kulungile into oyithethayo; ndiya kuyiphulaphula.
Ngoko ke, kutheni na ukuba awuyigcineli ilizwi lakho iNkosi, nokumphulaphula umyalelo endiwuwiselayo?
Wathi ke ukumkani kuShimeyi, Uyazi intliziyo yakho zonke izinto ezibi ozenzayo uDavide, uyise wam; ngoku ke iNkosi uya kukuhlawula ububi bakho.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uSolomon uya kuba ngumsindisi; isithsaba sikaDavide siza kuqiniswa phambi koYehova ngonaphakade.
Wathi ke ukumkani kuBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada; waphuma, wambetha uShimehi, waza wafa. Ke kaloku ubukumkani buqiniswa phantsi kwesandla sikaSolomon.

USolomon wenza isivumelwano somtshato noFaro, ukumkani wase-Egypt, ngokuthandana «umtshato» womfazi kaFaro. Wamthabatha waya eMzini kaDavide de agqibe ukwakha ipalamente yakhe, isibingelelo sikaThixo, nedonga elijikeleze iYerusalem.
Ke kaloku abantu baqhubeka besenza izibingelelo kwiindawo eziphakamileyo, ezindaweni zokuzinikela; ngokuba iTempile yegama likaYehova yayingakhiwanga.
USolomon wamthanda iNkosi, ehamba ngemithetho kaDavide, uyise; ke kaloku wanikela izibingelelo, waza wafumisa umlilo kwiindawo eziphezulu.

Ke kaloku ukumkani waya eGibheyon, ukuba anikezele izibingelelo; ngokuba yayiyona ndawo iphakamileyo ibalulekileyo. USolomon wanikela ngeentliziyo ezilishumi elinambini zezibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi phezu kwesibingelelo salo.
EGibheyon, wabonakala iNkosi kuSolomon ephupheni ngobusuku; wathi ke uThixo, Zicela nantoni na o Esanvostwa:

Waphendula uSolomon wathi, Uwenzile umkhonzi wakho uDavide, uyise wam, ububele obukhulu nobuxoki; ngokuba wayehamba phambi kwakho ngobuxoki, nangokunyanisekileyo, nomphefumlo ocacileyo; nawe wawenza kuye lo buxoki obukhulu, wabanika unyana ohlala phezu kwetrone yakhe namhlanje.
Ke ngoko, Nkosi yam, Thixo wam, ungenza umkhonzi wakho ube ngukumkani endaweni kaDavide, uyise wam; ke mna ndifana nomntwana omncinci, andikwazi ukutyelela.
Umkhonzi wakho uphakathi kwabantu bakho abakhethiweyo, uluntu olukhulu, luninzi ngaphezu kokubala.

Nceda, ndamnike umkhonzi wakho intliziyo eyaziyo, ukuze ndikwazi ukuphatha abantu bakho, ukuba ndikwazi ukukhetha phakathi kokulungileyo nokubi; kuba ngubani na ongakwaziyo ukuphatha abantu bakho abaninzi?
Wathandazela iNkosi, ngokuba uSolomon wacela loo nto.
Wathi ke uThixo kuye, Ngokuba uyayicela loo nto; awuyifunanga imihla emide kuwe, namandla akho, nokufa kwabathunywa bakho. Uyifumene intliziyo yakho, ukuze ukwazi ukumisela ngokuchanekileyo.
Ndiya kwenza ke loo nto uyifumeneyo, ndikunike intliziyo enobulumko nokuqonda; kuba akuzange kubekho mntu ofana nawe phambi kwakho, akazukubakho mntu ofana nawe.
Ke kaloku, into ongayicelayo ndiya kukunika yona: ubutyebi nobudumo; akuyi kubakho ukumkani omkhulu njengawe onke mihla yobomi bakho.
Ukuba ke uza kuhamba ngeendlela zam, ugcine imimiselo yam nemimiselo yam, njengokuba wahamba ngawo uDavide, Esanvostwa wakho, ndiya kukudelisa iintsuku zakho.

Wavuka ke uSolomon, waqonda ukuba yayiphupho. Wabuyela eYerusalem, wahlala phambi kwebhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova; wanikela izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo, wabanika isidlo bonke abaphathi bakhe.
Ke kaloku, kwafika ubusuku obunye amabhinqa amabini, abe ngamagqwetha, kukumkani, bamisa phambi kwakhe.
Wathi omnye kubo, Nceda, nkosi yam, mna nomfazi lowo sihlala endlwini enye; ndaza ndazala xa wayekhona nam.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezithathu zokuzalwa komntwana wam, lo mfazi wazala naye; sakuba sisoloko singababini; kwakungekho namnye endlwini ngaphandle kwethu.
Ke kaloku ngobusuku unyana waloo mfazi wafa, ngokuba wajika-jika phezu kwakhe.
Wavuka ngobusuku obuphakathi, wamthabatha unyana wam ecaleni kwam; ke mna umkhonzi wakho ndalala; wabeka emlonyeni wakhe, wababeka nomntwana wayo ofileyo emlonyeni wam.
Ke kaloku ndavuka kusasa, ndithi ndimxolele unyana wam; yabona ukuba ufile. Ndaye ke ndiya kumqwalasela ngokukhanya kwemini, yabona ukuba akanguye lo mntwana endiwuzalayo.

Wathi omnye umfazi, Hayi! Lo mntu ophilayo ngunyana wam; lo mntu ofileyo ngunyana wakho. Wathi ke omnye umfazi, Hayi! Lo mntu ofileyo ngunyana wakho; lo mntu ophilayo ngunyana wam. Bathetha ngoko phambi kokumkani.
Wathi ukumkani, Umnye wenu uthi, Lo ngunyana wam ophilayo, unyana wakho ke ufile; umnye wathi, Hayi, lo ngunyana wakho ofileyo, unyana wam ke ophilayo.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi, Ninikele iKrele. Bathi ke banikela iKrele kumkani.
Wathi ukumkani, Tsiya umntwana ophilayo ngamabini; niyisinike isiqingatha kumnye, nesiqingatha komnye.

Wathi ke umfazi ophilayo, ngenxa yothando lwakhe kunyana wakhe, kuye ukumkani, «Ndicela, nkosi yam, umnike loo mntwana ophilayo; musa ukuwubulala.» Wathi ke lo mfazi omnye, «Ayi kuba nam, akayi kuba nawe; udibanise.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi, Nceda umnikele lo mntwana ophilayo kumyeni wokuqala; musa ukuwubulala; yena ngumama wakhe.
Ke kaloku bonke amaSirayeli bayazi isinqumo sikakumkani, babemthanda kakhulu; ngokuba bebona ukuba uThixo wamnika ubulumko, ukuze agweme.
Ukumkani uSolomon waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli onke.
Ke kaloku aba bakhulu bakhe: uAzariya unyana kaSadoko, waba ngumbingeleli.
UElihorefi noAhiya, oonyana bakaShisha, babe ngababhali bokumkani; uYoshuwafati unyana ka-Ahilodi waba ngumphathi weencwadi.
UBherokênELI unyana kaYehoyada waba ngukumkani womkhosi; uSadoko noAbhiyatare babe ngababingeleli.
UAzariya unyana kaNathane waba ngumphathi weendawo; uZabhude unyana kaNathane waba ngumbingeleli, umcebisi wokumkani.
U-Ahisare waba ngukumkani wendlu; u-Adoniram, unyana ka-Abda, waba ngukumkani weenkonzo.
USolomon wayeneengqwalasela ezilishumi elinambini, zakwaSirayeli onke; babezilungiselela isonka ukumkani nosapho lwakhe. Umntu ngamnye wayemele alungiselele isonka senyanga nganye yonyaka.
Lemi amagama abo: uBhen-huri, ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim.
uBhen-dekeri eMakazi, noShaalbim, neBhete-shemeshi, noElon iBethanani.
uBheneheshedi, e-Arubhothi; iSokhoke nayo yonke ilizwe likaHefer yaba nguwe.
Unyana ka-Abinadabu, kuwo onke amasitenxe eDori; wayenomyeni uTafati intombi kaSolomon.
uBhahana unyana ka-Ahilodi, eThanake, naseMegidido, nayo yonke iBhethe-shehan ecaleni kweSarethani phantsi kweYezreyeli, evela eBhethe-shehan waya eAbele-mehola, wadlula eYokmeam.

uBhenengebere, eRamoti-gileyadi; izixeko zikaYaire, Usisono, ezikwiGiliyadi, zaba ziye kuye; nelizwe laseArgobhi, eBhashani, nemizi yayo emikhulu engamashumi asixhenxe, enemigangatho, nezitshixo zentsimbi ezinqamlezweni.
uAhinadabu unyana kaIdo, eMahanayim.
uAhimahazi, eNaphtali; wayeyindodana kaBhasemathi, intombi kaSolomon.
uBhahana unyana kaHushai get widya, eAshere naseBealothi.
uYoshafati unyana kaParahu, eIsrayeli.
uShimeyi unyana kaEla, eBhenjamin.
uGebere, unyana kaUri, eGiliyadi, ilizwe likaSihon ukumkani wamaAmori, noOg ukumkani waseBhashani; waba ngukumkani wendawo yonke yena kuphela.
Ke kaloku amaYuda namadoda aseSirayeli abe ngamaninzi, njengamacwecwe enqanawa ecaleni kolwandle; babedla besela, baphumle.
Ke kaloku uSolomon waba ngukumkani kuzo zonke izikumkani, esuka emlanjeni iEfrayim, iye kwilizwe labaFilisti, ukuya kumda weYiputa; zazisa umvuzo kuSolomon, zaba ngumkhonzi wakhe yonke ubomi bakhe.
Usapho lukaSolomon lwalifuna mihla ngemihla iisethi ezimashumi mathathu zesiqhamo, neeseti ezimashumi asixhenxe zesiqhamo esiqhelekileyo;
iinkomo ezilishumi ezityebileyo, iinkunzi zeegusha ezimashumi mabini, neentyatyambo ezimakhulu eminyaka, nezimvu, neebhokhwe, neentaka, neentlanzi ezityebileyo.
Walawula phezu kwezikumkani zonke ezisentshonalanga yeMlambo iEfrayim, ukusuka eTipsaha waya eGaza; ngazo zonke izikumkani ezisentshona yoMlambo. Waye noxolo kuwo onke amacala.

Ke kaloku amaYuda namaSirayeli ahlala ekhuselekile zonke iintsuku zobomi bukaSolomon, ukusuka eDan waya eBher-shebha; iqela ngalinye lihlala phantsi kweentyatyambo zayo, nangaphantsi komthi wayo wesiphini.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wayenamahhashi angamashumi amane amawaka enqanaweni zakhe, namawaka alishumi elinambini eemoto.
Ke kaloku abo baphathi bezixeko babenika uKumkani uSolomon isonka, nabo bonke ababedla emehlweni akhe; ngamnye wabanika ngenyanga yakhe, besenza ukuba kungabikho nantoni.
Bathi ke nabo, bathabathe ingqolowa notywala kumahhashi eemoto, namahhashi ahamba ngesantya esikhawulezayo, besiya kwiindawo ezifanelekileyo, umntu ngamnye esenza intlawulo yakhe.
Ke kaloku uThixo wamnika uSolomon ubulumko, nokuqonda okukhulu kakhulu, nobubanzi bengqondo, njengentlabathi esembindini wolwandle.
Ke kaloku ubulumko bukaSolomon babukhulu kunabo bonke abantu basempumalanga, nakwazo zonke iinyaniso zaseYiputa.
Wayenobulumko ngaphezu kwabanye bonke abantu, ngaphezu kukaEthan u-Ezrahi, ngaphezu kukaHeman noKhalkolu noDarda oonyana bakaMaholi; waba negama phakathi kwezizwe zonke ezijikelezayo.
Wathetha izithethe eziliqela elinamakhulu mathathu, wabhala iingoma elinamakhulu amane.

Wathetha ngezityalo, ukususela kwisityalo esikhulu se-cedar eLibanoni, ukuya kwisityalo esincinci se-hyssop, esikhulayo emgangathweni; wathetha ngezinto eziphilayo, neentlanzi, neziqhamo ezihamba phantsi komhlaba, neentlanzi.
Kwaza kwabakho abavela kumazwe onke, ukuba babone ubulumko bukaSolomon; kwathi ke kwabakho nabasuka kubo bonke abakumkani behlabathi, ababeva ubulumko bakhe.
Ke kaloku uHiram, ukumkani waseTire, waba ngumhlobo kaDavide yonke imihla. Wava ke uHiram ukuba uSolomon ubethelelwe ngukumkani endaweni yoyise, wathumela abakhonzi bakhe kuSolomon.
USolomon wamthumelela uHirame, esithi,

Uyazi ukuba uDavide, uyise wam, akakwazanga ukulungiselela indlu igama likaYehova uThixo wakhe; ngenxa yokuba wayeyintshayelelo kubo bonke abachasi bakhe abajikelezayo, de wazisa iNkosi phantsi kweenyawo zakhe.
Ke kaloku ngoku iNkosi, uThixo wam, wandinika uxolo ngazo zonke iinkalo; akukho namnye umqolo, akukho monakalo.

Ndicinga ke ngokukwakha indlu igama likaYehova uThixo wam, njengoko watshoyo iNkosi kuDavide, uyise wam, esithi, Unyana wakho, oza kumbeka phezu kwetrone yakho endaweni yakho, yena uya kwakha indlu igama lam.

Namhlanje ke, unike umthetho ukuba kuqhutywe izityalo zeediliya eLibanoni, ukuze ziqhutywe kum; nabakhonzi bam basebenze kunye nabakhonzi bakho; ndiya kubanika abakhonzi bakho iindleko zabo, ngokwento oza kuyigqiba. Uyazi ukuba akukho namnye kuthi okwaziyo ukuqhutywa kweentyatyambo njengeeSidon.
Wava ke uHiram amazwi kaSolomon, wavuya kakhulu; wathi, Buyiselani iNkosi namhlanje, ngokuba wamnika uDavide unyana owaziyo ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu kwaloo lizwe likhulu.
UHirame wamphendula uSolomon, wathi, Izinto ozithumeleleyo ndizifumana; ndiya kuzisenza zonke izinto ozifunayo malunga neentyatyambo zeediliya neentyatyambo zezityalo zenkomo.

Abasebenzi bam baya kuzikhupha zisuka eLibanoni zifike elwandle; ndiya kuzidibanisa zibe ziinqanawa, ndizithu montagzisile elwandle, ziye kwindawo oza kuyikhetha wena; ndiya kuzimisa khona, uze uzithabathe wena; ke wena uyenze into endiyifunayo, ukuba ube nesonka sabantwana bam.
Wathihim-ke uHiram wamnika uSolomon izityalo zeediliya, nezityalo zeziqhamo, zonke ezo wayezifuna.
USolomon wamnika uHiram iziqu zengqolowa ezimashumi mabini amawaka, ukuba zibe yimifuno yosapho lwakhe, neziqu zeoli ecocekileyo ezimashumi mabini. Wakwenza njalo uSolomon kuHiram ngonyaka nonyaka.
UYehova wamnika uSolomon ubulumko, njengokuba wathi kuye. Kwakukho uxolo phakathi kukaHiram noSolomon; basenza umyalelo bobabini.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uSolomon wamisa amadoda kuwo onke amaSirayeli, ukuba abe ngabasebenzi bakhe; babe ngamawaka a intandathu.
Wabathumela eLibanoni, inyanga ngenyanga, amawaka alishumi; behlala unyaka omnye eLibanoni, neentsuku ezimbini ekhaya. UAdoniram waba ngukumkani kubo bonke abathunywa.
USolomon wayenamadoda amashumi asixhenxe amawaka, abezithabatha izithuthi, namadoda amashumi asibhozo amawaka, abezitshisa iithayile eziphakamileyo.
Ngapha koko, kwabakho abaphathi bomsebenzi, bamakhulu amathathu, anamakhulu mathathu, alawula abo besenza umsebenzi.
Ke kaloku, ngomthetho wokumkani, batshisa iithayile ezinkulu, ezibizayo kakhulu, ukuba zenza isiseko sendlu kaThixo ngeethayile ezenziwe ngomthi.
Abaqulunqi bakaSolomon, nabaqulunqi bakaHiram, namadoda aseGabal, batshisa, balungiselela imithi nelitye lokwakha indlu.

USolomon waqalisa ukwakha indlu kaYehova iminyaka emakhulu amane, anamanci asibhozo, emva kokuba abantwana bakaSirayeli bephuma eYiputa; kwaba ngomnyaka wesine wokumkani kwakhe phezu kwaSirayeli, ngenyanga kaZivu, leyo iyinyanga yesibini.

Itempile kakumkani uSolomon, awayeyenza kuYehova, yayikuba ziikubhite ezimashumi asixhenxe ubude bayo, zibe ziikubhite ezimashumi mabini ububanzi bayo, zibe ziikubhite ezilishumi elinambini ubude bayo.
Udonga lwangaphambili lwendlu enkulu, ububanzi bayo bukuba ziikubhite ezimashumi mabini, ngokuhambelana nobubanzi betempeli; yaphuma phambi kwetempeli ibe ziikubhite ezilishumi.
Wazenza iifestile kwindlu ka Mysekeli, ngeekhabhathi ezingavulwanga.
Ecaleni kweendonga zangaphandle zegumbi eliphambili, negumbi elingaphakathi, walungisa isakhiwo esineetafile zegumbi lecala lijikeleze.

Umgangatho osezantsi ube ziikubhite ezintlanu ububanzi bakhe, nomgangatho ophakathi waba ziikubhite ezintandathu ububanzi bakhe, nomgangatho wesithathu waba ziikubhite ezisixhenxe ububanzi bakhe. Wayenza imigangatho yodonga lwendlu jikelele ngaphandle kwayo, ukuze iithayile zingabikho phantsi kweendonga zendlu.

Iithayile ezisetyenziselwa ukwakha iTempile zaqhutywa, zatywinwa, zaba yindawo yokusika. Ke ngoko, akufuneki ukuba kubekho umbhobho, okanye intonga, okanye nayiphi na enye into eyenziwe ngentsimbi, eyaziwa kwiTempile xa yakhiwa.
Kwicala lasempumalanga lendlu, kwakukho umngxunya wokungena kwigumbi eliphantsi leekhabhathi zesiqingatha; kwakukho iinqanawa eziya phezulu kwigumbi eliphakathi, nalapho ziye ecaleni lesithathu.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wakwakha indlu, waza wayigqiba; wayenza isakhelo sayo ngemiqadi neetafile zeediliya.
Wazilungisa iikhabhathi zecala ezijikeleze yonke indawo yendlu. Igumbi ngalinye liphezulu ngeekubhite ezintandathu; zadityaniswa nendlu ngemiqadi yesedari.
Kwafika ke umyalezo kaYehova kuSolomon, esithi,
Le ndawo yendlu oyenzayo, ukuba uhambe ngemimiselo yam, wenze izigqibo zam, uzigcine zonke imiyalelo yam, ndiya kukwenza kuwe konke endiyithethayo uDavide, uyise.
Ndiya kuhlala phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; andiyi kubashiya abantu bam, amaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uSolomon walungisa indlu jav widwa ammoni, wayigqiba.
Wazigubungela iindonga zangaphakathi ngeebhodi zeediliya, ukususela phezulu ukuya ezantsi; wazigubungela iithayile zemithi ye-cypress.
Wakha igumbi ecaleni kwendlu, ubude bayo bukuba ziikubhite ezimashumi mabini; lakhiwa ngeebhodi zeediliya, ukususela phezulu ukuya ezantsi. Eli ligumbi elingaphakathi lendawo engcwele kakhulu.
Igumbi elikhulu elingaphambili kwendlu inteligenti, ubude bayo bekuba ziikubhite ezimashumi mane.
Indlu yangaphakathi yaba yintyatyambo ye-cedar, eyenziwe ngeentyatyambo zesiqhamo, neentyatyambo ezivulekileyo; zonke izinto zaba zifakwe intyatyambo ye-cedar, ukuze ingabonakali itshe.
Walungiselela igumbi elingaphakathi ngaphakathi kwendlu-ngcwele, ukuba libekwe kuyo itekisi yomthethweni kaYehova.

Igumbi elingaphakathi, ubude bayo iikubhite ezimashumi mabini, ububanzi bayo iikubhite ezilishumi elinambini, ubude bayo iikubhite ezilishumi elinambini; waligquma ngegolide ecocekileyo. Waligquma isibingelelo secedar.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wagubungela ngaphakathi kwendlu ngegolide ecacileyo; wabeka izibonda zegolide phambi kwegumbi elingaphakathi, wayigubungela ngegolide.
Wazigubungela ngegolide zonke izinto ezingaphakathi kwendlu, de yagqitywa yonke; wazigubungela negolide zonke izibingelelo zegumbi elingaphakathi.
Kwigumbi elingaphakathi wazenza izithixo ezibini ezinemilebe, zentsimbi yeolive; ubude bomnye waba ziikubhite ezilishumi.
Icala ngalinye lento ephilayo yokuqala lalineenyawo ezintlanu ubude; ukususela kwintloko yecala elinye ukuya kwintloko yecala elinye kwakukho iinyawo ezilishumi.
Izinto eziphilayo zesibini, kwakunye nazo, zalinganiselwa zibe ziikubhite ezilishumi; zombini zazilingana ubungakanani, zazilingana nobume.
Iinyawo ezilishumi ziphakame ngazo zonke iintaka.

Wazibeka ezo zinto ziphilayo endlwini yangaphakathi yendlu kaThixo, iileta zazo zityebileyo. Iileta zokuqala zaziqhathana nodonga olunye, neileta zesibini zaziqhathana nodonga olunye; izileta zabo zaphakathi kwendlu yangaphakathi zaziqhathana ngalinye nelinye.
Wazigubungela iintaka ezi lett widla ammoni ngegolide.
Kwiindonga zonke zendlu ejikelezayo, nakwiindawo zangaphakathi nakwiindawo zangaphandle, waluka iintaka ezineziqu, neentyatyambo, neziqhamo.
Wazigubungela ngegolide iithayile zegumbi elingaphakathi, nangaphandle.
Wayenza iminyango yokungena kwigumbi elingaphakathi, eyenziwe ngomthi weoliven; imingxunya yazo eziphezulu, Esanvostwa, neengcango zazo zaba ngamaphiko amane.

Kwiminyango emibini yomthi weoliven waluka iintaka ezineziqu, neentyatyambo zetafile, neziqhamo ezivulekileyo; waza wazigquma ngegolide, wamisa igolide phezu kwezintaka ezineziqu neentyatyambo zetafile.
Wayenza imingxunya yomngxunya womngxunya wesango lendlu enkulu, eyenziwe ngomthi weoliven; yaba ngamacala amane.
Wayenza imingxuma emibini yokhuni lwe-cypress; umngxunya ngamnye waba nemisonto emibini ethe tyaba.
Waziluka ngazo iintlanzi ezinomqolo, nezityalo-mali, neentyatyambo ezivulekileyo; wazigubungela igolide zonke ezo ziluka.
Wayenza inkundla yangaphakathi ngemigca emithathu komthi ogqutyiweyo, nemigca enye yomthi we-cedar.
Isiseko setempile kaYehova sabekwa ngomnyaka wesine, ngenyanga kaZivu.
Yagqitywa ke indlu ngomnyaka weshumi elinanye, ngenyanga kaBul, leyo yinyanga yesibhozo; zonke iinkalo zayo zagqitywa ngokwemimiselo yayo. Wathatha uSolomon iminyaka esixhenxe ukuyenza.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wayala indlu yakhe; wachitha iminyaka elishumi elinamithathu egqiba yonke into.

Wayenza indlu yomthi weLibanoni; ubude bayo beyiikubhite ezilikhulu, ububanzi bayo beyiikubhite ezimashumi mahlanu, ubude bayo beyiikubhite ezilishumi elinambini. Yabe ibekwe phezu kwemigca emine yemiqadi yesedari, neengcango zesedari phantsi kwezimiqadi.
Isakhiwo sakhiwa ngesedari, sabekwa phezu kweengcango ezimashumi mane anesihlanu ezenziwe ngamagqabi; ngamagqabi alishumi elinambini kumgca ngamnye.
Iifestile zazikwimigca emithathu, ngeefestile ezijongene nganye nenye kwiqela leentsuku ezintathu.
Zonke iindonga zeengcango, nezikhonkwane zeengcango, ziiphaneli ezithe nkqo; neefestile zazijongene ngazo nganye enye.

Wayenza igumbi leentyatyambo; ubude bayo buyiikubhite ezimashumi mahlanu, ububanzi bayo buyiikubhite ezilishumi elinambini; phambi kwayo kwakukho isithuba esivulekileyo, neentyatyambo zayo, nophahla lwaso.
Wayenza igumbi letrone, elibizwa ngokuba ligumbi lomthetho, ukuba athethe khona abantu; yayigubungela ngesedari, ukususela ephahleni ukuya phezulu.
Ke kaloku ikhaya likaSolomon, apho wayehlala khona endlwini yakhe, lakhiwa phantsi kwendlu yangaphambili; wayenza ngokwendlela leyo. Wakha negumbi elifana nalo lonyana kaFaro, owamnika umtshato.

Zonke ezi zinto ziindlu zakhiwa ngamatye abiza kakhulu, aqingqiweyo ngokwemilinganiselo yawo, aqhutywa ngamasebe, ngaphakathi nangaphandle; ukusukela kwisiseko sazo ukuya phezulu, kwakunye nangaphandle ukuya endlwini enkulu.
Iziseko zabekwa ngamatye amakhulu, abiza kakhulu, amalunga neekubhite ezilishumi ubude, neekubhite ezisibhozo ubude.
Ngazo kwakukho iithayile ezi Mysaleleyo, ezigqunywe ngokwemilinganiselo yabo, neengcango zesedari.

Ke kaloku igumbi elikhulu langaphakathi lijikelezwe ngudonga lwemigca emithathu yamatye aqingqiweyo, nemigca enye yeengcango zeediliya, njengendlu yangaphakathi yesibingelelo sikaYehova, nanjengomnyango wayo.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uSolomon wathumela waya kuHiram, wamthabatha eTire.

UMama kaHiram waba nguwesifazane, wesizwe sikaNafetali; uBawo wakhe ke wayengumntu waseTire, owenza umsebenzi wentsimbi. Wathi uHiram, egcwele ubulumko, nokuqonda, nobuchule bokwenza zonke iintlobo zemisebenzi yentsimbi; waya kukumkani uSolomon, wayenza yonke imisebenzi yakhe.
Wazenza iirokên/iithayile ezimbini zentsimbi; nganye yayiyi-cubit elishumi elinambini ubude, ne-cubit elishumi elinambini ijikeleze.
Wayenza iintonga ezimbini zentsimbi eyenziwe ngodongwe, ukuba zibekwe phezulu kwezithsaba; intonga nganye yayiyiikubhite ezintlanu ubude.
Intloko nganye yayinothungelwano lwemizobo ethe nkqo, namakhonkco aqhutywa ndawonye; kwaba sababini kwintloko nganye.
Wayenza imiqolo emibini yeentyatyambo zentsimbi, ijikeleze umngxunya ngamnye, ukuze ziqhotyoshelwe ngazo iintambo eziphezulu zomthi; wakwenza njalo kumacala omabini eentambo.
Izinto eziphezulu zomthi emnyango wangaphambili zazifana nelili, ubude babo bekuba ziikubhite ezine.
Kwizinto eziphakamileyo zemisonto emibini, ngasentla kwesiqwenga esijikelezayo esisecaleni kothungelwano, kwakukho iziqhamo zegranate ezingamakhulu amabini, ezakhiwe ngomgca jikelele.
Wabeka iithayile emnyango wendlu kaThixo; wabiza igama lethayile esemzantsi ngokuba yiYakin, yathi igama lethayile esemntla ngokuthi yiBowazi.
Iintonga zamatye zazifana nelili; ngoko kwagqitywa umsebenzi wamatye amaninzi.
Wayenza ibhotile enkulu ejikelezayo, yentsimbi egqunywe ngamanzi lwandle; ibe ziikubhite ezilishumi ukuphakama kwayo ukusuka kumngxunya kuye komngxunya, zibe zizikubhite ezintandathu ubude bayo.
Ngasezantsi komngxunya wayo, ngazo zonke iindawo ezijikelezayo, kwakukho imiqolo emibini yeentyatyambo zesiqhamo, ezintandathu ngekubhite ngalinye; zaziqhutywa zisuka elwandle.

Ulwandle lwaluhlala phezu kweenkomo zentsimbi ezilishumi elinambini; ezintathu zijonge emntla, ezintathu zijonge emazantsi, ezintathu zijonge emzantsi, andresi zijonge emntla; ulwandle lwaluhlala ngasentla kwazo; iziphelo zabo zasemva zazijonge phezulu.
Ubukhulu bayo bebubanzi besandla; umngxunya wayo wawufana nomngxunya webhotile, wenziwe ngamaphiko elili; wagcina amanzi amawaka amabini eebhathi, amalunga neelitha ezilishumi elinambini.
Wazenza iziseko zentsimbi ezilishumi; ubude bomnye waba ziikubhite ezine, ububanzi bomnye waba ziikubhite ezine, ubude bomnye waba ziikubhite ezintathu.
Le nto yakwenziwa ngayo iziseko; zazineepaneli zecala ezidityanisiweyo neetafile.
Kwiibhodi eziphakathi kweengcango kwakukho iileya, neenkunzi zeenkomo, nezidumbu; kwiingcango, ngasentla nasentla kwezileya neenkunzi zeenkomo, kwakukho iziqhoboshi zeentyatyambo.
Kwabakho izithuthi ezine zentsimbi, nee-axis zentsimbi kwisiseko ngasinye. Kuzo zonke iincopho zantandathu kwakukho iintloko zokuxhasa isiqulatho, eziqhutywa ngemiqamelo ecaleni ngalinye.

Ngasemva kwesiseko kwakukho ukuvula okujikelezayo, ubunzulu bukakubhite Usi neutralityi, nesakhelo esijikeleze oko kubhite esinye nesiqingatha ngaphaya. Kububanzi bomngxunya kwabakho ukuhombisa. Iipaneli zesiphelo sezinto ezixhasayo zazithe nkqo, azijikelezanga.
Izithuthi ezine zaziphantsi kweepaneli, nezithuthi zesithuthi sazidityaniswe nesiseko; isithuthi ngasinye sakuba siphezulu ngekubhite enye nesiqingatha.
Izithuthi zakhiwa njengezithuthi zeenqanawa; izithuthi zabo, nezigqubuthelo zazo, namagqabi azo, namachiza awo, zonke zaba zizinto ezenziweyo.
Intloko nganye ibenezikhonkco ezine, enye kwikona nganye, yenziwe ngenxalenye enye nentloko.
Ngasentla kwesiseko ngasinye kwakukho ibhanti elijikelezayo elinobude besiqingatha sekubhite. Iindawo zokuxhasa kunye neepaneli ngasentla zayenziwe ibe yinxalenye enye nesiseko.
Wakha iintaka ezineziqu, neenkunzi zeenkomo, neentyatyambo zetafile, ngaphaya kweendawo eziphakamileyo, ngaphaya kweendawo eziphezulu, apho kwakukho khona isithuba, ngemiqadi ejikelezayo.
Wazilungisa ngale ndlela iziseko ezilishumi; zonke zathengiswa ngohlobo olunye, zazinomlinganiselo owodwa noyilo olunye.
Wazenza izitya ezilishumi zentsimbi; isitya ngasinye samanzi saba ngamabhathi angamashumi mane, saphakama iikubhite ezine ububanzi bayo; isitya ngasinye samanzi saba ngamabhathi amane.
Wazibeka iziseko ezintlanu ngasemzantsi wendlu, neziseko ezintlanu ngasemntla wendlu; wazisa ulwandle ngasemzantsi wendlu, ecaleni lasentshonalanga-ntshona.
Wazenza ke uHiram izitya zokupheka, nezitshizi, neziqulatho. Wagqiba ke uHiram yonke imisebenzi awayeyenza kukumkani uSolomon endlwini kaYehova:
amakhonkco amabini, neentyatyambo ezimbini eziphezulu emakhonkcweni, namatye amabini othungelwano akhuselayo iintyatyambo ezimbini eziphezulu emakhonkcweni;
iziqhamo zegranate ezimakhulu amane, ezenziwe ngemisonto emibini; imiqolo emibini yeziqhamo zegranate eyenziwe ngemisonto nganye, ukugubungela iintonga ezincinane ezikwimisonto.
iziseko ezilishumi, neziqulatho ezilishumi phezu kweziseko;
ulwandle, neenkomo ezilishumi elinambini phantsi kwalo;
neengxowa, neebhotile, nezitya. Zonke ezi zinto uHiram azenzayo kukumkani uSolomon, endlwini kaYehova, zakwenziwa ngentsimbi enqamlezayo.
Iibhombu zethutyana, iinqanawa zomlilo. Ukumkani wazenza ukuba ziqhutywe kumanzi acocekileyo eJordan, phakathi kweSukothi neZarethane.
Ke kaloku uSolomon akazange azilinganisele zonke ezi zinto, ngokuba zazininzi kakhulu; ubunzima bentsimbi abuzange bukwazike.
Wazenza ke uSolomon zonke izinto zangaphakathi endlwini kaYehova: isibingelelo segolide, netafile yegolide, apho kwabekwa khona isonka sokubeka phambi koThixo;
izityalo-mlilo zegolide ecacileyo, ezilishumi elinambini ngasempumalanga, nezilishumi elinambini ngasentshona, phambi kwendlu yangaphakathi; neentyatyambo zegolide, nezityalo-mlilo, nezitshizi;
iibhotile zegolide ecacileyo, neengxowa-mlilo, neebhafu, nezitya zokutya, nezitya zokupheka; namakhonkco egolide emagumbini angaphakathi endawo engcwele kakhulu, nakumasango endlu enkulu yeTempile.

Yagqitywa ke yonke imisebenzi ukumkani uSolomon awayeyenza endlwini kaYehova. Waza wazisa uSolomon izinto awazinikelayo uDavide, uyise, isilivere, negolide, nezithuthi, waza wazibeka kwiindawo zezinto ezigcinwayo zendlu kaYehova.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uSolomon wahlanganisa abathetheli bakaSirayeli eYerusalem, bonke abezi-overheads zeentsapho zakwaSirayeli, abathetheli bezindlu zabasetyhini zakwaSirayeli, ukuba bakhuphe ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova ukusuka eSiyon, emzini kaDavide.
Bahlangana ke bonke amadoda aseSirayeli kukumkani uSolomon, emthendelekweni wenyanga ka-Ethanim, leyo iyinyanga yesixhenxe.
Bafika ke bonke abathetheli baseYiputa, ababingeleli bakhupha ibhokisi.
Bayikhupha ibhokisi kaYehova, netentile yokuhlangana, nazo zonke izinto ezingcwele ezazisententeni; ababingeleli nabaLevi bayikhupha.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uSolomon, naye bonke abantu bakaSirayeli abasamkeleka kuye, babe phambi kwebhokisi, benikela iinkomo nezimvu, ezingalinganiswa ngenxa yokuninzi kwabo.

Bathi ke ababingeleli, bathabathe itekisi yomnqophiso kaYehova, bayifake endaweni yayo, endlwini yangaphakathi yendlu kaThixo, kwindawo engcwele kakhulu; bayibeka phantsi kweempawu zezinto eziphilayo.
Izinto eziphilayo zazisa iinwele zabo phezu kwendawo apho kwakukho khona isithuthi, zigubungela isithuthi kunye nemiqadi yayo phezulu.
Iintambo zazide kakhulu, ukuze iziphelo zazo zibonakale kwindawo engcwele phambi kwendlu yangaphakathi, kodwa zingabonakali ngaphaya; zikhona namhla.
Akukho nto esiqwini, ngaphandle kweebhodi ezimbini zelitye uMoses wazisa khona emnqamlezweni waseHorebhi, apho iNkosi wamenza khona umnqophiso nabantwana bakaSirayeli, xa bephuma eYiputa.
Ke kaloku, xa ababingeleli bephuma kwindawo engcwele, ifumene izulu indlu kaYehova.
Ababingeleli abazange bakwazi ukuhlala besenza umsebenzi wabo, ngenxa yefu; ngokuba ubutyebi bukaYehova buzele indlu yakhe.
Wathi ke uSolomon, UYehovarophule ukuba uya kuhlala emnyama.
Ke mna ndenza kuwe indlu entle, indawo yokuhlala kwakho ngonaphakade."
Ke kaloku ukumkani wajikeleza, wabambisa ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli; bonke ke babemile.
Wathi, Kuhlolwe iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, owawuthetha ngomlomo wakhe kuDavide uyise wam, wawenza ngesandla sakhe, esithi,

Ngokuba ukususela ngemini endiyikhupha ngayo abantu bam bakaSirayeli eYiputa, andikhethi mzi nganye yezizwe zakwaSirayeli, ukuba yenziwe khona indlu igama lam; ndakhetha uDavide ukuba abe ngukumkani kwaba bantu bam bakaSirayeli.
UDavide, utata wam, wabeka engqondweni yakhe yonke ukuba avule indlu igama likaYehova uThixo kaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathi kuDavide, uyise wam, Uthe wabeka engqondweni yakho yonke ukuba ugxininise indlu igama lam; kwakulungileyo ukuba ubeke loo nto engqondweni yakho.
Ke wena awuza kwakha indlu; unyana wakho, oza kuvela endlwini yakho, yena uya kwakha indlu igama lam.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wenza ilizwi lakhe, awalilithethayo; mna ke ndiphakame endaweni kaDavide, uyise wam, ndahlala kwisithsaba samaSirayeli, njengokuba wathi iNkosi, ndakha indlu igama likaThixo kaSirayeli.
Ndayilungiselela khona indawo itsimbi, ekhoyo kuyo umnqophiso kaYehova, umnqophiso awayewenza nabafazi bethu, xa wayebakhupha bephuma eYiputa.
Wahlala uSolomon phambi kwesibingelelo sikaYehova, ejonge kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli; wamisa izandla zakhe eziphakamileyo,
wathi, Nkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, akukho Thixo ofana nawe emazulwini ngasentla, nokuba ehlabathini ngezantsi; ogcina umnqophiso wakho nobubele bakho kubakhonzi bakho abalandelayo intliziyo yabo yonke.
Owugcinele umkhonzi wakho uDavide, uyise wam, ilizwi lakho; wathetha ngomlomo wakho, wawenza ngesandla sakho, njengokuba kunjalo namhlanje.

Namhlanje ke, Nkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, gcina umnqophiso owenzayo kumkhonzi wakho uDavide, utata wam, uthi, Akuyi kubakho mntu wokuhlala phambi kwam phezu kwetrone kaSirayeli, ukuba oonyana bakho bengazikhuseli ukuba bahambe phambi kwam, njengokuba ubehamba wena.
Ke ngoko, Thixo kaSirayeli, liqiniseke ke ngoku, nceda, ilizwi lakho olithethayo kumkhonzi wakho uDavide, udade wam.
Ingaba ke uThixo uya kuhlala kweli hlabathi? Izulu eliphakamileyo alikwazi ukukunika indawo; ingakanani na loo ndawo ingcwele endiyilungiselele yona?
Ke kaloku, mna iNkosi, Thixo wam, musa ukuliphulaphula umthandazo womkhonzi wakho, nombulelo wakhe, ungaliphulaphuli ilizwi, nomthandazo umkhonzi wakho owuthandaza kuwe namhlanje.
Amehlo akho ahlale ejonge le ndlu ngobusuku nobusuku, indawo othi, Igama lam liza kuba khona; ukuze uphendule umthandazo umkhonzi wakho owuthandaza kule ndawo.
Yiva ke izibingelelo zomkhonzi wakho, nabantu bakho bakaSirayeli, xa bethandaza kuloo ndawo; udibanise ezulu, kwindawo yokuhlala kwakho. Uyivumile loo nto, uyeke.
Xa umntu esenza inyaniso kumhlobo wakhe, ebangela ukuba abhiyozele, aze afike abhiyozele phambi kwesibingelelo sakho kule ndlu;
uthethe ke kude ezulu, wenze, ugweme phakathi kwabakhonzi bakho; umgwebe lowo unetyala ngokwento awayeyenzayo, umgwebe lowo ongenatyala ngokwento ayeyenzayo.
Xa abantu bakho, ooSirayeli, behlaselwa phambi kwemfazwe, ngenxa yokuba bathe bathini na kuwe; xa bebuyela kuwe, bebhaptiza igama lakho, bethandaza, becela uncedo kuwe kule ndlu,
uyiva ke kude ezulu, uyixolele isono sabantu bakho bakaSirayeli, ubabuyisele kwilizwe olinika ooyise babo.
Xa izulu litshixiwe, ingabikho mvula, ngenxa yokuba abantu bakho bathini na phambi kwakho; xa bethandaza kuloo ndawo, bebhaptiza igama lakho, bebuyela kwisono sabo, ngenxa yokuba ubabambisela,
