ke wena, udibanise emazulwini, ukhulule isono samakhonzi akho nabasetyhini bakho abaSirayeli, ubafundise indlela elungileyo yokuyihamba; uthuthe umhlwa phezu kwelizwe olibanikileyo abantu bakho ukuba babe lilifa.

Xa kukho umhlaza ezweni, xa kukho isifo esibulalayo; xa kukho ubhubhane weentyatyambo; xa kukho intsholongwane, namanzi acocekileyo, neengcongconi, nezidumbu; xa kukho ubuxoki obujikeleze enye yemizi yabo; nokuba yintoni na imiqobo okanye imeko-bume enokubakho,
ngawo onke amathandazo, nangawo onke amaxwebhu, oonyana bakho bakaSirayeli, xa umntu ngamnye eyazi intlungu yentliziyo yakhe, emisa izandla zakhe kule ndlu;
uthethe ke phezu kwezulu, kwindawo yakho yokuhlala, uyeke, wenze, ukwenze umntu ngamnye ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo; ngokuba uyazi intliziyo yakhe; kuba wena kuphela owazi intliziyo yabantu bonke.
Ke baya kukukhathalela zonke iintsuku zabo abaphilayo phezu kwelizwe olinika ooyise bethu.
Ke kaloku nabangaphandle, abangabakho kubantu bakho uSirayeli, baya kuvela kude ngenxa yegama lakho.
Kuba baya kufunda igama lakho elikhulu, nesandla sakho esinamandla, nemisipha yakho eqinileyo; xa befika bethandaza kuloo ndlu,

sithiwe ke wena emazulwini, endawo yakho yokuhlala, wenze zonke izinto eziza kukubiza ngazo lo mkhenkce; ukuze zonke iintlanga zehlabathi zikwazi igama lakho, zibe nokholo kuwe, njengokuba abantu bakho amaSirayeli; babone ke ukuba igama lakho libizwa ngalo le ndlu endiyibonile.
Xa abantu bakho bephuma emkhosini bahlasela abachasi babo, ngaphaya kwendlela oya kubathumela kuyo; xa bethandaza kuYehova, bejonge kumzi okinqumlayo wena, nendlu endiyenzileyo igama lakho:
ke ngoko, udibanise ukuthandaza kwabo, nokucela kwabo komnqamlezo, ubazise icala labo.

Xa besenza isono kuwe, (kuba akukho mntu ongenakusindisa), wena ukhe waxolisa kubo, wabanikela phambi kwamehlo oothunywa babo, bathabathe abakhweli-zithuthi baya ezweni lothunywa lwabo, lide okanye lifutshane;
ukuba ke babuyela emphefumlweni wabo, ezweni apho baya kutshatyalaliswa khona, bebuya, bekucela uncedo kuwe apho, besithi, Siphelele, sasenza okubi, sazenza izinto ezingafanelekanga;

ukuba bebuya kuwe ngentliziyo yabo yonke, nangomphefumlo wabo wonke, ezweni lezo zintathu ezibatyhileyo; ukuba bethandaza kuThixo wakho, besuka kuloo mhlaba owawunika ooyise babo, nedolophu oyikhethileyo, nendlu endiyilungiselele igama lakho,
ke ngoko, udibanise umthandazo wabo, nezicelo zabo, ezulu, endaweni yokuhlala kwakho, uyenze ityala labo.
Yabaxolela abantu bakho, abathe bakwenza isono kuwe; Yabaxolela zonke izigwebo zabo, abazenzayo kuwe; Yabaxolela abo bayawabulalayo.
Kuba ngabo abantu bakho, ipropathi yakho ekhethekileyo; wabakhuphe usuka eYiputa, ekungeneni kwefu lokutshisa intsimbi.
Amehlo akho ahlale avuliweyo ezingxolweni zomkhonzi wakho, nabasetyhini bakho bakaSirayeli, ubazixelele ngazo zonke izinto abazibizayo kuwe.

Kuba wena uwazikhethela ukuba babe yipropathi yakho, phakathi kwazo zonke iintlanga zehlabathi; njengokuba watsho ngoMoses, umkhonzi wakho, xa uxelela ooyise bethu ukuba baphume eYiputa, Nkosi yethu iNkosi.

Ke kaloku, xa uSolomon egqibile ukuthandaza kuye iNkosi ngalo mthandazo onke nalowo mthandazo, wamisa phambi kwesibingelelo sikaYehova, apho wayethe tye khona, enezandla zakhe zithe nkqo zijonge emphefumlweni.
Wahlala, wabhaptiza lonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, wathi ngelizwi elikhulu,

Wathi ke iNkosi, UThixo wamnika isiphelo abantu bakhe bakaSirayeli, njengokuba wathi; akubikho linye ilizwi elaliphazamisayo kuzo zonke izibhengezo zakhe ezilungileyo, awathetha ngaso uMoses umkhonzi wakhe.
UYehova, uThixo wethu, abe nathi, njengokuba wayebeneenkosi zethu; asikushiyenga, asikushiye.
ubeke intliziyo zethu kuye, ukuba sihambe ngeendlela zakhe zonke, sigcine imimiselo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, nezigwebo zakhe, awawisela ngazo ooyise bethu.
Ke kaloku la mazwi am, endiwucelayo iNkosi, ahlale ecaleni kukaYehova uThixo wethu busuku nobusuku; abe ngumkhonzi wakhe, abe luhlanga lwakhe uSirayeli, ngokwezinto zemihla ngemihla.
Zonke iintlanga zehlabathi ziya kuziqonda ukuba iNkosi nguThixo, akukho namnye.
Ke ngoko, nihlale nithembekile ngokupheleleyo kuYehova uThixo wethu, nihambe ngokwemimiselo yakhe, nigcine imigaqo yakhe, njengokuba nisenza namhlanje.
Ke kaloku ukumkani, noSirayeli bonke naye, banikela izibingelelo kuYehova.

Ke kaloku uSolomon wanikela izibingelelo zoxolo kuYehova, iinkomo ezimashumi mabini anambini amawaka, neentyatyambo ezimakhulu amane ananesithoba samawaka. Wathi ke ngoko ukumkani nabazalwana bonke bakaSirayeli bamisa indlu kaThixo.

Ke kaloku ngaloo mini ukumkani wamisa icala eliphakathi lendlu yangasemva kwendlwini kaYehova; wayalela khona izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zesonka, nenyama yezibingelelo zoxolo; ngokuba isibingelelo sentsimbi esingaphambili kukaThixo sasingenazo zonke.

Ke kaloku uSolomon wenza iholide ngaloo xesha, nabo bonke amaSirayeli naye; kwabakho isihlwele esikhulu sabantu, sisuka ekudeni kweHamati emntla, siye kumlambo waseYiputa emazantsi. Bayenza le nto phambi koYehova uThixo wethu iintsuku ezisixhenxe, neentlanganiso zemihla elishumi elinane.

Ke kaloku, ngemini elandelayo, wayalela abantu ukuba bahambe beya kumakhaya Usi neutrali. Babhaptiza ukumkani, baye emakhaya abo, bevuyisana, bevuyisa intliziyo yabo ngazo zonke izinto ezilungileyo azenzayo iNkosi kumkhonzi wakhe uDavide, nakwaSirayeli abantu bakhe.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wagqiba ukwakha indlu kaYehova, nendlu yokumkani; zonke izinto eziya kumthanda uSolomon ukuba azisebenze.
Wabonakala iNkosi kuSolomon kathathu, njengokuba wabonakala kom eGibheyon.

Wathi iNkosi kuye, Ndiye ndawuva umthandazo wakho, nokuthandaza kwakho kum; ndiyingcwelele le ndlu wawuyenzayo, ukuze ndibeke khona igama lam kude kube sekupheleni; amehlo am nengqondo yam ziya kuba khona yonke imihla.

Ke wena, ukuba uhambe phambi kwam, njengokuba wahamba khona uDavide, uyise wakho, ngobulungisa benhliziyo yakho, wenze into elungileyo, wenze zonke izinto endizisaziyo, uzigcine imimiselo yam nemithetho yam;
ndiya kuqinisa isithsaba sakho sokumkani phezu kwaSirayeli ngonaphakade, njengokuba ndathi kuDavide uyise wakho, ndisithi, Uza kubakho umntu ohlala esitsheni sakwaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, ukuba nina nabantwana benu nisuka mva kwam, ningayigcinanga imimiselo yam nemiyalelo yam endiyibeka phambi kwenu, niya kusebenza amadini athile, nizihlambulule;
ndiya kubakhupha amaSirayeli ezweni endibanikileyo; ndiya kubathutha le ndlu, endiyingcwelele igama lam; amaSirayeli aya kuba ngumbulelo nobuxoki phakathi kwezizwe zonke.
Ke kaloku le ndlu inkulu kakhulu; bonke abahamba ngaphaya kuyo baya kukhathazeka, baza kwenza umsindo, bathi, Kutheni na ukuba iNkosi ayenze loo nto kule lizwe nasele ndlu?
Baza kuphendula bathi, Kuba bashiye iNkosi uThixo wabo, owakhupha ooyise eYiputa, bathabathe amadini athile, bathandaza, babezikhonza; ngenxa yoko iNkosi wazisa phezu kwabo zonke ezi zinto zibi.
Wathatha uSolomon iminyaka emashumi mabini, ukuba alungiselele izindlu ezimbini, indlu kaYehova nendlu yokumkani.

Ke kaloku uHiram ukumkani waseTire wamnika uSolomon izityalo zeediliya, nezityalo zeziqhamo, negolide, njengoko wayenqwenela. Ukumkani uSolomon wamnika uHiram imimandla emashumi mabini ezweni laseGalili.
Ke kaloku uHiram waphuma eTire, ukuba ajonge imimandla awayemnika yona uSolomon; ayithandanga.
Wathi, Mhlobo wam, yintoni na le mimandla oyinikayo? Wayibiza loo ndawo igama elithi Ilizwe likaKabuli; ibe yiloo nto ibizwa ngayo mihla le.
Ke kaloku uHiram wamthumelela ukumkani italente zegolide ezimakhulu amabini anamashumi mabini, amalunga namawaka amane eetoni.
Ke kaloku le nto ithethayo ngomsebenzi owenziwe ngukumkani uSolomon, wawenza endlwini kaYehova, nendlu yakhe, neMilo, nodonga lweYerusalem, namadolophu aseHazori, naseMegidido, naseGezere.
Ke kaloku uFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, wayethe wahlasela iGezere, wayithabatha, wamngcwaba, wawabulala amaKanana ahlala kulo; wamnika lo mzi njengesipho somtshato intombi yakhe, umkakhe uSolomon.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wayala inteligentya iGezere; wayala neBhete-horon esezantsi,
noBhahalati, noThamari, engqondweni yelizwe lakhe.
Wazilungisa zonke izixeko zakhe zokugcina izinto, nezixeko zeenqanawa zakhe, nezixeko zeemahama akhe; nantoni na eyamthanda ukwakha yona wayenza eYerusalem, naseLibanoni, nakuzo zonke iilwimi zakhe.
Ke kaloku kwabakho abantu abaseleyo phakathi kwamaAmori, namaHeti, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaYebhusi; aba bantu ke babengaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku abo babeziqhamo zezizwe, abaSirayeli abazange bakwazi ukuzicima zonke; uSolomon wabarapezela ukuba babe ngabakhonzi bakhe, de kube namhlanje.

Ke kaloku kuSirayeli bonke, uSolomon akazange ayenze ibe yimikhonzi yakhe; babe ngabakhosi bakhe, nabaphathi bakhe, nabakumkani bakhe, nabathetheli bakhe, nabakumkani bezithuthi zakhe, nabaqhubi beenqanawa.
Kwabakho namadoda amakhulu amakhulu amahlanu, aneshumi elinesihlanu, abezilawulayo imisebenzi kaSolomon; babephatha abantu abasenza umsebenzi.
Ke kaloku, emva kokuba intombi kaFaro ifudukele emzini kaDavide, iye endlwini kaSolomon, awayeyenza kuye; uSolomon wakwakha uMirove.

Wayinikela uSolomon amaxesha amathathu ngonyaka izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo, phezu kwesibingelelo ebesiyile kuYehova; wasindisa nefuthe phambi koYehova. Wagqiba ke ngoko indlu.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uSolomon wenza iinqanawa eEzion-gebere, entliziyweni yeElathi, emantla elwandle olumnyama, ezweni laseEdom.
Ke kaloku uHiram wathumela amadoda akhe, oomatiloshe abayaziyo ilwandle, ukuba basebenze ngeenqanawa kunye namadoda kaSolomon.
Bahamba ngenqwelo ukuya eOfiri, babuyisela kukumkani uSolomon italente zegolide ezimakhulu amane, anamanci amabini.
Ke kaloku, ukumkani waseSheba wayeva ukuba uSolomon unegama elikhulu ngenxa yegama likaYehova; waya ke ukumvavanya ngemibuzo emibi.

Wafika ke eYerusalem, enosapho olukhulu kakhulu lwabakhonzi bakhe, neenkomo ezithabatha iziqhamo, negolide eninzi kakhulu, namatye abalulekileyo; waya kuSolomon, wathetha naye ngazo zonke izinto ezazisenhliziyweni yakhe.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wamxelela yonke imibuzo yakhe; akukho nto yaba nzima kukumkani ukuba amxelele.
Ukumkani waseSheba, ebona ubulumko bukaSolomon, wabona indlu yakhe ayenzeyo.

nesonka esikwitafile yakhe, nokuhlala kwabathunywa bakhe, nabakhonzi bakhe abagqoke izihlangu zabo, nabenzi bakhe beebhotile, nezibingelelo zakhe eziqhutywa ngamanzi, azenzayo endlwini kaYehova; waphuma umphefumlo kuye.
Wathi kukumkani, Kuyinyaniso yonke into endiyi ndiyiva ezweni lam, ngomsebenzi wakho nobulumko bakho.
Ke mna andikholwanga loo nto, de ndifike, ndazi ngamehlo am; ke kaloku kubonakala ukuba asikuthethwa nam isiqendu sazo na; ubulumko bakho nemali yakho zikhulu kakhulu kunale ndandiyivayo.
Kuhle kangakanani na abantu bakho! Kuhle kangakanani na abaphathi, abahlala phambi kwakho mihla le, beva ubulumko bakho!

UYehova, uThixo wakho, uya kuba luncedo kuwe, ukuba akubeke phezu kwetrone kaSirayeli; ngenxa yokuba iNkosi wayemthanda uSirayeli, ukuze abe ngonaphakade, wakwenza ukuba ube ngukumkani, ukuze wenze into elungileyo neyiyo.

Wanika ke ukumkani italente zegolide ezimakhulu amabini anamashumi mabini, namawaka amahlanu eetoni, neziqhamo ezininzi kakhulu, nezityalo ezibalulekileyo. Akukho namnye owayeza kutshabalalisa iziqhamo ezininzi, njengokuba ukumkani waseShebha wazisa ukumkani uSolomon.
Iinqanawa zikaHiram, ezithabatha igolide eOfiri, zathabatha nemithi ye-almuge, neithayile zexabiso, zininzi kakhulu, eOfiri.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wasebenzisa imithi ye-almugi, ukuba ayenze imigangatho endlwini kaYehova, nendlu yokumkani, nakwiintyatyambo nezandiso zabadlali bengoma. Akukho mthi we-almugi onjalo wabakhoyo, akabonakaliyo ukususela ngaloo mini.

Ukumkani uSolomon wamnika ukumkanikazi waseSheba yonke into ayifumeneyo, ayifumeneyo, ngaphandle kwayo yonke into awayeyamnika yona uSolomon emkhosini wakhe. Wabuya ke waya ezweni lakhe yena nabakhonzi bakhe.
USolomon wafumana ngonyaka ngamnye italente ezimakhulu amathandathu anesithandathu nesixhenxe nesibhozo zegolide.
Ngaphandle kwemali yabarhwebi, nabarhwebi-mali, nakwabakumkani bonke baka-Arabha, nabaphathi belizwe.
Ukumkani uSolomon wenza izikhuselo ezinkulu ezimakhulu amabini, ezenziwe ngegolide ephindwe kabini; iishekeli ezingamawaka amathandathu zegolide zasetyenziswa kwisikhuseli ngasinye.

Wazenza iinqanawa ezincinci ezimakhulu amathathu, ezenziwe ngegolide eqhutywa ngamandla; yasetyenziswa imiyalelo emithathu yegolide kwiinqanawa nganye yazo, ngaphezu kweekhilogram ezilishumi elinambini. Ukumkani wazisa kwindlu yomthi waseLibanoni.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wenza isithsaba esikhulu segolide, wasigqubuthela igolide elungileyo.
Intloko yetrone yayineempawu ezisithandathu, imilenze yayo yajikeleza; kwakukho izitulo zesandla ngaphaya naphaya kwesiqithi, nelilion ehlala phantsi kwesinye isitulo sesandla.
Iileya ezilishumi elinambini zahlala phezu kwezikhonkwane ezintandathu, enye ngasentloko nganye yesikhonkwane ngasinye. Akukho nto yenziweyo enjalo kulo naluphi na uluntu.

Zonke iinkozo zokusela zikakumkani uSolomon zazingwevu, nazo zonke izitya zendlu yomthi waseLibanoni zazingwevu ococekileyo; akukho nto yaba yintyatyambo yesilivere; kuba intyatyambo yesilivere yathathwa njengento encinci kwimihla kaSolomon.

Ukumkani wayenazo iinqanawa zorhwebo ezihamba elwandle, kunye neenqanawa zikaHiram; kwathi minyaka mithathu nganye zibuya iziinqanawa, zithabatha igolide, nesilivere, nentlanzi-mpuma, namagqabi, namachiza.
Ukumkani uSolomon waba mkhulu kunabo-zo zonke izikumkani zehlabathi, ngotyalo-mali nobulumki.
Ihlabathi liphela lafuna ubuso bukaSolomon, ukuva ubulumko bukaThixo, obubeka entliziyweni yakhe.
Ke kaloku, unyaka nonyaka, bonke abafikayo bazisa isipho sabo: izinto zesilivere, negolide, nezihlangu, nezithuthi, neziqhamo, neenkomo, neengulube.
USolomon wathabatha iinqanawa, namakhwenkwe; waba nezigidi ezilishumi elinamakhulu amane einqwelo-moya, namawaka alishumi elinamibini amakhwenkwe. Wazibeka emizini yeenqweno, naye eYerusalem.
Wakwenza ukumkani ukuba isilivere ibe lininzi eYerusalem, njengezithako; izityalo zekedari zibe zininzi njengokuba zikhula iintyatyambo zeziqhamo ezisentshona.
Iingelosi zikaSolomon zavela eYiputa; abarhwebi bakakumkani babezithenga ngeebhokhwe, ibhokhwe nganye ngexabiso elimiselweyo.
Yaphuma eYiputa inqanawa ngamakhulu amathandathu eeshekeli zesilivere, inqanawa ngamakhulu amahlanu eeshekeli zesilivere; bathengisa nabo kubo bonke abakumkani bakaHeti, nabakumkani baseAram.
Ukumkani uSolomon wathanda amadoda amanye amaninzi, ngaphandle kwendodana kaFaro; kwabakho amadoda aseMowabhi, namaAmoni, namaEdomi, namaSidoni, namaHethi.

Bafika kwamazwe aphesheya, iNkosi ebemxelela ngawo amaSirayeli. Waye wathi, Musani ukuba ngabafazi babo, nabo bangabafazi bakho; kuba baya kutshintsha intliziyo yakho, bayilandele idini labo. Ke kaloku uSolomon wabathandela abo madoda.
Waba neentombi ezimakhulu asixhenxe, nezikhulu, namadodakazi angamakhulu amathathu. Amabhinqa akhe aguqule intliziyo yakhe.

Ke kaloku, kwathi ke uSolomon eneminyaka emininzi, amabhinqa akhe atshintshe intliziyo yakhe, aye kulandela amanye amadini; intliziyo yakhe ayizange iphele ngokuthe ngqo kuYehova uThixo wakhe, njengokuba intliziyo kaDavide uyise.
Ke kaloku uSolomon walandela iAshtorethi, intombi kaThixo yamaSidoni, noMilkom, intombi yobuxoki yamaAmmon.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wenza okubi ngamehlo kaYehova; aka ayiphelelanga ekumlandela iNkosi, njengokuba wayemlandele uDavide uyise.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wakha indawo ephakamileyo kaKemoshi, into engalunganga yamaMowabi, entliziyweni yeYerusalem; wakha noMoloki, into engalunganga yamaAmoni.
Wakwenza njalo kubo bonke abazalwana bakhe abasemazweni, ababefumisa uvumba, benikela izibingelelo kuThixo wabo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxhaphaza uSolomon, ngokuba intliziyo yakhe itshintshile kuYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, owabonakala kuye amaxesha amabini.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngaloo nto, esithi, Akuyi kulandela amanye amadini. USolomon ke akawuthobeli umyalelo kaYehova.

Wathi ke iNkosi kuSolomon, Ngokuba wenze loo nto wena, ukuba awugcinenga umnqophiso wam namalungiselelo am, endikumwisela umthetho ngawo, ndiya kukutyhapha ubukumkani bakho, ndibunike kumkhonzi wakho.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa kaDavide uyise wakho, ndiza kuyisenza loo nto ngexesha lokuphila kwakho; ndiya kuyisa esandla somntwana wakho.
Ke kaloku, andiyi kutshisa ubukumkani bonke; ndiya kumnika unyana wakho isizukulwana esisodwa, ngenxa kaDavide umkhonzi wam, ngenxa yeYerusalem endiyikhethileyo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wavusa umkhonzi kuSolomon, nguHadade umEdomi; wayesuka endlwini yokumkani waseEdom.
Ke kaloku, ngelo xesha lidlulileyo, xa uDavide ehlasela iEdom, wanyuka uYowabhi, umphathi womkhosi, ukuba afumane abafayo, wababulala bonke amadoda aseEdom.
Wahlala khona uYowabhi, namadoda-wonke wakwaSirayeli, iinyanga esithandathu, de wabulala onke amadoda aseEdom.
Ke kaloku uHadade wabaleka waya eYiputa, naye namadoda amakhulu aseEdom asebenza kuyise; uHadade ke wayengumntwana.
Basuka eMidiyani, bafika eParan; bathabathe nabo abantu baseParan, bafika eYiputa, kuFaro ukumkani waseYiputa. Wamnika uFaro uHadade indlu, nesonka, nelizwe.
UFaro wamthanda uHadade, waza wamnika indodakazi yakhe, intombi yomyeni wakhe, uTafenis ukumkani.
Udade kaTafenis wamzala uGenubhathe, unyana kaHadade. Wamkhula uTafenis endlwini kaFaro; wahlala khona uGenubhathe phakathi kwabantwana bakaFaro.
Ke kaloku, xa uHadade waye eYiputa, wafunda ukuba uDavide ufile, noYowabhi, umphathi weqela, naye ufile. Wathi uHadade kuFaro, Ndivumele ndihambe ndiya ezweni lam;
Wathi ke uFaro kuye, Ufuna ntoni na apha kum, ukuba ufuna ukubuyela ezweni lakho? Waphendula uHadade wathi, Akukho nto; kodwa mna ndiya kukucela, vumelani ndihambe.
Ke kaloku uThixo wavusa omnye umchasi kuSolomon, nguRezon unyana kaEliyada; wayesele ephuma kumphathi wakhe, uHadarezere ukumkani waseTsoba.
Ke kaloku, emva kokuba uDavide wabulala uSobha, uReshon wamthabatha amadoda kuye, waba ngukumkani weqela lamagqwetha; bafika eDamasko, bahlala khona, babe ngabalawuli eDamasko.
Ke kaloku uReshon waba ngumthandi wamaSirayeli zonke iintsuku zobomi bukaSolomon, kwakunye noHadade owenza amaSirayeli abe buhlungu; waza waphulaphula amaSirayeli, waba ngukumkani eAram.
UYerebhoyamu unyana kaNabati, umEfrayim waseZereda, omnye wabakhonzi bakaSolomon; igama lonina lalinguSeruha, indoda engatshatanga. Wathi ke yena kukumkani:
Ke kaloku, waphuma ke uYowabhi waya eMilo. USolomon wayeseyile iMilo, ukuba aqinise umngxunya wodonga lomzi kaDavide, uyise.
Ke kaloku uYerebhoyamu waba ngumntu onamandla, mkhulule. Wabona ke uSolomon lo mntwana esebenza kanzima; wakwenza ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu komsebenzi onke wamaSirayeli oonyana bakaYosefu.
Ke kaloku, xa uYerebhoyamu ephuma eYerusalem, wadibana naye umprofeti uAhiya waseShilo, emlonyeni wakhe; uAhiya wayegqoke iingubo ezintsha; babe bengaphi na ngaphandle kwelizwe.
Ke kaloku uAhiya wathabatha isibhakabhaka esitsha, ebesigqokeyo, wayiluka ibe ziinxalenye ezilishumi elinambini.
Wathi kuYarobheham, Zithathele wena iziqwenga ezilishumi; ngokuba utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Yabona, ndiya kukhupha ubukumkani esandla sikaSolomon, ndikunike iintsapho ezilishumi.
Ke kaloku uSolomon uya kuba neqela elinye, ngenxa yomkhonzi wam uDavide, ngenxa yeYerusalem, lo mzi endiwukhethele kuzo zonke iintlanga zakwaSirayeli.

Ke kaloku ndiya kwenza oku, ngokuba bamishiya, bamkhonza uAshtorethi iNkosi yamaSidoni, noKemoshi uThixo wamaMowabi, noMilkom uThixo wamaAmmoniti; abahambanga ngeendlela zam, bangayenzanga into elungileyo ngamehlo am, begcina imigaqo yam nemiyalelo yam, njengokuba wenzayo uDavide, uyise kaSolomon.

Ke kaloku, andiyi kuthabatha ubukumkani bonke esandla sikaSolomon; ndiya kwenza ukuba abe ngukumkani zonke iintsuku zobomi bakhe, ngenxa yomkhonzi wam uDavide, endiwukhethileyo, ogcine imimiselo yam nemimiselo yam.
Ndiya kuthatha ubukumkani esandla somntwana wakhe, ndikunike izizwe ezilishumi.
Unyana wakhe ndiya kumnika isizukulwana esisodwa, ukuze umkhonzi wam uDavide abe nelanga phambi kwam ngonaphakade eYerusalem, emzini endiwukhethileyo ukuba libekwe khona igama lam.
Ndiya kukuthabatha wena, ube ngukumkani kuwo onke amathandabuzo entliziyweni yakho; ube ngukumkani kumaSirayeli.

Ke ukuba uya kuthobela zonke izinto endikuwiselayo, uhambe ngeendlela zam, wenze okulungileyo ngamehlo am, uzigcine imithetho yam nemimiselo yam, njengokuba wenzayo umkhonzi wam uDavide;држa ndiya kuba nawe. Ndiza kwenza kuwe isizukulwana esizinzileyo, njengoko ndenza kuye uDavide, ndikunike wena amaSirayeli.
Ndiya kuxhaphaza iziqhamo zikaDavide ngenxa yaloo nto, kodwa hayi ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wafuna ukumbulala uYerebhoyamu. Wavuka ke uYerebhoyamu, waya eYiputa, kuShishaki ukumkani waseYiputa; waba eYiputa, de wafa uSolomon.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uSolomon, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, nobulumko bakhe, ngaba azibhalwenga encwadini yamaNgqina kaSolomon?
USolomon waba ngukumkani eYerusalem, kumaSirayeli onke, iminyaka emashumi mane.
Wafa ke uSolomon, wabanjwa emzini kaDavide uyise; uRehobhowam unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ke kaloku uRehobhowam waya eShekemi; ngokuba bonke amaSirayeli babethe bafika eShekem, ukuba benze ukumkani kuye.
Ke kaloku uYaroboham, unyana kaNebhat, wava ke loo nto; wayeseYiputa, apho wayesele ephuma khona phambi kokumkani uSolomon, waba khona.
Bathumela abantu ukuba bamwise. Wafika ke uYerebhoyamu, nebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, bathetha noRehobha, besithi,
Wathi ubaba wakho kuthi, Umsebenzi wethu wawunzima; ngoko ke, nceda ukhawuleze umsebenzi wethu onzima, nobunzima bempahla yethu, abenze ngayo ubaba wakho kuthi, siza kukukhonza wena.
Wathi uRe pat vahanemuoči, Nihambeni iintsuku ezintathu, ni foydalanishele kum; abantu ke baphuma.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uRehobhowam wacebisa amadoda amakhulu, asebenzela kuSolomon uyise xa ephilayo, wathi kubo: Nindixelele ntoni na ukuba ndiphendule la bantu?
Bathi kuye, Ukuba ngoku uya kuba ngumkhonzi wale ndoda namhlanje, ube ngumsebenzi wayo, uphendule kubo ngelizwi elilungileyo, baya kuba ngabakhonzi bakho ngonaphakade.
Wayeka ke uRehobhowam icebiso labo abakhulu ababemnika lona; wabuza iingcebiso oonyana bakhe abakhulela naye, abakhonzayo.
Wathi kubo, Nicebisa ntoni na? Siphendule njani kulabo bantu abathe bathetha nam, besithi, Unciphise ubunzima obubekayo ubaba wakho kuthi?

Bathi kuye amadoda amancinci akhulela naye, bathi, Kuba la madoda akuxelele, athi, Ubaba wakho wawunzimalise umthwalo wethu, kodwa usisihlelele; uthi kubo njalo, Umnwe wam omncinane ubanzi kunamathambo kayise.
Ubaba wam wawenza umthwalo wenu mkhulu, mna ke ndiya kukwenza ube mkhulu; ubaba wam wakuzibulala ngeebhokhwe, mna ke ndiza kuzibulala ngeeskorpiyo.
Ke kaloku uYerebhoyamu, nabantu bonke, babuyela kuRehobhowam ngemini yesithathu, njengoko ukumkani abewisela umthetho ngayo, esithi, Buya kum ngemini yesithathu.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wabaphendula abantu ngelizwi elibi; washiya icebiso labo abakhulu, ababemnike lona.

Wathi ke kuye, ngokwengcebiso yamadoda amancinci, esithi, Ubaba wam wakwenza ukuba kube nzima umthwalo wenu, kodwa mna ndiya kwenza ukuba ube buhlungu; ubaba wam wakwenza ukuba niqhutywe ziintsontelo, kodwa mna ndiya kwenza ukuba niqhutywe ziintsontelo.
Ke kaloku ukumkani akawaphulaphulanga abantu; kuba kwakusuka kuYehova loo nto, ukuze kubekho lizwi likaYehova, elalithetha nguAhiya waseShilo kuYarobheham unyana kaNabati.

Bathe ke bonke amaSirayeli bebona ukuba ukumkani akawaphulaphulanga, baphendula uSirayeli kuye, bathi, Sinayo na inxaxheba kuDavide? Asinayo inxaxheba kunyana kaYese. Yiya ezintlanganisweni zakho, Isirayeli; uDavide, lungisa ngoku indlu yakho. Baye ke amadoda aseSirayeli endlwini yakhe.
Ke kaloku uRehobhowam waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli abahlala emizini kaYuda.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uRehobhowam wathumela uHadoram, umphathi weempahla zomsebenzi; bonke amaSirayeli bamthabatha ngamatye, waza wafa. Ukumkani uRehobhowam wakhawuleza enyuka kwimoto yakhe, waya eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli athabathela endlu kaDavide, waya kusasa.

Ke kaloku, beva bonke amaSirayeli ukuba uYerebhoyamu wabuya, bamwisela engqungqutheleni, bakwenza waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli onke; kwakungekho namnye ohlala phantsi kwendlu kaDavide, ngaphandle kwesizukulwana sikaYuda.

Wafika ke uRehobhowam eYerusalem, wahlanganisa bonke abantu bakaYuda nesizwe sikaBhenjamin, amawaka amakhulu asibhozo anamakhulu asibhozo, oodade abakhethiweyo bokulwa, ukuba bahambe behlasela amaSirayeli, babuyisele ubukumkani kuRehobhowam unyana kaSolomon.
Ke kaloku kwafika ilizwi likaThixo kuShemaya, indoda kaThixo, lisithi,
Utsho kuRehobhowam, unyana kaSolomon, ukumkani wakwaYuda, nakubantu bonke bakaYuda nabaBhenjamini, nakwabanye abantu, uthi kubo,

Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Musani kukhupha, nokulwa nabazalwana benu, oonyana bakaSirayeli. Yiya nisekhayeni lenu ngamnye; ngokuba ndiye ndenza okuyo loo nto. Baphulaphule ke ilizwi likaYehova, babuyela ekhayeni labo, njengokuba wathi iNkosi.
Ke kaloku uYarobheham wakwakha iShekem, ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim, waya kuhlala khona; waphuma apho, wakwakha iPhenuyeli.
Wathi uYerebhoyamu engqondweni yakhe, Ngokuba ubukumkani buya kubuyela kwindlu kaDavide.

Ukuba abantu aba baya phezulu benikela izibingelelo endlwini kaYehova eYerusalem, intliziyo yabo iya kubuyela kumphathi wabo uRehobhowam ukumkani wakwaYuda; banambulala mna, babuye kuma-Rehobhowam ukumkani wakwaYuda.

Ke kaloku ukumkani, ethe wathetha-thethana nabo, wenza iinkunzi zegolide ezimbini; wathi kubo, Kunzima kakhulu kuwe ukunyuka ufike eYerusalem; bona ke, Israel, la madini akho, awazikhuphileyo ezweni laseYiputa.
Wabeka inkomo enye eBheteli jav widwa ammoni, nenye ikwiDan.
Ke kaloku le nto yaba yintlungu,; kuba abantu babehamba besiya eDan, bakhonza khona inkomo.
Ke kaloku uYerebhoyamu walungisa iindawo eziphakamileyo, waza wenza ababingeleli kubo bonke abantu, abangabakho kwisizukulwana sikaLevi.

Ke kaloku uYerebhoyamu wamisa isikhumbuzo, ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga, ngemini yeshumi elinesihlanu yalo montagzi, njengesikhumbuzo sakwaYuda; wanikela phezu kwesibingelelo. Wayenza loo nto eBheteli, wanikela ngeenkomo azenzayo; wababeka ke eBheteli ababingeleli beendawo eziphakamileyo azenzayo.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla weshumi elinesihlanu wenyanga yesibhozo, yenyanga awaye wayikhethela ngokwakhe, wanyuka waya esibingeleli asenzayo eBheteli; wamisa iholide kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, wanyuka waya kwisibingelelo, ukuba afumise uvumba.
Ke kaloku, kwafika umntu kaThixo osuka eYuda waya eBheteli, ngelizwi likaYehova; uYaroboham ke wayesecaleni kwesibingelelo, elungiselela ukufakela intyatyambo.

Ke kaloku umntu kaThixo, ngelizwi likaYehova, wayalela esibingeleli esithi: Isibingelelo! isibingelelo! Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Yabona, kuzalwa umntwana endlwini kaDavide, igama lakhe lisithiyo nguYosiya; naye uya kubasindisa phezu kwakho oombingeleli bezinto eziphakamileyo abafumisa intyatyambo emehlweni akho, yaye amathambolasabantu aya kutshawa phezu kwako.
Ke kaloku wamisa uphawu ngaloo mini, wathi, Olu luphawu lokuba iNkosi uthe: Yabona, isibingelelo siza kunqunyulwa, inkungu yayo iya kuqhuma.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uYerebhoyamu, xa ephulaphule igama lomntu kaThixo, fallo ilizwi lakhe, elitshoyo phezu kwesibingelelo esiseBheteli, waphakamisa uYerebhoyamu icala lakhe ukusuka kwisibingelelo, esithi, Nciphisaneni naye. Ke kaloku isandla sakhe, ebesimile kuye, satshisa; akakwazanga ukuyibuyisela.
Ke kaloku isibingelelo saqhutywa, uthuli lwaso lwaphuma, njengokuba watsho umntu kaThixo ngophawu iNkosi wamnika lona.

Wathi ukumkani kumntu kaThixo, Nceda uxelele iNkosi uThixo wakho ukuba amthande, undixelele, ukuze isandla sam siphile kwakhona. Wathandaza ke lo mntu kaThixo kuYehova, saphila kwakhona isandla sikakumkani, saphinda safana nesiqalo.
Wathi ukumkani kulowo mntu kaThixo, Yiya ekhaya nam, uphuze isidlo sakusasa; ndiza kukunika umvuzo.
Waphendula ke lo mntu kaThixo ukumkani, wathi, Nakuba ungandinika isiqingatha sezinto zakho zonke, andiyi kungena nawe; andizukudla isonka, andizukusela amanzi kule ndawo.
UYehova wandiwisela umthetho, esithi, Musa ukutya isonka, ungaselanga amanzi; musa ukubuya ngendlela osuka kuyo.
Wahamba ke ngendlela eyahlukileyo, akabuyanga ngendlela awayefika ngayo eBheteli.
Ke kaloku kukho umprofeti omdala ohlala eBheteli. Bafika oonyana bakhe, bamxelela zonke izinto azenzayo khona loo mntu kaThixo ngaloo mini; bayamxelela ubaba wabo nantoni na athethayo ukumkani.
Wathi kubo utata wabo, Wayephi indlela awayehamba ngayo? Bathe ke oonyana bakhe babone indlela awayehamba Esanvostwa kaThixo eya eYuda.
Wathi kubo oonyana bakhe, Nciphisa isikhephe kumkhweli wam. Bathi ke kuye, Nciphisa isikhephe kumkhweli wamkhweli; wahamba phezu kwayo.
Waya emva komntu kaThixo, wamfumana ehlala phantsi kweenduli. Wathi kuye, Ngaba wena ungumntu kaThixo ovela eYuda? Waphendula wathi, Ndiye.
Wathi kuye lo mprofeti, Yiya ekhaya nam, usele inkukhu.
Wathi kuye lo mntu kaThixo, Andikwazi ukubuyela nawe, ndiya kungena ekhaya lakho; andizukudla isonka, andizukusela amanzi nawe kule ndawo.
UYehova wathi kum, Musa ukutya isonka apho, ungasela amanzi khona; musa ukubuya ngendlela osuka kuyo.
Wathi kuye lo mprofeti, Ndingumprofeti nanjengoko wena; isithunywa sezulu sathetha nam ngelizwi elivela kuYehova, sathi, Yibuyisele endlwini yakho, asele isonka, asele amanzi. Ke kaloku wayemxolela.
Wabuyela naye lo mntu kaThixo, wadla isonka, wasela amanzi endlwini yakhe.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa behlala ekhitshini, kwafika igama likaYehova kumprofeti omdala owambuyiselayo.
Wathi kumntu kaThixo owafika eYuda, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Uthe waphulaphula ulwimi lukaYehova; awugcinenga umyalelo kaYehova uThixo wakho wamwisela wona.
Wabuya, wadla isonka, wasela amanzi, kwindawo apho wathi kuwe, Musa ukutya isonka, nisele amanzi; ngoko ke isisu sakho asiyi kugcinwa kwisibingelelo sabafazi bakho.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu kaThixo egqibile ukutya nokusela, lo mprofeti wamisa isikelezi sakhe.

Ke kaloku, ekuhambeni kwakhe ngendlela, yadibana naye inkunzi yenkomo ekungeneni kwendlela, wayibulala; ithambo lakhe lalibanjwa ekungeneni kwendlela, nebhokhwe ihlala phantsi kwayo; inkunzi yebhokhwe nayo yahlala phantsi kwayo.
Ke kaloku, abantu abadlulayo bebona isidumbu silele ecaleni kwendlela, nelilo lisecaleni kwalo; bafika ke, baxela kuloo mzi, apho wayehlala khona lo mprofeti omdala.

Ke kaloku, umprofeti oneminyaka emininzi ubudala, lowo wambuyiselayo, wakubona oko, wathi, Lo ngumntu kaThixo owaphulaphula ulwimi lukaYehova; ngoko ke iNkosi wamnikela kulilivo, lalimcaphukisa, lalimbulala, njengoko iNkosi abemxelele.
Wathi kubo oonyana bakhe, Nceda mnikele inkunzi yeegusha. Baze bayibeke iigusha kuyo;
Waya, wafumana isidumbu sibekwe ecaleni kwendlela, nebhokhwe nayo, nelili lisecaleni kwalo; ilili alidlisi isidumbu, lingabikho nalo elibhokhwe.
Wathabatha ke lo mprofeti isiqu somntu kaThixo, wayibeka phezu kweebhokhwe, wayisa edolophini yakhe, ukuba aphumle kuye, aze amzise.
Wabeka isidumbu sakhe kwisibingelelo saso; batenelela kuye, besithi, Udade wam!
Ke kaloku, emva kokumzika kwakhe, wathetha oonyana bakhe, esithi, Xa ndifa, mnikele kum kwisibhedlele apho umntu kaThixo ekhutshwe khona; nibeke iinwele zam phantsi kweenwele zakhe.
Ngokuqinisekileyo kuya kwenziwa oko watshoyo, ngomyalelo kaYehova, ngesibingelelo esiseBheteli, nezindlu zonke eziphakamileyo ezimizini yaseSamari.

Ke kaloku, emva kwaloo nto, uYerebhoyamu akabuyanga kwindlela yakhe embi; waqhubeka esenza ababingeleli beendawo eziphakamileyo kubo bonke abantu. Wonke umntu ofuna ukuba ngumbingeleli, wayemmisa ukuze abe ngababingeleli beendawo eziphakamileyo.
Le nto yayiyisono sasekhaya likaYerebhoyamu, sabangela ukuba baphelelwe, bacinywe phezu komhlaba.
Ke kaloku, ngaloo xesha jav widwa ammoni uAbiya unyana kaYaroboham.

Wathi uYerebhoyamu kumfazi wakhe, Nceda zula, uzigqogqe, ukuze akukho namnye okwaziyo ukuba ungumfazi wam; uye ke eShilo; kuba kukho khona uAhiya umprofeti, owayendixelela ukuba ndiya kuba ngukumkani kubo bonke abantu.
Yithathe ngesandla sakho iziqhamo ezilishumi, neentyatyambo, nebhotile yenkukhu, uye kuye; yena uya kukuxelela oko kuza kwenzeka kulo mntwana.
Wakwenza ke umfazi kaYerebhoyamu njengokuba wathi; wavuka, waya eShilo, weza ekhaya likaAhiya. Ke kaloku akakwazanga ukumbona uAhiya, ngokuba wayethe mkhulu ngenxa yobude bakhe.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuAhiya, Yabona, umkakhe uYerebhoyamu uya kuza kukubuza ngonyana wakhe, ngokuba unesifo; uthi kuye into endiyithethayo kuwe; xa efika, uya kwenza ukuba ngumnye.
Ke kaloku, akuva uAhiya imilenze yakhe emehlweni emnyango, wathi, Yiya, mkakhe uYerebhoyamu; kutheni na ke ukuba ungumnye? Ndithunyelwe kuwe ngeendaba ezibi.
Yiya, uthethe noYaroboham, uthi, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Ndakuphakamisa wena phakathi kwabantu, ndakwenza ube ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bam bakaSirayeli.

Ndayisusa ubukumkani endlwini kaDavide, ndabunika kuwe; wena ke awuzange ube njengenkosi yam uDavide, owayegcina imiyalelo yam, wayemlandela ngentliziyo yakhe yonke, esenza okulungileyo kuphela phambi kwam.
Wakwenza okubi kakhulu kunabo bonke ababengaphambili kwakho; wazenza ngokwakho izithixo ezinye, imifanekiso eqingqiweyo yobhedu, ukuze undikhokelele emlonyeni wam, uyenzile umva wakho kum.

Ndiyabona ke, mna ndiza kuzisa ilahleko kwindlu kaYarobheham; ndiya kuyicima yonke inkunzi yendlu kaYarobheham eSirayeli, ibe ngumkhonzi, ibe ngumntu okhululekileyo; ndiya kuzitshisa zonke izindlu zikaYarobheham, njengokuba umntu ezitshisa khona inkunkuma, de ziphele.
Wonke umntu kaYerebhoyamu ofa edolophini, iinkunzi zekati ziya kumdla; onke umntu ofa esikolweni, intaka iya kumdla; iNkosi uthi njalo.
Ke wena, zula, uye ekhaya lakho; xa ufika edolophini, lo mntwana uya kufa.

OoSirayeli bonke baya kumlingisa, bayamzika; kuba nguye kuphela endlwini kaYerebhoyamu oza kuvulwa emgodini; ngokuba nguye kuphela endlwini kaYerebhoyamu apho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, wafumana khona into elungileyo.
UYehova uya kuphakamisa ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, oza kucima indlu kaYerebhoyamu. Yiyo loo mini! Yaye ke ngoku.

UYehova uya kubetha amaSirayeli, aze abe ngathi utyhala intambo emanzini; uya kubasusa amaSirayeli kuloo mhlaba mhle, awawanika ootata babo, wabasabalalisa ngaphesheya komlambo uEfrayim, ngenxa yokuba bayenze iAshere, bephulaphula iNkosi.
Uya kuwashiya amaSirayeli ngenxa yezono zikaYerebhoyamu, azenzayo iziSirayeli.
Wavuka ke umfazi kaYerebhoyamu, waya, wafika eTirsa. Yathi iphuma emngxunyeni wendlu yakhe, lo mntwana wabafa.
Bathi bonke amaSirayeli bamzingela, babhiyozela kuye, ngokwelizwi likaYehova elalithetha ngalo ngomkhonzi wakhe uAhiya umprofeti.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uYerebhoyamu, nendlela awayehlasela ngayo, nokuziphatha kwakhe njengokumkani, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi yemihla ngemihla yamaKumkani bakaSirayeli?
UYarobheham waba ngukumkani iminyaka emashumi mabini anababini; wafa ke; uNadabhi, unyana wakhe, waba ngukumkani emva kwakhe.

URehobhowam, unyana kaSolomon, waba ngukumkani kuYuda. Wayeminyaka imashumi mane ananye ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe engukumkani eYerusalem, lo mzi owawukhetha iNkosi kuzo zonke iintlanga zakwaSirayeli, ukuba abeke khona igama lakhe. Umkakhe wayenguNaama umAmoni.
Bathi oonyana bakaYuda basenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; bamenza ukuba abe nobuxoki ngezono zabo, ngaphezu kokwenza kwabo ooyise.
Bathi ke nabo balungiselela izikhululo eziphakamileyo, neentyatyambo zegolide, namachibi eAshere, kuwo onke amahlathi aphezulu, phantsi komthi wonke oluhlaza.
Ke kaloku kwabakho namadoda ahamba ngeebhokhwe ezweni; abantu ke basenza zonke izinto ezibi zobuxoki zabazwe, ezo iNkosi wazikhupha phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Ngomnyaka wesixhenxe wokumkani u-Rehobhowam, waya eYerusalem uSheshaki ukumkani waseYiputa.
Wathabatha iikhabhathi zendlu kaYehova, neikhabhathi zendlu yokumkani; wathabatha zonke izinto, nazo zonke izikhuselo zegolide azenzayo uSolomon.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uRehobhowam wenza izithuthi zentsimbi endaweni yazo, waza wazisa engqondweni yamapolisa alawula isango lendlu kakumkani.
Ke kaloku, xa ukumkani efika endlwini kaYehova, abagwebi babezithabatha izithuthi; emva koko bezibhiyozela kwigumbi labagwebi.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uRehobhowam, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, ngaba azibhalwenga encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani amaYuda?
Kwabakho umkhosi phakathi kukaRehobhowam noYaroboham, iintsuku zonke.
Ke kaloku uRehobhowam walala, wabanjwa nabafazi bakhe edolophini kaDavide. Unyana wakhe wayenguNaama umAmoni; uAbiyamu unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo wokumkani uYerebhoyamu, unyana kaNabati, waba ngukumkani uAbiyamu kuYuda.
Waye engukumkani eYerusalem iminyaka emithathu. Unyana ka-Abhisalom uMahaka waba nguyise wakhe.
Wahamba ngezono zonke azenzayo uyise phambi kwakhe; intliziyo yakhe ayizange iphele ngoYehova uThixo wakhe, njengentliziyo kaDavide, utata wakhe.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa kaDavide, iNkosi, uThixo wakhe, wamnika uAbiya ilanga eYerusalem; wamnika unyana ukuba abe ngukumkani emva kwakhe; waqinisa ke iYerusalem.
Wakwenza oko, ngokuba uDavide wayesenza okulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova. Wonke ubomi bakhe uDavide akazange ahambe nakweyiphi na into awayemwise ngayo iNkosi, ngaphandle kwetyala likaUriya umHeti.
Kwakukho kria phakathi kukaRehobhowam noYaroboham, zonke iintsuku zobomi bukaAbiya.
Ezinye izinto azenzayo uAbhiyam, nazo zonke izinto zakhe, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi yeendaba zamakumkani bakaYuda? Kwakukho umkhosi phakathi kukaAbhiyam noYaroboham.
Ke kaloku u/Abhiyam wafa, waba yinkosi edolophini kaDavide; u/Asa unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesibini kaYeroboham ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uAsa waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda.
Waye engukumkani eYerusalem iminyaka emashumi mane anesithathu. Unyana kaMahaka, intombi ka-Abhisalom, waba ngumama wakhe.
Ke kaloku uAsa wenza oko kulungile emehlo kaYehova, njengoko wayekwenzela uDavide, uyise.
Wakhupha ezweni oonyana bakaSirayeli, ababhiyozelayo, wasusa zonke iintaka ezifana nomlilo, ababezenza ooyise.
Ke kaloku uMahaka, umkakhe, wamsusa ukuba abe ngukumkani, ngenxa yokuba wayeyenze imifanekiso engaqhelekanga ka-Ashere. UAsa wayicima le mifanekiso engaqhelekanga, wayitshisa emlanjeni weKedron.
Iindawo eziphakamileyo azisuswa; ke kaloku intliziyo ka-Asa yayigqibelele kuYehova zonke iintsuku zakhe.
Waza wazisa endlwini kaYehova isilivere, negolide, nezithuthi, ezo wayezilungiselele yena noyise uThixo.
Kwabakho umkhosi phakathi kukaAsa noBhasha ukumkani wakwaSirayeli zonke iintsuku zobomi babo.
Ke kaloku uBhasha ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wahlasela amaYuda, wakwakha iRama, ukuba akukho mntu oza kungena nokuphuma kuAsa ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.

Wathabatha ke uAsa isilivere negolide zonke, ezishiyekileyo kwiikhabhathi zendlu kaYehova nasendlwini yokumkani; waza wazisa kumakhonzi akhe, wabathumela kuBhe-hadadi ukumkani waseAram, owayehlala eDamaseki. UBehadada wayeyintombi kaTabrimmon, intombi kaHezion.

Nceda senze umnqophiso, njengokuba kwaba phakathi kukayise wam noyise wakho; bona, ndithumelela isipho sesilivere negolide. Yiya uphucule umnqophiso wakho noBhasha ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ukuze amshiye mna.

Ke kaloku uBhenjamin-hadadi wamthobela ukumkani uAsa; wathumela abathetheli bakhe bemikhosi, waya kumadolophu kaSirayeli; bahlasela iIyon, noDan, noAbhiele, neBhete-maakha, nayo yonke iKinnerethi, nalo lonke ilizwe likaNafetali.
Ke kaloku, xa uBhasha wayeva oku, wayeka ukukwakha iRama, waya eThirsa.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uAsa wabeka umthetho kuwo onke amaYuda; akukho namnye Usisono. Bathabathe iithayile nemithi, ebeyisebenzisayo uBhahasha ekwakha iRama; wabalungisa ngazo ukumkani uAsa iGibeha kaBhenjamin, neMizpa.

Ezinye izinto azenzayo uAsa, zonke iimpembelelo zakhe, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, nemizi awayeyenzayo, zihleli zibhalwe encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani bakaYuda? Ke kaloku, xa wayekhulule, waba nesifo samadolo akhe.
Walala ke uAsa, wabanjwa nababukumkani bakhe edolophini kaDavide umzali wakhe; uYoshuwafati unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UNadab, unyana kaYerebhoyamu, waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli ngomnyaka wesibini kaAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda; uNadab waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emibini.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; wahamba ngeendlela zikayise, nesono sikayise, esenza ukuba amaSirayeli ahambe.
Ke kaloku uBhasha, unyana ka-Ahiya, wesizwe sika-Issakare, wenza isithethe kuNadabhi; wabulala uBhasha uNadabhi eGibethoni, emzini wamaFilisti, apho uNadabhi noSirayeli bonke besuka khona.
UBhasha wambulala uNadab, ngonyaka wesithathu kaAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda; waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.

Ke kaloku, kwathi ke uBhasha esuka waba ngukumkani, wabulala ikhaya lonke likaYerebhoyamu; akashiyenga mntu ophilayo kuYerebhoyamu; wawaphelisa onke, ngokwelizwi likaYehova elalithetha ngalo ngomnxeba kaAhiya umkhonzi wakhe waseShilo.
Yathi loo nto ngenxa yezono zikaYerebhoyamu, awazenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba aziphathe ngazo; ngenxa yokuba wavusa iNkosi uThixo kaSirayeli.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uNadabhi, nazo zonke iintshukumo zakhe, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi yemihla ngemihla yamakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Kwabakho umkhosi phakathi kukaAsa noBhasha ukumkani wakwaSirayeli zonke iintsuku zobomi babo.
Ngomnyaka wesibini kaAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda, uBhasha unyana ka-Ahiya waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli onke eTirsa; waba neminyaka emashumi mabini anane.
Wakwenza okubi ngamehlo kaYehova; wahamba ngeendlela zikaYarobhoham, nesono sikaYarobhoham, owenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba ahambe.
Ke kaloku kwa pat fifnemu Fizi, ilizwi likaYehova lafika ku foydalanisha uYehu unyana kaHanani, lithetha ngoBhasha, lisithi,

Ndinikhuphe emlilweni, ndakwenza ube ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bam bakaSirayeli; wena ke wahamba ngeendlela zikaYarobhoham, wabangele abantu bam bakaSirayeli ukuba benze isono, ukuze ndicaphuke ngenxa yezono zabo.
Ndiya kubona ke, ndiya kucima uBhasha nosapho lwakhe ngokupheleleyo; ndiya kwenza usapho lwakho lube njengosapho lukaYaroboham unyana kaNabati.
Abafayo endlwini kaBhasha emzini, iinkunzi zeegusha ziya kubadla; abafayo emaphandleni, intaka iza kubadla.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uBhasha, nento ayeyenzayo, nobutyebi bakhe, zihleli zibhalwe encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani bakaSirayeli.
Wafa uBhasha, wabanjwa eTirsa. UEla unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.

Ke kaloku ilizwi likaYehova lafika ngesandla sikaYehu umprofeti, unyana kaHanani, kuBhasha nosapho lwakhe; ngenxa yezinto zonke ezibi azenzayo uBhasha ngamehlo eNkosini, ukuze amxolele ngomsebenzi wakhe, ukuba abe njengosapho lukaYarobhoham, yaye ngokuba wabulala ubomi bakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinambini nesithandathu kaAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda, uEla unyana kaBhasha waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli eTirsa; waba neminyaka emibini.
Ke kaloku uZimri, omnye wabakhonzi bakhe, umphathi wesiqingatha Usisono. Uthe ke uEla eThirsa wayesele esela endlwini kaArsa, umntu olawula indlu yaseThirsa.
Wafika ke uZimri, wabetha uEla, wambulala; kwaba ngomnyaka wesibini wesixhenxe kaAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda. UZimri waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ke kaloku, kwathi ke uZimri waba ngukumkani, wahlala kwisithsaba sakhe, wabulala ikhaya lonke likaBhasha; akashiyenga mntu omnye ophilayo phakathi kwabahlobo bakhe naphakathi kwabahlobo bakhe.
Ke kaloku uZimri wabulala indlu yonke kaBhasha, njengokuba iNkosi wayethe wathi ngoBhasha, ngesandla sikaYehu umprofeti.
Kwaba njalo ngenxa yezono zonke zikaBhahasha, noEla unyana wakhe, abo bazenzayo iintliziyo zabo zibe zinikele kuYehova uThixo kaSirayeli, ngezinto zabo ezingenanto.
Konke okuseleyo kwezinto azenzayo uEla, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, ngaba akubhalwenga encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Ngomnyaka wesibini wesixhenxe kaAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda, uZimri waba ngukumkani eThirsa iintsuku ezisixhenxe; amaSirayeli aye eGibethoni, emzini wamaFilisti.

Ke kaloku, beva oonyana bakaSirayeli abasemagunyeni ukuba uZimri wenza isithethe, wabulala ukumkani; ke bona bonke amaSirayeli bakwenza uOmri, umphathi womkhosi, waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli ngaloo mini, emaguni.
Wathi ke uOmri, nabaSirayeli bonke naye, banyuka besuka eGibhathoni, bagubungela iThirsa.
Ke kaloku, xa uZimri ebona ukuba lo mzi uthathelwe, waphuma waya kwindlu kakumkani ekhuselekileyo; wamisa umlilo indlu kakumkani phezu kwakhe, wafa.
Wafa ngenxa yezono zakhe azenzayo, wenza oko kubi ngamehlo kaYehova, ehamba ngeendlela zikaYarobhoham, nesono sikaYarobhoham, owenzayo amaSirayeli.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uZimri, nokwenza kwakhe umkhosi kukumkani, zithe zabhalwe ncwadi yemihla ngemihla yamaKumkani amaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku abantu bakaSirayeli bahlukaniswa babe ngamaqela amabini; inxenye yabo yafuna ukumenza uTibni, unyana kaGinathi, ukumkani; inxenye yabo yalandela uOmri.
Ke kaloku abakhonzi baka-Omri babenamandla kunabakhonzi bakaTibni unyana kaGinathi. Wafa ke uTibni, waba ngukumkani uOmri.
Ngomnyaka wesithandathu nesithathu kaAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda, uOmri waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli; waba neminyaka elishumi elinambini engukumkani; iminyaka emithandathu yaba ngukumkani eTirsa.

Wathenga umnqamlezo waseSamari kuShemer, ngeetoni ezimashumi asixhenxe zesilivere; wakwakha phezu komnqamlezo lo mzi, wabiza igama lakhe ngokuba yiSamari, ngokutsho kwegama likaShemer, owayengumnini womnqamlezo.
Wakwenza uOmri okubi emehlweni kaYehova; wakwenza ngcono kunabo bonke abakumkani ababengaphambili kwakhe.
Wahamba ngeendlela zonke zikaYaroboham unyana kaNabati, nezono zikaYaroboham, owenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba aziphathe ngazo; bamangalisa iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, ngezinto zabo ezingenanto.
Elinye ilifa likaOmri, namandla akhe, akunjalo? Libhalwe encwadini yemihla ngemihla yamakumkani bakaSirayeli.
Wafa uOmri, wabanjwa eSamari; uAhabhi unyanaaidheana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.

Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesithathu nesibhozo ka-Asa ukumkani wakwaYuda, uAhabhi unyana kaOmri waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli. UAhabhi unyana kaOmri waba ngukumkani wamaSirayeli eSamari minyaka imashumi mabini anesibini.
Ke kaloku uAhabhi, unyana kaOmri, wenza okubi emlonyeni kaYehova, ngaphezu kookumkani bonke ababengaphambili kwakhe.
Ke kaloku, kungenjalo nje ukuba ahambe ngezono zikaYarobheham unyana kaNabati, wazala noYezebeli intombi ka-Ethbaal ukumkani wamaSidoni; wakhonza uBhaali, wamnikela kuye.
Wamisa isibingelelo kuBhala, endlwini kaBhala, awayeyenza eSamari.
Ke kaloku uAhabhi wenza iAshere. Wakwenza okuninzi ukuxhaphaza iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, kunazo zonke izikumkani zakwaSirayeli ezingaphambili kwakhe.

Ke kaloku uHiyeli waseBheteli, emihla kaAhabhi ukumkani, wayala kwakhona iYerusalem; wabeka iziseko zayo ngobomi bukaAbiron, unyana wakhe omdala, waza wamisa iindonga zayo ngobomi bukaSegub, unyana wakhe omncinane, ngokwelizwi likaYehova elalithetha ngalo nguYoshuwa unyana kaNun.
Wathi uEliya waseTishbhe, ohlala eGiliyadi, kuAhabhi, Uphila iNkosi uThixo kaSirayeli, Thixo wam, ukuba akusayi kubakho umsi namanzi abandayo kule minyaka imbalwa izayo, ngaphandle kwelizwi lam.
Ke kaloku kwafika ilizwi lika jav widwa ammoni, esithi,
Yiya apha, uye emazantsi ehlabathini, ufihlakele emantla komlambo weKeriti, ngasentshonalanga yeJordan.
Uya kusela kuloo mlambo; ndiwisela umthetho iintaka, ukuba zikulethe khona ukudla kuwe.
Wenza ke uEliya ngokwelizwi likaYehova; waya, wahlala ecaleni komlambo weKeriti, ngasentshonalanga yeJordan.
Iinkomo zazisa kuye isonka nenyama emveni kwemini, nesonka nenyama emveni kwemini; wayesela elwandle.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, uLwandle lwalutshisa; ngokuba akubikho manzi ezweni.
Kwafika ke kuye ilizwi likaYehova lett widwa ammoni, esithi,
Yiya, uye eSarefati, idolophu yaseSidon, uhlale khona; bona, ndiwisela umthetho omnye umkakhe, ukuba akuthobele.
Wavuka ke uEliya, waya eSarepta. Ke kaloku, afike emnyango wedolophu, wabona khona indoda yowesifazane iqoqa iziqhamo; wathi kuye, Nceda, ndisazise amanzi amancinci emlonyeni wam, ukuze ndisele.
Ke kaloku, ekuhambeni kwakhe ukuwu-ke, wabiza wathi kuye, Ncedi, nceda uthathe nam inxalenye yenkomo.

Wathi yena, Uphila iNkosi uThixo wakho; asikubikho nam isonka esinokuphekwa. Ndinesandla esigcweleyo somgubo emlonyeni wam, neoyile encinane kumbhoxo wam; ndithe ndathabatha iziqhamo ezibini, ukuze ndenze isidlo sam nonyana wam; siyidle siya kufa.
Wathi kuye uEliya, Musa ukuxoka; buyela ekhaya lakho, wenze njengoko uthiyo. Ke kaloku, yenza kum kuqala isidlo esincinci sesonka, uyenzile; wena nonyana wakho ke, yenza ngoko.
Utsho ke iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Ibhotile yobusi ayizukuphelelwa, nebhotile yeoli ayizukuphelelwa, de kube yimini apho iNkosi aza kuzisa umoya phezu kwehlabathi.
Waye waya, wenza njengoko uEliyahu abemxelela. Kwabakho isonka mihla le kuEliyahu, kuye nosapho lwakhe.
Ibhotile yomgubo ayiyi kugqitywa, nebhotile yeoli ayiyi kugqitywa; njengokuba iNkosi wathetha ngaye ngoEliya.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, wagula unyana wowesifazane, umnini wendlu leyo; waza waba buhlungu kakhulu, de wayeka ukuphefumla.
Wathi kuye uEliya, Mntu kaThixo, kukho ntoni na phakathi kwam nowe? Uthe wafika apha ukuba undikumbulise isono sam, ukuze umfaze unyana wam?
Wathi ke uEliya kuye, Nceda ndininike lo mntwana wakho. Ke kaloku wamthabatha loo mntwana emlonyeni wakhe, wawuphakamisa waya egumbini eliphezulu apho wayehlala khona, wayibeka phezu kwebhedi yakhe;
Wabiza iNkosi, wathi, Nkosi yam, Thixo wam, ngaba nalowo mkhwenyana ndihlala naye, uya kuwuphazamisa njani lo mntwana wakhe?
Wamisa isandla sakhe phezu komntwana kathathu, wathandaza kuYehova, esithi, Nkosi yam, Thixo wam, nceda uphefumlo lwalomntwana luphinde lube kuwo.
Ke kaloku u-Elias wathandaza kuYehova, waza uMoya wakhe wabuyela kuye, waphila.
Ke kaloku uEliyahu wamthabatha lo mntwana, wamkhupha egumbini eliphakamileyo, wamthabatha waya phantsi endlwini; wamnika umyeni wakhe, wathi, Bona, unyana wakho uphila.
Wathi umfazi kuEliya, Namhlanje ndiyazi ukuba ungumntu kaThixo; ke ngoko ilizwi likaYehova elithethayo ngukholo.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezininzi, ngomnyaka wesithathu wemvula, kwafika igama likaYehova kuEliyahu, lisithi, Yiya ubonakaliswe kuAhabhi; mna ndiza kunika imvula phezu komhlaba.
Ke kaloku uEliya waya, ukuba abonakaliswe kuAhabhi; ke kaloku indlala yayinzima kakhulu eSamari.
Ke kaloku uAhabhi wabiza uObhadiya, umntu olawula indlu yakhe; uObhadiya ke wayemthanda kakhulu iNkosi.

Ke kaloku, xa uYezebeli ebulala abaprofeti bakaYehova, uObhadiya wathabatha abaprofeti abangamakhulu asixhenxe, wabafihla emazulwini amabini, abantu abamashumi mahlanu nganye, wabanika isonka nesamanzi.

Wathi ke uAhabhi kuObhadiya, Yiya uhamba-hamba ezweni, uye kuzo zonke izilwandle, nezilambo zonke; mhlawumbi siza kubona neentyatyambo zokuzigcina ziphila iinkomo neengulube zethu, ukuze singabi nazo zonke iintlanzi.
Bahlula ke ilizwe phakathi kwabo, ukuba lijonge. UAhabhi waya endlela enye yena; uObhadiya waya endlela enye yena.
Ke kaloku uObhadiya wayehamba, yabona uEliyahu edibana naye. UObhadiya wamqonda, wahlangula ngobuso bakhe phezu komhlaba, wathi, Ingaba unguwe na, nkosi yam uEliyahu?
Waphendula uEliya wathi, Ndim; yiya sithi kukumkani wakho, UEliya apha.
Wathi ke uObhadiya, Ndiyenze ntoni na into engalunganga, ukuba mna, umkhonzi wakho, ndithunyelwe kuAhabhi, ukuze ndifa?

Ngokuba uphila iNkosi uThixo wakho, akukho lizwe naliphi na ihlabathi apho umphathi wam angathumeli khona abantu ukukukhangela; xa besithi, Akho apha, wazenza izikumkani namazwe athile aphelelwe lithemba, ukuba bangakukufumana.
Ke wena ngoku uthi kum, Yiya sithi kukumkani wakho: Khangela, uEliyahu apha.

Ke kaloku, xa ndisiya kuwe, uMoya kaYehova uya kukuthwala apho umntu awaziyo khona; ke ukuba ndathi kuAhabhi, akakwazi ukufumana wena, mna andibulala. Mna ke umkhonzi wakho ndamthobela uThixo ukususela ekubeni ngumntwana wam.

Ukumkani wam, asikuxelele na umntu into endiyenzayo xa uYezebeli wayewabulala amaprofeti kaYehova? Ndazifihla abantu abamakhulu asixhenxe kwabaprofeta bakaThixo ezingxoweni ezimbini, amadoda angama-50 ngalinye; ndabanika isonka nesamanzi.
Kwaye ngoku urokên/uyakutheni na? Uthi kum, Yaye, sithi kukumkani wakho: UElias ukhona. Uya kundibulala."
Wathi uEliya, Uphila iNkosi wamaSirayeli, lo Thixo endiwukhonzayo, ukuba namhlanje ndiya kubonakaliswa kuAhabhi.
Waya ke uObhadiya ukuhlangabezana noAhabhi, wamxelela.; waphuma ke uAhabhi ukuhlangabezana noEliya.
Ke kaloku, uAhabhi ebona uEliyahu, wathi kuye, Ingaba unguwe na lo mntu obangela ububi kuSirayeli?
Waphendula ke uEliya, wathi, Andibangele buhlungu amaSirayeli mna; kodwa wena nosapho lwabazali bakho. Nisuka kumgaqo kaYehova, nilandela ooBhaali.

Ke ngoko, thumela ke ngoku, uhlangabeze ooSirayeli bonke ukuba bafike kumnqamlezweni weKarmele; nibathumelele abaprofeti bakaBhaali abangamakhulu amane, anamashumi amahlanu, nabaprofeti bakaAshera abangamakhulu mane, abanokudla itephu kaYezebeli.
Wathumela ke uAhabhi kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, wahlanganisana nabaprofeti emnqamlezweni kaKarmele.

Ke kaloku uEliya wanyuka waya kubo bonke abantu, wathi, Niza kuqhubeka nini nihamba phakathi kwezinto ezimbini? Ukuba nguThixo iNkosi, landelani yena; kodwa ukuba nguThixo uBhaali, landelani yena. Abantu ke abathethi nto.
Wathi kubo uEliya, Ndisele mna kuphela phakathi kwabaprofeti bakaYehova; ke uBhaali uneempawu ezimakhulu amane, anamanci mahlanu.

Nceda nithumelele inkunzi yebhokhwe ezimbini, ukuze abaprofeti bakaBhali bakhethe kuboaukhethele ibhokhwe enye; bayenze ibe ziinxalenye, bayibeke emanzini, bangawutshisanga umsi; ke mna ndiya kuyilungiselela enye inkunzi yebhokhwe, ndiyibeke emanzini, angawutshisanga umsi.
Nizibiza ke nina igama loThixo wenu, mna ke ndizibiza igama likaYehova; uThixo ophendula ngomlilo, lowo nguThixo. Baphendula bonke abantu, bathi, Kulungile loo nto.
Wathi uEliya kubaprofeti bakaBhali, Nceda nikhetheni inkunzi yenkomo enye, niyilungiselele kuqala, ngokuba nininzi kakhulu; nibize igama loThixo wenu, kodwa musa ukutshisa umsi.

Bathi ke, bathabathe inkunzi yebhokhwe enikezelwe kubo, bayilungiselele; babiza ke igama likaBhali ukususela kusasa kude kube liphakathi kwemini, besithi, UBhali, uphendule kuthi. Ke kaloku akukho msindo, akukho namnye ophendulayo; badlala ngokujikeleza isibingelelo abasele besenza.

Ke kaloku, ngobusuku obuphakathi, uEliyahu waqala ukubaxelela. Wathi ke, Yitshoni ngelizwi elikhulu; akunjalo na ukuba nguThixo? Mhlawumbi ucinga, okanye uhambe apho, okanye ehamba uhambo olude; mhlawumbi uphumle, kwaye kufuneka avuswe.
Ke kaloku baqhubeka becaphukela, baluka ngokwabo ngeeklabhu neengqekembe, njengokuba bahlala besenza njalo, de kwaphuma igazi phezu kwabo.
Ke kaloku kwadlula isiqingatha semini, baqhubeka bethetha-thethana, de kube lixesha lokubhiyozela isidlo sangokuhlwa; kodwa akukho lizwi, akukho impendulo, akukho namnye oqaphela.
Wathi ke uEliya kubo bonke abantu, Nxibelelani kum. Bafika kuye bonke abantu; walungisa isibingelelo sikaYehova, esiqhutywe phantsi.
Wathabatha ke uEliyahu iithayile ezilishumi elinambini, nganye yazo izizwe zonyana bakaYakobi, lowo wathetha kuye iNkosi wathi, Igama lakho liza kuba nguSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, ngeethayile ezo, walungisa isibingelelo kwigama likaYehova; wavula umngxunya phezu kwesibingelelo sayo, ubukhulu bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini zembewu.
Wamisa imithi, wajika inkunzi yebhokhwe ibe ziinxalenye, wayibeka phezu kwemithi; wathi ke, Ziqulethe iziqhoboshi ezine ngamanzi, zidibanise phezu komnikelo wesono nangaphezulu kwamati.
Wathi ke, Yinzani kwakhona; bayenze kwakhona. Wathi ke, Yinzani kwakhona; bayenza kwakhona.
Amanzi aye phantsi ejikeleze isibingelelo, waza wagcwalisa amanzi naloo mngxuma.

Ke kaloku, ngexesha lomnikelo wesono, uEliyahu umprofeti wafika, wathi, Nkosi, uThixo kaAbraham, noIsake, noSirayeli, kufuneka kucatshulwe namhlanje ukuba wena unguThixo eSirayeli, yaye mna ndingumkhonzi wakho, yaye ndazenza zonke ezi zinto ngenxa yelizwi lakho.
Ndiphendule, Nkosi yam, ndiphendule; ukuze abantu aba bakwazi ukuba wena, Nkosi yam, unguThixo, nawe ubuyisela intliziyo yabo kuwe.
Waphuma umlilo endlwini kaYehova, watshisa isonka, nemithi, neethayile, nomhlaba; waza wahlamba amanzi emngxunyeni.
Ke kaloku, abantu bonke bakubona loo nto, babetha izandla zabo ehlabathini, besithi, UYehova nguThixo; iNkosi nguThixo.
Wathi ke kubo uEliya, Nciphisaneni nabaprofeti bakaBhali; asiyi kuphelelwa mnye wabo. Bawathatha, wabakhupha uEliya waya emlanjeni waseKishon, wababulala khona.
Wathi uEliya kuAhabhi, Yiya, usele usele; kuba ndiliva ilizwi lemvula enkulu lifika.
Waya ke uAhabhi, wadla waza wasela. Ke kaloku uEliyahu waya phezulu emnqamlezweni wentaba kaKarmele; wahlangula ehlabathini, wabeka ubuso bakhe phakathi kwengalo zakhe.
Wathi kumkhonzi wakhe, Yiya phezulu, ujonge ngaselwandle. Wanyuka umkhonzi, wakhangela, wathi, Akukho nto apha. Uthe ke kuye uEliyahu amaxesha asixhenxe, uthi, Yiya kwakhona, ubone.

Ke kaloku, kwathi ke ngexesha lesixhenxe, wathi, Ndibona ifu elincinci, lifana nesandla somntu, linyuka elwandle. Wathi uEliyahu, Yiya, sithi kuAhabhi, Ncamathelisa izithuthi zakho, uye phantsi, phambi kokuba imvula ikuthintele.
Ke kaloku, kwathi ke, izulu limnyama ngenxa yelanga nomoya; yaqala imvula enkulu ukuwa. UAhabhi wahamba ngemoto waya eYizreyeli.
Ke kaloku kwafika amandla kaYehova kuEliya; wabeka iingubo zakhe emqolo wakhe, wabaleka phambi kukaAhabhi, waya ekungeneni kweYezreyeli.
Ke kaloku uAhabhi wamxelela uYezebeli zonke izinto azenzayo uEliyahu, nokuba wabulala njani bonke abaprofeti ngeqhwa.

Wathumela ke uYezebeli umthunywa kuEliya, esithi, Bayenze loo nto naleyo amadini angandiyenzayo, ayandibeke kuyo, ukuba ngemini ngale xesha andiyikwenza impilo yakho ibe njengempilo yomprofeti ngamnye wale maprofeti.
Ke kaloku uEliya wakhathazeka, wavuka, wabaleka ukuze akhusele ubomi bakhe; waya eBher-shebha, eYuda, washiya khona umkhonzi wakhe.

Ke kaloku wayehamba, yena ngokwakhe, uhambo lwemihla yonke ezweni elingaziwayo; wafika ke ekumthi wotywala, wahlala phantsi kwawo, wacela uThixo ukuba amfa. Wathi ke, UYehova, ndenze ngokwaneleyo; ndiyithathe intliziyo yam, kuba andingcono kunabazali bam.
Ke kaloku walala phantsi komthi omncinci, waphumla. Yabona ke isithunywa sithi kuye, Yiya usele.
Wajonga, ke kaloku kukho ecaleni kwengcambu yakhe ibhotolo yesonka esitshiziwe ngeekhabhinethi ezishushu, nebhotile yamanzi; wadla waza wasela, wabuyela walala.
Ke kaloku iingelosi zikaYehova zabuyela kathathu, zathi kuye, Yiya, usele; kuba uhambo olukhoyo phambi kwakho lude kakhulu.
Wavuka ke, wadla waza wasela; wahamba ngobuchule balo mtya, iintsuku ezimashumi mane neentsuku ezine, waya eHorebhi, intaba kaThixo.
Ke kaloku waya apho ekungeneni komlambo, walala khona. Yathi ke ilizwi likaYehova lifika kuye, lisithi, Uyenza ntoni na apha, uEliya?

Wathi yena, Ndiye ndazithanda kakhulu iNkosi, uThixo wamaSirayeli; kuba oonyana bakaSirayeli batshintshe umnqophiso wakho, baphula izibingelelo zakho, babulala abaprofeti bakho ngeqhwa; ndisele mna kuphela; ke ngoku bafuna ukuba ndifa.

Wathi ke iNkosi kuye, Yiya ngaphandle, hlala elunxwemeni phambi koThixo. Ke kaloku wadlula iNkosi; kwakukho umoya omkhulu nonamandla ophula iintaba-mlilo, wanqunyamisa amatye emlilweni kaThixo; kodwa uThixo akanguye kulo mphefumlo; emva kokomoya kwabakho ukudubula kwehlabathi, kodwa uThixo akakabi nalo kududubu lwamhlaba.
Emva koxinzelelo lwehlabathi kwakukho umlilo, kodwa iNkosi akanguye kuloo mlilo; emva komlilo kwakukho umsindo omncinci.
Ke kaloku, xa uEliyahu ekubona loo nto, wafihla ubuso bakhe ngempahla yakhe, waphuma, wamisa emehlweni enkampu. Yabona ilizwi lithi kuye, Uyenza ntoni na apha, Eliyahu?

Wathi yena, Ndiye ndazithanda kakhulu iNkosi, uThixo wamaSirayeli; kuba oonyana bakaSirayeli batshintshe umnqophiso wakho, baphula izibingelelo zakho, babulala abaprofeti bakho ngeqhwa; ndisele mna kuphela; ke ngoku bafuna ukuba ndifa.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Yiya kwakhona ngendlela oya kuyo, uye emasikweni aseDamasko; xa ufike khona, unciphise uHazayeli ukuba abe ngukumkani waseAram.
Unciphise uYehu, unyana kaNimshi, ukuba abe ngukumkani kumaSirayeli; unciphise ke uElisha, unyana kaShafati, waseAbele-Mehola, ukuba abe ngumprofeti endaweni yakho.
UYehu uya kubulala wonke lowo ushiya ikrele likaHazayeli; noElisha uya kubulala wonke lowo ushiya Esanvostwa.
Ke mna ndazishiya kum amawaka asixhenxe eSirayeli, abangamkhonzi uBhaali, bangamxolela imifanekiso yakhe engumqondiso.

Wasuka ke uEliya khona, wafumana uEliya unyana kaShafati, Usisono. Waye emisa imbewu, eneentlobo ezilishumi elinambini zeenkomo phambi kwakhe; yena wayeqhuba iintlobo ezilishumi elinamibini. UEliya waya kuye, wamthabatha ingubo yakhe phezu kwake.

Ke kaloku uElisha washiya iinkomo, waya kulandela uEliya, wathi, Ndicela, ndivumele ukuba ndimxolele ubaba wam nomama wam; emva koko ndiya kukulandela. Wathi ke uEliya, Yiya; ndenza ntoni na ukuze ndikuthintele?
Wabuyela ke uElisha, wathabatha iinkomo zakhe ezibini, waza wazibulala; wapheka inyama ngezixhobo zemithi, wayinika abantu, badla. Wavuka ke, wamlandela uEliya, waba ngumncedisi wakhe.

Ke kaloku uBhe-hadadi, ukumkani waseAram, wathabatha lonke iqela lakhe; kwabakho naye amakumkani amashumi mathathu anababini, namahashe abo, neemoto zabo. Wanyuka waya eSamari, wayijikeleza, wayihlasela.
Wathumela abathunywa kumzi kuye uAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, esithi, Itsho loo nto uBhehadade:
Isilivere yakho negolide yakho yinyani yam-ke; nabafazi bakho nabantwana bakho, abo balungileyo, bayinya.
Waphendula ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi, Ngokungaphaya kokuthetha kwakho, nkosi yam ukumkani; mna ndiwe, nazo zonke izinto zam ziye kuwe.
Babuya abathunywa, bathi, Oku kukuthi nguBhe-hadadi, Ndithumelele kuwe, ndithi, Ndininike isilivere yakho, negolide yakho, namadoda akho, nabantwana bakho.
Ke kaloku namhlanje, ngale xesha, ndiya kukuthumela kuwe abakhonzi bam; baya kukhangela indlu yakho, nezindlu zabakhonzi bakho, bathabathe zonke izinto zakho ezilungileyo.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wabiza bonke abaphathi belizwe, wathi, Yabona ukuba lo mntu ufuna ntoni na ingxaki? Wathumela ngeempawu zam, neentombi zam, nesilivere yam, negolide yam; andizange ndimke.
Bathi kuye bonke abathetheli nabo bonke abantu, Musa ukuwuphulaphula, ungamvumelanga.

Wathi ke uAhabhi kubathunywa bakaBhe-hadadi, Nithi kukumkani, nkosi yam: Zonke izinto ozithenzileyo kumkhonzi wakho kuqala ndiza kuzilungisa; kodwa loo nto andikwazi ukuyilungisa. Baphuma abathunywa, babuyela kuBhe-hadadi.
Ke kaloku uBhehadade wathumela kuAhabhi, esithi, Amadini ayenze le nto kum, andiyenzile loo nto, ukuba kukho uthuli oluseleyo eSamari, ukuze bonke oonyana bam bathabathe isandla ngasinye.
Ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waphendula wathi, Nithi kuye, Umntu ogqoka iimpahla zakhe zokulwa akayi kubhiyozela njengokuba umntu ezikhupha emva komfa.
Ke kaloku uBhe-hadade, xa eva loo myalezo, yena namagqwetha akhe besela kwiintyatyambo zabo, wathi kumakhonzi akhe, Yinikele ukuhlasela. Bathi ke bona bangenikele ukuhlasela lo mzi.
Wafika ke umprofeti kuAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Ubona na eli qela likhulu? Ndiya kukunikela kulo namhlanje; nawe uya kuziqonda ukuba mna ndinguYehova.

Wathi uAhabhi, Nguwuphi oza kwenza loo nto? Wathi lo mprofeti, Utsho iNkosi oku: Baye bayenza oonyana bakakumkani bezixeko. Wathi ke uAhabhi, Nguwuphi oza kuqalisa umkhosi? Waphendula lo mprofeti, Nguwe.
Ke kaloku uAhabhi wabiza oonyana bakakumkani bezixeko, amadoda amakhulu amabini, anamanci mathathu anambini; wababiza ke namanye amaSirayeli, amawaka asixhenxe.
Baphuma ngobusuku obuphakathi; ke kaloku uBhe-di-Hadadi, namakumkani amashumi mathathu anababini ancedisayo kuye, aye ezitentileni zakhe, esela.
Baphuma kuqala oonyana bakakumkani bezixeko; baxela ke uBhe-hadadi abaphulaphuli bakhe, besithi, Amadoda aphuma eSamari.
Wathi ke, Ukuba baphuma ukuba benze uxolo, nokuba baphuma ukuba badlale, bathabathe ubomi.
Baphuma edolophini oonyana bakakumkani bemimandla, namadoda amaninzi alandela phantsi kwabo.
Ke kaloku babulala ngamnye umkhosi wakhe. Babaleka amaSirayeli, abaSirayeli bewalandela; uBhe-hadadi ukumkani waseSirayeli waphuma ehamba ngebhayisikili, naye namadoda akhe ahamba ngebhayisikili.
Waphuma ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wahlasela iinkunzi zeebhokhwe nezithuthi-mlilo; wababulala amaAram ngokubulala okukhulu.
Wafika ke umprofeti ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi kuye, Yiya, uqinise iqela lakho, ucinge ukuba ungakwenza ntoni na; kuba xa kugqitywa isiqingatha sonyaka, ukumkani waseAram uya kukuhlasela.
Bathi ke kuye abaphathi bakakumkani wakwa-Aram, Amadini abo amadini entlango; ngenxa yoko banamandla kunaye. Ke kaloku, ukuba senze ukulwa nabo emazantsi elizwe, siya kuba namandla kunabo.
Yenza oku: uthabathe ookumkani bonke emkhosini wabo, ubeke abathetheli bemikhosi endaweni yabo.

Yakha ke wena umkhosi ofana nomkhosi owawulahlekayo, inqanawa Usi neutrality, nemoto yemfazwe ifana nemoto yemfazwe; ngoko siza kulwa namaSirayeli emazantsi eNtaba-mlilo, sibone ukuba sinamandla kunabo. Wavuma uSolomon, wakwenza njalo.
Ke kaloku, kwathi kuvuka ubusika, uBhe-hadade wahlanganisa abaAram, waya eAfeki, ukuhlasela amaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli aqhutywa, anikezelwe isonka; baphuma bedibana nabo. AmaSirayeli athabathela isikhephe phambi kwabo, abe ngamaqela amabini ancinane eebhokhwe; ke amaSiria agubungela indawo.

Wafika ke umntu kaThixo ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, AbaAram bathi, UYehova nguThixo weenduli, akanguye uThixo weentlambo; ngoko ndiya kukunikela phambi kwakho loo mkhosi mkhulu wonke; niyazi ukuba ndinguYehova.
Zathi iintsapho zombini zihlala zijongene ngemihla esixhenxe. Ngomhla wesixhenxe kwaqala ukulwa; babulala ooSirayeli abantu abalishumi elinamawaka abahamba ngezinyawo eAram, ngosuku olunye.

Ke kaloku abo bambalwa babaleka befika edolophini yase-Afeki; wawela udonga kumadoda amabini anamashumi asixhenxe anamakhulu asixhenxe. UBhenjamin-hadadi ke waya emzini, wafihlakala kwigumbi elingaphakathi.

Bathi kuye abakhonzi bakhe, Yabona, sithe sazi ukuba ookumkani bakaSirayeli banobubele; ngoko ke sithi, siyazigqoka iimpahla ezingwevu, siyibeke intsontelo phezu kweentloko zethu, siphume kukumkani wakwaSirayeli; mhlawumbi uya kukukhusela ubomi bakho.

Ke kaloku bagqoka iimpahla ezingwevu, bethwala iintsontelo phezu kweentloko zabo; baya kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, bathi, Umkhonzi wakho uBhe-hadadi uthi: Nceda ndiphile. Waphendula ke uAhabhi wathi, Ingaba uyaphila na? Udade wam nguye.

Ke kaloku aba bantu belinde uphawu olulungileyo, bakhawuleza bafumanisa ilizwi lakhe. Bathi, NguBhe-hadadi unyana wakho. Wathi ke uAhabhi, Yiya, mnikele kuye; waphuma ke uBhe-hadadi, waza uAhabhi wamthabatha emkhosini.

Wathi kuye uBhe-hadadi, Iidolophu abazali bam babezithabatha kuyise wakho, ndiya kuzibuyisela kuwe; wenze izikhululo zakho zentengiso eDamasko, njengokuba uyise wam wazenza eSamari. Wathi ke uAhabhi, Ngento leyo ndiza kukushiya uhambe. Wenza ngoko umnqophiso naye, wamvumela ahambe.
Wathi ke omnye kusapho lwamaprofeti kumnye wabo, ngomyalelo kaYehova, Nceda, mphike. Ke kaloku lo mntu akafuni ukumphika.
Wathi umbingeleli, Ngokuba ungamthobeli iNkosi, ngoko ke, xa uphuma kum, ilili liza kukubulala. Ke kaloku, xa lo mntu esuka, ilili lalibafumana, lalimbulala.
Ke kaloku uprofeti wafumana umntu omnye, wathi, Nceda, ndidubule. Wadubula ke lo mntu, intambe.
Waye ke lo mprofeti, wamisa isandla sakhe kwindlela yokumkani; watshintsha ubuso bakhe, wakhupha intloko yakhe emehlo akhe.

Ke kaloku, xa ukumkani edlulayo, lo mprofeti wambiza wathi kuye: Umkhonzi wakho wafika phakathi kwemfazwe; kwathi ke umntu ufike kum enesihlwele. Wathi, Ukhusele loo ndoda; ukuba ilahlekile, uya kuyihlawula intliziyo yakhe ngentliziyo yakho, okanye ubuncinane iitoni ezilishumi elinambini zesililas.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa umkhonzi wakho esebenza apha naphaya, lo mntu waphela. Wathi kuye ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Lo ngumthetho wakho; wena ngokwakho uthethe oko.
Wakhawuleza ke lo mprofeti, wasusa isigqubuthelo ebusweni bakhe; ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wamqonda ukuba ungumprofeti.
Wathi umbingeleli kukumkani, Itsho loo nto iNkosi, Ushiye umntu endiwulungiselele ukufa; ke ngoko ubomi bakho buza kuba yimpilo yakhe, nabantu bakho bazoba ngabantu bakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wabuyela endlwini yakhe, waya eSamariya, ehloniphekileyo nobubi.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, kwabakho umntu okuthiwa nguNabhothi, umYizreyeli; wayenegadi yewayini eYizreyeli, ikwindlu kaAhabhi ukumkani waseSamari.

Wathi ke uAhabhi kuNabhoti, Ndininike ivini sakho, ndiyenze ibe yigadi yeentyatyambo; kuba lifutshane nendlu yam. Ndaza kukunika endaweni yayo ivini elingcono; okanye, ukuba kungcono kuwe, ndiya kukuhlawula ixabiso layo.
Wathi ke uNabhoti kuAhabhi, UYehova andivumelekanga ukuba ndikunike ilizwe endilifumana njengelifa kubafazi bam.

Wabuyela ke uAhabhi endlwini yakhe, ethambileyo, ehloniphekileyo, ngenxa yelizwi likaNabhothi waseYizreyeli, esithi, Andiyi kukunika ilizwe endililungu labazali bam. Walala phezu kwebhedi yakhe, wabeka ubuso bakhe emgangathweni, akayi kutya.
Wafika ke uYezebeli, indoda yakhe, wathi kuye, Yintoni enokubuhlungu ngayo intliziyo yakho, ukuba awudlanga?
Wathi kuye, Ndithe ndathetha noNabhoti umYizreyeli, ndithi, Yithengise kum ivini sakho; okanye ukuba unqwenela, ndizokunika enye ivini endaweni yayo. Wathi ke, Andiyi kukunika ivini sam.
Wathi uYezebeli, umfazi wakhe, Ingaba oku kukuthi wena ukuba ungukumkani wakwaSirayeli? Yiya, usele, ube nobubele; ndiza kukuthenga ivini likaNabhoti waseYizreyeli.
Wabhala ke amaxwebhu ngegama likaAhabhi, waza wazityhila ngomsesane wakhe, wazisa kumadoda amakhulu, namadoda amakhulu, ahlala emzini kaNabhothi.
Wabhala kuloo ncwadi, esithi, Nqumleleni imini yokuthandaza, nimise uNabhothi ephakameni phakathi kwabantu.
Ke kaloku, nibeke phambi kwakhe amadoda amabini angafanelekanga; bagwebe kuye, besithi, Uthe waphulaphula uThixo nokumkani. Ke ngoko, niyikhuphe ngaphandle, niyityekele iithayile, aze aphele.
Ke kaloku abaphathi, namadoda anamandla edolophini kaNabhothi, bakwenza njengoko uYezebeli wathetha kubo ngazo ezo ncwadi awazithumelelayo.
Babhengeza ukutya okuncinci, bamisa uNabhothi endaweni ephakade phakathi kwabantu.

Ke kaloku bafika abo madoda amabini akhohlakeleyo, bahlala ecaleni kwakhe; babemxelela uNabhothi phambi kwabantu, besithi, UNabhoti waphulaphula uThixo nokumkani. Bawukhupha ke ngaphandle komzi, bamwisela amatye, waza wafa.
Ke kaloku bathumela ukuthetha kuYezebeli, besithi, UNabhothi waqhutywa ngamatye, wafa.

Ke kaloku, xa uYezebeli efundile ukuba uNabhothi watyhutywa ngamatye waza wafa, wathi kuAhabhi: Yiya uthathe ivini likaNabhothi waseYizreyeli, awayekayi kukuthengisa yona; kuba uNabhoti akaphilili; wayefa.
Ke kaloku, xa uAhabhi efundile ukuba uNabhothi ufile, wavuka waya phantsi, ukuze athathe ivini likaNabhoti waseYizreyeli.
Ke kaloku kwafika ilizwi likaYehova kuEliya waseTishbhi, lisithi,
Yiya phantsi, ujongene noAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, olawula eSamari; bona ke, ungumphathi wewayini kaNabhothi; waphuma ukuba ayithathe.

Uthi kuye, Itsho loo nto iNkosi, Wabulala na umntu, wathabatha ilizwe lakhe? Uthi kuye ke ke, Itsho loo nto iNkosi, Kwindawo apho izinja zihlambe khona igazi likaNabhothi, ziya kuhlambela khona izinja igazi lakho.
Wathi ke uAhabhi kuEliya, Mna, mntu wamxhalabisayo? Uphendula uEliya wathi, Ewe, ndikuxhalabisayo; ngokuba uthengise ngokwakho ukuba wenze okubi phambi koYehova.
Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Yabona, ndiya kukuzisa ububi phezu kwakho; ndiya kukucima, ndiya kucima wonke umfana kaAhabhi kumaSirayeli, nokuba ungumkhonzi, nokuba ungumntu okhululekileyo.
ndiya kwenza indlu yakho ibe njengendlu kaYerebhoyamu unyana kaNabati, nendlu kaBhasha unyana ka-Ahiya; ngenxa yokuba undiyixolela intliziyo yam, wabangela ukuba amaSirayeli aphe.
Ke kaloku ngoYezebeli utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Iinkunzi zeenkomo ziya kulila uYezebeli ecaleni kwedonga laseYizreyeli.
Yonke into yosapho luka-Ahabhi ekufa emzini, iya kuliwa ziinkunzi; onke loo nto ifa ezweni, iya kuliwa ziintakarove.
Akukho namnye owayefana noAhabhi, othengise ngokwakhe ukuba akwenze okubi ngamehlo kaYehova, ekhutshwe nguYezebeli indoda yakhe.
Wakwenza izinto ezinobungozi, wakhonza imifanekiso engumqondiso, ngokwezinto abazenzayo amaAmori, abantu abagxothayo iNkosi phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, xa uAhabhi ephulaphule la magama, waluka iimpahla zakhe, wagqoka izihlangu ezingwevu, wahamba engadlanga; walala ngezihlangu ezingwevu, wahamba ngamandla.
Ke kaloku kwafika ilizwi likaYehova kuEliya waseTishbhi, lisithi,
Wabona na ukuba uAhabhi wenzakala phambi kwam? Ngokuba wenzakala, andiyi kuzisa loo nto ephilayo; kwimihla yonyana wakhe ndiya kuyikisela ikhaya lakhe.
Akukho mfazwe phakathi kuka-Aram noSirayeli iminyaka emithathu.
Ke kaloku, yathi ngomnyaka wesithathu, uJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda wahla waya kukubona ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kubakhonzi bakhe, Niyazi ukuba iRamoti yeGiliyadi yintliziyo yethu; ngoko ke kutheni na ukuba siyithathe kwakhona emkhosini kakumkani waseAram?

Wathi kuYosafati, Uza kungena na kum ukuhlasela iRamoti yeGiliyadi? Waphendula uYosafati ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi, Ndiya kuba nawe yonke indlela; abantu bam babantu bakho, izimvu zam ziinkunzi zakho.
Wathi ke uJehoshafati kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Nceda ubuze iNkosi kuqala, into ethethayo.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wahlanganisa abaprofeti, abangamakhulu amane amadoda, wathi kubo, Ndiya kungena eRamoti-gileyadi, ndibethe ukulwa, okanye ndiyishiye? Baphendula bathi, Yiya; kuba iNkosi uya kuyinika emkhosini.
Wathi ke uYoshafati, Akukho mprofeti kaYehova apha ukuze siwubuze?

Waphendula ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi kuJehoshafati, Kusekhona umntu omnye esinokumbuza iNkosi ngaye; nguMika unyana ka-Imla; ke mna ndimchukumisa; ngokuba akathethi nam nto ilungileyo, kodwa into embi. UYoshafati wathi, Akufanele ukumkani athethe njalo.
Waza ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wabiza omnye wabakhonzi bakhe, wathi, Yazisa ngokukhawuleza uMika unyana ka-Imla.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, babezigqoka iimpahla zabo zokumkani, behlala ezibhedleleni zazo, ngaphaya komhlaba wokukhulisa iziqhamo, ekungeneni kwesango laseSamari; bonke abaprofeti ke baprofeta phambi kwabo.
Ke kaloku uZedekiya, unyana kaKenanaha, wazenza izikhonkwane zentsimbi; wathi ke, Itsho le nto iNkosi, Uza kuzitshisa ngazo iiAram, de baphele.
Nabo bonke abaprofeti bathetha njalo, besithi, Yiya eRamoti-gileyadi, uphumelele; ngokuba iNkosi uya kuyinika emkhosini.

Wathi kuye lo mthunywa, lowo waya wathabatha uMika: Yabona, bonke abaprofeti bathetha ngelizwi elinye, bethetha okulungileyo kukumkani. Nceda ukuba ulwimi lwakho lube lufana nalo lwabo, uthethe okulungileyo.
Wathi ke uMika, Uphila iNkosi, into athethayo iNkosi kum ndiya kuyithetha.

Wafika ke ukumkani, ukumkani wathi kuye, Mikaya, kufuneka sihambe siye eRamoti-gileyadi ukubhiyozela, okanye kufuneka siyishiye? Waphendula uMika, Yiya uphumelele; ngokuba iNkosi uya kuyinika emkhosini.
Wathi kuye ukumkani, Ngaphi na amaxesha ndiza kukwenza ubeke isibonda, ukuba ungandithethili nto ngaphandle kwenyaniso egama likaThixo?

Wathi ke uMika, Ndibabona bonke amaSirayeli ephazamisekile emanzini aphakamileyo, njengokuba iinkomo zingenamlawuli; wathi ke iNkosi, Aba bantu bangabikho mphathi wabo; bahambe ngamnye endlwini yakhe ngoxolo.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYoshuwafati, Andikuthethile ntoni na, ukuba akathetha nam nto ilungileyo, kodwa into ebi?
Wathi ke uMika, Yizani ngoko ilizwi likaYehova: Ndabona iNkosi ehlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, nemiyalelo yonke yezulu ihleli phezu kwakhe, ngasekunene kwakhe nakwesobunxele.
Wathi iNkosi, Nguwuphi umntu oza kumxelela uAhabhi ukuba ahambe eRamoti-gileyadi, ukuze afe khona? Umnye wathi into enye, omnye wathi into enye.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma umphefumlo, wahlala phambi koYehova, wathi, Ndiya kumxelela.
Wathi iNkosi, Yintoni na? Wathi lo mphefumlo, Ndiza kuphuma ndibe ngumphefumlo wobubi emlonyeni wamaprofeti akhe onke. Wathi iNkosi, Uya kumxolela, uya kuphumelela; yiya wenze.
Ke kaloku, bona, iNkosi wabeka umphefumlo wobuxoki emlonyeni wabo bonke abaprofeti bakho; ke iNkosi wathi uya kukuzisa ingozi.
Wafika ke uZedekiya, unyana kaKenanaya, wabetha uMika emlonyeni, wathi, UMoya kaYehova wawusuka phi na kum, ukuba athethe nawe?
Wathi uMika, Uza kukwazi ngaloo mini, xa uza kungena ufihlakele kwigumbi elingaphakathi.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Nciphisa uMika, umthumelele kuAmon, umphathi womzi, noYowashe, unyana kakumkani.
Nithi kubo, Oku kuthe ukumkani: Nciphisa lo mntu endlwini yengxowa-mali, ungamniki nantoni na ngaphandle kwesonka esincinci nesamanzi, de ndibuye ndiphilile.
Wathi ke uMika, Ukuba uya kubuyela ngokukhuselekileyo, ngoko iNkosi akathethi ngam. Wathi ke uMika, Yithini le nto, nibantu bonke!
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli noYosafati, ukumkani wakwaYuda, banyuka beya eRamoti-gileyadi.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wathi kuYoshafati, Ndiya kuguqula ubuso bam, ndiye emfazweni; wena ke ugqoke iimpahla zakho zokumkani. Waguqula ubuso bakhe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waya emfazweni.

Ke kaloku ukumkani waseSirayeli wabawisela umthetho abaphathi bakhe beemoto ezimashumi mathathu anesibini, esithi, Musani ukuhlasela nabani na, nokuba mkhulu nancinci, ngaphandle kukakumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, abathetheli beemoto bakubona uYowafati, bathi, Ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli ke lowo. Baye babuyela kuye ukuba bamhlasele; uYowafati ke watsho.
Ke kaloku, bebona abathetheli beenqwelo-moya ukuba akanguye ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, babuyela emva kwakhe.

Ke kaloku omnye umntu wabetha umqolo, engazange abeke imiyalelo; wabetha ukumkani wakwaSirayeli phakathi kwempahla yakhe yokulwa. Wathi ukumkani kumqhubi wemoto yakhe, Buyela, ndisuse emfazweni; kuba ndidlwengula kakhulu.
Ke kaloku ukulwa kwaqhutywa yonke imihla; ukumkani wabekwa phantsi ekhayeni lakhe, phambi kweeAram; wafa ke ngaloo mhlwa. Igazi leentlungu zakhe laphuma lihla phezu komhlaba wekhayani.
Ke kaloku, xa ilanga lithe laphuma, kwafika umsindo phakathi komkhosi, usithi, Buyele umntu ngamnye edolophini yakhe, buyele umntu ngamnye ezweni lakhe.
Wafahim-futhi ukumkani, wathabatha waya eSamari, waza wabulawa khona.
Bahlamba inqanawa yakhe emlanjeni waseSamari; bahlambela khona amabhinqa ahamba ngeenxa zonke, kwathi iinkunzi zeegusha zidla igazi lakhe, njengoko iNkosi watsho.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uAhabhi, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, nendlu yegolide awayeyenze, nemizi yonke ayeyenza, zingaba zibhalwe nini ezincwadini zembali yamakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Wafa uAhabhi; uAhaziya, unyana wakhe, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UJehoshafati unyana ka-Asa waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda ngomnyaka wesine kaAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
UJehoshafati ubeminyaka imashumi mathathu anamihlanu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mabini anamihlanu engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguAzuba intombi kaShili.

Wahamba ngeendlela zonke zikaAsa, uyise, akaze atshintshe kuzo; wenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova. Ke kaloku iindawo eziphakamileyo azinyuswanga; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona, befumisa khona umlilo.
Ke kaloku uJehoshafati wenza uxolo nokumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uYowafati, nemisebenzi yakhe enamandla, nemikhosi awayeyenza, zingaba azibhalwenga phantsi kwencwadi yemihla ngemihla yamakumkani baseYuda?
Wazikhupha ezweni namanye amabhinqa ahamba ngeempawu zesini, abesele khona ukususela kwimihla kaAsa uyise.
Ke kalokapito-mkhosi wayelawula khona.
Ke kaloku uJehoshafati walungisa iinqanawa ezinkulu zorhwebo, ukuba zihambe ziye eOfhire zingenise igolide; kodwa azihambenga, ngokuba zaphuka eEzion-Gebere.
Wathi ke uAhaziya, unyana ka-Ahabhi, kuYosafati, Nceda bahambe abaphathi benqanawa bam nabaphathi benqanawa bakho enqanaweni. UYosafati wayeka.
Ke kaloku uJehoshafati waphumla, wabanjwa nabazalwana bakhe emzini kaDavide, utata wakhe. UYoram unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UAhaziya unyana kaAhabhi waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli eSamari, ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo kaYowafati ukumkani wakwaYuda; waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emibini.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; wahamba ngeendlela zoyise nodade wakhe, neendlela zikaYarobheham unyana kaNabati, owabangela ukuba amaSirayeli aphe.
Wakhonza uBhaali, wathandaza kuye; waza wamangalisa iNkosi uThixo kaSirayeli, njengoko wayesenza uyise.
2Kgs: Ke kaloku, emva kokufa kuka-Ahabhi, ilizwe likaMowabi labuya lisuka eSirayeli.
