Ke kaloku, uAhaziya wawela ngefestile yodonga lwegumbi lakhe eliphezulu eSamariya, waba buhlungu kakhulu. Wathumela abathunywa, wathi kubo, Yiya nibuze uBhaali-zebhub, uThixo ka-Ekron, ukuba ndiza kuphiliswa na kuloo monakalo.
Wathi ke umbingeleli kaYehova kuEliya waseTishbi, Yiya uxelele abathunywa bakakumkani waseSamari, uthi kubo, Ingaba akukho uThixo eSirayeli, ukuba niya kubuza uBhaali-zebubhi, idini laseAkroni?
Ngoko ke, utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Awuyi kuphuma ebhedini ohlala kuyo; uya kufa ngokuqinisekileyo. Waya ke uEliyahu.
Ke kaloku abathunywa babuyela kuye ukumkani; wathi kubo, Yintoni na yokuba nibuye?

Bathi kubo, Umntu omnye wafika esinxibelelana naye; wathi kuthi, Yiya kukumkani owasithumelelayo, nithi kuye, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Akukho Thixo na kumaSirayeli, ukuba uthumela abantu ukubuza uBhaali-zebhubu, uThixo waseAkroni? Ngoko ke, awusayi kuphuma kwibhedi oya kuyo; uya kufa.
Wathi kubo ukumkani, Nguwuphi na ubuso bomntu oza kudibana nani, ethetha kuni la mazwi?
Baphendula ke bathi, Waye ngumntu oneenwele, ephethe umgca wesikhumba emqolo wakhe. Wathi ukumkani, Lo nguEliya waseTishbi.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wamthumela kuEliya umphathi womkhosi, namadoda akhe amashumi mahlanu. Wanyuka ke lo mphathi kumprofeti uEliya; yabona ukuba ehlala phezulu komnqamlezo wenduli, wathi kuye, Mntu kaThixo, ukumkani uthi, Yiya phantsi.

Waphendula uEliya, wathi kukumkani, Ukuba mna ndingumntu kaThixo, makhuphe umnqamlezo ezulu, akutshise wena namadoda akho amashumi amahlanu. Waphuma ke umnqamlezo ehlabathini, wamtshisa loo mfazwe namadoda akhe amashumi mahlanu.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wamthumelela omnye umthetheli, namadoda akhe amashumi mahlanu. Wathi kuye lo mthetheli, Mntu kaThixo, ukumkani uthi, Yiya phantsi ngokukhawuleza.

Waphendula uEliya, wathi, Ukuba mna ndingumntu kaThixo, makhuphe umnqamlezo ukusuka esibhakabhakeni, akutshise wena namadoda akho amashumi amahlanu. Wakhupha ke umnqamlezo kaThixo ukusuka esibhakabhakeni, wamtshisa loo mlawuli namadoda akhe amashumi mahlanu.

Wathumela ke ukumkani umthetheli wesithathu weshumi elinesihlanu, naye namadoda akhe amashumi mahlanu. Wanyuka lo mphathi weshumi elinesihlanu, wabetha imilenze yakhe phambi kukaEliya, wamcela, wathi kuye, Mntu kaThixo, nceda uphefumlo lwam lube lubalulekileyo, nomoya wale mikhonzi yakho emihlanu.
Ke kaloku, umlilo wawela esibhaka-bhakeni, wabatshisa abo madoda amakhulu amabini angaphambili nabasetyhini babo; ngoko ke namhlanje mna ndicela ukuba umphefumlo wam ube yinzuzo kuwe.
Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova kuEliya, Yiya phantsi naye; ungamkholeli. Wavuka ke uEliya, waya phantsi naye kuye ukumkani.

Wathi ke uEliya kukumkani, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Uthumelele abathunywa ukuba babuze uBhaali-zebhub, idini laseEkron? Ingaba ngenxa yokuba akukho Thixo eSirayeli angabuza loo nto? Ngokuba wenze loo nto, awusayi kuphuma kwibhedi ohlala kuyo; uya kufa ngokuqinisekileyo.
Wafa ke uAhaziya, ngokwelizwi likaYehova elalithetha nguEliya. UYoram waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe, ngokuba akayena mntwana; kwaba ngomnyaka wesibini kaYoram, unyana kaYosafati, ukumkani wakwaYuda.
Ezinye izinto azenzayo uAhaziya, zihleli zibhalwe encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi wayeya kumthabatha uEliyahu emlilweni womoya, uEliyahu noElisa babephuma eGalgali.
Wathi uEliya kuElisha, Nceda, hlala apha; ngokuba iNkosi undithumelele eBheteli. Wathi ke uElisha, Uphila iNkosi nokuphila kwakho, andikushiyelanga wena. Bahla ke bedibana baseBetheleli.
Baphuma ke oonyana bakaprofeti eBheteli kuye uElisha, bathi kuye, Uyazi na ukuba iNkosi uya kumthabatha umphathi wakho namhlanje phezu kwakho? Wathi uElisha, Ndiyazi; musa ukuthetha ngalo.
Wathi ke kuye uEliya, Elisha, nceda uhlale apha; ngokuba iNkosi undithumelele eYeremiya. Wathi ke uElisha, Uphila iNkosi nokuphila kwakho, akuyi kukushiya mna. Bafika ke besuka eYeremiya.
Bafika ke oonyana bakaprofeti eYeremiya kuElisha, bathi kuye, Uyazi na ukuba iNkosi uya kumthabatha umphathi wakho namhlanje kude nawe? Wathi yena, Ndiyazi; musa ukuthetha ngalo.
Wathi kuye uEliya, Nceda, hlala apha; ngokuba iNkosi undithumelele kumlambo iJordan. Wathi ke uElisha, Uphila iNkosi nobomi bakho, ndiza kukushiya. Bahamba ke bona bobabini.
Ke kaloku bahamba amadoda amashumi amahlanu eqela labaprofeti, bahlala kude, bejongene nabo; ke uEliya noElisa babehlala ngaseYordan.
Ke kaloku uEliya wasusa iingubo zakhe, waza wayitywina, wabetha ngazo amanzi; lahlula amanzi ngasekunene nakwesobunxele; badlula bonke ababini phezu komhlaba omileyo.
Bathe badlula, uEliyahu wathi kuEliya, Nditshoni, ndingakwenza ntoni na kuwe phambi kokuba ndithathelwe kude nawe? Waphendula uEliya, Ndicela ukuba ndithathe inxalenye ephindwe kabini yomoya wakho.
Wathi ke uEliya, Ucela into enzima; kodwa ukuba ndimbona xa ndithathwa kude nawe, uya kuyifumana; ukuba ungandibonanga, awunakuyifumana.
Ke kaloku, xa behamba bethetha-thethana, kwafika phakathi kwabo inqanawa yomlilo, neemahashe zomlilo; wanyuka uEliyahu waya esibhakabhakeni.

Ke kaloku uElisha wakubona, watsho wathi, Utata wam! Utata wam! Iimoto zakwaSirayeli, nabakhweli babo! Wathi ke akakwazi ukuwubona kwakhona. UElisha wathabatha iimpahla zakhe, waza wazenza zibe zimbini.
Ke kaloku wathabatha ibhanti, elingena kuEliya, wabuyela, wamisa emehlweni eJordan.

Wathabatha ibhanti, eyaphuka kuEliya, wabetha ngayo amanzi, wathi, Aphi na iNkosi, uThixo kaEliya? Ke kaloku, xa ebetha amanzi, lahlukaniswa icala lasekunene nelinye lasekhohlo; uElisa wadlula phezu kwawo.
Ke kaloku iqela labaprofeti abasuka eYeremiya, belinde, bakubona, bathi, Umoya kaEliya ukwi-Elisha. Baye ke baya kumnqamla, baba ngumbulelo emhlabeni phambi kwakhe.

Bathi ke kubo, Yabona, sineendoda ezinamandla ezintandathu phakathi kwethu, thina abakhonzi bakho; sicela ukuba zihambe zifune ukumkani wakho; alanele ukuba umphefumlo kaYehova wamthabatha, wambeka phezulu kwelinye induli, okanye elunxwemeni nemu. Wathi uElisha, Hayi, musa ukuwathumela.
Ke kaloku baqhubeka bempembelela, de waba buhlungu kakhulu ukuba angabikho. Wathi ke, Bathumelele. Bathumelela amadoda amashumi amahlanu; babezama iintsuku ezintathu, bangawufumananga uEliya.
Ke kaloku babuyela kuye uElisa, ke yena wayehlala eYeremiya. Wathi kubo uElisa, Andikundixelela na ukuba musa ukuhamba?
Bathi oonyana bakaYeremiya kuElisha, Yabona, nkosi yam, lo mzi ukwindawo elungileyo, njengokuba ubona; kodwa amanzi amabi, ilizwe alivelisi nto.
Wathi uElisha, Ninikele isitya esitsha, nimise isonka kuso. Bayamnika ke.
Ke kaloku waphuma waya emlanjeni, wamthabatha umgubo kuwo, wathi, Ithi loo nto iNkosi, Ndiwaphilise la manzi; ayisayi kuba yingozi yokufa, nakwindawo yomhlaba, ukuba ingazali.
Amanzi aye aphiliswa, aya kuthi ke namhlanje, njengokuba wathi uElisha.
Waya khona uEliya waya eBheteli. Ke kaloku, ekuhambeni kwakhe phantsi kwendlela, kwaphuma amadoda amancinci emzini, ayemxolela; bathi, Yiya phezulu, mhlekazi! Yiya phezulu, mhlekazi.
Ke kaloku wajika, wababona, waza wabanga kubo ngegama likaYehova. Zaphuma ke izimvu ezibini zezilwanyana zasendle emthini, zaluka amadoda amakhulu amabini anamashumi mane.
Wahamba ke uElisha ukusuka apho waya emnqamlezweni kaKarmele, wabuyela khona eSamari.
UYoram unyana kaAhabhi waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli eSamari, ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo kaJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda; waba neminyaka elishumi elinambini engukumkani.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, akunjalo nanjengoko babesenza uyise nodade wakhe; wasusa isibonda esiphakamileyo sikaBhali, ebesiyenze udade wakhe.
Ke kaloku waqhubeka esenza izono zikaYarobhoham unyana kaNabati, owenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba athini na; akaze ahambe kuzo.
UMesha ukumkani wakwaMowabi wayenazo iinkomo; wabanika ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ngomnyaka ngamnye amawaka amakhulu eentlanzi, nolusu lwamawaka amakhulu eemvu.
Ke kaloku, emva kokuba uAhabhi efile, ukumkani wakwaMowabi wabuya waya kukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Waphuma ke ukumkani uYoram ngaloo mihla eSamari, wababiza bonke abaSirayeli ukuba bafakele.

Wathumela ke kuYoshafati ukumkani wakwaēšanaso uYuda, esithi, Ukumkani waseMowabhi unqula kum; uya kuhamba na nam ukuhlasela amaMowabhi? Waphendula uYoshafati wathi, Ndiya kuhamba; ndiya kuhlala nawe yonke indlela; abantu bam babantu bakho, izimvu zam ziinkunzi zakho.
Wathi ke uYoram, Ngubani na indlela esiza kuhlasela ngayo? Waphendula uYoram wathi, Yiyo imifula kaEdom.
Waye ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, nokumkani wakwaYuda, nokumkani wakwaEdom; bahamba bejikeleza iintsuku ezisibhozo; kwakungekho manzi aseleyo kumkhosi, nakwizinto eziphilayo eziya nabo.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Hayi ke! UYehova ubeke phezu kwethu ookumkani abathathu, ukuze athabathe iMowabhi.

Wathi ke uYoshafati, Akukho mprofeti kaYehova apha, ukuba sibuze iNkosi ngaye? Waphendula omnye wabaphathi bakakumkani wakwaSirayeli, wathi, UElisha unyana kaShafati ukho apha; yena wayedla ngokulinganisa amanzi emanqeni kaEliya.
Wathi uJehoshafati, Ilizwi likaYehova likhona naye. Wahla ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noYoshafati, nokumkani waseEdom, ukuba babone.

Wathi ke uElisha kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Yintoni ekufuneka ndiyenze kuwe? Yiya kumaprofeti kayise wakho nomkhulu wakho. Waphendula ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wathi, Hayi; kuba nguYehova owenza ukuba sihlangane ookumkani abathathu, ukusinikela kumaMowabhi;
Wathi uElisha, Uphila iNkosi wamaSirayeli, lo Thixo endiwukhonzayo; ukuba ndingamkhathaleli uYoshuwafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, andikukujonga, ndikubone.
Ke ngoko, mnikele mna umntu odlala i-harpa. Xa wayedlala loo mdlali we-harpa, kwafika amandla kaYehova kuElisha.
Wathi, Itsho loo nto iNkosi, Nivule amasango kuloo mlambo wonke.
Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Akuyi kubakho umoya nibonayo, namanzi anibonayo; lo mlambo ke uya kuthethwa ngamanzi; niza kusela nina, nezinto zenu eziphilayo, nezidalwa zenu.
Le nto ilula kuYehova; uya kuzinikela phambi kwenu neMowabhi.

Uya kuhlasela umzi ngamnye onemigangatho, nedolophu nganye eqinileyo; uyasikhupha imithi yonke elungileyo, niyitshise zonke iziqhamo, niyiphucule yonke indawo elungileyo, niyigubungele ngeentyatyambo.
Ke kaloku, kusasa, ngexesha lomnikelo wesono, kwafika amanzi asuka ekumgama waseEdom; ilizwe lizele ngamanzi.
Bathi ke bonke abantu bakaMowabhi, beva ukuba bafika ookumkani ukuhlasela kubo; ke kaloku bonke abakwaziyo ukugqoka izithuthuthu, nabancinci nabakhulu, baqhutywa, babekwa emda.
Ke kaloku, bavuka kusasa, ilanga lakhanya emanzini; kwabona amaMowabhi asentshonalanga yelali, ukuba amanzi amnyama njengamanzi, njengegazi.
Bathi ke, Yigazi eli! Abakumkani babhidekela, babulalana; ngoku ke, Moabi, sihambe sithathe okuseleyo kwabo.
Bafika ke amaMowabhi esixekweni samaSirayeli, bavuka amaSirayeli, babahlasela; babaleka. AmaSirayeli athabathela ezweni, abulala amaMowabhi.

Zazibulala izixeko; ngazo zonke izityalo ezilungileyo, umntu ngamnye watyhila itye lakhe, de ziqhotyoshelwe. Zazivala zonke iinqanawa zamanzi acocekileyo, bathabathe zonke iintyatyambo ezilungileyo. Kwahlala kuphela uKire-hareshethi, namagqabi ayo elitye, kodwa abantu abanesiqhamo samadoda babeyigubungela, bayihlasela.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaMowabi, xa ebona ukuba ukulwa luya kuqhutywa kuye, wathabatha naye amadoda angamakhulu asixhenxe asebenzisayo ikrele, ukuze azame ukuwela kuye ukumkani waseEdom; kodwa abakwazi.
Wathabatha ke unyana wakhe omdala, oza kuba ngukumkani emva kwakhe, wamnikela njengomnqophiso womlilo phezu kodonga lomzi. Kwabakho inkanuko enkulu kuSirayeli; babuyela ezweni labo.

Watsho umfazi womntu othile kubafundi bakambingeleli kuye uElisha, esithi, Umkhonzi wakho umfazi wam wafa; nawe uyazi ukuba wayemthanda iNkosi; ke kaloku uya kufika lo mntu onemali, athabathe oonyana bam ababini abe ngamakhonzi akhe.
Wathi kuye uElisha, Ndingakuncedisa ntoni na? Nceda ndixelele ukuba unani endlwini yakho. Wathi yena, Umkhonzi wakho awunanto endlwini yam, ngaphandle kwebhotile encinci yeoli.
Wathi uElisha, Yiya uhamba-hamba, uthenge izitya ezingenanto kubo bonke abahlobo bakho; uthathe konke okukwaziyo.
Ke kaloku uya kungena, uvale umngxunya emva kwakho nawe oonyana bakho; unciphise ioli kuzo zonke iziqhoboshi; xa zigcwele nganye nganye, uzibeke kude.
Waphuma ke yena, wavala umnyango emva kwakhe nabantwana bakhe; bazisa kuye iziqwenga zebhotile, waza wayala.
Ke kaloku, zithe zonke iziqhoboshi zigcwele, wathi kunyana wakhe, Nceda ndinike isiqhoboshi esinye. Waphendula wathi, Akukho siqhoboshi sinye. Yamisa ke ioli ukutyibilika.
Waye waya, wamxelela umntu kaThixo. Wathi ke yena, Yiya, uthengise ioli, uhlawule intlawulo yakho; wena nonyana bakho niphile ngale nto isele.

Ke kaloku, kwafika uElisa eShunem; kwabakho khona indoda enegunya elikhulu. Wayemxelela ukuba ahlale apho, aze athathe isidlo sakusasa. Emva koko, xa wayedlula khona, wahlala khona athathe isidlo sakusasa.
Wathi kumfazi wakhe, Ndiyazi ukuba lo mntu usiya kuthi rhoqo ngumfazi ongcwele kaThixo.
Siya kwakha igumbi elincinci elunxwemeni, siyibeke khona isibhedlele, netafile, nesitulo, nesibane; ukuze xa efika kuthi, ahlale khona.
Ke kaloku, kwafika uElisha ngemini enye, wanyuka waya egumbini eliphakamileyo, walala khona.
Wathi kuGhehazi, umkhonzi wakhe, Thitha lo mfazi waseShunami. Wathi ke uGehazi kuye; waya, wamisa phambi kwakhe.

Wathi uElisha kuGhehazi, Yathi kuye, Uthe wafika kuloo monakalo wonke ngenxa yethu; singakwenza ntoni na kuwe? Singathetha nini nawe ukumkani, okanye umphathi womkhosi? Waphendula yena wathi, Ndihlala ndikhuselekile phakathi kwabantu bam.
Wathi ke uElisha, Ingaba kunokwenziwa ntoni na kuye? Waphendula uGehazi wathi, Yabona, akakho mntwana wakhe, nomyeni wakhe ungumdala.
Wathi uElisha, Yivulele. Wayivula ke uGehazi; waza wahlala emnyango.
Wathi ke uElisha, Ngonyaka ozayo ngaloo xesha, uya kuba nonyana emlonyeni wakho. Wathi yena, Hayi, nkosi yam, mntu kaThixo, musa ukuxolela umkhonzi wakho.
Ke kaloku lo mfazi wakhulelwa, waza wamzala unyana ngomnyaka olandelayo ngaloo mini, njengokuba wathi kuye uElisha.
Wakhula ke lo mntwana; kwathi mihla le, waphuma waya kuyise, obona ukuba utata wakhe esebenza nabavelisi bembewu.
Wathi kuyise, Intloko yam, intliziyo yam ibuhlungu. Udade wakhe wathi kumkhonzi wakhe, Yibangele kuye umyeni wakhe.
Umkhonzi wamthabatha, wamthabatha kumkakhe. Wahlala unyana emlonyeni wakhe de kube lixesha lemini; waza wafa.
Wamthabatha, wambeka phezu kwebhedi yomntu kaThixo; wavala umngxunya, waya ngaphandle.
Waza wabiza umfazi wakhe, wathi, Nceda ndithumelele omnye wabakhonzi bam neeseyile; ndenze umjikelo kumntu kaThixo, ndikubuyele.
Wathi ke, Kutheni na ukuba uhambe kuye namhlanje? Akukho mhla wonyaka omtsha, ayikho iSabbath. Wathi yena, Kulungile.
Wayimisa i-esile, yathi kumkhonzi wayo, Yiya phambili, uye khawuleza; musa ukucotha ngenxa yam, ngaphandle kokuba ndikuxelele.
Wahamba ke, waya kumntu kaThixo eNtlambo iKarmele. Ke kaloku, xa umntu kaThixo embona ngaphaya, wathi kuGhehazi umkhonzi wakhe, Yabona, kukho lo mfazi waseShunemi.
Yiya ujongene naye, uthi kuye, Ulungile na? Umyeni wakho ulungile na? Unyana wakho ulungile na? Waphendula ke yena wathi, Zonke izinto zilungile.

Ke kaloku, afike kumntu kaThixo entliziyweni yenduli, wathabatha imilenze yakhe. Wafika uGehazi ukuba amtyumze; wathi ke lo mntu kaThixo, Ushiyeke; kuba ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu kakhulu, yaye iNkosi wawufihla kum, wandixelela ukuba yintoni.
Wathi ke yena, Ndithe ndakucela na unyana, nkosi yam? Andikwazanga na ukuba ndithi kuwe, Musa ukunika ithemba kum?

Wathi ke uElisha kuGhehazi, Ncamathisela iingubo zakho emqolo wakho, uze uthathe isandla sam sokuhamba, uye; ukuba udibana nabani na, musa ukumsilela; ukuba umntu wamsilela wena, ungamphendulanga; ubeke isandla sam sokuhamba phezu kobuso bomntwana.
Wathi ke utata wonyana, Uphila iNkosi nokuphila kwakho, ukuba andikushiyeki. Wavuka ke uElisha, walandela.

Ke kaloku uGehazi waya phambi kwakhe, wabeka isandla esihambayo phezu kobuso bomntwana; kwakungekho lizwi, kwakungekho mntu ophilayo. Wabuyela ke emveni kukaElisa, wamxelela wathi, Umntwana akawuvukanga.
Wafika ke uElisha endlwini, yabona lo mntwana ulele emehlweni akhe, efile.
Ke kaloku uElisha waya, wavala umngxunya emva kwabo bobabini, wathandaza kuYehova.
Waya ebhedini, walala phezu komntwana, umlomo nomlomo, amehlo ngamehlo, izandla ngeesandla; waza ke, ethe wamisa phezu kwakhe, isisu somntwana saqala ukufudumeza.
Wavuka ke uElisha, wahamba ngaphakathi endlwini, waya phezulu waya phantsi; wanyuka ke, wamisa isandla sakhe phezu komntwana. Unyana watshisa amaxesha asixhenxe, wavula amehlo akhe.
UElisha wambiza uGehazi, wathi, Thitha lo mfazi waseShunami. Wamwisela ke; wafika ke uElisha, wathi, Yiba nonyana wakho.
Wafika ke, wawela emazulwini akhe, waba phantsi ehlabathini; wamthabatha unyana wakhe, waphuma.

Ke kaloku uElisha wabuyela eGalgali; kwakukho ndlala kuloo lizwe. Iqela labaprofeti lahlala phambi kwakhe; wathi ke kumkhonzi wakhe, Yenza isiqulatho esikhulu emlilweni, ulungiselele isonka kubaprofeti aba.

Ke kaloku omnye wabo waphuma waya emasimini, ukuba athabathe iziqhamo. Wafumana imbewu yeentyatyambo eziphilayo, wathabatha iziqhamo eziphilayo ezininzi, ngokwazo zonke izinto zakhe zokuzigqobhoza; wabuya ke, waza wazisa kwisitya sokutya, engazange azi ukuba zithini na.
Ke kaloku, xa beqala ukutya, batsho bathi, Mntu kaThixo, kukufa ngaphakathi kwebhotile. Bathi ke, Asikwazi ukuyidla.
Wathi uElisha, Nceda, ninikele isonka. Wayibeka emngxunyeni, wathi, Yazisa abantu ukuba baphile; kwakukho nantoni na engalunganga emingxunyeni.

Kwafika umntu osuka eBhaali-Shalisha, ethwala kumntu kaThixo iziqholo ezimashumi mabini zesonka sesheyile, ezenziwe ngezinto zokuqala zokuvuna, neentyatyambo zengqolowa emgqomeni wakhe. Wathi uElisha, Zinike abantu ukuba bazile.
Wathi umkhonzi wakhe, Ndiyibeke njani loo nto phambi kwamadoda amawaka? Wathi ke uElisha, Yabanika abantu ukuba baphile; ngokuba iNkosi uthi, Baya kudla, baza kubakho abaseleyo.
Wabeka ke phambi kwabo; badla, baza bashiya, njengokuba iNkosi wayethe.

Ke kaloku uNaman, umphathi womkhosi kakumkani waseSiriya, waba mkhulu kakhulu ebantwini bakhe, waza wamangaliswa ngukumkani wakhe; ngokuba ngoNaman iNkosi wayemsindisile uSiriya. Waye ke lo mntu, owayengumntu onamandla, wayeneentlungu zesikhumba, ezibizwa ngokuba yi-leprosy.
Ke kaloku kwafika amaSirayeli amaqela ahlaselayo eAram, bathabathe umntwana omncinci; waba ngumkhonzi womkakhe uNaman.
Wathi kuye umfazi wakhe, Kungenjalo ukuba inkosi yam ifike kumprofeti waseSamari; yena wayemphilisa umkhuhlane wakhe.
Waya uNamane, wamxelela ukumkani umphathi wakhe, esithi, Utsho lo mntwana waseSirayeli.

Wathi ukumkani wakwa-Aram, Yiya ngoku, ndithumelele incwadi kumkani wakwaSirayeli. UNaman ke waya, wathabatha emlonyeni wakhe amashumi amabini eetoni zesilivere, namawaka amathandathu eeshekeli zegolide, nezigqomo ezilishumi zokunxiba.
Wazisa ubhalela ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, lisithi, Ngelo ncwadi ndimthumelela umkhonzi wam uNaman kuwe, ukuba uyiphilise intlungu yakhe yokoma.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ekufundeni kwakhe elo phepha, waluka iimpahla zakhe, wathi, NdinguThixo na mna? Ndingabulala ndiphinde ndisindise? Kutheni le nto lo mntu ethumela kum umntu ukuba aphiliswe umkhuhlane wakhe? Yabonani ke ukuba ufuna ukungqubana nam.

Ke kaloku, uElisha, indoda kaThixo, yaqonda ukuba ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waluka iimpahla zakhe; wabathumela kuye, esithi, Uthini na ukuba uluka iingubo zakho? Yithumele kum lo mntu, aze akwazi ukuba kukho umprofeti eSirayeli.
Wafika ke uNaman, namahashe akhe, neemoto zakhe zokulwa, wamisa emehlweni endlu kaElisha.
Ke kaloku uElisha wamthumela umthunywa, esithi kuye, Yiya, hlamba izihlandlo ezisixhenxe emlanjeni waseYordana; isikhumba sakho siza kuphiliswa, nawe uza kuba ucocekile.

Ke kaloku uNaman waxhaphaza, waya; wathi, Ndiyabona, ndicinga ukuba uya kumphuma ngokuqinisekileyo, aze ahlale khona, anikele igama likaYehova uThixo wakhe, athabathe isandla sakhe phezu kwendawo, amphilise umkhuhlane wam.
Umlambo waseDamasko, uAbana noFarfara, awufanelekanga na ngaphezu kwamanzi onke aseSirayeli? Andikwazanga na ukuhlamba kuwo, ndicoceke? Wajika ke, waphuma ephupheni.
Bafika ke abakhonzi bakhe, bathetha kuye, besithi, Utata wam, ukuba lo mprofeti wathi kuwe into ebuhlungu, awuzange uyenze na? Ke kutheni ungayenzanga loo nto, xa uthi kuwe nje, Hlala, ube mhlophe?
Wahla ke uNaamani, watshisa isandla sakhe eYordan amaxesha asixhenxe, ngokwelizwi lomntu kaThixo elichazileyo kuye; isikhumba sakhe sabuyiselwa, safana nesikhumba somntwana omncinci, wacoceka.

Wabuya ke uNamane, namadoda akhe onke, kuye umntu kaThixo; wahlala phambi kwakhe, wathi, Namhlanje ndiyazi ukuba akukho Thixo emhlabeni wonke, ngaphandle kwaSirayeli; ngoko ke, mna ndacela, ndamkele isipho kumkhonzi wakho.
Wathi ke uElisha, Uphila iNkosi, uThixo wam, ukuba andiyi kuthatha nantoni na. UNaman wayemnyanzela ukuba athathe; yena ke akawufaki.

Wathi ke uNaamani, Ukuba akunjalo, mna umkhonzi wakho ndize ndithabathe, nceda, iinkomo ezimbini ezinomthwalo womhlaba; kuba mna umkhonzi wakho andiyi kunikela kwakhona idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, okanye isibingelelo nasiphi na idini likaThixo, ngaphandle kukaYehova.

Ke kaloku, iNkosi amxolele umkhonzi wakho ngaloo nto: Xa inkosi yam ifika endlwini kaRimon ukuba ibhiyozele, ihlala emlenzeni wam, ndimxolele khona ke; xa ndimxolela endlwini kaRimon, iNkosi amxolele umkhonzi wakho ngaloo nto.
Wathi ke kuye uElisha, Yiya ngoxolo. UNamane waphuma, waya phantsi kwendlela.

Wathi ke uGehazi, umkhonzi kaElisheya, umntu kaThixo, Inkosi yam ivumele lo Naman waseAram ahambe ngokulula kakhulu, engathathelanga into awayenzileyo; njengoko iNkosi ephilayo, mna ndiya kumlandela, ndiyifune kuye into.
Ke kaloku uGehazi wakhawuleza emva kukaNamane. Wabona ke uNamane ukuba kukho umntu ohamba emva kwakhe, wenyuka esuka kwisithuthi sakhe, wamfumana, wathi, Kulungile na?

Wathi ke uGehazi, Kulungile. Umphathi wam umthumelele ndithi, Bafika kum amadoda amabini amancinci eqela labaprofeti, asuka entlango ka adresi kaEfrayim; nceda ubanike iinkunzi zesilivere ezilishumi elinambini, nezityazo szerembo ezimbini.

Wathi ke uNaman, Nceda, chukua amashekeli angamashumi asixhenxe anesibhozo. Wathi ke kuye uGhehazi, ukuba athathe; wabeka isilivere ezingxoweni ezimbini, kunye neempahla ezimbimbini, wamnika oonyana bakhe ababini, babezithabatha phambi kukaGehazi.
Ke kaloku uGehazi, efika emnqamlezweni, wazithabatha ezi zinto ezandleni zabakhonzi bakhe, wazifihla endlwini; wabavumela amadoda abo ahambe.
Wafika ke uGehazi, wahlala phambi kwenkosi yakhe. UElisha wambuza wathi kuye, Wayephi na wena, uGehazi? Waphendula wathi, Umkhonzi wakho akazange ahambe naphi na.

Wathi kuye uElisha, Umphefumlo wam akawukho na nawe, xa lo mntu ehla esuka kwimoto yakhe yokuqhuba, ukuhlangabezana nawe? Ngumhla wokuba uthathe imali, nempahla, nezityalo zeolive, nezityalo zezinkomo, neenkomo, neebhokhwe, nabakhonzi, nabakhonzikazi?
Ke ngoko, ukoma kukaNaman luya kuthethwa kuwe nakwimbewu yakho ngonaphakade. Waphuma ke uGehazi endlwini kaElisa, isikhumba sakhe saba nesifo sokoma; samhlophe njengekhephu.
Bathi oonyana bakaprofeti kuElisha, Yabona, indawo esihlala kuyo phambi kwakho incinci kakhulu kuthi.
Nceda sihambe siye kumlambo iYorodani, sifumane khona umntu ngamnye isiqhamo, sibe nendawo yokuhlala. Wathi uElisha, Yiya.
Wathi omnye kubo, Nceda uhambe nathi abakhonzi bakho. UElisha wathi, Ndiya kuhamba.
Wahamba ke nabo; bafika ke eYordan, baqala ukutywina imithi.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa omnye wabo emisa umthi, intloko yesakhelo sentsimbi yawela emanzini; watsho ke wathi, Hayi, Nkosi yam! Yafunyanwa.
Wathi umfazi kaThixo, Yawela phi na? Wayibonisa ke indawo; wamisa uElisa intambo, wayibeka emanzini apho, yayenza intsimbi ukuba ihambe.
Wathi ke, Yikhuphe. Wayimisa ngoko isandla sakhe, wayithatha.
Ke kaloku ukumkani waseAram wahlasela amaSirayeli. Wathetha nabasebenzi bakhe, esithi, Ndiya kumisa icamp yam kwindawo enjalo nenjalo.
Wathumela umfazi kaThixo ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, esithi, Khumbula ukuba ungayidlulanga indawo leyo; ngokuba abaAram baphuma khona.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wathumela kulapho umntu kaThixo wamxelela khona. Wamxelela khona uElisa, waphinda waphinda; ke ngoko ukumkani waya endlwini yakhe, akazange ahambe kuqala okanye kamva.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwa-Aram wakhathazeka kakhulu ngaloo nto; wababiza abaphathi bakhe, wathi kubo, Nceda nindixelele: Nguwuphi na umntu wethu osuka kukumkani wakwaSirayeli?
Wathi omnye wabakhonzi bakhe, Akukho namnye kuthi, nkosi yam ukumkani; nguElisha lo mprofeti waseSirayeli; yena uxela ukumkani wakwaSirayeli amazwi othethayo egumbini lakho lokuhlambela.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi, Yiya nibone apho ekhoyo, ukuze ndithumele abantu ndimthathe. Bathi kuye, Yabona, uDothan.
Wathumela khona amahashe, neemoto zokulwa, nemfazwe enkulu; bafika ngobusuku, bajikelezisa umzi.
Ke kaloku umkhonzi womntu kaThixo, evuka emveni kwemini, waphuma ngaphandle; ke kaloku, yabona inqanawa ijikeleze lo mzi, kunye neenkomo nezithuthi zokulwa. Wathi, Hayi, nkosi yam! Siza kwenza ntoni?
Wathi uElisha, Musa ukukhathazeka; kuba abakho nathi baninzi kunabo abakho nabo.
Wathandaza ke uElisha, wathi, Nkosi, nceda uvule amehlo akhe ukuba abone. Wavula iNkosi amehlo omntwana; wajonge, wabona iintaba zizele ngamahashe nakwiimoto zomlilo ezijikeleza uElisha.
Wathi uElisha kuYehova, esithi, Nceda, phulaphule abantu aba ngento emnyama. UYehova wabetha ke nganto emnyama, njengoko wathi uElisha.
Wathi kubo uElisha, Asiyo le ndlela, asiyo lo mzi; landelani mna, ndiza kunizisa kumntu niwufunayo. Wabahambisa ke waya eSamariya.
Ke kaloku, befika eSamari, uElisha wathi, Nkosi, vula amehlo lamadoda lawa, ukuba babone. Wavula ke iNkosi amehlo abo; bajonge, babebona ukuba baya phakathi kweSamari.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wababona, wathi kuEliyashi, Ubaba wam, ndibabulala na? Ndibabulala na?
Wathi uElisha kuye, Musa ukuwabulala; uya kuwabulala na abantu abawuthathele isikhephe sakho nesikhongo sakho? Yabanika isonka nesamanzi, basele bedla besela, baphinde babuyiselwe kumphathi wabo.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wabalungiselela isidlo esikhulu; badla ke, basela, waza wabayalela ukuba bahambe. Baye babuyela kukumkani wabo. Emva koko iinqanawa zamaSirayeli zayeka ukungena ezweni likaSirayeli.
Kwathi emva koko, uBhe-hadadi ukumkani waseAram wahlanganisa lonke iqela lakhe, waya eSamariya, wayijikeleza.

Ke kaloku kwabakho utywala olukhulu kuloo mzi; ke kaloku, xa bethi bahlala khona ixesha elide, intloko yeeseyile yathengwa ngeeshekeli zesilivere ezimashumi asibhozo, nebhotile encinci yenkcubeko yenkomo ithengwe ngeeshekeli zesilivere ezine.
Ke kaloku, xa ukumkani wakwaSirayeli ehamba phezu kwedonga ledolophu, watsho kuye indoda enye, isithi, Ndincede, nkosi yam, ukumkani.
Wathi yena, Ukuba iNkosi akakuncedisi wena, ndiya kukunceda njani? Ndinayo na ingqolowa evela kwigumbi lokuhlambela, okanye iwayini evela kumbhobho wewayini?
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Yintoni loo nto? Waphendula wathi, Lo mfazi uthi kum, Nceda usinikele unyana wakho, siye siyamdla namhlanje; mva ke siya kumdla unyana wam.
Ke kaloku, sapheka unyana wam, sawudla. Kwathi ke ngemini elandelayo ndithi kuye, Nceda uncede unyana wakho, siye kumdla; yena ke wafihla unyana wakhe.

Ke kaloku ukumkani, xa eva amazwi owesifazane, waluka iimpahla zakhe; ke kaloku wayehamba phezu kwedonga. Bathe ke abantu bejonge, babona ukuba, ngaphaya kolusu lwakhe, phantsi kweempahla zakhe, kukho isigqomo esingwevu.
Wathi ke, UThixo anikwenze njalo, amnike okungakumbi, ukuba uElisha, unyana kaShafati, ekugqibeleni kwaloo mini, intloko yakhe iya kuba phantsi komqolo wakhe.

Ke kaloku uElisha wayehlala endlwini yakhe, namadoda amakhulu edolophu ayehlala naye. Ukumkani wathumela umthunywa phambi kwakhe; ke kaloku ngaphambi kokuba umthunywa afike, uElisha wathi kubo: Ingaba nibona ukuba lo mfazi uthumela umntu ukuba amseke intliziyo yam? Yabona, xa umthunywa efika, zivale intlango, ziyivalwe phezu kwakhe. Akunjalo na ukuba ilizwi leenyawo zenkosi yakhe lisemva kwakhe?
Ke kaloku, ngelixa uElisha ethetha nabo, kwafika umthunywa kuye. Wathi ukumkani, Eli thuba livela kuYehova; kutheni na ukuba ndilinde iNkosi ngoku?

Wathi ke uElisha, Yiva ilizwi likaYehova. Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Ngomhla olandelayo, ngaloo xesha lithile, emnyango waseSamariya, intonga yesonka esilungileyo iya kuthengwa ngeshekeli enye yesilivere, neshekeli elinamashumi asixhenxe yesiqhamo iya kuthengwa ngeshekeli enye yesilivere.

Waphendula unyana womphathi, umkhonzi kakumkani exhaswa ngumqolo wakhe, wathi kumntu kaThixo, Nakuba iNkosi avule izibane ezisibhakabhaka, kungaba kwenzeka ntoni na loo nto? UElisha waphendula wathi, Yabona, uya kuyibona ngamehlo akho, kodwa awuyi kulila nanye.
Ke kaloku kwabakho amadoda amane anesifo sokoma, ehlala emehlweni esango ledolophu; bathi omnye komnye, Sihlala ntoni na apha silinde ukufa?

Ukuba sithi, Siya kungena kuloo mzi, siya kufa khona; kuba kukho utywala kuloo mzi. Ke ukuba sihlala apha, siya kufa nathi. Ngoko ke, siya kudlula kumkhosi wamaSirayeli, siphume. Ukuba baya kusishiya, siya kuphila; kodwa ukuba baya kusibulala, siya kufa.
Bavuka ke ngobusuku, bafika esixekweni samaSirayeli; bafike ekugqibeleni kwesixekweni samaSirayeli, bona, akukho namnye.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wamenza umkhosi wamaSirayeli ukuba azive ilizwi leenqanawa, nelizwi lamakhwenkwe, ulwimi lomkhosi omkhulu. Bathi ke omnye kunye: Yabona, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli uqeshe ookumkani bakaHeti, nabakumkani bakaYiputa, ukuba bathuke kuthi.
Ke kaloku bavuka, babaleka ngobusuku, bashiya iintende zabo, namakhwenkwe abo, neeshelufu zabo; bashiya isixeko sakwaSirayeli njengokuba sikwindawo yayo, babaleka ngenxa yobomi babo.

Ke kaloku abo madoda aneempawu zokoma afike esiphelweni somkhosi, bafika endlwini enye yetente, badla basela; bathabatha kuyo isilivere, negolide, nezihlangu, baye bazifihla. Babuyela ke, bafika endlwini enye yetente, bathatha nalapho, bazifihla.

Bathi ke omnye kunye, Akukho nto ilungileyo esiyenzayo. Namhlanje ngusuku lweendaba ezilungileyo; siyazigcina thina; ukuba silinde kude kube kusasa, siza kugwetywa. Siyaye ngoku, siyixelele indlu kakumkani.

Baya ke, babiza abakhuseli beengcango zomzi; babaxelela bathi, Sathi safika esixekweni samaSirayeli, yaye, bona, akukho namnye apho, akukho msindo womntu naphi na; kwakukho kuphela iinkunzi zeegusha ezibotshelelweyo, neentyatyambo zihlala ngazo.
Bathi abakhuseli beengcango le nto, yafunyanwa loo nto endlwini kakumkani.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wavuka ngemini, wathi kubaphathi bakhe: Ndiza kukuxelelani into abaSirayeli abayenzayo; ngokuba bayazi ukuba silahlekile; ke ngoko baphuma esixekweni, basifihla emaphandleni. Bathi, Xa amaSirayeli ephuma emzini, siya kuwaqwalasela ubomi, sifike kumzi.

Waphendula ke omnye wabaphathi bakhe, wathi, Bathi abantu bathathe iinkunzi zeenkomo ezintandathu eziseleyo kuloo mzi; kuba ukuba zifile, akuyi kubakho buhlungu kubo bonke ooSirayeli abaseleyo apha, nokuba bafile bonke abo bafileyo. Siyabathumela sibone ukuba kwenzeka ntoni.
Bathi ke, bathabathe izithuthuthu ezibini ezinemahashe; ukumkani wabathumela emva komkhosi wamaSirayeli, wathi kubo, Yiya nibone.
Baya kulandela amaAram, bafika emlanjeni weJordan. Indlela yonke yaba yimigqomo nezixhobo, abagxotha ngazo amaAram, xa behamba ngokukhawuleza; babuyela abathunywa, bamxelela ukumkani.

Baphuma ke abantu, bathabathe yonke into emkhosini wakwaSirayeli. Yathengwa imitha enye yesonka esilungileyo ngeshekeli enye yesilivere, nemitha elishumi elinane yesiqhamo ngeshekeli enye yesilivere, njengokuba iNkosi watsho.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wabeka umphathi, owawumxhasa ngesandla sakhe, ukuba abe ngumlawuli wesango. Bathi ke abantu bamthabatha ngaphaya kwesango, waza wafa, njengokuba wathi umfazi kaThixo, xa ukumkani wayesele ehla kuye.

Ke kaloku kwathiwa, njengokuba umntu kaThixo wathetha ukumkani, esithi, Ngomhla othile ngaloo xesha, emnyango waseSamariya, imitha enye yesonka siza kuthengwa ngeshekeli enye yesilivere, nemitha enye yobisi lize lithengwe ngeshekeli enye yesilivere.
Waphendula ke lo mphathi kumntu kaThixo, wathi, Nakuba iNkosi evule izibane eziphakamileyo, kungaba kwenzeka ntoni na loo nto? Wathi ke uElisha, Yabona, uya kuzibona ngamehlo akho, kodwa awuzukudla.
Ke kaloku kwathiwa kuye oko; abantu bamthabatha emnyango, waza wafa.

Ke kaloku uElisha wathetha nomkakhe, owayemsindisile unyana wakhe, wathi, Yiya, uhamba nawe nosapho lwakho; uye, ube ngumhlali apho ungaba khona; ngokuba iNkosi wabiza indlala, ibe iya kufika kule ndawo iminyaka esixhenxe.
Wavuka umfazi, wenza ngokwelizwi lomntu kaThixo; waya yena nosapho lwakhe, wahlala ezweni lamaFilisti iminyaka esixhenxe.
Ke kaloku, emva kweminyaka esixhenxe, wabuyela ezweni lamaFilisti; waya kukumkani, wamcela ukuba ambuyisele indlu yakhe nelizwe lakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wayethetha noGhehazi, umkhonzi womntu kaThixo, esithi, Nceda ndixelele zonke izinto ezinkulu azenzayo uElisha.

Ke kaloku, xa uGehazi ethetha kukumkani ukuba uElisha wavusa umntwana ofileyo, yafika loo ndoda eyayingumntwana wayo, icela ukumkani indlu yakhe nelizwe lakhe. Wathi uGehazi, Inkosi yam ukumkani, lo ngumntu lowo, nolowo ngunyana wakhe, owawususa umphefumlo uElisha.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wabuza umfazi, wamxelela. Ukumkani ke wamnika umphathi-ndlu omnye, wathi, Yibuyisele zonke izinto zakhe, nazo zonke iziqhamo zesizwe sakhe, ukususela kwimini awayephuma kuyo, de kube ngoku.
Ke kaloku uElisha waya eDamasko. UBhe-hadadi ukumkani waseAram wayegula; baxela ke ukumkani, besithi, Umntu kaThixo ufika apha.
wathi kuHazayeli, Yithathele isipho emlonyeni wakho, uye ukudibana nomntu kaThixo; ubuze iNkosi ngomlomo wakhe, uthi, Ndiya kuphiliswa na kule ngxaki?

Waya ke uHazayeli ukuhlangabezana noElisa, wathabatha isipho sazo zonke izinto ezilungileyo zaseDamasko, ezigqunywe ngeenyamezi ezintandathu. Yafika yahlala phambi kwakhe, wathi, Unyana wakho uBhe-hadadi ukumkani waseSiriya undithumelele ukuba ndibuze, Ndiza kuphiliswa na kule ngxaki?
Wathi kuye uElisha, Yiya, sithi kuye, Uza kuphiliswa ngokuqinisekileyo; kodwa iNkosi wandibonisa ukuba uya kufa.
Ke kaloku uElisha wajongela kuHazayeli, waza ke umphefumlo kaHazayeli wawucaphucaphu. Wathi lo mntu kaThixo, Lila!

Wathi ke uHazayeli, Yintoni na loo nto ulilindela ngayo, nkosi yam? UElisha waphendula wathi, Ngokuba ndiyazi ububi obuya kukwenza kubo ooSirayeli; uya kuzitshisa iinqaba zabo ngomlilo, uya kuwabulala ngekhephu oonyana babo abancinci, uya kubatyhadala abantwana babo, uya kubavula amabhinqa abo akhulelweyo.
Wathi ke uHazayeli, Ungenza ntoni na umkhonzi wakho, mna intombi yakho? Waphendula uElisha wathi, UYehova wandibonisa ukuba uya kuba ngukumkani waseSiria.
Washiya ke uHazayeli uElisa, wabuyela kukumkani wakhe. Wathi kuye uBhenath-hadadi, Utsho ntoni na uElisa kuwe? Waphendula uHazayeli wathi, Wathetha nam ukuba uya kuba ngcono.
Ke kaloku, ngemini elandelayo, uHazayeli wathabatha isigqomo, wayitshisa ngamanzi, wamthambisa phezu kobuso bukakumkani, waya kufa. UHazayeli waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesihlanu kaYoram, unyana kaAhabhi, waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli; ke kaloku uYoram, unyana kaJehoshafati, waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda.
Ubeminyaka imashumi mathathu anamibini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka esibhozo engukumkani eYerusalem.
Wahamba ngeendlela zabakumkani bakaSirayeli, njengokuba beyenze ikhaya likaAhabhi; ngokuba wamisa intombi kaAhabhi. Wenza oko kubi ngamehlo kaYehova.
Ke kaloku iNkosi akafuni ukucima amaYuda, ngenxa kaDavide, umkhonzi wakhe; ngokuba wayethe wathetha ukuba uya kumnika uDavide nembewu yakhe isibane ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku, ngexesha lokumkani uYoram, amaEdom asuka ekumkani wakwaYuda, wamisela ukumkani wakhe.

Ke kaloku uYoram waya eZayiri, nazo zonke iinqanawa zakhe zokulwa. Bathi ke abaEdom babemxelisa yena nabathetheli bakhe beinqanawa; wavuka ngobusuku, wabahlasela; amajoni akhe asuka aye ezintlanganeni zawo.
Ke kaloku iEdom yasuka phantsi kolawulo lukaYuda, iye kule mini. ULibna umzi-dolophu waphuma ngaloo xesha.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uYoram, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, ngaba azibhalwenga phantsi kwencwadi yemihla ngemihla yamakumkani aseYuda?
Walala ke uYoram, wabanjwa nabafazi bakhe emzini kaDavide; uAhaziya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibini kaYoram, unyana kaAhabhi, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waba ngukumkani kuYuda uAhaziya, unyana kaYoram.

UAhaziya ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamibini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinambini engukumkani eYerusalem. Umfazi wakhe wayenguAtaliya, intombi kaOmri ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Wahamba ngeendlela zendlu ka-Ahabhi, wenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, njengokuba bekwenze ikhaya lika-Ahabhi; ngokuba wayeyintsapho yendlu ka-Ahabhi.
Wahamba uAhaziya noYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ukuhlasela uHazayeli ukumkani wakwaSiriya eRamothi yeGiliyadi; amaSiriya abulala uYoram.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uYoram wabuya waya eYizreyeli, ukuba aphilise izidumbu zakhe, abaAram babembulala ngazo eRama, xa wayedlalwa nguHazayeli ukumkani waseYizreyeli. UAhaziya unyana kaYoram, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wehla waya eYizreyeli, ukuze ambone uYoram, unyana kaAhabhi; ngokuba wayedubula.
Ke kaloku uElisha umprofeti wabiza umntu othile kubantwana bakaprofeti, wathi kuye, Ubeke iingubo zakho emqolo wakho, uze uthathe esi siquphe seoli, uye eRamoti-gileyadi.
Xa ufike khona, khangela uYehu, unyana kaYoshafati, unyana kaNimshi; uye kuye, umsuse phakathi kwabahlobo bakhe, umngenise endlwini yangaphakathi.
Yithathe ke ibhotile yeoli, uyithele phezu kweentloko zakhe, usithi, Itsho le nto iNkosi, Ndikuphilise ukuba ube ngukumkani kumaSirayeli. Uvule ke umngxunya, uhambe; ungabi nexesha.
Waye ke lo mntwana, unyana womprofeti, waya eRamoti-gileyadi.

Ke kaloku, xa efika, wababona abathetheli bemikhosi behlala ndawonye. Wathi, Ndinento endiyithethayo kuwe, umphathi omkhulu. UYehu wathi, Kuwuphi na phakathi kwethu? Waphendula wathi, Kuwe, umphathi omkhulu.

Wavuka ke uYehu, wafika endlwini. Unyana womprofeti wamsusa ioli phezu kwentloko yakhe, wathi, Itsho le nto iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Ndikutywina ukuba ube ngukumkani kubo bonke abantu bakaYehova abaSirayeli.
Ke wena uya kuyicima indlu kaAhabhi, unkosi wakho; ukuze ndiyibuyisele kuYezebeli igazi labakhonzi bam abaprofeti, negazi labo bonke abakhonzi bakaYehova, abo wabulala.
Indlu kaAhabhi yonke iya kufa; ndiya kucima wonke umntu owesifazane endlwini kaAhabhi eSirayeli, nokuba ngumkhonzi, nokuba ungumntu okhululekileyo.
Ndiya kwenza indlu kaAhabhi ibe njengendlu kaYerebhoyamu unyana kaNabati, nendlu kaBhasha unyana kaAhiya.
Iinkomo ziya kulila uYezebeli ezweni laseYizreyeli, yaye akukho namnye oza kumfihla. Wavula ke umngxunya, waphuma.

Ke kaloku uYehu waphuma waya kubakhonzi bakakumkani wakhe. Wathi omnye kubo kuye, Kulungile na? Kutheni le nto lo mntu okhohlakeleyo efika kuwe? Waphendula uYehu wathi, Uyazi loo mntu nohlobo lwezinto athethayo.
Wathi ke uYehu, Wathetha kum, esithi, Itsho loo nto iNkosi, Ndikutywina wena ukuba ube ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku bakhawuleza bonke, bakhupha iingubo zabo, bazibhengeza phantsi kukaYehu, phezu kweenyawo ezimnyama; baphucula izidumbu, besithi, UYehu ungukumkani.
Ke kaloku uYehu, unyana kaJehoshafati, unyana kaNimshi, wenza isithethe kuYoram; ke kaloku uYoram noSirayeli bonke babekhusela eRamoti-gileyadi, ngenxa kaHazayeli ukumkani waseAram.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uYoram wabuya waya eYizreyeli, ukuba aphilise izidumbu zakhe, abaAram babembulala ngazo emfazweni noHazayeli ukumkani waseYizreyeli. Wathi ke uYehu kuye, Ukuba ungumntu wam, akukho namnye oza kuphuma kuloo mzi, aze amxelele uYizreyeli.
Ke kaloku uYehu wenyuka, waya eYizreyeli; kuba uYoram wayelele khona, ebuhlungu. UAhaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda wayesele ehla ukuba abone uYoram.

Ke kaloku, xa umgcini-ntloko, ohlala phezulu kwintombi yaseYizreyeli, ebona iqela likaYehu lifika, watsho wathi, Ndibona iqela lamadoda. Wathi uYoram, Thumela umqhubi wesikhephe ukudibana nabo, uthi, Uvela njani ngoxolo?

Waphuma ke umkhweli, wadibana noYehu, wathi, Ukumkani uthi, Ingaba ufika ngoxolo na? Waphendula uYehu wathi, Yintoni ekufumaneni uxolo kuwe? Yiya ngasemva kwam. Ke kaloku umkhonzi wamxelela, esithi, Umthunywa waya kubo, kodwa akabuyeli.
Wathumela ke ukumkani umkhweli wesithathu, wafika kubo, wathi, Ukumkani uthi, Ingaba nivela ngoxolo na? Waphendula uYehu wathi, Yintoni ekufumaneni uxolo kuwe? Yiya emva kwam.
Wathi umgcini, Ufike kubo; ke kaloku akabuyanga. Ukuqhuba kwakhe kufana nokuqhuba kukaYehu unyana kaNimshi; uqhuba njengokuba ngumntu onengqondo.

Ke kaloku uYoram wathi, Nciphisa imoto yam. Yathi ke imoto yam igqityiwe, waphuma uYoram ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noAhaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda, ngaye ngamnye ngemoto yakhe yokulwa noYehu; badibana naye ezweni likaNabhoti waseYizreyeli.

Ke kaloku, xa uYoram ebona uYehu, wathi kuye, Ufika njani ngoxolo, uYehu? Waphendula uYehu wathi, Kuza kubakho ntoni na uxolo, xa imifanekiso engumqondiso kaYezebeli, umyeni wakho, ikhona kuyo yonke indawo?
Ke kaloku uYoram wayalela imoto yakhe, wabaleka, wathi kuAhaziya, Ukwenza okubi, Ahaziya.
Ke kaloku uYehu wathabatha isithunywa sakhe, wambetha uYoram phakathi kwemilenze yakhe; isilayidi sadlula entliziyweni yakhe, waba phantsi emkhosini wakhe.

Ke kaloku uYehu wathi kuBidkare, umphathi weemoto zakhe, Yithabathe, uyithule kwindawo yomhlaba kaNabhothi waseYizreyeli; kuba uyakhumbula xa mna nowe sahamba ngasemva kukaAhabhi uyise wakhe, iNkosi wathetha ngaloo nto kuye, esithi,

Ndiyabona namhlanje igazi likaNabhothi, negazi labantwana bakhe, utsho iNkosi; ndiza kukuhlawula ngokuqinisekileyo kuloo mhlaba, utsho iNkosi. Ke ngoko, umthwale, umthubele kuloo mhlaba, njengoko utsho iNkosi.

Ke kaloku, uAhaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda ekubona loo nto, wabaleka waya kwindlela eya eBhete-hagani. UYehu ke wamlandela, esithi, Yibalwe naye; bamwisela emkhosini wakhe, ekuhambeni kwakhe ukuya eGuri, entliziyweni ka-Ibleyam. Waphuma waya eMegido, wafa khona.
Abaphathi bakhe bamthabatha endlwini yemoto yakhe, wamthabatha waya eYerusalem, bayamtyibilika nabazalwana bakhe kwisibingelelo sakhe, emzini kaDavide.
UAhaziya waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibini kaYoram, unyana ka-Ahabhi, ukumkani kwaSirayeli.
Wafika ke uYehu eYizreyeli. Ke kaloku, xa uYezebeli ekwazile loo nto, wamisa amehlo akhe, walungisa iinwele zakhe, wajonge ngaphandle kwefestile.
Ke kaloku, xa uYehu efika ngesango, watsho wathi, Ufika njani ngoxolo, uZimri, umfazi wokumkani wakho?
Ke kaloku uYehu waphakamisa amehlo akhe efestileni, wathi, Nguwuphi na lowo ungumnye nam? Nguwuphi na? Bathi abaphathi bendlu kakumkani ababini okanye ababini nabathathu bajonge kuye.
Ke kaloku uYehu wathi, Yikhupheni phantsi. Bayamkhupha ke phantsi; kwaphuma igazi lakhe litshisa phezu kodonga, nakwiihashe; zathi izihashe ziyikhupha phantsi.
Ke kaloku uYehu waya ngaphakathi, wadla waza wasela. Wathi ke uYehu, Yinikele ingqalelo kuloo ndoda ibalaseleyo, niyise; ngokuba wayeyintombi yokumkani.
Ke kaloku, bafika ukuba bamkhulise, abafumani nto iseleyo, ngaphandle kwengcuka yakhe, neenyawo zakhe, nezandla zakhe.
Ke kaloku babuyela, bamxelela uYehu. Wathi uYehu, Lithetha ntoni na ilizwi likaYehova ngesandla somkhonzi wakhe uEliyahu waseTishbhi, esithi, Kwilizwe laseYizreyeli amakati azodla inyama kaYezebeli.
Intliziyo kaYezebeli iya kuba njengenkunkuma yomhlaba, ezweni laseYizreyeli, ukuze akukho mntu oza kuthetha, Lo nguYezebeli.
Ke kaloku uAhabhi wayeneentombi ezimashumi asixhenxe eSamari. Wabhala ke uYehu iileta, waza wazisa eSamari, kubaphathi baseYizreyeli, nabathetheli, namadoda alawulayo oonyana bakaAhabhi, wathi,
Bakho nawe oonyana bakakumkani wakho, unazo izithuthi zemfazwe, neebhayisikile, nomzi onezikhephe, nezixhobo; ngoko ke, xa eli phepha lifika kuwe,
Bakhetheni olungileyo, onobuchule phakathi koonyana bakakumkani wenu; nimise phezu kwetrone kayise, nibethe ngendlu kakumkani wenu.
Ke kaloku bakhathazeka, besithi, Abakumkani ababini abakwazi ukumelana naye; siza kuhlala njani nathi?

Umphathi wendlu kakumkani, nomlawuli womzi, namagqwetha, neengxowa-ntsapho, bathumela kuYehu, besithi, Siyakuba ngabakhonzi bakho; siza kwenza konke okuthi usithi kuthi; asiyi kwenza mntu waba ngukumkani; wenze oko kulungileyo emehlo akho.

Wabhala ke kubo uYehu incwadi yesibini, esithi, Ukuba ningamthobeli mna, nokuba niya kumphulaphula, ninikele kum iintloko zabantwana baka [u]kumkani wenu ngoMgqibelo ngaloo xesha eYizreyeli. Ke kaloku oonyana bakakum szereli abamashumi asixhenxe bakhula kumadoda aphezulu omzi.
Wafika ke lo mbhalo kubo, bathabathela oonyana bakakumkani abamashumi asixhenxe, bababulala bonke; babeka iintloko zabo ezityeni, bayithumela kuye eYiputa.
Wafika umthunywa, wamxelela uYehu, esithi, Bazisa iinwele zabantwana bakakumkani. Wathi uYehu, Zibeke emngxunyeni wesango ledolophu, zibe ziimilo ezibini, kuze kube kusasa.
Waphuma ke uYehu emveni kwemini, wahlala phambi kwabantu bonke, wathi, Akukho monakalo kuni; kunene ndiye ndenza inkohlakalo kukumkani wam, ndawubulala; kodwa abo bonke babulawa ngubani?
Yazi ke loo nto, ukuba akukho lizwi elilodwa iNkosi alilithethayo ngendlu kaAhabhi; iNkosi wenza oko wathi ngomlomo womkhonzi wakhe uEliyahu.
Ke kaloku uYehu wabulala bonke abaseleyo bakaAhabhi eYizreyeli, namadoda amakhulu akhe onke, nabahlobo bakhe, nababingeleli bakhe; akazange ashiye mntu.
Waphuma ke uYehu waya eSamari. Wayihamba indlela, wafika eBhethe-ekede, apho abagcini bezinkomo bezisusa khona iinkomo zabo;
Wadibana nabahlobo bakaAhaziya, ukumkani wakwaYuda; wathi kubo, Nibani na? Baphendula bathi, Sinabahlobo bakaAhaziya; sithe sawela ukutyelela oonyana bakakumkani, oonyana benkosikazi.
Ke kaloku uYehu wathi, Bathabathe ubomi. Bathabathe ke ubomi, bababulala ecaleni kwevundla laseBhethe-ekede, amadoda amashumi mane anesibini; akashiyenga mntu omnye kubo.

Waphuma khona uYehu, wadibana noYonadabu, unyana kaRekabhi, esuka emnqamlezela. UYehu wamvuya, wathi kuye, Ingaba ungumntu olungileyo kum, njengokuba mna ndingumntu olungileyo kuwe? Waphendula uYonadabu, wathi, NdinguThixo. Wathi uYehu, Ukuba ungumntu olungileyo kum, nikela isandla sakho kum. Wayinika ke isandla sakhe; uYehu wamkhupha waya kwisithuthi.
Wathi ke uYehu, Yiya nam, ubone ukuba mna ndiyithanda njani iNkosi. Wahamba ke noYonadabu ngemoto yakhe naye.
Wafika ke uYehu eSamari, wabulala bonke abaseleyo kuAhabhi eSamari, wabasusa ngokupheleleyo, njengoko wathi iNkosi kuEliyahu.
Ke kaloku uYehu wahlanganisa bonke abantu, wathi, UAhabhi wamkhonza uBhaali kancinci; uYehu uya kumkhonza kakhulu.

Ke ngoko, zinikele ndawonye bonke abaprofeti bakaBhali, nabo bonke abakhonzi bakhe, nababingeleli bakhe bonke; ningabikho mntu uphelileyo; kuba ndiya kunikela isibingelelo esikhulu kuBhali. Nabani na ongafikayo, uya kufa. UYehu ke wayewakhohlisa, ukuze abulala abo bakhonzi bakaBhali.
Wathi ke uYehu, Buza ingqungquthela engcwele, ukuba bayihloniphe iBhaali. Babhengeza ke loo nto

Ke kaloku uYehu wathumela izithunywa kumaSirayeli onke, bafika bonke abakhonzi bakaBhali; akukho namnye wabahlalayo phakathi kwabo. Bathi ke baya kungena endlwini kaBhali, ibe igcwele ukususela esiphelweni sesiphelo.
Ke kaloku uYehu wathi kumntu olawula iimpahla, Thola phandle izinto zokugqoka kubo bonke abakhonzi bakaBhali. Wazisa khona izinto zokugqoka kubo.

Wafika ke uYehu noYonadabu, unyana kaRekabhi, endlwini kaBhali. Wathi uYehu kubo bonke abakhonzi bakaBhali, Nceda nijonge, nibone ukuba akukho namnye phakathi kwenu okhonzayo iNkosi, kodwa ngabakhonzi bakaBhali kuphela.

Bathi ke, bafike balungiselele izibingelelo nezibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi. Ke kaloku uYehu wababeka phandle amadoda angamashumi asibhozo; wathi kubo, Nabani na oza kwenza ukuba aphume umntu omnye kubo bonke abantu endibanikelayo kuni, uya kuphulukana nobomi bakhe.

Ke kaloku, xa uYehu egqibile ukunikela isibingelelo esiqhutywa ngamanzi, wathi kubo abakhonzi nabaphathi: Ngeni, babulalane nabo; akukho namnye oza kuphuma. Bawabulala ke ngeekhephu zabo; abakhonzi nabaphathi bathabathela izidumbu zazo, bafika kwigumbi elingaphakathi lendlu kaBhaali.
Bazikhupha iinkunzi zeenkomo endlwini kaBhaali, bazitshisa.
Batshisa ilitye likaBhali, baphucula indlu kaBhali, bayiguqula ibe yindawo yokuhlambela abantu; iye yahlala de kube ngaloo mini.
Ke kaloku uYehu wamsusa uBhaali eSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, uYehu akazange atshintshe izondlo zikaYaroboham unyana kaNabhati, awazenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba abe nezondlo; wazenza izimvu zegolide eBheteli naseDan.

Wathi iNkosi kuYehu, Ukwenze kakuhle ukuba wenze okulungileyo emehlweni am; ungenise indlu ka-Ahabhi zonke izinto endizifunayo; ke ngoko, imbewu yakho iya kuhlala kwisithsaba samaSirayeli iminyaka emine.
Ke kaloku uYehu akazange agcine ukuba alandele umthetho kaYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, intliziyo yakhe yonke; akaze ahambe kude nezono zikaYarobhoham, owenzayo amaSirayeli asinde.
Ngazo ezo mihla iNkosi waqala ukuncipha amaSirayeli; waza uHazayeli wababulala kumaSirayeli kuwo onke amacala.
Wathatha ilizwe elisentshonalanga yeJordan, lonke ilizwe laseGiliyadi, apho behlala khona amaGadi, namaRubheni, namaManase; wathabathela eAroeri, elunxwemeni lweArnoni, waya eGiliyadi noBhashan.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uYehu, nazo zonke izinto zakhe, nemisebenzi yakhe yonke, zithe zabhalwe encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani bakaSirayeli.
Wafa uYehu, wabanjwa eSamari; uYohahazi unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UYehu waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli eSamari iminyaka emashumi mabini anesibhozo.
Ke kaloku, xa uAthaliya, unyana kaAhaziya, ebona ukuba unyana wakhe ufile, wavuka waza wabulala bonke oonyana bokumkani.

Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, intombi kakumkani uYoram, umzalwana kaAhaziya, wathabatha uYowashe, unyana kaAhaziya, wamfihla phakathi kwabathetheli abaya kubulawa; wamfihla yena nomzala wakhe ekamelweni lokuhlambela. Akufumanekanga ke uAthaliya, akafanga.
Ke kaloku uYowashe wayefihlakele, yena noyisekazi wakhe, endlwini kaYehova iminyaka emithandathu; ke uAthaliya waba ngukumkani welizwe.

Ke kaloku, ngomnyaka wesixhenxe, uYehoyada ukumkani wathumela wayawabiza abathetheli bamawaka, namaKareti, nabagwebi; wabazisa endlwini kaYehova, waza wakwenza khona umnqophiso nabo, wawamisa emlonyeni endlwini kaYehova; wababonisa ke unyana womkumkani.
Wabawisela umthetho, wathi kubo, Le nto niyenzayo: isithathu senu esiphumayo ngeSabbathi sigcine indlu kakumkani.
Enye inxalenye yesithathu iya kuhlala emnyango waseShure, enye inxalenye yesithathu iya kuhlala emnyango ngasemva kwabagwebi; niya kuba yimihlaba yendlu.
Iindidi zenu ezibini, eziphumayo ngeSabhati, zigcine iTempile kaYehova kukumkani.
Nceda nihlale ndawonye phezu kokumkani, nomntu ngamnye enesithuthi sakhe esandlani. Nabani na oza kuthelekiswa nemigca yenu, aphelelwe; nibe phantsi komkani apho esiya khona.

Ke kaloku abathetheli beeshumi basenza konke oko uYehoyada ukumkani wamwisela umthetho ngawo. Bathabatha ngamnye amadoda akhe, abo baphumayo ngeSabhati, nabaphumayo ngeSabhati, baye kuYehoyada ukumkani.
Ke kaloku umbingeleli wabanika abathetheli izithunywa nezikhuselo, eziye zaba ngukumkani uDavide, ezibekwe endlwini kaYehova.
Ke kaloku abagwebi babekwa phezu kokumkani, ngamnye enesithuthi sakhe esandleni sakhe; besuka ecaleni lasempumalanga lendlu, besiya ecaleni lasentshonalanga, phambi kwesibingelelo nendlu.

Ke kaloku uYehoyada wamthabatha uyise kakumkani, wamisa phezu kwakhe umnqamlezo, waza wamnika ikopi yomnqophiso; bakwenza ukuba abe ngukumkani, bamnyamekela. Bathi ke abantu, becofa izandla zabo, bathi, Uphile ukumkani!
Ke kaloku uAthaliya wayeva intliziyo yabakhuseli, nabantu; waya kubo bonke abakhoyo endlwini kaYehova.

Wajonga, ke kaloku ukumkaniēšanasile ecaleni komngxunya, ngokwesiqhelo; nabathetheli, nabathumbuzi bemibhobho, ngasekunene kukakumkani; nabo bonke abantu belizwe babhiyozela, bephucula imibhobho. Ke kaloku uAthaliya waluka iimpahla zakhe, wathi, Ubuxoki! Ubuxoki!

Ke kaloku uYehoyada, umbingeleli, wabawisela umthetho abathetheli beentlanga, ababekwe phezu komkhosi, wathi, Yazisa phantsi phakathi kweendawo zokulwa; nabani na oza kumlandela, abulalane naye. (Ngenxa yokuba umbingeleli wayethe, Akuyi kubulawa endlwini kaYehova.)
Ke kaloku, xa wayephuma ekungeneni kweemahashe endlwini yendlu kakumkani, bathabathela kuye; wabulawa khona.
Wakwenza ke uYehoyada umnqophiso phakathi kukaYehova nokumkani nabantu, ukuba babe ngabantu bakaThixo; wakwenza nomnqophiso phakathi kukakumkani nabantu.

Ke kaloku bonke abantu belizwe bafika endlwini kaBhaali, bayikhupha phantsi; izibingelelo zazo nemifanekiso engumqondiso yazo yaba yimpucu alancama, babulala uMathan, umbingeleli kaBhaali, phambi kwezibingelelo. UYehoyada um tirhi wamisa abakhuseli endlwini kaYehova.

Wathabatha abathetheli bamawaka, nabaēšanasi, nabagwebi, nabo bonke abantu belizwe, bakhupha ukumkani phantsi endlwini kaYehova; baphuma ngesango labagwebi, bafika endlwini yokumkani. Ukumkani ke wahlala kwisitulo sobukhosi.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu belizwe babhiyozela, umzi waphumla; kuba uAthaliya wabanjwa ngeqhwa endlwini yendlu kakumkani.
UYowashe wayeneminyaka esixhenxe ubudala, xa waba ngukumkani.
UYowashe waba ngukumkani ngonyaka wesixhenxe kaYehu ukumkani wakwaSirayeli; waba neminyaka emashumi mane engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguSibiya waseBher-sheba.
Ke kaloku uYowashe wenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova, iminyaka yonke awayeyamfundisa ngayo uYehoyada ukumkani.
Ke kaloku iindawo eziphakamileyo azithunyelwe; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona izibingelelo, befumisa khona uvumba.

Wathi uYowashe kubo bonke ababingeleli, Nciphisaneni imali yonke ethe yafunyanwa kwindlu kaYehova, njengezinto ezingcwele: imali yobalo, nemali yezenzo zobulungisa, nemali yobuxoki, nemali yobuxoki bendlu kaYehova.
Wathi ke umbingeleli ngamnye, athathe lemali kubo bonke abantu abakhonzayo; uze uyisebenzisele ukulungisa nantoni na enokuchaphazela indlu.
Ke kaloku, ngomnyaka weshumi elinesithathu wokumkani uYowashe, ababingeleli abazange balungise indlu.

Ukumkani uYowashe wabiza uYehoyada ukumkani, nababingeleli bakhe, wathi kubo, Ngaba ningayilungisa ntoni na imiba yendlu kaThixo? Musani ukusukela ngoku ukuthabatha imali ebantwini abasebenza nabo; niyinikezele ukuze ilungiswe indlu.
Ke kaloku ababingeleli bavuma ukuba bangabikho bethatha imali abantu, nokuba bangabikho nabo belungisa indlu kaThixo.

UYehoyada umbingeleli wathabathaēšanaso ibhokisi, wayala umngxunya emnqamlezweni wayo, wayibeka ecaleni kwesibingelelo, ngasekunene kokungena kwabantu endlwini kaYehova. Ababingeleli abakhuselayo isingeniso babeka kuyo ibhokisi yonke imali abantu ababeyingenisa endlwini kaYehova.
Ke kaloku, xa bebona ukuba kukho imali eninzi kwibhokisi, wafika umbhali wokumkani nombingeleli omkhulu, babala imali eyafakwa endlwini kaYehova, bayibeka ezibhotileni.
Bazinikela ke ezo zimali, ezithengiswayo, kumadoda alawula umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova; aba bantu bahlawulisa ootitshala nabaqulunqi abasebenza endlwini kaYehova,
abakhonzi bamatshe, nabaqulunqi bamatshe. Basebenzisana nabo ukuthenga imithi, nelitye elixhotyiweyo, ukuze balungise indlu kaYehova, nazo zonke izinto ezifunekayo zokuyilungisa.
Imali eyabelwe endlwini kaYehova, ayisebenziswanga ukwenza izitya zesilivere, namatye okutshiza, namachibi, neebhokhwe, nazo zonke izinto zegolide nezesilivere ezibekwe endlwini.
Ke kaloku yanikezelwa kubo abasebenzayo, bayisebenzisa ukulungisa indlu kaYehova.
Abazange babuze abaphathi-mali ukuba benze ntoni na ngemali ebaye bayifumanayo, ukuze bahlawulise oomsebenzi; ngokuba bebengamangali.
Imali yomnikelo wesono, nomnikelo wesono, ayifakwanga endlwini kaYehova; yaba yintsapho yamabhinqa amaLevi.
Kwathi ngaloo xesha, uHazayeli ukumkani wakwaAram wahlasela iGati, wayithabatha. Wacinga ke ukuba uya kuhlasela iYerusalem.

Wathabatha ke uYowashe ukumkani wakwaYuda zonke izinto ezingcwele, ababezinikela ngazo oonyana bakhe, uJehoshafati, noYoram, noAhaziya, ababingeleli bakakumkani bakaYuda, namadini akhe; wathabatha igolide yonke efunyenweyo kwiziko lendlu kaYehova, nekhaya likakumkani, wayithumela kuHazayeli ukumkani waseSiria. Ke kaloku uHazayeli wabuyela eYerusalem.
Konke okuseleyo kwezinto azenzayo uYowashe, nazo zonke izinto zakhe, zingaba zibhalwe nini ezincwadini zembali yamakumkani baseYuda?
Bathi abakhonzi bakhe, babhiyozela kuye, babulala uYowashe eBhete-Milo, entliziyweni yendlela ihamba ezantsi eSila.
Abaphathi ababembulala nguYozabadi unyana kaShimeathi, noYozabadi unyana kaShomere; wafa ke, wabanjwa nabazalwana bakhe emzini kaDavide. UAmasiya unyana wakhe waba ngumkumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesibini omashumi mathathu kaYowashe unyana kaAhaziya ukumkani wakwaYuda, uYehohaza unyana kaYehu waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka elishumi elinambini.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; walandela iimpazamo zikaYaroboham, unyana kaNabati, owenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba enze iimpazamo; akaze ahambe kuzo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxoka kakhulu kuSirayeli; wabashiya eHazayeli ukumkani wakwa-Aram, noBhehadadi unyana wakhe, bewahlasela iminyaka emide.
Ke kaloku uYohahazi wathandaza kuYehova; iNkosi wamphendula; ngokuba wayebona ukuba ukumkani waseSirayeli wayemenza ntoni na.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wamnika amaSirayeli umsindisi; baphuma phantsi kwesandla samaAram. Bahlala ke amaSirayeli endlwini yabo, bekhuselekile, njengokuba kwangaphambili.
Ke kaloku, abasukanga ezindleleni zendlu kaYarobhoham, awayewenza amaSirayeli aphelelwe lithemba; baqhubeka bezenza ezo zinto. I-Ashere yahlala nayo eSamari.

Ke kaloku umkhosi kaYohahazi wawuncipha, waba ngamadoda amahlanu ahamba ngebhayisikile, neemoto ezilishumi, namawaka mabini ahamba ngezinyawo; kuba ukumkani waseSirayeli wayewabulala abo abaseleyo, wababeka phantsi njengamafu exesha lokutyisa.
Izinto eziseleyo zikaYowahazi, zonke izinto zakhe, nemisebenzi yakhe, zihleli zibhalwe encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani bakaSirayeli.
Wafa uYowahazi, wabanjwa eSamari; uYowashe unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesithathu nesixhenxe kaYowashe ukumkani wakwaYuda, uYowashe unyana kaYehohaza waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka elishumi elinambini engukumkani.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; akasukanga kuzo zonke izono zikaYaroboham, unyana kaNabati, owenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba azinikele kuThixo; waqhubeka ezenza.

Konke ke okuseleyo kwezinto azenzayo uYowashe, nazo zonke izinto zakhe, nobutyebi bakhe, nendlela awayehlasela ngayo uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, ngaba akubhalwenga encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Wafa ke uYowashe, wathatha indawo kaYerebhoyamu; waza wabanjwa uYowashe eSamari nakumkani bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uElisha waba nesifo sokufa. UYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waya kumbona, wavuma phezu kwakhe, wathi, Ubaba wam! Ubaba wam! Iimoto zakwaSirayeli, nabakhweli babo abahamba ngezithuthi.
Wathi ke kuye uElisha, Fumana isithunywa namaqhosha. Ukumkani wafumana isithunywa namaqhosha.
Wathi uElisha kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Nciphisa umtya esandla sakho. Ke kaloku wamisa uElisha izandla zakhe phezu kweenyawo zomkani.

Wathi uElisha, Vula ifestile ejonge emazantsi. Wayivula ke. Wathi uElisha, Utshise! Wathi utshise. Wathi uElisha, Le yimiyalelo kaYehova yokulwa, imiyalo yokulwa yama-Aram; uya kubetha ama-Aram ngaphesheya kweAfeki.
Wathi ke uElisha, Ncamathelisa amasuntswana. Ke kaloku ukumkani athabathela amasuntswana; wathi kuye uElisha, Ncamathelisa ihlabathi ngazo. Wencamathelisa ihlabathi kathathu, wamisa.

Ke kaloku umntu kaThixo waxoka kuye, wathi, Kufuneka uhlasele ihlabathi amaxesha amahlanu okanye amathandathu; ke ngoko uya kuba mkhulula ooAram; kodwa ngoku uya kuba mkhulula ooAram amaxesha amathathu.
Wafa ke uElisha, bayamzika. Kwabakho iindidi zeMowabi ezihlaselayo, zafika kuloo lizwe ngamanzi acocekileyo.

Ke kaloku, xa abantu bakaSirayeli besenza isibingelelo somntu omnye, babona iqela leengqwalasela; bathabathela umphefumlo waloo mntu, bawubeka ekufumaneni kukaElisha. Kwathi ke, xa umphefumlo wolowo mntu ufike emathunjini kaElisha, lo mntu waphilile, wahlala emehlweni akhe.
Ke kaloku uHazayeli ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wayala amaSirayeli zonke iintsuku zokumkani kaYowahazi.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wabathandela oonyana bakaSirayeli, wabazinikela kubo; wabatyelela ngenxa yomnqophiso wakhe noAbraham, noIsake, noYakobi; akafuni ukuwabulala, akazange awakhuphe phambi kwakhe nalapho.
Wafa uHazayeli ukumkani wakwaAram; waba ngukumkani uBhehadade unyana wakhe.

Ke kaloku uYowashe, unyana kaYehohaza, wambuyisela kuBhe-hadadi, unyana kaHazayeli, imimandla awayeyithathe uHazayeli emfazweni kumkakhe uYehohaza. UYowashe wambetha uBhe-hadadi amaxesha amathathu, wayambuyisela amadolophu aseSirayeli.
Ngomnyaka wesibini kaYowashe unyana kaYehohaza waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waqalisa ukumkani uAmasiya unyana kaYowashe eYuda.
Ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anesixhenxe ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mabini anesithoba engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguYehoyadini waseYerusalem.
Wakwenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova, hayi njengokuba wenzayo uDavide utata wakhe; wazenza zonke izinto azenzayo uYowashe uyise.
Ke kaloku iindawo eziphakamileyo azithunyelwe; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona izibingelelo, befumisa khona uvumba.
Ke kaloku, xa eqinisile ubukumkani bakhe, wabulala oonyana bakakumkani abo babulala uyise, ukumkani.

Ke bona oonyana babo ababulalayo, awawafazi; njengoko kubhalwe kwincwadi yomthetho kaMoses, apho iNkosi ewiselise khona umthetho, esithi, Abazali bangafa ngenxa yabantwana babo, nabantwana bangafa ngenxa yabazali babo. Wonke umntu uya kufa ngenxa yesono sakhe sodwa.
UAmasiya wabulala kuma Edomu amawaka alishumi, eNtaba yeSalti; wathabatha iShela emfazweni, wayibiza kwakhona ngegama likaYokteyeli, linguyena mmandla ubizwa ngalo mihla.
Wathumela ke uAmasiya abathunywa kuYowashe, unyana kaYehohaza, unyana kaYehu, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, esithi, Yiya, sijongene ngobuso nobuso.

UYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wamphendula uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, esithi, Intyatyambo eLibanoni yamthumela umnquba okwiLibanoni, ethi, Nceda unike intombi yakho kunyana wam ukuba abe ngumfazi wakhe. Kwathi kwafika intlanzi yomhlaba eLibanoni, yaphula intyatyambo.
Ngokuqinisekileyo uyayibulala iEdom, yaye ngoku uyavuya; uphile ngobudumo bakho, uhlale endlwini yakho; kutheni na ukuba ufune ububi obuza kukuhlabela wena noYuda nawe?
Ke kaloku uAmasiya akayi kuphulaphula. Waphuma ke uYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wadibana naye noAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda emfazweni eBhat-shemeshi, eya eYude.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli abulala amaYuda; amadoda aseYiputa aye endlwini yawo onke.

UYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wamtsala uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, unyana kaYowashe, unyana kaAhaziya, eBhete-shemesi. Wafika ke eYerusalem, waphula ugqubuthelo lwayo ukusuka kwisango likaEfrayim ukuya kwisango lesangqa, isiqendu esiyimitha ezilishumi elinesibhozo.
Wathabatha yonke igolide nesilivere, nazo zonke izitya ezifunyanwa endlwini kaYehova, nasezikhepheni zendlu kakumkani; wathabatha namagosa, wabuyela eSamaria.
Konke okuseleyo kwezinto azenzayo uYowashe, nobutyebi bakhe, nendlela awayehlasela ngayo uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, ngaba akubhalwenga encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Wafa uYowashe, wabanjwa eSamari, nakumkani bakaSirayeli; uYerobohami unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UAmasiya unyana kaYowashe ukumkani wakwaYuda waba ubomi beminyaka elishumi elinamihlanu emva kokufa kukaYowashe unyana kaYehohaza ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Amanye amatyala kaAmasiya, into awayeyenzayo, ayiyi kubhalwa na kwincwadi yemihla ngemihla yamakumkani baseYuda?
Ke kaloku abathile eYerusalem babhiyozela kuye; wabaleka waya eLakishi. Bathumela ke abantu emva kwakhe, waya eLakishi, bambulala khona.
Baya kumthabatha emkhosini, wabulawa; wabanjwa nabazalwana bakhe eYerusalem, emzini kaDavide.
Bathi ke bonke abantu bakaYuda bathabathe uAzariya, owayeneminyaka elishumi elinamithandathu ubudala, bakwenza waba ngukumkani endaweni kaAmasiya uyise.
UAzariya wayala iElathi, wayibuyisela kuYuda, emva kokuba unyana wakhe ukumkani efile.

Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesihlanu kaAmasiya unyana kaYowashe, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waqalisa uYeremiya unyana kaYowashe ukuba ngukumkani kwabaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka emashumi mane alishumi elinanye.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; akasukanga kuzo zonke izono zikaYarobhoham unyana kaNabhati, owenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba azinikele.

Wabuya wabuyisela umda wamaSirayeli, ukususela ekufikeni eHamati emntla, waya kulwandle olufayo emzantsi; ngokwelizwi likaYehova uThixo kaSirayeli, elalithetha ngalo ngomkhonzi wakhe uYona umprofeti, unyana kaAmitayi, waseGati-heferi.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wababona bonke abaSirayeli, ukuba bahlupheke kakhulu, nokuba ngumkhonzi nakuba ngumntu okhululekileyo; kwakungekho namnye wancedayo amaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku iNkosi akathethi ukuba asuse igama lakwaSirayeli ehlabathini; wabasindisa ngoko ngesandla sikaYaroboham, unyana kaYowashe.

Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uYerebhoyamu, zonke izinto zakhe, nobutyebi bakhe, nendlela awayehlasela ngayo, nokuba wabuyisela njani kumaSirayeli iDamaseki neHamati, eziye zaba nguYuda? Ingaba azibhalwenga encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani amaSirayeli?
Walala uYarobheham, wabanjwa nabakumkani bakaSirayeli; uZekariya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
Ngomnyaka wesibini wesixhenxe kaYeremiya ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uAzariya unyana kaAmasiya waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda.
Ubeminyaka ilishumi elinamithandathu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mahlanu anamibini engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguYekoliya waseYerusalem.
Wakwenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova, njengoko wayesenza uAmasiya uyise.
Ke kaloku iindawo eziphakamileyo azithunyelwe; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona izibingelelo, befumisa khona uvumba.
UYehova wambetha ukumkani ngeempawu zomkhuhlane, waza wahlala endlwini eyahlukileyo; uYothamu unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani wendlu kakumkani, wayelawula abantu belizwe.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uAzariya, nazo zonke izinto zakhe, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi yeendaba zamakumkani baseYuda?
Ke kaloku uAzariya waphumla, wabanjwa nabazalwana bakhe edolophini kaDavide; uYotam unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo kaUzari ukumkani wakwaYuda, uZekariya unyana kaYarobhoham waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli, eSamari; waba neminyaka emihlanu.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, njengoko babesenza abazalwana bakhe; akasukanga ezindleleni zikaYarobhoham unyana kaNabhati, owenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba abe nesono.
Ke kaloku uShalum, unyana kaYabheshi, wenza isithethe kuZekariya; wahlasela phambi kwabantu, wambulala, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uZekariya, zithini na? Zibhalwe encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani bakaSirayeli;
Ke kaloku kwathiwa nguYehova kuYehu, esithi, Abafazi bakho baya kuhlala kwitrone kaSirayeli iminyaka emine.
UShalum unyana kaYabheshe waba ngukumkani ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo wokumkani uUziya wakwaYuda; waba ngukumkani eSamari iminyaka emithathu.
Ke kaloku uManahem, unyana kaGadi, waya phezulu eThirsa waya eSamaria; wahlasela khona uShalum, unyana kaYabheshi, wambulala, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uShalum, nobuxoki bakhe, ngaba azibhalwenga phantsi kwencwadi yeziganeko zamakumkani bakaSirayeli?

Ke kaloku uManahem waphuma eThirsa, wahlasela iTiphasa, namadoda onke angaphakathi kuyo, namasango ajikeleze kuyo. Wahlasela loo mzi, ngokuba abantu bakhe abawuvulanga umngxunya wabo kuye; wabaphula zonke izibhinqa ezikhulelweyo apho.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo kaUzari ukumkani wakwaYuda, uManahem, unyana kaGadi, waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka elishumi engukumkani.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; akazange ahambe kuzo zonke iintsuku zakhe eziphilayo, ezonweni zikaYarobhoham unyana kaNabati, owenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba enze isono.
Wafika ke uPhu, ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, waya kuloo lizwe. UManahem wamnika uPhu imali yesilivere elishumi elinambini, ukuze umncede uPhu, ukuba abambe ubukumkani.
Ke kaloku uMenahem wathabatha imali kumaSirayeli, wamnika ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, ngamashumi amahlanu eeshekeli zesilivere kumntu ngamnye. Wabuya ke ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, akabikho ezweni.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uManahem, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi yemihla ngemihla yamakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Wafa uManahem, waba ngukumkani uPekahiya unyana wakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesihlanu kaUzari ukumkani wakwaYuda, uPekahiya unyana kaManahem waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka emibini engukumkani.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; akasukanga kwizono zikaYarobheham unyana kaNabhati, owenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba asinde.

Ke kaloku uPeka, unyana kaRemaliya, omnye wabaphathi bakhe, wakwenza inkohlakalo kuye. Wahlasela uPeka uPekahiya, e alanwabeleni yendlu yaseSamariya, namadoda amashumi amahlanu aseGiliyadi; wambulala yena, nemuArgobhi noAriye, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uPekahiya, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi yemihla ngemihla yamakumkani amaSirayeli?
Ngomnyaka wesihlanu wesithathu kaUzari ukumkani wakwaYuda, uPeka unyana kaRemaliya waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka emibini.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; akasukanga kwizono zikaYarobheham unyana kaNabhati, owenzayo amaSirayeli ukuba asinde.

Kwiintsuku zikaPeka ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, waya uTiglathi-pilesere ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, wathabatha iIyon, noAbele, neBhete-maakha, neYanoa, neKedesh, neHazori, neGiliyadi, neGalili, lonke ilizwe likaNafetali; wabathutha abantu abafileyo eAsiriya.
Ke kaloku uHosheya, unyana ka-Ela, wenza isithethe kuPeka, unyana kaRemaliya; wamhlasela, wambulala, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe. Kwakuba ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibini kaYothamu, unyana kaUziya.
Ezinye izinto azenzayo uPeka, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi yemihla ngemihla yamakumkani bakaSirayeli?
Ngomnyaka wesibini kaPeka unyana kaRemaliya waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uYothamu unyana kaUziya waba ngukumkani waseYuda.
Ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamihlanu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinamithandathu engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyanaafiiyo uYerusha intombi kaTsadoko.
Wakwenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova, njengoko wayesenza uUziya uyise.
Ke kaloku, iindawo eziphakamileyo azithunyelwe; abantu baqhubeka benikela khona izibingelelo, befumisa khona uvumba. UYothame wakha isango eliphezulu lendlu kaYehova.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uYothama, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi yeendaba zamakumkani baseYuda?
Ngaloo mihla iNkosi waqalisa ukuthutha uResini ukumkani waseAram, noPeka unyana ka-Rerimoliya, ukuba bahlasele amaYuda.
Walala uYotam, wabulawa nabazalwana bakhe emzini kaDavide, utata wakhe. UAhazi unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo kaPeka unyana kaRemaliya waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uAhazi unyana kaYotam waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda.

UAhazi ubeminyaka imashumi mabini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinamithandathu engukumkani eYerusalem. Akakwenzanga oko kulungileyo emehlweni kaYehova uThixo wakhe, njengokuba wenzayo uDavide, uyise.
Ke kaloku wahamba ngeendlela zabakumkani bakaSirayeli; wabeka nonyana wakhe emngxunyeni womlilo, esenza ngokwezinto ezibi zazo zonke izizwe, ezo iNkosi wayezikhuphe phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Wanikela izibingelelo, wafumisa uvumba kwiindawo eziphakamileyo, nasezindulini, phantsi komthi wonke oluhlaza.
Ke kaloku wanyuka uResin ukumkani waseAram, noPeka unyana kaRemaliya, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, bahlasela iYerusalem; bajikelezisa uAhazi, kodwa abakwazi ukuwubetha.
Ngelo xesha uReshin ukumkani waseAram wabuyisela iElathi kuma-Aram, wabakhupha khona abantu bakaYuda; basuka ke amaEdom eElathi, behlala khona namhla.

UAhazi wathumela abathunywa kuTiglathi-pilesere ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, esithi, Ndingumkhonzi wakho nonyana wakho; vuka usindise kum emkhosini kakumkani waseSirayeli, nomkhosi kakumkani wakwaSirayeli, abanihlasela.
Ke kaloku uAhazi wathabatha isilivere negolide, ezifunyanwa endlwini kaYehova, nakwiikhabhinethi zendlu kakumkani, waza wayithumela ukumkani wakwaAsiriya njengesipho.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaAsiriya wavuma; waya eDamasko, wayithatha, wawathabatha abazalwana bakaSirayeli, wabathumela eKire, wambulala uRezini.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uAhazi waya eDamasko, ukudibana noTiglathi-pilesere ukumkani wakwaAsiriya. Wabona khona isibingelelo; wathumela kuUriya ukumkani, umzobo wesibingelelo, nemiyalelo yokwakha.
Ke kaloku uUriya, ukumkani umbingeleli, wayilungisa isibingelelo, ngokwemimiselo kakumkani uAhabhi owawuthunyelwe eDamasko; wagqiba yona phambi kokuba kumkani uAhabhi abuye eDamasko.
Ke kaloku ukumkani, ebuya eDamasko, wabona isibingelelo; wanyuka waya kuyo, wanikela phezu kwayo.
Watshisa idini lakhe eliqhutywa limlilo, nedini lakhe lesonka, wamisa umnikelo wakhe wokudla, wasasaza phezu kwesibingelelo igazi leempawu zakhe zoxolo.
Wayisusa isibingelelo sentsimbi esingaphambili kukaYehova, wayisusa phambi kwendlu kaThixo, phakathi kwesibingelelo esitsha nendlu kaThixo, wayibeka ecaleni lasentshona lesibingelelo esitsha.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uAhazi wamwisela umthetho uUriya, umbingeleli, esithi, Kwisibingelelo esitsha esikhulu, usindise idini eliqhutywa lilanga, nomnikelo wokudla wemini, nedini eliqhutywa ngukumkani, nomnikelo wokudla wakhe, nezipho zobisi zabahlali bonke belizwe; uze usithule phezu kwayo yonke igazi leedini eziqhutywa lilanga, needini zenyama; kodwa isibingelelo sentsimbi siza kuba nam, ukuba ndiyibuze.
UUriya umbingeleli wenza konke oko ukumkani uAhazi wamwiselayo.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uAhazazi waluka iithayile zesitulo esingwevu, waza wasusa kuzo iziqulatho; wamkhupha umbhobho omkhulu wengwevu, obizwa ngokuba yilwandle, esuka ezimvu zenkomo zengwevu eziwuthabathayo, wayibeka phezu kwesiseko selitye.
Ke kaloku, ukuze athande ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, wasusa isango elikhuselweyo leSabbathi, lakhiwayo endlwini kaThixo, nokungena kukakumkani ngaphandle kwendlu kaYehova.
Konke okuseleyo kwezinto azenzayo uAhazi, bona, zibhalwe encwadini yeendaba zamakumkani baseYuda.
UAhazi waphumla, wabanjwa nabazalwana bakhe edolophini kaDavide; uHezekiya, unyana wakhe, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibini kaAhazi ukumkani wakwaYuda, uHosheya unyana kaEla waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli eSamari; waba neminyaka ethoba.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, akunjalo nanjengokuba babesenza ookumkani bakaSirayeli ababengaphambili kwakhe.
Wahlasela uShalmaneser ukumkani wakwa-Asiriya uHosheya; uHosheya waba ngumkhonzi wakhe, enika umvuzo ngonyaka nonyaka.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaAsiriya wafumanisa ukuba uHoshea unqula kuye. Wathumela ke uHoshea abathunywa kuSo, ukumkani waseYiputa, waza wayeka ukunika umvuzo kumkani wakwaAsiriya, njengokuba wayesenza ngonyaka nonyaka; wamthabatha ngoko ukumkani wakwaAsiriya uHoshea, wambeka endlwini yokugcina.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaAsiriya wanyuka waya ezweni lonke, waya eSamariya, wayijikeleza iminyaka emithathu.
Ngomnyaka wesithandathu wokumkani uHosheya, ukumkani wakwaAsiriya wahlasela iSamaria; wabathabatha amaSirayeli waya eAsiriya, wawamisa eHala, nomlambo uHabhore waseGozani, nakwiidolophu zakwaMediya.
Yathi loo nto, ngenxa yokuba oonyana bakaSirayeli babephelelwe nguYehova uThixo wabo, owabakhupha ezweni laseYiputa, wabasusa phantsi kwesandla sikaFaro ukumkani waseYiputa; bakhonza amadini athile.
Bahamba ngokwemimiselo yeentlanga, awazikhuphayo iNkosi phambi kwabo, nakwiimimiselo zabakumkani bakaSirayeli, ababeziqala.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli ngokufihlakeleyo basenza izinto ezingafanelekanga kuYehova uThixo wabo; bamisela kubo iindawo eziphakamileyo kuwo onke amadolophu abo, ukususela kwinqaba encinane yokujonga, ukuya kwinqaba enkulu yomzi onezindlu.
Bamisa iinkunzi zeenkomo, neentyatyambo zeAshere, ngazo zonke iinduli eziphakamileyo, phantsi kwazo zonke iintyatyambo eziluhlaza.
Bafumisa uvumba kuzo zonke iindawo eziphakamileyo, njengokuba zazenza izizwe, ezo iNkosi wabakhupha ngaphaya kwabo; basenza izinto ezingalunganga, bacinezela iNkosi.
Bakhonza imifanekiso engumqondiso, nakuba iNkosi wabawisela umthetho wathi, Musani ukwenza oko.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wayalela ooSirayeli noYuda, ngesandla samaprofeti akhe onke, ngabasetyhini ababonayo, esithi, Buyelani ezindleleni zenu ezibi, nigcine imimiselo yam, nemimiselo yam, ngokwemithetho yonke endiyiwiselayo kubazalwana benu, neyamthumelela ngayo izandla zam ezikhonzi bam abaprofeti.
Bonke ke abazange baphulaphule; babhinqa iinwele zabo, njengabafazi babo, ababengakholwa kuYehova uThixo wabo.

Bazikhupha imithetho yakhe, nomnqophiso wakhe, awawenza ngabasetyhini babo, nezibhengezo zakhe, awazenzayo kubo; balandela izinto ezingalunganga, babe zizinto ezingalunganga ngokwabo; bayenza imikhosi yamazwe ajikeleze kuwo, oko iNkosi wabawisela umthetho wona, ukuba bangayisebenzisi imikhosi yawo.
Baye basuka kumalungiselelo onke kaYehova uThixo wabo; bazenza iinkunzi zeegusha ezimbini, ne-ashere ephakamileyo; bakhonza zonke iinkwenkwezi ezisezulu, bakhonza uBhaali.
Banikela oonyana babo neentombi zabo emlilweni, bathetha ngezinto ezifihlakeleyo, namagqwetha; bathengisa ngokwabo ukuba benze okubi emehlweni kaNdikhoyo, ukuze bamkhulise.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxhaphaza kakhulu amaSirayeli, wabasusa phambi kwakhe; kwashiywa isizwe sikaYuda kuphela.
Ke kaloku noYuda akazange agcine imimiselo kaYehova uThixo wabo; bahamba ngezithethe zabaSirayeli, ababeziqala.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wayeka zonke iintsapho zakwaSirayeli, wabaphazamisa, wawanikela ebantwini abahlaselayo, de wabasusa phambi kobuso bakhe.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wamisa amaSirayeli endlwini kaDavide; bakwenza uYerebhoyamu, unyana kaNabati, waba ngukumkani kubo. Wabeka uYerebhoyamu amaSirayeli emngciphekweni wokumlandela iNkosi, wawabangela ukuba benze isono esikhulu.
Baqhubeka ke oonyana bakaSirayeli besenza zonke izono zikaYerebhoyamu, eziye wazenza; abasukanga kuzo.
de ke iNkosi asuse amaSirayeli phambi kwakhe, njengoko wayethe wathetha ngamazwi onke abazalwana bakhe abaprofeti. Bathunyelwe ooSirayeli ezweni labo, bathunyelwe eAsiriya, nalapho bakhona namhlanje.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaAsiriya wazisa abantu ukusuka eBhabheli, naseKutha, naseAva, naseHamati, naseSefarwayim, wabamisa emadolophini aseSamari, endaweni yabantwana bakaSirayeli; bathatha iSamari, bahlala emizini yayo.
Ke kaloku, ekuqalekeni kokuhlala kwabo khona apho, abawukhathaleli iNkosi; ngoko ke iNkosi wathumela phakathi kwabo iileyo, zazibulala izileyo.

Ke kaloku kwathiwa kukumkani wakwaAsiriya, besithi, Abantu abawenzileyo ukuba bafudukele edolophini yaseSamariya, abayazi into kaThixo welizwe elo; ngoko ke wathumela phakathi kwabo iileyo, zithe zazibulala, ngokuba bangawazi into kaThixo.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaAsiriya wamisa, esithi, Buyisane omnye wababingeleli abathunyelwe apho; ahambe aze ahlale khona, afundise abantu indlela yomthetho kaThixo welizwe.
Wabuya ke omnye wababingeleli abathunyelwe eSamari, waya kuhlala eBheteli; wabafundisa indlela yokuthandaza kuYehova.
Ke kaloku ilizwe ngalinye laqhubeka lisenza amadini ayo; babeka kumakhaya eendawo eziphakamileyo, abasemagunyeni baseSamariya babezenzayo, ilizwe ngalinye emadolophini abo ababehlala kuwo.
Amadoda aseBhabheli ayenze iSukothi-benothi; amadoda aseKuta ayenze iNergal; amadoda aseHamati ayenze iAshima.
Aba-Avithi bayenza iNibhazi, neTartaki; aba-Sepharvithi ke babetywina oonyana babo emlilweni, benikela ngomnikelo kuAdrameleke noAnameleke, amadini eSefarvayim.
Bakhonza iNkosi; ke kaloku bakhetha phakathi kwabantu babo bonke, ukuba babe ngababingeleli kwiindawo eziphakamileyo. Ababingeleli babanika izibingelelo ezingcwele.
Bakhonza iNkosi, ke bona bakhonza amadini abo, ngokwemimiselo yazo zonke iintlanga ezibathunyelelwe kuzo.

Bahamba ngomthetho wabo wangaphambili, kufike namhlanje; bangamthobeli iNkosi ngokunyanisekileyo, nakwimizekelo yakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, nezifundo zakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, awawisela ngayo iNkosi izizukulwana zikaYakobi, owabiza igama lakhe ngokuba nguSirayeli.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wamenza umnqophiso oonyana bakaSirayeli, wabawisela umthetho, esithi, Musani ukukhonza amadini angaphandle; musa ukuzihlangula, ningazisebenzisi, ningazisondeza izibingelelo.
UYehova kuphela niwukhonze, lowo wamthabathayo ezweni laseYiputa ngesandla esinamandla, nesandla esiqinileyo; niya kumnqamla yena, niya kunikela kuye idini.
