Nizigcine imithetho yakhe, nezigqibo zakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, nemiyalelo yakhe, awabhalileyo kuni, ukuba niyigcine yonke imihla. Musani ukukhonza amadini amanye.
Musani kulibala umnqophiso wam endiwenzayo nani, nize ningazithobeli izithixo ezinye.
Ke yena iNkosi uThixo wenu, niwukhonze; uya kukusindisa esandla sazo zonke izitha zenu.
Ke kaloku abazange bacinge; baqhubeka behamba ngemimiselo yabo yangaphambili.
Ke kaloku ezi zinto zamazwe zazithandaza kuYehova, zikhonza ke izithixo zazo; nabantwana babo, nabantwana bezitho zabo bazenza njalo, njengokuba babesenza ooyise babo, de kube ngaloo mini.
Ngonyaka wesithathu kaHosheya unyana kaEla ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, uHezekiya unyana kaAhazi waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda.
Ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamihlanu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mabini anesixhenxe engukumkani eYerusalem. Umfazi wakhe wayenguAbi intombi kaZekariya.
Wakwenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova, njengoko wayesenza uDavide, uyise.

Wazikhupha iindawo eziphakamileyo, wazingqubuthela iinkunzi zeenkomo, waza watshisa ii-ashere; wabaphula intaka yentsimbi, uMoses ayeyenzayo; ngokuba baya kuthi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli bayamcinezela umnqamlezo; kwathiwa igama layo nguNehushtani.
UHezekiya wathembela kuYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli; kwakungekho namnye owayefana naye phakathi kwabakumkani bonke bakaYuda, nangaphambili kwakhe, nakutshanje.
Wazibophelela kuYehova, akazange atshintshe ukulandela kwakhe; wagcina imimiselo kaYehova, awayemwisela uMoses.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waba naye, waphumelela kuzo zonke izinto azenzayo. Wasuka ekhohlisa ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, akawusebenzisi.
Wawahlasela amaFilisti, waya eGaza, nesiqithi sayo, ukususela kwintombi yokulinda ukuya kumzi mkhulu oneendonga.
Ngomnyaka wesine wokumkani uHezekiya, (wokuba ngunyaka wesixhenxe kaHosheya unyana kaEla waba ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli,) wafika uShalmaneser ukumkani wakwaAsiriya waya eSamaria, wayijikeleza.
Ke kaloku, emva kweminyaka emithathu, iAshuri yayithatha. Yatwaliswa ke iSamaria ngomnyaka wesithandathu kaHezekiya; wawungunyaka wesithoba kaHosheya ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Ukumkani wase-Ashuri wabathabatha amaSirayeli waya e-Ashuri, wawamisa eHala, nomlambo uHabhore, eGozani, nakwiidolophu zakwaMediya.
Oku kwenzeka ngenxa yokuba babengenakumthobela iNkosi, uThixo wabo; baphulaphule umnqophiso wakhe, nazo zonke izinto awisenzileyo uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova; abawuvanga lo myalezo, bangawuthobeli.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesine wokumkani uHezekiya, wafika uSenakheribhi ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, waya kuwo onke amadolophu akhuselweyo kaYuda, waza wawathatha.

Wathumela ke uHezekiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, kukumkani wakwaAsiriya eLakishi, esithi, Ndiphelelwe lithemba; shiya mna, ndiza kukuhlawula nantoni na oyifunayo. Ukumkani wakwaAsiriya wabiza uHezekiya, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ukuba amnike amawaka eetoni zesilivere namawaka eetoni zegolide.
Ke kaloku uHezekiya wamnika isilivere zonke ezifunyanwa endlwini kaYehova, nakwiikhabhathi zendlu.
Ke kaloku, ngaloo xesha, uHezekiya wasusa igolide yeminyango yetempile kaYehova, neengcango zesivalo sayo, igolide awayeyayibeka khona, wayinika ukumkani waseAshuri.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaAsiriya wathumela umphathi wakhe, uRahabhi, nomkhosi wakhe, esuka eLakishi waya kukumkani uHezekiya, eYerusalem, namadoda amaninzi; bafika ke eYerusalem, bamisa emehlweni olwandle oluphezulu, elunxwemeni lwendlela yendawo yokuhlamba.
Babiza ukumkani. Waphuma ke uEliyakim, unyana kaHilkiya, umphathi wendlu, noShebna umbhali, noYowa unyana kaAsafe, umbhali weencwadi, ukuba bahlangane nabo.
Wathi kubo uRafeki, Nithi ke kuni uHezekiya, Utsho loo nto ukumkani omkhulu, ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, uthi, Yintoni le ntlonipho yakho?
Nithi, Inyaniso ninayo, nobuchule bokulwa; kodwa ezi zinto zilizwi elingenanto. Uthini na ukholo lwakho, ukuba mna u izdele?
Yabona, ukholosa kuYiputa, kuloo ntyatyambo engqutyiweyo yentsontelo yokuhamba; ukuba umntu enyamezela kuyo, iyakutshisa isandla sakhe. Ufana noFaro ukumkani waseYiputa kubo bonke abaxolisa kuye.

Ke ukuba nithi kum, Sithembele kuYehova uThixo wethu? UHezekiya akazange na azisuse izikhululo zakhe eziphakamileyo nezibingelelo zakhe? UHezekiya akathethinga na kumaYuda naseYerusalem, esithi, Niya kukhonza phambi kwesibingelelo esi eYerusalem?
Ke ngoko, yenza ngoku urhwebo nokumkani wam waseAshuri; ndiza kukunika amawaka mabini eemahashe, ukuba ungabafumana na abakhweli kuwo.
Ingaba unokuxolela njani umphathi ophantsi, phakathi kwabakhonzi bakakumkani wam? Ke wena ukholelwa eYiputa ngenxa yeenqanawa nabasemagqabini.
Ke kaloku, ngaba ndiya kungena ngaphandle koYehova ukuhlasela le ndawo, ukuba ndiyilahle? UYehova wathi kum, Yiya phezu kweli lizwe, uyiafiile.
Wathi ke uEliyakim, unyana kaHilkiya, noShebna, noYowa, kuRahabhi, Nceda sithi kumakhonzi akho ngesiAram, ngokuba siyayiqonda; musa kuthetha nathi ngesiHebhere, phambi kwamehlo abantu abasedonga.

Waphendula ke uRahabhi, wathi, Ingaba ngukumkani wakho nowe kuphela inkosi yam eyandithumeleleyo ukuba ndithethe la mazwi? Hayi, mna ndamthumelela kubo amadoda ahlala phezu kwedonga; baya kudla inkunkuma yabo, basele umchamo wabo, njengeni.
Wahlala ke uRafeki, watsho ngesiHebhere, esithi, Yizani ilizwi likakumkani omkhulu, ukumkani waseAshuri.
Utsho ke ukumkani ukuthi, Musani ukuba uHezekiya akuxoleleni; kuba akakwazanga kunikhusela esandla sam.
Musani ke uHezekiya ukuba nithembe kuYehova, athi, UYehova uya kusikhusela ngokuqinisekileyo; lo mzi awuyi kubekwa emlonyeni kakumkani waseAshuri.

Musani ukumthobela uHezekiya. Utsho ke ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, Nithi, Yakheni nam uxolo, niphume kuni; nidla ngamnye nomnye imbewu yeentyatyambo zewayini yakhe, nemithi yomnquma wakhe, nisele umnye nomnye amanzi emilambo yakhe;

de ndifike, ndinithathe nisezweni ililo elifana nelizwe lenu; ilizwe lenkomo newayini entsha, ilizwe lesonka nezityalo zeziqhamo, ilizwe lezityalo zeoli yeoli nenkukhu; khethani ukuphila, musa ukufa. Musani ukumthobela uHezekiya, xa ekukuxelela athi, UYehova uya kusikhusela.
Ingaba kukho uThixo welizwe elinike ilizwe lakhe phantsi kwesandla sikakumkani waseAshuri?
Baphi na amadini aseHamati, namadini aseArpadi? Baphi na amadini aseSefarwayim, namadini aseHena, namadini aseIva? Bawukhusela njani uSamariya esandla sam?
Nguwuphi na uThixo, phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe ezi, okwaziyo ukusindisa ilizwe lakhe kum? UYehova angasindisi njani ke iYerusalem kum?"
Ke kaloku abantu banyamalala, bangaphenduli nto; ngokuba ukumkani wayewisela umthetho, esithi, Musani ukumphendula.
Ke kaloku uEliyakim, unyana kaHilkiya, umphathi wendlu kakumkani, noShebna umbhali, noYowa unyana kaAsafe, umlawuli weencwadi, bafika kuHezekiya, begqobhoza iimpahla zabo, bamxelela amazwi kaRahabhi.
Ke kaloku, xa ukumkani uHezekiya ekubona loo nto, waluka izihlangu zakhe, wagqoka iingubo ezingwevu, waya endlwini kaYehova.
Wathumela uEliyakim, umphathi wendlu kakumkani, noShebna, umbhali, nababingeleli abakhulu, bonke begqoke izihlangu ezingwevu, kuIsaya umprofeti, unyana kaAmozi.
Bathi kuye, Isithi le nto uHezekiya: Namhlanje yimini yoxinzelelo, nokunyamezela, nokucaphukisa; sifana nomntu okwindawo yokuzala, asinamandla okuzalisa.

Kungenzeka ukuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho,ēšanase wava onke amagama kaRafeki, othunyelwe ngukumkani waseAshuri, umphathi wakhe, ukuba aphucule uThixo ophilayo; kungabonakala ukuba iNkosi, uThixo wakho, uya kumnqula ngenxa yamazwi awawava; ngoko ke, mthandaze thina abambalwa abaseleyo.
Bafika ke abaphathi bakakumkani uHezekiya kuIsaya.
Wathi kubo uIsaya, Nithi kukumkani wenu, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Musa ukukhathazeka ngezi zinto uzivayo, ezo zinqulatho abakhonzi bakakumkani waseAshuri bathetha ngazo kum.
Yabona, mna ndiya kuzisa umphefumlo kuye; ke uya kwenza ukuba azive ilizwi, aze abuye ezweni lakhe; apho ezweni lakhe, mna ndiya kumbulala ngeqhwa.
Wava uRafeki ukuba ukumkani wakwaAsiriya uhambe eLakishi; wabuya ke uRafeki, wamfumana ukumkani ehlasela iLibhana.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaAsiriya wayeva ukuba uThirhaka, ukumkani waseEtiyopiya, waphuma ekulwa naye; wabathumela kwakhona abathunywa kuHezekiya, esithi,
Nithethe kuHezekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, nithi, Musani ukuba uThixo wakho, okholelwa kuye, akuxhoboze, esithi, IYerusalem ayiyi kunikezelwa emkhosini kakumkani waseAshuri.
Ngokuba ufundile into abayenzayo ookumkani baka-Asiriya kuzo zonke iilwimi, ukuba bazenza zibe zizinto ezilahlekileyo; wena ke uya kusindiswa na?
Bazikhusela na izitha zezinto eziphilayo, abazalwana bam abazibulalayo? Bazikhusela na iGozan, neHaran, neRezef, nabahlali baseEden abahlala eTelasare?
Uphi ukumkani waseHamati? Uphi ukumkani waseArpadi? Baphi ookumkani baseSefarwayim, nabaseHena, nabaseIva?
Ke kaloku uHezekiya wathabatha incwadi emlonyeni wabo abathunywa, wayifunda; waya endlwini kaYehova, wayikhupha phambi koYehova.
Wathandaza ke uHezekiya kuYehova, wathi, UYehova, uThixo wakwaSirayeli, ohlala emehlweni akho phakathi kweekeribhoni; wena kuphela uThixo wamakumkani onke ehlabathini; wena wazenza izulu nehlabathi.
UYehova, udibanise indlebe yakho, uthethe; iNkosi, vula amehlo akho, ubone; khumbula amazwi kaSenhakeri, othunyelwe ukucaphukisa uThixo ophilayo.
Inyaniso, Nkosi yam, ukuba ookumkani baka-Asiriya babhiyozela izizwe namazwe abo.
Bathabathela amadini abo emlilweni; kuba ayingomadini, kodwa isandla somntu sakwenza ukhuni nelitye; ngenxa yoko abaAshuri babulala ooThixo babo.
Ke ngoko, Nkosi yethu uThixo wethu, sisindise, sikucelayo, emlonyeni wakhe; ukuze zikwazi zonke izikumkani zehlabathi ukuba wena kuphela, Nkosi, unguThixo.
Wathumela ke uIsaya unyana kaAmozi kuHezekiya, esithi, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Ndiyakubona ilizwi lakho lomthandazo malunga noSanheribhi ukumkani wakwaAsiriya.
Eli lilizwi iNkosi alilithetha kuye, Lithi: Indodakazi, umzi weSiyoni, uyakuxolela, icula kuwe; Umzi weYerusalem utyhila intloko yakhe phambi kwakho, xa ubaleka.
Nguwuphi na umntu owenzayo umsindo, uyamxolela? Nguwuphi na umntu owenzayo umsindo, uyamxelela ngento engalunganga? Waye nguMngcwele kaSirayeli.

Ngezithunywa zakho ungenqula iNkosi, usithi, Ngeemoto zam ezininzi ndiye ndanyuka kwiintaba eziphakamileyo, ezona ndawo ziphezulu zeLibanoni. Ndiya kuzicima izityalo zayo zeediliya eziphakamileyo, neentyatyambo zayo ezilungileyo; ndiya kufika kwiindawo zayo eziphakamileyo, nezityalo zayo ezinde.
Ndiya kukhupha iziqithi, ndidla amanzi azo; ndiya kuzitshisa zonke iintaba zaseYiputa ngeenyawo zam.
Ungaziva na? Ndazilungiselela ngaphambili, Ndazicwangcisela imihla yakudala, Namhlanje ndiya kuzilungisa; Ndiza kukutshintsha imimandla enemigangatho ibe ziibhotwe.

Ke ngoko, abantu babo baphulukana nobuchule; bakhathazeka, baxhaphaza. Baye befana neentyatyambo ezigqwesileyo emthini, njengeentyatyambo eziluhlaza, njengeentyatyambo zendlu yasematyeni, ezitshisa phambi kokuba zikhule.
Ndiyazi ke ukuba uhlala phi, nokuba uphuma phi, nokuba ufika phi; ndiziqonda iinyembezi zakho endirimo.
Ngokuba unenkani kum, yaye ndiva amagama akho aphezulu, ngoko ke mna ndiya kuyibeka intloko yam emlonyeni wakho, nesigqubuthelo sam emlonyeni wakho; ndiya kukubuyisela ngendlela oza kuyo.

Le nto iya kuba nguphawu kuwe, uHezekiya: kulo nyaka uza kulila okukhulayo ngokwalo, nonyaka olandelayo oko kuvelayo kuwo; kodwa kunyaka wesithathu uya kulima, uthabathe inkunkuma, ukhule izityalo zezinkomo, uphile imbewu yazo.
Amadoda aseYuda aphumayo, ashiyekayo, aya kuphinda afake iziqhamo ezinzulu, aze aphumeze imbewu phezulu.
Kuza kuphuma eYerusalem iqela elinobuxoki, Nabo baphumayo baya kuvela emnqamlezweni weSiyone; Uthando lomlilo lukaYehova luya kwenza oku.
Ngoko ke, utsho iNkosi ngaye ukumkani wakwa-Asiriya, Akuyi kungena kuloo mzi, akawuthutha khona umqolo wakhe; akayi kudlula kuwo ngemiyalelo, akayi kwakha khona isango elinqamlezeneyo endlwini yayo.
Uya kubuyela ngendlela awayefika ngayo; akayi kungena kulo mzi, utsho iNkosi.
Ndiya kukhusela lo mzi, ndiwusindise, ngenxa yam, ngenxa yomkhonzi wam uDavide.

Waphuma ke umbingeleli kaYehova ngaloo busuku, wabulala emkhosini wama-Ashuri amadoda amakhulu asibhozo anamashumi amahlanu amawaka; bavuka ke abantu ngasekupheleni kwemini, bayabona ukuba kukho amathambo kuwo onke amazwe.
Wasuka ke uSennakheri, ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, waya endlwini yakhe; wahlala eNineve.

Ke kaloku, xa ethandaza endlwini kaNisroki uThixo wakhe, uAdrammeleki noSharezere oonyana bakhe bambulala ngekrwada, baphuma besiya ezweni laseArarati. UEsar-hadon unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Kwathi ngaloo mihla uHezekiya waba nesifo, wafa. Wafika kuye uIsaya umprofeti, unyana kaAmozi, wathi kuye, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Yilungiselele izinto zakho; ngokuba uya kufa, awusayi kuphiliswa.
Wajika uHezekiya ubuso bakhe emgangathweni, wathandaza kuYehova, wathi,
Nceda, Nkosi yam, uqaphele ukuba ndahamba phambi kwakho ngokuthembekileyo ngentliziyo yam yonke, ndiyenze into elungileyo emehlweni akho. Watsho ke uHezekiya ngelizwi elibi.
Ke kaloku, phambi kokuba uIsaya aphume kwindlu ephakathi, kwafika igama likaYehova kuye, lithi,

Yiya, utsho kuHezekiya, umphathi welizwe lam, uthi, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaDavide, utata wakho, esithi, Ndiluva umthandazo wakho, ndizibone iintyatyambo zakho; bona, ndiza kukuphilisa. Ngomhla wesithathu uya kungena endlwini kaYehova.
Ndiya kuzisa kwimihla yakho iminyaka elishumi elinamihlanu; ndiya kukusindisa wena nolu dolophu emkhosini kakumkani wase-Ashuri; ndiya kukhusela olu dolophu ngenxa yam, ngenxa yomkhonzi wam uDavide.
Wathi ke uIsaya, Nceda nithathe umxube weentyatyambo. Bawuthabatha, bawubeka phezu kwetye; waza uHezekiya waphiliswa.
Ke kaloku uHezekiya wathi kuIsaya, Yintoni loo phawu lokuba iNkosi uya kundiphilisa, ukuba ndiya kungena endlwini kaThixo ngemini yesithathu?

Waphendula uIsaya, wathi, Lo nguphawu oluvela kuYehova, ukuba uThixo uya kwenza loo nto athethayo: Ingaba isithunzi siza kuhamba phambili iincopho ezilishumi, okanye siza kubuyela umva iincopho ezilishumi?
Wathi uHezekiya, Kulula ukuba isithunzi sihambe phambili ngeenyawo ezilishumi; ke ngoko, sihambe ezantsi ngeenyawo ezilishumi.
UIsaya umprofeti wayalela iNkosi; iNkosi wambuyisela umva isithunzi, ngeenyawo ezilishumi, kwindlela ka-Ahazi.
Ngelo xesha uMerodaki-baladan, unyana kaBaladan, ukumkani waseBhabheli, wathumela iileta nomnikelo kuHezekiya; ngokuba wayeva ukuba uHezekiya usegula.

Ke kaloku uHezekiya wabafumana, wawabonisa konke okusezindlu zakhe zempahla, isilivere, negolide, neziqhamo, neoli entle, nekhaya lakhe lezithunywa, nazo zonke izinto ezisezindlu zakhe zempahla; kwakungekho nto endlwini yakhe, nakummandla wakhe onke, awayengayibonisi uHezekiya.
Wafika ke uIsaya umprofeti kukumkani uHezekiya, wambuza wathi kuye, Bathini na abo bantu? Bavela phi? UHezekiya waphendula wathi, Bavela ezweni elifutshane, eBhabheli.
Wathi uIsaya, Babona ntoni na endlwini yakho? UHezekiya wathi, Babone zonke izinto ezikwindlu yam; akukho nto kwizinto zam zempahla yam endiyibonisileyo.
Wathi ke uIsaya kuHezekiya, Yiva ilizwi likaYehova:
Yabona, ziya kufika iintsuku, xa zonke izinto ezikwindlu yakho, nazo zonke izinto ababezigcina ooyise bakho, kuze kube ngaloo mini, ziza kuthunyelwa eBhabheli; akukho nto izakushiywa, utsho iNkosi.
Baza kuthabatha abathile ebantwini bakho, abazaliselwe emlonyeni wakho; baza kuba ngamagqwetha endlwini kakumkani waseBhabheli.
Wathi uHezekiya kuIsaya, Lilungileyo ilizwi likaYehova olithethayo. Wathi ke uHezekiya, Ingaba akuyi kubakho ntoni na? Kuba kuya kubakho uxolo nokhuselo emini yam.

Konke okuseleyo kwezinto azenzayo uHezekiya, namandla akhe onke, nendlela awayewenza ngayo isiqulatho samatye, nomngxunya wokuhambisa amanzi emzini, ngaba akubhalwenga kuncwadi lwabalinganiswa bakakumkani baseYuda?
Wafa uHezekiya; uManase unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UManase ubeminyaka ilishumi elinamibini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mahlanu anamihlanu engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguHefezibha.
Wakwenza oko kubi ngamehlo kaYehova; walandela izinto ezibuhlungu zezinto zakwaSirayeli, ezo iNkosi wayezikhuphe phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.

Wazilungisa kwakhona iindawo eziphakamileyo, ezo uHezekiya uyise awazibulalayo; wamisa izibingelelo kuBhali, waza wenza iAshere, njengokuba wayeyenze uAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli; wayalela iinkwenkwezi zonke zezulu, wabakhonza.
Wakha izibingelelo endlwini kaYehova, apho iNkosi wathi khona, Ndiza kulibeka igama lam eYerusalem.
Wakha izibingelelo kuzo zonke iinkwenkwezi zezulu, ezindlwini zombini zendlu kaThixo.

Wabeka unyana wakhe emnqamlezweni, wasebenzisa iimfihlakalo, waza wasebenzisa amaphupha, waya kumadoda athetha ngezinto eziphilayo, nakwamadoda cultural; wenza okubi kakhulu ngamehlo kaYehova, wamnyamekela ke.

Wathabatha imifanekiso engumthi we-ashere, eyenziweyo, wayibeka kwindlu kaThixo, leyo iNkosi wayethe ngayo kuDavide noSolomon unyana wakhe, esithi, Kule ndlu, naseYerusalem, endiyikhethileyo phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaSirayeli, ndiza kulibeka igama lam kude kube sekupheleni.
Andiyi kuzisa kwakhona izandla zakwaSirayeli zisuka ezweni endilibambise lona ooyise babo, ukuba nje bagcinele ukuyenza yonke into endiyiwiselayo, besenza umthetho onke owawuthi uMoses umkhonzi wam.
Ke kaloku abantu abazange baphulaphule; uManase wababangela ukuba benze okubi ngaphezu kwazo zonke izizwe, ezo iNkosi wazibulala phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Wathetha ke iNkosi ngomlomo wabakhonzi bakhe abaprofeti, esithi,
UManase ukumkani wakwaYuda wenza ezi zinto zixhaphakileyo, wakwenza okubi kakhulu kunabaAmoreyi ababehlala apha phambi kwakhe; waza wabangela ukuba amaSirayeli abe nesono ngeempawu zakhe.
Ngoko ke, utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Yabona, ndiya kuzisa ingozi eYerusalem naseYuda, ukuze zonke izindlebe zalowo uzivayo zibe zinetshizi.

Ndiza kuyilinganisela iYerusalem ngentambo yam yokulinganisa, endiyimise eSamariya, nentambo yam yokulinganisa, eniyimise kwindlu ka-Ahabhi; ndiya kuyitshisa iYerusalem, njengokuthi umntu atshise isitya, ayitshise, ayijikelezise phezulu phantsi.
Ndiya kubashiya abo bami abaseleyo, ndibamise ebusweni bomkhosi wabo; nabo bonke abachasi babo baya kubatyhapha, baya kubathwala iimpahla zabo.
ngokuba benze oko kubi ngasemva kwam, bandise inkanuko yam ukususela ngemini ababephuma ngayo ootata babo eYiputa, kuze kube ngaloo mini.

Ke kaloku uManase wabulala abantu abaninzi abangenatyala, de wagcwalisa iYerusalem ngegazi labo ukusuka kwisiphelo esinye ukuya kwisiphelo esinye; kwakunye nesono awayesenza amaYuda aphume kulo, ekwenzeni okubi emehlweni kaYehova.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uManase, nazo zonke izinto zakhe, nesono sakhe esiwenzayo, zingaba azibhalwenga phantsi kwencwadi yeendaba zamakumkani amaYuda?
Wafa uManase, wabanjwa endlwini yegadi yakhe, egadi ka-Uza. UAmon unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UAmon ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamibini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emibini engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana kaHaruzi uMeshulemeti, waseYotbha.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, njengoko wayesenza uManase uyise.
Wahamba ngeendlela zonke zikayise; wakhonza imifanekiso engumqondiso, awayekhonza ngayo udade wakhe, wayalela.
Wayeka ukulandela iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi bakhe; akahamba ngeendlela zikaYehova.
Ke kaloku abakhonzi bakaAmon babhiyozela kuye, babulala ukumkani endlwini yakhe.
Ke kaloku abantu belizwe babulala bonke abo babhiyozelayo ukumkani uAmon; bakwenza uYosiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uAmon, zihleli zibhalwe encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani baseYuda.
Wagqunywa esibhedlele sakhe, endlwini yegadi ka-Uza. UYosiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani emva kwakhe.

UYosiya ubeminyaka ilishumi elinesibhozo ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mathathu anamibini ananye engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguYedida unyana kaAdaya waseBozkati.
Wakwenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova; wahamba ngeendlela zonke zikaDavide, utata wakhe; akatshintshi ngasekunene nakwesobunxele.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo wokumkani uYosiya, wathumela uShafani unyana kaAzaliya, unyana kaMeshulam, umbhali, endlwini kaYehova, esithi,
Yiya kuHilkiya, umbingeleli omkhulu, uyibalo imali ethe yafakwa endlwini kaYehova, abakhuseli beengcango abayiqokelele kubo bonke abantu.
Bazinikezele kumadoda alawulayo umsebenzi wendlu kaYehova; baya kuzihlawula ke iindleko zabasebenzi abalungisayo ukulimala kwendlu kaThixo.
abakhonzi, nabaqulunqi, nabahlenga-hlengikazi; bathengise imithi, batshise iithayile, ukuba balungise indlu.
Akukho mfuneko yokuba babeke ityala ngemali abayifumanayo, kuba bathembekile."
Wathi uHilkiya, umbingeleli omkhulu, kuShafani umbhali, esithi, Ndifumene incwadi yomthetho endlwini kaYehova. Wayinika loo ncwadi uShafani; wafunda uShafani.
Wafika ke uShafani, umbhali, wamxelela ukumkani, wathi, Abakhonzi bakho bakhuphe imali efumaneka kwindlu kaThixo, bayinike abantu abalawulayo imisebenzi yendlu kaYehova.
Wathi ke uShafani umbhali kukumkani, UHilkiya ukumkani wamnika incwadi. Wayifunda ke uShafani phambi kokumkani.
Ke kaloku, xa ukumkani eva amazwi encwadini yomthetho, waluka iimpahla zakhe.
Wamisa uHilkiya ukumkani, noAhikamu unyana kaShafani, noAkhobore unyana kaMika, noShafani umbhali, noAsaya umkhonzi wokumkani, wathi,

Niye, nibuze iNkosi ngesandla sam, nesandla sabantu, nesandla samaYuda onke, ngokubhaliweyo kwalo ncwadi lwafunyanwa; kuba kukhulu ubuxoki bukaYehova obunxulumene nathi; ngokuba abazalwana bethu abazange baphulaphule amazwi alo ncwadi, besenza konke okubhalwa kulo.

Waye ke uHilkiya, umbingeleli, noAhikam, noAkhobore, noShafane, noAsaye, ukuba bathethe noHulda umprofeti; yena wayeyindodana kaShalum, unyana kaTikwa, unyana kaHarhashe, olawula iimpahla zokumkani; wahlala eJerusalem, kwidolophu entsha.
Wathi kubo, Itsho loo nto iNkosi uThixo kaSirayeli, Nithi kulowo mntu wamthumelelayo, Nithi,
Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Yabona, ndiya kuzisa ingozi kule ndawo nabasezidolophini bayo, ngokwezinto ezibhaliweyo kulo ncwadi olufundwa ngukumkani waseYuda.
Basuka kum, basindisa uvumba kumadini amanye, ukuba ndimkhube, ngezinto zabo zonke ezifana nemifanekiso engumthi eyenziwe ngamehlo abo; ngoko ke inkanuko yam iya kuqhuma kuloo ndawo, ayizukufa.
Ke kuye ukumkani wakwaYuda, owabathumelela ukuba abuze iNkosi, nithi kuye, Oku kuthe iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, ngokuphathelele kumalizwi owavayo:

Ngokuba intliziyo yakho yathotywa, wayihlangula wena ngokwakho phambi koYehova, xa ufundile into endithetha ngayo ngale ndawo nabasezizweni zayo, adresi yokokuba iqhutywe, ibe yinyaniso; nawe waluka izihlangu zakho, watsho phambi kwam: ke mna ndakuphendula, uthi iNkosi.
Ngoko ke, khangela, ndiya kukuvumela ukuba uphile, uhlangane nabazalwana bakho; uza kuvulwa ngoxolo; awuzukubona lo monakalo onke endiwuzisayo kule ndawo. Bathi ke kubo ukumkani ilizwi lakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathumela, wababiza bonke abathetheli baseYuda naseYerusalem; bafika bedibana naye.

Wanyuka ke ukumkani waya endlwini kaYehova, naye bonke abantu bakaYuda, nabo bonke abahlali baseYerusalem, nababingeleli, nabaprofeti. Bafika bonke abantu, ukusuka kuncinci kuye kukhulu; wafunda ngamazwi abo onke amagama encwadini yomnqophiso, eyafunyanwa endlwini kaYehova.

Ke kaloku ukumkani waya phantsi, wamisa umnqophiso phambi koYehova, ukuba alandele iNkosi, ukuba agcine imiyalelo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, intliziyo yakhe yonke, nomphefumlo wakhe wonke, ukuze aphumeze amazwi omnqophiso obhalwe kuloo ncwadi. Bathi ke bonke abantu ukuba bagcine lo mnqophiso.

Wathi ukumkani kuHilkiya, umbingeleli omkhulu, nababingeleli besibini, nabagwebi beengcango, ukuba bakhuphe endlwini kaYehova zonke izinto eziyenziwe nguBhaali, neAshere, nazo zonke iinkwenkwezi zasemazulwini; wazitshisa ngaphandle kweYerusalem, emaphandleni oMlambo weKidron, waza wazisa inkungu yawo eBheteli.

Wasusa oonyana bakaThixo, ababingeleli, ababingeleli, ababebamisela amakumkani aseYiputa, ukuba basindise uvumba kwiindawo eziphakamileyo, ezidolophini zakwaYuda, nezijikeleze iYerusalem; wasusa nalabo abasindisa uvumba kuBhaali, nelanga, nenyanga, neeplanethi, neenkwenkwezi zonke zezulu.

Wathabatha i-ashere, yaphuma endlwini kaYehova, waya emlanjeni weKidron, ngaphandle kweYerusalem; wayitshisa khona, wayithambisa ibe yimpuphu, watywina umsi wayo phezu kwezibhedlele zabantu abaqhelekileyo.
Wazikhupha izindlu zabafazi ababhiyozelayo, ezikwindlu kaYehova, apho amabhinqa eqokelela khona iintonga ze-Ashere.

Wazisa ke uYosiya bonke ababingeleli emadolophini kaYuda, waya eYerusalem; waza wazenza izikhululo eziphakamileyo, apho besenza khona umnquba, zibe zimbi, ukusuka eGibeha ukuya eBher-shebha; wabaphula iinkunzi zeenkomo zeengcango, ekungeneni kwesango likaYoshuwa, umphathi womzi, elikwicala lasekhohlo, xa niphuma ngesango lomzi.
Ke kaloku ababingeleli beendawo eziphakamileyo abazange basebenze kwisibingelelo sikaYehova eYerusalem; babedla isonka esingaqhelekanga, nabo bonke oonyana babo ababingeleli.
Wayenza iTofeti, eNtaba kaBhen-hinnom, ibe yindawo engafanelekanga, ukuze akukho namnye onikela khona unyana wakhe okanye intombi yakhe emlilweni kuMoleki.

Wasusa iihashe, abakumkani bakaYuda ababezilungiselele ilanga; zazibekwe ekungeneni kwendlu kaYehova, kufutshane negumbi lomphathi okuthiwa nguNatan-meleki, elunxwemeni. Ke kaloku uYosiya watshisa izithuthi ezilungiselelwe ilanga.

Izibingelelo abakumkani bakaYuda babezilungiselele phezu kwendlu yangasese ka-Ahazi, ukumkani wazibhaka; izibingelelo uManase abezilungiselele ezindlwini zombini zetempeli kaYehova, wazibhaka; waza wazingcaphukisa khona, wazisa iintonga zayo emlanjeni weKidron.

Iindawo eziphakamileyo ezisemzantsi-mpuma yeYerusalem, ezingene kumntla wenduli yobuxoki, ukumkani wazenza zibe phantsi; uSolomon, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wayezilungiselela iAshtorethi, into engalunganga yamaSidoni, noKemoshi, into engalunganga yamaMowabi, noMilkom, into engalunganga yamaAmmoniti.
Ke kaloku uYosiya watshisa iinkunzi zeenkomo, waza waphula izityalo zeAshere, wazigubungela iindawo zazo ngeethambo zabantu.

Wayikhupha ke isibingelelo esiseBheteli, nendawo ephakamileyo awayeyenza uYaroboham, unyana kaNabati, lowo wabangela amaSirayeli ukuba enze isono; wayitshisa indawo ephakamileyo, wayitywina ibe ngumgubo, wayala iAshere.

Ke kaloku uYosiya, ejonge, wabona izibingelelo ezikwindawo eselunxwemeni; wazisa iinwele zazo kwizibingelelo, waza uzitshisa phezu kwesibingelelo, ukuze kungabikho nto yokuzikhonza kuyo; ngokwelizwi likaYehova elithethayo ngomntu kaThixo, owazise loo zinto ngonaphakade.

Wathi uYosiya, Yintoni loo mqondiso wesibingelelo ndiwubonayo? Bathi kuye abantu bedolophu leyo, Yingqungquthela yomntu kaThixo owafika eYuda, wathetha ngazo zonke ezi zinto ozenzayo kwisibingelelo eBheteli.
Wathi uYosiya, Yishiyeni; akukho namnye oza kuzitsala izihlunu zakhe. Zazishiya ke izihlunu zakhe, nezihlunu zomprofeti owafika eSamaria.
Wazisusa ke uYosiya nazo zonke iindawo eziphakamileyo, ezimizini yaseSamariya, abazenzayo ookumkani bakaSirayeli, ezo zabangela iNkosi ukuba acamngce; wazenza ngazo zonke izinto awazenzayo eBheteli.
Wawabulala bonke ababingeleli beendawo eziphakamileyo zezo phezu kwezibingelelo zabo, watshisa iinwele zabantu phezu kwezibingelelo; wabuya eYerusalem.
Wathi ukumkani kubo bonke abantu, Yenzani iPasha kuYehova uThixo wenu, njengoko kuchaziwe kulo ncwadi lomnqophiso.
Akuzange kubekho iPasha efana nale, ukususela ngemihla abagwebi belawula ngayo amaSirayeli, nakuzo zonke iintsuku zabakumkani bakaSirayeli nabakumkani baseYuda.
Ke kaloku ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo kakumkani uYosiya, kwathiwa iPasha leyo kuYehova eYerusalem.

Ke kaloku uYosiya wabasusa abo bathetha ngezinto eziphilayo, nabamangali, namadini asekhaya, nemifanekiso engumqondiso, nazo zonke izinto ezinobuxoki ezibonakala eYuda naseYerusalem; ukuze aphumeze amazwi omyalelo obhalwe kwincwadi kaHilkiya ukumkani, eyafunyanwa endlwini kaYehova.
Akubakho ukumkani ofana noYosiya, phambi kwakhe, nokuba kamva kuye, wabuyela kuYehova intliziyo yakhe yonke, nomphefumlo wakhe wonke, negunya lakhe lonke, esenza umthetho onke kaMoses.
Ke kaloku, iNkosi akayeki ukubuyela emnqamlezweni wobuxoki bakhe obukhulu, obusuka kuYuda, ngenxa yezinto zonke awazenzayo uManase zokumxolela.
Wathi iNkosi, Ndiya kususa noYuda phambi kwam, njengokuba ndisuse khona amaSirayeli; ndiya kuyeka iYerusalem, lo mzi endiwukhethileyo, neTempile, indawo endithe ndathi, Igama lam liya kuba khona.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uYosiya, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, ngaba azibhalwenga encwadini yeziganeko zamakumkani amaYuda?

Ke kaloku, ngexesha likaYosiya ukumkani, wanyuka uFaro Neko, ukumkani waseYiputa, waya kumlambo iEfrayim, ukuba amncede ukumkani wakwaAsiriya. Waphuma ke uKumkani uYosiya ukuba alwe naye; wadibana noNeko eMegido, wambulala.

Abaphathi bakaYosiya bamthabatha umphefumlo wakhe, wamthabatha emkhosini osuka eMegido waya eYerusalem, wamtyhila esibhedlele sakhe. Bathi ke abantu belizwe bathabathe uYehohaza, unyana kaYosiya, babambisa, bakwenza ukumkani endaweni yoyise.
UYohahazi ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamithathu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emithathu engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguHamutali unyana kaYeremiya waseLibna.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, njengoko babesenza ooyise bakhe.

Ke kaloku uFaro-Neho wamnqula ngeentambo eRibleha, ezweni laseHamati, ukuze angabi ngukumkani eYerusalem; wabangela ukuba amaYuda ahlawule izigidi ezilishumi elinambini zesilivere, nezigidi ezimashumi mathathu anesihlanu zegolide.
UFaro uNeko wamenza ukumkani uEliyakim, unyana kaYosiya, endaweni kaYosiya uyise, watshintsha igama lakhe waba nguYehoyakim; wamthabatha ke uYowahazi waya eYiputa, wafa khona.
UYehoyakim wamnika uFaro isilivere negolide, njengoko wayecelayo; ukuze akwenze oku, wahlawulisa ilizwe; wamenza umntu ngamnye ahlawule isilivere negolide, ngokwezinto zakhe, aze amnike uFaro uNeko.
UYehoyakim ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamihlanu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinanye engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana kaPedaya uZebida, waseRuma, wayengumntwana wakhe.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, njengoko babesenza ooyise bakhe.
Kwiintsuku zikaYoyakim ukumkani, wafika uNabukodonozor, ukumkani waseBhabheli, waya ezweni; waba ngukumkani wakhe iminyaka emithathu. Ke kaloku wanquma ukubuyela umva, waza waphuma kum.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wathumela phezu kukaYehoyakim amaqela eBhabheli, namaAram, namaMowabhi, namaAmmoniti; wabathumela ukuba baphulaphule amaYuda, njengokuba wathi iNkosi ngesandla samakhonzi akhe amaprofeti.
Ezi zinto zafika kuYuda, ngenxa yomthetho kaYehova; waza wazisa emehlweni akhe, ngenxa yezono zikaManase, nazo zonke izinto azenzayo,
Ke kaloku ngenxa yegazi elingabikho emthethweni, awayelisusa; uManase wagcwalisa iYerusalem ngegazi elingabikho emthethweni; iNkosi akafuni ukuxolela.
Ezinye ke izinto azenzayo uYehoyakim, nazo zonke izigqibo zakhe, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi yemihla ngemihla yamakumkani amaYuda?
Wafa uYoyakim; uYoyakim, unyana wakhe, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani waseYiputa akaphinde aphume ezweni lakhe; ngokuba ukumkani waseBhabheli wathabatha lonke ilizwe lakhe, ukususela emlanjeni weYiputa waya kumlambo uEfrayim.

UYehoyakim ubeminyaka ilishumi elinamithandathu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emithathu engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana kaNehushta, unyana kaElnathane, waseYerusalem, wayengumntwana wakhe.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, njengokuba wayesenza uyise.
Ngelo xesha, abaphathi bakaNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli bafika eYerusalem, bagubungela umzi.
Ke kaloku uNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli waya kuloo mzi, xa abaphathi bakhe bewujikeleze.

Ke kaloku uYoyakim, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waphuma waya kukumkani waseBhabheli, yena noyise wakhe, namagqwetha akhe, nabathetheli bakhe, nabakhonzi bakhe; ngomnyaka wesibhozo wokumkani wakhe, ukumkani waseBhabheli wamthabatha uYoyakim.

Wathabatha uNebhukadnezare zonke iikhabhathi zetempeli kaYehova, nendlu kakumkani; watshisa zonke izinto zegolide, azenzayo uSolomon, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, endlwini kaYehova, njengoko iNkosi abesithi.

Wabathwalisa bonke abantu baseYerusalem, bonke abathetheli, nabo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, amawaka alishumi elinambini, nabenzi bonke bezinto eziluncedo, nabenzi bezintsimbi; bashiyeke kuphela abantu abancinci belizwe.
UNebhukadnezare wamthabatha uYoyakim waya eBhabheli; wamthabatha nonyana kakumkani, nabafazi bakakumkani, namagqwetha akhe, namadoda amakhulu elizwe; wabathwala bonke eYerusalem aye eBhabheli.

Ke kaloku ukumkani waseBhabheli wathabathela waya eBhabheli onke amawaka asixhenxe amadoda anamandla, namawaka amane amalungu omsebenzi, nabasebenzi bentsimbi; bonke abo banamandla amakhulu, abalungele ukulwa.
Ukumkani waseBhabheli wenza uMatania, umyeni wakhe, ukumkani endaweni yakhe, watshintsha igama lakhe waba nguZedekiya.
UZedekiya ubeminyaka imashumi mabini ananye ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinanye engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguHamutali unyana kaYeremiya waseLibna.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, ngokwezinto zonke awazenzayo uYoyakim.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yobuxoki bukaYehova kwathiwa ezi zinto zonke eYerusalem naseYuda, de wazisabalalisa emehlweni akhe. UZedekiya ke wayalelwa ngukumkani waseBhabheli.

Ngomnyaka wethoba wokumkani wakhe, ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga yesixhenxe, ngemini yeshumi lenyanga, wafika uNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli, yena nemiyalelo yakhe yonke, waya eYerusalem; bamisa izibhedlele ezijikelezayo lo mzi, bayenza imigangatho yokulwa ijikelezayo.
Ke kaloku lo mzi wabekwa phantsi kohlaselo, waya kunyaka olishumi elinanye kaZedekiya ukumkani.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesithoba wenyanga yesine, ubhubhane lwalukhulu kakhulu kuloo mzi; kwakungekho kudla kwaba bantu.

Udonga lomzi lwaphucuka; bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli baphuma ngobusuku ngesango eliphakathi kweengcango ezimbini, ezingenakude negadi kakumkani; (abaBhabheli ke babejikelezile umzi); ukumkani wabaleka waya elwandle lwaseJordan.
Ke kaloku umkhosi wamaBhabheli walandela ukumkani uZedekiya, wamfumana ezindaweni eziphakamileyo zaseYeremiya; bonke abazalwana bakhe baphuma kuye, basasazeka.
Bathabathela ke ukumkani, bamthabatha waya kukumkani waseBhabheli eRibleha; wabeka umthetho phezu kwakhe.
Bawabulala oonyana bakaZedekiya phambi kwakhe; bakhupha iinwele zikaZedekiya, bamnqula ngeentambo zentsimbi, bamthabatha waya eBhabheli.

Ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga yesihlanu, ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo kaNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli, wafika eYerusalem uNebuzaradane, umphathi weendawo zokugquma, umkhonzi womkani waseBhabheli.
Wabeka umlilo endlwini kaYehova, nendlu kakumkani, nazo zonke iindwendwe zaseYerusalem; nazo zonke izindlu ezibalulekileyo wazingcola.
Ke kaloku umkhosi wonke wamaBhabheli, ephantsi kokumkani weengqekembe, waphula amasango aseYerusalem ajikelezayo.
UNebhuzaradan, umthetheli weengqekembe, wathabatha isiqwengana sabantu abaseleyo emzini, nalabo baphumayo kukumkani waseBhabheli, nesiqwengana sabantu abaseleyo, waza wabathutha.
Ke kaloku umphathi weengqekembe washiya abathile kubantu abancinci belizwe, ukuba basebenze ezityeni zewayini nasezikhungweni.
Iindonga zentsimbi, neziseko zentsimbi, nomngxunya omkhulu wentsimbi, obizwa ngokuba yilwandle, ezingenayo indlu kaYehova, abaBhabheli bawutshisa, bawuthabatha umnqamlezo waya eBhabheli.
Bathabathe namachibi, neengcongconi, neengxowa-mali, neebhotile, nazo zonke izinto zentsimbi ezisetyenziswa kumsebenzi wendlu.
Ukumkani wabagwebi wathabatha izitya zomlilo, nezitya zokubhaka, zonke izinto eziyenziwe ngegolide ecacileyo, nesilivere ecacileyo.
Ubhedu lwamathole amabini, nolwandle olukhulu, neziseko, azenzayo uSolomon endlwini kaYehova, lwalunzima kakhulu, alukwazi ukulinganiselwa.

Umbhobho ngamnye waba yimitha ezisixhenxe ubude; umbhobho wombhobho ngamnye waba yimitha elishumi elinambini ubude, ibe ngasemva kwentsimbi engenasici, ibe yintyatyambo yegranate yentyatyambo yentsimbi. Umbhobho wesibini wayefana nombhobho wesithathu.
Ukumkani wabagwebi wathabathela uSeraya, umbingeleli omkhulu, noZefaniya, umbingeleli wesibini, nabakhuseli bamasango abathathu.

Kubantu abasele edolophini, wathēšanas isikhulu esilawula oonyana bakaSirayeli, namashumi amahlanu amalungu entlango kakumkani, nombhali wenkosi yomkhosi, obiza abantu belizwe emfazweni, namadoda angamashumi asixhenxe abantu belizwe abafunyanwa emzini.
Ke kaloku uNebhuzaradan, umphathi weengqekembe, wawathabatha onke, wabazisa kukumkani waseBhabheli, waya eRibla.
Ke kaloku ukumkani waseBhabheli wababulala apho eRibleha, elunxwemeni lwaseHamati. Bathunywa ke abantu bakaYuda baphuma ezweni labo, babe ngamajoni.
UNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli wammisa uGedaliya, unyana ka-Ahikam, unyana kaShafane, ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu kwabantu abasondelelayo eYuda.

Bonke abaphathi bemikhosi, namadoda abo, babeva ukuba ukumkani waseBhabheli wamisa uGedaliya waba ngukumkani; bafika ke kuGedaliya eMizpa: nguIshmayeli unyana kaNethaniya, noYohananu unyana kaKareha, noSeraya unyana kaTanhumethi waseNetofa, noYazaniya unyana kaMaakathi, nabo amadoda abo.
Wathi uGedaliya kubo namadoda abo, Musani ukoyika abaphathi bakaBhabheli; hlalani kuloo lizwe, nisebenze kukumkani waseBhabheli, nize niphile ngokuthula.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga, waya uIshmayeli unyana kaNethaniya, unyana kaElishama, osuka kusapho lukakumkani, namadoda alishumi naye; bahlasela uGedaliya, bambulala, nabo bonke abantu bakaYuda, nabaBhabheli ababenoye eMizpa.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu, ukusuka kuncinci kuye kukhulu, nabaphathi bemikhosi, babaleka baya eYiputa; ngokuba babemxhalabisa uBabiloniyo.

Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesithathu nesixhenxe wokuthatha uYoyakim ukumkani wakwaYuda, ngomhla wamabini asixhenxe wesixhenxe wenyanga yeshumi elinesibini, waba ngukumkani waseBhabheli uEvil-merodaki; ngaloo nyaka wamkhulula uYoyakim ukumkani wakwaYuda emgodini.
Wathetha naye ngothando, wamisa isitulo sakhe esiphakamileyo ngaphezu kwazo zonke izikumkani ezingumyeni wakhe eBhabheli.
Ke kaloku uYehoyakin wasusa iimpahla zakhe zokugxothwa; wayedla mihla le ekhitshini likakumkani zonke iintsuku zobomi bakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wamnika isonka sosuku ngalunye, zonke iintsuku zobomi bakhe.

AmaPathusi, namaKasluhhi; abaFilisti bavela kubo, nabaKaftorithi.

Waba ngutata wamaJebhusi, namaAmori, namaGirgasi,

nabaArvadi, nabaZemariti, nabaHamatiti.

iHadoram, iUzaal, iDihla,
uEbhali, noAbhimeleki, noSheba,
UOfiri, noHawila, noYobhab; abo bonke baba oonyana bakaYoktan.
Iintsapho zikaShem: uShem, noArpakshade, noShela,
uHebhere, noPelege, noRehu,
uSerugi, noNahore, noTera,
noAbram, obizwa ngokuba nguAbraham.
Oonyana bakaAbraham: uIsake noIshmayeli.
Leyo imbali yabo: unyana wokuqala ka-Ishmayeli nguNebayothi; noKedari, noAbediyele, noMibsham,
uMishma, noDuma, noMasa, noHadade, noTema,
UYethure, noNafishe, noKedema; banonyana bakaIshmayeli.
UKetura, umkakhe uAbraham, wamzala uZimrani, noYoksani, noMedan, noMidiyani, noIshbhaki, noShuha. Oonyana bakaYoksani: uSheba noDedan.
Oonyana bakaMidiyani: uEfa, noEfer, noHanok, noAbida, noEldaha; abo bonke babantwana bakaKetura.
UAbraham wamzala uIsake; oonyana bakaIsake nguEsau noSirayeli.
Oonyana bakaEsau: uElifazi, noRehuyeli, noYeushe, noYalam, noKora.
Oonyana bakaElifazi: nguTeman, noOmar, noZefi, noGatham, noKenaz, noTimna, noAmaleki.
Oonyana bakaRehuyeli: uNahati, noZera, noShama, noMiza.
Oonyana bakaSeire: uLotane, noShobhali, noTsibonitaki, noAna, noDishoni, noEseri, noDishani.
Oonyana bakaLotan nguHori noHomam; udade kaLotan nguTimna.
Oonyana bakaShobhali: uAliyan, noManahati, noEbali, noShefi, noOnam. Oonyana bakaSibeon: uAhiya noAna.
Unyana kaAna nguDishon; oonyana bakaDishon nguHamrane, noEshbani, noIthrani, noKerane.
Oonyana bakaEsere: uBhilehan, noZawan, noYaakan; oonyana bakaDishan: uUzi noAran.
Ke kaloku, aba ke ngabakumkani ababekumkani ezweni laseEdom, phambi kokuba kubekho ukumkani owayekumkani phezu kwabantwana bakaSirayeli: uBela, unyana kaBeore; igama lomzi wakhe lalinguDinhaba.
Wafa uBhelaya, waba ngukumkani emva kwakhe uYobhab unyana kaZera waseBozra.
Wafa ke uYobhab, waba ngukumkani emva kwakhe uHusham, wasezweni lamaTemani.
Wafa ke uHusham, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uHadade, unyana kaBedade. UHadade wabetha amaMidiyani ezweni laseMowabi; igama lomzi wakhe lalinguAviti.
UHa partage wafa satélite, waba ngukumkani uSamla eMasreka.
Wafa ke uSamla, waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe uSawule waseRehobhothi eMlambo.
Wafa uSawule, waba ngukumkani emva kwakhe uBhaale-hanana unyana kaAkhobore.
Wafa uBhaale-hanana, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe uHadade; igama lomzi wakhe nguPayi; umkakhe nguMehetabele intombi kaMatredi, intombi kaMezahabi.
Wafa ke uHadade. Abathetheli beentsapho zakwaEdom: nguTimna, noAliya, noYetheti,
iOholibyama, neEla, nePinoni,
i-Kenaz, i-Teman, i-Mibzar,
noMagdiyeli, noHiram; abo babe ngabathetheli baseEdom.
Ke kaloku ke oonyana bakaSirayeli: uRubhen, noShimeon, noLevi, noYuda, noIsayakare, noZabulon,
uDan, noYosefu, noBhenjamin, noNafetali, noGadi, noAshere.
Oonyana bakaYuda: uEri, noOnan, noShela; abo bathathu bazalwa ngumfazi waseKanan, intombi kaShuha. UEri, umzali-mkhulu kaYuda, wayebi phambi koYehova; ke yena iNkosi wambulala.
UTamari, intombi kaYuda, wamzala uPerezi noZera; bonke oonyana bakaYuda babelishumi.
Oonyana bakaPerezi: uHeshron noHamuli.
Oonyana bakaZera: uZimri, noEthan, noHeman, noKhalkoli, noDara, bobahlanu.
Unyana kaKarmi nguAhara, lowo wabangela ingxaki kuSirayeli, ngokutyhala izinto ezingcwele zikaThixo.
Unyana ka-Ethan nguAzariya.
Oonyana abazalwa nguHeshron: uYerameyeli, noRam, noKalebe.
URam waba ngumzali ka-Amminadab; u-Amminadab waba ngumzali kaNashon, umthetheli wamaYuda.
UNahshon waba ngumzali kaSalma; uSalma waba ngumzali kaBowazi.
UBowazi waba ngumzali kaObedi; uObedi waba ngumzali kaYese.
Unyana wokuqala kaYese nguEliyaba; unyana wakhe wesibini nguAbinabadi; unyana wakhe wesithathu nguShimeha;
wesixhenxe uNethaneli, wesisihlanu uRadai,
wesixhenxe nguOzem, wesixhenxe nguDavide.
Oodade wabo: uSeruhiya noAbhigayeli; oonyana bakaSeruhiya abathathu: uAbishai, noYowabhi, noAsaheli.
UAbhigayeli wayengumntwana kaAmasa; uyise kaAmasa waba nguYetere, umIshmayeli.
UKalebe, unyana kaHeshron, wazala oonyana ngoAzuba, indoda yakhe, noJeriyoti; oonyana bakaAzuba: nguYeshere, noShobhab, noArdon.
Wafa uAzuba, ke kaloku uKalebe wamzala uEfrata; waza wazala uHure.
UHure waba ngumzali kaUri, uUri waba ngumzali kaBesaleyeli.
Ke kaloku, xa uHeshron eneminyaka engamashumi asixhenxe ubudala, wamisa intombi kaMahiri, utata kaGiliyadi; wamzala uSegub.
USegub wazalelwa nguYaire, owayekumkani weedolophu ezimashumi mabini anesine ezweni laseGiliyadi.
Ke kaloku amaGeshuri namaAram athabathe izixeko zikaYaire, neKenathi needolophu zayo, ziidolophu ezimashumi amathandathu. Aba bantu bonke babe yimizana kaMakhire, uyise kaGiliyadi.
Ke kaloku, emva kokufa kukaHeshron eKalebhe-efratha, uAbiya umfazi wakhe wamzala uAshure; yena waba nguyise kaTekoya.
Oonyana bakaYerameyeli, umzali-mkhulu kaHeshron: nguRam umzali-mkhulu wakhe, noBuna, noOren, noOzem, noAhiya.
UYerameyeli wayenenkosikazi enye, igama layo nguAtara; yena utata kaOnam.
Oonyana bakaRam, umzali-mkhulu kaYerameyeli, nguMahazi, noYamini, noEkere.
Oonyana bakaOnam: uShamai noYada; oonyana bakaShamai: uNadab noAbishuri.
Igama lomkakhe uAbhishuri nguAbihayeli; wazala uAhbane noMolide.
Oonyana bakaNadabhi: uShelede noAphayim. UShelede wafa, engabantwana.
Unyana ka-Apayim nguIshi; unyana ka-Ishi nguShetaki; unyana ka-Shetaki nguAhali.
Oonyana bakaYada, umzalwana kaShamai, nguYetere noYonatan. Wafa ke uYetere angabakho abantwana.
Oonyana bakaYonatan: uPeleti, noZaza; abo babantwana bakaYerahmeyeli.
USheshan akazange abe nabantwana amadodana, abe neentombi kuphela. Wabe nomsebenzi waseYiputa, igama lakhe lalinguYarha.
USheshan wamnika uYarha, umkhonzi wakhe, intombi yakhe ukuba ibe ngumfazi wakhe; waza wazala uAtayi.
UAtayi waba nguyise kaNathani; uNathani waba nguyise kaZabadi.
UZabadi waba nguyise ka-Eflali; uEflali waba nguyise kaObedi.
UObedi waba ngumzali kaYehu; uYehu waba ngumzali kaUzari.
UAzariya waba ngumzali kaHelezi; uHelezi waba ngumzali kaEleasa.
UEleasa waba nguyise kaShishmai; uShishmai waba nguyise kaShalum.
UShalum waba ngumzali kaYekamiya; uYekamiya waba ngumzali kaElishama.
Oonyana bakaKalebe, umzalwana kaYerameyeli, nguMesha umkhuluwa wakhe; yena waba nguyise kaZife; noMaresha unyana wakhe waba nguyise kaHebron.
Oonyana bakaHebhere: uKorha, noTaphuya, noRekem, noShema.
UShema waba nguyise kaRaham, uyise kaYorkeyam; uRekem waba nguyise kaShamai.
Unyana kaShamai nguMahoni; uMahoni waba nguyise kaBhethu-suru.
UEfa, umkakhe kaKalebe, wamzala uHaran, noMoza, noGazeze; uHaran waba nguyise kaGazeze.
Oonyana bakaYahadi: uRegem, noYothan, noGeshan, noPelet, noEfa, noShafe.
UMahaka, umyenikazi kaKalebe, wamzala uShebere noTirhana.
Wazala ke uShafa, utata kaMadmana, noSheva, utata kaMakbena neGibeha. Unyana kaKalebe waba nguAksha.
Oonyana bakaHure, umzali-mkhulu kaEfrata: nguShobhali ubaba kaKiriyati-yearimi; nguSobale ubaba kaKirihati-yearimi;
noSalma unyana kaBethelehemu, noHarefe unyana kaBhethe-gadere.
Oonyana bakaShobhali, utata kaKiriyati-yearimi: nguHarowe, nengxenye yabantu bakaMenuhothi.
Amaqela aseKiriyati-yearimi: amaYithrithi, namaPhuti, namaShumati, namaMishraithi; abantu baseTsora naseEshtaoli bavela kumaqela lalawo.
Oonyana bakaSalma: abantu baseBetheleyimu, nabaNetofati, neAtrothi-bhethe-yowabhi, nesiqingatha samaManahati, nabaseZori.
Iinkundla zababhali abahlala eYabhesi: amaTirathi, namaShimeathi, namaSukhathi. Lowo nguKeni osuka kuHamathi, utata wendlu yamaRekabhi.
Ke kaloku ke oonyana bakaDavide abazalwa kuye eHebron: umkhulu wakhe ngu-Amnon, owaziwa ngokuba nguAhinoam waseYizreyeli; wesithathu nguDaniyeli, owaziwa ngokuba ngu-Abihayeli waseKarmele.
wesithathu uAbhisalom, owazalwa nguMahaka intombi kaTalmai ukumkani waseGeshuri; wesixhenxe uAdoniya, owazalwa nguHagithi.
wesihlanu nguShefatiya, umzali wakhe uAbital; wesixhenxe nguItreyam, umzali wakhe uEgla, indoda kaDavide.
Aba bane bazalwa nguDavide eHebron, apho waba ngukumkani iminyaka esixhenxe neentsuku ezisixhenxe; waza waba ngukumkani eYerusalem iminyaka engamashumi mathathu anesihlanu.
Abantwana abazalwa kuye eYerusalem nguShimeya, noShobhab, noNatan, noSolomon; umzali wabo wayenguBhatshuwa intombi ka-Amiyeli. Bambini ke abo bane.
Kwabakho noIbhare, noElishama, noElifeleti,
uNoha, noNefegi, noYafiya,
uElishama, noEliyada, noElifelethe; aba bathoba.
Abo bonke baba oonyana bakaDavide, ngaphandle koonyana beziqhamo zakhe; uTamari wayengumyeni wabo.
Unyana kaSolomon nguRehobhowam; unyana kaRehobhowam nguAbiya; unyana kaAbiya nguAsa; unyana kaAsa nguYosafati.
Unyana kaJehoshafati nguYoram; unyana kaYoram nguAhaziya; unyana kaAhaziya nguYowashe.
Unyana kaYowashe nguAmasiya; unyana kaAmasiya nguAzariya; unyana kaAzariya nguYotham.
Unyana kaYotam nguAhazi; unyana kaAhazi nguHezekiya; unyana kaHezekiya nguManase.
Unyana kaManase nguAmon; unyana kaAmon nguYosiya.
Oonyana bakaYosiya: uYohhanan umzali omkhulu, noYehoyakim wesithathu, noZedekiya wesithathu, noShalumu wesine.
Oonyana bakaYoyakim: uJekoniya unyana wakhe, noZedekiya unyana wakhe.
Oonyana bakaJekoniya, owathathwa ebantwini: uShelatiyeli unyana wakhe;
noMalkhiram, noPedaya, noShenazare, noYekamiya, noHoshama, noNedabiya.
Oonyana bakaPedaya nguZerubhayele noShimeyi; oonyana bakaZerubhayele nguMeshulam noHananiya; uShelomith udade wabo.
UZerubhabele wayenabantwana abahlanu: uHashubha, noOheli, noBherekiya, noHasadiya, noYushabhe-hesede.
Oonyana bakaHananiya: uPelatiya, noYeshaya, oonyana bakaRefaya, oonyana bakaArnan, oonyana bakaObadiya, oonyana bakaShekaniya.
Unyana kaShekaniya nguShemaya; oonyana bakaShemaya abasithandathu: uHatushe, noIgali, noBariya, noNearya, noShafati.
Oonyana bakaNehariya abathathu: uEliyenai, noHezekiya, noAzrikam.
Oonyana bakaEliyoyenayi ababini: uHodaviya, noEliyasibhi, noPelaya, noAkubu, noYohanan, noDelaya, noAnani.
Oonyana bakaYuda: uPerezi, noHeshron, noKarmi, noHure, noShobale.
URehaya unyana kaShobale waba ngumzali kaYahati; uYahati waba ngumzali kaAhumayi, noLahadi. Ezi ziifama zabaSorathini.
Oonyana bakaEtam, utata kaEtam: nguYezreyeli, noIshma, noIdbhashe; igama lodade wabo lalinguHazelelponi.
UPhenuyeli waba nguyise kaGedore, uEzere waba nguyise kaHusha; abo babantwana bakaHure, umzali-ntsapho kaEfrata, waba nguyise kaBetheleyimu.
UAshhur, utata kaTekoa, wayeneentombi ezimbini: nguHela noNahara.
UNahara wamzala uAhuzam, noHefer, noTemani, noHahastari. Abo babantwana bakaNahara.
Oonyana bakaHela: uZerethi, noIshar, noEthana.
UHakosi waba nguyise ka-Anubhi, noZobhebha; uHakosi waba nguyise weemfazwe zika-Aharheli unyana kaHarum.
Ke kaloku uYabheze waba mkhulu kunabazalwana bakhe. Umama wakhe wamnika igama elithi Yabheze, esithi, Ndimzalile ngobuhlungu.

Wathandaza ke uYabhesi kuThixo wakwaSirayeli, esithi, Ndicela, ndibhaptize, ndikunike ilizwe elininzi; isandla sakho sibe nam, ndisandise isisu sam, ndingabi neentlungu. UThixo wamnika loo nto ayifumeneyo.
UKelub, unyana kaShuha, waba nguyise kaMehiri; yena waba nguyise kaEshton.
U-Eshton waba ngumzali kaBhethrafa, noPaseha, noTehina, umzali ka-Ir-nahashe. Abo bamadoda aseReka.
Oonyana bakaKenazi nguOthniyeli noSeraya; unyana kaOthniyeli nguHathathi.
UMeonothai waba nguyise kaOfra; uSeraya waba nguyise kaYowabhi, owasungula iGha-harashim, eNtshona yeSixeko samaNgqina; ngokuba abantu bayo babeziingcali.
Oonyana bakaKalebe, unyana kaYefune: nguIru, noEla, noNaham; unyana kaEla nguKenaz.
Oonyana bakaYehaleleli: uZife, noSifa, noTiriya, noAsareyeli.
Oonyana bakaEzra: uYetere, noMerede, noEfere, noYalon; omnye wabafazi bakaMerede wazala uMiriyam, noShamai, noIshbha, utata ka-Eshtemoa.
Umfazi wakhe waseYuda wamzala uYerede, utata kaGedore, noHebhere, utata kaSoko, noJekutiyeli, utata kaZanoa; abo ke baba oonyana bakaBitiya, intombi kaFaro, owamnika indodana uMerede.
Oonyana bakaHodiya, umfazi kaNaham, umzalwana wakhe: aba ooyise bakaKehila waseGarmi, noEshtemoa waseMaakathi.
Oonyana bakaShimoni: uAmnon, noRina, noBhehanan, noTilon; oonyana bakaIshi: uZohete, noBhenote.
Oonyana bakaShela, unyana kaYuda, nguEr, utata kaLeka, noLadetha, utata kaMaresha, neentsapho zabasebenzi belinen eBhete-ashbheya.
Ke kaloku uYokim, namadoda aseKozebha, noYowashe, noSarafe, abalawulayo eMowabhi, noYashubi-Lehem. Ezi zinto zivela kumaxesha amandulo kakhulu.
Baye ke abo abakhonzi bentsimbi, ababehlala eNethaim naseGedera; babehlala khona, basebenzela ukumkani.
Oonyana bakaSimeon: nguNemuyeli, noYamini, noYaribe, noZera, noShaule.
Unyana kaSawule nguShalum; unyana kaShalum nguMibsham; unyana kaMibsham nguMisma.
Oonyana bakaMishma: uHamuyeli unyana wakhe, noZakhuri unyana kaHamuweli, noShimehi unyana kaZakhuri.
UShimeyi waba neentombi ezilishumi elinamithandathu, neendodana ezine. Abazalwana bakhe ke babengenabantwana abaninzi; isini sabo sonke asizange sikhule njengesizukulwana sikaYuda.
Bahlala eBher-shebha, neMolada, neHazari-shuali,
uBhileha, noEzem, noTolade,
noBethuyeli, neHorma, neSiklagi,
IBhete-markabhothi, neHazari-sushim, neBhete-biri, neShaaraim; ezi ziidolophu zabo, de waba ngukumkani uDavide.
Iidolophu zabo zazi: iEtam, neAyin, neRimon, neToken, neAshan; ziidolophu ezintlanu;
nazo zonke iidolophu ezijikeleze la madolophu, ukuya eBhaali. Ezi ziyindawo abahlala kuzo; bagcina iincwadi zeentsapho zabo.
uMeshobhabi, noJamleki, noYosha unyana kaAmasiya,
uYoweli, noYehu unyana kaYosibiya, unyana kaSeraya, unyana kaAsiyeli;
uEliyonayi, noYakobi, noYeshohaya, noAsaya, noAdiyele, noYesimiyeli, noBhenaya,
noZiza unyana kaShifi, unyana kaAloni, unyana kaYedaya, unyana kaShimri, unyana kaShemaya.
Abo madoda, abizwa ngegama labo, babe ziintloko zeentsapho zabo; iintsapho zazo zakhula kakhulu.
Baye ke bahamba, bafika ekungeneni kweGedori, kwelasempumalanga yelali, befuna ukutya kwazo iinkomo zabo.
Bafumane khona ukutya okutyebileyo, okulungileyo; ilizwe ke libanzi, liphumle, likhululekile. Kwabakho abantu abathile baseHami babehlala apho ngaphambili.

Ke kaloku abo madoda abhaliweyo ngamagama, bafika ngemihla kaHezekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda; bahlasela amaHamiti eentlango zabo, nabaMeunithi abahlala khona, babulala bonke, njengangoku; bafudukela endaweni yabo; kuba kukho khona indawo yokuzala iinkomo zabo.
Ngabo ooSimeoni, amakhulu amahlanu aye ezweni eliphakamileyo laseSeiri; abathetheli babo nguPelatiya, noNearya, noRefaya, noUziyele, oonyana bakaIshi.
Bawabulala abo baseleyo, abathunyelwe kuAmaleki; babehlala khona kude kube namhlanje.

Ke kaloku aba oonyana bakaRubhen, umzali-ntsapho kaSirayeli; kuba yena wayengumzali-ntsapho; kodwa ngenxa yokuba wadibana nomnye wabafazi bakayise, ilungelo lakhe lokuzalwa komzali-ntsapho lanikezelwa oonyana bakaYosefu, unyana kaSirayeli; ngoko ke uRubhen akabhaliswanga phakathi kwabazala-ntsapho njengomkhulu.
Ke kaloku uYuda waba mkhulu kunabazalwana bakhe, waphuma kuye umlawuli; kodwa ilungelo lokuqala kwaba nguYosefu.
Oonyana bakaRubhen, umzali-mkhulu kaSirayeli: nguEnoki, noPalu, noHeshron, noKarmi.
Oonyana bakaYoweli: uShemaya unyana wakhe, noGoge unyana kaShemaya, noShimeyi unyana kaGoge,
uMika unyana kaShimehi, uRehaya unyana kaMika, uBhaali unyana kaRehaya,
noBhera unyana kaBhahali. UTiglathi-pilesere, ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, wathabatha uBhera waba ngukumkani wesizwe sikaRubhen.
Abazalwana bakhe, ngokweedolophu zabo, ngokubhaliweyo kweentsapho zazo: uJeyeli umlawuli, noZekariya,
noBela unyana ka-Aza, unyana kaShema, unyana kaYoweli; babehlala kuloo ndawo isuka eAroere, bafike eNebo noBhaali-meon.
Ngasemzantsi, bafudukela ezweni lasentshonalanga, besiya esiphelweni sesiqithi esiphakamileyo, esiseMlambo iEfrayim; ngokuba izimvu zabo zazikhulu kakhulu kunelizwe laseGiliyadi.
Ke kaloku, xa uSawule wayekumkani, baye bahlasela amaHagari, bababulala; babehlala etentlanganiseni kwamaHagari, kuwo onke amacala oMzantsi-mpuma kaGiliyadi.
Ke kaloku isizwe samaGadi sahlala ecaleni kwabo, ezweni laseBhashani, ukuya eSaleka.
UYoweli wayeyintloko, uShafam wayeyisibini, noYanani noShafati eBhashani.
Abazalwana babo, ngokweentsapho zabo: uMikayeli, noMeshulam, noSheba, noYorai, noYakan, noZiha, noHebhere, bonke abalishumi elinambini.
Baye ke oonyana bakaAbhihayeli, unyana kaHuri, unyana kaYaroha, unyana kaGiliyadi, unyana kaMikayeli, unyana kaYeshishayi, unyana kaYaho, unyana kaBuzi.
UAhi unyana kaAbdiyeli, unyana kaGuni, waba ngukumkani weentsapho zabo.
Bahlala eGiliyadi, naseBhashan, needolophu zayo, nazo zonke izixeko ezikufuphi neSaron, nalapho bafika khona.
Bonke aba babhalwe kwincwadi yeentsapho, ngemihla kaYotam ukumkani wakwaYuda, noYaroboham ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.

AbakwaRubhen, nabakwaGadi, nengxenye yesizukulwana sikaManase, babe ngamawaka anamanci mane anamakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci amathandathu, abalungiselelwe ukulwa; babe ngamadoda anamandla, aphatha iiglavu neekrele, emisa umqolo, aqeqeshiweyo emkhosini.
Baya kulwa nabaHagari, noYeturu, noNafishe, noNodabhi.
Wabanceda ke uThixo emfazweni, wabanikela phambi kwabo abaHagarithi, nabo bonke abaxhasayo; ngenxa yokuba bathandaza kuThixo emfazweni; waza waphendula, ngenxa yokuba babethembela kuye.
Bathabathe iinkomo zamaHagari, amawaka amashumi amahlanu, neenkomo ezimakhulu mabini, amawaka alishumi elinambini, neebhokhwe zamawaka amabini; bathabathe namadoda amawaka amakhulu amabini.
Bafa abathunywa abaninzi, ngokuba umkhosi wawunguThixo. Bahlala kuloo lizwe, de bathathelwe ebantwini bemi.
Ke kaloku abantu besiqithi esiphakathi sikaManase bahlala kuloo lizwe; baba makhulu, basasazeka ukususela eBhashani ukuya eBhaali-Hermon, noSenire, nomnxweme weHermon.

Ke kaloku, aba ngamadoda amakhulu eentsapho zabo: uEfer, noIshi, noEliyeli, noAzriyeli, noYeremiya, noHodaviya, noYadiyeli; abo bamadoda anamandla okulwa, amadoda anegama, amadoda amakhulu eentsapho zabo.
Ke kaloku baphulaphule kakubi uThixo wabafazi babo, balandela amadini eentlanga zaleyo lizwe, abo uThixo awazibulala phambi kwabo.

Ke kaloku uThixo wakwaSirayeli wavusa uPhu, ukumkani waseAshuri, (igama lakhe nguTiglathi-pilesere, ukumkani waseAshuri); wabathwala ebantwini ooRubhen noGadi, nesiqingatha sesiqithi sikaManase; wawathabatha waya eHala, naseHabori, naseHara, nomlambo waseGozani, de kube kuloo mini.
Oonyana bakaLevi: uGershoni, noKehati, noMerariya.
Oonyana bakaKehati: uAmram, noIshar, noHebron, noUziyele.
Oonyana bakaAmram: uAron, noMoses, noMiryam; oonyana bakaAron: uNadabhi, noAbihu, noElezare, noIthamari.
UElezare waba ngumzali kaPheneha; uPheneha waba ngumzali kaAbhishuwa.
UAbhishuwa waba nguyise kaBhukuki; uBhukuki waba nguyise kaUzi.
UUzi waba ngumzali kaZerahiya; uZerahiya waba ngumzali kaMerayothi.
UMerayothi waba ngumzali kaAmariya; uAmariya waba ngumzali kaAhitubhi.
UAhitubhi wazalelwa nguSadoki; uSadoki wazalelwa nguAhimaase.
UAhimaase waba ngumzali kaUzari; uUzari waba ngumzali kaYohanan.
Ke kaloku uYohanan waba ngumzali kaAzariya, owayengumbingeleli endlwini kaSolomon, eyayiseYerusalem.
UAzariya waba ngumzali kaAmariya; uAmariya waba ngumzali kaAhitubhi.
UAhitubhi wazalelwa nguSadoki; uSadoki wazalelwa nguShalum.
UShalum waba ngumzali kaHilkiya; uHilkiya waba ngumzali kaUzari.
UAzariya waba ngumzali kaSeraya; uSeraya waba ngumzali kaYosadaki.
Ke kaloku uYosadaki wathathwa waba ngugqirha, xa iNkosi ethumela abantu bakaYuda nabaseYerusalem ukuba bathunyelwe emkhosini ngesandla sikaNebhukadenesa.
Oonyana bakaLevi: uGershoni, noKehati, noMerari.
Lawona amagama oonyana bakaGershoni: uLibni noShimehi.
Oonyana bakaKehati: uAmram, noIshar, noHebron, noUziyele.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uMaheli noMushi. Ezi ziintsapho zakwaLevi, ngokweentsapho zabo.
Oonyana bakaGershoni: uLibni unyana wakhe, noYahati unyana kaLibni, noZima unyana kaYahati,
uYowa unyana kaZima, noIdo unyana kaYowa, noZera unyana kaZera, noYeterayi unyana kaZera.
Oonyana bakaKehati: uAmini-hadabi unyana wakhe, noKore unyana kaAmminadab, noAsire unyana kaKore,
uElkana unyana ka-Asiri, noEbhiyasaf unyana ka-Elkana, noAsiri unyana ka-Ebiyasaf,
noTahati unyana kaAsiri, noUriyeli unyana kaTahati, noUziya unyana kaUriya, noSawule unyana kaUsiya.
Oonyana bakaElkana: nguAmasai noAhimothi.
Oonyana bakaElkana: uZofay unyana wakhe, noNahati unyana kaZofay,
UEliyaba unyana kaNahati, noYeroham unyana kaEliyaba, noElkana unyana kaYeroham.
Oonyana bakaSamuweli: uYoweli, umzali wakhe omkhulu; noAbhiya, omnye.
Oonyana bakaMerari: uMaheli, noLibni unyana kaMaheli, noShimehi unyana kaShimehi, noUza unyana kaShimehi;
noShimeya unyana kaUza, noHagiya unyana kaShimeya, noAsaya unyana kaHagiya.
Ke kaloku aba ke abo uDavide wababeka phezu kweengoma endlwini kaYehova, emva kokuba isithunywa sithathe indawo yokuhlala khona.
Babesebenza bengoma phambi kwetabernakele, itentile yokuhlangana, de kube uSolomon elungiselela indlu kaYehova eYerusalem; babesenza umsebenzi wabo ngokwahlukeneyo, ngokwemimiselo yabo.
Ke kaloku abo amadoda akhonzayo, nabo oonyana babo: kusapho lwakwaKehati nguHeman umculi; yena unyana kaYoweli, unyana kaSamuweli;
unyana kaElkana, unyana kaYeroham, unyana kaEliyeli, unyana kaToha,
unyana kaSufe, unyana kaElkana, unyana kaMahati, unyana kaAmasayi,
unyana kaElkana, unyana kaYoweli, unyana kaAzariya, unyana kaZefaniya,
unyana kaTahati, unyana kaAsiri, unyana kaEbyashafi, unyana kaKora;
unyana kaIshar, unyana kaKahati, unyana kaLevi, unyana kaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uAsaphe, umzalwana kaHeman, wayesekunene kwakhe; uAsaphe ngunyana kaBerekiya, unyana kaShimea,
unyana kaMikayeli, unyana kaBhasheya, unyana kaMalhiya,
unyana kaEthni, unyana kaZera, unyana kaAdayiya,
unyana kaEthan, unyana kaZima, unyana kaShimehi,
unyana kaYahati, unyana kaGershoni, unyana kaLevi.
Ngasekhohlo kukaHeman babemi abazalwana babo, abakwindlu yamaMerari; uEthan unyana kaKishi, unyana kaAbdi, unyana kaMaluku, waba ngukumkani wabo.
unyana kaHashabiya, unyana kaAmasiya, unyana kaHilkiya,
unyana ka-Amsi, unyana ka-Bani, unyana ka-Shemere,
unyana kaMaheli, unyana kaMushi, unyana kaMerari, unyana kaLevi.
Abazalwana babo, amaLevi, babe nemisebenzi yonke yendlu kaThixo emnqamlezweni.

Ke kaloku uAron nonyana bakhe banikela ngeempawu phezu kwesibingelelo sesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, batshisa umnquba phezu kwesibingelelo sesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, besenza umsebenzi wonke wendawo engcwele kakhulu, besenza ubulungisa phakathi kwabaSirayeli; njengoko uMoses umkhonzi kaThixo abewisela umthetho.
Aba oonyana baka-Aron: uElezare, unyana wakhe; uPhenehasi, unyana kaPhenehasi; uAbishuwa, unyana kaPhenehasi;
uBhukuki unyana ka-Abishuwa, uUzi unyana ka-Bhukuki, uZerahiya unyana ka-Uzi,
uMerayothi unyana kaZerahiya, noAmariya unyana kaMerayotaki, noAhitubhi unyana kaAmariya,
noSadoko unyana ka-Ahitubhi, noAhimahazi unyana ka-Ahitubhi.
Ezi ziyindawo zabahlala kuzo oonyana baka-Aron, izixeko eziphakathi kwelizwe labo. Inxalenye yokuqala yanikezelwa kusapho lwakwaKahati, oonyana baka-Aron, ngokuqhutywa kwesiqhamo.
Yabanikezelwa iHebron, ezweni likaYuda, kunye neendawo zayo ezingqongileyo.
Ke izityalo, nezidolophu ezijikeleze lo mzi, zanikezelwa kuKalebe unyana kaYefune.
Wabanika oonyana baka-Aron iHebron, umzi wokhuselo, noLibna, neYatiri, neEshtemoa, ngazo zonke izixeko eziphakathi kwazo;
iHilen, neDebiri, ngazo zonke izityalo zazo;
neAshan, neBhethe-shemeshi, ngazo zonke izityalo zazo.
Kwisizwe sikaBhenjamin: iGibeha, neAlemeti, neAnathothi; ngazo zonke iintsapho zakwaKehati izixeko ezilishumi elinamathathu.
Amanye oonyana bakaKehati, bafumana ngesandla sabo, ezidolophini ezilishumi, ezisuka kusapho lwesiqingatha sesizukulwana sikaManase.
Oonyana bakaGershoni, ngokweefama zabo, bafumana ezidolophini ezilishumi elinambini, ezisuka kwisizukulwana sika-Issakare, naseAshere, naseNafetali, nakwinxalenye yesizukulwana sikaManase eBhashani.
Oonyana bakaMerariya, ngokwesizwe samaSirayeli, ngazo izixeko ezilishumi elinambini, zisuka kwisizukulwana sikaRubhen, nesizukulwana sikaGadi, nesizukulwana sikaZebulon.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli babanika amaLevi la madolophu namachibi abo.
Babanika ngeepilisi ezi dolophu zithe zathiwa ngamagama, ezisuka kwisizwe sikaYuda noSimeon noBhenjamin.
Ezinye iintsapho zakwaKehati zafumana imimandla esuka kwisizwe sikaEfrataki.
Yabanika iShekem, umzi wokhuselo, ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim, neGezere, ngazo zonke izixeko eziphakathi kwazo;
iYokmeyam, neBhathi-horoni, ngazo zonke izityalo zazo;
neAyaloni, neGati-rimmoni; nganye yazo iintaba zayo.
Ezinye iintsapho zakwaKehati zafumana, engxenyeni yesizukulwana sikaManase, uAner noBhileham, ngazo zonke iintaba zayo.
Abantwana bakaGershoni bafumana ezi dolophu: Kusapho lwesiqingatha sesizwe sikaManase, iGolan eBhashani, neAshtarothi, ngazo zonke izixeko eziphakathi kwazo.
Kwisizwe sika-Issakare: iKedesh, neDaberati, ngazo zonke izixeko zayo eziphakathi;
neRamoti, neAnem; nganye yazo iintaba zayo.
Kwisizwe sika-Asere: iMashali, neAbdon, ngazo zonke izixeko eziphakathi kwazo;
neHukok, neRehobhi, ngazo zonke izityalo zayo.
Kwisizwe sikaNafetali: iKedesh eGalili, neHamoni, neKiriyatayim; nganye yazo neendawo zayo eziphakathi.
Amanye amaLevi, oonyana bakaMerari, bafumana la madolophu: ukusuka kwisixeko sikaZabulon, iRimono, neThaboro, nganye nendawo yayo yokudada.
Kwisizwe samaRubhen, ngasemzantsi-mpuma womlambo iYorodani, ecaleni kweYeremiya: iBezer entlango, neYahaza, ngazo zonke izixeko eziphakathi kwayo;
neKedemothi, neMefaathi, ngazo zonke izityalo zazo.
Kwisizwe sikaGadi: iRamoti eGiliyadi, neMahanayim; ngazo zonke izixeko eziphakathi kwazo;
neHeshbon, neYaser, nganye yazo nezityalo zayo.
Oonyana baka-Isakare babelishumi elinambini: nguThola, noPuha, noYashubhe, noShimron.

Oonyana bakaTola: uUzi, noRefaya, noYereyeli, noYamai, noYibsham, noShemuyele. Baye ngamadoda amakhulu eentsapho zabo, kusapho lukaTola, abemi abanobuchule bokulwa. Imihla kaDavide, inani labo elibhalwa ngobomi babo kwaba ngamawaka amashumi amabini anesibini anamakhulu amathandathu.
Unyana ka-Uzi nguIzrahiya; oonyana baka-Izrahiya nguMikayeli, noObhadiya, noYoweli, noYishiya. Bonke abahlanu babe ngabakhulu.
Bathi, ngokweziqu zabo, babe ngamawaka amashumi mathathu anesithandathu, abantu abalungiselelwe ukulwa; ngokuba babaninzi amadoda nabantwana.
Abazalwana babo, kubo bonke oonyana baka-Issakare, amadoda anamandla okulwa; bonke ababhalwa ngokweefama zabo bamashumi asibhozo anesixhenxe amawaka.
UBhenjamin waba neenonyana abathathu: nguBela, noBekere, noYediyayeli.

Oonyana bakaBhelaya babelishumi: nguEshon, noUzi, noUziyeli, noJerimothi, noIri; aba bamadoda amakhulu eentsapho zabo, amadoda anamandla okulwa. Amadoda amakhulu abo, abemi bemfazwe, waba ngamawaka amabini anamanci mathathu anamashumi mane anesihlanu.
Oonyana bakaBekere: uZemira, noYowashe, noEliyezere, noEliyoyenayi, noOmri, noYeremote, noAbhiya, noAnathoti, noAlemete. Abo bonke babe oonyana bakaBekere.
Ababhali beentsapho zabo, abezikhulu zeentsapho zabo, babe ngamawaka angamashumi amabini anamakhulu mabini, amadoda amakhulu.
Unyana kaYediyayeli nguBhilehan; oonyana bakaBhelehan: uYeush, noBenjamin, noEhud, noKenana, noZethan, noTarshishi, noAhisahare.
Bonke abo oonyana bakaYediyayeli, abathetheli beenkundla zeentsapho zabo; babe ngamawaka angamashumi asixhenxe anesibhozo anamakhulu amabini, amadoda anamandla okulwa, ephuma emkhosini.
UShuphim noHuphim babe yindodana ka-Ire; uHushim waba ngunyana ka-Ahere.
Oonyana bakaNafetali: uYahaziyeli, noGuni, noYezere, noShalum; abo babantwana bakaBhila.
Oonyana bakaManase: uAsriyeli, owazalwa ngumfazi wakhe wesifazane waseAram; waza wazala noMakhire, utata kaGiliyadi.
Ke kaloku uMakhire wathabatha indoda yakwaHuppim, nakwaShuppim; igama lenkosikazi yakhe lalinguMahaka; elinye igama lakhe lalinguTselofehadi; wayenabantwana abafazi.
UMahaka, umfazi kaMakhire, wazala unyana, wathi igama lakhe nguPereshi; igama lonyana wakhe nguSheresh; oonyana bakhe nguUlam noRakem.
Unyana ka-Ulam nguBedan. Baye ke aba oonyana bakaGiliyadi, unyana kaMahiri, unyana kaManase.
UHamolekhethi, udade kaGiliyadi, wamzala uIshoditaki, noAbiezeri, noMahala.
Oonyana bakaShemida: uAhiya, noShekem, noLikhi, noAniyam.
Oonyana bakaEfrayim: uShutela unyana wakhe, noBherede unyana kaShutela, noTahati unyana kaBerede, noEleada unyana kaTahati, noTahati unyana kaEleada,
UZabhade unyana kaTahati, noShutela unyana kaZabhade; oonyana bakaEfrayim, uEzere noEleade, babulawa ngabantu baseGati abazalwa kuloo lizwe, xa bephuma ukuba bathabathe iinkomo zabantu.
UEfrayim, uyise wabo, wabalindile iintsuku ezininzi; bafika abahlobo bakhe bamxolisa.
Ke kaloku wabuyela waya kumkakhe; waza wakhulelwa, waza wazala unyana; wathi igama lakhe nguBeriya, ngokuba kwafika ingxaki endlwini yakhe.
Unyana kaEfrayim uShera; wakhiwa nguShera iBhete-horon esezantsi, neBet-horon esephezulu, noUtsen-Shera.
Oonyana bakaBeriya: uRefa unyana wakhe, noReshefe unyana kaRefa, noTela unyana kaReshefe, noTahan unyana kaTela,
uLadani unyana kaTahani, uAmihudi unyana kaLadani, uElishama unyana kaAmmihudi,
noNun unyana kaElishama, noYoshuwa unyana kaNun.
Ilizwe labo, nezixeko zabo, kwaba yiBheteli needolophu zayo, neNaaran emazantsi, neGezere needolophu zayo emazantsi, neShekem needolophu zayo, ukuya eAza needolophu zayo.
Ngapha komda kaManase: iBhethe-shean, neThaanake, neMegidido, neDore, nezixeko zazo; oonyana bakaYosefu unyana kaSirayeli bahlala kuloo mimandla.
Oonyana baka-Asere: uImna, noIsva, noIsvi, noBeriya; uSera ngudade wabo.
Oonyana bakaBeriya: uHebhere, noMalkiyeli; lo nguyise kaBirhathi.
UHebhere waba ngumzali kaYaflethi, noShomere, noHothame, noShuha udade wabo.
Oonyana bakaYaflethi: uPasha, noBimhali, noAshwati. Abo babantwana bakaYaflethi.
Oonyana bakaShomere: uAhi, noRoha, noHubha, noAram.
Oonyana bakaHelem, umzalwana wakhe: uSofa, noImna, noSheleshe, noAmali.
Oonyana bakaSofa: uShuha, noHarnefere, noShuhali, noBheri, noImra,
noBesere, noHode, noShama, noShilesha, noIthrane, noBhera.
Oonyana bakaYetere: uJefune, noPispa, noAra.
Oonyana bakaUla: uAraha, noHaniyeli, noRisiya.

Baye bonke oonyana baka-Asere; babe ziintloko zeentsapho, abemi abanobuchule bokulwa, abathetheli bezinto ezibalulekileyo. Iinkokheli zabo zaba ngamawaka amashumi amabini anesithandathu, alungele ukulwa.
Unyana wokuqala kaBhenjamin waba nguBela; wesibini waba nguAshbele; wesithathu waba nguAhara;
uNoha wesixhenxe, noRafa wesihlanu.
Oonyana bakaBela: uAdare, noGera, noAbihude,
noAbhishuha, noNaman, noAhoha,
noGera, noShefufan, noHiram.
Ke kaloku ke oonyana baka-Ehudi, abemi eGibeha, abakhulu beentsapho zabo, abathunyelwe eManahati:
UNamane, noAhiya, noGera; uGera waba yinxalenye yabo, xa behamba; yena wazalwa nguUza noAhihu.
Ke kaloku uShaharayim wazala abantwana ezweni laseMowabhi, emva kokuba ashiye ooHushim noBhara, amadodana akhe.
Wazalelwa nguHodeshe, umfazi wakhe, uYobhabhi, noTsiba, noMesha, noMalkham,
UYehuzi, noShakiya, noMirma; abo ke babe ziintsapho zeentsapho zamadodana akhe.
UHushim wamzala uAbitub noElpaali.
Oonyana baka-Elpaali: uHebhere, noMisham, noShemede. UShemede wakhiwa iOno, neLodi, nezixeko zazo.
UBeriya noShema babe ngamadoda amakhulu eentsapho ezihlala eAyaloni; bakhupha abantu baseGati.
uAhiyo, noShashaki, noYeremote,
uZebadia, noArad, noEdere,
UMikayeli, noIshpa, noYoha: oonyana bakaBheri.
uZebadia, noMeshulam, noHezekiya, noHebhere,
Oonyana bakaElpaali nguIshmerai, noIzliya, noYobhab.
noYakim, noZikri, noZabdi,
uEliyeni, noZilletayi, noEliyeli,
Oonyana bakaShimeyi: uAdaya, noBheraya, noShimrathi.
uIshan, noHebhere, noEliyeli,
noAbdon, noZikri, noHanani,
uHananiya, noElam, noAnothiya,
Oonyana bakaShashaki: uYifediya noFanuyeli.
uShamsherai, noShehariya, noAthaliya,
UYareshiya, noEliyahu, noZikri: oonyana bakaYeroham.
Abo bonke babe ziintloko zeentsapho, ngokweziqu zabo ezibhaliweyo; babe ngabathetheli; bahlala eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku uYeyeli, utata kaGibeyon, wayehlala eGibeyon; igama lomkakhe lalinguMahaka.
Unyana wakhe wokuqala uAbdon; abanye oonyana bakhe nguTsuri, noKishi, noBhaali, noNadab,
uGedori, noAhiyo, noZekere,
noMiklothi, unyana kaShimeha; nabo ke bahlala phantsi kwabazalwana babo eYerusalem.
UNere waba ngumzali kaKishi; uKishi waba ngumzali kaSawule; uSawule waba ngumzali kaYonatan, noMalkishishuwa, noAbinabadi, noEshbhayeli.
Unyana kaYonatan nguMerebhi-bhaali; uMerebhi-bhaali wayengumntwana kaMika.
Oonyana bakaMika: uPithon, noMeleki, noTareya, noAhaze.
UAhazi waba ngumzali kaYehoyada; uYehoyada waba ngumzali kaAlemeti, noAzmawete, noZimri; uZimri waba ngumzali kaMoza.
UMoza waba ngumntwana kaBineya; unyana kaBineya nguRafa; unyana kaRafa nguEleasa; unyana kaEleasa nguAsele.
Ke kaloku uAseli wayenendodana ezisithandathu; amagama abo nguAzrikam, noBokereu, noIshmayeli, noShearya, noObhadiya, noHanan. Bawo bonke oonyana kaAseli.
Oonyana bakaEsheki, umzalwana wakhe, nguUlam umkhuluwa wakhe, noYehushi wesibini, noElifeleti wesithathu.
Oonyana baka-Ulam babe ngamadoda anamandla okulwa, abakwaziyo ukudubula umqolo; babeninzi oonyana babo nabantwana babo, abelikhulu elinamanci mahlanu. Bonke abo baba ziinkomo zikaBhenjamin.
Ke kaloku bonke amaSirayeli babhalwa ngokweziqu zabo; bona, ezi zinto zibhalwe kwincwadi yamakumkani amaSirayeli. Bathunyelwe abantu bakaYuda eBhabheli, ngenxa yokuba babengakholwa kuThixo.
Aba bantu bakuqala ababuyayo ezweni labo, nasezidolophini zabo, babemi baseSirayeli, nababingeleli, nabaLevi, nabakhonzi bakaThixo.
Bahlala eYerusalem abantu abathile emasimini kaYuda, noBhenjamin, noEfraim, noManase.
KuYuda, nguUthai unyana ka-Amihudi, unyana ka-Omri, unyana ka-Imri, unyana ka-Bani; waba ngumntwana kaPerezi unyana kaYuda.
Kumadoda aseShiloni uAsayiya, umzali-mkhulu, naye nonyana wakhe.
Oonyana bakaZera: uYehuyeli; bonke oonyana bakaYuda babe ngamawaka anamanci mane anamashumi asithoba.
Kwisizwe sikaBhenjamin, nguSalu unyana kaMeshulam, unyana kaHodaviya, unyana kaHasenuya.
Ke kaloku kwabakho uIbneya unyana kaYeroham, noEla unyana kaUzi, unyana kaMikri, noMeshulam unyana kaShefatiya, unyana kaReuyeli, unyana kaIbniya.
Abazalwana babo, ngokweziqu zabo zabafazi, babemakhulu asithoba, anamashumi amahlanu anesithandathu; bonke abo madoda babe ziintloko zeentsapho zabo.
Ngabo ababingeleli: uYedaya, noYoyaribhi, noYakhini.
Ke kaloku uAzariya, unyana kaHilkiya, unyana kaMeshulam, unyana kaSadoko, unyana kaMerayothi, unyana ka-Ahitubhi; uAzariya ke wayengumphathi wendlu kaThixo.
Ke kaloku uAdaya unyana kaYeroham, unyana kaPashuri, unyana kaMalkiya; ke kaloku uMasayi unyana kaAdiyeli, unyana kaYazereha, unyana kaMeshulam, unyana kaMeshilemitha, unyana kaImere.

Bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli ababingeleli, abemi beentsapho zabo, babeyizigidi ezilishumi elinamakhulu asixhenxe anamashumi amathandathu; baba ngamadoda anamandla amakhulu, aye engqondweni yomsebenzi wokukhonza endlwini kaThixo.
Ngabo abaLevi, nguShemaya unyana kaHashubhi, unyana kaAzrikam, unyana kaHashabhiya, waba oonyana bakaMerariya.
Ke kaloku uBakbakare, noHereshe, noGalal, noMatania unyana kaMika, unyana kaZikri, unyana kaAsafe.
Ke kaloku uObhadiya, unyana kaShemaya, unyana kaGalali, unyana kaYeduthuni; ke kaloku uBerekiya, unyana kaAsa, unyana kaElkana, ohlala ezidolophini zabaseNetofati.
Abagwebi: uShalumu, noAkubu, noTalmon, noAhimanani, nabazalwana babo; uShalumu waba ngukumkani wabo.
Ke kaloku, ngaphambili, babehlala emnyango wokumkani, ngasempumalanga; baba ngabakhuseli beengcango zesixeko samaLevi.

UShalum unyana kaKore, unyana kaEbyashafe, unyana kaKora, naye nosapho lwakhe, oonyana bakaKorhayi, babe phantsi kolawulo lokugquma iminyango yetente; baba phantsi kolawulo lwabafazi babo, ukugquma umngxunya womkhosi kaYehova.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wokuqala, uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Elazare, waba ngukumkani wabagwebi; iNkosi waye naye.
UZekariya unyana kaMeshelemiya wayengumphathi wesango ekungeneni kwetenki yokuhlangana.

Bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli abakhethiweyo ukuba babe ngamagqwetha eengcango, kwaba ngamawaka amabini anamashumi mabini anesibini; babhaliswa ngokweziqu zabo ezidolophini zazo. UDavide noSamuweli umbonisi wabeka kubo izikhundla zegunya.
Baye ke, nabo oonyana babo, babezikhusela izibuko lendlu kaYehova, ikhaya letente.
Kwabakho abagwebi ngaphaya kweendawo ezine: emazantsi, namantshona, namantla, namantshona.
Abahlobo babo, abasezidolophini zabo, babemele bafike ngexesha ngalinye, bathathe inxaxheba kwimisebenzi yabo imihla esixhenxe ngaxeshanye.
Ke kaloku abakhulu abane abakhuseli beengcango, abaLevi, babekwa phantsi kolawulo oluthembekileyo; babe ngabasebenzi beekhabhathi nakwiindawo zokugcina izinto endlwini kaThixo.
Bahlala ngobusuku bejikeleza indlu kaThixo, ngokuba babeyikhusela; babeya kuyivula mihla le.
Ke kaloku kwakukho abanye kubo abaphatha iimpahla ezisetyenziswayo kumsebenzi wendlu kaNdikhoyo; babezibala, xa zithe zafakwa, naxa zaphuma.
Ke kaloku kwakukho abanye ababekwa phezu kwezixhobo, nazo zonke izinto ezingcwele, nangaphezulu komgubo oqinileyo, newayini, neoli, nefuthe, neziqhamo.
Ke kaloku, kwakukho abanye ababingeleli abaxubayo iziqhamo.
Ke kaloku wayekho umLevi okuthiwa nguMatithiya, unyana wokuqala kaShalum, umKorhathi, waba ngumcebisi wokupheka isonka esisetyenziselwa izipho.
Kwabakho abahlobo babo, abakwindlu yamaKahati, ababephethe ukulungiselela isonka esingcwele kwitafile ngaso nasiphi na isabhati.
Ke kaloku kwabakho abaculi, abezikhulu zeentsapho zakwaLevi; babehlala kwiikhabhathi zendlu kaNdikhoyo, bengenamsebenzi othile; ngokuba basebenza ngomsebenzi wabo mihla nabusuku.
Abo bonke babe ziintloko zeentsapho zakwaLevi, ngokubhaliweyo kweentsapho zabo; babe ngabaphathi; bahlala eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku uYeyeli, utata kaGibeyon, wayehlala eGibeyon; igama lomkakhe lalinguMahaka.
Unyana wakhe wokuqala uAbdon; abanye oonyana bakhe uTsuri, noKishi, noBhaali, noNeri, noNadab,
noGedori, noAhiyo, noZekariya, noMiklothi.
Ke kaloku uMiklothi waba ngumzali kaShimeam; bona ke bahlala phantsi kwabazalwana babo eYerusalem.
UNere waba ngumzali kaKishi; uKishi waba ngumzali kaSawule; uSawule waba ngumzali kaYonatan, noMalkishishuwa, noAbinabadi, noEshbhayeli.
Unyana kaYonatan nguMerebhi-bhaali; uMerebhi-bhaali wayengumntwana kaMika.
Oonyana bakaMika: uPiton, noMeleki, noTareha, noAhaze.
UAhazi waba ngumzali kaYare; uYare waba ngumzali kaAlemeti, noAzmawete, noZimri; uZimri waba ngumzali kaMoza.
UMoza wazalelwa nguBineya; uBineya unyana kaRefaya; uRefaya unyana kaEleasa; uEleasa unyana kaAsele.
Ke kaloku uAsele wayenendodana ezisithandathu; la mazwi abo nguAzrikam, noBokereu, noIshmayeli, noShearya, noObhadiya, noHanan. Lowo ke unyana kaAsele.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti bahlasela amaSirayeli; amadoda aseSirayeli abaleka phambi kwabo, bafa abantu abaninzi entlango kaGilboa.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti balandela uSawule noonyana bakhe; babulala oonyana bakaSawule, uYonathani noAbinadadi noMalkishuwa.
Ke kaloku, ukulwa lwaba lukhulu ngaseSauli; abathuthi-makhwenkwe bamfikelela, bamwikela.

Ke kaloku uSawule wathi kunyana wakhe othabatha izithuthi zakhe: Sula ikrele lakho, ndibulala ngalo; kuba ukuba ungakwenzanga njalo, baya kuvela abo bantu abangenakulitywa, bandise umsindo kum, babangele intlungu kum. Unyana woyika kakhulu ukuyenza loo nto; ke uSawule wathabatha ikrele lakhe, waya kuyo.
Ke kaloku, xa umthwali wezixhobo wayebona ukuba uSawule ufile, wabetha ke yena ikrele lakhe, wafa.
Wafa ke uSawule noonyana bakhe abathathu; nendlu yakhe yonke yafa ndawonye.

Ke kaloku, bonke amadoda aseSirayeli asemzantsi-ntshona, ebona ukuba amaSirayeli ahambe, yaye uSawule oonyana bakhe bafile, washiya amadolophu akhe, waya kuwo. Bafika ke abaFilisti, behlala kumadolophu abo.
Ke kaloku, kwathi ke ngemini elandelayo, befika abaFilisti ukuba bagqobe abo bafayo, bafumana uSawule noonyana bakhe bafa emnqamlezweni weGilboa.
Bawususa umzimba kaSawule, bathabathe intloko yakhe nezithuthi zakhe; bathumela abathunywa ezweni lonke lakwaFilisti, ukuba bayixelele loo nto iidoda zabo, nabantu babo.
Babeka izithuthi zakhe endlwini kaThixo wabo, bamisa intloko yakhe endlwini kaDagon.
Bathi ke bonke abantu baseYabhesi eGiliyadi, beva into abaFilisti ababeyenza kuSawule.
Baye bonke amadoda anamandla, bathabathe iziqu zikaSawule noonyana bakhe, bazisa eYabheshi; babezifihla iinwele zabo phantsi kwethamsanqa eYabheshi; bamisa iintsuku ezisixhenxe.
Wafa ke uSawule, ngenxa yobuxoki bakhe kuYehova; akazange aphulaphule ilizwi likaYehova; wabuza nomfazi othetha ngezinto eziphilayo, wathi,
Ke kaloku iNkosi wambulala, wamnika ubukumkani uDavide, unyana kaYeshaya.
Ke kaloku bonke amaSirayeli bahlangana kuDavide eHebron, besithi, Yabona, thina sinyama yakho negazi lakho.

Ke kaloku ngelo xesha, xa uSawule wayengumkumkani, waba nguwe ophumayo nobuyayo amaSirayeli emfazweni. Wathi ke kuwe iNkosi uThixo wakho, Uya kuba ngumlimi wabantu bam bakaSirayeli; uya kuba ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bam bakaSirayeli.

Bafika ke bonke abathetheli bakaSirayeli kukumkani uDavide eHebron. Wakwenza khona uDavide umnqophiso nabo phambi koYehova; bayamenza ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, njengoko watshoyo iNkosi ngesandla sikaSamuweli.
Ke kaloku uDavide noSirayeli bonke bafika eYerusalem (igama layo nguYebhusi); amaJebhusi ayehlala khona.
Bathi ke abantu baseYebhusi kuDavide, Awuza kungena apha; uDavide wathabatha isixeko esikhuselekileyo saseSiyoni, sakuba nguMzi kaDavide.
Ke kaloku uDavide wathi, Wonke umntu ohlaselayo abaYebhusi uya kuba ngukumkani womkhosi. UYowabhi unyana kaSeruhiya wanyuka kuqala, waba ngumphathi.
Ke kaloku uDavide waya kwindlu ekhuselekileyo; ngoko kwabizwa ngokuba yiMzi kaDavide.
Wakwakha umzi phezu kwayo, ukususela eMilo kude kube kuyo yonke indawo; uYowabhi walungisa isiphelo somzi.
Ke kaloku uDavide wakhula waza waba mkhulu; kuba iNkosi wamaSirayeli waye naye.
Ke kaloku, abo bamadoda amakhulu kaDavide, anamandla okulwa, nabo bonke amaSirayeli, bamxhasa emkhosini wakhe, ukuba abe ngukumkani, njengoko iNkosi wathetha ngaye kumaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku eli linani lamadoda anamandla kaDavide: uYashobham, umHakmoni, waba ngukumkani kwabathathu. Wasebenzisa isandla sakhe, wabulala amadoda angamawaka amathathu emfazweni omnye.
Emva kwakhe uElezare, unyana kaDodo, umAhohati; wayengumnye wabanqolobi abathathu.
Waye noDavide ePasdamini. Ke kaloku abaFilisti bahlangane khona ukubhiyozela ukulwa; kwabakho khona indawo egcwele ingqolowa; amaSirayeli abaleka phambi kwamaFilisti.
Ke kaloku uElayasare noDavide bahlala phakathi kwesiqithi, bakhusela isiqithi; babulala amaFilisti; ke iNkosi wabanika ukusindisa okukhulu.
Ke kaloku, abathathu kumadoda amakhulu amashumi mathathu bahla kuye uDavide ecaleni komthi, kwelaseAdulamini; amaFilisti ke aye esixekweni, emlanjeni wamaRafayim.
