Waye ke uDavide ngaloo mini kwindlu ekhuselekileyo; iqela lamadoda amaFilisti laseBhetelehem.
Ke kaloku uDavide wafuna kakhulu, wathi, Kungakuze kubekho umntu oza kumnika amanzi okusela ebhedini yaseBhetelehem, ekwisango.

Ke kaloku abo madoda amathathu anamandla, baphucuka phakathi kwamaqela eeFilisti, bathabathe amanzi emlanjeni okwisango laseBhetelehem, bamthabatha waya kuDavide; uDavide ke akakwazanga ukuwasela, wawutywina umnikelo kaYehova.

Wathi ke uDavide, UThixo andivumelenga ukuba ndiyenze loo nto; ndingayisela na igazi lamadoda lawo, abeka ubomi babo emngciphekweni? Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba babeka ubomi babo emngciphekweni ukulithatha, uDavide akayi kuyidla. Ezi zizinto zamadoda amakhulu amathathu anamandla.
UAbhishai, umzalwana kaYowabhi, waba ngukumkani wabo bathathu; wabeka imilenze yakhe emlonyeni wakhe, wawabulala amadoda angamakhulu mathathu; waba negama phakathi kwabo bathathu.
Waba mkhulu kunabo bobabini abathathu, waba ngukumkani wabo; ke kaloku akazange abe ngumnye kubo bathathu.

Ke kaloku uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada, owayengumntu onamandla eKabseyeli, wazenza izinto ezikhulu; wababulala abo babini abadumileyo baseMowabhi. Wahla waya emngxunyeni ngemini yekhephu, wabulala ilili.

Wabulala umYiputa, ophakamileyo kakhulu, ubude bakhe buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini; lo mYiputa wayenotshizi oluqinileyo njengenqanawa yombukeli; ke yena uBhenaya wafika kuye enesithunywa; watsala isithunywa esisesandlani somYiputa, wambulala ngaso.
Ezi zizinto zamandla kaBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada; waba negama phakathi kwabalinganiswa abathathu.
Waye mkhulu kunabo bamashumi mathathu, ke kaloku akazange abe ngabanye abathathu. UDavide wambeka phezu kwabakhuseli bakhe.
Ke kaloku kumadoda anamandla, uAsayeli umzalwana kaYowabhi; noElahani unyana kaDodo waseBetheleyimu;
uShamote umHaroni; uHelezi umPeloni;
uIra unyana ka-Ikeshe waseTekoya; noAbiezer waseAnathoti;
uSibhekayi waseHushathi; uElaya waseAhohi;
uMaharayi waseNetofa; uHeledi unyana kaBhana waseNetofa;
uIthai, unyana kaRibhayi, waseGibeha eBhenjamin; uBhanayasi wasePirathoni;
uHurai, osuka kumagqabi eGashe; uAbiyeli umArbati;
uAzmawethi waseBhaharum; uEliyaba waseShaalboni;
oonyana bakaHashemi, umGishoni; uYonathani, unyana kaShagi, umHariti;
uAhiyam, unyana kaShakare, umHarithi; uElifayeli, unyana kaUri;
uHefer waseMekerethi; uAhiya wasePeloni;
uHezero waseKarmele; uAyarayeli unyana ka-Ezbai;
uYoweli, umzalwana kaNathane; uMibhare, unyana kaHagri;
uSeleki, umAmoni; noNaharayi waseBherothi, owathabatha izithuthuthu zikaYowabhi unyana kaZeruya;
uIra umYithrithi; uGarebhi umYithrithi;
uUriya, umHeti; uZabadi unyana kaAhali;
UAdina unyana kaShisa, waseRubeni, owayengukumkani wabaRubeni; naye wayenendoda emashumi mathathu.
uHanan unyana kaMahaka; uYoshafati umMithini;
uUziya waseAshtarothi; uShama noYeyeli, oonyana bakaHothami baseAroeri;
uYediyayeli unyana kaShimri, noYoha umzalwana wakhe waseTishi;
uEliyeli umMahabhi; uYeribayi noYoshaviya, oonyana bakaElnaam; uItama umMowabi;
noEliyeli, noObedi, noYasiyele umMezobhayithi.
Ke kaloku abo madoda afike kuDavide eSikelegi, xa efihlakele phambi kukaSawule unyana kaKishi; babephakathi kwabanqolobi abancedisayo uDavide emfazweni.
Bezikhusela ngamaqhekeza, bekwazi ukutyhala amagophe, nokutyhila iithayile ngesandla sazo sokunene nasekhohlo; babe ngabahlobo bakaSawule, basesizwe sikaBhenjamin.
Waba nguAhiyezere umlawuli wabo, ke kaloku uYowashe, oonyana ababini bakaShemaya waseGibeha; kwakunye noYeziyeli noPeleti, oonyana bakaAzmawete, noBheraka, noYehu waseAnathothi;
uIshmaya waseGibheyon, umkhosi onamandla phakathi kwabo bamashumi mathathu, waba ngukumkani kubo bamashumi mathathu; noYeremiya, noYahaziyeli, noYohanan, noYozabadi waseGedere;
uEluzayi, noYerimothi, noBhealiya, noShemariya, noShefatiya umHarufite;
uElkana, noIshiya, noAzareli, noYozere, noYashobham, ooKorayi;
noYoyela noZebadiya, oonyana bakaYeroham waseGedori.

Ke kaloku kwabakho namadoda aseGadi aye kuDavide, endlwini yakhe ekhuselekileyo entlango, amadoda anamandla, aqeqeshiweyo emfazweni, asebenzisa imiyalelo nemikhosi; iintloko zazo zazifana neentloko zezimvu, zaba zikhawulezayo njengeentaka ezihamba phezulu emanzini.
uEzere wayeyintloko; uObhadiya waba yisibini; uEliyaba waba sisithathu;
uMishmana wesixhenxe, uYeremiya wesihlanu,
uAtayi wesixhenxe, uEliyeli wesixhenxe,
uYohanan wesibhozo, uElzabadi wesithoba,
uYeremiya wesixhenxe, noMakbannayi wesithoba.
Aba bantu bakaGadi babe ngabathetheli bemikhosi; umncinane kubo wayelawula abantu abamakhulu, nomkhulu wabo wabaphatha amawaka.
Badlula emlanjeni iYorodani ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga, xa umlambo ugcwele zonke iziqithi zakhe; bakhupha bonke abasemaphandleni, emazantsi nasentshonalanga.
Ke kaloku kwafika namadoda eBhenjamin noYuda kuDavide, endlwini yakhe yokhuselo.

Ke kaloku uDavide waphuma waya kuhlangana nabo, wathi kubo, Ukuba nifika ngokuzola ukuze mncede, ndiya kudibana nani; kodwa ukuba nifika ukuze mnikeze kumagosa am, nakuba akukho nto ingalunganga endiyenzayo, ngoko ke uThixo wabafazi bethu ajonge, aze akuxelele.

Wafika uMoya ku-Amasai, umlawuli wabamashumi mathathu, wathi, Siyakukho wena, uDavide; sikhona nawe, unyana kaYese. Uxolo, uxolo kuwe, noxolo kubo bonke abakuncedayo; ngokuba uThixo wakho uya kukunceda. UDavide wawamkela ke, wababeka njengeengqekembe zamadoda akhe.

Kwabakho namadoda eManase aye kuDavide, xa waya namaFilisti ukulwa noSawule; ke kaloku uDavide namadoda akhe akayi kunceda amaFilisti. Ke kaloku abaphathi bakaSirayeli bathetha ngale nto, bamthutha, besithi, Ukuba ubuyela kuSawule, umlawuli wakhe, kuya kuba ngumhlaza weentloko zethu.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide esiya eTsikelage, kwafika naye la madoda aseManase: nguAdna, noYozabadi, noYediyayeli, noMikayeli, noYozabadi, noElihu, noSiletayi; ngamnye waba ngukumkani wamawaka eManase.
Baye banceda uDavide ekuhlaseleni amaqela ahlaselayo; ngokuba bonke babe ngamadoda anamandla, abaphathi emkhosini wakhe.
Ngosuku nosuku kwafika abantu ukuncedisa uDavide, de kwaba neqela elikhulu kuye, njengeqela likaThixo.
Ke kaloku le milinganiselo yabantu abanezixhobo, abafikayo kuDavide eHebron, ukuba bamnike ubukumkani bukaSawule, njengokuba iNkosi wathi.
KuYuda kwafika amawaka amathandathu anamakhulu asixhenxe, amadoda alungiselelwe ukulwa, ethwala izithuthi nezikhephe.
KuSimeoni kwakukho amawaka asixhenxe anamakhulu mahlanu, amadoda anamandla okulwa.
KuLevi, amawaka amane anamakhulu amathandathu.
Ke kaloku uYehoyada, umlawuli wendlu ka-Aron, wafika naye amadoda amawaka amathathu anamakhulu asixhenxe;
wafika ke uSadoko, umntwana onamandla anamandla, namadoda amakhulu endlu yakhe, amabini anamashumi mabini anesibini.
KuBenjamin, isizukulwana sikaSawule, kwafika amadoda amawaka amathathu; ngelo xesha ininzi yabo yaba yinxalenye yendlu kaSawule.
KuEfrayim kwaba ngamawaka angamashumi amabini anamakhulu asibhozo, amadoda anamandla okulwa, anegama phakathi kweentsapho zabo.
Engxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase kwafika amawaka alishumi elinamithandathu, abakhethiweyo ngegama, ukuba bafike babe ngukumkani uDavide.
Kuye ku-Isakare, abathetheli abangamakhulu amabini, abanolwazi lwexesha, bayazi into ekufuneka bayiyenze iSirayeli; bonke abazalwana babo balandela umyalelo wabo.
NgaseZebulon kwakukho amawaka amashumi amahlanu, abantu abaqeqeshiweyo, abalungiselelwe ukulwa ngazo zonke iintlobo zezithuthi. Baye bonke bazimisele ukukunceda uDavide.
KuNafetali kwafika amawaka alishumi elinambini eempembelelo, namawaka angamashumi amathathu anesixhenxe anesixhenxe, abathabatha izikhuselo nezithuthi.
KuDan kwaba ngamawaka amashumi amabini anesibhozo, anamakhulu amathandathu, amadoda alungiselelwe ukulwa.
Ku-Ashere kwaba ngamawaka amashumi mane, abaqeqeshiweyo empilweni.
Ngasemzantsi-mpuma weJordan, eRubheni, naseGadi, nengxenye yesizukulwana sikaManase, kwaba ngamawaka amakhulu amabini anamashumi amabini, abalungiselelwe zonke iintlobo zezixhobo.

Ke kaloku bonke abo, abemi abanamandla okulwa, bafika eHebhoni, benengqondo eqinileyo, ukuba benze uDavide ukumkani phezu kooSirayeli bonke. Nabo bonke amanye amaSirayeli babe nelizwi elinye, ukuba benze uDavide ukumkani.
Bahlala khona noDavide iintsuku ezithathu, bedla besela; kuba abahlobo babo babebalungiselele isonka.

Ke kaloku nabo abasemagunyeni kwabo, basuka kude, besiya eIsrayeli, noZabulon, noNafetali, babezisa isonka phezu kweempawu, neenkomo, neengulube, nezimvu; kwakukho ukutya okuninzi: umgubo, iziqholo, neziqhamo, iwayini, ioli, inkunzi yeegusha, kunye neentlanzi. Kwabakho ukuthandana okukhulu kuSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uDavide wathetha ngale nto nabaphathi bakhe bamawaka, nabaphathi bakhe bamawaka, nabo bonke abathetheli bakhe.

Wathi ke kuye wonke umkhosi wakwaSirayeli, Ukuba kulungile emehlo enu, ukuba nguYehova uThixo wethu, sithumelele izibhambathiso kubahlobo bethu kuzo zonke iindawo zesizwe samaSirayeli, nakwabefundisi nabaLevi ezidolophini zabo nezixeko zazo, ukuze bafike bathabathele nathi.
Ke ngoko, siyibuyisele kuthi ibhokisi kaThixo wethu; ngokuba asizange siyifune xa uSawule waye ngukumkani.
Ke kaloku ibandla lonke lavuma ukuba liyenze loo nto, kuba bonke bacinga ukuba iyinto elungileyo.
Wathi ke uDavide wahlanganisa bonke amaSirayeli, esuka emlanjeni waseShihore waseYiputa, waya eHamati, ukuba bathabathe ibhokisi kaThixo eKiriyati-yearim.

Waya ke uDavide, naye onke amaSirayeli, waya eBhala (eli liKiriyati-yearimi laseYuda), ukuba babuyisele isithunywa soThixo iNkosi, ohlala esitroneni sakhe phakathi kweekerubi, isithunywa esibizwa ngegama lakhe.
Bayithabatha inqanawa kaThixo kwimoto entsha, yaphuma endlwini ka-Abinadabu; uUza noAhiyo baqhuba imoto.
Ke kaloku uDavide, namadoda onke aseSirayeli, bedlala phambi koThixo ngamandla abo onke, benezingoma, neziqhoboshi, nezigqubuthelo, neentsontelo, nee-cymbals, nezipho.
Ke kaloku, bafika befike esidlangalaleni sika-Chidon, izimvu zathi ziqhutywa; ke uUza wamisa isandla sakhe, ukuze aqinise itye.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxhaphaza kakhulu uUza, wambetha ngenxa yokuba watshisa isithuthi; wafa ke uUza khona phambi koThixo.
Ke kaloku uDavide waxoka, ngenxa yokuba iNkosi wayexhalabile ku-Uza; ngoko ke kwathiwa igama lendawo leyo nguPerezi-u-Uza, kuze kube namhlanje.
UDavide wakhathazeka uThixo ngaloo mini, wathi, Ndiyingenise njani ibhokisi kaThixo nam?
Ke kaloku uDavide akayithabatha inqanawa naye, waya kumzi kaDavide; wayisa endlwini ka-Obedi-Edom waseGathi.
Ibhokisi kaThixo yahlala nendlu ka-Obedi-Edom, endlwini yakhe, iinyanga ezintathu; wabhaptiza iNkosi indlu yakhe, nazo zonke izinto zakhe.
Wathumela uHiram ukumkani waseTire abathunywa kuDavide; wathumela iithayile zeediliya, nabaqulunqi bemigodi, nabaqulunqi bezitayile, ukuba bakwakha kuye indlu.
Waqonda ke uDavide ukuba iNkosi wammisa njengomkumkani phezu kwaSirayeli, waza wakwenza ubukumkani bakhe bukhulu ngenxa yabantu bakhe bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uDavide wathatha amadoda amakhulu eYerusalem, waza wazala oonyana nabantwanataki.
Lawona magama azalwa kuye eYerusalem: uShamua, noShobhab, noNathan, noSolomon,
uIbhare, noElishuwa, noElpelethe,
uNoha, noNefegi, noYafiya,
noElishama, noBheliyada, noElifeleti.
Ke kaloku, beva amaFilisti ukuba uDavide waphucuka waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli onke, lanyuka lonke iqela lamaFilisti liya kumfuna. Wazi ke uDavide loo nto, waphuma ukuwadibana.
Ke kaloku bafika amaFilisti, bahlasela iNtaba yamaRefayi.
UDavide wabuza uThixo, esithi, Ndiya kuhamba ndibahlasele na abaFilisti? Ngaba uya kuwanikela kum? Waphendula iNkosi wathi kuye, Yiya, ndiya kubanikela kuwe.

Waya ke uDavide namadoda akhe eBhayi-perazim, wababulala khona; wathi ke uDavide, UThixo waphula izithunywa zam ngesandla sam, njengokuba amanzi aphula umngxunya. Ngenxa yoko kwabizwa igama lendawo leyo ngokuba yiBhayi-perazim.
Bashiya khona amaSirayeli amadini abo; uDavide wathi, Bazithuthe.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti baphinde bahlasela ulwandle.
Wabuza uDavide kwakhona uThixo; waphendula uThixo, esithi, Musa ukuhlasela phambi kwabo; jikelezisa ngasemva kwabo, uwahlasele phambi kwezityalo ze-almuge.
Ke kaloku, xa ubona umsindo wokuhamba phezulu kwezityalo ze-balsam, uya kuphuma ukulwa; ngokuba uThixo uza kuphuma phambi kwakho, ukuba ahlasele amaFilisti.
UDavide wenza njengoko uThixo wamwisela umthetho ngawo; bahlasela amaFilisti emkhosini wabo, ukusuka eGibheyon waya eGezere.
UDavide waba negama ehlabathini lonke; iNkosi wambeka emlonyeni wazo zonke iintlanga.
Ke kaloku uDavide wakha izindlu zakhe eMzini kaDavide; walungiselela indawo yesiqwenga soThixo, wamisa itente kuyo.
Wathi ke uDavide, Akukho namnye oza kuthwala ibhokisi kaThixo, ngaphandle kwabaLevi; ngokuba abo bakhethelwe nguYehova ukuba bathwale ibhokisi kaThixo, ukuba babe ngabakhonzi bakhe ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku uDavide wahlanganisa bonke amaSirayeli eYerusalem, ukuba bathabathe itekisi kaYehova, bayikhuphe kwindawo awayeyilungiselela.
Waza wababiza oonyana baka-Aron, nabaLevi, wathi kubo:
Kubantwana bakaKahati: nguUriyeli umlawuli, nabazalwana bakhe abamakhulu amabini anamashumi.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uAsayiya umlawuli, nabazalwana bakhe abamakhulu amabini, anamanci mabini.
Oonyana bakaGershoni, uYoweli umthetheli; nabazalwana bakhe abamakhulu mathathu.
Kubafazi bakaElizafan, uShemaya umlawuli, nabazalwana bakhe abamakhulu amabini.
Oonyana baka-Hebron, uEliyeli umphathi, nabazalwana bakhe abamashumi asibhozo.
Oonyana baka-Uziyeli: uAminadabhi, umlawuli; nabazalwana bakhe babelikhulu elinamabini anamashumi mabini.
Wabiza ke uDavide uTsadoki noAbhiyatare, ababingeleli, nabaLevi, uUriyeli, noAsaya, noYoweli, noShemaya, noEliyele, noAminadabhi.
Wathi kubo, Niyintloko yeentsapho zakwaLevi; ziningcwele niye nabazalwana benu, niyikhuphe inqanawa kaYehova uThixo kaSirayeli kude kube yindawo endiyilungiselelileyo yona.
Ke nina, abaLevi, awuyithumeli kuqala; ngoko ke iNkosi uThixo wethu watyhala intliziyo yakhe phezu kwethu; asiwubuzenga indlela elungileyo yokwenza.
Bathi ke ababingeleli nabaLevi, basindise ngokwabo, ukuba bakhuphe ibhokisi kaYehova uThixo kaSirayeli.
Bayithabatha ke ooLevi itekisi kaThixo ngasemva kwabo ngeentambo, njengokuba uMoses ewiselise umthetho ngalo lizwi likaYehova.

Wathi ke uDavide kumadoda amakhulu eLevi, ukuba abeke phakathi kwabazalwana babo ababhali-ngoma; ukuba babhale ngeencwadi zengoma, namacwecwe, neengxowa-ngoma, neentsontelo, nababhali-ngoma abanoxolo.
Ke kaloku abaLevi bamisela uHeman, unyana kaYoweli, noAsafe, unyana kaBerekiya, umzalwana wakhe; nabahlobo babo, oonyana bakaMerari, uEthan, unyana kaKushaya.

Ke kaloku nabo abazalwana babo abalandelayo: uZekariya, noBeni, noYahaziyeli, noShemiramoti, noYehiyeli, noUnni, noEliyaba, noBhenaya, noMahesiya, noMatithiya, noElifelehu, noMikneya; namagwebi amabini, uObhede-Edom noYeyeli.
Ke kaloku oongomakazi uHeman, noAsafe, noEthan, badlala ngee-cymbals zentsimbi.
Ke kaloku uZekariya, noAzieli, noShemiramoti, noYehiyeli, noUnni, noEliyabi, noMashehiya, noBhenaya, babezidlala iziqhoboshi eziphakamileyo ezibizwa ngokuba yiAlamote.
UMatithiya, noElifelehu, noMiknehiya, noObedi-Edom, noYeyeli, noAzaziya, babeziqhuba iileyibhile eziqhutywa ngomsindo ophantsi, ezibizwa ngokuba yiSheminithi.
Ke uKenaniya, omnye wabathetheli bakaLevi, wabekwa phezu kokuzivocavoca; waza wafundisa abo bazivocavocayo, ngokuba wayeziqeqesha.
UBherekiya noElkana babeyikhusela inqanawa.

Ke kaloku uShebhaniya, noYoshafati, noNethaneli, noAmasai, noZekariya, noBhenaya, noEliyezere, ababingeleli, babeziphucula izidumbu phambi kwebhokisi kaThixo; noObedi-Edom noYehiya babeyigcina ibhokisi.
Waye ke uDavide, nabathetheli bakaSirayeli, nabaphathi bamawaka, besuka benyuka ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova ukusuka endlwini ka-Obedi-Edom, benethemba elikhulu.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba uThixo wabanceda ooLevi abathabatha itekisi yomnqophiso kaYehova, banikela ngeenkomo ezisixhenxe nezimvu ezine.
Ke kaloku uDavide wayegqoke ibhanti yelinen ethambileyo, nabaLevi bonke abathabatha isiqulathi-zincwadi, nabangomakazi, noKenaniya, umphathi wengoma; ke uDavide wayegqoke neefayibhu yelinen.
Ke kaloku bonke amaSirayeli bakhupha ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova, benqumle ngovuyo olukhulu, nelizwi leebhokhwe, nezithunywa zentsimbi, nee-cymbals ezidumileyo, nee-harps, nee-lyres.
Ke kaloku, xa ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova yafika emzini kaDavide, uMikayeli, intombi kaSawule, wayejonga ngefestile; wabona ukumkani uDavide edanisa nokudlala, wamnyamezela entliziyweni yakhe.
Bayingenisa ibhokisi kaThixo, bayibeka phakathi kwetenki kaDavide, awayeyithumele kuyo; banikela kuThixo izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide egqibile ukunikela izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo, wabambisa abantu ngegama likaYehova.
Wabanika ke ooSirayeli bonke, amadoda namadoda, intonga yesonka, nenxalenye yenkomo, nebhotolo yeziqhamo.
Wabeka abanye abaLevi ukuba basebenze phambi kwetsimbi kaYehova, ukuba bathethe, babe nobubele, babulele iNkosi uThixo kaSirayeli.

UAsafe wayengumphathi, uZekariya ke waba mncinane. Ke kaloku kwafika uYeyeli, noShemiramoti, noYehiyeli, noMatithiya, noElibham, noBhenaya, noObedi-Edom, noJeyeli, bedlala iingoma ezidumileyo neziqhoboshi; uAsafe wadlala iziqhoboshi ezidumileyo.
Ke kaloku uBhenaya noYahaziyeli, ababingeleli, babezidubula izithunywa zentsimbi phambi kwebhokisi yomnqophiso kaThixo.
Waqala ke uDavide ngaloo mini, wamisa uAsafe nabazalwana bakhe, ukuba bathande iNkosi ngengoma le:
Bonisani iNkosi, sithi igama lakhe; Bathi kumazwe aphesheya into ayeyenzayo.
Yidlale kuye, yidlale umnqamlezo wakhe; Yathi zonke izinto zakhe ezimangazayo.
Yibhiyozeleni igama lakhe elingcwele; Liphile intliziyo yabo ilinde iNkosi.
Khangelani kuYehova nobuchule bakhe; Khangelani kuye rhoqo.
Khumbulani izinto zakhe ezimangalisayo azenzayo, iimfihlakalo zakhe, nezigwebo zakhe athethayo,
Niziqhamo zomkhonzi wakhe uSirayeli, nina oonyana bakaYakobi, abakhethiweyo bakhe.
UYehova uThixo wethu nguye; Ehlabathini lonke zibonakala izigwebo zakhe.
Khumbulani umnqophiso wakhe ngonaphakade, Inyaniso yakhe eyenziweyo kumakhulu amawaka eminyaka.
Umnqophiso wakhe owawenza noAbraham, Inyaniso yakhe eyamtyhilayotaki uIsake.
Wayenza ibe ngumthetho kuYakobi, Umnqophiso ophilayo kuSirayeli.
Wathi, Ndiza kukunika ilizwe laseKanan, ibe yinxalenye yenu.
Ke kaloku, nibe bantu abancinci, nibambalwa kakhulu, ningabakhenkethi kuloo lizwe.
Bahamba besuka ezweni ukuya ezweni, Besuka kukumkani omnye kuye komnye.
Akazange avumele nabani na ukuba abengele intlungu kubo; Wathi kukumkani ngenxa yabo,
Musani ukutshisa abo ndibabhaptizileyo, Musani ukulimaza abaprofeti bam.
Yibani kuYehova, ihlabathi liphela; Yazise usindiso lwakhe mihla le.
Zixelele iintlanga ubutyebi bakhe, Zixelele zonke iintlanga izinto zakhe ezimangalisayo.
Umbingeleli iNkosi, mkhulu kakhulu, uyamkelekile kakhulu; Kuye kuthotywa ngaphezu kwazo zonke izitha.
Zonke izithixo zeentlanga zizinto ezingabonakaliyo; ke iNkosi wenza izulu.
Ubuhle nobuqaqawuli bujikeleze kuye, Ubutyebi nobulumko buzalisa indawo yakhe yokuhlala.
Ninikele iNkosi, nizizwe zeentlanga; ninikele iNkosi ubukumkani nobukrelekrele.
Nceda ninike iNkosi uzuko olufana negama lakhe; Ninikele isonka, nifike phambi kwakhe, Niwukhonze iNkosi ngobuhle bobungcwele bakhe.
Umhlaba onke, phumla phambi kwakhe; Ihlabathi lihlala liqinileyo, aluyi kutshisa.
Nceda zithande izulu, incede ihlabathi liphumle; Nceda kuthe phakathi kwezizwe: UYehova ungukumkani.
Nceda ulwandle, nazo zonke izinto ezingaphakathi kulo; Nceda izityalo, nazo zonke izinto ezizingaphakathi kulo, zithande.
Ke kaloku izityalo zomthi ziya kubhiyozela phambi koYehova; Kuba uya kufika ukuba agweme umhlaba.
Bonisani iNkosi, ngokuba ulungileyo; Inyaniso yakhe ihlala ubomi bonke.
Nithi, Sisindise thina, Thixo womsindisi wethu; Sihlangane nathi, usikhusele kumazwe aphesheya, ukuze sikwazi ukubonga igama lakho elingcwele, sithande xa sikubiza.
Niwuthande iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, ukususela ngoku ukuya kuthi ga ngoku. Bathi ke bonke abantu, Amen; bawuthande iNkosi.
UDavide washiya khona uAsafe nabazalwana bakhe, phambi kwebhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova, ukuba basebenzela khona ngokuqhubekayo, ngokwento efunekayo mihla ngemihla.
Washiya noObedi-Edom, nabazalwana bakhe abamashumi mane anesibhozo, ukuba basebenze nabo; uObedi-Edom unyana kaYeduthuni, noHosa babe ngabakhuseli besango.
UDavide washiya uSadoko umbingeleli, nabazalwana bakhe ababingeleli, phambi kwetenki kaYehova, kwindawo ephakamileyo yaseGibheyon.

ukuze balungiselele iNkosi iintsontelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, phezu kwesibingelelo seentsontelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, ngokuqhubekayo, ekuseni nakusihlwa, ngokwezinto zonke ezibhaliweyo emthethweni kaYehova, awawisela amaSirayeli.
Ngabo uHeman, noYeduthuni, nabanye abakhethiweyo ngegama, ukuba bathande iNkosi, ngokuba ubulungisa bakhe buhlala ubomi bonke.
UHeman noYeduthuni babezimele izidumbu, nee-cymbales, nezinye iintonga zokungoma uThixo; oonyana bakaJeduthuni babezimele emnyango.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu babuyela endlwini yabo; uDavide ke wabuyela endlwini yakhe, ukuba abhaptize indlu yakhe.
Wathi uDavide kuNathani umprofeti, Xa wayehlala endlwini yakhe, yathi uDavide kuNathani umprofeti, Yabona, ndihlala endlwini yesedari; ke itempu yomnqophiso kaYehova ihlala kwitente.
Wathi uNathani kuDavide, Yonke into ekho emlonyeni wakho yenza; ngokuba uThixo unguwe.
Ke kaloku ngaloo busuku, kwafika igama likaThixo kuNathani, lisithi,
Yiya, uthethe kumkhonzi wam uDavide, uthi, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Akuyi kuba nguwe oza kwakha indlu yam ukuba ndihlale kuyo.
Andihlalanga endlwini ukususela ngemini endiyikhupha ngayo iSirayeli eYiputa, kuze kube namhlanje; ndahamba ndisuka kwintente ukuya kwintente, ndisuka kwindawo enye ukuya kwenye.

Naphi na apho ndahamba khona ndihamba nabantu bakaSirayeli bonke, ndabuza na mna nabani na kubo abathetheli bam, endibawisela umthetho ukuba baphambukele abantu bam, ndithi, Nithini na ukuba ningandixhobisa indlu yesedari?
Ke ngoko ngoku uthethe kumkhonzi wam uDavide, uthi, Utsho iNkosi wamaSirayeli ukuthi, Ndakuthabatha endlwini yokugcina iinkomo, ukuba ube ngukumkani phezu kwabantu bam bakaSirayeli.
Ndaba nawe naphi na apho wahamba khona, ndawacima bonke abathunywa bakho phambi kwakho; ngoku ndiya kwenza igama lakho libe likhulu, njengegama lamadoda amakhulu ehlabathini.

Ndiya kulungiselela indawo kubomi bam bakaSirayeli, ndiyabatyala khona; baya kuhlala endlwini yabo, bangaphazamiseki kwakhona; abantu ababi abaya kubathathi-nxaxheba nabo, njengokuba besenza ekuqaleni,

njengokuba besenza ukususela ngemihla endiyimisa ngayo imiyalelo phezu kwabantu bam bakaSirayeli, ndiya kubabulala bonke abathunywa bakho. Ndikuxelela ukuba iNkosi uya kukwakha kuwe indlu, nosapho lwamakumkani.
Xa imihla yakho iphele, ube uphumle nababukumkani bakho, ndiya kuphakamisa umntwana wakho, oza kuvela emehlweni akho, ukuba abe endaweni yakho; ndikuqinise ubukumkani bakhe.
Ke yena uya kwakha indlu kum; ndiya kuyimisa isithsaba sakhe kude kube sekupheleni.
Ndiya kuba ngumzali wakhe, yena uya kuba ngunyana wam; ndiya kumsusa umnqamlezo wam emntwini, njengamsusa umnqamlezo wam kukumkani owawungaphambili kwakho.
Ndiya kummisa phezu kwendlu yam, nobukumkani bam, kude kuphele; isithsaba sakhe siza kuhlala kude kuphela.
Wathi uNathani kuDavide zonke izinto athethayo iNkosi ngaloo mboni.
Wafika ke ukumkani uDavide, wahlala phambi koYehova; wathi, Ndibani na mna, Nkosi yam uThixo? Yintoni na ikhaya lam, ukuba ndinikhokele kude kube ngoku.
Ke kaloku, njengokuba oku kungabi nto encinci ngamehlo akho, Thixo, uthetha ke ngomhla wokuphelelwa kwendlu yomkhonzi wakho; ungenza ukuba ndibe ngumntu omkhulu kakhulu, Nkosi yam uThixo.
Ndiya kuthetha ntoni na kuwe, ukuba ndimhlonela umkhonzi wakho ngale nto? Uyazi umkhonzi wakho.
UYehova, ngenxa yomkhonzi wakho, nangenxa yobubele bakho, wenza le nto inkulu; wazisa zonke ezi zinto zikhulu.
Akukho namnye ofana nawe, Nkosi yam; akukho Thixo ngaphandle kwakho, ngokwento esiyiva ngeendlebe zethu.

Ingaba kukho ulwimi lwehlabathi olufana nelizwe lakho, uSirayeli? UThixo, wafika ukuwasindisa ukuba abe luhlanga lwakho, ukuze wenze igama kuwe, wenze izinto ezinkulu nezimangalisayo. Wakhupha iintlanga phambi kwabantu bakho, owabasindisela eYiputa.
Wakwenza abantu bakho amaSirayeli ukuba babe ngowakho kude kube sekupheleni; wena, Nkosi, waba nguThixo wabo.
Ke ngoko, Nkosi yam, ilizwi lakho elithethayo kumkhonzi wakho nosapho lwakhe, lihlale likhona kude kube sekupheleni; wenze njengoko uthetheyo.

Ke ngoko igama lakho liza kuhlala liqinile, libe liphakamileyo kude kube sekupheleni; bathi ke, UYehova wemikhosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, nguThixo kaSirayeli; nendlu yomkhonzi wakho uDavide iya kuhlala iqinile phambi kwakho.
Uye, Thixo wam, wabonisa umkhonzi wakho ukuba uya kumnika usapho lwamagqwetha; ngenxa yoko ke umkhonzi wakho wafumana intliziyo yokuthandaza kuwe.
Nkosi, wena uThixo; uthethe loo nto ilungileyo kumkhonzi wakho.
Ke ngoko, uyayithanda indlu yomkhonzi wakho ukuba uyibhaptize, ukuze ibe phambi kwakho ngonaphakade; wena, iNkosi, uyibhaptizile, yaye iya kuba sibhaptizo ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku kwathi emva koko, uDavide wababulala amaFilisti, wawabeka phantsi kwesandla sakhe; wathabatha iGati neziqithi zayo kumadoda aseFilisti.
Wawahlasela amaMowabhi; abaMowabhi babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide, benika umnikelo.
UDavide wabetha uHadarezere ukumkani waseZobha, eHamati, xa wayehamba uHadarezere ukumisela igunya lakhe emlanjeni weEfrayim.

UDavide wathabatha kuye izithuthi ezilishumi elinambini, namawaka asixhenxe amadoda ahamba ngeebhayisikile, namawaka amabini anamashumi amabini amadoda ahamba ngezithuthi; waza watshisa zonke izithuthi zebhayisikile, ngaphandle kwezithuthi ezimakhulu.
Bafika ke abaAram baseDamasko ukuncedisa uHadarezere ukumkani waseTsoba; uDavide wabulala kumaSirayeli amawaka amashumi mabini anesibini.
Wabeka ke uDavide amaqela emkhosini wamaSirayeli eDamasko; abaSirayeli babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide, benika umvuzo kuye. UYehova wamkhusela uDavide apho aye khona.
UDavide wathabatha izikhuselo zegolide, zabasebenzi bakaHadarezere, waza wazisa eYerusalem.

Wathabatha ke uDavide eTibhathi, naseKuni, ezidolophini zikaHadarezere, intsimbi enkulu kakhulu; wayenza ngayo uSolomon inqanawa enkulu yentsimbi, eyaziwa ngokuba yilwandle, nezikhonkwane, nezixhobo zentsimbi zendlu.
Ke kaloku uThowu ukumkani waseHamati waqonda ukuba uDavide wambulala wonke umkhosi kaHadarezere ukumkani waseZoba.

Wathumela uHadoram, unyana wakhe, kukumkani uDavide, ukuba amhlelele, amthandele ngenxa yokulwa kwakhe noHadarezere; ngokuba uTowu wayebanjwa nguHadarezere. UHadoram wazisa zonke iintlobo zeempahla zegolide, nesilivere, nentsimbi.
Wazinikela ukumkani uDavide kuYehova, kunye nesilivere negolide awayeyithathe kuzo zonke iintlanga: eEdom, naseMowabhi, nakwa-Ammon, nakwaFilisti, nakwaAmaleki.
Ke kaloku uAbhishai, unyana kaSeruhiya, wabulala kumaEdom amawaka alishumi elinambini eNtaba yeSali.
Wabeka amaqela eEdom; bonke aba Edomu babe ngabakhonzi bakaDavide. UYehova wamsindisa uDavide, apho aye khona naphi.
Ke kaloku uDavide waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli onke, esenza inyaniso nomthetho kubo bonke abantu bakhe.
UYowabhi unyana kaSeruhiya waba ngukumkani womkhosi; uJehoshafati unyana kaAhilodi waba ngumbhali.
USadoko unyana ka-Ahitubhi, noAbimeleki unyana ka-Abhiyatare, babe ngababingeleli; uShavesha waba ngumbhali.
UBhenaya unyana kaYehoyada waba ngukumkani weeKherethi, neePhelethi, abakhuseli bobuso bukakumkani; oonyana bakaDavide babe ngabathetheli abakhulu ecaleni kukakumkani.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, wafa uNahashe ukumkani wamaAmoni; waba ngukumkani unyana wakhe endaweni yakhe.

Wathi uDavide, Ndiya kwenza ubulungisa kuHanun, unyana kaNahashe; ngokuba uyise wenza ubulungisa kum. UDavide wathumela abathunywa ukuba amxolele ngenxa yokufa kukayise. Bafika ke abakhonzi bakaDavide kuHanun, ezweni labantwana baka-Ammon, ukuba bamxolele;

Bathi abathetheli baka-Ammon kuHanun, Ingaba ucinga ukuba uDavide uyamhlonela uyise, ekuthumeleni abo bantu ukuxolela wena? Ke kaloku, abazalwana bakhe bafika ukuvavanya ilizwe, ukuba lijonge, ukuze lilahle.
Wathi ke uHanun, athabathe abakhonzi bakaDavide, wabala iinwele zabo, waluka izihlangu zabo phakathi, zifike emazantsi emilenze yabo, wabathumela.

Wathi ke uDavide, xa kuthe kwathiwa kubo loo nto, wathumela abathunywa ukuba bahlangane nabo; ngokuba babengenakulibaziseka kakhulu. Wathi ukumkani kubo, Bahlale eYeremiya, de iinwele zenu zikhule kwakhona; emva koko niye.

Babebona oonyana baka-Ammon ukuba bayabaxolela uDavide. Wathumela ke uHanun, nabantwana baka-Ammon, iingelosi ezilishumi elinambini zesilivere, ukuze baqeshe izithuthi neemahashe eMesopotamia, naseAram-maakha, naseTsoba.

Baqesha izithuthi zokulwa ezimashumi mathathu anesibini amawaka; waya ke ukumkani waseMahaka nomkhosi wakhe, bamisa inqaba eMedebha. Ke kaloku oonyana baka-Ammon bahlangane kumadolophu abo, baphuma behlasela.
Wava ke uDavide, wathumela uYowabhi, nomkhosi wonke wamaYuda anamandla.
Baphuma ke oonyana baka-Ammon, balungiselela ukulwa ekungeneni komzi wabo; abakumkani abathe bafika ke, bahlala phandle, ngaphaya kwelizwe.
Ke kaloku uYowabhi, xa ebona ukuba kukho umkhosi phambi kwakhe, nomkhosi ngasemva kwakhe; wakhetha abantu abakhethiweyo kuSirayeli, wawamisa emgceni amaAram.
Ke kaloku, isiqwengana esiseleyo somkhosi wasibeka phantsi komyalelo wonyana wakhe uAbhishayhi; balungiselela ukuhlasela oonyana baka-Amon.
Wathi uYowabhi, Ukuba amaSirayeli anamandla ngaphezu kwam, uya kumnceda; ukuba ke oonyana baka-Ammon banamandla ngaphezu kwakho, mna ndiya kukunceda.
Yiba namandla, sihlale sinamandla ngenxa yabantu bethu, nezixeko zoThixo wethu; iNkosi ayenze into elungileyo emlonyeni wakhe.
Waphuma ke uYowabhi nomkhosi wakhe, bahlasela amaSirayeli; amaSirayeli athabathela emveni kwakhe.
Bathe ke oonyana baka-Ammon bebona ukuba abaSirayeli babaleka, babaleka nabo phambi koSawule unyana kaYowabhi, babuyela emzini wabo. Wabuya ke uYowabhi waya eYerusalem.

Ke kaloku, abaAram bebona ukuba bahlaselwe nguSirayeli, bathumela abathunywa ukuba bathabathe amanye amaSirayeli ukusuka ngaphesheya komlambo uEfrayim; noShofaki, umphathi womkhosi kaHadarezere, waba phambi kwabo.
Ke kaloku, xa kuthe kwafunyanwa uDavide ngaloo nto, wahlanganisa bonke amaSirayeli, wadlula umlambo iJordan, waya kubo; wamisa iziqwenga ezibini zokulwa nabaAram, bahlasela.
Ke kaloku abaAram babaleka phambi kwaSirayeli. Wabulala uDavide kumaSirayeli amawaka asixhenxe eemoto zokulwa, namawaka anamanci mane ahamba ngeenyawo; wabulala noShofaki, umphathi weqela labo.
Ke kaloku, abakhonzi bakaHadarezere bebona ukuba bahlaselwe nguSirayeli, bamisa uxolo noDavide, babe ngabakhonzi bakhe. Amadoda aseAram akazange aphinde ancedise oonyana baka-Amon.

Ke kaloku, ngonyaka omtsha, ngexesha apho amakumkani ephuma khona emfazweni, uYowabhi waphuma, wathabatha inqanawa, wabulala ilizwe labantwana baka-Ammon, waya, wagubungela iRabha; ke uDavide wayehlala eYerusalem. Wahlasela uYowabhi iRabha, wayibulala.

Ke kaloku uDavide wathatha isithsaba esisuka ekhanda lomkumkani wabo; sakuba siyintonga yegolide, ibe ziikhilogram ezimashumi mathathu anesine zegolide yaso; kwakukho iithayile ezintsonkothileyo kuyo; zabekwa phezu kwehlavu likaDavide. UDavidu waba nempahla emininzi emzini.
Wakhupha abantu abakhoyo khona, wabalungisa ngeesereyi, neengcongconi zentsimbi, neengxowa-mali. UDavide wenza njalo kuwo onke amadolophu eAmmon; wabuyela ke uDavide nomkhosi wakhe wonke eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku kwabakho ukulwa nabaFilisti eGezeri; ngaloo xesha uShibekayi, umHushathi, wabulala uSifayi, owona mntwana wabaRafayeli; abaFilisti ke bahlaselwa.
Ke kaloku, kwabakho umfazwe nomFilisti, uElhanan, unyana kaYaire, wabulala uLahmi, umzalwana kaGoliyathi waseGati; imilenze yesilayidi sikaLahmi yaba mkhulu njengentonga yoboya.

Ke kaloku kwabakho ukulwa kwakhona eGathi, kwakukho umntu omkhulu kakhulu, oneempawu ezisixhenxe ngesandla ngasinye, neempawu ezisixhenxe ngenyawo ngalinye, abe ngamabini anane onke. Waye ke lowo waba ngunyana wamaGhathi.
Ke kaloku, xa wayemxolela uSirayeli, uYonathan, unyana kaShimeha, umzalwana kaDavide, wambulala.
Ke kaloku abo madoda babeziqhamo zeeRafayeli eGati; wababulala ke uDavide namadoda akhe.
Ke kaloku wavuka uSatani, wahlasela amaSirayeli, wamvusa uDavide ukuba abalose abantu bakaSirayeli.
Wathi ke uDavide kuYowabhi, namadoda amakhulu abantu, Yiya nibala amaSirayeli, ukususela eBher-shebha emazantsi, ukuya eDan emantla; nindithumelele inyaniso, ndikwazi ukuba bangaphi.

Wathi ke uYowabhi, UYehova azidibanise abantu bakhe ngamawaka amaninzi kunabo abakhoyo ngoku; nkosi yam ukumkani, bangaphi na abo bonke abakhonzi bakho? Kutheni na ukuba wenze loo nto? Kutheni na ukuba ubeke isono kuSirayeli?
Ke kaloku umyalelo wokumkani waphumelela uYowabhi. Waphuma ke uYowabhi, waya kuwo onke amaSirayeli, wabuya eYerusalem.

Ke kaloku uYowabhi wamnika uDavide inani elipheleleyo lamadoda; kwabakho kumaSirayeli onke amawaka ezigidi ezilishumi elinanye, asebenzisayo ikrele; kwabakho kumaYuda amawaka anamakhulu amane, anamanci asixhenxe.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli aseLevi nabaseBhenjamini, uYowabhi awazibala; ngokuba umyalelo wokumkani wawungathandeki kuYowabhi.
Ke kaloku uThixo akathandabuzi oko kwathiwa, wabetha amaSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide kuThixo, Ndikhe ndenze intlungu enkulu ngale nto; ngoku ke, mna, nceda, ndiyisuse intlungu yomkhonzi wakho; kuba ndenza into enobuxoki kakhulu.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathi kuGadi, umbona kaDavide,
Yiya, uthethe noDavide, usithi, Itsho iNkosi ukuba, Ndikunikela phambi kwakho izinto ezintathu; khethe enye yazo, ndiyikwenze kuwe.
Wafika ke uGadi kuDavide, wathi kuye, Ithi loo nto iNkosi, Khetha wena:

iminyaka emithathu yobhubhiso, okanye iinyanga ezithathu zokuwa phambi kwabatshaba bakho, nekrele labo likufumane kuwe; okanye iintsuku ezintathu zekrele likaYehova, ibe yisifo esibi ezweni, ibe yintsingiselo kaYehova yokunqula kuwo onke amaSirayeli. Namhlanje ke ucinge ukuba ndimphendulele ntoni lowo wamthumelayo.
Wathi uDavide kuGadi, Ndikwingozi enkulu kakhulu; mna ke ndifane ngesandla sikaYehova; ngokuba uxolo lwakhe lukhulu kakhulu; mna ke andifane ngesandla somntu.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathumela izifo ezinkulu kumaSirayeli; kwafa amawaka amashumi asixhenxe eSirayeli.

Wathumela uThixo isithunywa, ukuba sibulala iYerusalem. Ke kaloku, xa isithunywa saqala ukusibulala, iNkosi wabona, waba neentloni ngenxa yobubi; wathi ke kwisithunywa esibulala abantu, Kulungile! Yima ngoku. Iingelosi zikaYehova zathi zisecaleni kwendawo yokuhlambela ka-Ornani umYebhusheti.

Wakhupha uDavide amehlo akhe, wabona isithunywa sikaYehova sihlala phakathi komhlaba nezulu, sinekrele elixhonyweyo esandla sakhe, libekwe phezu kweYerusalem. UDavide nabasemagunyeni bakhe, begqoke iinwele ezingwevu, bawela phantsi ngobuso babo emhlabeni.

Wathi uDavide kuThixo, Andinguye na mna lowo wathetha ukuba babalolwe abantu? Ndiye ke mna owenza isono, ndiyenze into engalunganga; kodwa le ndoda ifana nengulube. Bakwenza ntoni na? Nkosi yam, Thixo wam, sandla sakho sihlale kum, nosapho lwam; ingabikho loo ntlungu ebantwini bakho.
Wathi ke umthunywa kaYehova kuGadi, ukuba athethe noDavide, athi: Yiya uyeke ukwakha isibingelelo kuYehova kwindawo yokubeka izityalo ka-Ornani umYebhusi.
Wanyuka ke uDavide, njengoko wathethayo uGadi ngegama likaThixo.
Ke kaloku u-Ornani wayethembisa ingqolowa; wajika, wabona isithunywa, yena nonyana bakhe ababini ababenam, bafihlakele.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide efika, uOrhana wajonge, wambona. Waphuma ke uOrhana esidlangalaleni, wayalela uDavide ngobuso bakhe emhlabeni.
Wathi uDavide ku-Aron, Yithengise kum eli gumbi lokuhlambela, ndiyixelise phezu kwalo isibingelelo sikaYehova; uyithengise kum ngexabiso elipheleleyo, ukuze liphele isifo phakathi kwabantu.

Wathi uAron kuDavide, Yazi; nkosi yam ukumkani ayenze into elungileyo emlonyeni wakhe. Khangela, ndiya kukunika iintombi ukuba zibe ziintsontelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, neengxowa zokuthambisa ukuba zibe yimithi yomlilo, nengqolowa ukuba ibe ngumnikelo wokudla; ndiya kuzinika zonke.
Wathi ke ukumkani uDavide ku-Ornani, Hayi, ndiya kunika ixabiso elipheleleyo; andiyi kuthatha into yakho, ndiyinike kuYehova; andiyi kunikela ngesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, esingabikho xabiso kum.
Ke kaloku uDavide wamnika uOrhana ikhilogram ezisixhenxe zegolide ngenxa yendawo.

Wakha uDavide khona isibingelelo kuYehova, wanikela khona izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo. Wabiza iNkosi, wamphendula ke iNkosi ngomlilo osuka emlilweni, waya kwisibingelelo esiqhutywa ngamanzi.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kwisithunywa; sabuyela isithunywa ikrele lakhe emlonyeni wayo.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide ebona ukuba iNkosi wamphendula kumhlaba wokukhulisa imbewu ka-Orhana umYebhusi, wanikela khona izibingelelo.
Ke kaloku itabernakele kaYehova, awayeyenza uMoses entlango, nesibingelelo sesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, sakuba ngelo xesha kwindawo ephakamileyo yaseGibheyon.
Ke kaloku uDavide akakwazanga kungena khona, ukuba abuze uThixo; ngokuba wayexhalabile ngenxa yeqhosha lesithunywa sikaYehova.
Wathi ke uDavide, Le yindawo apho ibekwe khona indlu kaYehova uThixouThixo, le yindawo apho ibekwe khona isibingelelo somnikelo wokushiswa kwaSirayeli.
Wathi ke uDavide, ukuba bahlangane abakhenkethi abahlala eSirayeli; wabamisela phakathi kwabo abagcini-dlelo, ukuba bathabathe iithayile zokwakha indlu kaThixo.
Ke kaloku uDavide wanikela intsimbi eninzi, ukuba ibe ziinkuni, nezixhobo zodonga lweengcango; nobhedu ngaphezu kobunzima.
Wanikela iinkuni zeediliya ezininzi, ezingalinganiswanga; ngokuba abantu bakaSidon noTire babethumelela uDavide iidiliya ezininzi.

Wathi uDavide, USolomon unyana wam ungumntwana, akakwazi ukucinga; ke loo ndlu ekufuneka ibekwe kuYehova kufuneka ibe mkhulu kakhulu, ibe negama elikhulu, ibe nomtsalane kumahlabathi onke; ngoko ndiza kuyilungiselela izinto. Wayilungiselela ke uDavide izinto ezininzi phambi kokuba afe.
Wabiza uSolomon, unyana wakhe, wamwisela umthetho ukuba asebenze indlu kuYehova uThixo kaSirayeli.
Wathi uDavide kuSolomon, Unyana wam, ndenze isigqibo sokwakha indlu igama likaYehova uThixo wam.

Ke kaloku kwafika igama likaYehova kum, lisithi, Ukhuphe igazi elikhulu kakhulu, wahlasela imikhosi emininzi; awusayi kwakha indlu igama lam; ngokuba ukhuphe igazi elikhulu phezu komhlaba phambi kwam.

Ke kaloku uya kuba nonyana oza kuba ngumntu woxolo; ndiya kumnika uxolo kuzo zonke izitha zakhe ezijikelezayo. Igama lakhe liza kuba nguSolomon; ndiya kumnika uxolo noxolo kumaSirayeli ngexesha lokumkani wakhe.
yena uya kwakha indlu igama lam; yena uya kuba ngunyana wam, mna ndiya kuba ngumzali wakhe; ndiza kuqinisa isithsaba sokumkani kwakhe phezu kwaSirayeli kude kube sekupheleni.
Ke ngoko, mntwana wam, iNkosi abe nawe, akusebenzele kakuhle; wenze indlu kaYehova uThixo wakho, njengokuba wathi.
UYehova akunike ubulumko nokuqonda, aze akumise phezu kwaSirayeli, ukuze ugcine umthetho kaYehova uThixo wakho.
Uza kuphumelela, ukuba ugcine ukuzenza izithembiso nemithetho kaYehova, awawisela uMoses ebantwini bakaSirayeli; ube namandla, ube nobubele, ungabikho nomonde, ungabikho nomsindo.

Ke mna ndisebenzele ukulungiselela indlu kaYehova, izigidi ezilishumi elinambini zeetoni zegolide, nezigidi ezimashumi mathathu anesihlanu zeetoni zesilivere, nobhedu nentsimbi ezingenakuthelekiswa nanto; ndalungiselela namatye namatye, nawe uzidibanise.
Unabo abasebenzayo abaninzi, abemi bethayile, abemi bezindlu, abemi bezindlu zentsimbi, nabasebenzi bonke abaqeqeshiweyo kwimisebenzi yonke.
Igolide, nesilivere, nobhedu, nentsimbi, zininzi kakhulu, zingalinganiswanga; ngoko ke zinikele kuloo nto; iNkosi abe nawe.
Wathi uDavide kubo bonke abathetheli bakaSirayeli, ukuba bancedise kuSolomon unyana wakhe; wathi kubo,
UYehova, uThixo wakho, akakho nawe na? Wakukunika uxolo ngazo zonke iinkalo zakho; wabeka abantu belizwe eli phantsi kwam; ngoku ke eli lizwe likwisandla soYehova nesonka sakhe.

Ke ngoko, misela intliziyo yakho nomphefumlo wakho ukuba ulandele iNkosi uThixo wakho; uyeke, wenze indawo engcwele kaYehova uThixo wenu, niyingenise ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova, nezithuthi ezingcwele zikaThixo, kwitempile eza kubekwa igama likaYehova.
Ke kaloku, xa uDavide waba mkhulu, ephila ubomi obude nobulumko, wenza uSolomon unyana wakhe ukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
Wazihlanganisa bonke abathetheli bakaSirayeli, nababingeleli, nabaLevi.
AbaLevi abaneminyaka emashumi mathathu ubudala nangaphezulu, baba ngamawaka alishumi elinambini anamakhulu asixhenxe.
Wathi uDavide, Abamashumi amabini anane amawaka kubo baya kuba ngabaphathi bemisebenzi yendlu kaYehova; amawaka amathandathu aya kuba ngamagqwetha namagwebi.
Amawaka amane azokuba ngabakhuseli beengcango; amawaka mane aza kukhumbuza iNkosi ngezixhobo zam zokudlala, endizilungiselele ukuba zikhutshwe.
Ke kaloku uDavide wabahlula amaLevi ngamaqela, ngokweefama zabantwana bakaLevi: nguGershoni noKehati noMerariya.
Kubantwana bakaGershoni: uLadan noShimehi.
ULadan wayeneenonyana abathathu: uYehiyeli owayengumlawuli, noZethamu, noYoweli.
Oonyana bakaShimeyi babethathu: uShelomothi, noHaziyeli, noHarani; abo babengamadoda amakhulu eentsapho zikaLadan.
Oonyana bakaShimehi: uYahati, noZina, noYeushe, noBeriya. Abo baneenyana zikaShimehi.
UYahati waba ngukumkani, uSiza waba yisibini; ke kaloku uYehushi noBeriya babengenabantwana abaninzi; ngoko ke babalwa ndawonye njengendlu yosapho elinye, ngemisebenzi enye.
Oonyana bakaKehati babelishumi elinambini: nguAmram, noIshar, noHebron, noUziyele.

Oonyana baka-Amram: uAron noMoses. UAron nosapho lwakhe babekwa phantsi, ukuba babe zingcwele kakhulu ngonaphakade, ukuba basindise inkunzi yenkomo phambi koYehova, ukuba bamkhonze, ukuba babambisene igama lakhe ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku oonyana bakaMoses, umntu kaThixo, babalwa phakathi kwesizwe sikaLevi.
Oonyana bakaMoses: uGershoni noEliyezere.
Oonyana bakaGershoni, uShebuyeli waba ngukumkani wabo.
Waba nguRehabhi, unyana kaEliyezere. UEliyezere akazange abe nendodana enye; ke kaloku uRehabhi wayenendodana eninzi kakhulu.
Oonyana baka-Ishar, nguShelomithi.
Oonyana bakaHebron: uYeriya owayengumlawuli, noAmariya owamnye, noYahaziyeli owomthathu, noJekameyam owesine.
Oonyana baka-Uziyeli: uMika owayengumlawuli, noIshiya owamnye.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uMaheli noMushi; oonyana bakaMaheli: uEleazar noKishi.
Ke kaloku uEleyazare wafa, angabakho noonyana bakhe; waba neentombi, zaba ngumfazi kumadodakazi abo oonyana bakaKisi.
UMushi waba neentombi ezintathu: uMaheli, noEdere, noYeremote.

Baye ke abo oonyana bakaLevi ngezindlu zabazali babo, abezikhulu zeentsapho zabo, ngokubhalwa kwamagama abo, babalwa ngoonobumba babo; babeminyaka imashumi mabini ezelwe nangaphezulu, besenza umsebenzi wokukhonza endlwini kaYehova.
Ke kaloku uDavide wathi, UYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, wanika abantu bakhe ukuphumla; uya kuhlala eYerusalem ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku abaLevi abasondelelanga ukuthabatha itabernakele, nazo zonke izinto ezisetyenziswayo kuyo.
Ngomthetho wokugcina kaDavide, babalwa ooLevi abaneminyaka emashumi mabini nangaphezulu.

Umsebenzi wabo waba kukuncedisa oonyana baka-Aron, ekusebenzeni kwendlu kaYehova; babeziphatha izitrato, nezindlu zecala, nokucoca zonke izinto ezingcwele, neminye imisebenzi yokusebenza kwendlu kaThixo.

Babephethe isonka esingcwele esibekwe phezu kwetafile, nobusi olubomvu olulungiselelwe izipho zesonka, neentyatyambo ezenziwenga ubisi, nezitya zokupheka, nokuxuba, nazo zonke izinto zokulinganisa ngobukhulu.
Ke kaloku, ukuba bahlale mihla ngemihla emnqamlezweni, bethandazela nokusikelela iNkosi; nokuba njalo mihla ngemihla emini.

Bancedisa ngazo zonke izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngomlilo kuYehova, kwiintsuku zokuphumla, neentlanganiso zenyanga entsha, nakwezinye imihla emiselweyo; bakhonza phambi koYehova ngokuqhubekayo, ngokwenani elifunekayo ngokwemithetho.
Ke kaloku amaLevi athathe ulawulo lwetenki yokuhlangana, nendawo engcwele; bancedise nabazalwana babo, oonyana bakaAron, ekusebenzeni kwendlu kaYehova.
Ezi ziintsapho zabantwana baka-Aron: oonyana baka-Aron nguNadab, no-Abhihu, no-Eleazar, no-Ithamari.
Ke kaloku uNadabhi noAbhihu bafa phambi kokufa kukayise wabo; abazange babenabantwana. UElezare noItamari ke babe ngababingeleli.
Ke kaloku uDavide wabahlula, ngesandla sikaSadoko, umntwana ka-Elazare, noAhileleki, umntwana ka-Itamari, yaba ziindidi zomsebenzi wabo.

Baninzi oonyana baka-Elazar abathetheli, kunabo oonyana baka-Ithamari; ngoko ke bahlukaniswa ngale ndlela: oonyana baka-Elazar babe ngabathetheli beentsapho ezilishumi elinambini, oonyana baka-Ithamari babe ngabathetheli beentsapho ezisibhozo.
Babahlukanise ngokulinganayo, bathabathe iinqununu; ngokuba kwabakho abaphathi bendawo engcwele, nabaphathi bakaThixo, phakathi kwabantwana bakaElazare noItamare.

UShemaya unyana kaNethaneli, umbhali, umLevi, wabhala amagama abo phambi kokumkani, nabaphathi, noTsadoki umbingeleli, noAhileleki unyana kaAbhiyathari, namadoda amakhulu eentsapho zezinto ezingcwele zababingeleli, nabaLevi; kwathiwa ngoqhawulo-mtshato intsapho nganye nguElezare, intsapho nganye nguItamari.
Inqununu yokuqala yaba nguYoyaribhi, yesibini ibe nguYedayayi;
wesithathu kuHarim, wesixhenxe kuSheorim,
isihlanu nguMalkiya, isithandathu nguMiyamini,
wesixhenxe kuHakoshe, wesibhozo kuAbiya,
yesithoba kuYeshua, yesixhenxe kuShekaniya,
yeshumi elinesibini kuEliyasibhi, yeshumi elinesibini kuYakimi,
ishumi elinesithathu likaHupha, ishumi elinesine likaYeshebhebhab,
eleshumi elinesihlanu likaBhilega, leshumi elinesithandathu kaImere,
ishumi elinesibhozo kuHeziri, ishumi elinesibhozo kuHappizezi,
elishumi elinethoba likaPethahiya, elimashumi mabini likaYehezkele,
elimashumi mabini ananye likaYakhini, elimashumi mabini anambini likaGamuli,
elimashumi mabini anathathu likaDelaya, elimashumi amabini anane likaMahaziya.
Ke kaloku lo mmiselo wabo wokukhonza, xa bengena endlwini kaYehova; bahamba ngokwemiyalelo kaAron, utata wabo, njengoko iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, abemwisele umthetho.
La maqela amanye oonyana bakaLevi: kubantwana bakaAmram, uShubhayeli; kubantwana bakaShubhayeli, uYedeyiya.
Ngabo oonyana bakaRehabiya, uIshiya, owayengumlawuli.
KwabaYisareyi kwaba nguShelomoti, kwaba oonyana bakaShelomoti kwaba nguYahati.
Oonyana bakaHebroni: uYeriya ophambili, noAmariya wesibini, noYahaziyeli wesithathu, noJekameyam wesine.
Unyana ka-Uziyeli nguMika; kunyana bakaMika ke uShamire.
Unyana kaMika waba nguIshiya; kubo oonyana bakaIshiya kwaba nguZekariya.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uMaheli noMushi; unyana kaYahaziya nguBheno.
Oonyana bakaMerariya, abasuka kuYahaziya: nguBheno, noShoham, noZakur, noIbri.
KuMaheli wazalwa uEleazar, akabikho kuye oonyana.
KuKishi kwaba nguYerameyeli unyana kaKishi.
Oonyana bakaMushi: uMaheli, noEdere, noYerimothi. Aba baLevi ababhalwa ngokweentsapho zabo.

Bathi ke nabo, njengokuba abahlobo babo oonyana baka-Aron, bathabathe iinqununu phambi kokumkani uDavide, noTsadoki, noAhileleki, namadoda amakhulu eentsapho zabazalwana ababingeleli nabaLevi. Iintsapho zodade omkhulu zazifana neentsapho zodade omncinci.

Ke kaloku uDavide, namadoda amakhulu emkhosini, bamisa abanye oonyana bakaAsafe, noHeman, noYeduthuni, ukuba babe ngabaprofeti, bedlala ngee-harp, ne-lyra, nee-cymbals. Eli linani lamadoda asebenza kuloo msebenzi:
Oonyana baka-Asafe: uZakhuri, noYosefu, noNethaniya, noAsarelaya; bona babe phantsi kolawulo luka-Asafe, abaprofetisa phantsi kolawulo lukakumkani.

Oonyana bakaYeduthuni: uGedaliya, noZeri, noYeshaya, noShimeyi, noHashabhiya, noMatithiya, abasithandathu bonke; babe phantsi kolawulo lukaYedutun, uyise wabo, oprofetisa ngeebhayisikile, ukubonga nokuzinikela iNkosi.
Oonyana bakaHeman: uBhukukiya, noMatania, noUziyele, noShebuyeli, noYerimothi, noHananiya, noHanani, noEliyata, noGiddaliti, noRomamthi-Ezere, noYosbekasha, noMalothi, noHotiri, noMahaziyothi.
Ke kaloku abo bonke baba oonyana bakaHeman, umprofeti wokumkani; uThixo wathetha ukuba amqinise; ke uThixo wamnika uHeman oonyana abalishumi elinambini, neentombi ezintathu.

Bonke la madoda aphantsi kolawulo lwabafazi babo, bedlala iingoma endlwini kaYehova, bedlala ngee-cymbals, nee-harps, nee-harp, ekusebenzeni kwendlu kaThixo; uAsafe noYeduthuni noHeman baphantsi kolawulo lukakumkani.
Bonke abo, nabo abazalwana babo, abaqeqeshiweyo, abakwaziyo ukubiza iNkosi; babe ngamawaka amabini anamashumi asibhozo anesibhozo.
Bonke bakhupha iziqendu zomsebenzi wabo, abancinci nabadala ngokufanayo, umfundi nomfundi.
Inqununu yokuqala kaAsafe yaphuma kuYosefu; inqununu yesibini yaphuma kuGedaliya, naye nabazalwana bakhe oonyana bakhe, abalishumi elinambini.
Isithathu saphuma kuZakhuri; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Isihlanu saphuma kuYizrehi; yena, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, baba lishumi elinambini.
Isihlanu saphuma kuNethaniya; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Isithandathu saphuma kuBhukukiya; yena, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Wayesixhenxe uYasarela; yena, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Wayesibhozo uYeshaya; yena, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Elithoba lafika kuMatania; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe babelishumi elinambini.
Ishumi lafika kuShimehi; yena, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Ishumi elinanye laphuma kuAzareli; yena, noonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinamibini.
ishumi elinesibini likaHashabiya; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe babelishumi elinambini.
Ishumi elinesibhozo laphuma kuShubhayeli; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
ishumi elinesine lafika kuMatithiya; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe babelishumi elinambini.
Ishumi elinesihlanu lafika kuYeremote; yena, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Ishumi elinesithandathu lafika kuHananiya; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe babelishumi elinambini.
Ishumi elinesibhozo lafika kuYoshebhekasha; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Ishumi elinesibhozo laphuma kuHanani; yena, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Ishumi elinethoba lafika kuMalothi; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Elishumi elinambini lafika kuEliyata; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinamibini.
Elimashumi mabini ananye lafika kuHothire; yena, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Elimashumi mabini anesibini lafika kuGiddaliti; yena nonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Elimashumi mabini anathathu lafika kuMahasiyothi; oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe babelishumi elinambini.
Elimashumi mabini anane lafika kuRomamthi-Ezere; yena, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, babelishumi elinambini.
Ezi ziindidi zabagwebi; kwaba Korahi nguMeshelemiya unyana kaKore, waba oonyana bakaAsaphe.
Oonyana bakaMeshelemiya: uZekariya umzali, uYediyayeli wesithathu, uZebadia wesithathu, uYatniel wesine;
uElam wesihlanu, noYohanan wesithandathu, noEliyehoyeni wesibhozo.
Oonyana baka-Obedi-Edom: uShemaya owayengumntwana wokuqala, noYozabad owayenguwesibini, noYoha owayenguwesithathu, noShakare owayenguwesine, noNethaneli owayenguwesihlanu;
uAmriyeli wesixhenxe, noIssakare wesixhenxe, noPehulletayi wesibhozo. UThixo wayemsindise uObedi-Edom ngokuqinisekileyo.
UShemaya unyana wakhe wayenabantwana; babe ngamadoda amakhulu eentsapho zabo, ngokuba bebengamadoda anamandla.
Oonyana bakaShemaya: uOthni, noRefayeli, noObhedi, noElzabadi; nabazalwana babo, uElihu noSemakiya, amadoda anamandla.
Bonke abo babantwana baka-Obedi-Edom, nabo oonyana babo nabazalwana babo, amadoda anamandla omsebenzi; babe ngamawaka angamashumi asixhenxe anesibini ku-Obedi-Edom.
Ke kaloku uMeshelemiya wayeneenonyana abalishumi elinesibhozo, nabazalwana bakhe, amadoda anamandla.
Kwabakho oonyana kuHosa, omnye wabaMerariya: uShimri wayeyinkokeli; naye akazange abe ngumzali omkhulu, kodwa ubaba wakhe wammisela ukuba abe yinkokeli.
UHilkiya wesibini, uTebaliya wesithathu, noZekariya wesixhenxe; oonyana bakaHosa nabahlobo bakhe bonke babelishumi elinambini.
La maqela oovimba, ngamadoda abo aphambili, abe nemisebenzi yokukhonza endlwini kaYehova, njengokuba babeyenza abahlobo babo.
Bakhupha iinqununu ngeengcango nganye, ngosapho lwazo, abancinci nabadala.
Ikhefu lesango lasempumalanga lafika kuShelemiya; babeka ke ikhefu lonyana wakhe uZekariya, umcebisi owaziyo izinto; lifike kuye ikhefu lesango lasentshona.
Isango elisemazantsi lafika ku-Obedi-Edom; igumbi lokugcina litaki lafika kubo oonyana bakhe.
Isango laseNtshona, nesango laseShalekethi, elunxwemeni oluphezulu, lafika kuShuphim noHosa. Abagwebi babekwa ndawonye.
AbaLevi abalishumi elinambini babehlala mihla ngemihla ngasempumalanga, ababini ngasentshonalanga, ababini ngasemzantsi, ababini ngaxeshanye endlwini yokugcina.
Kwindlu yangasemva ecaleni lasentshonalanga, kwakukho ezine kwindlela kunye nesibini kwindlu nganye.
Ezi ziindidi zabakhuseli beengcango, zabantwana bakaKorha nakwaMerariya.
Abazalwana babo abaLevi, uAhiya ephetheyo, babe ngabaphathi beekhabhathi zendlu kaThixo, neekhabhathi zeempawu ezinikezelwe kuThixo.
Oonyana bakaLadani, ooGershoni abasuka kuLadani, abe ngamadoda amakhulu eentsapho zikaLadani uGershoni: nguYehiyeli.
Oonyana bakaYehileli, uZethamu noYoweli umzalwana wakhe, babe ngabasebenzi beekhabhathi zendlu kaYehova.
Kwabafazi baka-Amram, noIshar, noHebron, noUziel;
UShebuyeli, umntwana kaGershoni unyana kaMoses, waba ngukumkani wezinto ezigcinwe endlwini.
Abahlobo bakhe ngoEliyezere, nguRehabiya unyana kaEliyezere, noYeshaya unyana kaRehabiya, noYoram unyana kaYeshaya, noZikri unyana kaYoram, noShelomothi unyana kaZikri.

Ke kaloku uShelomothi nabazalwana bakhe babe ngabaphathi beekhabhinethi zonke zezinto ezinikezelweyo kuThixo, ezinikezelwe ngukumkani uDavide, ngamadoda amakhulu eentsapho, ngamagqwetha amawaka namawaka, ngamagqwetha omkhosi.
Baye banikela ezinye zezinto ezilahlekileyo emkhosini, ukuba zilungiswe indlu kaYehova.

Zonke izinto azenzayo uSamuweli umprofeti, noSawule unyana kaKishi, noAbheri unyana kaNeri, noYowabhi unyana kaSeruya, zabekwa kuThixo; nazo zonke izinto azenzayo wonke umntu, zaba phantsi kwesandla sikaShelomothi nabahlobo bakhe.
Kubo ooIzahari: uKenaniya noonyana bakhe, abanikezelwe umsebenzi wendlu kaThixo; babe ngabaphathi nabagwebi kumaSirayeli.

Kumadoda aseHebhoni, uHashabiya nobazalwana bakhe, amadoda anamandla, amawaka amathathu anamakhulu asixhenxe, babe ngabaphathi kumaSirayeli ngaselwandle lweYorodani, ekwenzeni yonke imisebenzi kaYehova, nokukhonza ukumkani.

Kumadoda aseHebhoni, uYerehiya waba ngukumkani, ngokweencwadi zeentsapho zabo. Ngomnyaka wesine wesixhenxe wokumkani kukaDavide, kwafunyanwa ezi ncwadi, kwafunyanwa kubo amadoda anamandla okulwa eYaseri, eGiliyadi.

Ke kaloku uYerehiya wayeneentsapho ezilishumi elinambini, madoda anamandla, abezikhulu zeentsapho. Ukumkani uDavide wababeka phezu kwaRubhen noGadi, naphezu kweentsapho zakwaManase, kuwo onke amatyala kaThixo nokumkani.

Ke kaloku eli linani lamadoda aseSirayeli asebenza kukumkani, abezikhulu zeentsapho zabazali babo, nabaphathi bamawaka, nabaphathi bamawaka, nabaphathi babo, abakhonzayo ukumkani ngazo zonke izinto, ngokwemikhosi yabo ephumayo neyafikayo inyanga ngenyanga, iminyaka yonke; iqela ngalinye libe ngamawaka amabini anane.
Kwiqela lokuqala lenyanga yokuqala, kwaba nguYashobheyam unyana kaZabediyeli; kuluhlu lwakhe babe ngamawaka amabini anane.
Waba ngabantwana bakaPerezi, waba ngukumkani kubo bonke abathetheli bomkhosi ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga.
Kwiqela lakhe lenyanga yesibini kwaba nguDodayi, umAhohati; kuluhlu lwakhe uMiklothi waba ngukumkani; kumacandelo akhe babe ngamawaka amabini anane.
Umkhosi wesithathu wenyanga yesithathu uBhenaya, unyana kaYehoyada ukumkani; kuhlangatyezwana nalo amawaka amashumi mabini anane.
Lo ke uBhenaya, waba ngumntu onamandla phakathi kwabathathu, waba ngukumkani kubo abathathu; emkhosini wakhe uAmrizabadi unyana wakhe.
Wesine kunyaka wesine uAshayeli, umzalwana kaYowabhi; emva kwakhe uZebadia unyana wakhe; kumaqela akhe kwaba ngamawaka amashumi amabini anane.
Umkhosi wakhe waba ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu asixhenxe; umkhosi wakhe waba ngamawaka amane anamashumi amabini anane.
Wesithandathu kunyaka wesixhenxe uIra unyana ka-Ikeshe, waseTekoa; kumaqela akhe kwaba ngamawaka amabini anane.
Umlawuli wesixhenxe wenyanga yesixhenxe uHelezi umPheloni, waseSizwe sikaEfrayim; kumaqela akhe kwaba ngamawaka amashumi amabini anane.
Umpostile wesibhozo wenyanga yesibhozo uShibhakayi, umHushathi, waseZera; kumaqela akhe kwaba ngamawaka amashumi amabini anane.
Umphathi wesithoba wenyanga yesithoba nguAbhiezer waseAnathothi, waseBhenjamin; kumaqela akhe kwaba ngamawaka amabini anane.
Umphathi wesixhenxe wenyanga yesixhenxe wayenguMaharayi waseNetofa, wabaSera; kumaqela akhe kwaba ngamawaka amabini anane.
Weshumi elinesibini kunyaka weshumi elinesibini uBhenaya, umPirathoni, wesizwe samaEfrayim; kumaqela akhe kwaba ngamawaka amabini anane.
Weshumi elinesibini lonyaka weshumi elinesibini uHeldayi waseNetofa, wakwaOthniyeli; kumaqela akhe kwaba ngamawaka amashumi amabini anane.
Ke kaloku, aba babini babe ngabathetheli bezizwe zakwaSirayeli: kuRubhen uEliyezere unyana kaZikri; kuSimeon uShefatia unyana kaMahaka;
kuLevi nguHashabiya unyana kaKemuyeli; kubantwana baka-Aron nguTsadoko;
ngoYuda nguElihu, omnye wabahlobo bakaDavide; ngoIssakare nguOmri unyana kaMikayeli;
kuZabulon nguIshmaya unyana kaObadi; kuNafetali nguYeremote unyana kaAzriel;
ngoEfrayim, uHosheya unyana ka-Azaziya; ngaphesheya kwesizwe sikaManase, uYoweli unyana kaPedaya;
kwishumi lesizwe sikaManase eGiliyadi, nguIdo unyana kaZekariya; kuBhenjamin uYashiyeli unyana kaAbheri;
NgaseDan, nguAzareli unyana kaYeroham. Baye ke abo abathetheli bezizwe zikaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uDavide akayi kubala abo babeminyaka imashumi mabini ezelwe nangaphantsi; ngokuba iNkosi wayethe wathetha ukuba uza kwenza amaSirayeli abe ngamaninzi njengeenkwenkwezi ezulu.

UYowabhi, unyana kaSeruhiya, waqala ukubabala, kodwa akawugqibi; kuba kwafika ingqwalasela kuSirayeli ngenxa yokubalwa kwabo. Ke kaloku inani labo lonke alibhalwanga kwincwadi yeziganeko zikaDavide ukumkani.
UAzmawethe unyana kaAdiyeli waba ngukumkani weendawo zokugcina izinto; uYonathan unyana ka-Uziya waba ngukumkani weendawo zokugcina izinto ezisemaphandleni, ezimizini, nezixeko, nakwiintlambo.
Waye nguEzri unyana kaKelubi, waba ngumphathi wabo bonke abasemagunyeni, abasebenza ilizwe.
UShimeyi waseRama wayesezindulini; uZabdi, umSifemi, waba yindawo yokugcina iwayini yezindulini.
UBhaale-Hanan waseGeder wayeyingqongqoshe yezityalo zeoli kunye nezityalo zezinkomo ezisentshonalanga; uYowashe wayeyingqongqoshe yezityalo zeoli.
UShitrayi waseSharon waba ngukumkani wezinto eziphilayo ezidla imbewu eSharon; uShafati unyana ka-Adlai waba ngukumkani wezinto eziphilayo ezintabeni.
U-Obile, umIshmayeli, waba ngukumkani weempendulo; uYedeya, umMeronothi, waba ngukumkani weebhokhwe; uYazisi, umHagiriti, waba ngukumkani weemvu.
Bonke labo babe ngabaphathi bezinto zakwaDavide ukumkani.
Ke kaloku uYonatan, umyeni kaDavide, wayengumcebisi, ngumntu owaziyo, nombhali. UYehiyeli unyana kaHakmoni waba ngungqongqoshe weenyana zikakumkani.
UAhitofele wayengumcebisi wokumkani; uHushai, umArkiti, waba ngumhlobo womkani.
Emva kuka-Ahitofele kwakukho uYehoyada unyana kaBhenaya, noAbhiyatare; uYowabhi ke waba ngukumkani womkhosi wokumkani.

Ke kaloku uDavide wabiza bonke abathetheli bakaSirayeli eYerusalem; wababiza oothixo bezizwe, nabaphathi bamaqela asebenza kukumkani, nabaphathi bamawaka, nabaphathi kwamawaka, nabaphathi beempahla zonke, nezilwane zonke eziye zabakhoyo kumkani nabantwana bakhe, nabaphathi bendlu kakumkani, namadoda amakhulu, namadoda onke anamandla.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uDavide wenyuka, wathi, Ndixeleleni, bazalwana bam, abantu bam; ndacinga ukuba ndivule indlu ibe yindawo yokuphumla yesithunywa somnqophiso kaYehova, ibe yindawo yokubeka izandla zoThixo wethu; ndacinga ukuba ndiyivule.
Ke kaloku uThixo wandithi, Awuyi kwakha indlu igama lam; ngokuba ungumntu wemfazwe, uye wasusa igazi.

Ke kaloku iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, wandikhethela endlwini yam yonke, ukuba ndibe ngukumkani kumaSirayeli ngonaphakade; wakhetha unyana kaYuda ukuba abe ngukumkani, waza wakhetha ezweni likaYuda ikhaya loyise wam; kwathi kubo bonke oonyana boyise wam, wathandazela ukuba ndibe ngukumkani kumaSirayeli onke.
UYehova wandinika oonyana abaninzi; kubo bonke wakhetha uSolomon, unyana wam, ukuba ahlale phezu kwetrone yobukumkani bukaYehova phezu kwaSirayeli.
Wathi kum, USolomon unyana wakho uya kwakha indlu yam, nezitrato zam; ndimkhethile ukuba abe ngunyana wam, mna ndiya kuba ngumntwana wakhe.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba ubukumkani bakhe buhlale ubomi bonke, ukuba uqhubeka esenza imimiselo yam nemimiselo yam, njengokuba eyenza ngoku.

Ke ngoko ngoku, phambi koSirayeli wonke, isibingelelo soYehova, emlonyeni kaThixo wethu, gcinani ukuba nizigcine zonke imithetho kaYehova uThixo wenu; ukuze niyigcine le lizwe lilungileyo, nilishiye kubantwana benu emva kwenu, kude kube sekupheleni.

Ke wena, ntwana wam uSolomon, wazi uThixo kayise wakho, umkhonze ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nomphefumlo othandazelayo; ngokuba iNkosi ubona intliziyo zonke, waqonda zonke iimvakalelo neengcamango. Ukuba uya kumfuna, uya kufumaneka; kodwa ukuba uya kumshiya, uya kukutyhila kude kube sekupheleni.
Khumbula ukuba iNkosi ukukhethile wena, ukuba ube yindlu yakhe engcwele; ube namandla, wenze umsebenzi.

Ke kaloku uDavide wamnika uSolomon, unyana wakhe, imizobo yodonga lwendlu kaThixo, nemiboniso yayo, neendawo zayo zokugcina izinto, neendawo zayo eziphakamileyo, neendawo zayo zangaphakathi, negumbi lesakhelo sokumkani.

Wamnika iinkcazo zazo zonke izinto ezibeka uMoya engqondweni yakhe, zezindlu zangasemva zetempeli kaYehova, nazo zonke iigumbi ezijikelezayo kuyo, neekhabhathi zetempeli kaThixo, neekhabhathi zeempawu ezoyikiweyo zikaThixo.
Wathi ke uSolomon kuye, ngeendawo zababingeleli nabaseLevi, ngomsebenzi wonke wokusebenza endlwini kaYehova, ngazo zonke izinto ezisetyenziswayo ekusebenzeni kwayo.

Wathi kuye, Igolide ininzi kangakanani na, ukuba isetyenziswe kuzo zonke izinto zegolide ezisetyenziswayo kumsebenzi ngamnye; nesilivere ininzi kangakanani na, ukuba isetyenziswe kuzo zonke izinto zesilivere ezisetyenziswayo kumsebenzi ngamnye.

Wathi kuye igolide, ekufuneka isetyenziswe kwizityalo-mlilo zegolide, nezibane zazo, ngobunzima besityalo-mlilo ngasinye nesibane saso; wathi kuye nesilivere, ekufuneka isetyenziswe kwisityalo-mlilo ngasinye sesilivere, nesibane saso, ngokwemisebenzi yesityalo-mlilo ngasinye.
Wathi ke kuye, Inani legolide elifanele lisetyenziswe kwitafile nganye yeentlanzi ezilungiselelweyo, nenani lesilivere elifanele lisetyenziswe kwiitafile zesilivere.

Wathi ke kuye, Inani legolide elingenanto elifanele lisetyenziswe kwiibhotile zesonka, neebhotile zokubhaka, nezikhephe; Inani legolide nesilivere elifanele lisetyenziswe kwisitya ngasinye segolide nesitya ngasinye sesilivere.

Wathi ke kuye, Igolide ininzi kangakanani na ekufuneka isetyenziswe kwisibingelelo sokufakelwa umnqamlezo? Wathi ke kuye, Uhlobo luni lweemoto, iiKerubi zegolide ezisasaza amaphiko azo phezu kwentsiba yomnqophiso kaYehova?
Wathi uDavide, Zibhalwe kum zonke ezi zinto ngesandla sikaYehova; wandisela ukuba ndiqonde yonke into ethethwayo.

Wathi ke uDavide kuSolomon, unyana wakhe, Khumbula, ube nobubele, wenze umsebenzi; musa ukuxoka, ungabi nomsindo; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo, uThixo wam, uya kuba nawe; akakushiyelanga, akakushiyanga, de kugqitywe yonke imisebenzi yomsebenzi wendlu kaYehova.

Yabona, iindidi zababingeleli nabaLevi zilungiselelwe yonke imisebenzi yendlu kaThixo; nabani na othandazelayo, onobuchule ngazo zonke iintlobo zemisebenzi, uya kuhlala nawe; nabathetheli nabo bonke abantu baya kuzenza zonke izinto oziwiselayo.
Wathi ke ukumkani uDavide kuye onke amabandla, USolomon unyana wam, okhethiweyo nguThixo, ungumntwana, awazi nto; ke loo msebenzi omkhulu; ngokuba le ndlu ayibanjwa ngumntu; imele kuYehova uThixo.

Ndiye ndalungiselela ngesandla sam sonke, endlwini kaThixo wam, igolide yezinto zegolide, nesilivere yezinto zesilivere, nentsimbi yezinto zentsimbi engenasici, nentsimbi yezinto zentsimbi engenasici, nokhuni lwezinto zemithi; ndalungiselela namatye e-onyx, namatye okufakela, namatye akhanyayo anemibala emininzi, nazo zonke iintlobo zezityalo ezibalulekileyo, nemarble enkulu.

Ngapha koko konke oku, ngenxa yokuba ndiyayithanda indlu kaThixo wam, ndinika iimpahla zam zendlu yegolide nesilivere endlwini kaThixo wam; ngaphezu kwayo yonke into endiyilungiselele le ndlu ingcwele.
Ndiya kukunika igolide esuka eOfiri, izigidi ezilishumi zetoni, nesilivere ecocekileyo, izigidi ezimakhulu amabini anamashumi mane eetoni, ukuze zigubungele iindonga zezindlu;
nomsebenzi wonke wegolide nesilivere, oza kwenziwa ngabaqulunqi. Ke ngoko, ngubani na onqwenela ukunikela ngokwakhe kuYehova namhlanje?
Ke kaloku abathetheli beentsapho, nabathetheli bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, namagqwetha amawaka, namawaka, namagosa alawula imisebenzi kakumkani, banikela ngokucelayo.

Banikela, ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi wendlu kaThixo, izigidi ezilishumi elinamashumi asixhenxe zeetoni zegolide, namawaka alishumi elinesihlanu eetoni zegolide, nezigidi ezimakhulu amathathu anesithandathu zeetoni zesilivere, nezigidi ezimakhulu amathandathu aneshumi leetone zobhedu, nezigidi ezilishumi elinamakhulu mathathu eetone zentsimbi.
Nabani na obeneethayile ezibalulekileyo, wabanika kwindlu yokugcina idini likaYehova, ephantsi kolawulo lukaYehiyeli umGersoni.
Ke kaloku abantu bayavuya kakhulu, ngokuba abathetheli babo banikela ngokunyanisekileyo; babenika iNkosi ngentliziyo yabo yonke. Ukumkani uDavide wayevuya kakhulu.
UDavide wamthanda iNkosi phambi kwentlanganiso yonke, wathi, UThixo kaSirayeli, uyise wethu, ube luthando kuwe, Nkosi yethu, ukususela ngoku ukuya kuthi ga ngoku.

Kuwe, Nkosi, ubukhulu, nobunamandla, nobulumko, nokubhiyozela, nobuhle; zonke izinto ezikwizulu nezisehlabathini zize kuwe; kukuwe, Nkosi, ubukumkani; uphakame wena, ukuba ube ngukumkani phezu kwazo zonke.
Ubutyebi nobulumko buvela kuwe, nawe ulawula zonke izinto; ubutyebi nobunamandla bukwisandla sakho; wena owenza wonke umntu abe mkhulu, unika amandla onke amehlo.
Ke ngoko, Thixo wethu, siyakubonga thina, siwuthande igama lakho elingcwele.
Ndithini na ke mna, bathini na abantu bam, ukuba sikwazi ukunikela ngokucelayo njengokuba kunjalo? Zonke izinto zivela kuwe; siya kukunika isandla sakho.
Siya kuba phambi kwakho njengeendwendwe, neengxowa-mali, njengokuba babenjalo ooyise bethu bonke; iintsuku zethu emhlabeni zifana nesithunzi, azipheleli.
Nkosi yethu, Thixo wethu, onke la mandla ethu esiwalungiselele ukukwakha indlu igama lakho elingcwele, asuka esandla sakho; zizinto zakho zonke.

Ndiyazi, Thixo wam, ukuba uyivavanya intliziyo, uyamthanda umntu othembekileyo; ndazinika zonke ezi zinto ngokuthanda kwam, nobulungisa bentliziyo yam; ndiyabona ke ngoku, ndivuya, ukuba abantu bakho abakhoyo baya kukunikela kuwe.
UYehova, uThixo kaAbraham, noIsake, noSirayeli, abazalwana bethu, gcina le nto entliziyweni yabantu bakho ngonaphakade; ugcine intliziyo yabo ilungile kuwe.
Uncede ke uSolomon, unyana wam, ube nengqondo ethembekileyo ngokupheleleyo, ukuba agcine imigaqo yakho, nemimiselo yakho, nemimiselo yakho, abe nayo yonke into endiyilungiselele ngayo indlu.
Wathi ke uDavide kwintlanganiso yonke, Nceda ngoku niwuthande iNkosi uThixo wenu. Yawuthandazela ke intlanganiso yonke iNkosi uThixo wabafazi babo; bahlangula phambi koYehova nokumkani.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla olandelayo, banikela iinkunzi zeenkomo ezilishumi elinambini, neenkunzi zeegusha ezilishumi elinambini, nezimvu ezilishumi elinambini, nezibeleko ezilishumi elinambini kuYehova, nazo zonke iintsontelo zabo zokusela; kwakunye namadini amaninzi kuwo onke amaSirayeli.

Badla ke, basela ngaloo mini phambi koYehova, beyonwabile kakhulu. Bakwenza uSolomon, unyana kaDavide, waba ngukumkani wesibini; bawuphakisa phambi koYehova ukuba abe ngukumkani, bawuphakisa noTsadoki ukuba abe ngumbingeleli.
Wahlala ke uSolomon kwitrone kaYehova, waba ngukumkani endaweni kaDavide uyise; waphumelela; bonke amaSirayeli bamthobela.
Bonke oonyana bakakumkani uDavide, abathetheli bonke, namadoda amakhulu anamandla, bavuma ukumkani uSolomon.
Wakwenza iNkosi uSolomon abe mkhulu kakhulu ngamehlo onke amaSirayeli, wamnika ubukumkani obukhulu kunawo wonke ukumkani wamaSirayeli ongaphambili kwakhe.
UDavide unyana kaYese waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli onke.
Waye waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mane; eHebron waba neminyaka esixhenxe, eYerusalem waba minyaka imashumi mathathu anamithathu.
Wafa eneminyaka emininzi yobudala obuhle, ephila ubomi obude bemali nobulumko. USolomon unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Zonke izinto azenzayo ukumkani uDavide, ukususela ekuqalekeni kuye ekupheleni, zithe zabhalwe kwincwadi kaSamuweli umprofeti, nencwadi kaNathani umprofeti, nencwadi kaGadi umprofeti.
Ke kaloku konke ukumkani wakhe, nobutyebi bakhe, nezithembiso zakhe, nazo zonke izinto eziye zafika kuye, nakwaSirayeli, namakumkani onke eelizwe.
2Chr: Ke kaloku uSolomon, unyana kaDavide, waqinisa ubukumkani bakhe; iNkosi uThixo wakhe waba naye, wamnika amandla amakhulu.
Wathetha ke uSolomon kumaSirayeli onke, kubaphathi bamawaka, nabaphathi bamawaka, namagwebi, namadoda amakhulu onke aseSirayeli, abezikhulu zeentsapho.
Waye ke uSolomon, nombuki zindwendwe naye, kwindawo ephakamileyo eseGibheyon; kuba khona kwakukho itentile yokuhlangana kaThixo, intente eyayiyenziwa nguMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, esiqithi.
Ke kaloku uDavide wayesikhuphe isithunywa sikaThixo esisuka eKiriyati-yearimi, waya kwindawo ayeyilungiselela yona; wamisa itente kuyo eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku isibingelelo sentsimbi, ebesiyenze uBesaleyeli, unyana kaUri, unyana kaHuri, sakuba khona eGibheyon, phambi kwetenki kaYehova; waya khona ke uSolomon nebandla, bebuza iNkosi.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wanyuka waya kwisibingelelo sentsimbi phambi koYehova, entliziyweni yokuhlangana; wanikela phezu kwayo ngeentliziyo ezilishumi.
Ngobusuku balo, uThixo wabonakala kuSolomon, wathi kuye, Zicela oko ndiza kukunika wona.
Waphendula uSolomon uThixo wathi, Ukwenzele uDavide, uyise wam, ububele obukhulu nobuxoki; wandibeka mna njengomkumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ke ngoko, Thixo kaYehova, liqiniseke ke ngoku ilizwi lakho uDavide, uyise wam; ngokuba ungenza ndibe ngukumkani phezu kwabantu abaninzi njengamasuntswana ehlabathini.
Ndininike ubulumko nolwazi, ukuze ndikwazi ukuphuma ndiphume phakathi kwalabo bantu; kuba ngubani na oza kuphatha abo bantu bakho abaninzi?

Wathi uThixo kuSolomon, Le nto ikho entliziyweni yakho; awucelenga ubutyebi, namanzi acocekileyo, nobudumo, nokuba ubomi babo abo bakuxhaphazelayo, nawe wawucela iminyaka emide yobomi bakho. Uye wafuna ubulumko nenzululwazi, ukuze ube ngumgwebi kwaba bantu bam, endikwenza ngabo ukumkani.
Ndiya kukunika ubulumko nolwazi; ndiya kukunika nemali, nempahla, nobudumo, ngaphezu kwazo zonke izikumkani zangaphambili kwakho, nangaphezulu kwazo zonke izikumkani ezizayo emva kwakho.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wasuka kwindawo ephakamileyo yaseGibheyon, phambi kwetenki yokuhlangana, waya eYerusalem; waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli.
USolomon wathabatha iinqanawa, namakhwenkwe; waba nezigidi ezilishumi elinamakhulu amane einqwelo-moya, namawaka alishumi elinamibini amakhwenkwe. Wazibeka emizini yeengqekembe, naye eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wenza isilivere negolide zibe zininzi eYerusalem, njengezithako; nemithi yesedari ibe yizininzi, njengokuba zininzi izityalo zenkomo ezisemazantsi.
Iingelosi zikaSolomon zavela eYiputa, naseKuwe; abarhwebi bakakumkani bathenga kuzo eKuwe.

Bezithutha iinqanawa ezisuka eYiputa, ngamakhulu amathandathu eeshekeli zesilivere enye nganye, neemahashe ngamakhulu amahlanu nganye nganye; babezithengisa ke kuzo zonke izikumkani zakwaHeti, nezikumkani zaseAram.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wagqiba ukuba enze indlu igama likaYehova, nendlu yokumkani kuye.

Wakhetha amadoda angamashumi asixhenxe amawaka, ukuba abe ngabagcini-mpahla, namadoda angamashumi asibhozo amawaka, ukuba abe ngamagqabi entaba, namadoda angamakhulu amathathu, anamakhulu amathandathu, ukuba abe ngabaphathi kubo.
USolomon wamthumelela uHiram ukumkani waseTire, esithi, Ndithumelele iithayile zeediliya, njengokuba wazenza kuDavide uyise wam, xa wayeyila indlu yakhe ukuba ahlale kuyo.

Ndiza kwakha indlu igama likaYehova uThixo wam, ndiyikhethele kuye; ukuze sisindise khona intyatyambo yevumba elimnandi phambi kwakhe, nesonka esilungiselelwe ngokusisigxina, sinikela khona izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, kusasa nakusihlwa, ngeeSabbathi, nezithendeleko zenyanga entsha, nezithendeleko ezimiselweyo zikaYehova uThixo wethu. Lelo libe ngumthetho kumaSirayeli ngonaphakade.
Itempeli endiyenzayo iya kuba mkhulu; ngokuba uThixo wethu umkhulu kunazo zonke izitha.
Nguwuphi na ke okwaziyo ukwakha indlu kuye, xa izulu eliphakamileyo lingakwazi ukumgcina? Ndibani na mna ukuba ndiyenze indlu kuye, ngaphandle kokuba ibe yindawo yokufuya intyatyambo phambi kwakhe?

Ke ngoko, ndithumelele umntu owaziyo ukwenza igolide, nesilivere, nobhedu, nentsimbi, nezibonda ezingwevu, nezintsonkothileyo, namasuntswana aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, onolwazi lokwenza iziqhoboshi; angasebenza kunye nabaziyo ubugcisa eYuda naseYerusalem, abawulungiselele uDavide uyise.

Nceda ndithumelele iinkuni zesedari, nezenkomo, neze-almugo, ezisuka eLibanoni; kuba ndiyazi ukuba abakhonzi bakho baya kwenza khona ukusika umthi; bona abakhonzi bam baya kwenza kunye nabakhonzi bakho.
ukuze ndilungiselele imithi emininzi; ngokuba indlu endiyenzayo iya kuba mkhulu, iya kuba yinyani.

Yabona, ndiya kubanika oomatshini bakho abavuna imithi, amawaka angamashumi mabini eekhori engqolowa, namawaka angamashumi mabini eekhori eseleyo, namawaka angamashumi mabini eekhori yewayini, namawaka angamashumi mabini eekhori yeoli.
UHiram ukumkani waseTire wamphendula uSolomon ngelete, esithi, Ngokuba iNkosi uthanda abantu bakhe, ngoko wakwenza wena ukumkani kubo.
Wathi ke uHiram, Kubiwe iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, owenza izulu nehlabathi, ukuba wanika ukumkani uDavide unyana onobulumko, ogcwele ubulumko nokuqonda, oza kwakha indlu kaYehova, nendlu yakhe.
Ndiya kukuthumelela umntu owaziyo, onengqondo enkulu, igama lakhe nguHuram-abi.

Udade wakhe wayenguDani, utata wakhe waba nguTire; wakwazi ukusebenzela igolide, nesilivere, nobhedu, nentsimbi, namatye, nemithi, nezinto ezingwevu, nezibomvu, nezingwevu-mnyama, nezingwevu-sibhakabhaka, nelinen ethambileyo; wakwazi ukwenza zonke iintlobo zobugcisa, naziphi na izinto azifunayo. Waba neengcali zakho, neengcali zenkosi yam uDavide uyise.
Ke kaloku, inkosi yam ithumelele abakhonzi bayo ingqolowa, nesonka, neoli, newayini, athethayo.
Siza kukutyhila iinkuni ezifunekayo kuwe eLibanon, sizithule ngeebhayisikile kulwandle ukuya eYopa; ke ngoko uya kuzikhupha ziye eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wababala bonke abakhenkethi abasemazweni aseSirayeli, njengokuba wayebabala ngaphambili uDavide, uyise; babe ngamawaka amane anamashumi amahlanu anesine amakhulu amathandathu.

Wabamisa abamashumi asixhenxe amawaka, ukuba bathwale iimpahla ezinkulu, namawaka asibhozo anamakhulu asibhozo, ukuba babe ngamagqwetha emazantsi edolophu; wabamisa amakhulu amathathu, anamakhulu amathandathu, ukuba babe ngamakhoboka abantu.
USolomon waqalisa ukwakha indlu kaYehova eYerusalem, emnqamlezweni weMoriya, apho iNkosi wabavela khona kuDavide, uyise; yayikwindawo yokuhlambela ka-Ornani umYebhusi, apho uDavide wayeyilungiselele.
Waqala ukwakha ngomhla wesibini wenyanga yesibini, ngonyaka wesine wokumkani wakhe.
Lemilinganiselo ke kaSolomon, eyenza isiseko sendlu kaThixo, ngobungakanani besiqhelo: ubude bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini, ububanzi bayo buyimitha ezisibhozo.

Umgangatho ongaphambili kwendlu, ububanzi bawo buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini, ngokwesithuba sendlu; ubude bakhe bebuyimitha ezimashumi mabini anesine. Wazigubungela ngaphakathi ngegolide ecocekileyo.
Wayimisa igumbi eliphambili ngeebhodi zeqhwa, waza wazigquma ngegolide elungileyo; wayihombisa ngeenkomo, neengxowa.
Wayihlobisa indlu ngeekhabhathi zegolide, ukuze ibonakale intle; igolide yakhe yayivela eParwayim.
Wazigubungela ngegolide iithayile zesilingi, neengcango zomnyango, namagqabi, namasango etempeli; waza waluka amaKerubi emigangatho.
Wayenza indawo engcwele kakhulu; ubude bayo beyimitha ezilishumi elinambini, ngokwesithuba sendlu kaThixo, nobubanzi bayo beyimitha ezilishumi elinambini; wayigubungela ngegolide encinane.
Ubunzima bezinto zazo zegolide zaba ngamasentimitha angamashumi asixhenxe. Wazigubungela iikhabhathi eziphezulu ngegolide.
Kwindawo engcwele kakhulu, wazenza iikerubi ezimbini, azigqume ngagolide.

Ubude bemilenze yazo zonke iikerubi kwakuyimitha ezisibhozo. Iilebhu enye yekerub yokuqala yaba yimilinganiselo elishumi elinambini yobude, ibe incamathela emgangathweni wendlu kaThixo; nelinye icala layo laba limiyalelo emihlanu yokuphakama, ibe yincamathela kwilebhu yesithathu.

Icala elinye lalowo kerubi wesibini, liyimitha ezilishumi elinambini ubude bayo, lafika emnyango wesithathu wendlu kaThixo; nelinye icala lakhe, liyimitha ezilishumi elinambini ubude bayo, lafika emnyango wale kerubi.
Zonke iinwele zazo ezi kerubhi zaziphakamileyo, zibe ziimitha ezilishumi elinambini; izi kerubhi zathi zimi emehlweni azo, zijongene nendlu enkulu.
Wayenza intyatyambo yesitayile esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nesibomvu, nesingwevu, nelinen ethambileyo; wazenza iikerubi, zigqunywe kuyo.
Wayenza phambi kwendlu imibhobho emibini, ubude bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinanye; intloko nganye yaba yimitha ezilishumi elinanye.
Wazenza iinqanawa, wazisa ngasentla kwezithixo; waza wazenza iziqhamo zegranate ezikhulu, wazibeka phezu kwezinqanawa.
Wabeka iithayile phambi kwendlu kaThixo, enye ecaleni loMzantsi, nenye ecaleni loMntla; wabiza igama elisentshonalanga nguYakin, negama elisentshonalanga nguBhowa.
Wayenza isibingelelo sentsimbi; ubude bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinanye, ububanzi bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinanye, ubude bayo buyimitha ezine.

Wayenza ke inqanawa enkulu ejikelezayo yentsimbi, eyaziwa ngokuba yilwandle; yaphakama ukusuka kumngxunya waya kumngxunya, ibe ngaphezu kweemitha ezisibhozo ubunzulu bayo; yaphakama njengeemitha ezilishumi elinambini nezisibhozo ijikeleze.

Ngasezantsi komngxunya, ngazo zonke iinqanawa ezijikelezayo, kwakukho iintsontelo zeentlanzi, ezilishumi elinambini ngemitha nganye, zijikeleze ulwandle; izintsontelo zeentlanzi zazikwimigca emibini, zaqhutywa kulwandle.

Ulwandle lwalubekwe phezu kweenkomo zentsimbi ezilishumi elinambini; ezintathu zijonge emntla, ezintathu zijonge entshonalanga, ezintathu zijonge emzantsi, ezintathu zijonge emazantsi; ulwandle lwalubekwa phezulu kwezi; amathambo azo ajonge phakathi.
Ke kaloku lo lwandle lwaba lubanzi, ngaphaya kwesandla; umngxunya walo wawufana nomngxunya webhotile, ufana nobungama-lili; lalibalisa amalitha angamashumi asixhenxe anesithandathu amakhulu mane.

Wazenza iinqanawa ezilishumi zokuhlamba; wazisa ezintandathu ecaleni lasentshonalanga, neentandathu ecaleni lasentshonalanga; zasetyenziswa kuzo ukuhlamba izinto ezisetyenziselwa umnikelo womlilo; kodwa isilwandle salukusetyenziswa ngababingeleli ukuhlamba kuwo.
Wazenza izibane zegolide ezilishumi, ngokwemiyalelo yazo; wazisa endlwini kaThixo, ezine ngasempumalanga, nezine ngasentshona.
Wazenza iitoti ezilishumi, waza wazisa endlwini kaThixo, ezintlanu ngasempumalanga, neentlanu ngasentshona; wazenza neebhotile zegolide ezingamakhulu.
Wayenza inkundla yababingeleli, nenkundla enkulu yangaphandle, neengcango zenkundla; wazigubungela iingcango ngentsimbi.
Wabeka lo lwandle ecaleni lasempumalanga, kwikona yasempumalanga yendlu.
Wazenza ke uHiram izitya zokupheka, nezitshizi, neziqulatho. Wagqiba ke uHiram umsebenzi wakhe wamenza ukumkani uSolomon kwindlu kaThixo:
iimilenze emibini; iziqhoboshi ezibini ezincinane, ezenziwe ngombhobho, ezikwimilenze; amaqela amabini eentyatyambo zothungelwano, ezizigubungela iziqhoboshi ezibini zezinto eziphezulu ezikwimilenze;
iziqhamo zegranate ezimakhulu amane, kumacala omabini omsebenzi wothungelwano; imiqolo emibini yeziqhamo zegranate kumthungo ngamnye, ukugubungela iinqanawa zezinto eziphezulu ezikwimikhonto;
iziseko, neziqulatho ezisezisekweni;
ilwandle, neenkomo ezilishumi elinambini phantsi kwalo;
