nezitya zokupheka, neengxowa zokutya, neengxowa zenyama, nezinye zonke izinto ezisetyenziswayo. Ezi zinto zonke uHiram-abi wazenza kukumkani uSolomon, endlwini kaYehova, ngobhedu olugqityiwe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wazenza ukuba ziqhutywe ngemibhobho yomhlaba, eNtshona yeJordan, phakathi kweSukoto neZereda.
USolomon wazenza zonke ezi zinto, zininzi kakhulu; akukho namnye okwaziyo ukulinganisa ubunzima bentsimbi.
Wazenza ke uSolomon zonke izinto eziye zabekwa endlwini kaThixo: isibingelelo segolide, neetafile zeentlanzi zokubeka;
izityalo-mlilo zegolide ecacileyo, nezityalo zazo, ukuba ziqhume phambi kwendlu yangaphakathi, njengoko kuthethwa ngumthetho;
iziqhamo zegolide, nezibane, neengxowa-mali, ezenziwe ngegolide ecocekileyo;
neengxowa zegolide ecacileyo, neebhotile, neentonga, nezitya zomlilo. Imivalo yendlu kaThixo, imivalo yangaphakathi yendawo engcwele kakhulu, nemivalo yegumbi eliphambili, yayiyegolide.

Wagqiba ke uSolomon yonke imisebenzi awayeyenza endlwini kaYehova, wazisa izinto awazinikelayo uDavide uyise kuThixo, isilivere, negolide, nazo zonke operatene; waza wayibeka kwiziko lezinto ezigcinwe kwindlu kaThixo.

Ke kaloku uSolomon wahlanganisa abakhulu bakaSirayeli eYerusalem, namadoda amakhulu onke eemfazwe, nabathetheli beentsapho zakwaSirayeli; bafika ukunyusa ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova ukusuka kumzi kaDavide, othi yiZiyon.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseSirayeli aye endlwini kakumkani, emthendelekweni wenyanga yesixhenxe.
Bafika ke bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli, bathabathe amaLevi ibhokisi.
Bayikhupha ibhokisi, netentile yokuhlangana, nazo zonke izinto ezingcwele ezingaphakathi kuyo; bazikhupha oombingeleli, abaLevi.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uSolomon, naye wonke umkhosi wakwaSirayeli, bahlangana kuye phambi kwesiqwenga sethutyana, benikela iinkomo neentlanzi, ezingalinganiswa ngenxa yobuninzi bazo.
Bathi ke ababingeleli, bathabathe ibhokisi yomnqophiso kaYehova, bayifake endaweni yayo, endlwini yangaphakathi yendlu kaThixo, kwindawo engcwele kakhulu, bayibeke phantsi kwamaphiko eekeribhi.
Iikerubi zasasaza iinwele zabo phezu kwendawo apho bekukho khona isiqwenga sethutyana; ziyigubungela isiqwenga sethutyana, nezikhonkwane zayo.
Iintonga zazide kakhulu, ukuze iziphelo zazo zibonakale phambi kwegumbi elingaphakathi, kodwa zingabonakali ngaphaya; zikhona namhla.
Akukho nanye into kwityesi, ngaphandle kweebhodi ezimbini zelitye, uMoses wazisa kuyo eHorebhi, apho iNkosi wamenza khona umnqophiso nabantu bakaSirayeli, xa bephuma eYiputa.
Ke kaloku ababingeleli baphuma kwindawo engcwele; bonke ababingeleli abakhoyo apho, ngazo zonke iindidi zabo, babezilungisa ngokwabo.

Ke kaloku bonke abaLevi abezingoma, uAsafe, noHeman, noYeduthuni, noonyana babo nabazalwana babo, babekhona ecaleni lasempumalanga lesibingelelo, begqoke ilinen ethambileyo, bedlala ii-cymbals, nee-harps, nee-lyras; nabo kwabakho oonyana bakaThixo abangamakhulu amabini anamashumi amabini, bephucula izidumbu.

Ke kaloku, abadubuli bezithunywa, nabaculi, bahlangane ngelizwi elilodwa, bewuhlonipha iNkosi, bewuthandazela; bakhupha iingoma zabo, bewuhlonipha iNkosi, besithi, Ulungileyo; kuba ubulumko bakhe buhlala ubomi bonke. Ifumene icloudi indlu kaThixo, indlu kaYehova.
Ababingeleli abazange bakwazi ukuhlala besenza umsebenzi wabo, ngenxa yefu; ngokuba ubutyebi bukaYehova buzele indlu kaThixo.
Wathi ke uSolomon, UYehovarophule ukuba uya kuhlala emnyama.
Ke mna ndenza indlu entle kuwe, indawo yokuhlala kwakho ngonaphakade."
Ke kaloku ukumkani wajika umva, wabambisa ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli; bonke ke babe bemile.
Wathi, Kuhlolwe iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, owawuthetha ngomlomo wakhe kuDavide uyise wam, wawenza ngesandla sakhe, esithi,

ukususela ngemini endiyikhupha ngayo abantu bam eYiputa, andikhethi mzi nanye kwezizwe zonke zakwaSirayeli ukuba ndiyixelise indlu ukuze igama lam libe khona; andikhethenga namntu ukuba abe ngukumkani kubo bonke abantu bam bakaSirayeli.
Ke mna ndakhetha iYerusalem, ukuze igama lam libe khona; ndakhetha uDavide ukuba abe ngukumkani kwabahlobo bam bakaSirayeli.
UDavide, utata wam, wabeka entliziyweni yakhe yonke ukukwakha indlu igama likaYehova uThixo kaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathi kuDavide, uyise wam, Uthe wabeka engqondweni yakho yonke ukulungiselela indlu igama lam; kwakulungile ukuba ubeke loo nto engqondweni yakho.
Ke wena awusayi kwakha indlu; unyana wakho, oza kuvela emehlweni akho, yena uya kwakha indlu igama lam.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wenza ilizwi lakhe, awalilithethayo; mna ke ndiphakame endaweni kaDavide, uyise wam, ndahlala kwisithsaba samaSirayeli, njengokuba wathi iNkosi, ndakha indlu igama likaThixo kaSirayeli.
Ndayibeka khona itekisi, apho kukho khona umnqophiso kaYehova, awayewenza nabaSirayeli.
Wahlala uSolomon phambi kwesibingelelo sikaYehova, phambi kwentlanganiso yonke yamaSirayeli, wamisa izandla zakhe.

Ke kaloku uSolomon wayesele esenza isitulo sentsimbi, ubude bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini, ububanzi bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini, ubude bayo buyimitha enye; wayibeka phakathi kwendlu yangasemva; wahlala phezu kwayo, wajika-jika phambi kwesihlwele sonke samaSirayeli, wamisa izandla zakhe phezulu.
wathandaza, wathi, Nkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, akukho Thixo ofana nawe, emlilweni nasemhlabeni; wena ogcina umnqophiso wakho nobubele bakho kubakhonzi bakho abalandelayo ngentliziyo yabo yonke.
Wagcina igama lakho umkhonzi wakho uDavide, uyise wam; wathetha ngomlomo wakho, wawenza ngesandla sakho, njengokuba kunjalo namhlanje.

Ke ngoko, Nkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, ugcine elo ulithethayo umkhonzi wakho uDavide, uyise wam, uthi, Akuyi kuqhubeka ukhona umntu phambi kwam ohlala etroneni kaSirayeli, ukuba nje oonyana bakho bagcina behamba emthethweni wam, njengokuba wena wahamba.
Ke ngoko, Nkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, ilizwi lakho elithethayo kumkhonzi wakho uDavide, liqiniseke.
Ingaba uThixo uya kuhlala kwelinye ilizwe namadoda? Izulu, lizulu lezinto eziphakamileyo, alikwazi ukukunika indawo; ingakanani ke le ndawo ndiyilungiseleleyo?
Ke kaloku, mna iNkosi, Thixo wam, ndimxelele umthandazo womkhonzi wakho nombulelo wakhe, ndimxelele intliziyo yam nomthandazo owenzayo umkhonzi wakho phambi kwakho.
Ulinde le ndlu busuku nobusuku, indawo othi ubeke kuyo igama lakho, ukuze uyixelele imithandazo yomkhonzi wakho, ethandaza kuloo ndawo.
Yiva ke izibingelelo zomkhonzi wakho, nabantu bakho bakaSirayeli, xa bethandaza kuloo ndawo; udibanise ezulu, kwindawo yokuhlala kwakho, udibanise, uyeke.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu esenza intlungu kumhlobo wakhe, ukuba agwetywe umlomo wakhe, aze afike abe ngumlomo phambi kwesibingelelo sakho kule ndlu;
ke wena, udibanise ezulu, wenze, ugweme phakathi kwabakhonzi bakho, unqulethe umnqamlezo kulowo unetyala, unqulethe inyaniso kulowo angabikho emthethweni, wanikela ngomsebenzi wabo olungileyo.
Xa abantu bakho, ooSirayeli, behlaselwa phambi kwemfazwe, ngenxa yokuba bathe bathini na kuwe; ukuba babuyela kuwe, babe lidini lakho, bethandaza, becela uncedo phambi kwakho kule ndlu,
uthethe ke phezu kwezulu, uyixolele isono sabantu bakho abaSirayeli, ubabuyisele kwilizwe olibanikileyo kubo nabazalwana babo.
Xa izulu litshixiwe, kungabikho mvula, ngenxa yokuba abantu bakho bathini na phambi kwakho; xa bethandaza kuloo ndawo, bebhaptiza igama lakho, bebuyela kwisono sabo, xa ubabalisayo:

utsho ke wena emazulwini, ukhulule isono samakhonzi akho nabasetyhini bakho bakaSirayeli, ubafundise indlela elungileyo yokuyihamba; uyeke umhlwa phezu kwelizwe lakho, elinika abantu bakho ukuba libe lilifa labo.

Xa kukho utywala elunxwemeni, xa kukho isifo, xa kukho intsholongwane, xa kukho umkhuhlane, xa kukho izidumbu, xa kukho iintlanzi, xa kukho ubuxoki, xa kukho naziphi na iidolophu zazo ezikufutshane; nokuba yintoni na imiqobo, nokuba yintoni na imeko-bume;
xa umntu othile, okanye bonke abantu bakho bakaSirayeli, bethandaza, becela uncedo kuwe, ngathi ngamnye wabo uyazi intlungu yakhe nobuhlungu bakhe, bamisa izandla zabo kule ndlu;
sithiwe ke ngasezulu, kwindawo yokuhlala kwakho, ukhulule, uncede umntu ngamnye ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo; ngokuba uyazi intliziyo yawo; wena kuphela owazi izinto ezingaphakathi kwintliziyo yabantu.
Ke ngoko baya kukukhathalela, bahambe ngeendlela zakho zonke iintsuku zabo eziphilayo phezu kwelizwe olinika ooyise bethu.

Ke kaloku nothile, angabakho kubomi bakho bakaSirayeli, ukuba afike ezweni elunxwemeni, ngenxa yegama lakho elikhulu, nesandla sakho esinamandla, nomlomo wakho oqinileyo; xa befika bethandaza kule ndlu,

sithiwe ke wena emazulwini, endlwini yakho yokuhlala kwakho, wenze zonke izinto oza kuzibiza ngazo loo mkhenkce; ukuze bonke abantu basehlabathini bakwazi igama lakho, bakuhlonele, njengokuba abantwana bakho bakaSirayeli bekukhokelayo kuwe; baze bazi ukuba igama lakho libizwa ngalo le ndawo yendlu endiyilungiselele.
Xa abantu bakho bephuma behlasela abachasi babo, ngendlela oya kubathumela ngayo, bathandaza kuwe, bejonge kuloo mzi wena owawukhethileyo, nendlu endiyenzileyo igama lakho;
Nkosi, udibanise ukuthandaza kwabo, nokucela kwabo, ezulu, ubancede.
Xa besenza isono kuwe, (kuba akukho mntu ongenakusindisa), ukhe waxolisa kubo, wabanikela phambi kwamehlo oothunywa babo, bathabathe abakhweli-zithuthi baya ezweni elincinane, okanye elifutshane;
ukuba ke babuyela emphefumlweni wabo, ezweni apho baya kutshatyalaliswa khona, bebuya, bekucela uncedo kuwe apho, besithi, Siphelele, sasenza okubi, sazenza izinto ezingafanelekanga;

ukuba bebuyela kuwe ngentliziyo yabo yonke, nomphefumlo wabo wonke, ezweni apho babebathunyelwe khona phantsi kwengxowa-mali, bathandaza bejonge ilizwe olinika ooyise babo, lo mzi owawukhethayo, nendlu endiyenzileyo igama lakho:
uthethe ngoko umthandazo wabo, nezingxowa-mali zabo, ezulu, kwindawo yokuhlala kwakho; ubakhusele, ubakhulule abantu bakho abathe bathini na kuwe.
Ke ngoko, Thixo wam, ukuba amehlo akho avuleke ke ngoku, indlebe yakho ivakalise umthandazo ovela kule ndawo.

Nceda ke ngoku, Thixo kaYehova, uphakame, ufike kwindawo yakho yokuphumla, wena notyhubhu lomkhosi wakho; Thixo kaYehova, bagqoke ubulungisa ababingeleli bakho, babe nenceba abantu bakho abangcwele ngenxa yobubele bakho.
Nkosi, Thixo wam, musa ukubuyela umva kukumkani wakho othambileyo; ukhumbula ububele bakho kumkhonzi wakho uDavide.
Ke kaloku, xa uSolomon egqibile ukuthandaza, waphuma umnqamlezo esibhakabhakeni, watshisa idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo; ubutyebi bukaYehova buzele indlu.
Ababingeleli abazange bakwazi ukungena endlwini kaYehova, ngokuba ubutyebi bukaYehova buzele indlu.

Ke kaloku bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bebona umlilo uphumayo, babone ubukumkani bukaYehova phezu kwendlu; bahlangula ngobuso babo phezulu kwithambeka lelitye, bathandaza, bewuthandazela iNkosi, besithi, Ulungileyo yena, kuba inyaniso yakhe ihlala ixesha elide.
Ke kaloku ukumkani, nabantu bonke, banikela izibingelelo phambi koYehova.
Ukumkani uSolomon wanikela iinkomo ezimashumi mabini anambini amawaka, neentyatyambo ezilishumi elinambini amawaka; ngoko ke ukumkani nabantu bonke bamisa indlu kaThixo.

Ke kaloku ababingeleli bahlala ezindaweni zabo, nabaLevi ke bahlala nezixhobo zokudlala zeNkosi, ezo ukumkani uDavide wazenza ukuba zivuyisane noYehova, xa uDavide ethandazela ngenkonzo yabo, esithi, Kuba ubulumko bakhe buhlala ngonaphakade. Ecaleni kwabo amaLevi, abambingeleli babephucula izidumbu; bonke amaSirayeli behlala.

Ke kaloku uSolomon wamisa phakathi kwendlu yangasemva, phambi kwendlu kaYehova; waza wanikela khona izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nenyama yezibingelelo zoxolo; ngokuba isibingelelo sentsimbi ebesiyenze saba sincinci ngokwaneleyo ukuba zifakwe kuzo zonke izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zesonka, nenyama.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wenza isikhumbuzo seentsuku ezisixhenxe, nabo bonke amaSirayeli naye; ibandla elikhulu kakhulu, lisuka ekungeneni kweHamati emntla, libe lifike emanzini aseYiputa emazantsi.
Ngomhla wesibhozo bamisa isibingelelo esikhethekileyo; besenza ukunikela kwesibingelelo iintsuku ezisixhenxe, neholide iintsuku ezisixhenxe.

Ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga, ngomhla wamabini anamashumi amathathu, uSolomon wayisa abantu endlwini yabo; babe bathandazela, bethandazela intliziyo yabo, ngenxa yobulungisa bonke obuwenzayo iNkosi kuDavide, noSolomon, nabantu bakhe abaSirayeli.
Wagqiba ke uSolomon indlu kaYehova, nendlu yokumkani; zonke izinto azenzayo uSolomon engqondweni yakhe, kwindlu kaYehova nasendlwini yakhe, zaphumelela.
Wabonakala iNkosi kuSolomon ngobusuku, wathi kuye, Ndimva umthandazo wakho, ndikhethe le ndawo ukuba ibe yindlu yam yomnikelo wokudla.
Xa ndiyivalileyo izulu, ukuze kungabikho mvula, xa ndithi kwiintaka ukuba zidle ilizwe, xa ndithumela ubhubhane phakathi kwabantu bam,

ukuba abantu bam, ababizwa ngegama lam, bahlambulule iimvakalelo zabo, bethandaza, bendimfuna, bebuyela kwindlela yabo engalunganga; ndiya kuziva ezulu, ndizixolele isono sabo, ndiyiphilise ilizwe labo.
Namhlanje amehlo am aya kuba avuliweyo, neendlebe zam ziya kuhlala zivuya kumthandazo ovela kule ndawo.
Ndiyikhethile ke le ndlu, ndiyingcwelele, ukuze igama lam libe khona ngonaphakade; amehlo am nenhliziyo yam ziya kuba khona njalo.
Ke wena, ukuba uya kumlandela mna, njengokuba wamlandela uDavide uyise wakho, wenze zonke izinto endikumwisela umthetho ngazo, ugcine imimiselo yam nezigwebo zam,
ndiya kuqinisa isithsaba sakho sokumkani, njengokuba ndathi kuDavide uyise wakho, ndisithi, Uza kubakho mntu uya kuhlala elawula phezu kwaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, ukuba nisuka, nizishiye imithetho nemimiselo yam endiyibeka phambi kwenu, nihambe nikhonza amadini athile, niyihloniphe;
ndiya kubakhupha amaSirayeli ezweni lam, endibanikileyo; ndiya kuyicima le ndlu, endiyingcwelele igama lam; ndiya kuyibeka ibe yinto yokucaphukisa, nento yobuxoki phakathi kwamazwe onke.
Ke kaloku, le ndlu iphakamileyo kakhulu ngoku; wonke lowo udlulayo kuyo uya kunyamezela, athi, Yintoni na loo nto iNkosi ayenze ngaloo ndawo neleyo ndlu?
Bathi ke, Kuba bashiye iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi babo, owabakhupha ezweni laseYiputa, bakhetha amadini athile, bewuthandazela, bewukhonza; ngenxa yoko wazisa phezu kwabo zonke ezi zinto zibuhlungu.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wachitha iminyaka emashumi mabini ekwakha indlu kaYehova nendlu yakhe.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wakwakha kwakhona imimandla awayemnika yona uHiram, wabamisa khona ooSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uSolomon waya eHamati-zobha, wayithatha.
Wayenza iTadmori esiqwini, nezixeko zonke zokugcina izinto wazenza eHamati.
Wakwakha kwakhona iBhete-horon ephezulu, neBethe-horon esezantsi, imizi eqinileyo, enodonga, nemivalo, nezitshixo.
Wakwakha iBhalathi, nemizi yayo yonke yezinto ezigcinwayo, nemizi yawo onke amakhadi, namakhwenkwe; nantoni na eyamthanda ngayo wayenza eYerusalem, naseLibanoni, nakwilizwe lonke elalilawulayo.
Ke kaloku kwabakho abantu abaseleyo phakathi kwamaHeti, namaAmori, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaYebhusi; abo bantu ke babengaSirayeli.
Aba ngabantwana abo, abaSirayeli abazange babulalayo kuloo lizwe; uSolomon wabamisa ukuba babe ngabakhonzi bemikhosi, de kube ngaloomini.
Ke kaloku kuSirayeli bonke, uSolomon akayi kwenza nabani na ukuba abe ngumkhonzi wakhe; babe ngabakhosi bakhe, nabaphathi beenqanawa zakhe, nabaphathi beemoto zakhe, nabaqhubi bamabhayisikili.
Ke kaloku, kwabakho abathetheli abakhulu bakakumkani uSolomon, abangamakhulu amabini anamashumi mahlanu, abalawula abantu.

Ke kaloku uSolomon wamkhupha intombi kaFaro esuka kumzi kaDavide, waya kwindlu awayeyithumele yona. Wathi ke uSolomon, Umfazi wam akayi kuhlala kwisixeko sikaDavide ukumkani wakwaSirayeli; ngokuba zingcwele iindawo apho ibhokisi yoYehova ibikho khona.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wanikela ngeempawu zomlilo kuYehova phezu kwesibingelelo sikaYehova, ebesiyile phambi komnyango wendlu.

Wakwenza njalo ngomhla ngamnye, ngokwemiyalelo kaMoses, ngeeSabbathi, neentsuku zonyaka omtsha, neeholide ezintathu zeminyaka dalima, iFesti yezonka ezingaxutywanga, neFesti yeeVeki, neFesti yezindlu zangasese.

Wabeka, ngokwemiyalelo kaDavide, uyise, iindidi zababingeleli ekusebenzeni kwabo, nabaLevi emisebenzini yabo, ukuba baqhubele phambili ukubonga, nokuncedisa ababingeleli, njengokuba kwafuneka ngemini nganye; wabeka nabasebenzi beengcango ngezindidi zabo kwingcango nganye; ngokuba kwaba ngoko umyalelo kaDavide, umfazi kaThixo.
Baze bangaphazamisi nantoni na ukumkani awawisela umthetho ngayo oombingeleli nabaLevi, ekufumaneni iimpahla ezikhuselayo.
Yagqitywa ke loo msebenzi wonke kaSolomon, ukususela ngemini yokubeka isiseko sendlu kaYehova, de yagqitywa. Yagqitywa ngoko indlu kaYehova.
Ke kaloku uSolomon waya eEzion-gebere, neElathi, emntla weEdom.

Ke kaloku uHiram wamthumelela iinqanawa, ngabasebenzi bakhe, abantu abayaziyo ilwandle; bahamba nabo nabakhonzi bakaSolomon baya eOfiri, babuya bethwala igolide, ibe ziitoni ezilishumi elinambini, bazinika ukumkani uSolomon.

Ukumkani waseShebha wava igama likaSolomon, waya eYerusalem ukuwuvavanya ngemibuzo engalunganga. Wafika nosapho olukhulu kakhulu lwamakhonzi, neenkomo ezithabatha iziqhamo, negolide eninzi, namatye abalulekileyo; waya kuSolomon, wathetha naye ngazo zonke izinto ezazisentliziyweni yakhe.
Ke kaloku uSolomon wamxelela yonke imibuzo yakhe; akukho nto yamqhelekanga ukuba amxelele.
Wabona ukumkani waseSheba ubulumko bukaSolomon, nendlu yakhe eyayiyixhobisa.

Wabona ukutya kwetafile yakhe, nokuhlala kwabakhonzi bakhe, nokusebenza kwabakhonzi bakhe, nezihlangu zabo, nabakhonzi bakhe bewayini, nezihlangu zabo, namadini akhe okusindisa endlwini kaYehova; waphuma umphefumlo kuye.
Wathi kukumkani, Kulungile loo nto ndiyivayo ezweni lam, ngomsebenzi wakho nobulumko bakho.
Ke mna andikholwanga loo nto, de ndifike, ndazi ngamehlo am; kuba kungekho mntu wamxelela inxalenye yobulumko bakho obukhulu; umkhulu kakhulu kunaye into endiyivayo.
Kuhle kangakanani na abantu bakho! Kuhle kangakanani na abaphathi bakho, Abahlala phambi kwakho rhoqo, Beva ubulumko bakho!

UYehova, uThixo wakho, uya kuba luncedo kuwe, ukuze akubeke phezu kwetrone yakhe ukuba ube ngukumkani kuYehova, uThixo wakho; ngenxa yokuba uThixo wakho wathanda amaSirayeli, efuna ukubaqinisa ngonaphakade, ngoko ke wenza wena ukumkani wabo, ukuze wenze imithetho negunya.
Wamnika ke ukumkani iithani ezilishumi elinambini zegolide, neziqhamo ezininzi kakhulu, namatye abalulekileyo; akuzange kubekho iziqhamo ezinjengezo ukumkani waseSheba wamnika kumkani uSolomon.
Abakhonzi bakaHiram, nabakhonzi bakaSolomon, abathabatha igolide eOfiri, bathabatha nemithi ye-almugiba, neethayile ezintle.
Wasebenzisa ukumkani umthi we-almugibe, ukuba ayenze imigangatho yendlu kaYehova, nendlu yokumkani, namacwecwe namagqabi abo badlalayo; akuzange kubekho nto yabonakala ngale nto eYuda.
Ukumkani uSolomon wamnika ukumkani waseSheba yonke into ayifumeneyo, eyamcelayo, ngaphezu kwayo yonke into ayemnika yona uSolomon. Wabuya ke waya ezweni lakhe yena namadoda akhe.
USolomon wafumana unyaka nonyaka igolide, njengeetoni ezimashumi mabini anesine.
Ngaphandle kwegolide ethethwa ngabarhwebi, nabarhwebi abathethwayo; bonke ookumkani base-Arabha, nabaphathi belizwe lonke, babethethwa igolide nesilivere kuSolomon.
Ukumkani uSolomon wenza izikhuselo ezinkulu ezimakhulu amabini, ezenziwe ngegolide ephindwe kabini; isikhuselo ngasinye sasebenzisa ikhilogram ezine zegolide.
Wazenza izikhuselo ezincinci izigidi ezintathu zegolide eyenziwe ngesandla, ngazo ikhilogram ezilishumi elinambini zegolide; ukumkani wazisa kwindlu yomthi waseLebanoni.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wenza isithsaba esikhulu segolide, wasigqumathela ngegolide ecacileyo.
Intloko yayineempawu ezisithandathu, nesihlalo segolide esidityanisiweyo sayo; kwakukho iziqhamo ngaphaya naphaya kwesiqithi; kwakukho ilili lisecaleni lesiqhamo ngasinye.
Iileya ezilishumi elinambini zahlala phezu kwezikhonkwane ezintandathu, enye ngasentloko nganye yesikhonkwane ngasinye. Akukho nto yenziweyo enjalo kulo naluphi na uluntu.
Zonke izitya zikakumkani uSolomon zazigolide, nazo zonke izitya zendlu yomthi waseLibanoni zaba yigolide ecocekileyo; isilivere ayizange ithathelwe ingqalelo mihla kaSolomon.

Ukumkani wayenazo iinqanawa eziya eTarshishi, zihamba namadoda kaHiram; ngonyaka ngamnye weminyaka emithathu zabuya iziinqanawa, zithabatha igolide, nesilivere, nentlanzi-mpuma, namaphiko, neebhokhwe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uSolomon waba mkhulu kunabo bonke abakumkani behlabathi, ngemali nobulumko.
Ke kaloku, bonke abakumkani behlabathi babefuna ubuso bukaSolomon, ukuba babone ubulumko bakhe, obubekayo uThixo entliziyweni yakhe.
Ke kaloku, unyaka nonyaka, bonke bazisa izipho zabo, izinto zesilivere, negolide, nezihlangu, nezithuthi, neziqhamo, neenkomo, nezimvu.
USolomon wayenamashumi amane amawaka eengxowa-mahashe, neemoto zokulwa, namawaka alishumi elinambini eemoto zokulwa; wababeka emizini yeemoto zokulwa, naye eYerusalem.
Waba ngukumkani kubo bonke abakumkani, esuka emlanjeni uEfrayim, waya kwilizwe labaFilisti, waya kumda weYiputa.
Wakwenza ukumkani ukuba isilivere ibe lininzi eYerusalem, njengezithako, nemithi yesedari ibe lininzi, njengokuba zininzi izityalo zeziqhamo ezisentshona.
Iinkomo zikaSolomon zavela eYiputa, nakwazo zonke iilizwe.

Zonke ezinye izinto azenzayo uSolomon, eziqalekayo neziphelileyo, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi kaNathan umprofeti, nencwadi yobuprofeti kaAhiya waseShilo, nakwiimbono zikaIdo umbonisi kaYerebhoyamu unyana kaNabati?
USolomon waba ngukumkani eYerusalem, kumaSirayeli onke, iminyaka emashumi mane.
Wafa ke uSolomon, wabanjwa emzini kaDavide uyise; uRehobhowam unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ke kaloku uRehobhowam waya eShekem; ngokuba bonke amaSirayeli babethe bafika eShekem, ukuba abe ngukumkani.
Ke kaloku uYerebhoyamu, unyana kaNabhati, wayesele eYiputa, apho waphuma khona phambi kokumkani uSolomon; ke kaloku xa uYerebhoyamu ekubona loo nto, wabuyela eYiputa.
Ke kaloku abantu bathumela bambiza. Wafika ke uYeremiya noSirayeli bonke, bathetha kuRehobhoham, besithi,

Ubaba wakho usinike umsebenzi onzima kakhulu, esenza ukuba sibe lubunzima ezincweni zethu; ngoko ke ngoku ukhawulezisa umsebenzi wethu onzima, noburharha obunzima abunike wona ubaba wakho kuthi, siza kukukhonza.
Wathi kubo, Buya kum emva kweentsuku ezithathu. Baye ke abantu baphuma.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uRehobhowam wacebisa amadoda amakhulu, asebenzela kuSolomon uyise xa ephilayo, wathi kubo: Nindixelele ntoni na ukuba ndiphendule la bantu?
Baphendula bathi kuye, Ukuba uya kuba ngumkhonzi wale ndoda, ubathande, uthetha nabo amazwi alungileyo, baya kuba ngabakhonzi bakho ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku washiya ucebiso labo abakhulu ababemxelela lona; wababuza iingcebiso oonyana bakhe, abo bakhulela naye, abakhonzayo.
Wathi kubo, Nicebisa ntoni na? Siphendule njani kuba bantu abathe bathetha nam, besithi, Unciphise umthwalo owawubeka phezu kwethu utata wakho?

Bathi kuye amadoda amancinci akhulela naye, Utsho kubo abantu abathe bathetha nawe, besithi, Ubaba wakho wawunzimalisa umthwalo wethu, ke thintela ubunzima bethu; uthi kubo njalo: Umnwe wam omncinane ubanzi kunamathambo kayise.
Ubaba wam wawenza umthwalo wenu mkhulu, mna ke ndiya kukwenza ube mkhulu; ubaba wam wakuzibulala ngeebhokhwe, mna ke ndiza kuzibulala ngeeskorpiyo.
Wabuya ke uYerebhoyamu, nabantu bonke, kuye uRehobhowam ngemini yesithathu, njengoko ukumkani wayethe, Nibuye kum ngemini yesithathu.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wabaphendula ngelizwi elibuhlungu. Ukumkani uRehobhowam washiya icebiso labakhulu,

wathetha nabo ngokwengcebiso yamadoda amancinci, esithi, Ubaba wam wakwenza kube nzima umthwalo wenu, mna ke ndiya kuwenza ube nzima; ubaba wam wakuzibulala ngeebhokhwe, mna ke ndiza kuzibulala ngeentaka.
Ke kaloku ukumkani akawaphulaphuli abantu; kuba uThixo wakwenza oku, ukuze iNkosi aphumeze ilizwi lakhe, elalithetha nguAhiya waseShilo kuYaroboham unyana kaNabati.

Bathi ke bonke amaSirayeli, xa bebona ukuba ukumkani akawaphulaphuli; baphendula ukumkani bathi, Sinenxalenyeni ntoni nathi kuDavide? Asinayo inxaxheba kumntwana kaYese. Yiya wonke umntu endlwini yakhe, ooSirayeli! UDavidi, khangela ngoku ikhaya lakho. Ke kaloku bonke abaSirayeli baya endlwini yabo.
Ke kaloku uRehobhowam waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli abahlala emizini kaYuda.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uRehobhowam wathumela uHadoram, umphathi weempahla ethethwayo. Bathi ke ooSirayeli kuye ngamatye, waza wafa. Ukumkani uRehobhowam wakhawuleza waya kwisithuthuthu sakhe, waya eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli athabathela endlu kaDavide, waya kusasa.

Wafika ke uRehobhowam eYerusalem, wahlanganisa abantu bakaYuda noBhenjamin, amakhulu asibhozo anamakhulu asibhozo amawaka, oonyana bakaSirayeli abakhethiweyo, ukuba badlale nabaSirayeli, babuyisele ubukumkani kuRehobhowam.
Kwafika ke ulizwi likaYehova kuShemaya, umntu kaThixo, lisithi,
Utsho kuRehobhowam, unyana kaSolomon, ukumkani wakwaYuda, nakumadoda onke aseSirayeli aseYuda nakwaBhenjamin, uthi,

Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Musani kukhupha, nibhideze abazalwana benu; mbuyisele umntu ngamnye endlwini yakhe; ngokuba ndiye ndenza oku. Bathi ke ngoko, baphulaphule amazwi kaYehova, bangakhuphi ukuhlasela uYaroboham.
Wahlala ke uRehobhowam eYerusalem, wakhiwa amadolophu emkhosini eYuda.
Wakha uBethelehem, neEtam, neTekoya,
iBhethe-suru, neSoko, neAdulami,
neGati, neMaresha, neZipho,
uAdoraim, neLakishi, noAzeka,
iSora, neAyaloni, neHebron; ezi ziidolophu eziqinileyo, ezinamadonga, eYuda naseBhenjamin.
Waziqinisa iinqaba, wabeka kuzo abakumkani, nezixhobo zokutya, neoli yeoli, newayini.
Wabeka edolophini ngalinye izithuthi nezikhephe, waza wazenza zinamandla kakhulu. Ke kaloku uYuda noBhenjamin babe ngabo.
Ke kaloku ababingeleli nabaLevi, abasuka kuwo onke amaSirayeli, bafika ezindaweni zabo, babe ngaye.
Bashiya ooLevi izityalo zabo, nempahla yabo, bafika eYuda naseYerusalem; ngokuba uYeremiya nonyana bakhe abavumelekanga ukuba babe ngababingeleli bakaYehova.
Ke kaloku uYerebhoyamu wamisela ababingeleli bakhe, ukuba babe ngababingeleli beendawo eziphakamileyo, nababingeleli beentyatyambo neentlanzi azenzayo.

Emva kwabo amaLevi, kwafika eYerusalem abantu abasuka kuzo zonke iintlanga zakwaSirayeli, ababeka intliziyo yabo ekufuneni iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, ukuba benze izibingelelo kuYehova, uThixo wabafazi babo.
Baqinisa ke ubukumkani bukaYuda, banceda uRehobhowam, unyana kaSolomon, iminyaka emithathu; kuba behamba ngeendlela zikaDavide noSolomon iminyaka emithathu.
URehobhowam wamzala uMahalati, intombi kaYerimothi, unyana kaDavide, noAbhihayeli, intombi kaEliyaba, unyana kaYese.
Waba nawo oonyana: uYehushi, noShemariya, noZaham.
Ke kaloku, emva kwakhe, wamisa uMahaka, intombi ka-Absalom; wamzala yena uAbiya, noAtayi, noZiza, noShelomi.

URehobhowam wamthanda uMahaka, intombi ka-Abhisalom, ngaphezu kwamadoda akhe onke, namadoda amakhulu; kuba wayenamadoda angamashumi elinesibhozo, namadoda amakhulu angamashumi asixhenxe; waba neentombi ezimashumi mabini anesixhenxe, nabantwana abangamashumi asixhenxe.
Ke kaloku uRehobhowam wamisa uAbiya, unyana kaMahaka, ukuba abe ngukumkani phakathi kwabazalwana bakhe; kuba wayefuna ukumenza ukumkani.
Ke kaloku, esebenza ngombulelo, wamisa oonyana bakhe kuzo zonke iinkalo zikaYuda noBhenjamin, kuwo onke amadolophu akhuselweyo; wabanika ukutya okuninzi, wabafumana amadoda amakhulu.
Ke kaloku, xa ubukumkani bukaRehobhowam bebuqinileyo, waza waba namandla, wasuka emthethweni kaYehova; nabo bonke amaSirayeli.
Ngomnyaka wesihlanu wokumkani uRehobhowam, wafika uShishaki ukumkani waseYiputa waya eYerusalem; ngokuba abantu babemnqula iNkosi.

Wafika ngeemoto ezilishumi elinambini ezimakhulu amabini, namawaka angamashumi asixhenxe amadoda ahamba ngezithuthi; wafika naye eYiputa abantu abaninzi, abangababalalanga: abaLibya, nabaSukhi, nabaKushi.
Wathabatha izixeko ezikhuselwe ngamagqabi eYuda, waya eYerusalem.

Wafika ke uShemaya umprofeti kuRehobhowam, nabakhulu bakaYuda, abathe bahlangane eYerusalem ngenxa kaShishaki; wathi kubo: Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Nindishiyeni mna; ngoku ndinishiye nisesandla sikaShishaki.
Ke kaloku abathetheli bakaSirayeli, nokumkani, bakhupha izandla zabo, bathi, UYehova ulungile.

Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi ebona ukuba baphucula izandla zabo, kwafika umyalezo kaThixo kuShemaya, esithi, Baphucula isandla sabo; ke mna ndiya kubasindisa ngokukhawuleza, andiyi kukhupha inkanuko yam phezu kweYerusalem ngesandla sikaShishak.
Ke kaloku baya kuba ngabakhonzi bakhe, ukuze bafunde ukuba kuhlukile phakathi kokukhonza kwam nokusebenza kwabakumkani bezizwe.
Wafika ke uShishaki ukumkani waseYiputa eYerusalem, wathabatha iimpahla zendlu kaYehova, nempahla yendlu yokumkani; waza wathabatha zonke izinto, namashiti egolide awenzayo uSolomon.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uRehobhowam wazenza izithuthi zentsimbi endaweni yazo, waza wazinika abaphathi beengxowa-mali, abagcinayo isango lendlu kaThixo.
Ke kaloku, xa ukumkani ephuma endlwini kaYehova, befika abagwebi, bezithabatha izithuthi, zazibuyisela kwigumbi labagwebi.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba uRehobhowam waxolisa, inkanuko kaYehova yabuyela kuye; akabikho ethe nkqo. Kwabakho nakunye okulungileyo kuYuda.

Ukumkani uRehobhowa waqinisa ke isandla sakhe eYerusalem, waba ngukumkani. Wayeminyaka imashumi mane anamibini ananye ezelwe ukuba ngukumkani; waba neminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe engukumkani eYerusalem, lo mzi owawukhethela iNkosi phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaSirayeli, ukuze alibeke khona igama lakhe. Unyana wakhe wayenguNaama umAmoni.
Wakwenza okubi, ngokuba akazange abeke intliziyo yakhe ekufumaneni iNkosi.

Nazo zonke izinto azenzayo uRehobhowam, eziqalekayo neziphelileyo, zihleli zibhalwe encwadini kaShemaya umprofeti, nencwadi ka-Iddo umbona, encwadini yeentsapho. URehobhowam noYaroboham babe nemikhosi yonke.
Ke kaloku uRehobhowam wafa, waza wabanjwa emzini kaDavide; uAbiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo wokumkani uYeremiya, waba ngukumkani uAbiya kuYuda.
Waba ngukumkani iminyaka emithathu eYerusalem. Unyana kaMika, intombi ka-Uriyeli waseGibeha, waba ngumzali wakhe. Kwakukho umkhosi phakathi kukaAbiya noYaroboham.

UAbiya waya emfazweni, enemikhosi elishumi elinamakhulu amane amawaka abantu abakhethiweyo; uYerebhoyamu wamisa iqela lakhe phambi kwakhe, enomakhulu asixhenxe amawaka abantu abakhethiweyo, anamandla amakhulu.
Ke kaloku uAbiya wahlala phezu kwentaba kaZemarayim, entlango kaEfrayim, wathi, Nindixeleleni, nina uYarobhohamu, nani bonke amaSirayeli.
Awazi na ukuba iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, wamnika uDavide nonyana bakhe ubukumkani bukaSirayeli ngonaphakade, ngomnqophiso ongenako ukuwuphula, umnqophiso wesonka?
Ke kaloku uYerebhoyamu, unyana kaNabati, umkhonzi kaSolomon, unyana kaDavide, wavuka, waba mkhuluwa wakhe.
Ke kaloku bahlangana kuye abantu abakhohlakeleyo, ababi, bamisa isandla sabo kuRehobhowam unyana kaSolomon; ke kaloku uRehobhowam wayeneminyaka embalwa kuphela, wakhathazeka, akakwazi ukumelana nabo.

Namhlanje ke nicinga ukuba niya kuhlasela ubukumkani bukaYehova, obusesandla sabantwana bakaDavide; ningabantu abakhulu kakhulu, nina nazonke iinkomo zegolide, azenzayo uYaroboham ukuze zibe zimikhosi yenu.

Awuwakhuphanga na oombingeleli bakaYehova, oonyana bakaAron, nabaLevi? Awuyikwenzanga na ababingeleli bakho, njengokuba zenza iintlanga zezinye iilwimi? Nabani na ofika nonyana womntu omncinci neentombi ezisixhenxe, ukuba alungiselele ngokwakhe, angaba ngumbingeleli weempawu ezingayi kuba ziingelosi.
Ke thina, iNkosi nguThixo wethu; asiwushiyenga. Ababingeleli bethu abakhonzayo iNkosi babantwana baka-Aron; nabaLevi nabo baya kuncedisana nabo emisebenzini yabo.

Bazitshisa iintsontelo, nefuthe elimnandi kuYehova, kusasa nakusihlwa; bamisa ubisi olungcwele phezu kwetafile ecocekileyo; baphatha isibambo segolide nesibane sayo, ukuba zisindise ekuseni nakusihlwa. Siyamthobela iNkosi uThixo wethu; kodwa niyamshiya.

Yabona, uThixo ungummelwane wethu; ababingeleli bakhe bakhona, benezithunywa ezidumileyo, ukuba bakhuphe umnxeba wokulwa kuni. Babantu bakaSirayeli, musa ukuhlasela iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi benu; ngokuba ningaphumelelanga.
Ke kaloku uYerebhoyamu wathumela abantu abajikelezayo, ukuba bafihlakele ngasemva komkhosi kaYuda; ke ngoko umkhosi wakhe waba phambi koYuda, nabafihlakeleyo babe ngasemva kwabo.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseYuda ajonge ngaphesheya, wabona ukuba uhlaselo luphuma phambi kwabo, nasemva kwabo; bathandaza ke kuYehova, ababingeleli bephucula izidumbu.
Ke kaloku amadoda aseYuda avakalisa umlilo wokulwa. Xa evakalise umlilo, uThixo wabetha uYerebhoyamu nabaSirayeli bonke phambi koAbhiya noYuda.
Ke kaloku abaSirayeli babaleka phambi kwaYuda; uThixo wabanikela kubo.
Ke kaloku uAbiya neqela lakhe babulala abantu abaninzi kakhulu kubo. Bafa amadoda alishumi elinambini amawaka, akhethiweyo kuSirayeli.
Ke kaloku abaSirayeli bahlaselwa ngaloo mihla; abantu bakaYuda ke babenamandla, ngokuba bethembela kuYehova uThixo wabafazi babo.
UAbiya wamlandela uYerebhoyamu, wathabatha kuye imimandla: iBheteli, neJeshana, noEfron, nezixeko zazo.
Ke kaloku uYerebhoyamu akazange aphinde abe nobuchule zonke iintsuku zobomi bukaAbiya; wambetha ke iNkosi, wafa.
Ke kaloku uAbiya waba namandla; wathatha amadodana alishumi elinane, wazalelwa oonyana abamashumi mabini anesibini, neentombi ezilishumi elinamihlanu.
Konke okuseleyo kwezinto azenzayo uAbhiya, nendlela awayehamba ngayo, nelizwi lakhe, ngaba akubhalwenga kuncwadi luka-Ido umprofeti?
Wafa ke uAbiya, wabanjwa eMzini kaDavide. UAsa unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe. Iminyaka ilishumi yokumkani kukaAsa ilizwe lahlala likhululekile.
Ke kaloku uAsa wenza oko kulungileyo, okuthe nkqo emehlweni kaYehova uThixo wakhe.
Wazisusa izibingelelo zezinto zangaphandle, neziseko eziphakamileyo; waphula iinkunzi zeenkomo, waza watshisa ii-ashere.
Wathi ke kuYuda ukuba bafune iNkosi, uThixo wabazali babo, bagcine umthetho wakhe nemimiselo yakhe.
Wazisusa nakwiidolophu zonke zakwaYuda izibingelelo eziphakamileyo, nezibingelelo zomlilo; ubukumkani buphumle iintsuku zakhe zokukumkani.
Wakhiwa amadolophu anemigangatho eYuda, ngokuba ilizwe lalibambelela; kwakungekho mfazwe ngaloo minyaka; ngokuba iNkosi wamnika isiphelo.

Wathi ke kuYuda, Siyazikwakha ezi dolophu, sizigqume ngemigangatho ejikelezayo, neentyatyambo, nezivalo, nezitshixo; ilizwe lihlala likwindawo yethu; ngokuba sijongene noYehova uThixo wethu. Sijongene naye, wasisinika uxolo ngazo zonke izinto ezingqongileyo. Bathi ke ngoko, bayenza kakuhle.

Waye uAsa unesizwe samaYuda, abanemiyalelo emikhulu nemiyalelo emincinci, amawaka angamakhulu amathathu; namaBhenjamini, abanemiyalelo emincinci nemiyalelo emincinci, amawaka anamakhulu mabini anamashumi asibhozo; bonke abo bamadoda anamandla.
Waphuma ke uZera, umEtiyopiya, ukuba athabathe intshayelelo kubo, enemikhosi yezigidi ezilishumi elinambini, neemoto zemfazwe ezimakhulu mathathu; waya eMaresha.
Ke kaloku uAsa waphuma ukudibana naye; balungiselela ukulwa emlanjeni weSefata, eMaresha.

Watsho uAsa kuYehova, uThixo wakhe, wathi, Nkosi, akukho namnye ngaphandle kwakho okwaziyo ukuncedisa lowo uncinane emnqamlezweni wale nto inamandla. Sixhase wena, Nkosi, uThixo wethu; ngokuba siyakuthembela kuwe: ngegama lakho sithe safika kuloo mkhosi omkhulu. UYehova, uThixo wethu, unguwe; asivumeleni umntu ukuba aphumelele phezu kwako.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wabetha amaEtiyopiya phambi koAsa noYuda; amaEtiyopiya abaleka.

Ke kaloku, uAsa nomkhosi wakhe bathabathela emva kwabo besiya eGerari. Bafa abaKushi abaninzi kakhulu, ukuba bangabikho nabani na oza kubuya; baqhutywa phambi koYehova nomkhosi wakhe; amadoda aseYuda athathe iintaka ezininzi kakhulu.
Bazibulala zonke izixeko ezijikeleze iGerare, ngokuba uzuko lukaYehova lwathi lufikelele kuzo; bathabathe yonke into ebalulekileyo yazo iidolophu ezo, kuba kwakuninzi okutwabela.
Bahlasela namaqela oomvundla, bathabathe iinkomo neengqekembe ezininzi; babuya bebuyela eYerusalem.
Wafika uMoya kaThixo kuUzariya, unyana kaOdedi.

Waphuma, wadibana noAsa, wathi kuye, Nxibelelani nam, Asa, nani bonke amaYuda nabaseBhenjamini; iNkosi uya kuba nani, ukuba niye naye. Ukuba mna ke ndimfunayo, ndiya kumfumana; kodwa ukuba mna ke ndimshiyayo, mna ke ndimshiya.
Ke kaloku, iminyaka emininzi iSirayeli ibingenaThixo okunene, ingabikho umbingeleli ofundisayo, ingabikho umthetho.
Ke kaloku, xa bekwingozi yabo, babuyela kuYehova uThixo kaSirayeli, babemkhangela, babafumana.
Ke kaloku, ngazo ezo mihla, kwakungekho mntu okhuselekileyo ekuhambeni; kwabakho uxinzelelo olukhulu kubo bonke abahlali baloo mazwe.
Ilizwe lihlasela ilizwe, umzi uhlasela umzi; ngokuba uThixo wabaphazamisa ngezinto zonke ezibuhlungu.
Ke wena, ube namandla; musa ukulahleka; kuba kukho umvuzo wemisebenzi yakho.

Ke kaloku, akuva uAsa la mazwi, umyalezo ka-Odede umprofeti, waba namandla; wasusa iinyembezi ezibi kuzo zonke iilizwe zikaYuda noBhenjamin, nakwiidolophu ebezithathe ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim; waza walungisa isibingelelo sikaYehova phambi kwendlu yangasemva yetempeli kaThixo.

Wazihlanganisa bonke abantu bakaYuda noBhenjamin, nabahlali phakathi kwabo abavela eEfrayim, noManase, noSimeon; kwabakho namadoda amaninzi asuka kumaSirayeli aye kuye, bebona ukuba iNkosi uThixo wakhe unguye.
Bahlangana eYerusalem ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga, ngonyaka olishumi elinambini wokumkani kukaAsa.
Banikela umbingelelo kuYehova ngaloo mini, kwizinto ezilahlekileyo ababezibuyisele, iinkomo ezimakhulu asixhenxe, neenkomo zamawaka asixhenxe.
Bakwenza umnqophiso wokufuna iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi babo, ngentliziyo yabo yonke nomoya wabo wonke.
Nabani na ongeke afune iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, wayefa, nokuba ngumntwana, nokuba ngumdala, nokuba ngumfazi, nokuba ngumfazi.
Bathi ke banikela umnikelo kuYehova ngelizwi elinamandla, ngovuyo olukhulu, nezidumbu neebhokhwe.
Ke kaloku bonke amaYuda bayavuya ngaloo nto, ngokuba babethembise intliziyo yabo yonke; bafuna iNkosi ngentliziyo yabo yonke, bamfumana. Wabanika ke iNkosi uxolo ngazo zonke iinkalo.

Ke kaloku ukumkani uAsa wasusa uMahaka, umkakhe, ukuba angabi ngukumkani, ngenxa yokuba wayeyenze idini elibuhlungu likaAshere; uAsa wayala elo dini, wayitshisa ibe yimpuphu, wayitshisa emlanjeni weKedron.
Iindawo eziphakamileyo zomlilo azisuswa kuSirayeli; ke kaloku intliziyo ka-Asa yayithembekile ngokupheleleyo zonke imihla yakhe.
Waza wazisa endlwini kaThixo isilivere, negolide, nezitya, ezo zinto yena noyise babezilungiselele uThixo.
Akukho mfazwe ngaphezu koko, waya kunyaka omashumi mathathu anesihlanu wokumkani kukaAsa.
Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesithathu nesixhenxe wokumkani kukaAsa, uBhasha ukumkani wakwaSirayeli waya eYuda; walungisa iRama, ukuze akukho namnye oza kungena nokuphuma kuAsa ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Wathabatha ke uAsa isilivere negolide ezityeni zendlu kaYehova, nezityeni zendlu yokumkani, waza wazisa kuBhe-hadadi ukumkani waseAram, owayehlala eDamasko, esithi,

Kubekho umnqophiso phakathi kwam nowe, njengokuba kwakukho phakathi kukayise wam noyise wakho; bona, ndithumelele isilivere negolide. Yiya uphucule umnqophiso wakho noBhasha ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ukuze amshiye mna.
Ke kaloku uBhe-hadade wamthobela ukumkani uAsa; wathumela abathetheli bemikhosi yakhe emizini yamaSirayeli; bahlasela iIyon, neDan, neAbeli-mayim, nemizi yonke yokugcina izinto kaNafetali.
Ke kaloku, xa uBhasha efundile loo nto, wamisa ukwakha iRama, wayeka umsebenzi.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uAsa wathabatha bonke amadoda aseYuda, athabathe iithayile namatye, ayewasebenzisayo uBhahasha ekwakha iRama; wayisebenzisa loo nto uAsa ekwakha iGibeha neMizpa.

Ngelo xesha ke waya kuAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda uHanani, umprofeti, wathi kuye, Uthe wathembela kumkani waseAram, wawungathembeli kuYehova uThixo wakho; ngoko ke iqela lokumkani waseAram lithe laphuma kuwe.
AbaKushi, nabaLibhi, abazange babe ngumkhosi omkhulu na, benezithuthi zemfazwe, neenqanawa ezininzi kakhulu? Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba ukholose kuYehova, wabanikela phambi kwenu.
Amehlo kaYehova ajonge phezu kwehlabathi lonke, ukuba anike amandla abo ingqondo yabo ilungile kuye. Niye niyenze into engaqhelekanga kuloo nto; ukusukela ngoku kuya kubakho iintshaba kuni.
Ke kaloku uAsa waxoka kulowo umbonayo, wambeka endlwini yokugcina; ngokuba wayexhalabile kuye ngenxa yaloo nto. Wathi ke uAsa ngaloo xesha, Akukho namnye kubo bonke abantu owenza into enobubi.
Zonke izinto azenzayo uAsa, eziqalekayo neziphelileyo, zihleli zibhalwe kwincwadi yamakumkani amaYuda namaSirayeli.

Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesithathu nesithoba wokumkani wakhe, uAsa waba nesifo seenqwelo zakhe; isifo sakhe saba sibuhlungu kakhulu; ke kaloku, nakwisifo sakhe, akazange ajonge kuYehova ukuba aphiliswe, wakhangela abagqirha.
Wafa ke uAsa ngomnyaka wesine nesixhenxe wokumkani wakhe.

Bayamzika ekufumaneni kwakhe isibingelelo, ebesitshisa ngokwakhe emzini kaDavide; bamisa phezu kwebhedi yakhe, beyigubungela ngezinto ezinomsoco, neziqhamo ezenziwe ngumzobi weentyatyambo. Babenza umlilo omkhulu kakhulu ukuwuhlonipha.
UYoshuwafati unyana ka-Asa waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe; waqinisa ubukumkani bakhe phezu kwaSirayeli.
Wabeka amajoni kuwo onke amadolobha aseYuda anezikhephe; wabeka namagqwetha emkhosini ezweni laseYuda, nasezidolophini zaseEfraim, ezo uAsa, uyise wakhe, ayezithatha.
Waye iNkosi noYosafati; ngokuba wayehamba ngendlela kaDavide, utata wakhe, ezinyangeni zakhe zokuqala; akawakhonzanga amaBaali.
Ke kaloku wakhangela kuThixo kayise, wagcina imigaqo yakhe; akayeki ukwenza njengoko besenza ooSirayeli.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waqinisa ubukumkani phantsi kwesandla sakhe; bonke abantu bakaYuda banikela isipho kuYowafati; waba nobutyebi obuninzi nobudumo.
Yathi intliziyo yakhe, ukuba ihambe ngeendlela zikaYehova; wasusa nakwiidolophu eziphakamileyo, neentyatyambo zeAshere, eYuda.
Ngomnyaka wesithandathu wokumkani wakhe, wathumela abaphathi bakhe, uBhenhayeli, noObhadiya, noZekariya, noNethaneli, noMika, ukuba bafunde emizini kaYuda.
Wathumela nabo abaLevi: uShemaya, noNethaniya, noZebadia, noAshayeli, noShemiramoti, noYonatan, noAdoniya, noTobiya, noTobadaniya; wathumela nabo oombingeleli uElishama noYoram.
Bafundisa ke abantu eYuda, babe nencwadi yomthetho kaYehova emandleni abo; bahamba bejikeleza kuwo onke amadolophu aseYuda, befundisa abantu.
Ke kaloku uzuko lukaYehova lwafika kuzo zonke izikumkani ezijikeleze iYuda, ukuze zingangeni emfazweni noYoshuwa.
Bathi ke nabanye abaFilisti bamnika uYoshafati isipho, nesilivere njengemali; bayamnika nabo amaArabhu inkomo, izimvu ezimakhulu asixhenxe, anamakhulu asixhenxe eebhokhwe.
Ke kaloku uJehoshafati waqhubeka enamandla; wayala iinqaba, nemizi yokugcina eYuda.
Wazigcina izityalo ezininzi emizini kaYuda; waza wagcina eYerusalem abantu abanamandla, abanobuchule.
Ngabo, ngomhla wokubhalwa kwabo ngokweentsapho zabo: kuYuda, abathetheli bamawaka; nguAdna umthetheli, naye namadoda amakhulu amawaka amakhulu mathathu;
emva kwakhe uYohanan, umthetheli, namawaka amabini anamakhulu asibhozo;
Emva kwakhe uAmasiya, unyana kaZikri, onikela ngokwakhe ukuba asebenze kuYehova, nomakhulu mabini amawaka abantu abanamandla.
NgoBhenjamin: uEliyada, umkhosi onamandla, nomakhulu mabini amawaka abantu abambe iziqhoboshi nezikhuselo;
emva kwakhe uYozabade, nomakhulu asibhozo anamakhulu asibhozo amawaka alungiselelwe ukulwa.
Baye ke aba bantu bakhonza ukumkani, ngaphandle kwabathunywa ababemi ezidolophini ezinqamlezileyo zonke eYuda.
Ke kaloku uJehoshafati waba nemali enkulu, nobudumo obuninzi; wadibana noAhabhi ngendoda.
Ke kaloku, emva kweminyaka emininzi, wahla waya kuAhabhi eSamari; uAhabhi wabulala iinkomo nezimvu ezininzi kuye, namadoda ahamba naye; wamxelela ukuba ahambe naye eRamoti-gileyadi.

Wathi uAhabhi, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, kuYoshuwafati, ukumkani wakwaYuda, Uza kuhamba na nam ukuhlasela iRamoti yeGiliyadi? Waphendula uYoshuwafati wathi, Ndiye nawe; abantu bam njengabantu bakho; siza kukudibana emfazweni.
Wathi ke uYoshafati kukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Ke kaloku, buza iNkosi ngaphambili.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wahlanganisa abaprofeti, amadoda angamakhulu amane, wababuza wathi kubo, Siya kungena eRamoti yeGiliyadi ukubhiyozela, okanye ndiyishiye? Bathi ke, Yiya; kuba uThixo uya kuyinika emkhosini ukumkani.
Wathi ke uJehoshafati, Akukho namnye na umprofeti kaYehova apha ukuba siwubuze?

Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYoshafati, Kukho umntu omnye ekufuneka siwubuze iNkosi ngaye; kodwa mna ndimnyamezela; ngokuba akathethi nam nto ilungileyo, kodwa into embi kuphela: nguMika unyana kaYimla. Wathi uYoshafati, Akufanele ukumkani athethe njalo.
Waza ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wabiza umphathi, wathi, Yiya khawuleza uMikaya unyana kaYimla.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, behlala emathrethini abo, begqoke iimpahla zabo zokumkani; behlala kwindawo evulekileyo entliziyweni yesango laseSamari; bona bonke abaprofeti bethetha ngokuprofeti ngaphambili kwabo.
UZedekiya, unyana kaKenanaya, wenza iinkomo zentsimbi, wathi, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Ngazo uya kubathutha ngasemva amaSiriya, de baphele.
Ke kaloku bonke abaprofeti bathetha ngaloo nto, besithi, Yiya eRamoti-gileyadi, uphumelele; ngokuba iNkosi uya kuyinika emkhosini.
Wathi kuye umthunywa, lowo waya kumnqula uMika, Yabona, bonke abaprofeti bethetha ngelizwi elinye into elungileyo kukumkani; nceda ke ukuba ilizwi lakho lifana nalo labo, uthethe into entle.
Wathi ke uMika, Uphila iNkosi, oko Thixo wam angandisithiyo, ndiya kuthetha.
Wafika ke kukumkani, ukumkani wathi kuye, UMika, kufuneka sihambe siye eRamothi-gileyadi ukubhiyozela, okanye ndiyishiye loo nto? Waphendula wathi, Yiya uphumelele; baya kuthuthwa kuwe.
Wathi kuye ukumkani, Ngaphi na amaxesha ndiza kukwenza ubeke isibonda, ukuba ungandithethili nto ngaphandle kwenyaniso egama likaThixo?

Wathi ke uMika, Ndibabona bonke amaSirayeli ephazamisekile emanzini aphakamileyo, njengokuba iinkomo zingenamlawuli; wathi ke iNkosi, Aba bantu bangabikho mphathi wabo; bahambe ngamnye endlwini yakhe ngoxolo.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYowafati, Andikuthembi na ukuba akathethi nam nto elungileyo, kodwa into embi?
Wathi ke uMika, Yizani ngoko ilizwi likaYehova: Ndabona iNkosi ehlala kwisithsaba sakhe, namadoda onke asezulu abekwe ngasekunene kwakhe nakwesobunxele.
Wathi iNkosi, Nguwuphi umntu oza kumxelela uAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ukuba ahambe eRamoti-gileyadi, aze afe khona? Umnye wathi into enye, omnye wathi into enye.
Waphuma ke umphefumlo, wahlala phambi koYehova, wathi, Ndiya kumxolela. Wathi iNkosi kuye, Uthini na?
Wathi yena, Ndiza kuphuma ndibe ngumphefumlo wobubi emlonyeni wabaprofeti bakhe bonke. Wathi iNkosi, Uya kumxolela, uya kuphumelela; yiya wenze oko.
Ngoku ke, bona, iNkosi wabeka umphefumlo wobuxoki emlonyeni wabo bonke abaprofeti bakho; iNkosi wathetha ukuba le nto inobungozi iya kuza kuwe.
Wafika ke uZedekiya, unyana kaKenanaya, wambetha uMika emlonyeni, wathi, UMoya kaYehova wawusuka phi na kum, ukuba athethe nawe?
Wathi uMika, Uza kukwazi ngaloo mini, xa uza kungena kwigumbi ngalinye, ukuze ufihlakele.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, Nciphisa uMika, umthumeli kuAmon, umphathi womzi, noYowashe, unyana kakumkani.
Nithi kubo, Utsho ukumkani ukuba, Nciphisaneni lo mntu endlwini yengxowa-mali, nimnike isonka esincinci namanzi, de ndibuye ndiphilile.
Wathi uMika, Ukuba uya kubuyela ngoxolo, ke ngoko iNkosi akathethi ngam. Wathi ke uMika, Khumbulani loo nto, nibantu bonke.
Waye ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda, ehlasela iRamoti yaseGiliyadi.
Wathi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli kuYoshafati, Ndiya kungena emfazweni ndizifihla; wena ke ugqoke izihlangu zakho zokumkani. Wazifihla ke ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, bafika emfazweni.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wakwa-Aram wabawisela umthetho abaphathi beenqanawa zakhe, wathi, Musani kuhlasela nabani na, nokuba mkhulu nancinci, ngaphandle komlawuli wamaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, abathetheli beemoto bebona uYowafati, bathi, Lo ngukumkani wakwaSirayeli. Baye ke bajikeleza ukuba bamhlasele; watsho uYowafati, iNkosi wamnceda, waza uThixo wabasusa kuye.
Ke kaloku, bebona abathetheli beenqwelo-moya ukuba akanguye ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, babuyela emva kwakhe.

Ke kaloku umntu omnye wabetha umqolo, engazange abeke imiyalelo; wabetha ukumkani wakwaSirayeli phakathi kwezinto zakhe zokuzikhusela. Wathi ukumkani kumqhubi wemoto yakhe, Buyela, ndisuse emfazweni; ngokuba ndivutha kakhulu:
Ke kaloku, intshayelelo yaba buhlungu ngaloo mini yonke; ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wahlala ekhayeni lakhe elinomkhosi, ejonge kuma-Aram, de kwafika isidlo sakusasa; xa ilanga lithe laphuma, wafa.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wabuyela ekhaya lakhe ekhuselekile, waya eYerusalem, endlwini yakhe.
Waphuma ke uYehu, unyana kaHanani, umprofeti, wamphendula, wathi kukumkani uYoshafati, Ingaba uya kunceda abantu ababi na? Uthanda na abo batshutshisa iNkosi? Ke ngoko, iNkosi unethutyana nawe.
Ke kaloku kukho izinto ezilungileyo kuwe; ususe iinkuni zeAshere ezweni, wabeka intliziyo yakho ekufuneni uThixo.
Wahlala ke uJehoshafati eYerusalem; waphuma kwakhona phakathi kwabantu, ukusuka eBher-shebha, waya ezweni eliphakamileyo likaEfrayim, wababuyisela kuYehova, kuThixo wabo babafazi.
Wabeka abagwebi kuloo lizwe, kuwo onke amadolophu akhuselweyo eYuda.
Wathi ke kubo abagwebi, Khumbulani oko nikwenzayo; ngokuba ningawugwebi umntu, kodwa iNkosi; yena uya kuhlala nani xa nigqiba ityala.
Ke ngoko, uzuko lukaYehova luza kuba nani; nijongeni oko nikwenzayo; ngokuba iNkosi, uThixo wethu, akabi nenyaniso; akajongi isizwe, akathatheli intlawulo.
Ke kaloku eYerusalem uYoshafati wamisela abaLevi, nababingeleli, namadoda amakhulu eentsapho zakwaSirayeli, ukuba abe ngamagqwetha kaYehova, aze agqibe izigwebo; bahlala ke eYerusalem.
Wabawisela umthetho, esithi, Nisebenzele ngokuthembekileyo, ngentliziyo yenu yonke, ngoxolo lukaYehova.

Xa abazalwana bakho abahlala ezidolophini zazo besiya kuwe ngomthetho wokubulala, nomthetho wemithetho, nomyalelo, nemimiselo, nezigwebo, nizixelele ngazo zonke izinto, ukuze bangabi nesono kuYehova; ukuze ingxabano yakhe ingabikho phezu kwakho nangaphezulu kwabazalwana bakho. Yenza njalo, uze ungabi netyala.

UAmariya, umbingeleli omkhulu, uya kuba phezu kwenu kuwo onke amatyala kaYehova; uZebadiya unyana kaIshmayeli, umlawuli wesizwe sikaYuda, uya kuba phezu kwenu kuwo onke amatyala kakumkani; ooLevi ke baya kuba ngabaphathi bakho. Babe namandla, nisebenze; yaye iNkosi abe nabo abazenzayo izinto ezilungileyo.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, kwafika abantu bakaMowabhi nakwa-Ammon, kunye nabantu abathile baseMehoni, ukuhlasela uYoshuwa.
Bafika abantu, baxela uYoshuwa, besithi, Iqela elikhulu livela eEdom liya kuwe, lisuka kwelinye icala lolwandle olufayo; bona, sele likho eHazason-tamare. Eli yiEngedi.
Ke kaloku uJehoshafati wakhathazeka, waza wamisa isandla sakhe ukuba abuze iNkosi; wathi kubo bonke abantu baseYuda ukuba bahlale begula.
Ke kaloku abantu bakaYuda bahlangana, becela iNkosi; kwafika abavela kumadolophu onke kaYuda, befuna iNkosi.
Ke kaloku uJehoshafati wahlala phambi kwamadoda aseYuda neYerusalem, endlwini kaYehova, phambi kwendlu entsha.
Wathi, Nkosi, uThixo wabafazi bethu, awunguye na lo Thixo osemazulwini? Ulawula ngazo zonke izikumkani zeentlanga; unamandla onke, unamandla amakhulu; akukho mntu unokukumelana nawe.
Thixo wethu, akunjalo na wena owazikhuphe izizwe ezihlala kuloo lizwe phambi kwabantu bakho bakaSirayeli? Akunjalo na wena owayinika imbewu kaAbraham umhlobo wakho kude kube kuphela?
Bahlala kuyo, bakwakha khona indlu igama lakho; bathi,

Ukuba siza kuvela kumngcipheko kuthi, nokuba ngumfazwe, nokuba ngumgwebo, nokuba yintsholongwane, nokuba yindlala, siya kuhlala phambi kwendlu le, phambi kwakho; ngokuba igama lakho likwindlu le; siya kuthandaza kuwe emngciphekweni wethu, uyayiva, uyasisindisa.
Khangela ke ngoku oonyana baka-Ammon, noMowabhi, nomnxweme waseSeiri; xa amaSirayeli ephuma eYiputa, wawungabavumelanga ukuba bafike ezi zweni; ngoko ke amaSirayeli atshintshile kuzo, awazibulala.
Ke ngoko, bona ngoku basenza ntoni na kuthi? Bafika besiya kusikhupha ezweni olinikele lona ukuba sibe yindawo yethu.
Thixo wethu, awuya kuwagweba na? Singenakukwazi ukumelana nalo mkhosi omkhulu othi ufike kuthi; asiyazi into esiyenzayo, kodwa amehlo ethu aya kuwe.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseYuda ahlala khona phambi koYehova, nabantwana babo, nabafazi babo, nabantwana babo.
Wafika uMoya kaYehova kuYahaziyeli, apho ephakathi komkhosi; wayengumLevi, waba nguAsafe, unyana kaZekariya, unyana kaBhenaya, unyana kaYeyele, unyana kaMatania.

Wathi, Nxibelelani, bonke ooYuda, nabahlali baseYerusalem, nokumkani uYoshuwafati; Utsho kuni iNkosi ukuthi, Musani ukuxoka, nize nigweme ngenxa yaloo mkhosi mkhulu; kuba lo mfazwe awukho wenu, kodwa nguThixo.
Mhlawumbi baya kukhupha ukuhlangabezana nabo; baya kunyuka ngendlela yokungena eSizi; uya kubafumana esiphelweni somlambo, phambi komhlaba omnyama weYeruyeli.

Akuyi kubakho mfuneko yenu yokulwa kuloo mfazwe. Nceda nihlale ndawoni, nihlale ndawoni, nilinde iNkosi ukuba akusindise, wena uYuda noYerusalem; musa ukuxoka, musani ukukhathazeka; phumani nidibana nabo namhlanje: ngokuba iNkosi uya kuba nawe.
Ke kaloku uJehoshafati wanqunyamisa ubuso bakhe ehlabathini; bonke abantu bakaYuda nabaseYerusalem bawela phantsi phambi koYehova, bakhonza.
Ke kaloku bavuka abaLevi abathile, abasuka kumaKahati namaKori, bavuma iNkosi uThixo kaSirayeli ngelizwi elikhulu kakhulu.

Bavuka kusasa, baphuma befika emasikweni aseTekoya. Ke kaloku, xa besuka, uYosafati wahlala, wathi, Nindixelele, niYuda nabaseYerusalem; nikholwa kuYehova uThixo wenu, ukuze nihlale; nikholelwa kumaprofeti akhe, ukuze niphumelele.
Wathetha nabo, wamisela abaculi ukuba bahambe phambi kweqela, bewuthanda iNkosi ngenxa yobuhle bakhe obungcwele. Bathi ke, Buzisani iNkosi; ngokuba ububele bakhe buhlala ubomi bonke.
Ke kaloku, xa beqala ukubiza nokuzinikela, iNkosi wabeka abantu abafihlakeleyo phezu kwabantwana baka-Ammon, namaMowabhi, nomnxweme waseSeyiri, abahlaselayo ooYuda; babanjwa.
Ke kaloku amaqela ka-Ammon namaMowabhi abuyela kubo abasemazantsi eSeyiri, babulala bonke abo. Bagqiba nabo abasemazantsi eSeyiri, babuyela, babulala ngamnye omnye.
Ke kaloku, befika amadoda eYuda apho kujongwa khona ihlabathi liphela, bajonge kuloo mkhosi mkhulu; ke bona, bonke ababonayo baba ziinkunzi ezifileyo ezilala phezu komhlaba; akukho namnye waphuma.

Wafika ke uYoshafati, namadoda akhe, ukuba athabathe iimpahla ezilahlekileyo; bafumanisa phakathi kwabafileyo izinto ezininzi zempahla entle, nezihlangu, nezinto ezintle kakhulu. Bazithabatha ezo zinto zininzi kangangokuba abakwazi ukuzithwala; kwathatha iintsuku ezintathu ukuba bazithathe zonke.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe bahlangana emlanjeni weBheraka, bewubiza khona iNkosi; ngenxa yoko yabizwa ngokuba yiNtlambo yeBheraka, de kube ngaloo mini.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda aseYuda neYerusalem, noYoshafati ephambili kwabo, abuyela eYerusalem, entliziyweni enothando; ngokuba iNkosi wabanika uthando phezu kwabachasi babo.
Bafika eYerusalem, beya endlwini kaYehova, benezikhonkothi, neziqhoboshi, neebhokhwe.
Ke kaloku kwafika ukukhathazeka kukaThixo kuzo zonke izikumkani zazo zonke iilwimi, xa beva ukuba iNkosi wahlasela oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku ubukumkani bukaYoshafati buphumle; ngokuba uThixo wakhe wamnika uxolo ngazo zonke izinto ezijikelezayo.

Ke kaloku uJehoshafati waba ngukumkani wakwaYuda; wayeminyaka imashumi mathathu anamihlanu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinambini engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguAzuba intombi kaShili.
Wahamba ngeendlela zikaAsa, uyise, akaze atshintshe kuzo; wenza oko kulungileyo ebusweni bakaYehova.
Ke kaloku iinyembezi eziphakamileyo azisuswanga; abantu abazange babeke intliziyo yabo kuThixo wabazali babo.
Zonke ezinye izinto azenzayo uYowafati, eziqalekayo neziphelileyo, zithe zabhalwe kuncwadi lukaYehu unyana kaHanani, olukwincwadi yamaKumkani bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, uJehoshafati ukumkani wakwaYuda wenza umnqophiso noAhaziya ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, lowo wayebi kakhulu.
Bathe bagqiba ukuba benze iinqanawa, zihambe ziye eTarshishi; bazenza iinqanawa eEzion-Geber.

Ke kaloku uEliyezere, unyana kaDodavahu, waseMaresha, waprofetisa ngoYowafati, wathi, Ngokuba ungenise isandla sakho kuAhaziya, iNkosi uya kuzibulala izinto ozisebenzelayo. Zathi inqanawa ziqhutywa,: azikwazi ukuya eTarish.
Ke kaloku uJehoshafati waphumla, wabanjwa nabazalwana bakhe eMzini kaDavide; uYoram unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
Ke kaloku uYoram wayenabazalwana, abanye oonyana bakaYoshafati: nguAzariya, noYehiyeli, noZekariya, noAzariya, noMikayeli, noShefatiya; abo bonke babe ziintsapho zikaYoshafati ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Ubaba wabo wabanika izipho ezininzi zesilivere, negolide, neempahla ezixabisekileyo, namadolophu aqinileyo eYuda; kodwa ukumkani wamnika uYoram, ngokuba wayeyintombi yokuqala.
Ke kaloku, xa uYoram ethathe ubukumkani bukayise, waqinisa isandla sakhe; wababulala bonke abazalwana bakhe ngeqhwa, nabanye abakhulu bakaSirayeli.
UYoram ubeminyaka imashumi mathathu anamibini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka esibhozo engukumkani eYerusalem.
Wahamba ngeendlela zabakumkani bakaSirayeli, njengendlu kaAhabhi eyahamba ngazo; ngokuba wayengumkakhe intombi kaAhabhi; wenza okubi phambi koYehova.
Ke kaloku iNkosi akafuni ukucima ikhaya likaDavide, ngenxa yomnqophiso wakhe noDavide; waza wathi kuDavide nembewu yakhe, ukuba uya kubanika isibane esikhanyayo ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku, ngexesha lokumkani uYoram, amaEdom asuka eYuda, wamisa ukumkani wakhe.
Ke kaloku uYoram waya khona, naye namadoda amakhulu akhe, nezithuthi zakhe zonke. Baye ke aba Edomu bamgubungela; wavuka ngobusuku, wabahlasela nabo nabaphathi bezithuthi zawo.
Ke kaloku iEdom yasuka phantsi kolawulo lukaYuda, iye mihla le. Ngowo ke uLibna waphuma kuye ngaloo xesha; ngokuba wayemshiya iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi bakhe.

Ke kaloku wakha izindlu eziphakamileyo eziphezulu, emazantsi entaba kaYuda; wabangela ukuba abantu baseYerusalem baphume emlonyeni kaThixo, njengokuba umfazi ethengisa isisu sakhe; wabangela ke ukuba amaYuda aphume emlonyeni.
Kwafika ke kuYoram incwadi evela kuEliya umprofeti, isithi, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaDavide utata wakho, uthi, Awuhambenga ngeendlela zikaJehoshafati uyise wakho, noAsa ukumkani wakwaYuda.

Ke wena uhambe ngeendlela zabakumkani bakaSirayeli, wabangela ukuba amaYuda nabahlali baseYerusalem bathini na kum, njengokuba kwenzeke kwindlu kaAhabhi; nawe wabulala oonyana bakho, oonyana bakayise wakho, abangcono kuwe.
Ke ngoko, ngoku iNkosi uya kubetha abantu bakho ngento ebuhlungu kakhulu, nabantwana bakho, namadoda akho, nezinto zonke ozinayo.
Uya kuba buhlungu kakhulu wena, ngenxa yesifo seentliziyo zakho; imihla ngemihla iya kunyuka inkulu, de ziphume iintliziyo zakho.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wavusa amaFilisti, nabaseArabhu abasemaphandleni kwamaEtiyopiya, ukuba bahlasele uYoram.
Bahlasela amaYuda, bafika, bathabathe zonke izinto ezifunyanwa endlwini kakumkani, nabantwana bakhe nabafazi bakhe; kwashiywa kuphela uYowahazi, unyana wakhe omncinane.
Ke kaloku, emva koko konke, iNkosi wambetha uYoram ngomhlaza wesibeleko, ukuba angaphiliswa.

Ke kaloku, emva kweminyaka elishumi elinambini, zaphuma izitho zakhe ngenxa yesifo sakhe; waza wafa ngeemvakalelo ezibi kakhulu. Amadoda akhe akazange amsindise ngomlilo, njengokuba babesenza kubazalwana bakhe.

UYoram ubeminyaka imashumi mathathu anamibini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka esibhozo engukumkani eYerusalem. Akukho namnye owayemlingisa emfazweni wakhe; bayamzika eMzi kaDavide, kodwa bekungabakho emasimini amakumkani.

Abahlali baseYerusalem bakwenza uAhaziya, unyana omncinane kaYoram, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe; kuba bonke oonyana abakhulu babebabulala abahlaseli ababeza neArabhu emkhosini. UAhaziya, unyana kaYoram, ukumkani wakwaYuda,: waba ngukumkani.
UAhaziya ubeminyaka imashumi mane anamibini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinambini engukumkani eYerusalem. Umfazi wakhe wayenguAtaliya intombi ka-Omri.
Wahamba neendlela zendlu kaAhabhi; ngokuba unyana wakhe wamcebisa ukuba akwenze okubi.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, njengendlu ka-Ahabhi; emva kokufa kukayise, babe ngabacebisi bakhe; kwathi ke oko kwaba ngumonakalo wakhe.
Ke kaloku, elandela icebiso labo, waya noYoram unyana kaAhabhi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, ekulwa noHazayeli ukumkani waseAram, eRamoti-gileyadi. Bathi ke abaAram babulala uYoram.

Ke kaloku uYoram wabuya waya eYizreyeli, ukuba aphilise izidumbu zakhe ezibalwe ngazo eRama, xa wayedlalwa nguHazayele ukumkani wakwaAram. UAhaziya unyana kaYehoram ukumkani wakwaYuda wehla waya eYizereli ukubukela uYoram unyana kaAhabhi; ngokuba wabanjwa.
Ke kaloku, uAhaziya efika khona, waphuma noYoram, ukuba ahlangane noYehu, unyana kaNimshi, lo mntu iNkosi wamtywinayo, ukuze aphelise ikhaya likaAhabhi.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa uYehu ebulala ikhaya likaAhabhi, wafumana abathetheli bakaYuda, nabantwana bezihlobo zikaAhaziya, abakhonzayo uAhaziya; wababulala.

Ke kaloku waya ekhangela uAhaziya. Bathi oonyana bakaYehu, bafumanisa ukuba ufihlakele eSamari; bamthabatha kuye uYehu, bambulala, bamzika; ngokuba bathi, Uyise kaYosafati ke yena, lowo wafuna iNkosi intliziyo yakhe yonke. Akukho namnye kusapho lukaAhaziya onamandla okuphatha ubukumkani.
Ke kaloku, xa uAthaliya, umzali kaAhaziya, ebona ukuba unyana wakhe ufile, wavuka waza wabulala bonke oonyana bakakumkani baseYuda.

Ke kaloku uYoshabhathi, intombi kakumkani uYoram, wamfihla uYowashe, unyana kaAhaziya, phakathi kwabantwana bakakumkani abaza kubulawa; wamfihla yena noyisekazi wakhe ekamelweni lokuhlambela. UYoshabhathi, intombi kakumkani uYoram, indodana kaYehoyada ukumkani, wayeyintombi kaOhaziya; wamfihla lo mntwana phambi kukaAthaliya; ngoko ke akawubulalanga uAthaliya.
Wahlala nabo, efihlakele endlwini kaThixo, iminyaka emithandathu; ke uAtaliya waba ngukumkani welizwe.

Ke kaloku ngomnyaka wesixhenxe, uYehoyada wafumana intliziyo yakhe; wabambisana nabathetheli bamawaka: nguAzariya unyana kaYeroham, noIshmayeli unyana kaYohanan, noAzariyahu unyana kaObedi, noMashekiya unyana kaAdaya, noElishafati unyana kaZikri.
Bahamba bonke eYuda, bahlanganisana amaLevi kuwo onke amadolobha abo, namadoda amakhulu eentsapho zakwaSirayeli; bafika eYerusalem.

Ke kaloku bonke abantu abathe bahlangana, bamisa umnqophiso nokumkani endlwini kaThixo. Wathi kubo uYehoyada, Yabona, unyana womkani uya kuba ngukumkani, njengokuba wathi iNkosi ngabantwana bakaDavide.
Le nto niyenzayo: isithathu senu, ababingeleli nabaLevi, abaphumayo ngeSabbathi, bagcine izibuko.
Isithathu siza kuba endlwini kakumkani, nesithathu siza kuba emnyango wesiseko; bonke abanye abantu baya kuhlala ezindlwini zendlu kaYehova.
Musani kuzisa nabani na endlwini kaYehova, ngaphandle kwababingeleli nabaLevi abakhonzayo; baya kungena bona, ngokuba bangcwele; bonke abantu ke bahlale phandle, bephulaphule umthetho kaYehova.
Bathi ke amaLevi ahlale engqongileyo kukumkani, umntu ngamnye enesithuthi sakhe esandleni sakhe; ukuba ngubani na oza kungena kwindlu kaThixo, niyamfaze. Nibe nomkakhe apho esiya khona.

Ke kaloku abaLevi, namadoda onke aseYuda, bayenze yonke loo nto uYehoyada ukumkani wamwiselayo; umphathi ngamnye wathabatha amadoda akhe, abo bephumayo emthendelekweni, nabaphumayo emthendelekweni; ngokuba uYehoyada ukumkani akazange avumele iqela elinye lihambe.
Ke kaloku uYehoyada, umbingeleli, wabanika abathetheli beentlanga iinqanawa, nezikhuselo ezikhulu nezincinci, zakumkani uDavide, ezibekwe endlwini kaThixo.
Wabeka oonyana bonke, ngamnye enesithuthi sakhe esandlani sakhe, ejikeleze ukumkani, ukususela ecaleni lasekunene lendlu kuya ecaleni lasekhohlo, phambi kwesibingelelo nendlu.
Baphuma ke unyana kakumkani, bamisa phezu kwakhe isithsaba, bamnika ikopi yomthetho womnqophiso, bakwenza waba ngukumkani. UYehoyada nonyana bakhe bamenza umkhenkce, besithi, Uphile ukumkani!
Ke kaloku uAthaliya wayeva intliziyo yabantu behamba, benqumlela ukumkani; waya kubo endlwini kaYehova.

Wabona, ke kaloku ukumkani uhlala ecaleni komthi wakhe osemgangathweni wesango, namagqwetha akhe, nabaqhubi-trombone phantsi kwakhe; nabo bonke abantu belizwe babhiyozela, bephucula ii-trombone, nabadlali bemiboniso behamba phambi kwabo. Ke kaloku uAthaliya waluka iimpahla zakhe, wathi, Nibaphulaphuli, nize nibaphulaphuli!

Ke kaloku uYehoyada, umbingeleli, wathumela abathetheli beentlanga, abaphethe umkhosi, wathi kubo, Yikhupheni emehlweni amadoda; nabani na oza kumlandela, bulalaneni naye. Umbingeleli ke wathi, Musani ukumbulala endlwini kaYehova.
Ke kaloku, xa efika ekungeneni kwesango lemahashe endlwini kakumkani, bathabathela kuye, bambulala khona.
Wakwenza ke uYehoyada umnqophiso phakathi kwakhe, naphakathi kwabantu bonke nokumkani, ukuba babe ngabantu bakaYehova.
Ke kaloku abantu bonke bafika endlwini kaBhali, bayikhupha; izibingelelo zakhe nemifanekiso emihle yezandla yakhe yayiyiphuca, babulala uMathan, ukumkani kaBhali, phambi kwezibingelelo.

UYodaya wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kweempawu zendlu kaNdikhoyo, ezigqunywe ngababingeleli baseLevi, abalungiselelwe nguDavide kwindlu kaSirayeli, ukuze banikezele izibingelelo ezincibilikayo kuYehova, ngokwemithetho kaMoses, nobubele nengoma, njengokuba uDavide wayewisela umthetho.
Wabeka abagwebi emasangoni endlwini kaYehova, ukuze akukho namnye ongcolileyo ngandlela-thile angangena.

Wathabatha abaphathi beentlanga, namadoda amakhulu, nabalawuli bezizwe, nabo bonke abantu baselizweni, bathabathela ukumkani esuka endlwini kaYehova. Bahamba ngesango eliphezulu lendlu kakumkani, babeka uKumkani phantsi kwisihlalo sobukhosi.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu belizwe babhiyozela, umzi ke waphumla; kuba uAthaliya wababulala ngeqhosha.
UYowashe ubeminyaka ilishumi elinesixhenxe ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mane engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguSibiya waseBher-sheba.
Ke kaloku uYowashe wenza okulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova zonke iintsuku zokuphila kukaYehoyada ukumkani.
Ke kaloku uYehoyada wamthatha amadodana amakhulu amabini; waza wazala oonyana nabafazi.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, uYowashe wabeka engqondweni kwakhe ukulungisa indlu kaThixo.

Wazibiza ababingeleli nabaLevi, wathi kubo: Yiya emizini kaYuda, nithabathe imali kumaSirayeli onke ngonyaka ngamnye, ukuze nilungise indlu yoThixo wenu; yenzani ngokukhawuleza. Ke kaloku amaLevi akazange ahlele.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wambiza uYehoyada, umkhonzi omkhulu kaThixo, wathi kuye: Kutheni na ukuba abaLevi bangabikho bengenisa iindleko ezisuka eYuda naseYerusalem? UMoses, umkhonzazana kaYehova, nabantu bakaSirayeli babeka le ndleko yetente yomnqophiso.
Ke kaloku oonyana baka-Athaliya, lo mfazi ongalunganga, batshisa itempile kaThixo, basebenzisa izinto ezingcwele zetempeli kaYehova ukuba zisebenze kuBaali.
Wathi ke ukumkani, bayenze ibhokisi yomthi, bayibeke ngaphandle, emnyango wendlu kaYehova.
Bathi ke, babhengeza kuwo onke amaYuda neYerusalem, ukuba abantu babengele kuYehova intlawulo kaMoses, umkhonzi kaThixo, eyayimiselwe amaSirayeli esiqwini.
Ke kaloku bonke abathetheli, nabantu bonke, bayavuya ukukwenza oko; babezisa imali yabo, beyibeka ebhokisini, de iphele.

Ke kaloku, xa abaLevi bezisa isiqulatho kubaphathi bakakumkani, babona ukuba kukho imali eninzi kuso; ke ngoko, wayefika umbhali kakumkani, nomphathi wombingeleli omkhulu, wabasusa kuyo. Baye babuyisela isiqulatho endaweni yayo; babesenza njalo mihla ngemihla, bafumana imali eninzi.

Ke kaloku ukumkani noYehoyada banikela lemali kubo bonke abaphathi bemisebenzi yendlu kaYehova; baqesha oomatiloshe, nabakhonzi bezitena, ukuba bayilungise indlu kaYehova, nabenzi bentsimbi nentsimbi engenasici, ukuba bayiqinise.
Ke kaloku, abasebenzayo basebenze kanzima, baqhubela phambili ukulungisa; balungisa kwakhona indlu kaThixo ngokwemimiselo yayo, bayiqinisa.

Ke kaloku, begqibile, bazisa kukumkani noYehoyada imali eyonwabisayo; bayilungisa ngayo iimpahla zendlu kaYehova, izinto zomsebenzi wendlu kaThixo, nezinto zokunikela, izitya, nezitya zegolide nesilivere. Kuzo zonke iintsuku zobomi bukaYehoyada, zathotywa iintsontelo zomnquba endlwini kaYehova mihla le.
Ke kaloku uYehoyada waba mkhulu, waphila iminyaka emininzi eyonwabisayo; wafa wayeneminyaka engama-130 yobudala.
Wazitywinwa phakathi kwabakumkani eMzini kaDavide, ngokuba wenza okulungileyo kakhulu kumaSirayeli, kuThixo nendlu yakhe.
Ke kaloku, emva kokufa kukaYehoyada, bafika abathetheli bakaYuda, baba ngumbulelo kukumkani; ukumkani waphulaphula inyaniso yabo.
Bashiya indlu kaYehova, uThixo wabazalwana babo, bakhonza iiAshere nemifanekiso eqingqiweyo; kwathi ke ngenxa yalo monakalo, uThixo wabaxolela ooYuda noYerusalem.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathumela kubo abaprofeti, ukuba bababuyisele kuye; babemxelela ooprofetayo, kodwa abazange bathethe.

Wafika uMoya kaThixo kuZekariya, unyana kaYehoyada, umLevi; wahlala phezu kwabantu, wathi kubo, Utsho uThixo, Niziphulaphule njani imiyalelo kaYehova? Akuyi kuba ngonaphakade. Kubanishiya iNkosi, naīcingela nani.
Ke kaloku bakwenza idini kuye; ngomthetho wokumkani, bamthabatha ngamatye, waza wafa endlwini yendlu kaThixo.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uYowashe akayikhumbula inyaniso yakhe, eyayenzayo kuye uYehoyada, uyise kaZekariya; wabulala ke unyana wakhe. Ke kaloku, xa uZekariya wayefa, wathi, UYehova ajonge, akubuyisele.

Ke kaloku, ngokuphela konyaka, kwafika umkhosi wamaSirayeli ukulwa noYowashe; bahlasela iYudiya neYerusalem, babulala bonke abathetheli belizwe, bathumela zonke izinto ezilahlekileyo kukumkani wabo eDamasko.
Ke kaloku iqela lakwaAram lincinci; ke kaloku iNkosi wamnikela phambi kwabo iqela elikhulu kakhulu; ngokuba bashiye amaYuda iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi babo. Wathi ke uYowashe ngale ndlela.

Ke kaloku, baphuma amaAram, uYowashe wahlaselwa buhlungu; ke kaloku, abakhonzi bakhe bamxolela, ngenxa yokuba wambulala unyana kaYehoyada umbingeleli. Bamwila ebhedini yakhe, waza wafa; wabanjwa emzini kaDavide, kodwa akafunyanwa kwiziko lamakumkani.
Ke kaloku amadoda athethelayo kuye, nguZabadi unyana kaShimeathi, indoda yaseAmmon; noYozabadu unyana kaShimriti, indoda yaseMowabi.
Ke kaloku, imiba yawo oonyana bakhe, neziprofeto zakhe ezininzi, nokwakha kwakhe indlu kaThixo, bona, zibhalwe kwincwadi yamaYuda. UAmasiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UAmasiya ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anesixhenxe ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinambini engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguYohadan waseYerusalem.
Wenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova, akunjalo ke ngentliziyo yakhe yonke.
Ke kaloku, xa ubukumkani bakhe bebuqinisekile, wabulala abo bathetheli ababulalayo unyana wakhe ukumkani.

Ke oonyana babo awawabulalanga; njengoko kubhalwe emthethoni, kwincwadi kaMoses, apho iNkosi ewiselayo umthetho khona, esithi, Abazali bangafa ngenxa yabantwana babo, nabantwana bangafa ngenxa yabazali babo. Wonke umntu uya kufa ngenxa yesono sakhe saye.

Ke kaloku uAmasiya wahlanganisa abantu bakaYuda, wabamisa ngokwezindlu zabazali babo, abe ngabaphathi bamawaka, nabaphathi bamawaka, kuwo onke amaYuda nakwaBhenjamin. Wababala abaneminyaka engama-mashumi mabini nangaphezulu; wabafumana amakhulu mathathu amawaka abantu abakhethiweyo, abanokungena emkhosini, besebenzisa isigwebo nesikhuseli.
Ke kaloku waqesha kumaSirayeli amawaka amakhulu, amadoda anamandla, ngeetoni ezintathu zesilivere.
Ke kaloku kwafika kuye umntu kaThixo, wathi, Ukumkani, akufuneki iqela lakwaSirayeli lihambe nawe; ngokuba iNkosi akakho nakwaSirayeli, nabo bonke abantu bakaEfraim.
Nakuba uhambe, ube ngumntu onamandla, uThixo uya kukuvumela umchasi wakho ukuba akuhlasele; ngenxa yokuba uThixo unegunya lokukunceda, nokwenza ukuba ulwe.
Wathi ke uAmasiya kumntu kaThixo, Yintoni na loo mali yonke endiyihlawulile iqela lakwaSirayeli? Waphendula lo mntu kaThixo wathi, UYehova unokukunika okuninzi kunale.
Ke kaloku uAmasiya wayalela oonyana bakaSirayeli abathe bafika kuye eEfrayim, wathi kubo, Yiya ekhaya lenu. Baye baxoka kakhulu kuYuda, baye endlwini yabo bexoka.
Ke kaloku uAmasiya waba namandla, wathatha iqela lakhe waya eNtaba yeSali; wabulala khona amawaka alishumi eSeiri.
Ke kaloku amaYuda athabathe ubomi amadoda amawaka amabini, ayewabeka ecaleni komngxunya wenduli, wabatyhila phezu kwayo; bonke baqhutywa.
Ke kaloku oonyana baka-Amasiya, abaye babuyiselwa ukuba bangabikho emfazweni, bahlasela imimandla kaYuda, evela eSamariya waya eBhathoroni; babulala amawaka amathathu, bathabathe iintaka ezininzi.
Ke kaloku, kwabuya uAmasiya ehlasela ama-Edom, wazisa izitha zabahlali baseSeyiri, wazimisa zibe ziyimithi yakhe, waza wazingca, wabafumisa intyatyambo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxoka kuAmasiya, wamthumelela umprofeti, wathi kuye, Kutheni na ukuba ukhonza izithixo zalaba bantu? Abazange basindise abantu babo phambi kwakho.

Ke kaloku, ngelixa uprofeti ethetha, ukumkani wathi kuye, Mhlawumbi sikwenza wena ube ngumcebisi kukumkani? Yima; kutheni na ukuba ufa? Wayeka ke lo mprofeti, wathi, Ndiyazi ukuba uThixo wagqiba ukukucima, ngokuba wenze loo nto, ungamthobeli umcebisi wam.
Wathetha ke uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda nabacebisi bakhe, wathumela kuYowashe unyana kaYehohaza, unyana kaYehu, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, esithi, Yiya, sijongene ngobuso nobuso.

UYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wamphendula uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, esithi, Intyatyambo eLibanoni yamthumelela umthi wesedari okwiLibanoni, isithi, Nceda unina wakho wamnike unyana wam ukuba abe ngumfazi wakhe. Ke kaloku kwafika intlanzi yomhlaba eLibanoni, yabetha intyatyambo.
Uthi, Ndiwahlasela ama-Edom; ke ngoku uyamkela umsindo wakho; hlala endlwini yakho; kutheni na ukuba ucele ingxaki, ukuze uhlaselwe, wena noYuda nawe?
Ke kaloku uAmasiya akayi kuphulaphula; kuba uThixo wakwenza oku, ukuze abonise ebantwini babo, ngokuba bakhonza amadini aseEdom.
Waphuma ke uYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, wadibana naye noAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda emfazweni eBhethe-shemeshi, eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli abulala amaYuda; bonke amadoda aseYiputa aye endlwini yakhe.

UYowashe ukumkani wakwaSirayeli wathabathela uAmasiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, unyana kaYowashe, unyana kaYehohaza, eBhete-shemesi; wamthabatha waya eYerusalem, wabaphula idonga laseYerusalem, ukusuka kwisango likaEfrayim ukuya kwisango lesangqa, ibe ziimitha ezilishumi elinesibhozo.

Wathabatha igolide yonke, nesilivere yonke, nazo zonke izinto ezifunyanwa endlwini kaThixo, ezigcinwe ngu-Obede-Edom; wathabatha nakwiimpahla zendlu kakumkani, wathabatha namadoda amabi, waya eSamari.
UAmasiya unyana kaYowashe, ukumkani wakwaYuda, waba ubomi beminyaka elishumi elinamihlanu emva kokufa kukaYowashe unyana kaYehohaza, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Zonke ezinye izinto azenzayo uAmasiya, eziqalekayo neziphelileyo, zihleli zibhalwe kwincwadi yamakumkani amaYuda nakwaSirayeli.
Ngomhla wokuba uAmasiya esuka elandela iNkosi, kwabakho ukubhiyozela kuye eYerusalem; wabaleka waya eLakishi. Bathumela emva kwakhe eLakishi, bambulala khona.
Baya kumthabatha emkhosini, bayamzisela phakathi kwabazalwana bakhe, eYerusalem kaYuda.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bakaYuda bathatha uUziya, owayeneminyaka elishumi elinamithandathu ubudala, bakwenza ukumkani endaweni kaAmasiya uyise.
UUziya wayala iElathi, wayibuyisela kumaYuda, emva kokufa kukayise.
UUziya ubeminyaka ilishumi elinamithandathu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mabini anesihlanu engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguYekoliya waseYerusalem.
Wakwenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova, njengoko wayesenza uAmasiya uyise.
Wajonga uThixo yonke imihla kaZekariya, umntu owayemfundisa ukuba agweme uThixo; yonke imihla awayejonga iNkosi, uThixo wamnceda.
Waye waya ekulwa nabaFilisti, waphula imigangatho yeGati, neYabneha, neAshdodi; wakhiwa amadolophu eAshdodi, nakwiindawo zakwaFilisti.
UThixo wamnceda ebantwini baseFilisti, neentlanga zaseArabhu ezihlala eGuri-bhaali, nabaseMeunithi.
Ke kaloku amaAmmon anika uUziya imali yomnikelo. Waba mkhulu kakhulu, wafika waya kumasango eYiputa; ngokuba waba namandla amakhulu.
Ke kaloku uUziya wayala iinqaba eYerusalem, kwisango lesangqa, nesango lentaba, nakwisango lesangqa sodonga, waza wazenza ziqinile.

Wakha namatye engqongileyo, waxhaphaza iziqulatho zamanzi ezininzi; kuba wayenazo iinkomo ezininzi emazantsi entaba, namahlathi aphantsi. Waba neentyatyambo zesiqhamo nezityalo zeziqhamo eziphakamileyo, nezityalo zasendle; ngokuba wayethanda ukulima.
Waye uUziya enemikhosi elungiselelwe umfazwe, ebekwe ngamaqela; babalolwa nguYeyeli umbhali, noMasheya umphathi, phantsi kolawulo lukaHananiya, omnye wabaphathi bakakumkani.
Kwaba ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu asixhenxe, abaphathi bezindlu zakwamadoda amakhulu.
Ngabo kwakukho amawaka amakhulu amathathu, anamashumi asixhenxe amawaka, anamakhulu amahlanu, amadoda aqeqeshiweyo emfazweni ngesandla esinamandla kakhulu, ukuze amncede ukumkani ebantwini bakhe.
Ke kaloku uUziya wamnika umkhosi wonke izithuthi, nezikhephe, nezigqubuthelo zobuso, nezithuthi-mlilo, namathontsi, namatye eentsontelo.

Ke kaloku, eYerusalem, waba nezixhobo ezenziwe ngabantu abaqeqeshiweyo, ukuba zibekwe ezityeni, nakwiikona zedonga, ukuze ziqhutywe ngamaqhosha, ziqhutywe ngamatye amakhulu; waza wafumana igama libanzi, ngenxa yokuba uThixo wamnceda ngezinto ezimangalisayo, de waba namandla.
Ke kaloku, xa uUziya enamandla kakhulu, intloko yakhe yathi iya kumnqula; waphula umthetho kaYehova uThixo wakhe. Wafika endlwini kaYehova, ukuba afumise uvumba kwisibingelelo sokufakela uvumba.
Ke kaloku uAzariya, umbingeleli, wafika emva kwakhe, naye namawaka asibhozo oombingeleli bakaYehova abanamandla.

Bathi kukumkani uUziya, Akukuko kuwe, Uziya, ukuba usindise intyatyambo kuYehova; le yimisebenzi yababingeleli, oonyana baka-Aron, abalungiselelwe ukusindisa intyatyambo. Yiya ngaphandle kwendawo engcwele; ngokuba uxhalabile; uThixo kaNdikhoyo akakuhloniphi ngenxa yoko.

Ke kaloku uUziya wayenebhotile yokufumisa intyatyambo esandla sakhe; waza waxoka. Yathi ke, emehlweni abo ababingeleli phambi kwesibingelelo sokufakelwa umnqamlezo endlwini kaYehova, kwaphuma iintsholongwane emlonyeni wakhe phambi kwabo.

UAzariya, umbingeleli omkhulu, nababingeleli bonke, bajonge kuye, babona iintsholongwane zesikhumba ebusweni bakhe. Baye bamkhawulezisa ukuba aphume endlwini kaThixo; yena ke wakhawuleza ukuba ahambe, ngokuba iNkosi wambetha.

Ke kaloku uUziya ukumkani waba neentlungu zesikhumba, kuze kube yimini yokufa kwakhe; wahlala endlwini eyahlukileyo, ngokuba wayeneentlungu zolusu. Akakwazanga kungena kwisibingelelo sikaYehova. UYothame unyana wakhe wayengumphathi wendlu kakumkani, wayalela abantu belizwe.
Zonke ezinye izinto azenzayo uUziya, zabhalwa nguIsaya umprofeti, unyana kaAmozi, ukususela ekuqaleni kuye kukuphela.
Wafa ke uUziya, wabanjwa nababukumkani bakhe, emzini wokuzibulala kwabakumkani; ngokuba bathi, Waba nesifo sesikhumba. UYotam unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UYotam ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamihlanu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinamithandathu engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguYerusha intombi kaSadoko.
Wakwenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova, njengoko wayesenza uUziya uyise; ke kaloku akazange angene endlwini kaThixo, njengokuba wayengene uyise. Ke kaloku abantu baqhubeka besenza okubi.
UYothame wakwakha kwakhona isango eliphezulu lendlu kaYehova, waza wenza udonga olukhulu eOfel.
Wakhiwa amadolophu entlango kaYuda, nakwiindawo ezingqongileyo zomthi wakhiwa iinqaba neentyatyambo.

Wahlasela ukumkani wabo oonyana baka-Ammon, wababulala; ke kaloku abo abantwana bakwa-Ammon bamnika kuloo nyaka isiqingatha setoni yesilivere, namawaka alishumi elineshumi elinambini eekore zengqolowa, namawaka amashumi amabini anesihlanu eekore zesheyile. Ngomnyaka wesibini nowamathathu babemnika njalo.
Ke kaloku uYothame waba namandla, ngokuba walungisa indlela yakhe, wamthobela iNkosi uThixo wakhe.
Nazo zonke ezinye izinto azenzayo uYotam, nemikhosi yakhe yonke, neendlela zakhe, zingaba zibhalwe na kwincwadi yamakumkani bakaSirayeli noYuda?
Ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamihlanu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinamithandathu engukumkani eYerusalem.
Wafa uYotam, wabulawa eMzini kaDavide; uAhazi unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.

UAhazi ubeminyaka imashumi mabini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinamithandathu engukumkani eYerusalem. Akakwenzanga oko kulungileyo emehlweni kaYehova, njengokuba wenzayo uDavide, uyise.
Ke kaloku wayehamba ngeendlela zabakumkani bakaSirayeli; wakwenza namagqabi egolide eeBhaali.
