Wafumisa uvumba emlanjeni kaBhen-hinnom, wafumisa oonyana bakhe ukuba babe yimibingelelo emnqamlezweni; wenza ngokweempawu ezibi zezizwe, ezo iNkosi wabakhupha phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Wanikela izibingelelo, waza wasindisa uvumba eziphakameni zeentaba, nakwiinduli, phantsi komthi wonke oluhlaza.

Wathi iNkosi, Thixo wakhe, écrita kuye ukumkani waseAram; bawubetha ke ooAram, bathabathe abantu bakhe abaninzi, baba yimikhosi eya eDamasko; wabekwa nokumkani wakwaSirayeli, wababulala amadoda akhe amaninzi.
Ke kaloku uPeka, unyana kaRemaliya, wabulala eYuda, ngosuku olunye, amawaka amakhulu amabini anamashumi mabini, amadoda amakhulu; ngokuba babemshiya iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi babo.
Ke kaloku uZikri, umkhosi onamandla waseEfrayim, wabulala uMaasiya, unyana kakumkani, noAzrikam, umphathi wendlu, noElkana, omncinane kukumkani.
Bathabathela ooSirayeli abazalwana babo baseYuda, amawaka amabini anamakhulu amabini, amadoda, noonyana, neentombi; bathabathela nento eninzi yezinto ezilahlekileyo, bazisa eSamari.

Ke kaloku kukho khona umprofeti kaYehova, igama lakhe nguOdede; waphuma waya kudibana nalo mkhosi, xa efika eSamariya, wathi, Yabona, iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi benu, ngenxa yobuxoki bakhe kubo bonke amaYuda, wabanikela phambi kwenu; nibabulala ke nina ngoxinzelelo oluya phezulu emazulwini.
Namhlanje ke nicinga ukuba nibamise abantu bakaYuda nabaseYerusalem, amadoda nabafazi, ukuba babe ngabakhonzi benu; kodwa ningabikho nani nobubi kuYehova uThixo wenu?
Ke ngoko, ndimxelele; buyiselani abafazi nibathatheyo phakathi kwabazalwana benu; ngokuba inkanuko yomlilo kaYehova ikho phezu kwenu.

Ke kaloku kwaphuma abanye abathetheli bakaEfrayim, bahlasela amadoda abuyayo emfazweni: nguAzariya unyana kaYohanan, noBherekiya unyana kaMesilemote, noYehezkiya unyana kaShalum, noAmasa unyana kaHadlayi.
Bathi kubo, Musani ukuthutha apha abo babulawayo; nifuna ukongeza isono sethu nobubi bethu phambi koYehova; kuba ububi bethu bukhulu kakhulu, yaye inkanuko yakhe inamandla phezu kwaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku abakhonzi bashiya abadumileyo, nempahla ethethwayo, phambi kwamadoda amakhulu, nangabo bonke abantu.

Ke kaloku abo madoda abizwa ngegama, bathabathe abafazi; nabo bonke abamnyama, babebagqoka ngale nto, babebagqoka, babebagqoka izihlangu, babebanika ukutya nokusela, babeka ioli ebusweni babo; nabo bonke abakhubazekileyo, babebakhupha phezu kweebhokhwe, babazisa kubazalwana babo eYerusalem, emzini weentyatyambo. Babuyela eSamari.
Ngelo xesha ukumkani uAhazi wacela uncedo kumakumkani baseAshuri.
Ke kaloku babuya abaEdom, bahlasela amaYuda, bathabathe abantu abafileyo.
Ke kaloku abaFilisti bahlasela imimandla yendawo ephantsi, nasempumalanga kaYuda; bathabathela iBhete-shemeshi, neAyaloni, neGederethi, neSoko, neTimna, neGimzo nezixeko zazo, bahlala kuzo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wawakhupha amaYuda ngenxa kaAhazi ukumkani wakwaSirayeli; ngokuba washiya amaYuda ahambe, waba nento engafanelekanga kakhulu kuYehova.
Wafika kuye uTiglathi-pilesere, ukumkani wakwaAsiriya; wayemxolela, akawuncedanga uThixo.
Ke kaloku uAhazi wathabatha izinto zetempeli kaYehova, nendlu kakumkani, namadoda amakhulu, wamnika ukumkani wakwaAsiriya; akazange azisebenzise.
Ukumkani uAhazi, xa wayekwixesha lakhe elibuhlungu, waqhubeka ekhohlisa iNkosi.

Wanikela izibingelelo ezingcwele zaseDamasko, ezo zamhlaselayo; wathi ke, Iintliziyo zamakumkani aseAram ziye zabanceda; ngoko ndiya kubanika idini labo, ukuze bandise uncedo lwam. Ke kaloku babe ngumonakalo wakhe, nomonakalo wabaSirayeli bonke.
Ke kaloku uAhazi wathabatha izinto zetempeli kaThixo, waza wazingquma; wavala iminyango yetempeli kaYehova, wamisa izibingelelo kwikona nganye yendlela eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku, kuwo onke amadolophu aseYuda, walungisa izindlu eziphakamileyo, ukuba asindise uvumba kuThixo othile; waza wamangalisa iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi bakhe.
Nazo zonke ezinye izinto zakhe, nazo zonke iindlela zakhe, eziqalekayo neziphelileyo, zithe zabhalwe incwadi yamakumkani amaYuda namaSirayeli.
Wafa ke uAhazi, wabanjwa emzini waseYerusalem; kodwa akafumaneki emasimini amakumkani bakaSirayeli. UHezekiya unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UHezekiya ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamihlanu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mabini anesixhenxe engukumkani eYerusalem. Unyana wakhe wayenguAbiya intombi kaZekariya.
Wakwenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova, njengoko wayesenza uDavide, uyise.
Ngonyaka wokuqala wokumkani wakhe, ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga yokuqala, wavula iindonga zetempeli kaYehova, wayilungisa.
Wabazisa oombingeleli nabaLevi, wabahlanganisa ndawonye kwindawo evulekileyo esemntla.
Wathi kubo, Ndixeleleni, niLevi; zinikeleni ngoku, niyigcinele iTempile kaYehova uThixo wabasetyhini benu, nizisuse zonke izinto ezingcolileyo kwindawo engcwele.
Bathi ooyise bethu, basenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova uThixo wethu, bamshiya; batshintshe imilomo yabo kude nendawo yokuhlala kukaYehova, bajikelezisa imilenze yabo kuye.
Zazivala izibuko lendawo yokungena, zazitshisa iinkunzi zeenkomo; bezingawuthuthi umnquba, nesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, kuThixo wakwaSirayeli, kwindawo engcwele.
Ke kaloku, iNkosi waxoka kuYuda noYerusalem; wabazisa ukuba babe ngumthwalo woxinzelelo lwabantu, nomthwalo woxinzelelo, nomthwalo woxinzelelo, njengoko nibona ngamehlo enu.
Ke kaloku abazalwana bethu babulawa emfazweni, oonyana bethu, neentombi zethu, namadodana ethu athathwe ebantwini.
Ndathi ke ngoku, ukuba ndenze umnqophiso noYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, ukuze inkanuko yakhe eshushu ihambe kuthi.
Namhlanje, oonyana bam, musa ukuba nobuxoki; ngokuba iNkosi wakhetha kuni ukuba nihlale phambi kwakhe, nisebenze kuye, nibe ngabakhonzi bakhe, nifumise uvumba.

Ke kaloku abaLevi bamisa izandla zabo ukuba benze umsebenzi: kusapho lwakwaKahati, nguMahati unyana kaAmasayi, noYoweli unyana kaAzariya; kusapho lwakwaMerariya, nguKishi unyana kaAbdi, noAzariya unyana kaYehaleleli; kusapho lwakwaGershoni, nguYowa unyana kaZima, noEden unyana kaYowa.
Kusapho lukaElizafan: uShimri noYehuyeli; kusapho lukaAsaphi: uZekariya noMatania.
Kusapho lukaHeman: uYehuyeli noShimeyi; kusapho lukaJeduthun: uShemaya noUziyele.
Bahlanganisana ke abazalwana babo, bamisa izandla zabo, bafika becoca indlu kaYehova, njengoko ukumkani abewisela umthetho ngayo, ngokwelizwi likaThixo.

Baya kungena ababingeleli ngaphakathi kwendlu kaYehova, ukuba bayihlanze; bazisa zonke izinto ezingcolileyo ababezifumana endlwini kaThixo, ziphuma kwindlu yangaphakathi. AbaLevi baya kuzithabatha, bazithutha emlanjeni weKedron.

Baqala ukubhiyozela indlu ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yokuqala; ngomhla wesibhozo wenyanga bafika endlwini kaYehova; bachitha iintsuku ezisibhozo bebhiyozela indlu kaYehova, bagqiba ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga yokuqala.

Bafika ke kukumkani uHezekiya endlwini kakumkani, bathi, Sisele sicocekile yonke indlu kaYehova, nesibingelelo sesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, nezithuthi zayo zonke, netephu yeentlanzi zokubeka, nezithuthi zayo zonke.
Siyazilungiselela ke, sizingcwelele zonke ezo zinto ukumkani uAhabhi wazisa, xa wayengumkumkani, ephelelwe lithemba kuThixo; bona, zingaphambili kwesibingelelo sikaYehova.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uHezekiya wavuka ekuseni, wahlanganisa abakhulu bedolophu, waya endlwini kaYehova.

Bathabathela iinkunzi zeenkomo ezisixhenxe, namabhokhwe asixhenxe, neentlanzi ezingamashumi amabini anesixhenxe, namadoda amakhulu eegusha alishumi elinambini, abe ngumnikelo wesono kukumkani, kwindlu kaThixo, noYuda; ukumkani wathi kubabingeleli, oonyana baka-Aron, ukuba banikela ngazo phezu kwesibingelelo sikaYehova.

Bathi ke ababingeleli, babulala iinkunzi zeenkomo, bathabathe igazi labo, bayitshisa phezu kwesibingelelo; babulala oonyana bakaSirayeli, bayitshisa igazi labo phezu kwesibingelelo; babulala iintlanzi, bayitshisa igazi labo phezu kwesibingelelo.
Bathi ke bazisa amabhokhwe omnikelo wesono phambi kokumkani nangaphambili kwabantu; babeka izandla zabo phezu kwawo.

Ke kaloku ababingeleli babulala iinkunzi zeegusha, babeka igazi labo phezu kwesibingelelo, ibe yidini lesono, ukuze kulungiswe uThixo kubo bonke amaSirayeli; kuba ukumkani wayewisela umthetho ukuba kwenziwe idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, nedini lesono, kubo bonke amaSirayeli.

Wabeka ke uHezekiya abaLevi endlwini kaYehova, benee-cymbals, nee-harps, nee-piare, ngokwemiyalelo kaDavide, noGadi, umprofeti wokumkani, noNathan umprofeti; ngokuba lo myalelo wawuvela kuYehova, ngesandla sabaprofeti bakhe.
Ke kaloku amaLevi ahlala elungiselelwe ngeentsimbi zikaDavide, nababingeleli neentsimbi.

Ke kaloku uHezekiya wathi kubo, Ninikele idini eliqhutywa ngamandla phezu kwesibingelelo. Xa liqala idini eliqhutywa ngamandla, kwaqala nongoma kaYehova, neembombo, neziculo zikaDavide ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bathandaza, nabaculi bengoma, nezidumbu zidlale, de kwagqitywa umnikelo wokushiswa.
Ke kaloku, xa begqityiwe ukunikela, ukumkani, nabo bonke ababe naye, bahlangula, bakhonza.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uHezekiya, nabathetheli bakhe, bathetha kuLevithi, ukuba babuyise iNkosi ngeelizwi likaDavide, noAsafe umprofeti. Babhiyozela ke ngovuyo, bahlangula, bathandaza.

Wathi ke uHezekiya, Nceda, ngokuninika izandla zenu kuYehova; nifike, ninikele izibingelelo nezibingelelo zobubele kwindlu kaYehova. Bathi abantu banikela izibingelelo nezibingelelo zobubele; wonke othandazelayo wanikela izibingelelo zokufa.
Bathi ke abantu banikela ngeenkomo ezimashumi asixhenxe, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezilikhulu, neentlanzi ezimakhulu amabini; zonke ezo ziidini eziqhutywa limlilo kuYehova.
Ezinye iinkomo, ezo zabekwa njengezinto ezingcwele, zazimakhulu amathandathu eebhokhwe, namawaka amathathu eemvu.

Ke kaloku ababingeleli abazange baphelelanga, ukuba bakwazi ukuthambisa zonke iinkunzi zebhokhwe eziqhutywa ngamanzi; ke ngoko abazalwana babo, amaLevi, wabanceda, de kube kugqityiwe loo msebenzi, naphezu kokuba abanye ababingeleli begqibezela ukulunga kwabo; kuba amaLevi ayemthanda kakhulu ukulunga kwabo kunababingeleli.

Kwaba zininzi izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngomlilo, kunye nenyama yezibingelelo zoxolo, nezibingelelo zokusela, ezisuka ngazo zonke izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngomlilo. Ke kaloku iinkonzo zendlu kaYehova zabuyiselwa.
Ke kaloku uHezekiya, nabantu bonke, bayavuya ngenxa yezinto azenzayo uThixo kubo bonke abantu; ngokuba zonke ezi zinto zathethwa ngaphaya.

Ke kaloku uHezekiya wathumela kuwo onke amaSirayeli neYuda, wabhala namaphepha kumaEfrayim nakumaManase, wababiza ukuba bafike endlwini kaYehova eYerusalem, ukuze benze iPasha kuYehova uThixo kaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku ukumkani, namagqwetha akhe, nabo bonke abantu baseYerusalem, bacebisa ukuba benze iPasha ngenyanga yesibini.
Abazange bakwazi ukuyenza ngaloo xesha, ngokuba ababingeleli babengenakuthethwa, abantu ke abazange bahlangane eYerusalem.
Yathi loo nto ilungile phambi kokumkani, nangaphambili kwabantu bonke.

Bagqiba ke ukuba bathunyelwe umyalezo kuwo onke amaSirayeli, ukusuka eBher-shebha ukuya eDan, ukuba baye eYerusalem, benze iPasha kuYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli; kuba abantu abaninzi abazange bayenze ngokuthethwa ngumthetho.

Bathi ke abathunywa, bathabathe iileta ezisuka kukumkani nakwiimfazwe zakhe, zafika kuwo onke amaSirayeli nakumaYuda; ngokwemiyalelo yokumkani, zisithi, Buyeleni kuYehova, uThixo kaAbraham, noIsake, namaSirayeli, nina maSirayeli; aze abuye kubo bonke abaseleyo phakathi kwenu abasuka kumakumkani baseAshuri.
Musani ukuba ningabafazi benu, nabangani benu, ababemxhalabisa iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi babo; wavumela ukuba bakhululwe, njengokuba nibonayo.

Musani ukuxhaphaza iinwele zenu, njengokuba kwabanjalo ooyise benu; zinikeleni kuYehova, nifike endlwini yakhe, eyaye yayilungisa ibe yingcwele ngonaphakade; nikhonze iNkosi uThixo wenu, ukuze inkanuko yakhe enobuxoki igqume kuwe.

Ukuba niya kubuyela kuYehova, baya kuba nesonka kubo abantu abathuthayo abazalwana benu nabantwana benu, ukuze babuye kuloo lizwe; ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wenu unobubele nobulumko, akayikubuyiselanga isandla sakhe kuwe, ukuba niye kuye.
Bahamba ke abathunywa, besuka emzini waya emzini, eEfrayim naseManase, bafike eZebulon; babemxelela, babemxolela.
Ke kaloku kwabakho amadoda asuka eAshere, naseManase, naseZabulon, aye eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku eYuda, amandla kaThixo abangela ukuba abantu bavume ukuthobela umthetho wokumkani nabathetheli, ngokwelizwi likaYehova.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wenyanga yesibini, bahlangana eYerusalem abantu abaninzi kakhulu, ukuba benze usuku lweentlanzi ezingaphekiwanga.
Bazisusa izibingelelo eYerusalem, bazisa zonke izibingelelo zefuthe, bazithutha emlanjeni weKidron.
Babhiyozela iPasha ngomhla weshumi elinesine wenyanga yesibini; ababingeleli nabaLevi bakhathazeka, baba ngcwele, bangenise iintsontelo eziqhutywa ngamandla endlwini kaYehova.
Baye bamisa isikhundla sabo, ngokwemithetho kaMoses, umntu kaThixo; ababingeleli batywina igazi labo, labaLevi belibanika.
Ke kaloku abantu abaninzi kulo msitho abazange bangcwelele; ke ngoko amaLevi abulala iinkunzi zeenkomo zePasha kuwo onke amadoda angacocekanga, ukuba azingcwelele kuYehova.

Baninzi abantu, kuEfrayim noManase noIsayakare noZebulon, abazange bacocwe; ke kaloku babedla iPasha engathethwa ngumthetho. Ke uHezekiya wathandaza kubo wathi, UYehova olungileyo asuse wonke umntu umonakalo wakhe,
abo babeka intliziyo yabo ekufuneni uThixo, iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi babo; nokuba bangabi nacoceko ngomthetho wendlu kaThixo.
Waphendula iNkosi uHezekiya, waphilisa abantu.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli eYerusalem, bagcine imini yeentlanzi ezingaxutywanga, iintsuku ezisixhenxe, ngovuyo olukhulu; abaLevi nababingeleli bewuthanda iNkosi mihla le, bewubiza iNkosi ngemibhobho emihle.

Ke kaloku uHezekiya wakhuthaza ooLevi bonke abakwaziyo ukukhonza kuYehova. Badla inxalenye yabo ngemihla yesixhenxe yosuku olungcwele, benikela izibingelelo zoxolo, babonga iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi babo.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bagqiba kwelokuba benze isikhumbuzo seentsuku ezisixhenxe. Basenza ke isikhumbuzo sazo ezinye iintsuku ezisixhenxe, bevuya.

Ke kaloku uHezekiya, ukumkani wakwaYuda, wanikela kubo abantu inkunzi yenkomo elinamawaka amabini, nenkomo elinamakhulu asixhenxe; oonyana bakakumkani banikela kubo inkunzi yenkomo elinamakhulu mabini, nenkomo elinamakhulu mahlanu. Baninzi ababingeleli ababhiyozelayo.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bakaYuda, nababingeleli, nabaLevi, nabo bonke abantu abathe bafika eYiputa, namaSirayeli, nabasetyhini abathe bafika eYiputa, nabahlali baseYiputa.
Ke kaloku kwabakho uxolo olukhulu eYerusalem; kuba kungekho nto injalo eYerusalem ukususela kwimihla kaSolomon, unyana kaDavide, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Bavuka ke oombingeleli nabaLevi, babhaptiza abantu; uThixo wabaphendula, ibingelelo lwabo lwafika emazulwini, kwindawo yakhe engcwele.

Ke kaloku, kwagqitywa zonke ezi zinto, baphuma bonke amaSirayeli abakhoyo emadolophini kaYuda, batshisa iinkunzi zeenkomo, bathabathe ii-ashere, baphula izindlu eziphakamileyo, nezibingelelo, kuwo onke amazwe kaYuda noBhenjamin, naseEfrayim naseManase, de babeziphelile zonke. Babuyela ke bonke amaSirayeli emizini yabo, ezweni labo.

Ke kaloku uHezekiya wamisa oombingeleli nabaseLevi ngokweziqu zabo, ngamnye ngomsebenzi wakhe; abanye banikela ngeentliziyo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo; abanye ke bekhonza, bezithandazela, baze zivuya emehlweni endlu kaYehova.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wanikela iinkomo ezisuka kwimpahla yakhe, ukuze zilungiselelwe izibingelelo zokungcwatywa ekuseni nakusihlwa, nezimbingeleli zeentsuku zentlanganiso yenyanga entsha, neentlanganiso zonyaka omtsha, njengokuba kubhalwe emthetho kaYehova.
Wathi ke kubantu abahlali eYerusalem, ukuba banikezele inxalenye yabo kubabingeleli nabaLevi, ukuze babeke ixesha labo lonke emthethweni kaYehova.

Ke kaloku, xa loo myalelo uphumayo, oonyana bakaSirayeli banikela ngezinto zakuqala zeentyatyambo zabo, nengqolowa, newayini elungileyo, neoli, nenkukhu, nazo zonke izinto ezivela emasimini; banikela ngokuninzi kakhulu, ishumi lento yonke.

Ke kaloku oonyana bakaSirayeli nakwaYuda, abahlala edolophini kaYuda, bazisa ishumi lezinto zabo eziphilayo, nezimvu, neshumi lezinto ezingcwele, ezinikezelwe kuYehova uThixo wabo; bazenza zibe ziintonga.
Baqala ukwenza imiqulu ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga, bagqiba ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga.
Bafika ke uHezekiya, nabathetheli bakhe, babona iinkunzi zezityalo, bavuma iNkosi, babambisa abantu bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uHezekiya wababuza ababingeleli nabaLevi ngemiqulu.

Waphendula ke uAzariya, umbingeleli omkhulu, wendlu kaTsadoki, wathi, Ngomhla aba bantu baqala ukuzisa izipho endlwini kaYehova, sadla saphelelwa, sashiya nento eninzi; ngokuba iNkosi ubambisela abantu bakhe; le nto ininzi kakhulu esiyishiyeleyo.
Wathi ke uHezekiya kubo, Balungiselele izindlu zokugcina endlwini kaYehova; bazenza.
Bezifaka ngokuthembekileyo izipho, nezishumi, nezinto ezingcwele; uKonaniya umLevi waba ngukumkani phezu kwabo, noShimehi unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani osibini.

UYehileli, noAziya, noNahati, noAsaheli, noJerimothi, noYozabadi, noEliyeli, noI dalimi, noMahati, noBhenaya, babe ngabaphathi abaphantsi kwesandla sikaKonania, noShimeyi unyana wakhe; kwaba nguHezekiya ukumkani, noUzariya, umphathi wendlu kaThixo.
UKore unyana ka-Imna, umLevi, umgcini weengcango emnyango wasempuma, wayesezinikezelweni zoThixo; yena wazisa izinikezelo zikaYehova, nezingcwele kakhulu.

Ngasekunene kwakhe kwakukho uEden, noMinyamini, noYeshuwa, noShemaya, noAmariya, noShekaniya; basebenza ngokuthembekileyo emizini yabazalwana bakaThixo, benika iintsapho zabo iziqendu zazo, abafileyo nabafileyo.

Babanika amacandelo oonyana abaneminyaka emithathu nangaphezulu, abo babhaliswe ngokweziqu zabo zabafazi, bonke abaphumayo endlwini kaYehova ukuba benze umsebenzi wabo wosuku nosuku, ngamaqela awo, ngomsebenzi wabo.
Babanika oombingeleli, ngokweziqu zabo zabafazi, nakwaLevi abaneminyaka engama-mashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, ngomsebenzi wabo, ngamaqela abo.
Ke kaloku kwabantwana abancinci, nabafazi, namadodakazi, namadodana, namadodakazi, abhaliswe ngomhla wokuzalwa kwebandla lonke, banikela; ngokuba babezingcwele ngokwazo.

Kuba ababingeleli, oonyana baka-Aron, ababehlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ezijikeleze izixeko zabo, kwabakho amadoda abizwa ngegama kulo mzi ngamnye, ukuba anike iinkalo kubo bonke madoda phakathi kwamagqwetha, nakulo wonke umntu obhalwa kwincwadi yabaLevi.
Wakwenza njalo uHezekiya kuwo onke amazwe aseYuda; wasenza oko kwakulungileyo, nokuthe nkqo, nokuthembekileyo phambi koYehova uThixo wakhe.
Ke kaloku, yonke into awayeqala ukuyisenza ngomsebenzi wendlu kaThixo, nomthetho nomyalelo, wayenza ngentliziyo yakhe yonke, efuna uThixo wakhe. Waphumelela.

Ke kaloku, emva kokuba uHezekiya ekwenzele ezo zinto zonke ngokunyanisekileyo, kwafika uSenakheribhi ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, waya kuYuda; wamisa izikhephe ezingaphandle kwezixeko ezinqamlezileyo, ecinga ukuba uya kuzithatha.
Ke kaloku uHezekiya wayebona ukuba uSennakheri wafika, efuna ukuhlasela iYerusalem.
Wathetha ke namagqwetha akhe, neengqwalasela zakhe, ukuba batshise amanzi emilambo engaphandle komzi; baya kumnceda.
Ke kaloku abantu abaninzi bahlangana, batshisa zonke iziqhamo, nomlambo odlulayo phakathi kwelizwe; bathi ke, Ingaba abakumkani baka-Asiriya baya kungena bafumane amanzi amaninzi?

Ke kaloku uHezekiya wasebenza ngesandla sakhe, wayala zonke iinqanawa zodonga lwakhe, waza waba yimigangatho phezu kwayo. Wakha nodonga olunye ngaphandle kwalo, wamqinisa umzi kaDavide ngophahla oluqinileyo; wenza izithuthi nezikhuseli ezininzi.
Wabeka abathetheli bemikhosi phezu kwabantu, wabahlanganisela kwindawo evulekileyo yesango ledolophu; wabakhuthaza wathi,
Bakhokeleni, nibe namandla. Musani ukuxoka, ningabi nethemba ngenxa kakumkani waseAsiriya, nomkhosi omkhulu ohamba naye; kuba umkhulu lowo wethu kunaye.
Ke kaloku uThixo wethu, iNkosi, ungumncedisi wethu, ukuba asincede sifeze imibhiyozo yethu. Bakhululwa ke abantu ngamazwi kaHezekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda.

Ke kaloku, kwathi emva koko, uSennakheri ukumkani wakwaAsiriya wathumela abathetheli bakhe eYerusalem, ethetha noHezekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda, nabo bonke abantu bakaYuda ababe eYerusalem; ke kaloku umkhosi wakhe wonke wawuhlasela iLakishi.
Wathi, Utsho uSanheribhi ukumkani wakwa-Ashuri, Ndithi, Yintoni na le nto niyithemba ngayo, ukuba nihlala eYerusalem, xa iqhutywa?
Ngokuba uHezekiya uyakuxolelani, ukuze nife ngotywala notywala; esithi, UYehova uThixo wethu uza kusikhusela kukumkani waseAsiriya.
UHezekiya, yena, akawususanga na amadini aphakamileyo kaYehova, nezibingelelo zakhe? Akathi na kuYuda naseYerusalem, Nizikhonze kwisibingelelo esinye kuphela, nitshise uvumba phezu kwayo?
Uyazi na into endiyenzayo, mna nobawo bam, kuzo zonke iintlanga zezizwe? Ingaba amadini lamazwe anjalo angasindisa ilizwe labo kum?
Akukho namnye kubo bonke abangcwele beelizwe ababezibulala ooyise bam, okwaziyo ukusindisa abantu bakhe kum; ngoko ke uThixo wenu angakukhusela njani kum?

Musani ukuba uHezekiya akuxhoboze, akuxhoboze ngale nto; musa ukumkholwa; kuba akukho Thixo welizwe naliphi na, naliphi na igunya, okwaziyo ukusindisa abantu bakhe kum, okanye kubazalwana bam; ngaba ke uThixo wenu akakusindiseni nani kum?
Bathetha ke nangakumbi abaphathi bakhe ngoYehova uThixo, noHezekiya umkhonzi wakhe.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wabhala izibhengezo, ephulaphulisa iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, wathi kuye: Amadini eemfazwe akazange asindise abantu bakhe kum; ke ngoko noThixo kaHezekiya akazukusindisa abantu bakhe kum.
Ke kaloku abakhonzi bakhe babiza ngeelwimi zesiHebhere abantu baseYerusalem ababesedongweni, ukuba baphazamise, ukuba baphoxeke, ukuze bathathe lo mzi.
Bathetha ngoThixo waseYerusalem, njengokuba efana neentlanga zehlabathi, ezo zizinto ezenziwe ngamehlo omntu kuphela.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uHezekiya, noIsaya umprofeti, unyana kaAmozi, bathandaza ngenxa yaloo nto, batshola emazulwini.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wathumela isithunywa, sabulala bonke abavukeli abanamandla, nabathetheli, nabaphathi, emkhosini kakumkani waseAsiriya. Wabuyela ke uSenhakheribe ezweni lakhe elinobuxoki; waza waya endlwini yoThixo wakhe, kwathi apho abanye oonyana bakhe bambulala ngekrebe.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wamkhusela uHezekiya, nabahlali baseYerusalem, esandla sikaSenakheribhi ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, nasezandla zazo zonke izitha zabo; wabanika uxolo ngazo zonke iindawo.
Ke kaloku abantu abaninzi bazisa izipho kuYehova eYerusalem, nezipho ezilungileyo uHezekiya ukumkani wakwaYuda; ukusukela ngoko zonke iintlanga zathi ziyamthanda kakhulu.
Ngaloo mihla uHezekiya wagula, waya kufa. Wathandaza kuYehova; waphendula ke iNkosi, wamnika umqondiso.
Ke kaloku uHezekiya wavuka, akawuthandabuzi ubulungisa obufunyenwe kuye; waza ke iNkosi waxoka kuye, noYuda noYerusalem.
Ke kaloku uHezekiya, nabahlali baseYerusalem, bakhupha izandla zabo, babuyela emlonyeni wabo; ngoko ke, ingxabano kaYehova ayizange ifike kubo zonke iintsuku zobomi bukaHezekiya.
Ke kaloku uHezekiya wayenobutyebi obuninzi, nobudumo obukhulu. Wakha izindlu zokugcina isilivere, negolide, neethayile ezibalulekileyo, neziqhamo, nezithuthi, nazo zonke iintlobo zezinto eziluncedo.
Wakha namagumbi okugcina ingqolowa, newayini entsha, neoli yeoli, neendawo zokuhlala zonke iintlobo zezinto eziphilayo, nezibhedlele zeemvu.
Wakha izixeko kuye, wafumana iinkomo nezimvu ezininzi kakhulu; ngokuba uThixo wamenza abe mkhulu kakhulu.
Ke kaloku uHezekiya lowo wavala umlambo ophezulu weGihon, wayalela amanzi ukuba ahambe phantsi ecaleni lasentshonalanga lomzi kaDavide. Waphumelela uHezekiya kuzo zonke izinto awazenzayo.

Ke kaloku, xa abathetheli bakaBhabheli bethumela izithunywa ukuba babuze kuye ngophawu olumangalisayo lwaluye lwabakho kuloo lizwe, uThixo wamshiya, ukuze amvavanye, aze abone zonke izinto ezisentliziyweni yakhe.
Ezinye zonke izinto azenzayo uHezekiya, nezimilo zakhe ezilungileyo, zithe zabhalwe kumboniso kaIsaya umprofeti, unyana kaAmozi, encwadini yamaKumkani bakaYuda nakwaSirayeli.

Wafa ke uHezekiya, wabanjwa emnqamlezweni wezibingelelo zamadodana kaDavide; bonke abantu bakaYuda nabaseYerusalem bamnika ubukumkani ekufa kwakhe. UManase unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UManase ubeminyaka ilishumi elinamibini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mahlanu anesihlanu engukumkani eYerusalem.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova; wazenza izinto ezibuhlungu zezizwe, ezo iNkosi wayezikhuphe phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Wazilungisa kwakhona izindlu eziphakamileyo, uHezekiya, uyise, wazingcwaba; wamisa izibingelelo kumaBhali, waza wenza iinkunzi zeenkomo, waba ngumbulelo kuzo zonke iinkwenkwezi zezulu, wayikhonza.
Wakha izibingelelo endlwini kaYehova, kwindawo apho iNkosi ebethe ngayo, esithi, EYerusalem liza kubakho igama lam ngonaphakade.
Wakha izibingelelo iinkwenkwezi zonke zezulu, ezindlwini zombini zendlu kaThixo.

Wanikela oonyana bakhe emlilweni, eNtaba kaBhen-hinnom; waza wasebenza ngeentsingiselo, neengcamango, neengcamango zobuxoki, waya kumadoda athetha ngomoya, namaphupha; wenza okubi kakhulu ngamehlo kaYehova, enze ukuba abe nomsindo.

Wathabatha imifanekiso engumthi eqingqiweyo, awayeyenzayo, wayibeka kwindlu kaThixo; apho iNkosi wathetha khona kuDavide noSolomon unyana wakhe, esithi, Kule ndlu, naseYerusalem, endiyikhethileyo kuzo zonke iintlanga zakwaSirayeli, ndiza kulibeka igama lam kude kube sekupheleni.

Ndiya kuzisa kwakhona ooSirayeli, ukuba bangaphazamisi ilizwe endilibambise lona ooyise babo; ukuba nje bagcina ukuyenza yonke into endiyiwiselayo, umthetho wonke, nemimiselo, nezigwebo, ezinikezelwe nguMoses.
Ke kaloku uManase wabanga abantu bakaYuda nabaseYerusalem, ukuba benze okubi ngaphezu kwazo zonke izizwe awazibulalayo iNkosi phambi kwabaSirayeli.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuManase nosapho lwakhe; abazange bacinge.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wazisa phezu kwabo abathetheli-mkhosi bakakumkani wakwaAsiriya; bathabathe uManase, bamisa iintonga emlonyeni wakhe, bamnqula ngeentambo zentsimbi, bamthabatha waya eBhabheli.
Ke kaloku uManase, emehlweni engxakini yakhe, wathandaza kuYehova uThixo wakhe, waxolisa kakhulu phambi koThixo wabafazi bakhe.
Wathandaza ke iNkosi, wavuma umthandazo wakhe, waza waphendula isibingelelo sakhe; wambuyisela eYerusalem, waba ngukumkani wakhe. Waqonda ke uManase ukuba iNkosi nguThixo.

Ke kaloku, emva koko, uManase walungisa ugqubuthelo lwangaphandle loMzi kaDavide, ekumzantsi-mpuma womthombo weGihon, elunxwemeni, ukuya kwisingeniso sesango leentlanzi; wamgubungela umnqamlezo weOfeli, wamenza mkhulu kakhulu. Wabeka abathetheli bemikhosi kuwo onke amadolophu akhuselweyo aseYuda.
Wasusa endlwini kaYehova amadini angaphandle, nemifanekiso engumqondiso; waza wasusa zonke izibingelelo awazenzayo emnqamlezweni wendlu kaThixo, naseYerusalem, wazisa ngaphandle komzi.
Wayenza kwakhona isibingelelo sikaYehova, wanikela phezu kwayo izipho zoxolo nezipho zokubonga; wathi kumaYuda ukuba bakhonza iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku abantu baqhubeka besenza izibingelelo eziphakamileyo, kodwa kuYehova uThixo wabo.

Nazo zonke ezinye izinto azenzayo uManase, nomthandazo wakhe kuThixo wakhe, namazwi abo ababonisi ababethetha kuye ngegama likaYehova uThixo kaSirayeli, ngaba akunjalo, zibhalwe kwincwadi yamakumkani bakaSirayeli?

Umthandazo wakhe, nokuba iNkosi wamphendula njani, nezono zakhe zonke, nobuxoki bakhe bonke, nezixeko apho wazenza khona izikhumbuzo eziphakamileyo, waza wamisa iintaka zeAshere, neemifanekiso engumqondiso, phambi kokuba ahlonipheke; bona, zibhalwe kwincwadi yamaNgqina.
Wafa uManase, wabanjwa endlwini yakhe; uAmon unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani esikhundleni sakhe.
UAmon ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamibini ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emibini engukumkani eYerusalem.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova, njengokuba wenzayo uManase uyise. UAmon wanikela izibingelelo kuzo zonke iinkwenkwezi, awazenzayo uManase uyise, waza waziyalela.
Ke kaloku, akazange aphumle phambi koYehova, njengokuba waphucula uManase uyise; ke kaloku, uAmon wakhula ekwenzeni isono.
Ke kaloku abakhonzi bakhe babhiyozela kuye, bambulala endlwini yakhe.
Ke kaloku abantu belizwe babulala bonke abo babhiyozela ukumkani uAmon. Bakwenza uYosiya, unyana wakhe, waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UYosiya ubeminyaka ilishumi elinesibhozo ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emashumi mathathu anamibini ananye engukumkani eYerusalem.
Wakwenza oko kulungileyo ngamehlo kaYehova; wahamba ngeendlela zikaDavide, utata wakhe, akazange azitshintshe ngasekunene nakwesobunxele.

Kunyaka wesibhozo solawulo lwakhe, xa wayencinci, wanquma ukufuna uThixo kaDavide umzali wakhe; kunyaka weshumi elinanye wanquma ukucoca iYudiya neYerusalem, amadini aphezulu entlango, neentyantya zeAshere, nemifanekiso eqingqiweyo, nemifanekiso engumzi.

Ke kaloku, ekuboneni kwakhe, abantu baphula izibingelelo zezinto ezingcwele zikaBhaali; wathabathela iinkunzi zeenkomo ezibekwe phezu kwazo, waza wazilahla ii-ashere, nemifanekiso eqingqiweyo, nemifanekiso eqingqiweyo yobhedu, waza waba yimpuphu, wayitywina imipuphu phezu kweentsapho zalabo ababhiyozelayo.
Wazitshisa izihlunu zababingeleli phezu kwezibingelelo zabo; waza walungisa uYuda noYerusalem.
Wakwenza njalo kumadolophu kaManase, noEfrayim, noSimeon, waya eNafetali, nakwiindawo ezilahlekileyo ezijikelezayo.
Wazibulala izibingelelo, waza wazingquma iinkunzi zeenkomo, nemifanekiso eqingqiweyo yaba yimpuphu, waphula zonke izibingelelo zefuthe elinobucwebe kulo lonke elaseYiputa; wabuyela eYerusalem.

Ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo wokumkani wakhe, emva kokuba egqibile ukucoca ilizwe nendlu kaThixo, wathumela uShafani unyana kaAzaliya, no operatela womzi, uMashekiya, noYowa unyana kaYehohaza, umbhali, ukuba balungise indlu kaYehova uThixo wakhe.

Bafika ke kuHilkiya, umbingeleli omkhulu, banikela kuye imali ethe yafunyanwa endlwini kaThixo; abaLevi abagwebi beengcango babeyiqoqele kubo bonke abantu bakaManase noEfrayim, nakwamanye amaSirayeli, nabo bonke ooYuda nabaBhenjamini, nabaseYerusalem.
Zazinika kubo abaphathi bomsebenzi wendlu kaYehova; abo madoda bahlawulisa abasebenzayo, abalungisayo ikhaya loThixo, belisandise.
Babinika imali kubaqulunqi, nabaqambi, ukuba bathenge iithayile ezenziwe ngesandla, nemithi yokwakha, nophahla lwezindlu, abakumkani bakaYuda babezikhuphile.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, besenza loo msebenzi ngokuthembekileyo; babe ngabaphathi babo uYahati noObadiya, abaLevi abasuka kusapho lwakwaMerari; noZekariya noMeshulam, abavela kusapho lwakwaKahati; namanye ama Lawi, onke awazi iingoma,
babe ngabasebenzi abathabatha iimpahla ezithunyelweyo, belawula bonke abasebenzi emisebenzini yonke. Baye ke abanye abaLevi babe ngababhali, nabaphathi, nabakhuseli-ntlango.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa bekhupha imali eyafakwa endlwini kaYehova, uHilkiya ukumkani wafumana incwadi yomthetho kaYehova, eye yanikezelwa nguMoses.
Waphendula ke uHilkiya, wathi kuShafani umbhali, Ndifumene incwadi yomthetho endlwini kaYehova; wamnika ke uHilkiya incwadi kuShafani.
UShafani wathabatha incwadi waya kukumkani, wamxelela, wathi, Zonke izinto ozithethelayo, abakhonzi bakho bazenza.
Bathe basusa imali eyayisendlwini kaYehova, bayinika kubo abalawulayo nabasebenzayo.
Wathi ke uShafani umbhali kukumkani, UHilkiya ukumkani wamnika incwadi. Wafunda khona uShafani phambi kokumkani.
Ke kaloku, xa ukumkani eva amazwi omthetho, waluka iingubo zakhe.
Wabeka umthetho uHilkiya, noAhikamu unyana kaShafani, noAbdon unyana kaMika, noShafani umbhali, noAsaya umkhonzi wokumkani, wathi,
Uthe: "Nceda, qhubekani nicela iNkosi ukuba anincede, nina nabantwana benu abaseleyo eYiputa noIsrayeli, ngokubhekisele kumazwi abhalwe kulo mbhalo othi, 'Siza kwenza okulungileyo.' "

Waye ke uHilkiya, nabathunywa bakakumkani, kuHulda umprofeti; waye ngumfazi kaShalum, unyana kaTokhathi, unyana kaHasra, umphathi weempahla zokumkani. Wahlala eYerusalem, kwidolophu entsha. Baīcinga kuye izinto ezimnyakalayo.
Wathi kubo, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, Nithi kulowo mntu wamthumelelayo kuni,
Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Yabona, ndiya kuzisa ingozi kule ndawo nabasezidolophini bayo, zonke izibingelelo ezibhalwe kwincwadi efundelwe ukumkani wakwaYuda.

Ngokuba bamishiya, bamfumisa uvumba amadini amanye, ukuba bandise inkanuko yam ngemifanekiso engumqondiso yabo yonke, nemisebenzi yezandla zabo; ngoko ke ingxolo yam iya kuqhutywa phezu kwaloo ndawo, ayizukufa.
Ke kuye ukumkani wakwaYuda, owabathumelela ukuba babuze iNkosi, nithi kuye, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, ngamazwi awaziyo:

Ngokuba intliziyo yakho yathotywa, wayihlangula ngokwakho phambi koThixo, xa ufundile ilizwi lakhe malunga nale ndawo nabahlali bayo; wabahlangula wena ngokwawe phambi kwam, waluka izihlangu zakho, wayalela phambi kwam: ke mna ndakuphendula, utshilo iNkosi.
Yabona, ndiya kukuvumela ukuba uphile ngoxolo, ube nobubele nabazalwana bakho; awuzukubona lo monakalo wonke endiwuzisa kuloo ndawo nabahlali bayo. Bathi ke kubo ukumkani ilizwi lakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wababiza bonke abakhulu baseYuda naseYerusalem.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wanyuka waya endlwini kaYehova, naye wonke umntu waseYuda nowaseYerusalem, nababingeleli, nabaLevi, nabo bonke abantu, ukusuka kuncinci kuye kukhulu; wafunda ngamazwi abo onke amagama encwadini yomnqophiso, afunyenwe endlwini kaYehova.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wahlala endaweni yakhe, wenza umnqophiso phambi koYehova, ukuba uya kumlandela iNkosi, ukuba agcine imiyalelo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, nezigqibo zakhe, intliziyo yakhe yonke nomoya wakhe wonke, ukuze enze amazwi omnqophiso obhalwe kulo ncwadi.
Wakwenza ukuba bonke abaseYerusalem nakwaBhenjamin bathethe ngaloo nto. Bathi ke abantu baseYerusalem baphulaphule umnqophiso kaThixo, uThixo wabafazi babo.

Wazisusa ke uYosiya zonke iinyembezo kuzo zonke iilizwe zabantwana bakaSirayeli, wamenza wonke umntu eYiputa ukuba asebenze kuYehova uThixo wabo; bonke ubomi bakhe bebengaphaya kokumlandela iNkosi uThixo wabafazi babo.
Ke kaloku uYosiya wenza iPasha kuYehova eYerusalem; babhiyozela izimvu zepasha ngomhla weshumi elinesine wenyanga yokuqala.
Wabeka oombingeleli emisebenzini yabo, wabanceda ekusebenzeni kwabo kwindlu kaYehova.

Wathi ke kumaLevi, abafundisayo bonke amaSirayeli, abathe bahlukaniswa kuYehova, wathi, Nciphisa isiqwenga esingcwele endlwini kaSolomon, unyana kaDavide, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli; musa ukusithabatha ngaphezu kwemilenze yenu; ngoku nisebenzele iNkosi uThixo wenu, nabantu bakhe bakaSirayeli.
Nceda nilungiselele ngokweentsapho zenu, ngokweendidi zenu, njengokuba wabhala uDavide ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, noSolomon unyana wakhe.
Nibekho nikwindawo engcwele, nina namadoda amaLevi, ngamnye ngendlu yakhe yosapho, phakathi kwabahlobo benu bonke abantu.
Nqulethe iinkunzi zeenkomo zepasha, nizingcweleni, nizilungiselele kubazalwana benu, niyenze njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngoMoses.

Ke kaloku uYosiya wabanika abantu iinkomo ezimashumi mathathu amawaka, neenkunzi zeebhokhwe zakhe, ukuba zibe ziintyatyambo zePasika kubo bonke abakhoyo; waza wanikela iintlanzi zamawaka amathathu. Zonke ezo zinto zavela kwimpahla yokumkani.

Abasebenzi bakhe nabo banikela ngokuzithandela kubo bonke abantu, kumaSirayeli nakwilizwe liphela: uHilkiyahu, noZachariah, no-Abhimeleki, no-Eliezer, no-Ezer, no-Elhanan, no-Eliezer, no-Eliezer, no-Eliezer, no-Eliezer.

UKonaniya, noShemaya, noNethaneli, bazalwana bakhe, noHashabhiya, noYeyeli, noYozabadi, abathetheli bakaLevi, banikela kumaLevi amawaka amahlanu eemvu, neebhokhwe, neenkomo ezimakhulu amahlanu, njengeempawu zepaska.
Ke kaloku zonke izinto ezilungiselelwe ukukhonza zabekwa, ababingeleli bamisa ezindaweni zabo, nabaLevi ngomahluko wabo, njengoko ukumkani abewisela umthetho.
Bazibulala iinkunzi zeenkomo zePasika; ababingeleli batywina igazi, labaLevi babelibazisa; amaLevi ke akhupha inwele.
Zazibeka iinkunzi zebhokhwe, ukuba zinikezelwe abantu ngokwezindlu zabazali babo, ukuze bazinikela kuYehova, njengokuba kubhalwe kwincwadi kaMoses; bazenza njalo nenyama yenkomo.

Bazitshisa ke iinkunzi zeenkomo zePasika emanzini, njengokuthi kuthethwa ngumthetho; nezinto ezingcwele zazo zazitshisa kwiziqithi, neziqulatho, nezitya zokupheka, bazilungiselela ngokukhawuleza bonke abantu.

Emva koko abaLevi balungiselela kubo, nababingeleli; ngokuba ababingeleli, oonyana baka-Aron, babexakekile ngomnikelo wokushiswa notywala ukuya kusasa; ke ngoko abaLevi balungiselela kwabo, nababingeleli.

Abalingisi, oonyana baka-Afaf, babekhona ezindaweni zabo, ngokwendlela kaDavid no-Afaf, no-Jeduthun, umprofeti kaThixo. Iinkosikazi zazo zonke iintlobo zazihlala phantsi kweendawo zabo, zigcina isandla sazo kwisiqwengana ngasinye sempahla.
Yagqitywa ngoko yonke inkonzo kaYehova ngaloo mini, ukulungiselela iPasha, nokunikela izibingelelo ezitshiswayo phezu kwesibingelelo sikaYehova, njengoko ukumkani uYosiya abewisela umthetho.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli abakhoyo, bagcine iPasha ngaloo xesha, nosuku lweentlanzi ezingaqhelekanga, iintsuku ezisibhozo.

Ke kaloku, akufuneki ukuba kubekho iPasha enjalo kuSirayeli ukususela kwimihla kaSamuweli umprofeti; ke kaloku, akukho namnye kubo bonke abakumkani bakaSirayeli owenzayo iPasha efana naleyo uYosiya wayenza, naye oombingeleli, nabaLevi, nabo bonke abantu bakaYuda nabaSirayeli ababekhona, nabantu baseYerusalem.
Kwathi ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibhozo wokumkani kukaYosiya, kwaqhutywa iPasha le.
Emva kwayo yonke loo nto, xa uYosiya elungiselele indlu kaThixo, waphuma uNeko ukumkani waseYiputa, ukuba ahlasele eKarkemishe, emlanjeni weEfrayim. Waphuma uYosiya ukuba amhlasela.

Wathumela ke uNeko abathunywa kuye, esithi, Yintoni na into oyifunayo kum, wena ukumkani wakwaYuda? Namhlanje andifikanga ukuhlasela wena, kodwa ubukumkani bam; uThixo wandixelela ukuba ndikhawuleze. Musa ukulwa noThixo, okho nam, ukuze angakulahli.

Ke kaloku uYosiya akayeki ukubuyela; watshintsha iimpahla zakhe, waya kukulwa naye; akazange aphulaphule amazwi kaNeko, nakuba umyalezo wawuvela kuThixo. Wafika ke uYosiya ukuba ahlasele emazantsi eMegido.
Ke kaloku abathunywa babetha ukumkani uYosiya. Wathi ke kumadoda amakhulu akhe, Mthabatha mna; kuba ndidlwengula kakhulu.

Bathi ke abaphathi bakhe, bawukhupha emkhosini wakhe, bawubeka emkhosini wakhe wesibini, bamthabatha waya eYerusalem; wafa khona, waza wabanjwa emasimini ootata bakhe. Bonke abantu bakaYuda nabaseYerusalem babhiyoza uYosiya.

Ke kaloku uYeremiya wabhala iingoma zokumkani uYosiya; bonke abaculi, amadoda nabasetyhini, bakhumbula uYosiya ezingoma zabo zokumkani, ziye zathiwa kumaSirayeli; ngoko ke, bona, zibhalwe kwincwadi yeeNtloko.
Izinye zonke izinto azenzayo uYosiya, nokwenza kwakhe okulungileyo, ukuba agcine konke okubhaliweyo emthethweni kaYehova,
Zonke izinto zakhe, eziqalayo neziphelileyo, zihleli zibhalwe kwincwadi yamaKumkani bakaSirayeli nakwaYuda.
Bathi ke abantu belizwe bathabathe uYowahazi, unyana kaYosiya, bamenza ukumkani eYerusalem endaweni yoyise.
UYowahazi ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamithathu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emithathu engukumkani eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku ukumkani waseYiputa wamkhupha ukuba angakumkani eYerusalem; wabeka ilizwe lihlawule isiqingatha setoni yesilivere, nesiqingatha setoni yegolide.
Ukumkani waseYiputa wenza uEliyakim, umzalwana wakhe, ukumkani phezu kweYuda neYerusalem, watshintsha igama lakhe waba nguYoyakim. UNeko wamthabatha uYehohaza, umzalwana kaEliyakim, waya eYiputa.
UYehoyakim ubeminyaka imashumi mabini anamihlanu ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinanye engukumkani eYerusalem. Wenza okubi phambi koYehova uThixo wakhe.
UNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli waya kuye, wamnqula ngamakhonkco entsimbi, ukuba amthwale eBhabheli.
Ke kaloku, uNebhukadnezare wathabatha ezinye zezinto zasendlwini kaYehova waya eBhabheli, wazibeka endlwini yakhe.

Ezinye zonke izinto azenzayo uYehoyakim, nezinto ezibi azenzayo, nobubi bonke obufunyanwa kuye, bona, zibhalwe kwincwadi yamakumkani bakaSirayeli nakwaYuda. UYoyakin unyana wakhe waba ngukumkani endaweni yakhe.
UYehoyakim ubeminyaka imashumi asibhozo ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka emithathu neentsuku ezilishumi engukumkani eYerusalem. Wenza okubi phambi koYehova.

Ke kaloku, xa imvula yaphuma, ukumkani uNebhukadnezare wathumela wamtsala, wamthabatha waya eBhabheli, nazo zonke izinto ezibalulekileyo zendlu kaYehova; wammisa uZedekiya, umzalwana wakhe, waba ngukumkani kuYuda naseYerusalem.
UZedekiya ubeminyaka imashumi mabini ananye ezelwe, ukuba ngukumkani kwakhe; waba neminyaka elishumi elinanye engukumkani eYerusalem.
Wakwenza okubi emehlweni kaYehova uThixo wakhe; akazange aphumle phambi koYeremiya umprofeti, othetha amazwi kaYehova.
Ke kaloku wayalela ukumkani uNebhukadnezare, owenza ukuba athethe ngegama likaThixo, ukuba abe ngumntu othembekileyo; waxhaphaza imilenze yakhe, akayeki ukubuyela kuYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli.

Ke kaloku bonke abathetheli bakambingeleli nabasetyhini, nabo bonke abantu, baqhubeka besenza ubuxoki. Bahamba ngazo zonke iinyaniso ezibi zeentlanga; babengcolisa indlu kaYehova, eyayiyingcwele eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku iNkosi, uThixo wabazali babo, wabathumelela amazwi ngezandla zabathunywa bakhe, waqala waza waqhubeka; ngokuba wayemthanda abantu bakhe, nendawo yakhe yokuhlala.
Ke kaloku, babhiyozela abathunywa bakaThixo, babengathandabuzeki amazwi akhe, babhiyozela ooprofeti bakhe. Kwaza kwanyuka inkanuko kaYehova phezu kwabantu bakhe, kungekho mntu wakwazi ukuyimisa.

Wazisa phezu kwabo ukumkani wakwaBhabheli, wababulala ngeqhwa oonyana babo abancinci endlwini yabo engcwele; akawakhathaleli oonyana nabafazi abancinci, nabasetyhini abancinci, nabasetyhini abakhulu, nabasetyhini abancinane. UThixo wawanikela kuwo onke.
Wazisa eBhabheli zonke izinto zetempeli kaThixo, ezikhulu nezincinci, neempahla zetempeli kaYehova, neimpahla zokumkani namadoda amakhulu akhe.
Batshisa iTempile kaThixo, baphula udonga lwaseYerusalem; batshisa zonke izindlu eziphakamileyo, babulala yonke into entle.
Amadoda asele ecaleni kwekrwada, ayewathabatha waya eBhabheli; babe ngabakhonzi bakhe nabantwana bakhe, de kwafika ukumkani wasePersiya.

Ke kaloku kwathiwa, ilizwi likaYehova elimthunyelwe nguYeremiya liphume, ukuba ilizwe liphumle ngesikhumbuzo sayo; zonke iintsuku zayo ezingenanto, laphumla, de kube kugqityiwe iminyaka eyishumi elinesixhenxe.

Ngomnyaka wokuqala ka-Koresh, ukumkani wasePersiya, iNkosi wawenza ukuba kwenzeke ilizwi lakhe elithethayo ngesandla sikaYeremiya. Wavusa uThixo intliziyo kaKoresh, ukumkani wakwaPersia, ukuze akhuphe isibhengezo kuzo zonke izixeko zokumkani wakhe, aze azibhalela, esithi:

Utsho uKore ukumkani wasePersiya, UYehova, uThixo wezulu, wandinika zonke izikumkani zehlabathi; wamkhethela ke ukuba ndithise indlu yakhe eYerusalem, eYuda. Nabani na phakathi kwenu phakathi kwabantu bakhe, angaya khona; iNkosi, uThixo wabo, abe naye.
Ezra: Ngomnyaka wokuqala ka-Koresh, ukumkani wasePersiya, iNkosi wawenza ukuba kwenzeke ilizwi lakhe elithethayo ngesandla sikaYeremiya. Wavusa uThixo intliziyo kaKoresh, ukumkani wakwaPersia, ukuze akhuphe isibhengezo kuzo zonke izixeko zokumkani wakhe, aze azibhalela, esithi:
Utsho uKore ukumkani wasePersiya, UYehova, uThixo wezulu, wandinika zonke iintlanga zehlabathi; wakhetha ke ukuba ndiyixelise indlu yakhe eYerusalem, eYuda.
Nabani na phakathi kwenu kubantu bakhe, afike eYerusalem, eya eYuda; uThixo wakhe abe naye; bavule indlu kaYehova, uThixo wakwaSirayeli; yena nguThixo ohlala eYerusalem.

Naphi na apho kukho umntu oseleyo phakathi kwabantu bakhe, abantu bendawo leyo bancedisane naye ngesilivere, negolide, neempahla, neenkomo, kunye nomnikelo wabo wokukhethayo wendlu kaThixo eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku bavuka abathetheli beentsapho zakwaYuda nakwaBhenjamin, nababingeleli, nabaLevi, ukuba bathabathe phezulu basebenze indlu kaYehova eYerusalem; bonke abo uThixo wabeka intliziyo yabo kuyo.
Nabo bonke abasemaphandleni kwabo bancedisa kubo ngezinto zesilivere, negolide, nezithuthi, nezinyama-ntliziyo, nezipho ezilungileyo, ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto abazikhethelayo.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uKire wazisa iimpahla zetempeli kaYehova, ezo uNabukodonozoro wazithabatha eYerusalem, waza azibeka endlwini yamadini akhe.
Ke kaloku uKirisi, ukumkani wasePersiya, wathumela uMitredathi, umphathi wezinto ezigcinwayo, wayazikhupha; wababala kuye uSheshbazar, umlawuli wakwaYuda.
Leyo ke inani labo: izitya zegolide ezimashumi mathathu, nezitya zesilivere elinamawaka amabini, iinqanawa eziyishumi elinesithoba;
iziqulatho zegolide ezimashumi mathathu, neziqulatho zesilivere ezimakhulu amane, anamanci mabini, nezinye izinto ezilishumi.

Zonke izitya zegolide, nezitya zesilivere, zaba ngamawaka amahlanu, anamakhulu amane. USheshbazar wazisa zonke ezi zinto esandla sakhe, xa abathunyelwe emkhosini benyuka besuka eBhabheli baye eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku, abo babantu belizwe ababuyayo ebantwini basemkhosini, ababethunyelwe eBhabheli nguNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli; babebuyela eYerusalem naseYuda, ngamnye endlwini yakhe.
Bafika nabo uZerubabele, noYeshuwa, noNehemiya, noSeraya, noRelaya, noMordekayi, noBilshan, noMishpar, noBigwai, noRehumu, noBhaana. Lowo ke ubalo lwamadoda aseSirayeli:
Oonyana bakaParoshe baba ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu mahlanu, anamanci asixhenxe anesibini.
Oonyana bakaShefatiya ibingamakhulu amathathu, anamanci Renga.
Oonyana baka-Ahara babemakhulu asixhenxe, Rengamahlanu.
Oonyana bakaPahati-Mowabhi, ngoYeshuwa noYowabhi, amawaka amabini anamakhulu asibhozo, anamanci mabini.
Oonyana baka-Elam ibilikhulu, elinamakhulu amabini, anamanci mahlanu anane.
Oonyana bakaZathu babemakhulu asithoba, anamanci mahlanu.
Oonyana bakaZakayi ibingamakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci amathandathu.
Oonyana bakaBani ibingamakhulu amathandathu, anamanci mane anabini.
Oonyana bakaBebhayi babemakhulu amathandathu, anamanci mabini anathathu.
Oonyana baka-Azgadi ibingamakhulu amabini, anamanci mabini anamashumi mabini.
Oonyana baka-Adonikam ibingamakhulu amathandathu, anamanci asixhenxe ananye.
Oonyana bakaBhigweyi baba ngamawaka amabini anamashumi mane anesithandathu.
Oonyana baka-Adin ibingamakhulu amane, anamanci mahlanu anane.
Oonyana baka-Atere, ngoHezekiya, abamashumi indonga anesibhozo anesibhozo.
Oonyana bakaBezayi ibingamakhulu amathathu, anamanci indoda mathathu.
Oonyana bakaYora babelikhulu, elinamabini anamashumi mabini.
Oonyana bakaHashumi babemakhulu amabini, anamanci indonga mathathu.
Oonyana bakaGibhare babemashumi asithoba anesihlanu.
Amadoda aseBhetelehem amakhulu amabini anamashumi mathathu.
Amadoda aseNetofa amashumi amahlanu anesithandathu.
Amadoda aseAnathothi amakhulu amabini anamashumi asibhozo.
Oonyana baka-Azmavethi babemashumi amane anesibini.
Amadoda aseKiriyati-arimi, neKefira, neBherothi, amakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mane anathathu.
Amadoda aseRama, naseGiba, ama dende amashumi Renga mabini ananye.
Amadoda aseMikmasi ayelikhulu, elinamabini anambini.
Amadoda aseBheteli neAyi amakhulu amabini, anamanci mathathu.
Amadoda aseNebo amahlanu anabini.
Amadoda aseMagbishi amakhulu amahlanu anasithandathu.
Oonyana bakaElam omnye, amawaka amane anamakhulu mabini, anamanci mahlanu anesine.
Oonyana bakaHarim ibingamakhulu amathathu, anamanci mabini.
Amadoda aseLodi, naseHadidi, naseOno, amakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mabini anesihlanu.
Amadoda aseJerikho amakhulu mathathu, anamanci mane anesihlanu.
Oonyana bakaShenaha, amawaka amathathu, anamakhulu Rengathathu.
Ababingeleli: oonyana bakaYedaya, abakwindlu kaYeshuwa, bamakhulu asithoba, anamanci asixhenxe anesihlanu.
Oonyana baka-Imere babelikhulu, elinamanci mabini anamashumi amabini.
Oonyana bakaPashure ibingamakhulu amabini, anamashumi mane anesine.
Oonyana bakaHarim babelikhulu, elinamanci asixhenxe.
AbaLevi: oonyana bakaYeshuwa noKadmiyeli, abasuka kuHodaviya, baba zimashumi asixhenxe anenkosi.
Abangomani: oonyana baka-Asaphi babelikhulu, elinamanci mabini anamashumi asibhozo.
Abagwebi: oonyana bakaShalum, noAtere, noTalmon, noAkube, noHatitha, noShobhayi; bonke babelikhulu elinamanci mathathu anathoba.
Abakhonzi bakaThixo: oonyana bakaSiha, noHashufa, noTabhaothi,
iKeros, neSiha, nePadon,
noowyono, neLebhana, neHaghaba, neAkubo,
uHaghabhi, noShamlayi, noHanani,
uGideyeli, noGahare, noRehaya,
uReshini, noNekodada, noGazam,
uUza, noPaseha, noBesayi,
uowyono, neMeyunim, neNefizim,
uowyubuki, neHakupha, neHarhuri,
noowyeki, neBazluthi, neMehida, neHarsha,
uBarkosi, noSisera, noTema,
noNesiya, noHatifa.
Oonyana bomkhonzi kaSolomon: oonyana bakaSotayi, noHasofereti, noPeruda,
uowyala, neDarkoni, noGideyeli,
noShefatiya, noHatiyeli, noPokerethe uHazebayim, noAmi.
Bonke oonyana bakaNethinim, nabantwana bamakhonzi kaSolomon, babe ngamawaka amathathu amashumi asithoba anesibini.
Ke kaloku kwanyuka abantu abathile emadolophini aseTeli-mela, naseTheli UTel-harsha, naseKerubhi, naseAdan, naseImere; kodwa abazange bakwazi ukuveza iintsapho zabo ukuba zivela kuSirayeli.
Oonyana bakaDelaya, noTobiya, noNekoda, abamakhulu amathandathu, anamanci mahlanu anabini.
Kubabingeleli: oonyana bakaHobhaya, uHakosi, noBarzilayi. UBarzilayi wayesele ekhulelwe intombi kaBarzilayi waseGiliyadi, wathabatha igama lendlu yakhe.
Baye bakhangela amagama abo kuncwadi lwabafazi, bengazifumananga; ngoko ke, abazange babe ngababingeleli babo.
Ukumkani wathi kubo ukuba bangadla into engcwele kakhulu, de kubekho umbingeleli oza kubuza ngo-Urim no-Thummim.
Wonke umkhosi waba ngamawaka angamashumi mane anesibini, namawaka anamakhulu amathathu, anamanci amathandathu;
ngaphandle kwabakhonzi babo, amadoda namadoda, amawaka asixhenxe, anamakhulu amathathu, anamanci mathathu anesixhenxe. Babeneengomakazi, amadoda namadoda, anamakhulu amabini.
Babeneebhayisikile ezimakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mathathu anesithandathu, neembumbulu ezinekhulu linamashumi mane anesihlanu;
iinkomo ezimakhulu amane, anamanci mathathu anamashumi amahlanu, neenkunzi zeegusha ezilishumi elinambini.
Ke kaloku, befika endlwini kaYehova yaseYerusalem, kwathiwa ngabanye abaphathi bezindlu zabafazi banikela ngeempawu, ukuze baphinde bavule indlu kaThixo endaweni yayo.
Banikela, ngokwezinto abakwaziyo ukuzenza, kwimali yokwakha: itoni enye yegolide, netoni enye yesilivere, nempahla ethe tyaba yeshumi elinanye yamadini.
Bathi ke ababingeleli, nabaLevi, nabanye abantu, nabaculi, nabagwebi, nabaNethinim, bahlala emizini yabo; nabo bonke amanye amaSirayeli bahlala emizini yabo.
Kwafika ke unyaka wesixhenxe, oonyana bakaSirayeli behlala emizini yabo; bonke abantu bahlangana eYerusalem njengendoda enye.

Ke kaloku uYeshua unyana kaumhvørvilo, nabazalwana bakhe ababingeleli, noZerubabele unyana kaShealtiyele, nabazalwana bakhe, baqalisa ukulungiselela isibingelelo soThixo wakwaSirayeli, ukuba benze phezu kwayo izipho eziqhutywa ngamanzi, njengokuba kubhalwe emthethweni kaMoses, indoda kaThixo.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yoxolo lwabahlali bemimandla ejikeleze kubo, baphinde bakwakha isibingelelo esiphakamileyo kwisiseko sayo; banikela phezu kwayo izipho eziqhutywa ngamlilo kuYehova kusasa nobusuku.
Bayenza ke imini yeentyatyambo, njengoko kuthethwa ngumthetho; banikela iintsontelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, ngokwenani lemihla ngemihla.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, banikela izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamandla, nezibingelelo zeentsuku zonyaka omtsha, neentsuku zonke ezingcwele zikaYehova; banikela nakwiimpawu zabantu, ukuba bazinike kuYehova.
Baqalisa ukunikela izibingelelo zokunqula kuYehova ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yesixhenxe; ke kaloku isiseko setempile kaYehova asikubikho sabekwa.

Banika imali kubaqulunqi bemigangatho, nabakhonzi; banikela ukutya nokusela, neoli, kumaSidoni nakumaTyori, ukuba bathuthe izityalo zeediliya elwandle ukusuka eLibanoni ziye eYopa; ngokuba uKore ukumkani wasePersiya wabavumeleyo.

Ngonyaka wesibini, ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga, emva kokuba bafike eYerusalem, beqala ukwakha indlu kaThixo. Baqala uZerubabele, unyana kaShealtiyele, noYeshuwa, unyana kaYosadaki, namanye abazalwana babo oombingeleli nabaLevi, nabo bonke abathe babuyela eYerusalem ukususela ekubondeni kwabo; bamisela amaLevi aneminyaka engama-mashumi mabini nangaphezulu, ukuba abe ngabasebenzi bendlu kaYehova.

Ke kaloku uYeshua, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, noKadmiyeli, oonyana bakhe nabazalwana bakhe, oonyana bakaYuda, bahlanganisana ukuba babe ngabaphathi abasebenzayo endlwini kaThixo; bancediswa ke ngabo oonyana bakaHenadadi, oonyana babo nabahlobo babo, ooravuti.
Ke kaloku, abaqulunqi babeka isiseko seTempile kaYehova. Bathi oonyana baka-Asaphu, abaLevi, bemile ngeekholamu, bathandaza kuYehova, njengoko uDavide ukumkani wakwaSirayeli abewisela umthetho ngawo.

Bathi ke, behamba-hamba,umhvørvisa nokuzinikela kuYehova, besithi, Ulungile; ngokuba uthando lwakhe lwamaSirayeli luhlala ubomi bonke. Abantu bonke babhiyozela iNkosi ngezwi elikhulu, ngenxa yokuba isiseko sendlu kaThixo sabekwa.

Ke kaloku, abaninzi abakhulu phakathi kwababingeleli nabaLevi, namadoda amakhulu eentsapho, abaye babona indlu yokuqala, xa bebona isiseko sendlu leyo sibekwe, batsho ngamandla; abanye ke abaninzi bavakalisa uzuko.
Akukho mntu wakwaziyo ukukhetha phakathi kwelizwi lothando nelizwi lokulingisa, ngenxa yobuninzi belizwi laba bantu; ilizwi labo laziwa kude.
Ke kaloku abachasi bakaYuda noBhenjamin bafumanisa ukuba abantu ababuyayo besuka ebantwini, besenza indlu kaYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli.

Bafika ke kuZerubabele, naumhvørvilo zeentsapho, besithi kubo, Siza kukuncedisa ukwakha; ngokuba siyamkhonza uThixo wakho njengokuba niyamkhonza wena; siye sazinikela kuye ukususela kwimihla kaEsar-hadon ukumkani wakwaAsiriya, owathuthela apha.

Waphendula ke uZerubabele, noumhvørvilo lukaHezekiya, namanye amalungu osapho lwakwaSirayeli, esithi, Akukho namnye phakathi kwenu oza kwakha indlu kaThixo wethu; siza kuyilungisa thina kuphela kuYehova, uThixo wakwaSirayeli, njengokuba uKirisi ukumkani wasePersiya usinike umthetho.
Ke kaloku abantu baloo lizwe bafuna ukuxolela intliziyo yabantu bakaYudiya, ukuba bangawulungisa umzi.
Baqesha abacebisi, ukuba basebenze nabo, ukuze bathintele isigqibo sabo; babesenza njalo zonke iintsuku zikaKore ukumkani wasePersiya, de kwaba nguDariyo ukumkani wasePersiya.
Ke kaloku, ekuqaleni kokumkani kuka-Axerxes, babhalela ityala abantu bakaYuda nabaseYerusalem.
Kwiintsuku zika-Artaxerxe, uBishlam, noMithredathi, noTabeyeli, nabahlobo babo, babhala incwadi ku-Artaxerxe ukumkani wasePersiya; yabhalwa ngeelwimi zesiAram, neelwimi zesiAram.
Wabhala uRehum, umphathi omkhulu, noShimshai, umbhali, incwadi malunga neYerusalem kukumkani uArtakserksesi. Yathi le nto.
Yavela kuRehum, umphathi omkhulu, noShimshai, umbhali, nabahlobo babo, abagwebi, namagqwetha, namagosa abantu baseEreki, naseBhabheli, naseShushan eElam, nezinye iindawo;
nezinye iint balethi, abathuthwayo nguAshurbanipele, omkhulu, nomhle, waza wahlala kumzi waseSamari, nakwamanye amazwe asentshonalanga yomlambo i-Efrata.
Eli likopi leleta abathunyelwe ngayo: Kukumkani uArtakserkses, kubasebenzi bakho, abantu abasemazantsi eMlambo iEfrata.
Yaziwe ngukumkani, ukuba abaYuda abathe baphuma kuwe baya kuthi, baye eYerusalem, bewulungisa lo mjikelo wobuxoki obubi, bewugqiba udonga, bewulungisa isiseko sakhe.
Yazi ukumkani ukuba, ukuba lo mzi ubuyiselwe, zigqiželwe iingcango zakhe, baya kuyeka ukuhlawula inzala, neendleko, neentlawulo; ngoko ke iindleko zomkani ziya kuphelelwa.
Ngokuba siyindoda ethembekileyo kwindlu kakumkani, asifuni ukuba ukumkani agwetywe; ngoko ke sithumelele kukumkani sithi,

ukuze ujonge iincwadi zoncwadi lwabafazi bakho, uze ufumane kuloo ncwadi, ukuba lo mzi ngumzi wokuphazamiseka, umngcipheko kumakumkani nakumaphondo; waba yindawo yokuphazamiseka ukususela kwixesha elidlulileyo; ngenxa yoko wasuswa.
Siyakuxelela ukumkani ukuba, ukuba lo mzi ukhiwa kwakhona, zigqitywe iingcango zawo, akuyi kubakho into oyishiyayo ecaleni lomlambo iEfrati.
Ukumkani waphendula wathi, KuRehumu umphathi omkhulu, noShimshai umbhali, nabahlobo babo abahlala eSamari, nakwabanye abasemazantsi emlambo iEfrata: Ndibulele.
Ileta oyithumeleleyo iguqulelwe kwaye ifundwe kum.
Kwabakho umyalelo wam, kwafunyanwa ke, ukuba lo mzi uphindezela kumakumkani ukususela kwixesha elidlulileyo; waba yindawo yobuxoki nokuphazamisa.
Kwabakho ookumkani abanamandla belawula eYerusalem, nakwilizwe lonke elaseNtshona komlambo uEfrayim; kwathiwa kubo iindleko, neentlawulo, neendleko zokuhamba.
Učine imiyalelo, niyivale le ndoda, ukuze lo mzi ungakhiwanga, de kube limiyalelo yam.
Khumbulani, musa ukulibala loo nto; kuba kutheni na ukuba le ngozi ikhule ibe yintlungu kumakumkani?
Ke kaloku, xa ikopi yelete kakumkani uArtakserkses yafundwa kuRehumu, noShimshai umbhali, nabahlobo babo, bakhawuleza baya kumaYuda aseYerusalem, babathintela.
Ke kaloku, kwamiswa umsebenzi wendlu kaThixo eYerusalem; wamiswa kude kube ngumnyaka wesibini wokumkani kukaDariyo ukumkani wakwaPersiya.
Ke kaloku abaprofeti, uHageyi noZekariya unyana kaIdo, bathetha ngamazwi kaThixo kumaYuda aseYuda naseYerusalem; bathetha ngegama loThixo wakwaSirayeli, owawuse phezu kwabo.
Ke kaloku uZerubabele, unyana kaShealtiyele, noYeshuwa, unyana kaYosadaki, baphinde baqalisa ukulungiselela indlu kaThixo eYerusalem; babe nabo abaprofeti bakaThixo, benceda.
Ngaloo xesha bafika kubo uTatenai, umphathi welizwe elunxwemeni loMlambo, noShethar-bozenai, nabahlobo babo, bathi kubo, Nguwuphi na lowo wamnika umthetho wokwakha le ndlu, nokugqitywa kwalomgca?
Bathi ke, Yintoni amagama lamadoda asebenza kuloo ndawo?
Ke kaloku uThixo wayezikhusela izikhulu zakwaYuda; abaželoyi-mthetho ke babengenakubathintela, de kube kuthunyelwe incwadi kuye uDariyos, ibe iphendulwe ngeleta.
Eli likopi leleta, eyathunyelwa nguTatenai, umphathi welizwe elunxwemeni loMlambo uEfrayi, noShethar-bozenai, nabahlobo babo, abathetheli belizwe elunxwemeni loMlambo, kukumkani uDariyo.
Bathumela iposti, bethi, Kukumkani uDariyos: Uxolo noxolo.

Uyazi ukumkani, ukuba safika kwiphondo laseYuda, endlwini kaThixo omkhulu; ibe ikhiwa ngamatye amakhulu, zibekwa izikhonkwane ezingwevu kumadonga; le misebenzi iqhutywa ngokucothayo, kwaye iyahamba kakuhle.
Sathi ke kubo, Ubani na owazisa ukuba niphindeni ukwakha le ndlu, nigqibezele lodonga?
Siyababuza namagama abo, ukuze sibhale kuwe amagama eempawu zabo eziphezulu.
Bathi ke kuthi, Siyakuba ngabakhonzi bakaThixo wezulu nehlabathi; siyakwakha kwakhona indlu eyenziwe iminyaka emininzi eyadlulayo; ukumkani omkhulu wakwaSirayeli wayenza, wayigqiba.
Ke kaloku abazalwana bethu bamangalisa uThixo wezulu; wabanikela kuNabukodonozor, umBhabheli, ukumkani waseBhabheli; wayala le ndlu, wathabathela abantu eBhabheli.
Ke kaloku, ngomnyaka wokuqala kaKiriso ukumkani waseBhabheli, uKiriso ukumkani wabeka umthetho wokwakha kwakhona le ndlu yoThixo.

Wazikhupha ke uKirisi ukumkani, endlwini kaThixo yaseBhabheli, izinto zegolide nezesilivere zendlu kaThixo, ezo uNebhukadeva wazisa endlwini kaThixo yaseYerusalem, waya kuzibeka endlwini kaThixo yaseBhabheli; waza wazinika umntu okuthiwa nguSheshbazar, awayewenza ukuba abe ngumphathi.
Wathi ke uKirisi kuye, Zithathe, uzibeke kwakhona endlwini kaThixo eYerusalem; uyibuyisele indlu kaThixo kwindawo yayo.
Ke kaloku waya uSheshbazar, wabeka isiseko sendlu kaThixo eYerusalem; ukususela ngoko yakhiwa, ayigqitywanga ke.

Ke ngoko, ukuba kulungile kumkumkani, kufuneka kwenziwe ukukhangela encwadini yamatyala kakumkani eBhabheli, ukuba nguKumkanikazi uKiriso ogunyazisiweyo ukubuyisela kwakhona le ndlu kaThixo eYerusalem; ke ngoko, umkani athumelele imiyalelo yakhe ngale nto.
Wathi ke ukumkani uDariyos, bafuna iincwadi ezigcinwe kwizindlu zezinto ezikhuselekileyo eBhabheli.
Ke kaloku kwafunyanwa isiqulathi-zincwadi kwindlu ekhuselekileyo yaseEkbatani, esikwiphondo laseMediya; le nto ibhalwe kuyo:

Ngomnyaka wokuqala kaSirayeli ukumkani uKire, ukumkani wamisa umthetho malunga netempile kaThixo eYerusalem, esithi: Itempeli iphinde ibuyiselwe ibe yindawo yokunikela izibingelelo; isiseko sayo silungiswe ngokuqinileyo; ubude bayo bube ziimitha ezimashumi mabini anesixhenxe, ububanzi bayo bube ziimitha ezilishumi elinambini.
Kumele kubekho iziqwenga ezintathu zezityalo ezikhulu, nesiqwenga esinye semithi entsha; iindleko zayo zihlawulwe endlwini kakumkani.

Ke kaloku, iimpahla zegolide neumhvørvilo zetempeli kaThixo, ezo uNabukodonozor wazisa eYerusalem kwitempile, waza wazisa eBhabheli, kufuneka zibuyiselwe; zisasele eYerusalem kwitempeli, uze uzibeke ndawonye endlwini kaThixo.
Wabhala ke uDariyo, esithi, Namhlanje, Tatenai, umphathi welizwe elunxwemeni loMlambo iEfrayim, noShethar-bozenai, nabazalwana benu abakumkani elunxwemeni loMlambo, hlalani apho.
Ukumkani wamaYuda, namadoda amakhulu amaYuda, aphinde abuyele ukwakha le ndlu kaThixo kuloo ndawo yangaphambili.

Ke mna ke ndithi kuni, ukuba nincedisane nabathetheli bakaYuda kuloo ndlu kaThixo; ukuba iindleko zabo zonke zinikezelwe kubo, kwimali yokumkani, esuka kwintlawulo esemzantsi-mpuma komlambo uEfrayim, ukuze le misebenzi ingabi nethuba.

Yonke into efunekayo kubo, inkomo產子的,nkunzi yebhokhwe, iinkunzi zeegusha, neentlanzi ezincinci, ukuba zibe zizipho zomlilo kuThixo wesibhaka-bhaka; neziqhamo, noxube, nemvinyo, neoli, kufuneka zinikezelwe kuzo mihla ngemihla, zingabi nangxaki, ngokwesicelo sababingeleli abaseYerusalem.
Ke kaloku balungiselele izibingelelo ezithandekayo kuThixo wesibhaka-bhaka, bathandazayo ngenxa yobomi bukakumkani nabantwana bakhe.
Ndithi ke, ukuba umntu utshintshe lo myalelo, kufuneka kuqhutywe umbhobho endlwini yakhe, bathathelwe phezulu, bagwetywe kuwo; indlu yabo kufuneka ibe ngumqolomba ngenxa yaloo nto.

UThixo, owenza igama lakhe lihlale khona, athabathe phantsi ukumkani ngamnye, nohlanga ngalunye, oluthi lutshintshe loo nto, lube nenjongo yokuyicima le ndlu kaThixo eYerusalem. Mna, uDariyos, ndimise umthetho, ukuze kuqhutywe ngokuco Haintravu.
Ke kaloku uTatenai, umphathi welizwe elunxwemeni loMlambo iEfrayim, noShethar-bozenai, nabahlobo babo, basenza ngokusondeleyo konke oko ukumkani uDariyos awawiselayo.

Ke kaloku abathetheli bakaYuda baqhuba ukwakha, besenza kakuhle, ngenxa yelizwi likaHaggai noZekariya unyana ka-Iddo, abaprofeti; bagqiba ukwakha indlu, ngokwemiyalelo yoThixo wakwaSirayeli, nemiyalelo kaKore noDariyos noArtakserkses, ookumkani basePersiya.
Yagqitywa ke le ndlu ngomhla wesithathu wenyanga ka-Adare, ngonyaka wesixhenxe wokumkani kukatodoyo ukumkani.
Ke kaloku abantu bakaSirayeli, oombingeleli, nabaLevi, namanye amaYuda asuka entolongweni, babhiyozela ukunikezelwa kwaloo ndlu kaThixo.

Banikela ekunikezeleni le ndlu kaThixo ngeenkomo ezilikhulu, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezimakhulu amabini, neenkunzi zeegusha zimakhulu amane; banikela ngesonka sesono kumaSirayeli onke, ngamakhoboka alishumi elinambini, esinye isizwe ngasinye samaSirayeli.
Babeka oombingeleli nabaLevi ngokweziqu zabo, ukuba basebenze kuThixo eYerusalem, njengoko kuchaziwe kwincwadi kaMoses.
Ke kaloku abantu ababuyayo ebantwini balungiselela iPasha ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga yokuqala.
Ke kaloku ababingeleli nabaseLevi bacocekile bonke, babecocekile bonke; ke ngoko abaLevi babulala iinkunzi zeenkomo zepaska kubo bonke abantu ababuyayo, nababingeleli abangabo, nabo.
Badla ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ababuyayo ebantwini, iPasha; nabani na owaziqhelanise neendlela ezibi zeentlanga zale lizwe, ukuba abe nguThixo kaYehova uThixo kaSirayeli.

Bayenza imini yeentlanzi ezingaumhvørvinweni iintsuku ezisixhenxe, bevuya; ngokuba iNkosi wabakhulisa ngempumelelo, watshintsha intliziyo kakumkani wakwaAsiriya, ukuba ancedise ekwenzeni umsebenzi wendlu kaThixo, uThixo kaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, emva kwezi zinto, ngexesha likaArtakserksesi ukumkani wasePersiya, kwabakho umntu okuthiwa nguEzra, unyana kaSeraya, unyana kaAzariya, unyana kaHilkiya,
unyana kaShalum, unyana kaSadoko, unyana kaAhitubhi,
unyana kaAmariya, unyana kaAzariya, unyana kaMerayothi,
unyana kaZerahiya, unyana kaUzi, unyana kaBuki,
unyana ka-Abhishuwa, unyana ka-Phenesha, unyana ka-Eleazar, unyana ka-Aron, ukumkani wamadini.

Ke kaloku uEzra lowo waphuma eBhabheli, waba ngumfundi owaziyo kakuhle umthetho kaMoses, umthetho kaYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli; ukumkani wamnika yonke into awayeyifumeneyo, ngokuba iNkosi uThixo wakhe wayemnceda.
Baya naye nabanye oonyana bakaSirayeli eYerusalem, ngomnyaka wesixhenxe wokumkani uArtakserkses; nabo bakhona ababingeleli, nabaLevi, nabaculi, nabagwebi, nabakhonzi bakaThixo.
Wafika ke uEzra eYerusalem ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga, ngonyaka wesixhenxe wokumkani.
Waphuma eBhabheli ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yokuqala, wafika eYerusalemželwini ngomhla UTsha unyaka wesixhenxe, ngenxa yokuba isandla esilungileyo soThixo wakhe saba phezu kwakhe.
Ke kaloku uEzra wabeka intliziyo yakhe ekufundeni umthetho kaYehova, ukuba awugcine, ukuba afundise kumaSirayeli imimiselo yawo nemimiselo.
Eli likopi yeleta, ukumkani uArtakserkses wamnika uEzra, umkhonzi kaThixo, umfundi, owaziyo imimiselo kaYehova nemimiselo yamaSirayeli.
U-Artaxerxe, ukumkani wamakumkani, kuEzra umbingeleli, umfundi womthetho kaThixo wezulu: Inyaniso.
Ndibeka umthetho, ukuba bonke abantu bakaSirayeli ekumkani wam, nababingeleli babo, nabaLevi babo, abo banqwenela ukuya eYerusalem, bahambe nawe.
ngokuba uthunyelwe ngukum Jasmini, nomphathi wakhe wesixhenxe, ukuba ujonge ukuba iYuda neYerusalem zisenza njani umthetho kaThixo wakho, okho kuwe.
uze uthathe ngesandla sakho isilivere negolide, eyamnikelayo ukumkani namagqwetha akhe ngokunyanisekileyo kuThixo wakwaSirayeli, ohlala eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku, uthathe isilivere negolide zonke ozifumanayo kwiphondo laseBhabheli, kunye nomnikelo osuka kwintliziyo yabantu nababingeleli abanikelayo ngesandla endlwini kaThixo wabo, eYerusalem.

Ke ngoko, usebenzise ngokucothayo lemali, uthenge iintombi ezincinci, neenkunzi zeenkomo, neentlanzi ezincinci, nezipho zabo zesonka, nezipho zabo zokusela; uzilungiselele phezu kwesibingelelo sendlu kaThixo wakho eYerusalem.
Nawe, nabazalwana bakho abaYuda, niyenze into elungileyo emlonyeni wenu ngesiqhelo sesilivere negolide, njengokuba uThixo wenu enqwenela.
Zonke izinto ezinikezelwe kuwe, ukuze zisetyenziswe endlwini kaThixo wakho, zinikele kuThixo waseYerusalem.
Nantoni na enye into oyifunayo endlwini kaThixo wakho, uyihlawulele kulawulo lukakumkani.

Mna, ukumkani uArtakserkses, ndiwisela umthetho onke amakhosazana asentshonalanga yomlambo iEfrayim, ukuba, nantoni na ecelayo kuni uEzra, umbingeleli, umfundi womthetho kaThixo wesibhaka-bhaka, bayinike ngokucothayo;
ngaphezu kweetoni ezisibhozo zesilivere, neentyatyambo ezilishumi zengqolowa, ngaphezu kwamawaka amabini eelitye lewayini, namawaka amabini eelitye leoli yeoli yeoli, nesonka esininzi ngokwaso.
Yonke into vidiwe nguThixo wezulu ngendlu yakhe, kufuneka yenziwe ngokucothayo; ukuze ingabikho inkanuko phezu kolawulo lukakumkani nabantwana bakhe.

Siyakuxelela ke nina, ukuba akufuneki nabani na kubo bonke ababingeleli, nabaLevi, nabaculi, nabakhuseli beengcango, nabakhonzi bakaThixo, nabo bonke abasebenza kule ndlu kaThixo, bahlawule idini, okanye umrhumo, okanye intlawulo.

Ke wena, uEzra, sebenzisa ubulumko bukaThixo wakho obukwisandla sakho, wenze abagwebi nabaphathi, ukuba bathethe kubo bonke abantu abasemazantsi eMlambo, abo bazi umthetho kaThixo wakho; nalowo angaziyo, mfundise.

Nabani na oza kwenzanga umthetho kaThixo wakho, nomthetho wokumkani, kufuneka agwetywe ngokukhawuleza, nokuba ngukufa, okanye ukuba abuyele ezweni lakhe, okanye ukuba iimpahla zakhe zithathwe, okanye ukuba abeke emgodini.
Wathi uEzra, Kubulawe iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi bethu, owawubeka entliziyweni yokumkani ukuba ayenze ingcwele kaYehova eYerusalem.

Wayibonisa kum inyaniso yakhe phambi kokumkani, nabangamacebisi bakhe, nabangamagqwetha akhe onke anamandla; ngenxa yokuba iNkosi uThixo wam wayemncedayo, ndaba nethemba, ndazihlanganisa iinkokheli zakwaSirayeli, ukuba zikhuphe nam.
Ke kaloku, aba ngamadoda amakhulu eentsapho, nabo bonke abantu ababhaliswe kubo, ababeya phezulu nam ukusuka eBhabheli, ngexesha lokumkani uArtakserkses.
Kubantwana bakaPhinehasi, nguGershoni; kubantwana baseItamari, uDaniyeli; kubantwana bakaDavide, uHatushi.
kwaba oonyana bakaShekaniya, kwaba oonyana bakaParoshe, uZekariya; naye namadoda angamakhulu amahlanu, abhaliswe ngeencwadi zosapho.
Kubantwana bakaPahati-Mowabhi, nguEliyehonayi unyana kaZerahiya; naye amadoda angamakhulu ma maximum.
Kubantwana bakaShekaniya, uYahaziyeli unyana wakhe; naye namadoda angamakhulu amathathu.
Oonyana baka-Adin nguEbedi unyana kaYonathan, naye namadoda amahlanu.
Oonyana baka-Elam, uYeshaya unyana ka-Athaliya; naye amadoda amashumi asixhenxe.
Kubafazi bakaShefatiya, uZebadia unyana kaMikayeli; naye amadoda angamashumi asibhozo.
Kubantwana bakaYowabhi: uObhadiya, unyana kaYehiyeli; naye amadoda angamakhulu amabini, anamanci asibhozo.
Kubafazi bakaShelomith, uYosiphiya unyana wakhe; naye namadoda angamakhulu amathandathu.
Kubantwana bakaBebhayi, uZekariya unyana kaBebhayi; naye amadoda angamashumi amabini anesibhozo.
kubo oonyana baka-Azgadi, uYohanan unyana kaHakatani; naye namadoda angamakhulu amahlanu.
Kubantwana baka-Adonikam, abalandelayo: uElifeleti, noYehuyeli, noShemaya, nabo amadoda angamashumi asixhenxe.
Kubantwana bakaBigwai, nguUthai noZabhude; nabo amadoda amashumi asixhenxe.
Ke kaloku ndibahlanganisela kumlambo osuka eAhava, sathi sihlala khona iintlanganiso iintsuku ezintathu; ndabona abantu nababingeleli, ukuba akukho mLevi nalapho.

Ke kaloku, ndathumela ndizibiza ezi zikhulu: uEliyezere, noAriyeli, noShemaya, noElnathani, noYaribe, noElnathani, noNatane, noZekariya, noMeshulam; ndathumela ke ndizibiza uYoyaribhi noElnathani, abafundi.

Ndabathumela kuma-Iddo, umphathi wendawo ebizwa ngokuba yi-Kasifiya; ndathi kubo into abamele bayithethe ku-Iddo, nabazalwana bakhe, abakhonzi bakaThixo base-Kasifiya, ukuba bathuse kuthi abakhonzi bendlu kaThixo wethu.

Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba isandla esilungileyo soThixo wethu sisenokuba phezu kwethu, basithabatha umntu owaziyo, igama lakhe nguSherebiya, oonyana bakaMaheli, unyana kaLevi, unyana kaSirayeli; naye nabantwana bakhe nabahlobo bakhe, amadoda alishumi elinambini.
Bathabathe noHashabiya, naye noYeshaya, oonyana bakaMerariya, nabo abazalwana bakhe noonyana babo, amadoda angamashumi amabini.
Bathabathela nabo abakhonzi bakaThixo abangamakhulu amabini, anamanciželekileyo, abo uDavide nabathetheli bakhe babebamisela ukuba bancedise kumaLevi; bonke babhalwa ngegama.
Ke kaloku ndathi khona kumlambo we-Ahava, ukuba sihlale siphumle, sihlambuluke phambi koThixo wethu; sacela kuye indlela ekhuselekileyo kuthi, nabantwana bethu, nezinto zethu zonke.

Mna ke ndazixolela ukuba ndiumhvørviswe ngukumkani iinqanawa, nabakhweli beebhayisikili, ukusikhusela kumagosa endlela; kuba sathi kukumkani, Isandla esilungileyo soThixo wethu sikho phezu kwabo bonke abamkelayo kuye; kodwa amandla akhe nobubi bakhe bukho phezu kwabo bonke abamshiyayo.
Ke kaloku, sazila, sathandaza kuThixo wethu ngaloo nto; waphendula umthandazo wethu.
Ke kaloku ndakhetha abalishumi elinambini kumadoda amakhulu oombingeleli, noSherebiya, noHashabiya, nabazalwana babo abalishumi.
Ndazilinganisela kubo isilivere, negolide, neempahla, ezinikezelwe yikumkani, nabacebisi bakhe, nabathetheli bakhe, nabo bonke ooSirayeli abakhona, endlwini kaThixo wethu.
Ndazilinganisela kubo iileta ezilishumi elinambini zesilivere, nezixhobo zesilivere ezimalunga neelete ezintathu nesiqingatha, neelete ezintathu nesiqingatha zegolide,
iibhotile zegolide ezimashumi mabini, ziyimitha ezisixhenxe neshumi elinambini; izitya ezimbini ezilungileyo zobhedu olugqityiweyo, zinexabiso njengegolide.
Ndathi kubo, Niyingcwele kuni iNkosi; nazo ezi zinto zingcwele; isilivere negolide yisipho esinikezelwe ngokukhululekileyo kuYehova, uThixo wabafazi benu.
Zigcineni ngokucokisekileyo, de nizilinganise ezindlwini zendlu kaYehova eYerusalem, phambi kwamadoda amakhulu eempawu zakwaSirayeli, namaLevi, namadoda amakhulu eemfazwe.
Bathi ke ababingeleli nabaLevi bathathe isilivere, negolide, neempahla ethe tyaba, ngobunzima bayo, ukuba bazise endlwini kaThixo wethu, eYerusalem.

Sasuka sasuka emlanjeni weAhava, ukuba sihambe siye eYerusalem, ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga yokuqala; isandla soThixo wethu sakuba phezu kwethu, wasisikhusela kumkhosi womntu othile, nakumkhosi womntu othile endlela.
Safika ke eYerusalem, saphumla khona iintsuku ezi Rengathathu.

Ke kaloku, ngemini yesine, sazilinganisela endlwini kaThixo wethu isilivere, negolide, neempahla, sazinika kuMeremothi unyana kaUriya, umbingeleli; noEleazaru unyana kaPhinehasi naye, nabaLevi, uYozabade unyana kaYeshuwa, noNoyadi unyana kaBinui.
Zonke ezo zinto zabanjwa, zathethwa; isisindo sazo zonke sabhalwa ngaloo mini.

Ke kaloku abantu ababuyayo ebantwini banikela ngeempawu zomlilo kuThixo kaSirayeli, ngeenkomo ezilishumi elinambini zakwaSirayeli bonke, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezimashumi asithoba anesithandathu, neenkunzi zeegusha ezimashumi asixhenxe anesixhenxe, neenkomo zezimvu ezilishumi elinambini, njengesonka sesono; zonke ezi zinto zaba yimifuno yomlilo kuYehova.
Babeka ke imiyalelo yokumkani kumadoda amakhulu kakumkani, nakumagosa asentshonalanga yeMlambo uEfrayim; bancedisa ngoko abantu, nendlu kaThixo.

Ke kaloku, emva kokuba ezi zinto zigqityiwe, bafika kum abathetheli, besithi, Abantu bakaSirayeli, nababingeleli, nalabaLevi, abaye bahlukaniswa neentlanga zeelizwe ezijikeleze kubo; bayakwenza izinto zabo ezibi, njengezinto zabaKanana, namaHeti, namaPerizi, namaYebhusi, namaAmmonita, namaMowabhi, namaYiputa, nama-Amoreti.
Bathe babhiyozela oonyana babo, babanika umtshato oonyana babo; ke ngoko abangcwele bakaThixo baya kuhlangatyezwana namazwe ajikeleze kubo; abezithetheli nabaphathi baqala ukuxhatshazwa kuloo nto.
Ke kaloku, ndithe ndeva loo nto, ndarhoxa iingubo zam, nebhanti yam; ndazisusa iinwele zesifuba sam, neengcambu zam, ndahlala ndiphazamisa.
Ke kaloku, bonke abathe batshixiwa ngamazwi kaThixo wakwaSirayeli, bahlangana kum, ngenxa yobuxoki balo mntu obuyayo; ndahlala khona nditshixiwe, kude kube lixesha lokunikela ngomnikelo wesono.
Ke kaloku, ngexesha le Jasmine isonka, ndanyuka ndisuka kwingxolo yam, ingubo yam nebhanti yam zirhoxisiwe; ndathi ndafa ngamagqabi am, ndaphakamisa amehlo am kuYehova uThixo wam.

Ndathandaza, ndithi, Thixo wam, ndinyanzeleka, ndaželwa kakhulu, ukuba ndikhuphe ubuso bam kuwe, Thixo wam; kuba iimpazamo zethu ziphakamile ngaphezulu kweentloko zethu, inkohlakalo yethu inyuke iye emazulwini.

Ukusuka kwiintsuku zabafazi bethu, isono sethu sikhulu, siye safika ngoku; ngenxa yezinto zethu ezibi, sanikezelwa thina, ookumkani bethu, nababingeleli bethu, emkhosini weemfazwe zakwamanye amazwe, ukuba sibe ngumqolo, ukuba sithathelwe inqanawa, ukuba siqhutywe, ukuze sigwetywe, njengokuba kunjalo namhlanje.

Ke kaloku iNkosi, uThixo wethu,產eyo kuthinamhlanje; wasenza ukuba sibe nexesha elifutshane elincinane lokuhlala nathi, waza wasinika indawo ekhuselekileyo kwilizwe lakhe lingcwele. UThixo wethu wamnika ukukhanya amehlo ethu, nomphefumlo omncinci ekubeni singabakhonzi.

Siyakuba ngabakhonzi; ke kaloku uThixo wethu asikushiyelanga ebunkunkqweni bethu, wabonisa kuthi inyaniso yakhe phambi kokumkani wasePersiya, waza wasinika umoya wokwakha kwakhona indlu kaThixo wethu, wasizalisa iinyembezi zayo, wasisinika udonga olukhuselayo eYuda naseYerusalem.
Ke ngoko, Thixo wethu, singathi ntoni na emva koko? Siyiphulaphule kakubi imimiselo yakho,
Wathi, Ilizwe lenu eliphumayo ukuba nilithathe lingalunganga; izizwe ezihlala kulo ziluhlambulule ngezinto zabo ezibi, zazigcwalisa ngobubi babo, ukusukela esiphelweni ukuya kwisiphelo sazo.

Ke ngoko, abazali benu abangamantombazana angabafazi oonyana babo, nabantwana benu bangamantombazana abafazi oonyana babo; ningaze nizame ubomi babo noxolo lwabo ngonaphakade; ukuze nihlale ninamandla, nidla izinto ezilungileyo zale lizwe, niyishiye kubo abantwana benu ukuba babe yindawo yabo yonke.

Ke wena, Thixo wethu, emva kwezinto zonke ezithe zathiwa kuthi ngenxa yemisebenzi yethu emibi, ngenxa yobuxoki bethu obukhulu, usenza ukuba sigwetywe ngaphantsi kobuxoki bezono zethu, wasisazisa abantu abambalwa.
Ingaba siza kuphinda senze imithetho yakho, sitshate nabantu abazenzayo ezi zinto zixhaphakileyo? Awuyi kutyhafa na ukuba uthule ngokugqithiseleyo, ukuze akukho mntu ushiyeke ophumayo?

UYehova, uThixo kaSirayeli, ulungile wena; thina sisoloko sihlala mihla le, singendawo ekhuselekileyo. Yabona, siya kuhlala phambi kwakho ngenxa yobulungisa bethu; akukho namnye wethu okwaziyo ukuma phambi kwakho ngenxa yaloo nto.

Ke kaloku, ngelixa uEzra ethandaza, eshumayela, ecula, ehla phantsi phambi kwendlu kaThixo, kwahlangana kuye ibandla elikhulu kakhulu lakwaSirayeli, amadoda, namadodakazi, nabantwana; nabo ke babelilila ngothando.

Waphendula ke uShekaniya, unyana kaYehiyeli, oonyana baka-Elam, wathi kuEzra, Siye saphula umthetho kaThixo wethu, sithe sazala amadoda angaphandle phakathi kwezizwe ezingqongileyo kuthi; ke kaloku kukho ithemba likaSirayeli.

Nceda senze umnqophiso noThixo wethu, ukuba sishiye oomfazi bonke nabantwana babo, njengokuba utsho wena, nkosi yam, nangabo bakhathazeka ngomyalelo kaThixo wethu; ukuze kuhlangatyezwane nokuthethwa ngumthetho.
Yiya phezulu; le nto isebenza kuwe, nathi sikunye nawe; ube nobubele, uyenze.
Wavuka ke uEzra, wazenza izikhulu zeentlanga zababingeleli, nabaLevi, nabo bonke amaSirayeli, bavume ukuba baya kwenza loo nto. Bavuma ke.

Waphuma ke uEzra phambi kwendlu kaThixo, waya egumbini likaYohanan, unyana kaEliyashabi; wahlala khona, engadlanga isonka, angasela amanzi; ngokuba wayesoloko egxeka ngenxa yobuxoki babo bonke abantu ababuyayo.
Ke kaloku kwathunyelwa umyalezo kuwo onke amazwe aseYuda neYerusalem, ukuba bonke abathe babuyela ebantwini basemkhosini bahlangane eYerusalem.
Nabani na ongafikanga kwiintsuku ezithathu, iimpahla zakhe zonke zalahleka, njengokuba kwathiwa ngabathetheli nabakhulu, waza wagwetywa ebantwini ababuyayo.

Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezintathu, bonke amadoda kaYuda nakwaBhenjamin ahlangana eYerusalem. Ngomhla wama-20 wenyanga yesithoba, abantu bonke bahlala esidlangalaleni phambi komnyango wesibingelelo sikaThixo; becinezela ngenxa yaloo nto, nemvula enkulu.
Wavuka ke uEzra, ukumkani, wathi kubo, Nithe nizinikele; nani nabanikele amadoda angaphandle, ukuze niyikhuphe intlungu yamaSirayeli.
Ke ngoko, zinikele u Jasmine kuYehova, uThixo wabafazi benu, niyenze into eyonwabisayo kuye; nithabathe isiqingatha seentlanga ezikufutshane kwenu, namadoda angaphandle.
Baphendula ke bonke abantu ngelizwi elikhulu, besithi, Kulungile oko uthethayo; simele senze ngoko utshoyo.

Ke kaloku kukho abantu abaninzi apha, yaye lixesha lemvula; asikwazi ukuma ngaphandle; kwakunye noko, akusayi kubakho ukwenza oko ngemini enye okanye ngeentsuku ezimbini, ngenxa yokuba sininzi thina esiphelelwe yityala ngaloo ndlela.

Bathi abaphathi bethu basebenzele iumhvørvilo lonke, ukuba wonke umntu edolophini lethu omtshatile umfazi waseSirayeli afike kwixesha elimiselweyo, namadoda amakhulu edolophu nganye, nabagwebi bayo, nabo; de kuphele ukucasuka koxolo lukaThixo wethu ngenxa yaloo nto.
Ke kaloku uYonatan unyana ka-Asaheli, noYahaziya unyana ka-Tikwa, babe ngaphaya koko; baxhaswa nguMeshulam noShabhethai umLevi.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli ababuyayo, benze njalo. UEzra umbingeleli wakhetha abazalwana beentsapho zabo, umntu ngamnye weentsapho zabo, bonke babhalwe amagama abo; bahlala ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yesixhenxe, ukuze bajonge ityala ngalinye.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yokuqala, bagqiba ukuphatha amadoda onke athabathela amabhinqa aseSirayeli.
Kubo ababingeleli, abo babhiyozela amadoda angaphandle: kubantwana bakaYeshua unyana kaYosadaki, nabazalwana bakhe; nguMashekiya, noEliyezere, noYaribe, noGedaliya.
Bathi ke bonke ukuba baya kuzikhupha izibhinqa zabo. Ke kaloku, ngenxa yobulungisa babo, banikela umntu ngamnye ibhokhwe yemvu, ibe yisonka sesono.
Kubantwana baka-Imer: uHanani noZebadia.
Kubafazi bakaHarim: uMahashiya, noEliya, noShemaya, noYehiyeli, noUziya.
Kubafazi bakaPashuri: uEliyenai, noMasheya, noIshmayeli, noNethaneli, noYozabadi, noElasa.
AbaLevi: uYozabadi, noShimeyi, noKelaya, owaziwa ngokuba nguKelita, noPetahi maximum.
Kubo abaculi: uEliyasibhi; kubo abagwebi: uShalum, noTelem, noUri.
Kubo bonke amanye amaSirayeli, kubo oonyana bakaParoshe: uRamiya, noYiziya, noMalkiya, noMiyamini, noElezare, noMalkiya, noBhenaya.
Kubafazi bakaElam: uMatania, noZekariya, noYehiyeli, noAbdi, noJeremothi, noEliya.
Kubantwana bakaZathu: uEliyenai, noEliyasibhi, noMathaniya, noYeremote, noZabhadi, noAziya.
