Kubafazi bakaBebhayi: uYohanan, noHananiya, noZabhayi, noAtlayi.
Kubantwana bakaBani: nguMeshulam, noMaluku, noAdayiya, noYashubhe, noShehali, noYeremote.
Kubantwana bakaPahati-Mowabhi: uAdna, noKhelali, noBhenaya, noMahashiya, noMatania, noBesaleyeli, noBinuyi, noManase.
Kubafazi bakaHarim: uEliyezere, noIshiya, noMalkiya, noShemaya, noShimeon;
noBhenjamin, noMaluku, noShemariya.
Kubantwana bakaHashumi: uMatheni, noMathata, noZabadi, noElifeleti, noYeremiya, noManase, noShimeyi.
Kubantwana bakaBani: uMahadayi, noAmram, noUyeli,
uowyono, noBhenaya, noBhedeya, noKeluhi,
uowyoni, noMeremothi, noEliyasibhi,
uMathaniya, noMatheni, noYashu,
uBani, noBinui, noShimehi,
uowyono: uShelemiya, noNathani, noAdahiya,
uMaknadebai, noShashai, noSharai,
uAzareli, noShelemiya, noShemariya,
uShalum, noAmariya, noYosefu.
Kubafazi bakaNebo: uYeyeli, noMatithiya, noZabadi, noZebina, noIddo, noYoweli, noBhenaya.
La mabhinqa onke aye atshatile nabafazi abathile; kwakukho nabani na phakathi kwabo ozalwa ngabafazi.
Neh: Ilizwi likaNehemiya, unyana kaHakaliya. Ngomhla wenyanga kaKislewe, ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibini, ndandikwiShushan, isixeko sokumkani.
Ke kaloku wafika uHanani, omnye wabahlobo bam, waya eYuda, naye namadoda amaninzi; ndababuza ngeeYuda ezishiyekileyo, eziseleyo phakathi kwabo bathunyelwe ebantwini, neYerusalem.
Bathi kum, Abantu abaseleyo, abaseleyo kuloo mmandla, bakwingozi enkulu nokungakhathali; nedonga laseYerusalem liqhutywe phantsi, namasango alo aqhutywe ngamanzi.
Ke kaloku, ndithe ndiziva ezi zinto, ndahlala, ndalilela; ndalibalisa iintsuku ezininzi, ndazila, ndathandaza kuThixo wezulu.
Ndathi, Nkosi, uThixo wezulu, ndimphendule, mna; wena uThixo omkhulu, onobulumko, ogcina umnqophiso wakho nobubele kubo abakuthandayo, nabagcina umthetho wakhe.

Nceda, udibanise intliziyo yakho, uvule amehlo akho, udibanise umthandazo wam mkhonzi wakho, endiwuthandaza kuwe busuku nobusuku ngenxa yabantwana bakaSirayeli, abakhonzi bakho; ndiya kuzivuma iziphoso zethu, oonyana bakaSirayeli, esizenzayo phambi kwakho; ndandiphelelwe lithemba, mna nendlu yoyise.
Sikwenzele okubi kakhulu phambi kwakho; asiyi kuthobeli imimiselo yakho, nemimiselo yakho, nezithethe zakho, oziwisele kumkhonzi wakho uMoses.
Nceda uqaphele amagama awiseleyo kuMoses, umkhonzi wakho, uthi, Ukuba niyiphulaphule inyaniso, ndiya kunisasaza phakathi kwezizwe.

Ke ukuba nibuya kuni, nigcine imimiselo yam, nokuba baphazamisekile ekugqibeleni kwezulu, ndiya kubahlanganisa nalapho; ndiya kubazisa kwindawo endiyikhethileyo ukuba libe yindawo yokuhlala igama lam.
Baye ke abakhonzi bakho, abantu bakho; wabasindise ngobukrelekrele bakho obukhulu, nesandla sakho esinamandla.

Nkosi, mna pertence u祷a lomkhonzi wakho, nomthandazo wabalipe Politiki bakho abanqwenela ukuthobela igama lakho; ndincede ke namhlanje ukuba ndenze kakuhle, ndikunike ubulumko kukumkani. Ke kaloku ndamisa iwayini ukumkani.
Ngomhla wenyanga ka-Nisan, ngomnyaka omashumi mabini wokumkani uArtakserksesi, kwaziswa iwayini kukumkani; ndayithatha le wayini, ndayinika kuye. Andizange ndenze nto ebuhlungu phambi kwakhe.
Wathi ke kum ukumkani, Kutheni na ukuba imehlo akho alumkile? Akukho buhlungu kuwe; kuba kulumkile intliziyo yakho. Ndiye ndakhathazeka kakhulu,
ndathi kukumkani, Ukumkani uphile ngonaphakade! Ndiza kwenza ntoni na ukuba amehlo am angabi buhlungu? Lo mzi, indawo yokufa kwabazalwana bam, uphambukile; izisango zayo ziqhutywe ngumlilo.
Wathi kum ukumkani, Ufuna ntoni na? Ndathandaza ke kuThixo wezulu.
Ndathi kukumkani, Ukuba kulungile kukumkani, ukuba ndinempumelelo phambi kwakho, nceda uyandithumelele eYuda, kumzi weentsapho zami, ukuze ndiwuphinde ndiwuvule.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wahlala ecaleni kukakumkani, wambuza wathi kum, Ixesha lide kangakanani na uhambo lwakho? Uza kubuya nini? Wathandazela ukumkani ukuba andithumelele; ndathi kuye, Ndiya kuba kude ixesha elide.
Ndathi ke kuye ukumkani, Ukuba kulungile kukumkani, ndininike iileta eziya kubaphathi abasemazantsi eMlambo uEfrayim, ukuba bandise uhambo lwam, ndifike kumaYuda.

Nceda nindinike neleta kuAsafi, umphathi wemithi kakumkani, ukuba andinike imithi; ukuze ndiyisebenzise ukwenza izibambo zeengcango zendlu ekhuselekileyo esendlwini kaThixo, nodonga lomzi, nendlu endiza kuhlala kuyo. Ke kaloku ukumkani wandinika into endiyicelayo, ngenxa yokuba isandla esilungileyo sikaThixo wam sakuba kum.
Ndathi ke, ndiye kumagosa asentshonalanga yomlambo iEfrata, ndazinika izibhengezo zokumkani; ukumkani wathumela kunye nam abathetheli bemikhosi, nabaqhubi beebhayisikili.
Ke kaloku, xa uSanbalati waseHoroni, noTobiya umphathi weAmmon, beva ngale nto, bakhathazeka kakhulu, ngokuba kukho umntu oza kunceda ooSirayeli.
Ndafika eYerusalem, ndahlala khona iintsuku ezintathu.

Ndavuka ke ngobusuku, mna namadoda ambalwa; andizange ndixelele umntu into endiyibekayo intliziyo yam uThixo wam, ukuba ndiyenze eYerusalem. Inyama kuphela endinayo phantsi kwam, leyo ndandihamba ngayo.
Ndaphuma ngaloo busuku ngesango leNtshona, ndiya kwimpucuko ye-Jakelet, nesango le-Mush; ndabona iingcango zeYerusalem, ukuba ziqhutywe, nezivalo zayo, ukuba zenziwe ngomlilo.
Emva koko ndaya kwiGate yeNtshona nePool kaKumkani, kodwa kwakukho indawo eyaneleyo ukuba ikati yam ihambe.
Ke kaloku, ndaya phezulu emlanjeni ngaloo busuku, ndabona idonga; ndajika ndabuyela, ndaphuma ngesango lenduli.

Ke kaloku abaphathi bedolophu babengazi ukuba ndiye phi, nokuba ndingayenza ntoni na; kuba andizange ndenze nto ndathetha ngayo kumaYuda, nakubabingeleli, nabenzi bezinto ezibalulekileyo, nabasemagunyeni, nabani na owenza umsebenzi.
Ndathi ke kubo, Nibona ububi obukho kuthi, ukuba iYerusalem iphukile, neengcango zayo ziqhutywe ngamanzi; niza ke, siphinde siyivule kwakhona ingcango yeYerusalem, ukuze singabi namahlazo.
Ke kaloku ndazixelela ukuba isandla esilungileyo sikaThixo wam sikhona kum, nelizwi likakumkani elithethayo nam. Bathi ke bona, Siya kwakha; basuka ke bemisa ukuyenza le misebenzi entle.
Ke kaloku, xa uSanbalati waseHoroni, noTobiya umphathi we-Ammon, noGishemi umArabha, berája ngale nto, bathabathela isidumbu kuthi; bathi, Yintoni Metroni? emeso yenu? NdiyaRhulumente na?
Ndaphendula ndathi kubo, UThixo wezulu uya kusinceda; nathi abakhonzi bakhe siza kuqala ukwakha. Ke wena awunayo inxaxheba, okanye ilungelo, okanye igama eYerusalem.

Ke kaloku uEliyashabi, umLevi omkhulu, nabazalwana bakhe ababingeleli, baqalisa umsebenzi wabo, balungisa isango leentyatyambo; baya kwenza ukuba libe yindawo engcwele kuThixo, bamisa iifestile zayo. Bayenza kwakhona ingqalelo yodonga ukuya kwintombi yamawaka, nentombi kaHananile, bayenza ibe yindawo engcwele kuThixo.
Amadoda aseJerihoni ayekha inxalenye elandelayo; emva kwawo ke wayakha uZakhuri unyana ka-Imri.
Isango leentlanzi lakhiwa ngabanyana bakaHasenaya; babeka iithayile zayo, bamisa iindonga zayo, nezitshixo zazo, namakhonkco.

UMeremoti unyana kaUriya, unyana kaHakosi, walungisa isiqingatha esilandelayo; ecaleni kwakhe walungisa uMeshulam unyana kaBerekiya, unyana kaMeshezabele; ecaleni kwakhe walungisa uSadoko unyana kaBhaana.
Inxalenye elandelayo yayiyilungisa abantu baseTekoya; ke bona abaphathi babo babengathandanga ukuyenza le misebenzi, abayinike yona iinkomo zabo.
UYehoyada unyana kaPasheya, noMeshulam unyana kaBesodeya, balungisa isango elidala; bamisa izikhonkwane zalo, babeka iifestile zalo, nezitshixo zalo, nezingcango zalo.
Ecaleni kwabo balungisa uMelathiya waseGibheyon, noYadon waseMeronothi, amadoda aseGibheyon neMizpa, waya endlwini yokumkani welizwe elunxwemeni loMlambo iEfrati.

Ecaleni kwabo walungisa uUziyeli, unyana kaHarhaya, umenzi wegolide; ecaleni kwakhe walungisa uHananiya, omnye wabavelisi bezithambiso. Baphinde bakwakha idonga laseYerusalem lifike elunxwemeni olubanzi.
Ecaleni kwabo walungisa uRefahiya, unyana kaHure, umphathi wesiqingatha sendawo yaseYerusalem.
Ecaleni kwabo walungisa uYedaya, unyana kaHarumafe, phambi kwendlu yakhe; ecaleni kwakhe walungisa uHatushe, unyana kaHashabneya.
UMalkiya unyana kaHarim, noHashubu unyana kaPahati-Mowabhi, balungisa enye inxenye, neTonge leziFrentshi.
Ecaleni kwakhe walungisa uShalum, unyana kaHaloheshi, umphathi wesiqingatha sedolophu yaseYerusalem, naye neentombi zakhe.

Isango leNtshona lilungiswe nguHanun namadoda aseZanoa; baya kwakha, bamisa iifestile zayo, nezitshixo zazo, namakhonkco ayo; balungise iithayile ezilishumi elinambini subjektini, ukuya kwisangoRhudo.
UMalekiya unyana kaRekabhi, umphathi wendawo yaseBhat-hakerem, walungisa isango lezinto ezilahlekileyo. Wayila, waza wamisa iminyango yayo, nezitshixo zayo, nezingxobo zayo.

UShaluni unyana kaKhole-Hoze, umphathi wendawo yaseMizpa, walungisa isango lempucuko. Wayenza kwakhona, waza wayibeka intyatyambo phezu kwayo, wamisa izibuko layo, nezitshixo zayo, namakhonkco ayo; walungisa ke udonga lolwandle lweSiloyamu, ecaleni kwegadi yokumkani, waya ezinyaweni ezisezantsi kumzi kaDavide.
Emva kwakhe walungisa uNehemiya, unyana ka-Azbuki, umphathi wesiqingatha selizwe laseBhete-shuri, waya ecaleni kweengqungquthela zikaDavide, waya esidlangalaleni, waya kwindlu yamadoda anamandla.
Emva kwakhe balungisa amaLevi, phantsi kukaRehum unyana kaBani. Ecaleni kwakhe walungisa uHashabiya, umphathi wesiqingatha selizwe laseKehila, ezweni lakhe.
Emva kwakhe balungisa abazalwana babo, amaLevi, phantsi kwesandla sikaBhavayi unyana kaHenadadi, umphathi wesibini sendawo yaseKehila.
Ecaleni kwakhe walungisa inxalenye enye uEzere, unyana kaYeshuya, umphathi waseMizpa, ecaleni kophahla oluphakamileyo, ukuya phezulu kwigumbi lezixhobo, elunxwemeni lodonga.
Emva kwakhe uBharuki, unyana kaZabhayi, walungisa enye inxenye ngesandla sakhe esinamandla, ukususela kwincopho ukuya kumngcango wendlu kaEliyasibhi, umbingeleli omkhulu.
Emva kwakhe walungisa uMeremothi, unyana kaUriya, unyana kaHakoshe, inxalenye enye, ukususela emnyango wendlu kaEliyasibhi, waya esiphelweni sayo.
Emva kwakhe balungisa ababingeleli bendawo ejikelezileyo.
Emva kwabo balungisa uBhenjamin noHashubhi, ngaphesheya kwendlu yabo; emva kwabo walungisa uAzariya, unyana kaMahasihiya, unyana kaAnaniya, ecaleni kwendlu yakhe.
Emva kwakhe walungisa uBinui, unyana kaHenadadi, elinye icandelo, ukusuka endlwini ka-Uzariya, waya kumacala omabini, nakwikona yodonga.
UPalal, u pertence ka-Uzayi, walungisa ngaphesheya ko覗o lodonga olungasemva kwendlu enkulu yokumkani ephakamileyo, entliziyweni yenkundla yamagwebu; emva kwakhe walungisa uPedaya, unyana kaParosh.
Abakhonzi bakaNdikhoyo bahlala emnqamlezweni weOfel, kude kube kufutshane nesango lamanzi elunxwemeni olusentshonalanga, nodonga oluphumayo.
Emva kwabo balungisa amadoda aseTekoya enye inxaxheba, esuka ngaphaya kwentyatyambo enkulu iphumayo kudonga lweOfel.
Ngasentla kwesango lemahashe, balungisa oombingeleli, ngamnye ecaleni kwendlu yakhe.
Emva kwabo walungisa uSadoko unyana ka-Imere, phambi kwendlu yakhe; emva kwakhe walungisa uShemaya unyana ka-Shekaniya, umgcini wesango lasempumalanga.
Emva kwakhe walungisa uHananiya, unyana kaShelemiya, noHanun, unyana wesixhenxe kaZalaphe, enye inxaxheba; emva kwabo walungisa uMeshulam, unyana kaBerekiya, ecaleni kwendlu yakhe.
Emva kwakhe walungisa uMalhiya, omnye wabaqulunqi begolide, waya endlwini yabakhonzi bakaThixo nabarhwebi, ngaphezu kwesango lokuhlola, waya kwigumbi eliphezulu lekona.
Abaqulunqi begolide, nabarhwebi, balungisa phakathi kwegumbi eliphezulu kwekona nesango leentyatyambo.
Ke kaloku, xa uSanbalati eva ukuba siwulungisa umngxunya wodonga, waxhaphaza, waba neentloni kakhulu; waza wayalela abaYuda.

Wathi phambi kweentombi zakhe, nangaphambili komkhosi waseSamariya, Yintoni le eyenzayo loo maYuda athambileyo? Bacinga ntoni na ukuba baya kuyila udonga ngobomi babo? Ngaba baya kunikela izibingelelo? Ingaba baya kuyigqiba ngemini enye? Ingaba baya kuzibuyisela ezitye ziqhutywa ngamanzi ezintabeni zamatye?
Ke kaloku uTobiya, umAmoni, wayesecaleni kwakhe. Wathi ke, Nakuba intaka ikhuphe phezulu kwinto abayenzayo, iya kutyhila ingcango yabo yelitye;
Ndathandaza, ndithi, Yiva, Thixo wethu, ngokuba sithethwa phantsi; Uyibuyisele inkohlakalo yabo phezu kweentloko zabo; Bathunyelwe ebantwini belizwe elingaphandle.
Musa ukugubungela ububi babo, ungawucimi umonakalo wabo emehlweni akho; ngokuba baphulaphule abo balungisa.
Sawulungisa ke udonga, saza saludibanisa lonke, kufike kwintloko yalo; ngokuba abantu basebenza ngengqondo yabo yonke.
Ke kaloku, xa uShanbalati noTobiya, nabaseArabhu, nabaseAmmon, nabahlali baseAshdodi, beva ukuba ukuhonjiswa kweendonga zaseYerusalem kuqhubeka, nokuba iziqhamo zivalwe, baxoka kakhulu.
Ke kaloku bonke bathethe ndawonye, ukuba baya kulwa neYerusalem, ukuba benze umonakalo.
Ke kaloku sathandaza kuThixo wethu, sabeka amagwebu ubusuku nemini, ukuze sikhuselwe kubo.
Ke kaloku abantu bakaYuda basithi, Abasebenzi balahleka kakhulu, iinkuni zininzi kakhulu; asikwazi ukuwulungisa udonga.
Bathi abathunywa bethu, Kude bakwazi ukuba sikhona, nakuba babone ukuba sikhona, siza kuba phakathi kwabo; siyababulala, siyayimisa le misebenzi.
Ke kaloku kwafika amaYuda ahlala ecaleni kwabo, wathetha nathi amaxesha asixhenxe, esithi, Baza kusihlasela ngazo zonke iinkalo.
Ndabeka ke abantu ngasemva kweendawo eziphantsi zedonga, ezindaweni ezivulekileyo; ndababeka ngokweentsapho zabo, benesikhephe sabo, nezithuthi zabo, namaqhekeza abo.

Ke kaloku, ndithe ndeva, ndavuka, ndathi kubo abakhulu, nabaphathi, naleyo mininzi yabantu, Musani ukuxoka phambi kwabo; khumbulani iNkosi omkhulu, onobungozi, nife ngenxa yabazalwana benu, ngenxa yeenyana zenu, ngenxa yeentombi zenu, ngenxa yamabhinqa enu, ngenxa yezindlu zenu.
Ke kaloku abathunywa bethu bafumanisa ukuba siyazi isigqibo sabo, ngokuba uThixo waphulaphulela izigqibo zabo; sabuyela ke sonke kudonga, ngamnye emisebenzini yakhe.

Ngomhla lowo, kwathi ke, isiqingatha samadoda am sisenza umsebenzi; isiqingatha samadoda am siphatha izithunywa, nezikhuselo, namaqhekeza, nezixhobo zokulwa. Abaphathi bemikhosi babe ngasemva kwabantu bonke bakaYuda.
Bathi ke abo bayenzayo idonga, abathabathayo imithwalo, besenza umsebenzi wabo ngesandla esisodwa, babe nezixhobo zabo ngesandla esinye.
Ke kaloku amakhonzi, onke anesikhephe sakhe esandleni sakhe, esenza umsebenzi wakhe; umntu ophucula intsimbi wayehlala nam.
Ndathi ke kumadoda amakhulu, nabaphathi, namanye amalungu eqela labantu, Imisebenzi ikhulu, inobubanzi obuninzi; thina sibekwe kude ngamnye kumnye phezu kwedonga.
Naphi na apho niyiva khona ilizwi lebhokhwe, nifikeni nathi; uThixo wethu uya kulwa nathi.
Ke kaloku saqhubeka sisebenzela, nesiqingatha samabhinqa esinazo iinqanawa, ukususela ekuqaleni kokukhanya kwemini, de kwaphuma iintlanga.
Ke kaloku ndathi kubo ngaloo xesha, Wonke umntu ahlale ngaphakathi eYerusalem ngobusuku, yena nomsebenzi wakhe; ukuze bakhusele nathi ngobusuku, basebenze mihla le.
Ke kaloku akukho namnye wethu okhupha iimpahla zakhe, mna, nabazalwana bam, namakhonzi am, nabakhuseli abahamba nam; wonke umntu wabeka isithuthi sakhe esandla sakhe, xa besiya kufumana amanzi.
Bathi ke amadoda, namabhinqa abo, ephulaphule ngelizwi elikhulu kubazalwana babo amaYuda.
Bathi abanye, Sinabantwana abaninzi namadodakazi amaninzi; sifuna ingqolowa ukuze sidle, siphile.
Bathi ke abanye, Siyazinikela izityalo zethu, nezityalo zewayini zethu, nezindlu zethu, ukuba siyithathe ityala, ukuze sifumane ubisi ngexesha lendlala.
Bathi ke abanye, Sithathe imali siyihlawulele intlawulo yokumkani, ngeendawo zethu, neentaba zethu zewayini.

Ndithi ke kuni, thina sifana nabazalwana bethu abaYuda; bantwana bethu bafana nabo. Ke kaloku siya kuthengisa oonyana bethu neentombi zethu zibe ngamagqwetha; nakwakhona kukho ezinye zeentombi zethu ziye zabekwa ngamagqwetha; asikwazi ukwenza nto ngaloo nto, kuba izityalo zethu nezityalo zeziqhamo zethu ziyinxalenye yabanye abantu.
Ke kaloku, ndithe ndava izilumkiso zabo, nento abathiyo, ndamxotha kakhulu.

Ke kaloku, ndithe ndacinga ngale nto, ndathi kumadoda amakhulu nabasemagunyeni, Ndithi kubo, Nizihlawula iindleko zeentsapho zenu. Ndathi ke, Ndizamile ukulungiselela intlanganiso enkulu, ukuze ndenze ngaloo nto.

Ke kaloku ndathi kubo, Sibathengise abahlobo bethu, ooYuda, abathe bathengiswe kumaSirayeli, njengoko sakwaziyo; ke nina nithengisa abazalwana benu, ukuze bathengiswe kuthi. Baye bekhala, bangafumani nto yokuphendula.
Ndathi ke, Ayikho into elungileyo leyo niyenzayo; kufuneka nihambe ngokholo kuThixo wethu, ukuze abathunywa bethu phakathi kwezizwe bangabi nesizathu sokuba bathabathe isidumbu.
Ndithi ke, nabantwana bam, nabakhonzi bam, ndiyidlulisa intsapho yam imali nengqolowa; nceda siyeke ukuhlawula umvuzo.

Nizibuyisele kubo namhlanje izityalo zazo, nezityalo zeziqhamo zazo, nezityalo zeolivini zazo, nezindlu zabo; nizibuyisele nabo iindleko zemali, neziqhamo, newayini entsha, neoli yeolivini, nizibuyisele.
Bathi ke kubo, Siyazibuyisela, asiyi kucela nantoni na; siza kwenza njengoko utshoyo. Ndawabiza ngoko ababingeleli, ndabatyhila phambi kwabo, ukuba baya kwenza oko bathethayo.

Ke kaloku, ndathi, Umntu wonke oza kwenza loo nto, uThixo amkhubeke ngale ndlela endlwini yakhe nakwimpahla yakhe; aqhutywe lo mntu, angabikho namnye. Bathi bonke abantu: Amen! Bawuthandazela iNkosi. Yathi ke into leyo intsapho yam.

Kuba ukususela kwixesha pertencela ezweni lakwaYuda, ukusuka kunyaka o Sept Politiki, kuze kube umnyaka weshumi elinambini wokumkani uArtaxerxes, iminyaka emihlanu nelishumi elinamibini yonke; mna nabazalwana bam asidlanga isonka somphathi.

Ke kaloku abo baphathi abangaphambili kwam babebamisa abantu, bethabathela kubo isonka newayini, nesilivere elishumi elinanye; namadoda abo asebenza nabo ayewalawula abantu ngokugqithisileyo; ke mna andizange ndenze njalo, ngokuba ndimxelela uThixo.
Ke kaloku ndasebenza ngesandla esinzima kulo mgca; asithengi mhlaba; bonke abantu bam bahlangane khona ukuba basebenze.
KwabaYuda, nabaphathi abalishumi elinambini, ndabalungiselela isonka emehlweni am; kwakunye nabantu abathi bafika kuthi, besuka kumazwe ajikelezayo.

Kwandilungiselelwa mihla ngemihla inkomo enye, neenkomo ezintandathu ezilungileyo, neentlanzi ezincinci; kwathi nganye imini elishumi kwakuthethwa ubisi oluninzi lwazo zonke iintlobo zewayini. Ke kaloku, ndandingazicela izitya zokumkani, ngokuba abantu babenzima kakhulu.
Khumbula kum, Thixo wam, ngezinto ezilungileyo zonke endizenzayo kubo bonke abantu.

Ke kaloku, xa uShanbalati, noTobiya, noGishemi umArabhu, namanye amaxhoba ethu, beva ukuba ndibuyele ndawulungisa ugqubuthelo lodonga, ukuba akukho thuba lisele kulo; nokuba andizange ndibeke izivalo ezindlwini zeengcango.
Ke kaloku uShanbalati noGishemi bathumela kum, bethi, Yiya, sihlangane ndawonye esinye sezixeko ezikwindawo eselunxwemeni lwase-Ono. Baye ke bafuna ukundiphazela.
Ndathumela abathunywa, ndithi kubo, Ndisenza umsebenzi omkhulu; andikwazi ukuwa phantsi. Ingaba umsebenzi uya kuvalwa na, ukuba ndiwushiye ndiya ezantsi kuni?
Bendithumelela loo myalezo kathathu; ndabaphendula ngomhla ngamnye ngaloo nto.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe, uSanbalati wamthumela kum umkhonzi wakhe, ngento efanayo; wayeneleta evulekileyo esandla sakhe.

Wathi, Kuthe kwathiwa phakathi kwezizwe, ke kaloku uGeshem uthi kulungile, ukuba wena namadoda aseYiputa nifuna ukuxoka; ngenxa yoko ukwakha kwakhona ugqubuthelo; bathetha ke ukuba uya Metroni wabo subjektile.
Uthe ke, Nithi nikhethe abaprofeti ukuba bashumayele ngenu eYerusalem, besithi, Kukho ukumkani eYuda. Ke kaloku le nto iya kubuyela kuye ukumkani; ndiza kuthi ngoko sithethe ngale nto ndawonye.
Ke kaloku ndimthumelela umyalezo, ndithi, Akukho nto injalo eyenziweyo njengokuba uthethayo; wena uyenza ngengqondo yakho.
Ke kaloku bonke bafuna ukusikhathaza, besithi, Izandla zabo ziya kulahleka, zize zingayi kwenza loo nto, ukuze ingagqitywanga. Ndathandaza ke, ndithi, Namhlanje, Thixo wam, uqinise izandla zam;

Ke kaloku ndafika ekhaya likaShemaya, unyana kaDelaya, unyana kaMehetabele; ke kaloku wayetshixiwe endlwini yakhe. Wathi, Siya kuhlangana kwindlu kaThixo, ngaphakathi kwetempile, sivale izivalo zetempeli; kuba abantu baya kuza ukukubulala; baza kufika le ntambama ukukubulala.
Wathi ke mna, Ingaba umntu onjengomntu wam uya kubaleka na? Ingaba umntu onjengomntu wam uya kungena endlwini kaThixo ukuze aphile? Andiyi kungena.
Ke kaloku ndafumanisa ukuba uThixo akawuthumeli; kuba wathetha lo mprofeti kum, ngenxa yokuba uTobiya noSanbalati bamhlawulile.
Baye bamqesha, ukuba andikhokelele ekwenzeni oku, ndithini na, ukuze bandise igama lam, bandise uxolo lwam.
Khumbula, Thixo wam, into awayeyenza uTobiya noSanbalati; nomprofeti uNoyadi, namanye amaprofeta, afuna ukumkhokela.
Wagqitywa ke udonga ngomhla weshumi elinesihlanu wenyanga ka-Elile, ngeentsuku ezimashumi mahlanu anesibini.
Ke kaloku, xa abathunywa bethu bonke beva ngale nto, bakhathazeka zonke iintlanga ezingqongileyo kuthi; zathi ke iimvakalelo zabo ziphazamiseka. Bayazi ukuba lo msebenzi uwenziwe nguThixo wethu.
Ke kaloku, ngazo ezo mihla, abantu abakhulu baseYuda bathumela iileta ezininzi kuTobiya; zafika ke kubo izilete zikaTobiya.
Ke kaloku abantu abaninzi baseYuda babemthobela, ngokuba wayengumyeni kaShekaniya unyana ka-Araha; ke kaloku uYohanan unyana wakhe waba nendodana kaMeshulam unyana ka-Berekiya.
Ke kaloku bathetha kum ngezinto ezilungileyo azenzayo uTobiya; ke kaloku bamxelela ilizwi lam. Wathumela ke uTobiya izibhengezo, ukuba andikhokelele.
Ke kaloku, emva kokuba ugqubuthelo lugqityiwe, ndazibeka izivalo; abagwebi, nabaculi, nabaLevi, banikezelwa imisebenzi yabo.

Ke kaloku ndamisa uHanani, umzalwana wam, ukuba abe ngukumkani eYerusalem, naye uHananiya, umphathi weendawo ezikhuselekileyo. UHananiya ke waba ngumntu othembekileyo, wayemthanda uThixo ngaphezu kwabanye bonke abantu.

Ndathi kubo, Musani ukuvula iindonga zeYerusalem, de kube lishushu ilanga; bavale izibuko, bazitshixe, ngelixa abakhuseli beengcango besoloko besebenza; nikhethe abantu abahlali eYerusalem ukuba babe ngabagwebi, nibeke abanye kwiindawo zabo zokuzikhusela, nabanye endlwini yabo.
Ke kaloku lo mzi wawubanzi, waba mkhulu; kodwa kwabakho abantu abambalwa kuloo mzi; izindlu ke zathi zingabi zithengiswa.

Ke kaloku uThixo wam wabeka entliziyweni yam, ukuba ndizihlanganisela izikhulu, namagqwetha, naba bantu, ukuze babhaliswe ngokweentsapho zabo; ndafumanisa iincwadi zokubhalwa kweenkolelo zabaqalayo, ezibhalwe ngale nto:
Ke kaloku, abo babantu belizwe ababuyayo ebantwini basemkhosini, ababethunyelweyo nguNebhukadnezare ukumkani waseBhabheli; babuyela eYerusalem naseYuda, ngamnye edolophini yakhe.
Bafika noZerubabele, noYeshuwa, noNehemiya, noAzariya, noRamiya, noNahamani, noMordekayi, noBileshan, noMisperethe, noBhigweyi, noNehum, noBhaana; le ke inani lamaSirayeli:
Oonyana bakaParoshe baba ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu mathathu, anamanci asixhenxe anesibini.
Oonyana bakaShefatiya ibingamakhulu amathathu, anamanci asixhenxe anabini.
Oonyana baka-Ahara babemakhulu amathandathu, anamanci mahlanu anabini.
Oonyana bakaPahati-Mowabhi, ngoYeshuwa noYowabhi: amawaka mabini anamakhulu asibhozo, anamanci asibhozo.
Oonyana baka-Elam ibilikhulu, elinamakhulu amabini, anamanci mahlanu anane.
Oonyana bakaZathu ibingamakhulu asibhozo, anamanci mane anesihlanu.
Oonyana bakaZakayi ibingamakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci amathandathu.
Oonyana bakaBinui babemakhulu amathandathu, anamanci mane anamashumi asibhozo.
Oonyana bakaBebhayi ibingamakhulu amathandathu, anamanci mabini anasibhozo.
Oonyana baka-Azgadi baba ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu mathathu, anamanci mabini anambini.
Oonyana baka-Adonikam ibingamakhulu amathandathu, anamanci asixhenxe anesibhozo.
Oonyana bakaBhigweyi baba ngamawaka amabini anamashumi asixhenxe anesixhenxe.
Oonyana baka-Adin babemakhulu amathandathu, anamanci mahlanu anesihlanu.
Oonyana baka-Atere, ngoHezekiya, abamashumi asithoba anesibhozo.
Oonyana bakaHashumi babelikhulu, elinamanci mabini anamashumi asibhozo.
Oonyana bakaBezayi babelikhulu, elinamanci mabini anane.
Oonyana bakaHarifi babelikhulu, elinamabini anamashumi mabini.
Amadoda aseGibheyon amashumi asithoba anesihlanu.
Amadoda aseBhetelehem neNetofa ayelikhulu, elinamashumi asibhozo anesibhozo.
Amadoda aseAnathothi ayelikhulu, elinamanci mabini anesibhozo.
Amadoda aseBhethe-azmavethi amawaka amane anesibini.
Amadoda aseKiriyati-yearimi, neKefira, neBherothi, amakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mane anathathu.
Amadoda aseRama, naseGeba: inani labo limakhulu amathandathu, anamabini ananye.
Amadoda aseMikmasi ayelikhulu, elinamabini anambini.
Amadoda aseBheteli, naseAyi, amawaka amashumi mabini anathathu.
Oonyana bakaNebo omnye babemashumi amahlanu anesibini.
Oonyana baka-Elam omnye, amawaka amane anamakhulu mabini, anamanci mahlanu anesine.
Oonyana bakaHarim ibingamakhulu amathathu, anamanci mabini.
Amadoda aseJerikho ayemakhulu amathathu, anamanci mane anamashumi amahlanu.
Amadoda aseLodi, naseHadidi, naseOno: amakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mabini ananye.
Amadoda aseShena, amawaka amathathu anamakhulu asithoba, anamanci mathathu.
Ababingeleli: oonyana bakaYedaya, abakwindlu kaYeshuwa, bamakhulu asithoba, anamanci asixhenxe namathathu.
Oonyana baka-Imere babelikhulu, elinamanci mabini anamashumi amahlanu.
Oonyana bakaPashure ibilikhulu, elinamakhulu amabini, anamanci mane anesibhozo.
Oonyana bakaHarim ibilikhulu, elinamanci asixhenxe.
OoLevi: oonyana bakaYeshuwa, ngoKadmiyeli, owaseHodeva, abamashumi asixhenxe anesihlanu.
Abangomani: oonyana baka-Asaphi babelikhulu, elinamashumi mane anesibhozo.
Abagwebi: oonyana bakaShalum, noAtere, noTalmon, noAkube, noHatitha, noShobhayi, abelikhulu elinamanci mathathu anamashumi asibhozo.
Abakhonzi bakaThixo: oonyana bakaSiha, noHashufa, noTabhaothi,
uKeros, noShiha, noPadon,
uLebhana, noHagaba, noSalmai,
uHanani, noGideyeli, noGahare,
uRehaya, noRezin, noNekoda,
noGazhamu, noUza, noPaseha,
uBhesiya, noMeyunim, noNephusheshim,
uowyubuki, neHakupha, neHarhuri,
noBazliti, noMehida, noHarsha,
uBarkosi, noSisera, noTema,
noNesiya, noHatifa.
Oonyana bomkhonzi kaSolomon: oonyana bakaSotayi, noSofherethi, noPerida,
uYahala, noDarkon, noGidele,
noShefatiya, noHatiyeli, noPokerethe uHazebayim, noAmon.
Bonke oonyana bakaNethinim, nabantwana bamakhonzi kaSolomon, babe ngamawaka amathathu amashumi asithoba anesibini.
Ke kaloku kwanyuka abantu abathile eTeli-mela, neTheli-harsha, neKerubhi, neAddoni, neImeri; kodwa abakwazi ukuveza iintsapho zabo ukuba zivela kuSirayeli.
Oonyana bakaDelaya, noTobiya, noNekoda: amawaka anamanci mane anababini.
Ababingeleli: oonyana bakaHobhaya, noHakosi, noBarzilayi. UBarzilayi wayesele ekhulelwe intombi kaBarzilayi waseGiliyadi, wathabatha igama lendlu yakhe.
Baye bakhangela amagama abo kuncwadi lwabafazi, bengazifumananga; ngoko ke, abazange babe ngababingeleli babo.
Ukumkani wathi kubo ukuba bangadla into engcwele kakhulu, de kubekho umbingeleli oza kubuza ngo-Urim no-Thummim.
Wonke umkhosi waba ngamawaka angamashumi mane anesibini, namawaka anamakhulu amathathu, anamanci amathandathu;

ngaphandle kwabakhonzi babo, amadoda namadoda, amawaka asixhenxe, anamakhulu amathathu, anamanci mathathu anesixhenxe. Babeneengomakazi, amadoda namabhinqa, anamakhulu amabini, anamanci mane anesihlanu.
Babeneebhayisikile ezimakhulu asixhenxe, anamanci mathathu anesithandathu, neembumbulu ezinekhulu linamashumi mane anesihlanu;
iinkomo ezimakhulu amane, anamanci mathathu anamashumi amahlanu, neenkunzi zeegusha ezilishumi elinambini.

Ke kaloku abanye abakhulu beentsapho zakwaSirayeli banikela kumsebenzi. Ukumkani wanikela kwindlu yempahla ethengiswayo, igolide eyishumi elinesixhenxe nesiqingatha sekhilogram, nezitya ezilishumi elinambini, neengubo ezimakhulu amahlanu anamashumi mathathu, zababingeleli.
Bathi ke abanye abaphathi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli banikela kwimali yokwakha, iingelosi ezilishumi elinazine zegolide, neentlobo ezilishumi elinambini zesilivere.
Amanye amaSirayeli anikela ngegolide, ngamakhulu asixhenxe eetoni, nesilivere, ngamashumi amathandathu anesixhenxe eetoni, nezigqomo zababingeleli, ngamakhulu asixhenxe anesibhozo.

Bathi ke ababingeleli, nabaLevi, nabaphathi beengcango, nabapostile, namanye amaSirayeli, namaNethinim, nabo bonke amanye amaSirayeli, bahlala emizini yabo. Ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga, babemi oonyana bakaSirayeli emizini yabo.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bahlangana njengendoda enye kwindawo evulekileyo phambi kwesango lamanzi, besithi kuEzra umfundi, ukuba athathe incwadi yomthetho kaMoses, owawunika iNkosi amaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga yesixhenxe, uEzra ukumkani wazisa umthetho phambi kwesihlwele sabafazi nabafazi, bonke abakwaziyo ukuva.

Wafunda kulo, ejonge ibala elivulekileyo elingaphambili kwengubo yamanzi, ukusukela kusasa ukuya emveni kwemini; wafunda ngalo phambi kwamadoda nabasetyhini, nangabo bonke abakwaziyo ukuqonda. Indlebe yabantu bonke yaba kuncwadi lwamthetho.

Ke kaloku uEzra, umfundi, wahlala phezu kwebhedi ephakamileyo yomthi, eyenziwe ngaloo njongo; ngasekunene kwakhe kwahlala uMatithiya, noShema, noAnaya, noUriya, noHilkihiya, noMaaseya; ngasekhohlo kwakhe kwahlala uPedaya, noMishayeli, noMalkiya, noHashum, noHasbaddana, noZekariya, noMeshulam.
Ke kaloku uEzra wavula incwadi phambi kwamehlo abantu bonke; ngokuba wayesecaleni kwabo. Yathi ke, xa evuleleyo, bavuka bonke abantu.
Ke kaloku uEzra wamthandazela iNkosi, uThixo omkhulu; bonke ke abantu baphakamisa izandla zabo, bephendula bathi, Amen, amen. Bahlangula ke, bakhonza iNkosi ngobuso babo phantsi.

amaLevi, uYe-shuwa, noBani, noSherebiya Sept覗a, noYamin, noAkubhu, noShabhethai, noHodiya, noMashehiya, noKelitha, noUzariya, noYozabadi, noHanan, noPelaya, banceda abantu ukuba bazi umthetho; ke bona behlala phantsi.
Bafunda incwadi yomthetho kaThixo ngokucacileyo, bachaza intsingiselo yayo; ke ngoko abantu baqonda oko kwafundwa.

Wathi ke uNehemiya, umlawuli, noEzra, umbingeleli, umfundi, nabaLevi, abafundisa abantu bonke, bathi kubo bonke: Lo mhla ngungcwele kuYehova uThixo wenu; musa ukuxolela, ningalibali. Kuba abantu bonke babelilila xa beva amazwi omthetho.

Wathi ke uNehemiya, Yiya, nidla isonka esilungileyo, niphuze isiselo esimnandi, nithumelele kubo abangenanto elungiselelweyo; ngokuba lo mhla ngungcwele kuYehova wethu. Musani ukuba neentlungu, kuba uxolo lukaThixo luye lwaba lunamandla enu.
Ke kaloku abaLevi bamisa bonke abantu, besithi, Nceda niphumle; ngokuba le yimini engcwele; musa ukukhathazeka.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu basuka bedla, besela, bethutha isonka, bebhiyozela ngovuyo olukhulu; ngokuba babeziqonda amagama abagqugquzelweyo kubo.
Ke kaloku ngomhla wesibini, bahlangana abathetheli bezindlu zabazali zabantu bonke, nababingeleli nabaLevi, kuEzra umfundi, ukuba bafunde amagama omthetho.
Bafumanisa kumthetho, owawuthi iNkosi ngesandla sikaMoses, libhalwe ukuba oonyana bakaSirayeli bahlalise ezibhedlele ngexesha lemikhosi yenyanga yesixhenxe.

Yathi ke ukuba babhengeza kulo lonke ilizwe labo, naseYerusalem, besithi, Yiya entlango, nizise iziqhamo zeolive, neziqhamo zeolive eziphilayo, neziqhamo ze-myrte, neziqhamo zepali, nezinye iziqhamo ezineziqhamo, ukuze nizenza izindlu zangasese, njengoko kubhalwe.

Baphuma ke abantu, bazisa iziqhamo zazo, bazenza iikhabhathi-zindlu; bazenza phezu kweentyatyambo zabo, nakwiinduli zabo, nakwiinduli zendlu kaThixo, nakwindawo evulekileyo yeGate yamanzi, nakwindawo evulekileyo yeGate kaEfraim.
Ke kaloku bonke ababuyayo ebantwini balungisa izindlu zokuhlala, behlala kuzo. AbaSirayeli abazange benze njalo ukususela kwimihla kaYoshuwa unyana kaNune; ke bona bonke baba mnandi.

Wafunda ke uEzra mihla ngemihla kwincwadi yomthetho kaThixo, ukususela kumhla wokuqala waya kumhla wokugqibela; basenza imini yesixhenxe; ngomhla wesibhozo babe nengqungquthela ekhethekileyo, ngokwesiqhelo somthetho.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla weshumi elinesine lenyanga leyo, bahlangana oonyana bakaSirayeli, bephe isonka, benezigqomo, bebeka uthuli ezindlebeni zabo.
Ke kaloku abo baphuma ebantwini bakaSirayeli, bathabathela kubo bonke abasemagunyeni; behlala, bavuma iziphoso zabo, neziphoso zabafazi babo.

Zathi ke, zasezindaweni zabo, zihlambulule isiqingatha soalaniso lwemini; bafunda incwadi yomthetho kaYehova uThixo wabo. Zihlambulule isiqingatha semihla ngemihla bevuma iimpazamo zawo, bazinikela kuYehova uThixo wabo.
Ke kaloku amaLevi, uYeshua, noBani, noKadmiyeli, noShebaniya, noBuni, noSherebiya, noBani, noKenani, bamisa phezu kweenyawo zabo, bathandaza kuYehova uThixo wabo ngelizwi elikhulu.

Bathi ke uYeshua, noKadmiel, noBani, noHashabneya, noSherebiya, noHodiya, noShebania, noPetahiya, amaLevi, Nciphisani nivumile iNkosi uThixo wenu, ophilayo ngonaphakade; nivumile igama lakho eliqaqambileyo, Nkosi, likhulu kunazo zonke izibhengezo zethu nezivumi.

UYehova uThixo wakho, wena kuphela; wazenza izulu, nezulu eliphakamileyo, neziqhamo zonke. Wayenza ihlabathi nazo zonke izinto zayo, amalwandle nazo zonke izinto zawo; uya kuzisindisa zonke ezi zinto; naloo mkhosi wezulu uyamthandazela.
Uye iNkosi uThixo, owazikhethela uAbram, wamkhupha eUre waseBhabheli, wamnika igama elithi uAbraham.

Wabona ukuba intliziyo yakhe ithembekile kuwe, wakwenza naye umnqophiso wokuba uya kumnika isizukulwana sakhe ilizwe lamaKanana, namaHeti, namaAmori, namaPerizi, namaYebhusi, namaGirgasi; ugcine igama lakho, ngokuba ungumntu olungileyo nolungisa.
Wabona ububi babazali bethu eYiputa, Wava ukholo lwabo elunxwemeni olumnyama.
Wawenza amaphawu namathandabuzo kuFaro, kumakhonzi akhe onke, nabahlali bonke belizwe lakhe; ngokuba wayazi ukuba bathethe Dura, nakwaSirayeli; wakwenza igama kuwe, njengokuba kunjalo n Metro.
Wahlula ulwandle phambi kwabo, bahamba phakathi kwalo ngendawo ecocekileyo; wabathutha abo abawaphazamisa emazulwini aphakamileyo, njengokuba lilitye emazulwini amabi.
Wabaqhuba ngomhlathi welanga mihla le, ngomhlathi womlilo busuku bonke, ukuba ukhanyise indlela abaza kuyihamba.
Wahla phezu komnxweme weSinayi, wathetha nabo esibhakabhakeni, wabanika izigqibo ezilungileyo, nemimiselo ethembekileyo, imimiselo emihle nemiyalelo.
Wabafundisa iSabatha yakho engcwele, wabeka kubo imimiselo, nemimiselo nemithetho, ngesandla sikaMoses umkhonzi wakho.
Wabanika isonka esiphuma emlilweni, xa babenandlala; wabakhupha amanzi ebhayisekileni, xa babenethamsanqa; wathetha nabo ukuba bafike bathathe ilifa elizweni owawuthi uya kulinika.
Ke kaloku abazalwana bethu babhidekela, babhidekela imilenze yabo, bangawaphulaphuli amalungiselelo akho.

Bathe ke, bangawuphulaphuli umyalelo wakho; balibala imiqondiso yakho oyenzayo phakathi kwabo; bagqiba imilenze yabo, bamisela umkhuluwa kubo, ukuba abonise ukubuya kwabo eYiputa, ukuba babe ngabakhonzi bakho. Ke wena, Thixo, ungumsindisi, unobubele nobulumko, uthambileyo ekukhanyeni, ugcwele inyaniso yothando; awubashiyelanga;
Ke kaloku, xa besenza inkunzi yenkomo eyenziwe ngobhedu, besithi, Lo nguThixo wakho owenza ukuba uphume eYiputa; ke kaloku, xa bethetha ngezinto ezibi kakhulu kuwe,

ke wena, ngenxa yobubele bakho obuninzi, wawungawashiya ezweni elincinane; umbhoxo wefuthe akazange abuyele phambi kwabo ngemini ukubakhokela kwindlela yabo; nombhoxo womlilo akazange abuyele phambi kwabo ngobusuku ukubonisa indlela.
Wabanika umphefumlo wakho olungileyo, ukuba bafundise; uManna wawumnika ukuwadla, wawumnika amanzi ukuba abe neswekile.
Iminyaka emashumi mane ubazikhathalele kuloo mfula, babenazo zonke izinto ezifunekayo kubo; iimpahla zabo azithengiswanga, nemilenze yabo ayitshizi.
Wabanika izikumkani nezizwe, wabanika ilizwe ngapha nangapha; bathathe ilizwe likaSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni, nelizwe likaOgi ukumkani waseBhashani.
Wakwenza oonyana babo baninzi njengokuba zininzi iinkwenkwezi emazulwini; wababeka ezweni, owathi kubazalwana babo ukuba baya kungena lilizwe labo.

Ke kaloku bafika oonyana babo, bathathe ilizwe; wababulala phambi kwabo abaKanani abahlala kuloo lizwe, wabanikela kubo, nabo bonke ababingeleli babo, nabahlali baloo lizwe, ukuba benze kubo ngokwemfuno yabo.

Bathabathe imizi enemigangatho, nelizwe elisempilweni; bathathe iimpahla ezigcwele izinto ezintle, neziqulatho ezenziweyo, izityalo zeziqhamo, nezityalo zeoli, nemithi yeentyatyambo eninzi; badla, bakhulule, babe makhulu, baphumle kubuhle bakho obuninzi.
Bathi ke, bekuphulaphule wena, bakwenza okubi kuwe; babeka umyalelo wakho ngasemva kwabo, babulala abaprofeti bakho, ababemxelela ukuba baya kubuyela kuwe; bathetha ngezinto ezibuhlungu kuwe.

Wabanikela ke ngamehlo oothunywa babo, ukuba babenciphise. Ke kaloku, ngexesha loxinzelelo lwabo, bathandaza kuwe; wena wabaziphulaphula emazulwini; ngenxa yobuninzi bemithandazo yakho, wabanika abakhuseli, ababebakhusela kumathunya abo.

Ke kaloku, emva kokuba baphumle, baphinde baphinda besenza okubi phambi kwakho; ke wena wabayashiya emlonyeni wabachasi babo, ukuba babe ngabaphathi kubo. Baye babuya bethandaza kuwe, nawe wawuva ezulu, wabakhusela ngobubele bakho, uphinde uphinde.

Wabaxelela ukuba babuyiselwe emthethweni wakho; ke bona babhiyozela, bangawuphulaphuli umyalelo wakho, baphelelwa ziimvume zakho, eziphilayo kubo bonke abazenzayo. Babethe imilenze yabo ngasemva, bengenakuphulaphula.
Wabaxolela iminyaka emininzi; Umphefumlo wakho wabaxelela ngesandla samaprofeti akho, kodwa abazange bacinge; ngoko ke wabayanikela ebantwaneni bezizwe zehlabathi.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yobubele bakho obuninzi, wawungabaphelisi ngokupheleleyo, wawungabashiya; unguThixo olungileyo, unamandla.

Namhlanje ke, Thixo wethu, wena uThixo omkhulu, onamandla, owamangalisayo, ogcina umnqophiso wakho, nobubele bakho; musa ukukhumbula ngokulula zonke iintlungu zethu, ezithunyelwe kuthi, kumakumkani bethu, nabathetheli bethu, nababingeleli bethu, nabaprofeti bethu, nabazalwana bethu, nabo bonke abantu bakho, ukususela kwimihla yamakumkani aseAshuri, kuze kube namhlanje.
Ulungile wena kuzo zonke izinto ezithunyelwe kuthi; uthembekile wena, thina ke sasenza okubi.
Abakumkani bethu, abathetheli bethu, oombingeleli bethu, nabazalwana bethu, bangawusebenzisi umthetho wakho; bangawaphulaphuli amalungelo akho, nemiyalelo yakho, nezilumkiso zakho.

Ke kaloku, ngexesha labo lokumkani kwabo, nangendlela yakho yonke elungileyo oya kubanika yona, nelizwe lakho elibanzi, elithambileyo, owalibeka phambi kwabo, abakundikhonzanga, besuka kwiindlela zabo ezibi.
Yabona, namhlanje siya kuba ngabakhonzi; kwilizwe olinika ooyise bethu, ukuba badla iziqhamo zalo nezinto zayo ezilungileyo, siya kuba ngabakhonzi.
Intyatyambo yayo eninzi ifika kumakumkani, owababeka phezu kwethu ngenxa yezono zethu; balawula ubomi bethu nezinto zethu eziphilayo ngokuthanda kwabo. Sikwingozi enkulu.
Ngenxa yoko konke oku, thina siya kwenza umyalelo oqinileyo, siwubhalela; abathetheli bethu, nabaLevi bethu, nababingeleli bethu, baya kutyhutyha.
Lowo mntu wabeka isityhilelo kumnqophiso: uNehemiya, umphathiswa, unyana kaHakaliya, noZedekiya;
uSeraya, noUzariya, noYeremiya,
uPashuri, noAmariya, noMalkiya,
uHatushe, noShebaniya, noMaluku,
uHarim, noMeremoth, noObhadiya,
uDaniyeli, noGinethon, noBharuki,
uMeshulam, noAbhiya, noMiyamini,
noMahaziya, noBhilgayi, noShemaya; aba ke ngababingeleli.
AbaLevi: uYeshua, unyana kaAzaniya, noBinui, oonyana bakaHenadade, noKadmiyeli,
nabahlobo babo abaLevi: uShebaniya, noHodiya, noKelitha, noPelaya, noHanan;
uMika, noRehobhi, noHashabiya,
uZakhuri, noSherebiya, noShebaniya,
noHodiya, noBani, noBeninu.
Bathi ke abathetheli babantu: uParoshe, noPahati-Mowabhi, noElam, noZathu, noBani,
noBuni, noAzgadi, noBebhayi,
uAdoniya, noBhigwayi, noAdin,
uAtere, noHezekiya, noAzure,
uHodiya, noHashum, noBezai,
iHarifi, neAnathothi, noNobhayi,
noMagpiyashe, noMeshulam, noHezire,
uMeshezabele, noTsadoki, noYaduya,
uPelatiya, noHanani, noAnaya,
uHosheya, noHananiya, noHashubhi,
uHaloheshi, noPilha, noShobheki,
uRehum, noHashabna, noMashehiya,
uAhiya, noHanani, noAnani,
noMaluku, noHarim, noBhaana.

Ke kaloku kwafika namanye amaYuda, oombingeleli, nabaLevi, nabakhuseli beengcango, nabangomani, nabakhonzi bakaThixo, bonke abo bathabathela ebantwini abaphakathi kwabo, ukuba benze umthetho kaThixo, nabafazi babo, noonyana babo, neentombi zabo, onke amadoda angaqondanga.

Badibana nabahlobo babo, namadoda amakhulu abo, bamisa umnqophiso wokuba baya kuhamba ngomthetho kaThixo, onikezelwe ngesandla sikaMoses, umkhonzi kaThixo; ukuba bagcine ngokungqongqo yonke imimiselo kaYehova uThixo wethu, nemimiselo yakhe, nemithetho yakhe.
Siyavuma ukuba asiyi kuzisa iintombi zethu kubafazi abaphakathi kwethu, nabantwana bethu bangabi namantombazana abo.

Ke kaloku, xa pertenceni zithe zafika izizwe ezingqongileyorint Politiki kwisabatha ukuthengiswa kwazo; asiyi kuthenga kubo ngeSabbathi nakweyiphi na imini engcwele. Ngomnyaka wesixhenxe siza kwenza ukuba isiqhamo singekho emzini wethu; siya kuzikhupha zonke iityala zethu.
Ke kaloku, sithathe isigqibo sokuba sinikezele unyaka ngamnye iingelosi ezilishumi elinambini zesilivere, ukulungiselela umsebenzi wendlu kaThixo wethu.

Oku kukutya okungcwele, nomnikelo wokudla oqhubekayo, nesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, nezipho zeentsuku zokuphumla, nezipho zeentsuku zonyaka omtsha, nezipho zeentsuku ezimiselweyo, nezipho ezingcwele, nezipho zesono, ukulungisa amaSirayeli phambi koThixo, nakwimisebenzi yonke yendlu kaThixo wethu.

Sinamabhinqa, nathi oombingeleli, nalabaLevi, nabantu, sabetha iziqhoboshi zethu, ukuze sibone ukuba iinkokheli zeentsapho nganye ziya kuzisa njani imithi endlwini kaThixo wethu ngonyaka ngamnye, ukuze ziqhume phezu kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uThixo wethu, njengoko kubhalwe emthethweni.
Siyavuma ukuba siza kuzisa endlwini kaYehova, ngonyaka ngamnye, into yokuqala yeentyatyambo zethu, nento yokuqala yotywala lomthi wonke.

ngokuba siza kuzisa oonyana bethu abazalwa kuqala, nabazalwa kuqala kwezilwanyana zethu, neenkomo zethu, neentyatyambo zethu, endlwini kaThixo wethu, kubabingeleli abasebenza khona, njengoko kuthe umthetho.

ukuba siza kuzithabatha izinto zokuqala zomgubo wethu, neentyatyambo zethu, neziqhamo zezityalo zethu zonke, newayini yethu entsha, neoli yethu yeoli, sizithumelele kubabingeleli, ezindlwini zendawo yokugcina yendlu kaThixo wethu; ukuba siza kuzithabatha ishumi lembewu yethu sizithumelele kumaLevi; ngokuba amaLevi athabathe ishumi elinanye kuwo onke amadolophu ethu emithi.
Kubekho unyana ka-Aron, umbingeleli, nabaLevi, xa befumana ishumi; babe neshumi elinesixhenxe abaLevi baya kuyingenisa endlwini kaThixo wethu, kwizindlu zokugcina iimpahla.

Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, nabaLevi, bangenise izipho zabo, ingqolowa, newayini entsha, neoli, kwizindlu zokugcina, apho zigcinwa khona izinto zendlu kaThixo, nalapho behlala khona ababingeleli abanomsebenzi wabo, nabagwebi, nabaculi; ukuze singayishiyanga indlu kaThixo wethu.
Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli bahlala eYerusalem; abanye ke bathabathela iinqununu, ukuba bahlala eYerusalem, emzini ongcwele, umntu ngamnye kusapho ngalunye olulishumi; abathoba ke bahlala emizi yabo.
Ke kaloku abantu babhiyozela amadoda onke asuka eYerusalem, aye kuhlala kuwo.

Ke kaloku, aba ke abo bathetheli belizwe labahlala eYerusalem; namanye amaSirayeli, nababingeleli, nabaLevi, nabaNethinimi, neentombi zabakhonzi bakaSolomon, babehlala emizini ka Metroni no subjektini yabo.
Bathi ke abanye abantu bakaYuda nakwaBhenjamin bahlala eYerusalem; kuYuda: nguAtayi unyana kaUziya, unyana kaZekariya, unyana kaAmariya, unyana kaShefatiya, unyana kaMahalaleli, oonyana bakaPerezi;
noMasiya unyana kaBharuki, unyana kaKol-hoze, unyana kaHazaya, unyana kaAdaya, unyana kaYoyaribhi, unyana kaZekariya, owamkelayo uShela.
Oonyana bakaPerezi abahlala eYerusalem babe ngamawaka amane anamashumi amathandathu anesibhozo amadoda anamandla.
KuBenjamin: uSalu unyana kaMeshulam, unyana kaYode, unyana kaPedaya, unyana kaKolaya, unyana kaMasheya, unyana kaIthiyeli, unyana kaYeshaya;
emva kwakhe uGabayi, noSalayi; bonke amadoda amawaka asithoba anamashumi mabini anesibhozo.
UYoweli unyana kaZikhri waba ngukumkani wabo; uYuda unyana kaHasenuayi waba ngumntu wesibini kumzi.
Ababingeleli: uYedaya unyana kaYoyaribhi, noYahini;
uSeraya unyana kaHilkihiya, unyana kaMeshulam, unyana kaTsadoko, unyana kaMerayothi, unyana kaAhitubhi, umphathi wendlu kaThixo;

nabazalwana babo ababingeleli, ababesenza umsebenzi endlwini kaThixo, babemakhulu asibhozo, amabini anamashumi mabini; noAdaya unyana kaYeroham, unyana kaPelali, unyana kaAmzi, unyana kaZekariya, unyana kaPashuri, unyana kaMalkiya;
nabazalwana bakhe, abathetheli beentsapho zabo, amadoda amakhulu amabini anamashumi mane anesibini; noAmashayi unyana kaAzareli, unyana kaAhzai, unyana kaMeshilemothi, unyana kaImere;
nabazalwana bakhe, abemi abanobuchule bokulwa, babelikhulu elinamanci mabini anamashumi asibhozo; uZabediyeli unyana kaHagedolim wayengumphathi wabo.
kwabaLevi: uShemaya unyana kaHashubhi, unyana kaAzrikam, unyana kaHashabiya, unyana kaBuni;
noShabhethai, noYozabadi, ababini kumadoda amakhulu amaLevi, ababelawula imisebenzi yangaphandle yendlu kaThixo;

noMathaniya unyana kaMika, unyana kaZabdi, unyana kaAsafe, owawulawula ukubonga nokuthandaza; noBakbukiya, owayeyinto yesithathu phakathi kwabazalwana bakhe; noAbda unyana kaShamua, unyana kaGalal, unyana kaJeduthun.
Ke kaloku bonke amaLevi edolophini engcwele babe ngamawaka amabini anamashumi asibhozo anesine.
Abagwebi: uAkubu, noTalmon, nabazalwana babo, abagwebi beengcango; babelikhulu elinamashumi asixhenxe anesibini.
Amanye amaSirayeli, nababingeleli, nabaLevi, bahlala kuwo onke amadolophu kaYuda, ngamnye ezweni lakhe leentsapho.
Ke kaloku abakhonzi bakaThixo bahlala emnqamlezweni weOfeli; uSiha noGishpa babe ngabaphathi babo.
Waba nguUzi unyana kaBani, unyana kaHashabhiya, unyana kaMathaniya, unyana kaMika, umphathi weeLevi eYerusalem; waba ngabantwana bakaAsafe, abe ngabaculi abalawula iinkonzo zendlu kaThixo.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wabeka umthetho malunga nabaculi; bafumana umnikelo othile mihla le.
UPetahiya unyana kaMeshezabele, oonyana bakaZera unyana kaYuda, waba ngumncedisi kukumkani kuwo onke amatyala amalunga nabantu.
Ngeedolophu nezixeko zazo, kwabakho abathile kuYuda abahlala eKiriyati-arba nakwiidolophu zayo, naseDiboni nakwiidolophu zayo, naseJekabseyeli nakwiidolophu zayo;
ngoYeshuya, noMolada, noBhethe-peleti,
eHazari-shuhali, naseBhereshebha nakwiidolophu zayo;
eSikelagi, naseMekona nakwiidolophu zayo;
eEn-rimmoni, neZora, neYarmuthi,
neZanoa, neAdulami, needolophu zazo, eLakishi neentaba zayo, nase-Azeka neentaba zayo. Bahlala ke besuka eBhereshebha, bafike emlanjeni kaHinom.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaBhenjamin, besuka eGibeha bahlala eMikmasi, naseAyiya, naseBheteli nakwiidolophu zayo;
eAnathothi, naseNobi, noAnaniya,
neHasoro, neRama, neGithayim,
uHadide, noTsebhoyim, noNebalati,
neLodi, neOno, eNtshona yeSixeko samaNgqina.
Ezweni likaBhenjamin kwahlala amaqela eLevi asuka eYudeya.
Ke kaloku, aba babingeleli nabaLevi ababuyayo noZerubabele unyana kaShealtiyeli, noYeshua; nguSeraya, noYeremiya, noEzra,
uAmariya, noMaluku, noHatushe,
uShekaniya, noRehum, noMeremoth,
uIdo, noGinetoyi, noAbiya,
uMiyamini, noMadiya, noBilha,
uShemaya, noYoyaribhi, noYedayayi,
USalu, noAmoki, noHilkihiya, noYedaya. Abo babengabaphathi ababingeleli, nabahlobo babo, ngemihla kaYeshuwa.
AbaLevi: uYeshua, noBinui, noKadmiyeli, noSherebiya, noYuda, noMatania. UMatania nabazalwana bakhe babe ngabaphathi beengoma zokubonga.
UBakbukiya noHuno, abazalwana babo, babemi ngaphesheya kwabo, besenza umsebenzi.
UYeshu wazala uYoyakim; uYoyakim wazala uEliyasibhi; uEliasibhi wazala uYoyadaya.
UYehoyada waba ngumzali kaYonatan, uYonatan waba ngumzali kaYaduya.
Ngosuku lukaYoyakim, kwaba ngababingeleli abakhulu beentsapho: kuSeraya, uMeraya; kuYeremiya, uHananiya;
ku-Ezra nguMeshulam; ku-Amariya nguYohanan;
kuMaluku uYonathan; kuShebaniya uYosefu;
kuHarim nguAdna; kuMerayothi nguHelekayi;
ku-Iddo nguZekariya; ku-Ginethon nguMeshulam;
kuAbhiya, uZikri; kuMinyamini noModiya, uPiltayi;
kuBhilga, nguShamua; kuShemaya, nguYonatan;
kuYoyaribhi uMatanayi; kuYedaya uUzi;
kuSalayi, uKalayi; kuAmoki, uHebhere;
kuHilkihiya, uHashabiya; kuYedaya, uNethaneli.
Kwiintsuku zikaEliyasibhi, noYehoyada, noYohanan, noYaduya, babhalwa abathetheli bezindlu zabafazi bakaLevi nababingeleli, ngexesha lokumkani uDariyosi wasePersiya.
Amadoda amakhulu eentsapho zakwaLevi abhalwe kwincwadi yamatyala, de kwafika imihla kaYohanan unyana kaEliyasibhi.

Abathetheli bakaLevi: uHashabhiya, noSherebiya, noYeshuwa unyana kaKadmiyeli. Abazalwana babo babekwa ngaphesheya kwabo, ukuba badlale nokubonga; iqela elinye liphendulane nelinye, ngokwemiyalelo kaDavide umntu kaThixo.
UMatania, noBakbukiya, noObhadiya, noMeshulam, noTalmon, noAkub, babe ngabakhuseli beengcango, bagcina iindawo zokugquma ezingcangeni.
Babesebenza ngemihla kaYoyakim, unyana kaYeshuwa, unyana kaYosadaki, nemihla kaNehemiya, umphathiswa, noEzra, umbingeleli ongumfundi.

Ke kaloku, xa ikhonkrithi yaseYerusalem isixhenxekileyo,alanjwe amaLevi kuwo onke amadolobha abo eYerusalem; bafika besenza isixhenxekelo ngothando nokuzinikela ngeengoma zesikhumbuzo, nama-cymbals, neengxowa zomnqamlezo, neziqhamo.
Ke kaloku badibana nabaculi abasuka emazantsi eYerusalem, nakwiidolophu zabaseNetofati;
basuka eBhete-gilgali, nakwindawo yaseGibeha neyeAzmavethi. Bathi ke oongomakazi babebalungiselela iintaba ezijikeleze iYerusalem.
Ke kaloku ababingeleli nabaLevi bahlamba, bahlamba abantu, neengcango, nedonga.

Kwathi ke, ndabakhupha abathetheli bakaYuda phezulu emngxunyeni wodonga; ndakhetha amaqela amabini amakhulu avakalisayo, ukuba ahambe ecaleni kodonga; amaqela amabini amakhulu aye ngasekunene kwesango leentyatyambo.
UHoshaya, naphezu kwabo bonke abathetheli baseYuda;
noAzariya, noEzra, noMeshulamu,
uYuda, noBhenjamin, noShemaya, noYeremiya.
Balandela ke abanye ababingeleli, benezithunywa; noZekariya unyana kaYonatan, unyana kaShemaya, unyana kaMatania, unyana kaMika, unyana kaZakhuri, unyana kaAsaphe;
nabazalwana bakhe, uShemaya, noAzareli, noMilalayi, noGilalayi, noMahayi, noNethaneli, noYuda, noHanani; badlala ngezixhobo zomculo zikaDavide, indoda kaThixo. UEzra umfundi waba yinxalenye yabo.
Baye benyuka ngeenyawo zesixeko sikaDavide, bengapha kwengcango yempucuko yodonga, ngasentla kwendlu kaDavide, bafike emnyango wamanzi osuka emazantsi.
Ke kaloku iqela lesibini lahamba icala elinye, ngasekhohlo; mna ke ndaya ngasemva kwabo phezulu kwedonga, namnye nephenyane laba bantu; sadlula eTowers of the Furnaces, safika kudonga olubanzi.
sadlula ngesango likaEfrayim, nesango elidala, nesango leentlanzi, nombhoxo kaHananile, nombhoxo wamawaka, safika kwisango leengulube; sahlala emngxunyeni womgcini.
Ke kaloku amaqela onke amabini avakalisayo, aye endlwini kaThixo; ndathi ke ke mna naphezu kwabathetheli,
nababingeleli, uEliyakim, noMahasheya, noMinyamini, noMika, noEliyenai, noZekariya, noHananiya, benezithunywa zabo;
noMasheya, noShemaya, noEleazar, noUzi, noYohanan, noMalkiya, noElam, noEzer; abangomakazi bevuma ngelizwi elikhulu, ekho uYezrahiya.
Ke kaloku banikela izibingelelo ezininzi ngaloo mini, babhiyozela; ngokuba uThixo wabanika uthando olukhulu. Babhiyozela namadoda nabantwana; ilizwi lothando eYerusalem laza livakala kude.

Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini, kwakhethwa abantu ukuba babe ngabaphathi beendawo zokugcina izinto ezinikezelweyo, nezokuqala zeentyatyambo, nezilishumi elinambini, ukuze bathabathe ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ezijikeleze imimandla yamadolophu, bazifake kwiindawo zokugcina izinto, inxalenye yomthetho yababingeleli nabaLevi. Abantu bakaYuda bayavuya ngenxa yabo bonke ababingeleli nabaLevi ababekhonza.
Baya kwenza umsebenzi kaThixo wabo, nomsebenzi wokuhlamba, nabani na oimbaleki, nabani na ongumphathi wesango, ngokwemiyalelo kaDavide noSolomon unyana wakhe.
Kwabakho ngonaphakade, kwimihla kaDavide noAsafi, abathetheli beingoma, nezingoma zokuzinikela nokubonga kuThixo.

Ke kaloku, ngemihla kaZerubabele noNehemiya, bonke amaSirayeli babenika oongomakazi nabahleli beengcango iinkalo zabo zemihla ngemihla; babeka nento nganye yabaLevi; abaLevi ke babeka nento nganye yababingeleli, oonyana bakaAron.
Ke kaloku ngaloo mini bafunda incwadi kaMoses emlonyeni wabantu; bafumanisa kulo ibhalwe into yokuba uAmmon, noMowabhi, angangeni kwibandla likaThixo ngonaphakade,
ngokuba abazange bahlangane nabaSirayeli ngesonka, namanzi; ke kaloku bahlawulisa uBhileham ukuba ababhengeze; kodwa uThixo wethu wayiguqula loo mbhengezo ibe sisipho.
Ke kaloku, xa abantu beva lo mthetho, bahlula bonke abasemazweni aphezu kwaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku, phambi kwayo yonke loo nto, uEliyashabhi, umbingeleli, waba ngumphathi weendawo zokugcina zendlu kaThixo wethu; wayengumhlobo kaTobiya.

Wamnika ke uTobiya igumbi elikhulu; eli gumbi lasetyenziswa ukugcinwa kweempawu zesonka, nefuthe, neempahla zetempeli, nezishumi zesonka, newayini, neoli yeoli, ezichaziweyo ngumthetho ukuba ziyizinto zabaLevi, nabaculi, nabakhuseli beengcango, kunye nomnikelo wamadini.

Ke kaloku, xa ezi zinto zonke zazithethwa, mna andizange ndibe eYerusalem; kuba ngomnyaka weshumi elinambini nemashumi mathathu ka-Artaxerxesi ukumkani waseBhabheli, ndabuya kwam ukumkani; kwathi emva kweentsuku ezimbalwa, ndacela ukumkani ukuba ndiya.
Ndabuya ke eYerusalem, ndafumanisa ukuba uEliyasibhi wenza ntoni na embi ngenxa kaTobiya, ngokuba wamnika indawo endlwini yendlu kaThixo.
Kwathi ke, xa ndaba buhlungu kakhulu, ndazikhupha zonke izinto zikaTobiya ezingaphandle kwegumbi.
Ndathi ke, zicocwe izindlu; ndazibeka kwakhona izinto zetempeli kaThixo, kunye nesonka somnikelo wesono, nefuthe.
Ke kaloku ndafumanisa ukuba abaLevi abaye banikezelwa inxalenye yabo; ngoko ke abaLevi nabaculi abasenza umsebenzi, bonke baye ezindleleni zabo.
Ke kaloku, ndathi kumadoda amakhulu, ndithi kubo, Yintoni na loo nto indlu kaThixo ilahliwe ngayo? Ndawabiza ke amaLevi, ndababuyisela emisebenzini yabo.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bakaYuda bazisa ishumi labo lengqolowa, newayini entsha, neoli, emagumbini okugcina.

Ke kaloku ndamisa uShelemiya ukumkani, noTsadoki umfundi, nomLevi okuthiwa nguPedaya, ukuba abe ngabaphathi beendawo zokugcina; noHanan unyana kaZakhuri, unyana kaMatania, waba ngumncedisi wabo; aba bantu ke bayaziwa ngokuba bathembekileyo, babe nemisebenzi yokwahlula iziqendu kusapho lwabo.
UThixo wam, khumbula mna ngenxa yaloo nto; musa ukucima izinto ezilungileyo endizenzayo ngokuthembekileyo endlwini kaThixo wam, nemisebenzi yam.

Ngaloo mihla ndabona eYuda abantu betshisa iziqhamo ngesabatha; abanye ke bezisa iinkomo zengqolowa, bezifaka ezibhokhweni, newayini, neziqhamo, nezithixo, nazo zonke iintlobo zezithuthi; babezibeka eYerusalem ngesabatha. Ndathi ke kubo, Musani ukuthengisa ukudla ngaloo mini.
Ke kaloku kwabakho namadoda aseTyre, ahlala eYerusalem, azisa iintlanzi, nezinto zonke ezithengiswayo, ayezithengisa ngeSabhati kumaYuda eYerusalem.
Ke kaloku, ndize ndathi kumadoda amakhulu eYuda, ndisithi kubo, Yintoni le nto inobubi niyenzayo, ukuba niyenze imini yesikhumbuzo ibe njengemihla enye?

UThixo wethu akazange ayenze loo nto na kumaSirayeli? Ke ngoko, uThixo wethu wazisa zonke ezi zinto zibuhlungu kuthi naselu dolophini; ke nina nizidibanise inkanuko yakhe ebantwini bakaSirayeli, ningayilungisanga iSabbathi.

Ke kaloku, xa izithunzi zemini zaqala ukuwa phezu kweengcango zaseYerusalem, phambi kosuku lokuphumla, ndathi zivalwe izivalo, zingavunywanga de kube liphelile usuku lokuphumla; ndabeka amadoda am ngasezingcebeni, ukuze akukho mthwalo oza kungena ngaloo mini yokuphumla.
Ke kaloku abarhwebi, nabathengisa zonke iintlobo zezinto ezithengwayo, bahlala busuku bonke ngaphandle kweYerusalem, kathathu nakwesibini.
Ke kaloku ndathi kubo, Yintoni na le nto nihlalani ecaleni kwedonga? Ukuba niza kuphinda niyenze loo nto, mna ndiya kukuxhaphaza. Basuka ngoko ke, bangafikanga ngeSabatha.

Kwathi ke, nda pertencela amaLevi ukuba ahlanzeke, bafike babelipe Politiki kumasango, ukubeka imini yeSabbath engcwele. Ke kaloku, Thixo wam, undixelele ngaloo nto, ndimthande ngenxa yobubele bakho obukhulu.
Ke kaloku, ngazo ezo mihla ndabona amadoda amaYuda athathe abafazi baseAshdodi, naseAmmon, naseMowabi.
Ke kaloku isiqingatha sabantwana babo sathetha ulwimi lweAshdodi, okanye ulwimi lwabanye abantu; abazange bakwazi ukuthetha ulwimi lukaYuda.

Ndabaxolela, ndababhaptiza; ndababetha abanye kubo, ndabasusa iinwele zabo; ndabamisa ngegama likaThixo, ndithi, Musani ukunika oonyana benu iintombi zenu, ningazithatheli oonyana benu okanye nina abantwana babo.

USolomon, ukumkani wakwaSirayeli, akazange aphelelwe lithemba ngale nto? Kuzo zonke iintlanga kwakukho ukumkani ongafana naye; uThixo wakhe wamthanda, wammisa waba ngukumkani kumaSirayeli onke. Ke kaloku yena waphelelwa lithemba ngabafazi abangaphandle.
Siza kukuphulaphulani na, siyenze loo nto inobubi obukhulu? Siza kwenza ubuxoki kuThixo wethu, sithathe amadoda angaphandle?
Ke kaloku omnye oonyana bakaYoyadi, unyana kaEliyasibhi, umbingeleli omkhulu, waba ngunyana womyeni kaSanbalati waseHoroni; ke ndawukhupha kum.
Khumbula kubo, Thixo wam, ngokuba bahlambalaza ububingeleli, bephula umnqophiso wababingeleli nabaseLevi.
Ndawasusa ke oombingeleli nabaLevi kuzo zonke izinto ezingaphandle, ndabanika imisebenzi yabo, ngamnye umsebenzi wakhe.
Ke kaloku, ndalungiselela imithi ukuba inikezwe kwixesha elimiselweyo, nakwizinto zokuqala zeentyatyambo. Khumbula kum, Thixo wam, ngothando.
Esth: Ezi zinto zakwenzeka ngemihla yokumkani u-Axerxes, obizwa ngokuba ngu-Ashur-esh-uras; waba ngukumkani kumaphondo amakhulu amabini anamashumi asixhenxe anesixhenxe, esuka eIndiya waya eEthiopi.
Ke kaloku, uKumkani u-Axerxes wayelawula ubukumkani bakhe, esuka kwisitulo sakhe sokumkani, eSusa, isixeko esikhuselekileyo.
Ngomnyaka wesithathu wokumkani wakhe, wenza isidlo esikhulu kubo bonke abathetheli bakhe, nabakhonzi bakhe; babekhona naye oonyana bakaPersiya nabaMediya, namadoda amakhulu, nabaphathi bezizwe.
Wabonisa iintsuku ezininzi, imihla emakhulu asibhozo, ubutyebi obukhulu bobukumkani bakhe, nobuhle nobukhulu begunya lakhe lobukumkani.
Ke kaloku, zigqityiwe ezo mihla, ukumkani wenza isidlo seentsuku ezisixhenxe kubo bonke abantu baseShushan, idolophu ekhuselweyo, kumkhulu nakumncinane, kwisitrato somthi wendlu kakumkani.

Kwabakho izitezi ezimhlophe, nezibomvu, ezidityanisiweyo ngemisonto yelinen emnyama, neyombala ongwevu, ezibekwe kwiziqhoboshi zesilivere ezinxibe iithayile zemarble; kwabakho neebhedi zegolide nezesilivere phezu komgangatho wemarble oluhlaza, nomhlophe, nomthubi, nomoya.
Iintyatyambo zathiwa ngeebhotile zegolide, ibhotile nganye yahlukile kwintyatyambo enye; newayini yokumkani yayininzi kakhulu; ngokuba ukumkani wayenobundlobongela.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wabeka umthetho, ukuba akukho namnye omele usele iwayini. Ukumkani wathi kubo bonke abakhonzi bakhe endlwini yakhe, ukuba banikezele kumntu ngamnye oko afunayo.
Ke kaloku uVasti, umkumkani, wenza isidlo sabafazi endlwini yobukhosi kaKumkani uAshereyesi.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe, xa ukumkani ephelelwe ngumphefumlo ngenxa yewayini, wayalela oonyana bakakumkani abalishumi elinambini abakhonzayo, uMehumani, noBiztha, noHarbona, noBigtha, noAbagta, noZethari, noKarkashe.
Wathi ukuba bafike kuye uVasti, ukumkani, egqoke isithsaba sakhe sokumkani, ukuze abonakalise ubuhle bakhe phambi kwamadoda amakhulu; ngokuba wayehle kakhulu.
Ke kaloku uVasti, ukumkani, akazange afike; ke kaloku ukumkani waxoka kakhulu, inkanuko yakhe yaphuma ngaphakathi kwakhe.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathetha nabantu abanolwazi, abayaziyo imihla; ngokuba kwakusoloko kukumkani ukuba abuze abantu abanolwazi ngemithetho nezomthetho.

Ke kaloku amadoda afana naye: uKarshena, noShethari, noAdmatha, noTarishishi, noMeresi, noMarsena, noMemukani, abathetheli besixhenxe basePersiya naseMediya; bona basuka bebona ukumkani ngaso nasiphi na isikhathi, babe phezulu emkhosini.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi, Lithini na umthetho othi kufuneka kwenziwe kumkanikazi uVasti? Uthe akawusebenzisi umyalelo kakumkani uAhasheresi, awawuthunyelwe ngamagqwetha.

Waphendula ke uMemukan phambi kokumkani nabathetheli, wathi, UVasti ukumkanikazi akabi ngumntu okhohlakeleyo kukumkani kuphela; waba nento elungileyo kubo bonke abathetheli, nakwabawo onke amazwe kakumkani uAzariya.
Ke kaloku amadoda onke ayazi into eyenziwe ngukumkani, azothi kumadoda abo: Ukumkani u-Ahashe watsho ukuba afike kumkanikazi uVasti; ke yena akazange afike.

Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini, abafazi abakhulu basePersiya nabaseMediya, abo bayaziyo into eyenziwe ngukumkani, baya kuthetha ngokufanayo kubo bonke abathetheli bakakumkani; ngoko ke, kuya kubakho ukuxhaphaza noxinzelelo olungapheliyo.

Ukuba kulungile kukumkani, aphume umyalelo wokumkani, abhalwe phakathi kwemithetho yamaPersiya namaMediya, ukuba angatshintshwanga; ukuba uVasti angaphinde afike phambi kokumkani uArtakserkses. Ukumkani ke amnike ubukumkani bakhe omnye umntu ongcono kuye.
Ke kaloku, xa isigqibo sikakumkani siza kwaziswa kulo lonke ubukumkani bakhe obukhulu, amadoda onke azowakhathalela amadoda abo, esuka kumkhulu kuye kuncinci.
Le nto yathandeka kukumkani, nakubaphathi bakhe; ukumkani ke wenza ngokwelizwi likaMemukani.

Wathumela iileta kuzo zonke izixeko zokumkani wakhe, kwisixeko ngasinye ngokubhaliweyo saso, kuhlanga ngalunye ngolwimi lwaso; ukuba umntu ngamnye abe ngukumkani endlwini yakhe, athethe ngolwimi lwaso abantu bakhe.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, xa umkhosi ka-Ahashe waphumla inkanuko yakhe, wakhumbula uVasti, nento awayeyenzayo, nento eyayithethwa ngaye.
Bathi ke abakhonzi bakakumkani, Kufunyanwe kukumkani amabhinqa amancinci athandekayo, angatshatanga.

Nathi ukumkani akhethe abaphathi ezweni ngalinye lobukumkani bakhe, ukuba bathabathe zonke ezi ntombazana zintle, zibe zizise kwindlu yamabhinqa eShushan, isixeko esikhuselekileyo; nathi babekwe phantsi kolawulo lukaHegayi, umkhonzi kakumkani, olawula amadodana amabhinqa; nathi banikezelwe ubuhle.
Ke kaloku umfazi omncinci oza kuyonwabela ukumkani, abe ngukumkani endaweni kaVasti. Wathandazela ukumkani lo mthetho, wawenza.
Ke kaloku, kwakukho mntu omnye waseYiputa eShushan, isixeko esikhuselekileyo, igama lakhe lalinguMordekayi, unyana kaYaire, unyana kaShimehi, unyana kaKishi, wesizwe sikaBhenjamin.
Ke kaloku wayesele ethunyelwe eYerusalem, yena noYekoniya ukumkani wakwaYuda, xa uNebhukadenezare ukumkani waseBhabheli ebewathatha.

Ke kaloku uMordekayi wamzala uHadasha, umyeni wakhe, owaziwa ngokuba nguEstere; kuba wayengenayise nanina. Lo mntwana waba mkhulu ngobuso bakhe, wabukeka kakuhle. Wafa ke utata wakhe nomama wakhe, uMordekayi wamthatha ukuba abe ngunyana wakhe.

Ke kaloku, xa imiyalelo yokumkani yaphuma, kwathiwa amabhinqa amancinci amaninzi aye eShushan, isixeko esikhuselekileyo, abekwe phantsi kolawulo lukaHegayi; kwathiwa ke noEstere wathathwa waya endlwini kakumkani, abekwa phantsi kolawulo lukaHegayi, owayengumphathi wamabhinqa.

Wathanda uEstere uHegayi, waza wamthandela; wakhawuleza wamnika iinwele zakhe, nesonka sakhe esikhethekileyo; wamnika amabhinqa amabini asele endlwini kakumkani; wamfaka yena namabhinqa amabini endlu yamabhinqa, kwindawo elungileyo.
Ke kaloku uEstere akazange amxelele mntu nabani na abantu bakhe, nosapho lwakhe; ngokuba uMordekayi wamwisela umthetho ukuba angamxelela.
Ke kaloku uMordekayi wayehamba mihla le, esuka esiya ecaleni kwendlu yabasetyhini, ukuze afunde ukuba uEstere ungubani, nokuba kwenzekani kuye.

Ke kaloku, phambi kokuba kufike ixesha lomfazi omncinci ukuba ahambe kuye ukumkani uXeshazare, wayemele agqibe iintsuku ezilishumi elinambini zokuzilungisa: iintsuku ezintandathu ngeoyile ye-mirre, iintsuku ezine ngeziqhamo nezithambiso zabafazi.
Ke kaloku, xa ibhinqa elincinci lifika kukumkani, linqunyulwa nantoni na efuna ukuyithabatha nayo ukusuka kwindlu yamabhinqa iye endlwini kakumkani.

Waza waya kukumkani ngemini, wabuyela emveni kwemini endlwini yesibini yamabhinqa, phantsi kolawulo lukaShaashgaz, umphathi wendlu kakumkani, olawula amadodana amaninzi kakumkani. Akazange aphinde afike kukumkani, ukuba angathandabuzi kuye, aze abizwa ngegama lakhe.

UEstere wayeyintombi ka-Abhihayeli, umyeni kaMordekayi; uMordekayi wamthabatha waba ngunyana wakhe. Ke kaloku, xa kwafika ixesha lakhe lokungena kukumkani, wacela into ethethwa nguHegayi, umphathi wokumkani, olawula amadoda; bonke ababonayo uEstere bayamthanda.
Wathabatha ke uEstere kukumkani uAhashe, endlwini yakhe yobukhosi, ngenyanga yeshumi, leyo yinyanga kaTebhethi, ngomnyaka wesixhenxe wokumkani wakhe.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wamthanda uEstere ngaphezu kwamadoda onke; wathandeka kuye, wafumana inceba kuye ngaphezu kwamadoda amancinci onke. Wabeka isithsaba sokumkani emlonyeni wakhe, wamenza ukumkani endaweni kaVasti.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wenza umthendeleko omkhulu kubo bonke abaphathi bakhe, nabakhonzi bakhe; waba ngumthendeleko ka-Estere; wabhengeza imini yokuphumla kuwo onke amaphondo, waza wanikela izipho ezininzi, njengokuba ukumkani ekwaziyo.
Ke kaloku, xa izibhinqa ezimncinci zafunyanwa ngesibini, uMordekayi wayehlala emnyango wokumkani.
Ke kaloku uEstere akazange amxelele mntu nantoni na intsapho yakhe, nabantu bakhe, njengokuba wayemxelela uMordekayi. UEstere wamthobela uMordekayi, njengokuba wayemthobela xa wayemqeqesha.
Ngaloo mihla, xa uMordekayi ehlala emngxunyeni wokumkani, abaphathi ababini bokumkani, abakhuselayo umngxunya, uBhigatani noTereshe, baphoxeka, bafuna ukumkani uAzariya ukuwufa.
Wazi ke uMordekayi loo nto, wamxelela uEstere ukumkani. Wamxelela uEstere ukumkani, wathi, UMordekayi wayazi loo nto.
Yafunyanwa ke loo nto, yaba yinyaniso. Bathi ke abo bathetheli ababini batshitshiswe emnqamlezweni; zabhalwa zonke ezi zinto kwincwadi yamatyala phambi kokumkani.
Emva kwazo zonke ezi zinto, ukumkani uAhashe wanyusa uHaman, unyana kaHammedatha, umAgagi; wambeka ephakameni phezu kwabaphathi bonke.
Ke kaloku bonke abaphathi bakakumkani, ababekwisango likakumkani, baphumla, bamnikela uHaman; ngokuba ukumkani wabawisela umthetho loo nto. Ke kaloku uMordekayi akaphumli, akawunikela.
Bathi abakhonzi bakakumkani emnyango kuMordekayi, Yintoni leyo oyiphulayo umthetho kakumkani?
Bathi kuye mihla ngemihla, kodwa akawuva; ke kaloku baxela loo nto kuHaman, ukuba babone ukuba ilizwi likaMordekayi liza kuthotywa na; ngokuba wabaxelela ukuba yena nguYuda.
Ke kaloku, xa uHaman ebona ukuba uMordekayi akawuhlambululi umlenze wakhe, akazange amhlonele, waxhaphaza.

Ke kaloku, akazange agwebe uMordekayi kuphela; kuba kwathiwa kuye ukuba ngubani na abantu bakaMordekayi. Wafuna ke uHaman ukucima bonke abantu bakaMordekayi, ooYuda, kubo bonke ubukumkani buka-Ahashe.

Ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga, lowo ngunyaka kaNisan, ngomnyaka weshumi elinesibini wokumkani uAzariya, batyhila iPuri, oko kukuthi, umjikelo, phambi kukaHaman, ukuba bakhethe usuku nenyanga; umjikelo waphuma ngomhla wenyanga yeshumi elinesibini, lowo ngunyaka kaAdare.

Wathi ke uHaman kukumkani uAzariya, Kukhona abantu abatshabalaliseka phakathi kwezizwe kuzo zonke iidolophu zobukumkani bakho; imithetho yabo ayifani nayo yonke imimiselo yobukumkani; akufanelekanga ukumkani ukuba abonise ukuba baphile.

Ukuba kulungile phambi kokumkani, abhaleke umthetho ukuba bakhululwe; mna ke ndiya kuzihlawula izihlandlo ezilishumi elinambini zeetoni zesilivere abaphathi bemisebenzi yokumkani, ukuze bazifake kwindlu yenkcubeko yomkani.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wamsusa umsesane wakhe wesitshixo emlonyeni wakhe, wamnika uHaman, unyana kaHammedatha, umAgagi, umkhonzi wamaYuda.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi kuHaman, Imali ihlale kuwe; wenze kubo bonke abantu njengoko unqwenela.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe wesithathu wenyanga yokuqala, babizwa ababhali bakakumkani; babhalela oovimba bakakumkani, nabaphathi belizwe ngalinye, nabathetheli bezizwe ngalinye, konke oko uHaman abemxelela ngawo, babhalela ilizwe ngalinye ngokubhalwa kwayo, nelizwe ngalinye ngolwimi lwayo; babhala ngegama likakumkani uAzariya, batshixisa ngomsesane kakumkani.

Abathunywa bathabathela iileta kuzo zonke iidolophu zikakumkani, ukuba baphule, babulala, baphelise bonke amaYuda, abancinci nabakhulu, abantwana nabafazi, ngosuku olunye, ngomhla weshumi elinesibhozo wenyanga yeshumi elinambini, leyo yinyanga ka-Adare, ukuba bathathe yonke into yabo.
Ikopi yalo myalelo, ukuba ibe ngumthetho ezweni ngalinye, iboniswe kuzo zonke iintlanga, ukuze zilungiselele loomini.

Ke kaloku, ngenxa yemiyalelo yokumkani, abathunywa bakhawuleza bephuma; kwathi ke, igunya lafunyanwa eShushan, isixeko esikhuselweyo. Ukumkani noHaman bahlala besela; kodwa iShushan, isixeko, saphazamiseka, sakhathaza.
Ke kaloku, xa uMordekayi eyazi zonke izinto ezithe zenziwe, waluka iimpahla zakhe, wagqoka isande, wafihla isisu sakhe; waphuma waya elunxwemeni lwesixeko, ethandaza ngelizwi elikhulu, ethandazela.
Waza wafika emnyango wokumkani; kuba akukho namnye omele afike kulo, egqoke iimpahla ezingwevu.
Ke kaloku, kuwo onke amaphondo, apho imiyalelo yokumkani yafika khona, kwabakho uxolo olukhulu phakathi kwaBayuda; babhiyozela, bekhalaza, bezingela; abaninzi babo babeka izihlangu ezingwevu nethusi.

Bafika oonyana baka-Estere, namagqwetha akhe, bamxelela ngoMordekayi. Ukumkani wakhathazeka kakhulu; wamthumelela uMordekayi izihlangu ukuba azigqoke endaweni yesigqubuthelo sakhe segolide; yena ke akazange azithathe.
Ke kaloku uEstere wambiza uHathaki, omnye wabakhonzi bakakumkani, awayemmisela ukumkani ukuba amncedise; wathi kuye ukuba afike kuMordekayi, aze afunde ukuba yintoni loo nto, nokuba kutheni.
Waphuma ke uHathaki kuye uMordekayi, ecaleni lomhlaba womzi, phambi kwesango lomkani.
Ke kaloku uMordekayi wamxelela zonke izinto ezithe zathiwa; wamxelela nenani lemali, awayethetha ngayo uHaman ukuba uya kuyinikela kwindlu yolawulo lukakumkani, ukuba abulala amaYuda.

Ke kaloku wamnika ikopi yemiyalelo yokubulala amaYuda, eyabhalwa eShushan, ukuba ayibonise kuEstere, ayenze ithixo kuye; wathi ke kuHathaki, ukuba amxelele ukuba ahambe kumkani, afune uxolo kuye, alumke kuye ngenxa yabantu bakhe.
Wabuyela uHathaki, waxela uEstere amazwi kaMordekayi.
Wathi ke uEstere kuHathaki, ukuba abhalela uMordekayi, esithi,

Bonke abathetheli bakakumkani, namadoda asezidolophini zikakumkani, bayazi loo mthetho, ukuba wonke umntu, indoda nawesifazane, othi afike kukumkani endlwini yangaphakathi, engachazwanga, kufuneka afumane ukubulala; ngaphandle kokuba ukumkani athabathe isikhephe sakhe segolide, aze amnike umphefumlo wakhe. Ke mna andikhange ndichazwe ukuba ndiya kukumkani iintsuku ezimashumi mathathu.
Bathi ke kubo uMordekayi amazwi kaEstere.
Waphendula ke uMordekayi uEstere, esithi, Musa ukucinga ukuba, ngenxa yokuba ukwindlu kakumkani, uya kukhuseleka xa bonke abaYuda bebulawa.

Ukuba ke wena uya kunyamalala kuloo xesha, uncedo nokhuselo lwabaYuda luza kuvela kwelinye ilizwe; kodwa wena nendlu yoyise uza kufa; ngubani na owaziyo? Mhlawumbi ngenxa yexesha elifana nale, ukhe waba ngukumkani.
Waphendula ke uEstere uMordekayi, esithi,

Yathi, Yiya, uhlanganise bonke abaYuda eSusa; zinikele isonka kum. Musani ukutya nakuphi na okuselayo iintsuku ezintathu, busuku nobusuku; mna namabhinqa am amancinci ndizike isonka; ke ngoko ndiza kungena kukumkani, nokuba kuyingozi loo nto; ukuba ndifa, ndife.
Waya ke uMordekayi, wenza konke oko uEstere wamxelela wona.

Ngomhla wesithathu, uEstere wagqoka iingubo zakhe zokumkani, waya endlwini yangaphakathi yendlu kakumkani, phambi kwegumbi likakumkani; ukumkani ke wayehlala kwisitulo sakhe sokumkani, ngaphakathi kwegumbi, phambi kokungena.
Ke kaloku ukumkani ebona uEstere, umkumkani, ehleli enkundleni, wathandazela kuye; wamisa kuye isikhephe segolide esisesandlani sakhe. Wafika ke uEstere, watshisa isiphelo sesikhephe.
Wathi ukumkani kuye, Yintoni loo nto, uEstere umkumkani? Yintoni loo nto oyifunayo? Ndiya kukunika, nakuba ibe yinxalenye yobukhosi bam.
Waphendula uEstere, wathi, Ukuba kulungile kukumkani, makafike ukumkani noHaman namhlanje emdlalweni endiwulungiselela kumkani.
Wathi ukumkani, Nciphisani uHaman, ukuze siyenze into asithiyo uEstere. Waye ke ukumkani noHaman kwisonka esilungiselelwe nguEstere;
Ke kaloku, ngelixa besela iwayini, ukumkani waphinda wathi ku-Esther, Yintoni na into oyifunayo? Iza kukunikezelwa. Yintoni na into oyicelayo? Nakuba ibe sisiqingatha sokumkani wam, iya kwenziwa;
Waphendula uEstere, wathi, Le nto ndiyifunayo, le nto ndiyicelayo.

Ukuba ukumkani unemithandazo kum, ukuba kulungile kukumkani ukuba amnike isibingelelo sam, akwenze umnqweno wam, ngoko ke mna nokumkani noHaman siza kusasa kwintlanganiso endiza kubalungiselela yona; emva koko ndiya kuphendula imibuzo yokumkani.

Ke kaloku uHaman waphuma ngaloo mini, ethandekayo, enengqondo elungileyo. Ke kaloku xa ebona uMordekayi emnyango wokumkani, ukuba uMordekayi akavukanga, akazange amxolele; ke ngoko uHaman waba mkhulule uMordekayi.
Ke kaloku uHaman wagwetywa, waya endlwini yakhe; wababiza bonke abahlobo bakhe, noZereshe indoda yakhe.

Ke kaloku uHaman wabaxelela ubutyebi bakhe, nabantwana bakhe abaninzi; wabaxelela yonke into awayeyamnika yona ukumkani ukuba abe ngudumo, nokuba wayekhululwe ngaphezu kwabanye oonyana bakakumkani nabakhonzi bakhe.
Wathi ke uHaman, Akukho nanye loo nto; uEstere umkumkani akazange amkele mntu ngaphandle kwam, ukuba abe nokumkani emlonyeni wakhe; naye wamkele mna kusasa nokumkani.
Ke kaloku zonke ezi zinto andivumeli ukuba ndiphumle, ndeva uMordekayi lowo umYuda ehlala emnyango wokumkani.

Wathi ke kuye uZereshe, indoda yakhe, nabahlobo bakhe bonke, Yenza intambo ephakamileyo, ibe ziimitha ezilishumi elinambini ubude bayo; kusasa utsho kukumkani ukuba umkhonze khona uMordekayi; uye ke nokumkani emlonyeni, ube nomsindo. Yathanda loo nto uHaman, wamisa intambo.
Ke kaloku, ngobusuku obulo, ukumkani akakwazi ukuphumla; wathi ke ukuba bafike bafunde phambi kwakhe incwadi yobomi.
Kwafunyanwa khona okubhaliweyo, ukuba uMordekayi wenza ntoni na ngoBhagtana noTereshi, ababini abaphathi bakakumkani, abakhuselayo isango, abathe bafuna ukumkani uAzariya.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi, Yintoni na inkolo nomvuzo ofunyenwe nguMordekayi ngenxa yaloo nto? Baphendula abakhonzi bakakumkani ababekhona naye, Besithi, Akukho nto eyenziwe kuye.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wathi, Nguwuphi umntu okwindlu yangasese? UHaman wayesele efike kwindlu yangasese yangaphandle yendlu kakumkani, ukuba athethe nokumkani, ukuba umkhonze uMordekayi emnqamlezweni awayemlungiselela.
Abakhonzi bakakumkani bamxelela, besithi, Fumana uHaman ehlala emveni. Wathi ukumkani, Afike.

Wafika ke uHaman, ukumkani wathi kuye, Kufuneka kwenziwe ntoni kumntu onqwenela ukumkani ukuwuhlonipha? Wathi uHaman engqondweni yakhe, Nguwuphi na umntu onqwenela ukumkani ukuwuhlonipha, ngaphandle kwam?
Waphendula ke yena ukumkani, wathi, Kuba umntu onqwenela ukumkani ukuwunikela,
bathabathe iingubo zokumkani, awazigqokayo ukumkani, nehashe, alihambayo ukumkani, ibe phantsi kwayo intyatyambo yomkani.

La mavazi namahashe anikezelwe komnye wabaphathi abakhulu bakakumkani, aze amgqobe umfazi onqwenela ukumkani ukuwuhlonipha, amqhubele phezu kwesikhephe ecaleni kwendlela yomzi, azise phambi kwakhe, athi, Kunjalo oko kwenziwa kumntu onqwenela ukumkani ukuwukhonza.
Wathi ukumkani kuHaman, Yiya ngokukhawuleza, uthathe ibhanti ne horse, njengoko uthiyo, wenze njalo kuMordecai, umYuda, ohlala emnyango wokumkani; ungabikho nantoni na oyitshoyo.
Wathi ke uHaman, wathabatha ibhanti, ne horse, wagqoka uMordecai, wamqhuba phezu kwee Horses, waya endlwini yomzi, ebiza phambi kwakhe, esithi, Kunjalo kwenziwa kumntu onqwenela ukumkani ukuwunikela.
Ke kaloku uMordekayi wabuyela emnyango wokumkani; uHaman ke wakhawuleza waya endlwini yakhe, ehloniphekileyo, egubungela intloko yakhe ngenkanuko.

Ke kaloku uHaman wamxelela uZereshi, indoda yakhe, nabahlobo bakhe bonke, zonke izinto eziye zaphazamisa. Bathi kuye abacebisi bakhe abanobulumko, noZereshi, indoda yakhe: Uqale ukufa phambi kukaMordekayi; kuba unguYuda, awukwazi ukuphumelela kuye; uya kupheliswa ngokuqinisekileyo.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa besoloko bethetha naye, bafika abakhonzi bakakumkani, bakhawulezisa uHaman ukuba afike emlonyeni ka-Estere.
Ke kaloku ukumkani noHaman bafika bedla nomkakhe uEstere.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesibini, xa besela iwayini, ukumkani wathi kuEstere: Yintoni na into oyifunayo, uEstere umkumkani? Iza kukunikezelwa. Yintoni na into oyicelayo? Nakuba ibe sisiqingatha solawulo lwam, iya kwenziwa.

Waphendula uEstere umkumkani, wathi, Ukumkani wam, ukuba ukhe wandiseka kum, nokuba kulungile phambi kwakho, nceda usindise ubomi bam; kuba oku kukucela kwam; nceda usindise abantu bam; kuba oku kukucela kwam.

Ndithe ndathengwa, mna nosapho lwam, ukuba siqhutywe, sibulawe, siphelelwe; ukuba sithe sathengwa sibe ngamagqwetha, amadoda nabasetyhini, ndiya kunyamalala. Ke kaloku akukho namnye umkhosi oza kuphinda abuyisele ilahleko yokumkani.
Wathi ukumkani uAzariya kuEstere ukumkanikazi, Nguwuphi na loo mntu? Naphi na lo mfazi owaziyo ukwenza loo nto?
Wathi uEstere, Lo mntu umxhamli, lo msaliti nguHaman, lowo mntu ombi. UHaman ke wakhathazeka phambi kokumkani nokumkakhe.

Ke kaloku ukumkani wavuka kwiwayini, waphuma endlwini yegadi yendlu kakumkani; uHaman ke wahlala phantsi, ecela uEstere, umkakhe, ukuba agcine ubomi bakhe; ngokuba wayebona ukuba ukumkani ugqibile ukuwubulala.

Ke kaloku, xa ukumkani ebuyela kwigumbi lokutyela, esuka kwisityalo sendlu yasekumkani, ke kaloku uHaman ulele phezu kwebhedi apho uEstere ehlala khona. Watsho ukumkani wathi, Ingaba uya kuhlasela umkakhe, mna ndikwindlu yasekumkani? Xa ukumkani ethetha loo nto, abakhonzi bafihla ubuso bukaHaman.

Wathi ke uHarbona, omnye wabakhonzi bakakumkani, wathi, Yabona, kukho umnqamlezo obekwe endlwini ka-Haman, ubude bakhe buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini; wawubeka kuMordekayi, umntu othethayo ukusindisa ukumkani. Ukumkani wathi, Mngcwabeni kuwo.
Ke kaloku bamisa uHaman emnqamlezweni, awayewulungiselela uMordekayi. Yathi ke inkanuko yokumkani iphumla.

Ke kaloku ngaloo mini, ukumkani uAhashe wanikela kumkanikazi uEstere zonke izinto zikaHaman, umthandi wamaYuda. Wafika ke uMordekayi phambi kokumkani; ngokuba uEstere wayemxelela ukumkani ukuba unxulumano naye.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wasusa isitshixo sakhe, ebesiyithathe kuHaman, wayinika uMordekayi. UEstere wammisa uMordekayi engqondweni yonke into kaHaman.
Waqhubeka uEstere ethetha kukumkani, wagwa emadolweni akhe, wathandaza, wamcela ukuba athintele isigqibo esibi sikaHaman umAgagi, esigqiba ngaso abaYuda.
Ke kaloku ukumkani wamnika uEstere isikhephe segolide. Wavuka ke uEstere, waya phambi kokumkani.

Wathi, Ukuba kulungile kukumkani, ukuba uthandana nam, ukuba kuyinyani engqondweni yakhe, ukuba ndithandana naye, kufuneka kubekho umyalelo obhaliweyo, wokuba zibuyiselwe izibhengezo ezibhalwe nguHaman, unyana kaHammedatha, umAgagi; ezo wazibhalela ukuwabulala amaYuda kuwo onke amaphondo kakumkani.
Ndiya kumelana nantoni na, ndibone ukuba ingxaki ifike kubomi bam? Ndiya kumelana nantoni na, ndibone ukuba usapho lwam luphelile?
Wathi ukumkani uAzariya ku-Estere, ukumkanikazi, noMordekayi, umYuda, Bona, ndazinika u-Estere zonke izinto zikaHaman; bayamtshisa emnqamlezweni, ngenxa yokuba wahlasela ooYuda.

Ke ngoko, nibhaleni incwadi entsha ngegama lokumkani malunga nabaYuda, njengokuba kunibona kulungile; niyityhalelise ngomsesane wokumkani; kuba akukho ncwadi ibhaliweyo ngegama lokumkani, ityhilelwe ngumsesane wakhe, engayi kususwa.

Babizwa ngoko ababhali bakakumkani, ngomhla weshumi elinesithathu wenyanga yesithathu, leyo yinyanga kaSiwan; babhalela konke oko uMordekayi awawiselayo kumaYuda; babhalela abaphathi, nabalawuli, namagosa, emazweni amakhulu amabini anamashumi asixhenxe anesibhozo, asuka eIndiya waya eEtiyopiya; babebhala kumaphondo onke ngokubhala kwawo, kumazwe onke ngoulwimi lwawo, kubaYuda ngokubhala kwabo nolimi lwabo.
Wabhala ke uMordekayi ngegama likakumkani uAzariya, waza watyhila izibhengezo ngomsesane wokumkani; wazisa ngamagqwetha ahamba ngeenqanawa ezikhawulezayo, zamadoda asekuhlaleni.

Ukumkani wavumela ngale ncwadi ooYuda, abakwidolophu nganye, ukuba bahlangane, bakhusele ubomi babo; ukuba baphucule, babulala, baphelise nabani na owenza umkhosi, nabani na ongumntu, nabani na osuka ezweni elincinane, ahlaselayo kubo, nabantwana babo, nabasetyhini babo; ukuba bathabathe iimpahla zabachasi babo.
ukuze kwenzeke ngaloo mini enye, kuzo zonke izixeko zikakumkani uAzariya, ngomhla weshumi elinesibhozo wenyanga yeshumi elinambini, leyo yinyanga ka-Adare.
Ikopi yale ncwadi, ukuba ibe ngumthetho ezweni ngalinye, yapapashwa kuzo zonke iintlanga, ukuze abaYuda balungiselele ngaloo mini ukumelana nabaphulaphuli babo.
