Ke kaloku abathunywa baphuma ngokukhawuleza, behamba ngeebhayisikile zokumkani, bekhawuleza ngokwemiyalelo yokumkani; kwathi ke iShushan, idolophu ekhuselekileyo, yabhengeza loo nto.
Ke kaloku uMordekayi waphuma phambi kokumkani, egqoke iimpahla zokumkani ezibomvu nezimhlophe, enesibhakabhaka esikhulu segolide, noboya obungwevu belinen. Umzi waseShushan wabhiyozela.
KwabaYuda ke kwakukho ixesha lokukhanya, nobulumko, nothando, nobubele.

Ke kaloku kuwo onke amaphondo, nangawo onke amadolophu, apho imiyalelo yokumkani yafika khona, kwabakho ukuthandazela nokuvuya kwaBayuda, besenza iintlanganiso nezihlandlo ezilungileyo; nakwamanye amazwe amaninzi aye waba ngabaYuda, ngokuba babebaxolela abaYuda.

Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe wesithathu wenyanga yeshumi elinesibini, leyo yinyanga kaAdare, imiyalelo yokumkani yathi iya kwenziwa; ngaloo mini abathunywa bakaYuda babecinga ukuba baya kubaphulaphula. Ke kaloku izinto zaguquka, ke abaYuda baphulaphula abo babachukumisayo.

Ke kaloku abaYuda bahlangana emizini yabo, kuzo zonke iidolophu zikakumkani u-Axerxes, ukuba bahlasele abo babefuna ukubaphazamisa; akukho namnye okwaziyo ukumelana nabo; ngokuba kwabakho ubuxoki kubo phakathi kwezizwe zonke.
Bonke oonyana bakakumkani bezidolophu, nabaphathi, namagosa, nabakhonzi bakakumkani, banceda amaYuda; ngokuba babemkhokela uMordekayi.
Ke kaloku uMordekayi waba mkhulu kakhulu endlwini kakumkani; ilizwi lakhe lafika kuwo onke amaphondo, waza uMordekayi waqhubeka ekhula.
Ke kaloku abaYuda babetha bonke abathunywa babo ngeqhwa, bebabulala, bebaphelisa; basenza kubo abo babemxhalabisayo konke okubi.
Ke kaloku, eShushan, isixeko esikhuselekileyo, abaYuda babulala, babulala amadoda angamakhulu amahlanu.
Babulala noParsandatha, noDalfon, noAspatha,
iPorhata, neAdaliya, neAridata,
uParmashta, noArisayi, noAridai, noVaizatha,
oonyana abalishumi bakaHaman, unyana kaHamedatha, umkhonzi wamaYuda; ke kaloku akazange athathe nanye iimpahla zabo.
Ngomhla lowo kwaziswa ukumkani inani labantu abafayo eShushan, isixeko esikhuselekileyo.

Wathi ukumkani kuEstere umkumkani, EShushan, isixeko esikhuselekileyo, amaYuda abulala, aphelise amadoda angamakhulu amahlanu, oonyana abalishumi bakaHaman; bakwenze ntoni na eminye imimandla yokumkani? Ke ngoko, yintoni oyifunayo? Iza kukunikezelwa. Yintoni enye oyifumeneyo? Iza kukwenziwa.

Waphendula uEstere, wathi, Ukuba kulungile kukumkani, baphinde bayenze imihla elandelayo ooYuda abaseShushan, ngokwemiyalelo yosuku lwangoku; nabafileyo oonyana ababini baka-Haman bagwetywe emnqamlezini.
Wathi ke ukumkani ukuba kwenzeke; kwaziswa umthetho eShushan, batshisa iziqu zabantwana abalishumi bakaHaman.
Ke kaloku abaYuda ababe eSusa baphinde bahlangana ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga ka-Adare, babulala amadoda angamakhulu amathathu eSusa; kodwa akazange athathe nanye into yabo.

Ke kaloku namanye amaYuda, akwiidolophu zikakumkani, badibana nabo, ukuba bakhusele ubomi babo, ukuze baphumle kumagosa abo; babulala kubo ababaxolelayo abantu abangamashumi asixhenxe anesihlanu amawaka; kodwa bebengawuthathanga umthwalo wabo.
Yathi loo nto ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga ka-Adare; ngomhla wesixhenxe baphumla, bayenza ibe yimini yokubhiyozela nokuthandazela.
Ke kaloku amaYuda aseSusa ahlangana ngomhla wesixhenxe nesithathu, nomhla wesixhenxe nesine; ke ngomhla wesixhenxe nesihlanu baphumla, bayenza ibe yintlanganiso nenhlanhlo.

Ke kaloku, abaYuda abasemaphandleni, nakumadolophu angasemgangathweni, bayenza imini yeshumi elinesine yenyanga ka-Adare ibe yimini yokuthandazela nokudla; ibe yintlanganiso yokuthunyelwa kwezipho omnye komnye.
Wazibhala ke uMordekayi ezi zinto, wathumela izibhengezo kuzo zonke iidolophu zikakumkani uAzariya, kubo bonke abaYuda, abasekufutshane nabangasentshona.
Wathi kubo ukuba bagcine imini yeshumi elinesine yenyanga ka-Adare, nemini yeshumi elinesihlanu yonyaka wonke.

Ke kaloku ezi mihla abaYuda baphumle kuyo imikhosi yabo, ngomhla wonyaka apho ubuhlungu babo buguqulwa bubumnandi, noluvo lwabo lube ngusuku oluhle; ukuze babe ziintsuku zokuzonwabisa nokunyaniseka, bethumelana izipho ngamnye komnye, neentyatyambo kubafazi.
Bathi ke abaYuda ukuba baqhubeke nokwenza loo nto babeqale ukuyisenza, njengoko uMordekayi abewabhalela.
Ke kaloku uHaman, unyana kaHamedatha, umAgagi, umfowunelwa weeYuda zonke, wayethe wacinga ukuba abulala ooYuda; waza watyhila iPuri, oko kukuthi, isigqibo, ukuba awaphule aze awakhulule.

Ke kaloku, xa ukumkani ekwazile loo nto, wathumela izibhengezo, ukuba isigqibo sakhe esibi, awayesicwangcisile kumaYuda, sibuyiselwe phezu kwentloko yakhe. Wathi ke uHaman noonyana bakhe, bagwetywe emnqamlezeni.
Ngenxa yoko ezi mihla zibizwa ngokuba yiPurim, esuka kwigama elithi Pur; ngenxa yezinto zonke ezibhaliweyo kulo mbhalo kaMordekayi, nezonke izinto ababezibonayo, nezonke izinto ezazibangelwa ngazo.

Ke kaloku abaYuda bagqiba kwelokuba benze le nto ibe yimimiselo kubo, nabantwana babo, nakwabo bonke abathe badibana nabo, ukuba bangabi nethuba lokwenza loo mihla mibini ngonyaka ngamnye, ngokwendlela ebhaliweyo.
ukuba ezi mihla ziphawulwe, zigcinwe kuhlobo ngalunye, kwindlu nganye, kwisiqithi ngasinye, kumzi ngamnye; ukuze ezi mihla zePurim zingabikho phakathi kwaBayuda, zibe yimithandazo yosapho lwabo.
Wabhala ke uEstere ukumkani, intombi ka-Abihayeli, noMordekayi umYuda, ngegunya elipheleleyo, ukuqinisa elo phepha lesibini lePurhi.
Wathumela ke uMordekayi izibhengezo kuzo zonke iidolophu ezimakhulu amabini anamashumi asixhenxe anesixhenxe zombuso ka-Azariya, ngamazwi oxolo nokholo kubo bonke abaYuda.

Ezi ncwadi zaqinisa iintsuku zePurim ngexesha labo, njengoko uMordekayi umYuda, noEstere ukumkani, bezenzayo, nanjengoko abaYiputa babezimisela kubo nabantwana babo, ngamaxesha abo okuxoka nokungcola.
Umyalelo ka-Estere waqinisa le mimiselo yePurhimi; yabhalwa ke encwadini.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uXeshazare wayalela abantu behlabathi lonke, neziqithi zelwandle, ukuba bahlawule intlawulo.

Nazo zonke izinto azenzayo ngobukrelekrele bakhe, nobubele bakhe, nazo zonke iziganeko zakhe, ukuba uMordekayi wawukhulu kangakanani na, xa ukumkani wayemkhupha ephakadeni kwakhe? Ingaba azibhalwenga ezincwadini zobomi bamakumkani baseMediya namaPersiya?

Ke kaloku uMordekayi, umYuda, waba ngukumkani wesibini, emva kukaKumkani uAxerxes; waba mkhulu phakathi kwamaYuda, wathandeka kubo bonke abazalwana bakhe amaYuda, ngenxa yokuba wayefuna ukuzola kwabantu bakhe, ethetha ngoxolo nokhuseleko lwabo bonke.
Job: Kwabakho umntu, igama lakhe nguYobhi, wayehlala ezweni laseUzi; waba ngumntu olungileyo, kungekho monakalo kuye; waba ngumntu ogqibeleleyo, wayemthanda uThixo, washiya into embi.
Waba neentombi ezisibhozo, neentsana ezintathu.

Waba neentyatyambo zamawaka asixhenxe, neeenkomo zamawaka amathathu, neenkunzi zeenkomo ezilishumi elinambini, neeesile ezingamakhulu amahlanu; wayenabasebenzi abaninzi kakhulu. Uwo mntu waba mkhulu kunabo bonke abantu baseMpuma.
Babehamba oonyana bakaYobhi, besenza izipho endlwini yabo, ngamnye ngemini yakhe; babezibiza nabazalwana babo abathathu, ukuba basele basele nabo.

Ke kaloku, xa zigqitywa iintsuku zokudla, uYobhi wayebathumela oonyana bakhe, wabalungisa phambi koThixo; wavuka ekuseni, wanikela isonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi ngokwenani labo bonke. Wathi uJobhi, Kungenxa yokuba oonyana bam baphelelwe lithemba, besuka emphefumlweni wabo kuThixo. UJobhi wenza njalo.
Ke kaloku, kumhla omnye, zafika izithunywa zezulu zihlale phambi koYehova; kwafika noSatani, umkhonzi, phakathi kwabo.
Wathi iNkosi kuSatani, Ufika phi na? Waphendula uSatani iNkosi, wathi, Ndisuka ndihamba phantsi kwehlabathi, ndihamba ngaphesheya kwayo.

Wathi ke iNkosi kuSatani, Ubone na umkhonzi wam uYobhi? Kuba akukho namnye ehlabathini ofana naye; ngumntu olungileyo, akabikho monakalo kuye; ungumntu othembekileyo, othandazelayo uThixo, osuka emngciphekweni.
Waphendula uSatani iNkosi, wathi, UYobhi uyamhlonela uThixo kungekho nto?
Wakwenza umngxunya wokhuselo kuye, nosapho lwakhe, nazo zonke izinto zakhe; wabhikelela yonke into ayenzayo; iinkomo zakhe neebhokhwe zakhe zasasazeka ezweni lonke.
Ke kaloku, udibanise isandla sakho, uthabathe zonke izinto zakhe; aze akucaphukele phambi kwakho.
Wathi iNkosi kuSatani, Yabona! Zonke izinto zakhe zikwisandla sakho; kuphela ngoJob, ungawukhuphi umnwe wakho. Waphuma ke uSatani phambi koThixo.
Ke kaloku, kwaba nemini, xa oonyana bakhe nabafazi bakhe bedla besela iwayini endlwini yodade wabo omdala.
Kwafika umthunywa kuYobhi, esithi, Iinkomo zithe ziqhobosha, iinkunzi zeenkomo ke zidla izityalo ezikufutshane.
Ke kaloku bafika amaShabhayi, bathabathela, babulala oonyana bakaSirayeli ngeqhwa; ndabaleka ndiye mna kuphela ukuba ndikuxelele.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa yena ethetha, kwafika omnye, wathi, Umnqamlezo kaThixo waba phantsi esibhakabhakeni, watshisa iinkomo nabakhonzi; ndabuya ndimnye nje ukuba ndikuxelele.

Ke kaloku, ngelixa yena ethetha, kwafika omnye, wathi, ABakhalidi bamisela amaqela amathathu, bahlasela iinkomo, zazithabatha, babulala oonyana abancinci ngeqhwa; ndabuya ndimnye nje ukuba ndikuxelele loo nto.
Ke kaloku, ngelixa yena ethetha, kwafika omnye, wathi, Oonyana bakho neentombi zakho babedla besela iwayini endlwini yodade wabo omkhulu.
Ke kaloku, yafika inkungu enkulu esuka emlanjeni, yabetha iziphelo ezine zendlu; yawela phezu kwamadoda amancinci, bafa. Ndiye ndabaleka mna kuphela ukuba ndikuxelele.
Wavuka ke uYobhi, warhoxisa iingubo zakhe, waza wamisa intloko yakhe; waba phantsi ehlabathini, wakhonza.
Wathi, Andinanto xa ndazalwa; ndiya kuba ngantoni na xa ndifa. UYehova wamnika, iNkosi wamthabatha; livuyisane igama likaThixo.
Kuzo zonke ezi zinto, uYobhi akabi nesono, akabi nobuxoki kuThixo.
Ke kaloku, kwathi ke ngemini elandelayo, zafika izithunywa zezulu zihlale phambi koYehova; wafika noSatani nabo, ahlale phambi koYehova.
Wathi iNkosi kuSatani, Ufika phi na? Waphendula uSatani iNkosi, wathi, Ndisuka ndihamba phantsi kwehlabathi, ndihamba ngaphesheya kwayo.

Wathi ke iNkosi kuSatani, Ubone na umkhonzi wam uYobhi? Kuba akukho namnye ehlabathini ofana naye; ngumntu olungileyo, akabikho monakalo kuwo; ungumntu othembekileyo, othandazelayo uThixo, osuka emngciphekweni wobubi; uhlala ethembekileyo; nawe wathetha kum ukuba unyuse yena ngaphandle kwesizathu.
Waphendula uSatani iNkosi, wathi, Isikhumba ngesikhumba; umntu uya kunikela zonke izinto zakhe, ukuze agcine ubomi bakhe.
Ke kaloku, udibanise isandla sakho, uthabathe isisu sakhe, namathambo akhe nenyama yakhe; aze akucaphuke phambi kwakho.
Wathi iNkosi kuSatani, Yabona, uya kuba phantsi kwesandla sakho; ke ngoko, unciphise ubomi bakhe.
Waphuma ke uSatani phambi koYehova, wabetha uYobhi ngeentlungu ezibuhlungu, ukusuka phantsi kweenyawo zakhe, waya phezulu kwentamo yakhe.
Ke kaloku uYobhi wathabatha isiqwenga sodongwe, ukuba athabathe icala lakhe; wahlala phakathi kwengca.
Wathi yena umfazi wakhe kuye, Ingaba uyaqhubeka uqinisa ubuxoki bakho? Yala uThixo, uye kufa.

Waphendula ke uYobhi, wathi, Uthetha njengowesifazane ongenangqondo; siya kufumana na kuThixo izinto ezilungileyo kuphela, asiyi kuthatha na izimbi? Kuzo zonke ezo zinto, uJobha akabi nesono ngamazwi akhe.

UYobhi wayeneentombi ezintathu, uElifazi waseTeman, noBhedide waseShuha, noSofare waseNaama. Ke kaloku, beva loo nto yonke ingxaki eyafika kuYobhi, baphuma bonke endlwini yabo; bagqiba ke ukuba bahlangane, bafike balumkele uJob, bamxolele.
Ke kaloku, bakubona uYobhi ukusuka kude, bengenakukwazi ukumqonda. Bathi ke ngelizwi elikhulu, batshisa izihlangu zabo, batyhala umsi phezu kweenkophe zazo.
Bahlala ke naye phezu komhlaba iintsuku ezisixhenxe, neentlanga ezisixhenxe; akukho namnye wathetha naye lizwi; ngokuba babona ukuba ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu.
Emva koko, wavula uYobhi umlomo wakhe, waphulaphula imini ezalwa kuyo.
UJob wathi:
Usuku endizalwa ngalo, luza kususwa; nobusuku obuthi, Kuza kuvela umntwana omncinci.
Imini leyo itshintshe ibe yimpucuko, UThixo ophezulu akayiqondi; Akukho kukhanya kuzele kuyo.
Umnyama nesithunzi esinzulu siyibuyisele umva; icloudi ihlale phezu kwayo, umbala ongwevu ushiyeke.
Ubusuku obumnyama buthabathe lo busuku, Bungabanjwa phakathi kweentsuku zonyaka; Bungabalulwa ibe yinxalenye yenyanga nanye.
Le mihla ihlale ingabikho nto kuyo; Akukho msindo wokuthandazela ungavakala kulo.
Baye bayicaphukele iintsuku abo bacinga ukuba baya kuzivusa iintaka zaselwandle, uLeviathan.
Iinkwenkwezi zayo zemini zihlale zimnyama, Zilinde ukukhanya okungafikanga; Zize zingabonisi izibane zokuqala zosuku.
Akuyi kuvala ibele lomntwana wam, ukuba andizalisekanga; Akuyi kuyifihla intlungu emehlo am.
Kutheni na ukuba ndafa xa ndazalwa? Kutheni na ukuba ndafa ndiphuma emlonyeni womyeni wam?
Kutheni na ukuba kubekho umlenze wam, wamthabathayo, Namatye am, amdlalayo?
Ukuba ndafa ngoko, ndiya kuhlala ndilala ngoxolo; Ndiza kuphumla ndiphumle;
nabakumkani, nabacebisi babo, abathi bavule izindlu ezinkulu, eziye zafa;
okanye nabathetheli abanegolide, Bezigcwele iindlu zabo ngesilivere.
Kutheni na ukuba ndifunyanwe phantsi njengonyana ozalwa efileyo, njengonyana ongabonanga ukukhanya?
Xa befa, ababi bayeka ukulimala; Bafumana ukuphumla abo baxakekile.
Abagwetywa baphumla ndawonye apho. Baze bangalibali ukucaphukisa komqhubi womkhonzi.
Uncinci nomkhulu bakhona apho; umkhonzi ukhululekile kukumkani wakhe.
Kutheni na ukuba uThixo anikezele ukukhanya kubo abaxhaphakileyo, nokuphila kubo ababuhlungu intliziyo?
Banqwenela ukufa, kodwa akuyi kufikelanga; bafuna ukufa kunokuba bafune iimpahla ezifihlakeleyo.
Baza kuphumla ngovuyo, baza kuthandazela ukuba bafike ekufeni.
Kuthini na ukunika ukukhanya komntu, angabonanga apho ahamba khona, owathi uThixo wamgqubuthela?
Iintyatyambo zam ziye zaba yinyama yam, Intyatyambo yam iqhutywa njengeelwandle.
Okundikhokelayo kwam kwafika kum; Oko ndandikhumbuza ngaso, kwathiwa kum.
Andinaxolo, ndingenakuphumla, ndingenakuphumla; ingxaki kuphela efika.
Waphendula ke uElifazi waseTeman, wathi,
Ukuba ke umntu efuna ukuthetha nawe, uya kukhathazeka na? Kodwa ngubani na oza kuhlala ephumle?
Khumbula ukuba ufundile abantu abaninzi, waqinisa izandla ezincinane.
Amabinzana akho anciphisa abo bafayo, Ukwenza ukuba zinamandla iinwele ezilahlekileyo.
Ke mna ngoku, xa ingxaki ifika kuwe, uphelelwe lithemba; xa ifike kuwe, uphelelwe luxolo.
Ingaba ukholo lwakho kuThixo alufanelekanga ukuba lube luqiniseko kuwe? Ingaba ubomi bakho obulungileyo alufanelekanga ukuba bube luthemba kuwe?
Ucinga ukuba umntu ongenabulungisa uphelelwe lixesha na? Abantu abathembekileyo baphelelwa lixesha nini na?
Kuzo zonke izinto endizibonayo, abo baqhawula ububi, nabafaka ubundlobongela, baya kuzihlambela.
UThixo uphefumla phezu kwabo, bafa; Umphefumlo wobuxoki bakhe ubasusa.
Inkunzi yenkomo iya kutyhila, inkunzi yenkomo enamandla iya kwenzakalisa; kodwa iintsontelo zeentombi zenkomo zilahliwe.
Ilili elidala lifa, ngenxa yokuba alikho nantoni na yokubulala; Iinkunzi zelili ziqhutywa.
Kwafika kum umyalezo ngokufihlakeleyo; Iindlebe zam zaziphulaphula ilizwi lakhe.
Yaza ngeephupho ezinobungozi ngobusuku, Xa abantu belala phantsi.
Uxolo noxinzelelo lwandithatha, Zonke iinwele zam zazingca.
Wadlula umphefumlo phambi kobuso bam, iinwele zenyama yam zanyuka.
Yayeka, kodwa andikwazi ukuchaza ukuba ibonakala ntoni. Kwabakho into ehlala phambi kwam, kwakukho uxolo, ke ndava lizwi lisithi,
Ingaba umntu unokuba mkhulu kunaye uThixo? Ingaba umntu unokuba mkhulu kunaye lowo wamenzayo?
Yabona, uThixo akathembeki nakumkhonzi wakhe; Naye izithunywa zakhe ezingcwele azibona ngazo.
Ngaphaya koko, bangaphi na abantu abahlala endlwini yodongwe, Abathi iziseko zabo zikwimpuphu, Baqhutywa njengamakhoboka?
Ngokuba phakathi kwemini nobusuku baqhutywa; Bafa ngonaphakade, akukho namnye owaziyo.
Izibophelelo zeentyatyambo zabo ziqhutywa phezulu, Bafa bengenabulumko.
Ukuba unqwenela ukubiza, uya kukuphendula phi na? Kunye naziphi na izithunywa ezingcwele oza kuzijonga?
Inkanuko ibulala umntu ongenangqondo, Ke kaloku uxinzelelo lubulala owaziyo.
Ndabona umntu ongenangqondo emisa iziqhamo; Kwaza ndabona indlu yakhe ilahliwe.
Abantwana bakhe baphelelwe lithemba; Baqhutywa emthethweni, akukho mntu ubakhuselayo.
Badla abantu abathambileyo imbewu yakhe, Beyithatha phakathi kweentyatyambo; Abantu abathambileyo banqwenela ubutyebi bakhe.
Akukho monakalo ukhulayo emgqomeni, Nakuba akukho buhlungu buphumayo emhlaba.
Ke kaloku abantu bazalwa befuna ubuhlungu, Ngokuqinisekileyo njengokuba iziqhamo zihamba phezulu.
Ukuba ndinguwe, ndiya kubuyela kuThixo; Ndiza kumnika ityala lam.
Ukwenza izinto ezikhulu, akukho mntu unokuziqonda; Izinto ezimangalisayo, akukho mntu unokuzibala.
Uthumela imvula phezu komhlaba, Amanzi ezindaweni.
Wabaphakamisa abo baphantsi, Wabakhupha abagulayo ekhuselekileyo.
Uyasiphazamisa izigqibo zamadoda akhohlakeleyo, ukuze izandla zabo zingaphumelelanga.
Uthi uthabathe abalumkileyo kwiingcamango zabo; Izigqibo zabantu abanobuchule ziqhutywa ngaphaya.
Ubusuku bahamba emnyama; Ngomhla wesiqingatha semini beziva indlela yabo, njengokuba libusuku.
Wabasindisa abafazi, Esuka kwisikrele somlomo wabo, Esuka kumandla anamandla.
Ke kaloku abafazi baya kuba nethemba; Ububi buvala umlomo bawo.
Kuhle kangakanani na ukuba umntu ugwetywe nguThixo! Ngoko ke, musa ukunyanzelisa imiyalelo kaThixo Onamandla onke.
Ubuhlungu, ke yena ubanda umkhuhlane; Ukulimala, ke yena izandla zakhe ziphilisa.
Uya kukusindisa kwizigulana ezintandathu; Kuzo zonke izigulana ezisixhenxe, akukho buhlungu obuza kukukhokela.
Kwixesha lendlala uya kukusindisa kukufa, Nakwixesha lokulwa, ekungeneni kweqhwa.
Uya kukhuselwa ekufumaneni ibhombu lelwimi; Akuyi kubakho uxinzelelo xa kufika ukufa.
Uza kutyelela ukulimala nokufa, awuyi kukhathazeka ngenxa yezinto eziphilayo.
Uya kuba nesivumelwano namatye ehlabathini; Izinto eziphilayo zasendle ziya kuphumla nawe.
Uza kwazi ukuba ikhaya lakho likhuselekile. Xa ukhangela ipropathi yakho, akukho nto ichaphazelayo.
Uza kwazi ukuba uza kubaninzi oonyana bakho; Intsapho yakho iya kuba njengeentyatyambo zehlabathi.
Uza kungena ekufumaneni kwakho ngobufazi obutsha, njengokuba ingqolowa igcinwa ngexesha lokuvuna.
Yabona, siyifundile loo nto, ibe yinyaniso; thetha ke ngoko, ufunde, ukuze kube lula kuni.
Waphendula uYobhi, wathi,
Yaye ke, ukuba intlungu yam ikwazi ukuthenjwa, Nazo zonke izigulana zam zibekeke emgceni!
Ziyi kube zinzima kunamanzi onke elwandle. Ngoko ke, amazwi am aye ngamatye amnyama.
Amagosa kaThixo Onamandla onke anqunyulwa kum, Umphefumlo wam usela intsholongwane yawo; Iingozi zikaThixo zilungelelaniswa kum.
Ingaba inkunzi yebhokhwe ivuya xa ineentyatyambo? Ingaba inkomo ivuya xa inesonka?
Ingaba ungadla isonka esingenanto yobumnandi ngaphandle kweso? Ingaba kumhlophe lweqanda kukho ubuhle?
Andifuni ukutshisa ezi zinto, zindibangela ukuba ndibi.
Ndiyathemba ukuba ndiza kufumana into endiyicelayo; Ndiyathemba ukuba uThixo uya kundinika into endiyifunayo,
ukuba uThixo angathanda ukumcaphukisa, ukuba alungise isandla sakhe, athabathe umphefumlo wam.
Ke ngoko ndiya kuba noxolo olunjalo, Ndiza kukhupha ngemiphefumlo yam, Nakuba kubuhlungu obungapheliyo; Andiyi kunyanzelisa amazwi Ongcwele.
Ndinesiphi isandla sam, ukuze ndilinde? Ndinesiphi isiphelo sam, ukuze ndihlale ndiphumle?
Ndinamandla njengelitye na? Ingaba umzimba wam wenziwe ngentsimbi?
Andinamandla ukuba ndincede ngokwam, Nawo nawuphi na umngcipheko wokuphumelela uthathelwe kum.
Umntu ofuna ukuyeka kufuneka afumane ububele kubazalwana bakhe, Nakuba eshiya ukuthobela uThixo Omkhulu.
Ke kaloku abazalwana bam bafana nomlambo ongenakuthembeka, njengemilambo ethe tyaba.
Ngexesha lobusika zimnyama ngomkhenkce kwaye zifihlakele phantsi kwekhephu.
Ke kaloku, xa kubandayo, ziphuma; Xa kushushu, ziphuma ezibhedini zabo.
Abahamba ngeenyawo bajika-jika, befuna ukuwafumana; Baphuma emlanjeni, baba mnyama.
Abahambayo baseTema bafuna amanzi; Abarhwebi baseShebha bayathemba ukuwafumana.
Baye baphulukana nethemba ngenxa yokuba babethembela. Bafika apho kwaye bakhathazekile.
Namhlanje nifana naleyo milambo; nibona into ebuhlungu, nize nikhathazeke.
Ndithi na, Nceda ndininike into? Ndithi na, Nceda nindihlawulele into kwimali yenu?
Ndithi na, Usindise kum emkhosini wam? Ndithi na, Usindise kum ebantwini ababi?
Ndifundise, ndithi ndiza kuphumla; Ndibonise ukuba ndenze ntoni na embi.
Ilizwi elinobulungisa linamandla; Kodwa ukuthetha kwakho kubonisa ntoni?
Ingaba uyasilungisa ntoni na into endithethayo, Ukwenza ukuba ilizwi lomntu ongenathemba libe ngumoya?
Uza kubeka iinkwenkwezi zabantwana abafileyo, uthengise umhlobo wakho.
Nceda ke ngoku ujonge kum; Andiyi kukuxelela inyaniso phambi kwakho.
Nceda uphumle. Musa ukuba ngumntu ongalunganga. Khangela kwakhona, kuba ubulungisa bam bukwingozi.
Ingaba kukho into engalunganga emlonyeni wam? Andikwazi na ukutya okubi?
Ingaba ubomi behlabathi abusoloko bunzima kulowo nalowo? Ingaba iintsuku zethu azikho njengeentsuku zomqeshwa?
Njengomkhonzi ofuna isithunzi semini, njengokuba umqeshi elinde umnikelo wakhe,
Ndinikelwe iinyanga zokungakhathali, neentsuku ezide zoxinzelelo.
Xa ndilala, ndithi, Ndiza kuvuka nini na? Ubusuku buphela lini na? Ndizijikelezisa, ndizigqubuthela, de kube limini.
Isiqu sam sigubungela iintsholongwane neentlungu. Ulusu lwam lutshabalalise kwaye luphuma ngamanzi.
Iintsuku zam zihamba ngesantya esikhawulezayo kunaso isigqubuthelo somxolisi, Zigqitywa zingenanto yokuthemba.
Khumbula, Thixo, ukuba ubomi bam ngumoya; Andiyi kubuya ndibone ubulumko.
Abambonayo mna ngoku, baya kumbona kwakhona; niza kundifuna, kodwa ndiya kupheleka.
Njengoko ifuthe lihamba, libe liphelile, ngoko ke umntu ophumayo ebhedini akabuyanga phezulu.
Akuyi kuphinda afike ekhaya lakhe; Indlu yakhe ayizukumqonda kwakhona.
Ke ngoko, andiyi kunyamalala; ndiza kuthetha ngenxa yobuhlungu bomphefumlo wam, Ndiza kwenzakalisa ngenxa yobuhlungu bengqondo yam.
Ndiyilwandle na mna, okanye iintaka zelwandle, ukuba ubeke umgcini kum?
Xa ndithi, Ibhedi yam iya kundixolisa, Nebhedi yam iya kunika uxolo umsindo wam;
Ke mna uyamxolela ngeendoto, Mna uyamxelela ngokubona.
Ndiyathanda ukuba ndigwetywe; ndiyathanda ukufa, kunokuba ndihlale kuloo thambo.
Ndimxolela ubomi bam, Andifunanga ukuphila ngonaphakade; Yazi ukuba iintsuku zam zison sesona siphelo.
Zithini na iintlanga, ukuba uzenza ngazo izinto ezininzi kakhulu, ukuba uziqhelanisa nazo izinto ezininzi?
Uyijonga yonke imini uze uyivavanye ngazo zonke iimeko.
Ingaba awuzukundishiya ujonge kum? Ingaba awuzukundishiya ndiphumle ixesha elide, ukuze ndenze isisu?
Ukuba ndenze isono, ndikwenzele ntoni na kuwe, wena olawulayo abantu? Kutheni le nto ungenza ndibe yinjongo yakho? Kutheni le nto ndiye ndaba ngumthwalo kuwe?
Kutheni na ukuba ungamxoleli umngcipheko wam, Uyisuse njani isono sam? Ndiya kuphumla ngokukhawuleza emlilweni; Uya kundifuna, kodwa ndiya kuphelelwa.
Waphendula ke uBiledi waseShuha, wathi,
Ingaba uza kuqhubeka uthetha njalo? Ilizwi lakho lifana nomoya onamandla.
Ingaba uThixo unqumle loo nto ilungileyo? Ingaba uMoya oyiNgcwele unqumle loo nto ilungile?
Ke kaloku, xa abantwana bakho besenza intlungu kuye, wabanika ityala lesono sabo.
Ke wena, ukuba ujonge kuThixo, Ucela umnqamlezo kuThixo Onamandla onke,
ukuba ucocekile, uqinisekile, uya kuvuka ngokuqinisekileyo ukukunceda, akubuyisele indawo yakho elungileyo.
Nakuba uqala ngento encinci, uza kugqiba ube neyoninzi kakhulu.
Buza abantu abaphila phambi kwethu, Ubone ukuba bafunda ntoni ooyise babo.
Sizalwa namhlanje, asiyazi nto; Iintsuku zethu emhlabeni zifana nesithunzi.
Baza kukufundisa na, baya kukuxelela na? Baza kukunika na ubulumko beentliziyo zabo?
Ingaba i-papyrus ingakhula phezulu apho akukho mlambo? Ingaba iziqhamo zingakhula ngaphandle kwamanzi?
Xa sele ziluhlaza kwaye azisayi kutywinwa, ziyatshisa ngokukhawuleza kunezinye izityalo.
Le nto iphuma kubo bonke abalibalayo uThixo; Ithemba lamadoda akhohlakeleyo lifa.
Into abathembela kuyo iqhutywa ngaphaya. Ukunyaniseka kwabo kubuthathaka njengothungelwano lwe-spider
Bathethwa kuthungelwano lwabo, kodwa lushiya indawo; Bathethwa kulo, kodwa aluyi kuhlala.
Bafana neentyatyambo ezimanziwe kakuhle phantsi kokukhanya kwelanga, zisasaza iziqhamo zazo phezu kwegadi.
Iingcambu zayo zijikeleza umqulu weethayile, kwaye zitsala iithayile.
Ke kaloku, xa iqhutywa esuka kwindawo yayo, indawo leyo iya kuyinyanisela, isithi, Andikwazanga kukubona.
Ke kaloku kuphele uxolo lwalo, Zikhuphe izityalo ezinye emhlaba endaweni yayo.
Yabona, uThixo akawukhuphi mntu ongenasono, Akawancedanga amadoda angcolileyo.
Uza kuzisa uzuko emlonyeni wakho, Nemilomo yakho inkulumo yothando.
Abamthubi bakho baya kugubungela uxolo; Iindlu zabakhohlakeleyo ziya kuphelelwa.
Waphendula uYobhi, wathi,
Ndiyazi ukuba oku kuyinyani; ke ngoko, umntu angazilungisa njani kuThixo?
Ukuba umntu efuna ukuthetha-thethana noThixo, akakwazi ukuphendula uThixo, nokuba kungenxa yexesha elinamawaka.
UThixo unobulumko obukhulu, unamandla amakhulu; Nguwuphi na lowo wahlasela naye, waphumelela?
Ushenxisa iintaba, zingazi nto; Uzijika-jikisa ngamandla akhe.
Utshisa ihlabathi esuka kwindawo yayo, Uzenza izikhonkwane zayo ziqhume.
Uthi kulanga, alukhuphanga; Ufihla ukukhanya kweenkwenkwezi.
Uye kuphela omisa izulu, Ehamba phezu kwamaza elwandle.
Wayenza intaka, neOrion, neePleyades, neziqithi zeenkwenkwezi ezisentshonalanga.
Ukwenza izinto ezinkulu, akukho namnye ongaziqondayo; Izinto ezimangalisayo, akukho namnye onokuzibala.
Xa ehamba ngaphezu kwam, andikwazi ukumbona; Xa ehamba phambi kwam, andikubona.
Ukuba ethatha into, ngubani na oza kumthintela? Ngubani na oza kumwathi, Yintoni oya kuyisenza?
UThixo akayithinteli inkanuko yakhe; Nabo abancedisi bakaRahabhi, iintaka ezidumileyo, bahlala phantsi kwakhe.
Ndiza kumphendula njani ke? Ndiza kukhetha ntoni na ilizwi, ukuze ndimxelele?
Nakuba ndingumntu olungileyo, andikwazi ukumphendula; Ndiya kucela uxolo kumgwebi wam.
Nakuba ndithi, uphendule kum, andicingi ukuba uya kundiphulaphula.
Mna ke, uThixo wam, uyayityhapha intliziyo yam, Uyikhupha iinwele zam ezimdaka.
Andivumelanga ukuba ndiyigcine intliziyo yam, Ndimnika ubuhlungu.
Ukuba yingxaki yobukrelekrele, yena unamandla kakhulu; ukuba yingxaki yobulungisa, ngubani na oza kumnqula?
Nakuba ndingenakubi, imilenze yam iya kundixolela; Nakuba ndingenakubi, imilenze yam iya kundixolela.
Andinangxaki, kodwa andikhathali ngobomi bam; ndimxolela ubomi bam.
Ndithi ke, Kunye naloo nto yonke: Uwubulala lowo ongenasono, nolowo ukhohlakeleyo.
Xa umonakalo ubulala abantu ngaphaya kwexesha, uya kudlala ngeentlungu zobuxoki.
Xa ilizwe liwela esandla somntu ongalunganga, ufihla amehlo abagwebi bayo; Ukuba akunguye uThixo owenza loo nto, ngubani na?
Iintsuku zam zihamba ngesantya esikhawulezayo kunabaqhubi; Zibaleka, zingabonanga uxolo.
Bahamba ngathi iinqanawa ezikhawulezayo ezenziwe ngeentyatyambo, Ngathi i-eagle ehla phantsi kwinto yayo.
Ukuba ndithi, Ndiya kulibala uxolo lwam, Ndiyitshintshe imilenze yam, Ndize ndilumke;
Ndisoloko ndizixolela iintlungu zam zonke; Kuba ndiyazi ukuba awundiyi kwenza ukuba ndingabikho.
Ndiya kufumana ityala naphi na; ngoko ke, kutheni ndimele ndiqhutywe ngento engasebenziyo?
Nakuba ndizihlamba ngekhephu, Ndizihlambulule izandla zam ngesabuni,
Uya kundityhila kumngxunya wothuli, Nasezigqomeni zam ziye zandixolela.
UThixo akayena mntu, njengam; ngoko ke andikwazi ukumphendula, nokuba ndimhlangane naye emthethweni.
Kungenjalo ke ukuba kubekho umntu oza kugqiba phakathi kwethu, abeke isandla sakhe phezu kwethu bobabini.
Ndiyathemba ukuba kukho umntu oza kumsusa umnqamlezo kaThixo, ukuze uxinzelelo lwakhe olungamkhokeli.
Ndiya kuthetha ke ngoko, ndize andikholele kuye; kodwa njengoko zinjalo izinto, andikwazi.
Mna ndilutha ngobomi, Ndiya kutyhala umsindo wam; Ndiza kuthetha ngenxa yobubi bengqondo yam.
Ndithi kuThixo, Musa ukundibiza ngetyala nje; Nceda ndixelele ukuba kukho ntoni na oyifunayo kum.
Ingaba kulungile kuwe ukuba undise ndim, ukuba unciphise mna, umsebenzi wezandla zakho? Ukuba utyhila iinzame zababi?
Ingaba unamehlo omntu? Ingaba ubona izinto njengokuba abantu bezibona?
Ingaba ubomi bakho buncinci njengexesha lokuphila komntu? Ingaba iminyaka yakho ifana nathi,
Ufuna ukuba ujonge iimpazamo zam, Ufune izono zam?
Uyazi ukuba ndingenakubi, kodwa akukho namnye oza kundikhusela esandla sakho.
Izandla zakho zandisela, zamenza; Uya kuphinda uphinde usindise na?
Khumbula, mna uThixo, ukuba undidala njengodongwe; Ingaba uya kundibuyisela umsi?
Undikhupha phantsi njengobisi, Ungenza ukuba ndibe mdaka njengekheyi.
Undigqoka ngesikhumba nenyama, Ndizibophe ngemithambo nemithambo-luvo.
Usindise ubomi bam, Wabonisa kum inyaniso yobubele bakho; Intliziyo yam iphila ngenxa yokuzinikela kwakho.
Ke wena wafihla lo mnqweno entliziyweni yakho; Ndiyazi ukuba oku kuthethwa ngawe:
Ukuba ndenze isono, uya kundijonga; awuyi kushiya intlungu yam ingabikho nto.
Ukuba ndinobuxoki, yintoni na endinokuyenza? Nakuba ndingenakubi, andikwazi ukuphakamisa intloko yam; Kuba ndiza kugqitywa kukuxhaphaza, Ndiza kuphelelwa ngumsindo.
Ukuba ndiyikhupha intloko yam, Uya kunqula njengelion; Uyambonisa kwakhona kum amandla akho amangalisayo.
Uza kwenza izibhengezo ezintsha kum; Inkanuko yakho ikhula kum; Imikhosi yakho ihamba ngamandla, ihamba ngamandla.
Uthini na ukuba ndizalwa? Ndinqwenela ukuba ndafa phambi kokuba mna ndibone.
Ndinqwenela ukuba andikho ngaphambili, kodwa ndithunyelwe ngokuthe ngqo ukusuka emntwini ukuya ekufaneni.
Ubomi bam buphelelwe lixesha. Ngoko shiya! Ndishiye ndiphumle, ukuze ndikwazi ukuhlala
phambi kokuba ndihambe ezweni, apho andizukubuya khona, ilizwe elimnyama, nelitye elincinane;
ilizwe elinobumnyama obunzulu bobusuku, nesithunzi esinzulu sokungaqiniseki; apho ukukhanya kunjengobumnyama.
Waphendula ke uSofari waseNaama, wathi,
Ingaba akufuneki ukuba kuphendulwe la mazwi onke? Ngaba umntu othetha kakhulu uya kubonisa ukuba ulungileyo?
Ingaba ukubhiyozela kwakho kwenza ukuba abantu baphumle? Xa usenza umxhwele uThixo, akufuneki kubekho umntu oza kukuxhaphaza?
Uthi kuThixo, Izinto endizikholelwayo zicocekile; Ndicocekile phambi kwakho.
Ke kaloku, ndinqwenele ukuba uThixo athethe, avule umlomo wakhe kuwe!
Ndinqwenela ukuba akuxelele izinto ezifihlakeleyo zobulumko; kuba ubulumko bunomtsalane obubini. Yazi ke loo nto, ukuba uThixo akakuxolelanga ngaphezu kwesono sakho.
Ungaziqonda na izinto ezinzulu zikaThixo? Ungazifumanisa na iziphelo zoMmandla Omkhulu?
Ziphezulu kunazo zonke izulu; ungazenza ntoni na? Ziphantsi kunesibhedlele. Ungazifunda ntoni na?
Ezi zide kunehlabathi, zibanzi kunelwandle.
Ukuba ke uThixo efika, ebeka umntu emgodini, eyambiza phambi komthetho, ngubani na oza kumthintela?
Uyazi ukuba ngubani na okhohlakeleyo; Xa ebona okubi, akayikuqapheli na?
Umntu okhohlakeleyo uya kuba ngumphefumlo, Xa i-esile emnyama izala umntu.
Ke wena, ukuba ubeke intliziyo yakho kuThixo, uphakamise izandla zakho kuye,
Ukuba uyasikhupha isono esikwisandla sakho, nokuba awuvumelenga umonakalo ukuba ahlale endlwini yakho;
Ke ngoko uya kukwazi ukuphakamisa ubuso bakho, ungabi necala; uza kuhlala uqinileyo, awunakuxoka.
Uza kuyilibala ingxaki yakho, Uza kuyikhumbula kuphela njengeelwandle ezidlulayo.
Ukuphila kwakho kuya kuba kukhanya kunemini; Nakuba kumnyama, kuya kuba ngobusuku.
Uya kuziva ukhuselekile, ngokuba kukho ithemba; uya kujonga ngapha nangapha, uphumle ngokukhuselekileyo.
Uya kuphumla, akukho namnye oza kukukhathaza; abantu abaninzi baya kufuna uxolo lwakho.
Ke kaloku amehlo oothixo aya kuphelelwa lithemba, Akuyi kubakho indlela yokuphuma kubo; Ukufa kuya kuba yithemba labo.
Waphendula uYobhi, wathi,
Ngokuqinisekileyo nibantu abanobulumko, yaye ubulumko buza kufa nani.
Ke mna ndinengqondo, njengokuba ninayo na; andibi ngaphantsi kwenu; ngubani na ongazizo ezi zinto zonketri.
Ndiye ndaba yinkcazo yabahlobo bam, ndibiza uThixo, ndaphendulwa; Ndiye ndaba ngumntu olungileyo ongenanto yobuxoki, yaye ndaba yinkcazo.
Amadoda akhululekileyo ajonge phantsi abo bakwingxaki; Bacinga ukuba ingxaki iya kubakho kubo abahamba ngeenyawo.
Iintyatyambo zabahlaseli zikhuselekile; Bakhuselekile abo bamangalisa uThixo, Abathabatha uThixo wabo esandla sabo.
Ke ngoko, ubuze iintaka, ziya kukuxelela; ubuze iintlanzi zezulu, ziza kukuxelela.
Okanye sithi kumhlaba, uya kukufundisa; Intlanzi yolwandle ithethe nawe.
Nguwuphi na phakathi kwezi zinto zonke ongaziyo ukuba isandla sikaYehova sisenza oku?
Umphefumlo wezinto zonke eziphilayo ukwisandla sakhe, Nefuthe lomntu ngamnye.
Indlebe ayivavanyi na amagama, njengokuba ulwimi ludla ukudla?
Ubulumko bufunyanwa phakathi kwabakhulu; Ulwazi luhamba nobude bexesha.
Kodwa ubulumko nobukrelekrele bukaThixo; Inyaniso nemfundiso ziye kuye.
Izinto azenzayo ukuba zilahle, azikwazi ukwakha kwakhona; nalapho ebeka umntu emgodini, akukho namnye zazikhupha.
Xa ethintela imvula, zonke izinto zitshisa; Xa evumela amanzi ukuba aphume, ziwalela umhlaba..
Intliziyo yakhe inamandla, intliziyo yakhe inobulungisa; Umkhohlisi nomkhohlisayo baphantsi kolawulo lwakhe.
Wabakhupha abacebisi, wabasusa yonke into; Wababeka abagwebi ukuba babe ngamagqwetha.
Uthabathe amandla amakumkani, Wabeka intsontelo emlonyeni wabo.
Wabathutha ababingeleli, abagxothwa ngazo zonke izinto; Wabakhupha abo babehlala ixesha elide.
Uyimisa intliziyo yabacebisi abathembekileyo, Uyisusa ingqondo elungileyo yabakhulu.
Ubanika ubuxoki abo balawulayo, Wabasusa amandla abo abanamandla.
Ubonisa izinto ezinzulu, ezifihlakeleyo emthunzini; Uzisa izithunzi ezinzulu kukukhanya.
Ukwenza iintlanga zibe mkhulu, waza uzicima; Ukwenza iintlanga zibe zikhulu, waza uzixhoma.
Uyisusa intliziyo yabaphathi behlabathi, Wabashiya bahamba-hamba emlilweni, apho akukho ndlela yokuhamba.
Bahamba ngeendawo ezimnyama, ngaphandle kokukhanya; Ukwenza ukuba bahambe ngaphaya-phaya njengezigulane.
Yabona, iliso lam lizibonile zonke ezi zinto; Indlebe yam yaziva, yaziqonda.
Into oyaziyo wena, ndiyayizi na; Andisayi kuba ngaphantsi kuwe.
Ke mna ndifuna ukuthetha noThixo Onamandla onke, Ndifuna ukuxelela uThixo ityala lam.
Nithi ke nina, nizifihla izinto ngobuxoki; ningamagqirha abengasebenziyo.
Ukuba ke niza kuphumla ngokupheleleyo, oko kuya kuba yinyaniso ukuba niyenze.
Nceda ke, niyiva into endiyithethayo; niyiqonde into endinayo yokuyithetha.
Ingaba uthetha ubuxoki kuThixo? Ingaba uthetha ubuxoki kuye?
Ingaba uya kuthatha inxaxheba yakhe? Ingaba uza kuthetha-thethana naye ngetyala lakhe?
Ingaba kuya kuba ngcono kuwe, ukuba akubone ngokungqongqo? Ungamxolela njani, njengokuba uxolela abantu?
Ngokuqinisekileyo uya kukuzilungisa ukuba uthathe inxaxheba ngokufihlakeleyo
Ingaba ubukhulu bakhe abuyi kukukhathaza na? Ingaba ukukhathazeka kwakhe akuyi kukuhlangula na?
Amabinzana akho anobulumko afana netyhefu; Iingcamango zakho zifana nodongwe, zingasebenzi.
Nceda uphumle, ndithethe; ke ngoko, nantoni na endinokuyenza, ikwenzeke.
Kutheni na ukuba ndibeke ubomi bam emngciphekweni, Ndiyithathe ubomi bam ngesandla sam?
Nakuba enze ukuba ndifa, yaye andifuni ukuthemba, Ndiya kuzikhusela indlela zam phambi kwakhe.
Ke kaloku ndiya kusindiswa, kuba akukho mntu ukhohlakeleyo oza kungena phambi kwakhe.
Nceda nicinge ngamazwi am, Nize zingenise ilizwi lam ezindlebeni zenu.
Yabona, ndiyilungiselele inkundla yam; Ndiyazi ukuba ndiza kubekwa phantsi.
Ingaba kukho umntu oza kumxelela ityala? Ukuba ke kunjalo, ndiya kuphumla ndifa.
Zonke ezi zinto zibini, Thixo, ndizinike; ngoko ke andizukufihla phambi kwakho:
Nciphisa isandla sakho kum, Musa ukumkhokela ngezinto zakho ezibuhlungu.
Ndithi ke ke, mnqamle, ndiphendule; Okanye ndithethe, wena uphendule.
Ingaba zininzi na iimpazamo zam, nezono zam endizenzayo? Nceda ndibonise inkohlakalo yam nesono sam.
Kutheni na ukuba ufihla ubuso bakho kum, Ungenza ndibe ngumchasi wakho?
Ingaba uyasikhathaza iphepha eliqhutywa ngamandla omoya? Ingaba uyakulandelela umqhaphu ongenamanzi?
Ubhalela phezu kwam izigwebo ezibuhlungu, Ndizihlawulele izono zam zexesha lam elincinci.
Uzibeka izinyawo zam emnqamlezweni, ujonge yonke intshukumo yam; Ubophelela umgca apho zihamba khona izandla zam.
Ndithi ke, Ndiza kuhlala ndifana nento ephukileyo, Njengempahla ethethwa ziintaka.
Wonke umntu ozalwa ngumntu wesifazane uphila ixesha elifutshane, ubomi bakhe buzele ziintlungu.
Sikhula sifana neentyatyambo, sizitshisa; Siphela sifana nesithunzi, asiyi kuhlala.
Ingaba uyayimisa iliso lakho kumfana nam? Ngaba uya kundibeka phambi komthetho, ukuze ndigwetywe nguThixo?
Nguwuphi na ongenza into ecocekileyo evela kwinto engalunganga? Akukho namnye.
Uya kumisela ubude bemihla yokuphila komntu; ubeka inani leentsuku zakhe, ubeka imida engadlulanga kuyo.
Musani ke ngoko ukumbona, shiya ukuba aphumle, de aphele imihla yakhe njengokuba ngumqeshwa.
Intyatyambo inethemba; Ukuba iqhutywe, iya kukhula kwakhona, Iimbewu ezintsha ziyaqhubeka zikhula.
Iingcambu zayo ziya kuba zikhulu ehlabathini, Intloko yayo iya kufa emlilweni;
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yevumba lamanzi, iya kukhula, ikhuphe iziqhamo ezintsha, njengentyatyambo encinci.
Ke kaloku umntu ufa, ubekwe phantsi; Uphuma umphefumlo wakhe ophelileyo, uyaphi?
Ngokuba amanzi aphuma emlanjeni, Umlambo utshisa, uyeke;
Ke kaloku abantu baya kuphumla, bangavumi ukuvuka; Kude kube ziphelile izulu, abayi kuvuka, bangavuthwa ephupheni labo.
Ndiyathemba ukuba uyandifihla entolongweni, Undifihla kude kube liphelile inkanuko yakho; Ndiyathemba ukuba umisela ixesha lokumkhumbula.
Ukuba umntu ufile, angaphila na? Ndiya kulinde iintsuku zonke zomsebenzi wam onzima, Ude kube kufike ukukhulula kwam.
Uza kundibiza, ndiya kukuphendula; uza kunqwenela ukwenziwa kwezandla zakho.
Ke ngoko, uya kuzijonga iintshukumo zam; Kodwa awuyi kujonga isono sam.
Iimpazamo zam zazingcwatywa kwibhotile, Uza kuzifihla isono sam.
Ke kaloku, njengokuba umnxweme uphuma, uqhutywa, nelitye lisuka endaweni yayo,
njengokuba amanzi akhupha iithayile, namanzi emvula asusa umthi; ngoko ke uya kucima ithemba lomntu.
Uyamqwalasela kuqala, wayalela ukuba ahambe; Uguqula ubuso bakhe, uwuthutha.
Ukuba oonyana bakhe bahlonishwa, yena akayazi; ukuba bahlaliswa phantsi, yena akakubona.
Uziva kuphela iintlungu zesiqu sakhe, ulele kuphela ngenxa yakhe yena.
Waphendula ke uElifazi waseTeman, wathi,
Ingaba umntu onobulumko uya kuphendula ngeengcamango ezingasebenziyo, Uza kwenzakalisa ngokwakhe ngomoya oshushu?
Ingaba uya kuxoxa ngeelizwi ezingasebenziyo, neenkcazo ezingenamsebenzi?
Ke nina ke, nisusa ukholo kuThixo, nithintela abantu ukuba bangathandaza kuye.
Isono sakho sifundisa umlomo wakho ukuba uthethe ntoni na; Ukhetha ukuthetha njengokuba ngumntu onzima.
Umlomo wakho, hayi umlomo wam, uthetha kuwe; Imilebe yakho ithetha nawe.
Ingaba wena ungumntu ozalwa kuqala? Wadalwa na phambi kweentaba?
Ingaba uthetha ngezinto ezifihlakeleyo zikaThixo? Ingaba ucinga ukuba ungumntu owaziyo kuphela?
Uyazi ntoni na loo nto asiyaziyo? Uqonda ntoni na loo nto asiyiqondiyo?
Amadoda amadala, aneenwele ezingwevu, ecaleni lethu, amadoda aneminyaka emininzi kunaye uyise.
Ingaba akunyanzelekanga kuwe uxolo lukaThixo, namazwi amnandi athethayo kuni?
Kutheni le nto intliziyo yakho ikufuphi nawe? Kutheni le nto amehlo akho eqaqamba,
ukuze ubeke inkanuko yakho phambi koThixo, uzikhuphele ilizwi elinjalo emlonyeni wakho?
Nguwuphi umntu, ukuba abe mhle? Nguwuphi umntu ozalwa ngumbhinqa, ukuba abe mkhulu phambi koThixo?
Yabona, uThixo akakholwanga nakwiingelosi zakhe ezingcwele; Nasezizulu azicocekanga phambi kwakhe.
Uphi na ke umntu okhohlakeleyo, onobubi, osela isono njengeelwandle?
Yiva kum, ndiza kukuxelela; Ndiya kukuxelela into endiyibonayo,
ezo zifundiselwe ngabantu abanobulumko, ezithunyelweyo kubazali babo, zingafihli nto.
La lizwe lanikezelwa kubazalwana babo kuphela; akukho mntu wangaphandle wabakho phakathi kwabo.
Umntu okhohlakeleyo ubuhlungu bonke ubomi bakhe, Nazo zonke iinyanga ezibekwe ecaleni kumqolo.
Iindlebe zakhe zigcwele ilizwi elibuhlungu; Xa izinto zibonakala zikhululekile, umonakalo uhlasela.
Akakholwanga ukuba uya kuphuma emthunzini; Ikrele lilindelwe kuye.
Ujikeleza ekhangela ukutya, esithi, Kuphi na? Uyazi ukuba imini yobumnyama ifutshane.
Intlungu noxinzelelo luya kumkhulisa, Ziye ziwukhulule njengokumkani olungiselela ukuhlasela.
Ngokuba watshisa isandla sakhe kuThixo, waza wabhiyozela uThixo Onamandla onke.
Wathi uThixo, ngemikhosi eqinileyo nenamandla.
Intloko yakhe iqulethe umgubo, Umqolo wakhe uthambileyo ngawo.
Uya kuhlala edolophini elinqumlayo, endlwini engahlali kuyo umntu, endlwini ethe yafa ibe yimihlaba.
Akuyi kuhlala ephilile, Amandla akhe akayi kuqhubeka; Izinto zakhe aziyi kusasazeka kwilizwe.
Akuyi kuphuma emthunzini; Umlilo uya kutshisa iziqhamo zayo, Umoya womlomo kaThixo uya kumthabatha.
Akufanele akhohlise yena ngokwakhe, ethemba into engasebenziyo; ngokuba akuyi kufumana nto isebenza.
Imali yakhe iya kuhlawuliswa ngokupheleleyo phambi kwexesha lakhe; Iziqhamo zakhe aziyi kuba luhlaza.
Uya kuba njengomthi weentyatyambo, okhupha iziqhamo zakhe ezingapheliyo; njengomthi weolibhi, okhupha iintyatyambo zakhe.
Iqela lamadoda akhohlakeleyo alizukuba nabantwana; Umlilo uya kuzitshisa izindlu zalabo abathanda umnikelo.
Bacinga ububi, bazala ububi; Intliziyo yabo icinga ubuxoki mihla le.
Waphendula uYobhi, wathi,
Wathi ke uYakobi, Ndiziva izinto ezininzi ezinjalo ngaphambili; niyimiphefumlo emibi yonke.
Ingaba ukuthetha kwakho okude akusoze kuphele? Yintoni enokukukhathaza, ukuba uqhubeka uthetha-thethwana?
Ndiya kukwazi ukuthetha ngendlela oyithethayo, ukuba ungumntu wam; ndiya kwenza izithethe ezilungileyo kuwe, ndiyitshise intloko yam kuwe.
Ke mna ndiya kukuxelela ngelizwi lam, Ndiya kukuxelela ngoxolo lwam, Ndiya kukuxelela ngomsindo wam.
Ukuba ndithetha, intlungu yam ayiyi kuphuma; Ukuba ndinyamalala, ayiyi kushiya.
Ngokuqinisekileyo, Thixo, uyandiphazamisa; Uyithatha yonke indlu yam.
Ungenza ukuba ndikhube, ibe yinkcazo kum; Intlungu yam iphakame, ithethe kum.
UThixo, emnqamlezweni wakhe, wanqumla, wanqumla kum; Wagquma iinwele zakhe kum; Umchasi wam ujonge kum ngamehlo aphikisayo.
Bawuvula umlomo wabo ngokubanzi, bendixolela; Bemcofa imilenze yam, bendixhaphaza; Bonke badibana kum.
UThixo wandinikela kubantu ababi, Wandibeka esandla somntu ongenabulungisa.
Ndaphila ngoxolo, ke yena wandiphucula; Wamtsala ngeentloko zam, wandiseka ngamatye am; Wandibeka ukuba ndibe yinjongo yakhe.
Abaqhoboshi bakhe banxibelelene nam; Uyitshisa imithambo yam, angazixoleli; Uyikhupha imithambo yam ehlabathini.
Iindonga zam ziye zaqhutywa, Ziye zaqhutywa; Wathi kum njengendoda enamandla.
Ndizigqobhoza iinwele zam phantsi kwesikhumba sam, Ndiyifihla inkulumo yam emnqamlezeni.
Ubuso bam bubomvu ngenxa yokholo, Izithunzi ezimnyama zijikeleza amehlo am.
Ke izandla zam azisebenzisi ububi; Umthandazo wam ucocekile.
Umhlaba, musa ukugubungela igazi lam; Musa ukuba uxolo lwam lwezobulungisa lube lusizi.
Ngoku ke, umshushisi wam ukwizulu; Umthunywa wam ephakamileyo.
Abahlobo bam bandiseka kum; Amehlo am aphuma emlonyeni kaThixo.
Ndifuna ukuba kubekho umntu oza kumcela uThixo ngenxa yam, njengokuba umntu ethandaza ngenxa yomhlobo wakhe.
Kwiminyaka embalwa kuphela ndiya kuhamba kwindlela apho andizukubuya khona.
Umphefumlo wam uqhutywe, Imihla yam iphele; Umhlaba wokufa undilindela.
Abamxolelayo bamijikeleza, Ndimele ndibabone bendixhaphaza.
UThixo, nceda uncede mna ngokwakho; Nguwuphi omnye oza kunenza umyalelo kum?
Uvale intliziyo yabo ukuba ingaqondi, ukuze ungabavumelanga baphumelele.
Ukuba umntu ubuyela kumhlobo wakhe ngenxa yomvuzo, abantwana bakhe baya kuphulukana nayo.
UThixo wandibeka phantsi koxinzelelo phakathi kwabantu, Bathi baphuca emlonyeni wam.
Amehlo am amnyama ngenxa yoxinzelelo; Intliziyo yam yonke incinci njengesithunzi.
Amadoda athembekileyo anqunyulwa ngale nto; Abangenasono baphazamiseka ngenxa yobuxoki.
Ke kaloku abantu abalungileyo baqhubeka behamba ngendlela elungileyo, Nabo abanezandla ezicocekileyo baya kukhula ke kancinci.
Ke nina, buyelani, nizame kwakhona; andizukufumana mntu owaziyo phakathi kwenu.
Iintsuku zam zigqityiwe, Izigqibo zam zilahlekile, Nazo zonke iimfuno zentliziyo yam.
Baguqula ubusuku bubemini, besithi, Ukukhanya kufutshane, xa kumnyama.
Ukuba ikhaya lam kuphela elilindelwe ngukufa, Ukuba ndiya kwenza ibhedi yam emnyamani,
Ukuba ndithi kumngxunya, Ubaba wam ukho wena; nomhlaza, Umama wam ukho wena, nodade wam ukho wena;
Yintoni ke ngoko ithemba lam? Nguwuphi oza kundibona ndinethemba?
Ingaba ithemba lam liya kutshona nam ezingcebeni zesihlwele? Ingaba siza kuhla ndawonye emlilweni?"
Waphendula ke uBiledi waseShuha, wathi,
Uza kuhlala ixesha elingakanani ukhangela amagama? Khumbula kuqala, ke ngoko sithethe.
Uthini na ukuba nithi sinyama? Uthini na ukuba nithi si Puntland?
Uyamcaphukisa wena ngokwakho ngobuxoki bakho. Ingaba ihlabathi liya kushiya ukungabikho ngenxa yakho? Ingaba iithayile ziya kususwa kwiindawo zabo ngenxa yakho?
Ukukhanya komntu ongalunganga kuya kutshisa; Umnqamlezo womlilo wakhe uya kuphelela ukutsha.
Ukukhanya kwetentile yakhe kuya kuba mnyama; Ilanga elingasemva kwakhe liya kutshisa.
Amanyathelo akhe aqinileyo aya kuba mancinci; Iingcamango zakhe ziya kumtshisa.
Iinwele zakhe ziye zathisa kuye kwingxowa, Wahamba ngokuthe ngqo kumagxa ayo.
Inqwelo iyamtsala ngomlenze wakhe, Umgquba uyamkhusela ngokuqinileyo.
Intsontelo ifihlakele phezu kwakhe ehlabathini, Nobuxoki bubekwe kwindawo yakhe.
Iingozi ziye zamkhulisa ngazo zonke iinkalo, Ziya kumthobela ngemizuzwana.
Ubuthathaka ngenxa yendlala, Intlungu ilungiselelwe kuye xa ewela.
Isifo sidla isikhumba sakhe; Umntwana wokuqala wokufa udla izihlunu zakhe nemilenze.
Usuka kwindawo ekhuselekileyo yetentile yakhe, waphuma waya kukumkani weengozi.
Amanye amazwe ahlala kwitentile yakhe, I-sulfure eshushu iqhutywa phezu kwendlu yakhe.
Iingcambu zayo zitshisa phantsi, Iziqhamo zayo zitshisa phezulu.
Akukho namnye ehlabathini oyamkhumbulayo; akukho namnye ezweni owazi igama lakhe.
Uqhutywa esuka kukukhanya waya emthunzini, uqhutywa ngaphandle kwehlabathi.
Akubakho abantwana bakhe, nabantwana bakanyana bakhe, phakathi kwabantu bakhe; Akukho namnye ushiyekayo endlwini yakhe.
Amadoda aphumayo emva kwakhe, ebona into eya kwenzeka kuye, ayakhathaza; njengokuba abo bangaphambili babekhathaza.
Ngokuqinisekileyo oku kuya kwenzeka kumakhaya abantu ababi; oko kubangela ukufa kwabo bangazi uThixo.
Waphendula uYobhi, wathi,
Ingaba uya kuniphazamisa ixesha elingakanani na, uye unyuse ngamazwi akho?
Kuthi ke ngoku, ngaphezu kweentsuku ezilishumi, nindixhaphaze; Nindihlasele ngaphandle kokungakhathali.
Nakuba yinyaniso ukuba ndenze okubi, iimpazamo zam zinikele kum ngokwam.
Ukuba ke nifuna ukuba ngcono kuni, nakuba mna, ukuze niyisebenzise inkanuko yam njengobungqina kum;
Uyazi ke, ukuba uThixo unyanzeleka kum, Wamthabatha mna emtyeni wakhe.
Nditsho ndithi, Nceda, nceda! Ndinyanzeleka; kodwa akukho mntu uphendulayo kum. Nditsho ndicela uncedo, kodwa akukho mthetho.
UThixo wavala indlela yam, ndisakwazi ukudlula; Wazigubungela iindlela zam ngokukhanya.
Wayisusa inkulumo yam, Yayikhupha isithsaba entliziyweni yam.
Unditshisa ngazo zonke iinkalo, Ndize ndiphele; Wakhupha umnqweno wam njengetyiwa.
Inkanuko yakhe iqhuma kum, Icinga ukuba ndingumnye wabachasi bakhe.
Iinqanawa zakhe zithe zadibana, Zazilungisa iimbandezelo zokulwa nam, Zenza izikhululo ezijikeleze intente yam.
Abazalwana bam abagxotha kude kum; Intsapho yam eyaziyo iphucukile.
Abahlobo bam bahamba, Abahlobo bam abathandekayo bayandilibala.
Abamelwane bam, neentombi zam ezikhonzanzana, bandisela kum njengokuba ndingumnye umntu; Ba bonwabela kum njengokuba ndingumnye umntu.
Ndimbiza umkhonzi wam, akawuphendulanga; Nakuba ndimcela uncedo.
Uphefumlo lwam olungathandekiyo kumyeni wam; Abazalwana bam bangazithandanga.
Nabantwana abancinci bajonge phantsi kum; Xa ndiphuma, bendixelela.
Bonke abazalwana bam abathandekayo bandiyichukumisa; Abandithandayo batshintshela kum.
Ndiyisikhumba, ndiyimithambo kuphela; Ndiye ndakhuseleka ngesikhumba samazinyo am.
Nceda mncede, bazalwana bam! Nceda mncede; Kuba isandla sikaThixo sindise.
Kutheni na ke nindiphazamisa njengokuba uThixo ephazamisa? Ingaba ungenawo umonakalo omkhulu kumzimba wam?
Ndinqwenela ukuba ibhalwe amagama am, Ndinqwenela ukuba abhalwe kwincwadi!
Ndinqwenele ukuba zitywinwe emthini ngonaphakade ngesixhobo sentsimbi, zibe zigcwele isilivere!
Ke mna ndiyazi ukuba uphila lowo undisindisayo; Kwixesha elizayo uya kuhlala ehlabathini.
Nakuba ulusu lwam luphelelwe lixesha, ndiya kubona uThixo ngenyama yam.
Ndiya kumbona ecaleni lam; ndiya kumbona ngamehlo am, hayi njengendoda engaziwayo. Yintoni na intliziyo yam inqwenela loomini!
Ukuba nithi, Siyamthobela; kuba isiseko sengxaki sikhona kuye;
ke ngoko, niyihloniphe intliziyo yenu ikrele; kuba uzuko lukaThixo luya kwenza umgwebo ngekrele, ukuze nikwazi ukuba kukho uhlolo.
Waphendula ke uSofari waseNaama, wathi,
Iimvakalelo zam eziphazamisayo zenza ukuba ndiphendule, ngokuba ndinoxinzelelo olukhulu ngaphakathi.
Ndiziva izicaphuno zenu, ezindikhaphazelayo; Intliziyo yam ibonisa ukuba ndiphendule.
Kuba niyazi loo nto, ukususela kwixesha elidlulileyo lide, ukususela ekubeni abantu babekwe emhlabeni,
Uthando lwabantu ababi luya kuba lifutshane; Uthando lwabakhohlakeleyo luya kuba yimizuzu embalwa.
Nakuba ubutyebi babo bufike emazulwini, Nakuba iinwele zabo zithabathe amafu,
Baya kuphelelwa ngonaphakade, njengamakhoboka abo; abawaziyo baya kusithi, Baphi na?
Zihamba njengephupha, azifumaneki; ziqhutywa njengembono yobusuku. Zihamba njengephupha, azifumaneki.
Iinwele ezibabonayo aziyi kubabona kwakhona; Indawo yabo ayizukubabona kwakhona.
Abantwana babo baya kucela uncedo kumahlwempu; Baya kuphinda babuyisele iimpahla zabo, abazithathele.
Intliziyo yabo yayizele ngamandla omntwana; ke loo mandla aya kuphumla nabo emlilweni.
Ububi lumnandi emlonyeni wabo, Bazifihla phantsi kweelwimi zabo.
Bayithanda loo nto, abafuni ukuyishiya ihambe; bayigcina emlonyeni wabo.
Ke kaloku ukutya kwabo kuguquka lube lutyhefu emlonyeni wabo, Kube lufana nomhlaza obulalayo ngaphakathi kwabo.
Bathe badla ilifa, baya kulityhala; UThixo uya kubabuyisela izitho zabo.
Ziya kuphumla inkunkuma yenkcubeko. Iinwele zenkcubeko enobungozi ziya kuzibulala.
Akuyi kubakho ukuzonwabisa kweelwandle, nemilambo ethe tyaba ngenyathelo nobisi.
Baya kuphinda babuyisele into abasebenzele yona, bangayidla; Abayi kuyonwabela intlawulo yorhwebo lwabo.
Le nto, ngenxa yokuba baphulaphule amahlwempu, babashiya bengenanto; bathathe izindlu abazange bazenza.
Iinyembezi zabo azizange zikhululwe; ngoko ke, abayi kukwazi ukusindisa nantoni na yazo izinto ababezithandayo.
Akukho nto ishiyekayo, emva kokuba bayile konke; ke ngoko, ubutyebi babo abuyi kuhlala.
Ke kaloku, xa begcwele, intlungu iya kubaphulaphula; Inkanuko epheleleyo yobubi iya kubuya kubo.
Ke kaloku, xa bezele izibeleko zabo, uThixo uya kutywina phezu kwabo inkanuko yakhe eshushu; imvula iya kubathutha phezu kwabo, xa bedla.
Baya kuhamba phambi kwesixhobo sentsimbi, kodwa umqolo wegolide uya kubatyhala.
Bayikhupha emqolo wabo, Icala eliqaqambileyo liphuma engqondweni yabo; Uxinzelelo luya kuba phezu kwabo.
Umnyama opheleleyo ulinde iimpahla zabo; Umnquba ongenakuqhutywa ngumntu uya kuwatshisa, Wazibulala zonke izinto eziseleyo kwizindlu zabo.
Izulu liza kubonisa ububi babo, Ihlabathi liza kubeka isandla sayo kubo.
Ulwandle luya kuzisusa izindlu zawo, Amanzi ahamba ngamandla emini yobuxoki bukaThixo.
Le nto uThixo ayifumeneyo kubantu ababi; le nto uThixo ayemnika yona njengenxalenye yabo.
Waphendula uYobhi, wathi,
Nceda, qaphela into endithethayo; Le nto ibe yintlonipho endiyinikayo.
Xa ndithethayo, nilindeni; xa ndithe ndathethayo, qhubekani nindixolela.
Mna ndilumkisa umntu na? Kutheni ndingabi noxinzelelo lwam?
Nceda ujonge kum, uyeke ukukhathazeka; ubeke isandla sakho emlonyeni wakho.
Xa ndicinga ngaloo nto, ndiza kukhathazeka, isiqu sam siqhutywa.
Kutheni na ukuba abantu ababi bahlale bephila? Bakhula ubomi babo, baba namandla.
Abantwana babo bakhula ngaphesheya kwabo, Babona oonyana babo.
Izindlu zabo zikhuselekile, azikho uxinzelelo; UThixo akawaphazamisi.
Iinkomo zazo aziyi kuphulukana nokuzala; Inkunzi yazo ikhulelwa, ayilahleki inkunzi yayo.
Bakhupha abantwana babo njengeqela leentlanzi; Abantwana babo badlala ngokujikeleza.
Bavuma ngemiculo yeentsontelo, neengxowa-ngoma; Badlala ngesandi sentsimbi eshushu.
Bachitha ubomi babo ekufumaneni izinto ezilungileyo, Bawela emfazweni ngoxolo.
Bathi ke kuThixo, Ushiye nathi; Asifuni ukukwazi iindlela zakho.
Nguwuphi uThixo Onamandla onke, ukuba sikhonzane naye? Siza kufumana ntoni ukuthandaza kuye?"
Ke kaloku ubomi babo abukho esandla sabo; Ndiya kuzama ukungazithobeli izigqibo zababi.
Ingaba iphi na ilanga lezinto ezibi eliya kutshisa? Ingaba iphi na intlungu esiya kuthi kubo? Ingaba iphi na uThixo oza kuwagwebisa ngoxolo lwakhe?
Ingaba bahlala ixesha elingakanani befana nomthi oqhutywa ngamandla omoya, nanjengeziqhamo ezithunyelwe yimvula?
Nithi, UThixo uya kukhusela ubundlobongela babo kubomi bomntwana wabo; bagwetywe nguThixo ngokwabo, bayazi.
Baze babone ububi babo ngamehlo abo; Baze basele inkanuko yoThixo Onamandla onke.
Kutheni kufuneka bakhathalele ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kusapho lwabo emva kokuba befa kwaye ixesha labo liphelile?
Ingaba umntu unokumfundisa nantoni na uThixo, ukuba yena ubala abo basemhlabeni?
Umntu omnye ufa ngelixa eqhubeka enamandla, ekhululekile ngokupheleleyo kwaye ephumle.
Intliziyo yakhe isempilweni, amathambo akhe anamandla, aphilile.
Umnye umntu ufa entliziyweni ethambileyo, engazange ayonwabele nto ilungileyo.
Ke kaloku bobabini baphumla emhlabathini, iintsholongwane zizigubungela bonke.
Yabona, ndiyazi iimvakalelo zenu, neengcamango zenu zokungcula.
Nithi, Yintoni na ngoku indlu yomntu omkhulu? Yintoni na itente apho ababi behlala khona?
Awazibuza na abo bahambayo? Awaziva na izihloko zabo?
Amadoda amabi agcinwa emini yentlungu, Emini yobuxoki bakaThixo bakhuselwa.
Nguwuphi na lowo ubaxelela ngamehlo abo ukuba bayenze ntoni na? Nguwuphi na lowo ubahlawula ngokwenza kwabo?
Bathabatha impahla yabo engqondweni, Amadoda akhusela izibingelelo zabo.
Umhlaba wendawo eselunxwemeni ucocekile kubo; bonke balandela emva kwabo, njengokuba abantu abaninzi behamba phambi kwabo.
Ungandixolisa njani ke ngelizwi lenu elingenanto? Iimpendulo zenu aziyi kubakho nanye, kodwa ububi.
Waphendula ke uElifazi waseTeman, wathi,
Ingaba umntu unokufezekisa ntoni na kuThixo? Nakuba ngumntu owaziyo, uyafezekisa yena kuphela.
Ingaba uThixo Onamandla onke unokuyonwabela, ukuba ungumntu olungileyo? Ingaba uya kufumana nantoni na, ukuba umphefumlo wakho ungabikho monakalo?
Ingaba ngenxa yokuba uyamkhathalela yena, ke ngoko uyakuxolela, uze ufike emthethweni?
Hayi, ngenxa yokuba ububi bakho bukhulu kakhulu, nezono zakho aziphelelanga.
Wathabatha iimpahla zakwabazalwana bakho, waza wazenza zibe yindawo yokuxolela, ngaphandle kwesizathu esilungileyo; uthabathe izihlangu zamadoda, wabashiya bengwevu.
Amanzi awawanikelanga abantu abathambileyo, Nakudla kwabo bafunayo.
Uye waba ngumntu onamandla, ulawula ilizwe; ube ngumntu othandekayo, uhlala kulo.
Iinkosikazi uzithutha zingenanto, Utshisa ubutyebi beentlanga.
Le nto isenza ukuba kubekho iintshaba ngaphaya kwakho, noxinzelelo olukhawulezayo luza kukuxelela.
Yiyo loo nto kumnyama kakhulu, ukuba ungabonanga; Ulwandle lwamanzi luya kukugubungela.
UThixo akasekho na phezulu emazulwini? Khangela ukuba ziphakame njani iinkwenkwezi ezisentshonalanga!
Ke nina nithi, UThixo uyazi ntoni na? Ingaba uya kugqiba phakathi kokukhanya okunzulu?
Amafu aqinileyo amfihla, ukuze asibone, xa ehamba phezu kophahla lwezulu.
Ingaba uya kuhlala kwindlela yakudala, Abafileyo behamba ngayo?
Bathunyelwe phambi kwexesha labo; Iziseko zabo zaqhutywa ngamanzi ashushu.
Bathi kuThixo, Sishiye; Unamandla onke angakwenza ntoni kuthi?
Ke kaloku uThixo wayezigcwele izindlu zabo ngezinto ezilungileyo; Ndingathandabuzi ukuba ndithathe inxaxheba kwiingcebiso zababi.
Abantu abalungileyo bebona ukulahleka kwabo, bayavuya; Abangenabulungisa baya kudlala nabo, bathi,
Abathunywa bethu bakhululwe, Umlilo utshisa ilifa lezinto zabo ezilungileyo.
Yazi uThixo, yenza uxolo naye; ke ngoko ziya kuza kuni izinto ezilungileyo.
Yamkela umthetho emlonyeni wakhe, Gcina amazwi akhe entliziyweni yakho.
Ukuba ubuyela kuThixo Onamandla onke, uya kwakhiwa kwakhona; Yisuse ububi kude nekhaya lakho.
Igolide yakho uyithule emthethweni, Igolide yakho elungileyo phakathi kwamatye entaba.
Ke uThixo Onamandla onke uya kuba yigolide yakho, nesilivere yakho entle.
Ke ngoko uya kuthandazela kuThixo Onamandla onke, Ukhuphe ubuso bakho kuThixo.
Uya kuthandaza kuye, yena uya kukuphendula; nawe uya kuzigcina izibingelelo zakho zakhe.
Nantoni na oza kuyigqiba ukuba uyiyenze, iya kuphumelela; Ukukhanya kuya kuqaqamba endlela yakho.
Xa abantu bephantsi, usithi, Baphakame! UThixo uya kusindisa abo baphantsi.
Uya kusindisa nalowo unetyala; uya kusindiswa, ngenxa yokuba izandla zakho zicocekile.
Waphendula uYobhi, wathi,
Ngokuba mna namhlanje ndivutha ngobuhlungu; Isandla sikaThixo sinzima kum, Nakuba ndiphucula.
Ndiyakuthanda ukuba ndiyazi apho ndingawufumana khona, Ndiyakuthanda ukuba ndifike apho ehlala khona!
Ndiya kubeka ityala lam phambi kwakhe, Ndiza kugcwalisa umlomo wam ngezinto ezichaseneyo.
Ndiza kwazi ukuba uya kumphendula njani, Ndiya kuqonda into athethayo kum.
Ingaba uya kumxelela ngesandla sakhe esikhulu? Hayi, uya kundiphulaphula.
Kwakhona umntu othembekileyo unokucinga naye; Umgwebi wam uya kundikhulula ngonaphakade.
Ukuba ndiya kumntla, akakho; ukuba ndiya kumzantsi, andikwazi ukumfumana.
Xa esenza umsebenzi wakhe emazantsi, andikubonanga; Xa ejikeleza ekumntla, andikwazi ukumbona.
Ke yena uyazi indlela endiyithathayo; Xa endivavanya, ndiya kuphuma ndicocekile njengegolide.
Izinyawo zam zihamba ngaphaya kwezikhokelo zakhe; Ndiyigcina indlela yakhe, Andiyi kuphuma.
Andiyi kuphuma kwimimiselo yemilomo yakhe; Ndiyigcine ilizwi lakhe lingaphezu kwesonka sam sosuku nosuku.
Ke yena ke uThixo, yena kuphela; Nguwuphi na lowo unokumelana naye? Ukwenza konke okunqwenela.
Uya kumenza into ayifumeneyo, yaye kukho izinto ezininzi azifunayo njengezo.
Ke ngoko, xa ndiyicinga loo nto, ndiza kukhathazeka phambi kwakhe; kwaye xa ndicinga ngaloo nto, ndizoyika kuye.
UThixo wayenza intliziyo yam ikhubazeke, UThixo Onamandla onke wandixelela.
Ke mna andinakucinywa ngukukhanya, Ngubumnyama obugqwesileyo obugubungela ibuso bam.
Kutheni na ukuba uThixo Onamandla onke abeke imihla yokugweba? Kutheni na ukuba abo bayaziyo bangaziboni iintsuku ezi?
Baninzi abantu abajika iithayile zesiphelo, bathabathe ilizwe; bathabathe izimvu, bazibeke ezityeni zabo.
Bakhupha inkunzi yebhokhwe yomntwana, Beyithatha inkomo yowesifazane ibe yityala.
Bakhupha abafazi abafileyo ecaleni kwendlela, Nabo bonke abafazi belizwe bafihla.
Abafazi baphuma besebenza, befuna ukutya; Umhlaba omnyama ubanika ukutya oonyana babo, njengokuba iinkunzi zebhokhwe ziphila engqondweni.
Bonisa iziqhamo ezindaweni zabanye abantu, Bathabathe iinkomo ezishiyekileyo kwizityalo zewayini zababi.
Bachitha imini bemnyama, bengenazigqomo, bengenanto yokuzikhusela ebusika.
Zixutywe ziimvula zaselunxwemeni kwaye ziqwalasela iithayile kuba azikho indawo yokukhusela.
Abanye abantu bathatha abantwana abancinci emabeleni eentsapho zabo. Bathatha abantwana abancinci bemihlwempu ukuba babe yimali yokuhlawula.
Ke kaloku abafazi bahamba bengatshatanga, bengenazinto zokugqoka; bethwala iziqwengana zeziqhamo, kodwa behlala begula.
Batshisa iolives phakathi kweengcango zabasemagunyeni, batshisa iziqhamo kwiingxowa zewayini, kodwa baya kuthethwa.
Amadoda anqumle edolophini enobungozi, Abadutyiweyo bathandaza; Ke uThixo akayazi ukuba kukho into engaphaya.
Baninzi abantu abakhohlisayo ukukhanya, Abazi iindlela zalo, Bathi bangabikho kwimizila yalo.
Umfazi uvuka ngemini, ebulala umhlwempu nomnelisekayo; Ngobusuku usebenza njengothothi.
Umntu ohlala nomyeni womnye umntu, ulinde kusasa; Uthi, Akukho mntu uya kundibona; ngoko ke ufihla ibuso bakhe.
Kwixesha elimnyama, abahlaseli bafika endlwini. Ngemini bavala ikhaya labo. Bafuna ukuba nento yokuyenza nokukhanya.
Kubo bonke, ubusuku bufana nobumnyama obunzulu; Bahlobo bezinto ezibuhlungu zesithunzi.
Baye bafana nefuthe elihamba emanzini; Inxalenye yabo yelizwe ilahlekile, Akukho namnye oza kwiintyatyambo zazo.
Njengoko ubushushu nexesha elibandayo litshisa ikhephu, Ngokuba umlilo uthabathela abo bathini na.
Amama abo ayawalibala; Iintsholongwane zidla ngazo, Akukho namnye owazikhumbulayo; Ngokuba ububi buqhutywa njengokhuni.
Basebenzisana nabafazi abangenabantwana, Abafazi abanendodakazi ababuxhasi.
Ke kaloku uThixo unqula abanamandla ngegunya lakhe; Nakuba babonakala benamandla, bangaqinisekanga ngobomi babo.
UThixo uya kubavumela ukuba bahlale bekhuselekile; Amehlo akhe ajonge iindlela zabo.
Bakhulula ixesha elincinci, baphuma; bahlaliswa phantsi, baqhutywa njengezinye iintlanga zonke; bakhutshwa njengeziqhamo zengqolowa.
Ukuba ke akunjalo, ngubani na oza kundibonisa ukuba ndingumxoki, nokuba amagama am angabi nto?
Waphendula ke uBiledi waseShuha, wathi,
UThixo ungukumkani, niyamhlonele; Ukwenza uxolo emazulwini aphakamileyo.
Ingaba umntu unokulinganisa amaqela akhe? Nguwuphi na umntu ongenakukhanya kwakhe?
Ke ngoko, umntu angathini na ukuba ngumntu olungileyo phambi koThixo? Ozalelwa ngabafazi angathini na ukuba ungcwele?
Ukuba inyanga nayo ayikhanyanga, Neenkwenkwezi azicocekanga phambi kwakhe;
kungekhona njani na umntu, onguye iintaka kuphela, nomuntu, onguye intsholongwane kuphela?
Waphendula uYobhi, wathi,
Uthini na uncedo lwakho kumntu ongenamandla? Uthini na ukusindisa kwakho isandla esinganamandla!
Yintoni na le mfundiso elungileyo oyinika umntu ongenabulumko? Yintoni na ingqondo entle oyibonisayo!
Nguwuphi umphefumlo wakho owenza ukuba uthethe la mazwi? Nguwuphi umphefumlo wakho othetha ngawe?
Iziphefumlo zezinto ezifileyo zitshisa, Eziphantsi kwamanzi, nazo zonke ezihlala apho.
Isibhedlele sivuliwe phambi koThixo; Indawo yokufa ayifuni ukukhuselwa.
Umisa izulu lasentshonalanga phezu komhlaba ongenanto, Wabeka umhlaba phantsi kwezinto ezingakhoyo.
Ubeka amanzi emazulwini akhe aqinileyo; Amazulu angaphuka ngenxa yobunzima bayo.
Ugubungela ubuso benyanga egcweleyo, Ukhupha amafu akhe phezu kwayo.
Ubophelela umda phezu kobuso bamanzi, Umda phakathi kokukhanya nobumnyama.
Iindonga zezulu zicinezela, Ziyixabise inyaniso yakhe xa ethetha.
Wamisa ulwandle ngobukrelekrele bakhe, Wabulala iRahabhi inkulu ngengqondo yakhe.
Ngokuphefumla kwakhe, izulu lakhanya; Isandla sakhe satshisa intaka ehambayo.
Ke kaloku ezi zinto ziyinxalenye kuphela yezinto azenzayo; siziva nje ilizwi lakhe elincinci. Nguwuphi na okwaziyo uthuthu lwamandla akhe?
UJob waqhubeka ethetha:
Ngokuba Thixo uphilayo, owandisela umyalelo wam, UThixo Onamandla onke, owenza intliziyo yam ibuhlungu,
Ngokuba ubomi bam bukhona kum, Nomoya kaThixo ukho emlonyeni wam,
Imilomo yam ayizukuthetha into elungileyo, Ulwimi lwam aluyi kuthetha ubuxoki.
Andiyi kukuxelela ukuba ungumntu olungileyo; Ndiya kuqhubeka ndithi ndingenakubi, kude kube limini endifa.
Ndiya kuqinisa inyaniso yam, Andiyi kuyishiya; Intliziyo yam ayizukundigweba yonke imihla yam.
Umnqamlezo wam ahlale efana nomntu ongalunganga, Nalowo uhamba mna ahlale efana nomntu ophuzi.
Ingaba kukho ithemba elingenanto kumadoda angakholwayo, xa uThixo athabathela umphefumlo wabo?
Ingaba uThixo uya kuyiva intloko yabo, Xa ingxaki ifika kubo?
Ingaba baya kuthandazela kuThixo Onamandla onke? Ingaba baya kubiza uThixo ixesha lonke?
Ndiya kukuxelela igunya likaThixo; Andiyi kufihla into ayenzayo lowo Mkhulu.
Nizibone ke zonke; nithetha ntoni na ngoko izinto ezingalunganga ezi?
Le nto uThixo ayifumeneyo kubantu ababi, Ngubani na oza kuyifumana inyaniso kummandla wonke?
Baya kubaninzi oonyana babo, kodwa ikrele liya kuwabulala; usapho lwabo aluyi kupheka ngonaphakade.
Isifo siya kuwabulala abo baphilayo; abafazi babo abangamabhinqa baya kutyhala.
Baya kubeka isilivere njengamafu, nempahla njengemigqomo yomhlaba.
Ke kaloku abantu abalungileyo baya kuzigqoka ezo mpahla, nabasetyhini abanobulungisa baya kuzonwabisa isilivere.
Iindlu zabo bazenza zifana nekhabhathi ye-moth, njengekhabhathi ebekwe ngumgcini ezweni.
Baya kuhlala bephilile, kodwa kuya kuba ngumhla ophelileyo; Xa bevula amehlo abo, zonke izinto ziphela.
Izidumbu ziwela phezu kwabo, Inkungu ithabathela ngasebusuku.
Umoya wasempumalanga uyawathabatha, bahamba; Wabasusa esuka kwindawo yabo.
Iphefumla phezu kwabo ngaphandle kobulumko, Xa befuna ukuyeka amandla ayo.
Ibetha izandla zayo ngazo, itshisa ngazo xa zishiya indawo yazo.
Zikhona izityalo apho isilivere ifumaneka khona, kunye neendawo apho igolide icocwa khona.
Intsimbi ithathwa ehlabathini, Intsingiselo iqhutywa emtyeni.
Abatyali-mali bazisa ukukhanya emthunzini; Bafuna kwiindawo ezinzulu iithayile ezifihlakeleyo emthunzini.
Bakha iinqanawa kude nalapho abantu behlala khona, kwiindawo apho akukho namnye ohambayo; batshixiwe kude namanye amalungu ehlabathi, bajikeleze-jikeleze ngentambo.
Isonka sikhula ngaphaya kwehlabathi, kodwa phantsi kwayo sijika-jika, njengokuba ngumlilo.
Ii-sapphires zifunyenwe kumatye ayo, Uthuli lwalo lunegolide.
Akukho ntaka yokubulala eyaziyo loo ndlela ifihlakeleyo. Akukho mva webhokhwe owaziyo.
Akukho mnyama ohambayo uphakamileyo wahamba phezu kwayo, Akukho lizukulwana sadlula kuloo ndlela.
Abaqulunqi bemigodi bahlasela iithayile ezinzima kakhulu kwaye bathabathe iziqhamo zeentaba.
Bavula imigangatho yodonga, Amehlo abo abona zonke iimpahla zayo ezibalulekileyo.
Bazivala iziqhamo zomlambo, Bazisa izinto ezifihlakeleyo kukukhanya.
Kodwa ubulumko bufumaneka phi? Ubulumko buhlala phi?
Akukho mntu uyaziyo intsingiselo yayo; Ayifumaneki ezweni labo abaphilayo.
Ulwandle olunzulu luthi, Akukho kulo mna; ulwandle luthi, Akukho nam.
Ayithengiswanga ngegolide elungileyo; Ixabiso layo alihlawulwanga ngesilivere.
Ayithengiswanga ngegolide yase-Ofiri, nokuba yi-onyx entle, nokuba yi-sapphire.
Igolide nekristale aziyi kuthelekiswa nayo; Ayikwazi ukuthengwa ngeempahla zegolide.
I-coral ne-jasper azifanelekanga ukubhalwa; ixabiso lobulumko liphezulu kunee-ruby.
I-topas yase-Ethiopia ayilingani nayo; Ayithengwanga ngegolide ecocekileyo.
Ke ngoko, ubulumko buvela phi na? Ubulumko buhlala phi?
Ifihlakele ngamehlo ezinto zonke eziphilayo, nakwiintyatyambo zezulu.
Ububi nokufa bathi, Siva nje ilizwi ngaye.
UThixo uyazi indlela yayo; yena kuphela owazi indawo yokuhlala kwayo.
Ubona kude kube ziincam zehlabathi, Nazo zonke izinto phantsi kwezulu.
Ke kaloku, xa enika umoya amandla akhe, Elinganisela amanzi ngokulinganayo,
Xa esenza umthetho wemvula, Nendlela yethutyana.
Ke kaloku wajonga ubulumko, wathetha ngalo; wayimisa, wayivavanya.
Wathi ke kubantu, Yabona, ukukhathalela iNkosi kukudelela ubulumko; nokuyeka okubi kukudelela inyaniso.
UJob waqhubeka ethetha:
Yintoni na endiyifunayo iinyanga ezidlulayo, Iintsuku apho uThixo wayendikhusela khona?
Xa ilanga lakhe likhanya ngasentloko yam, Ndihamba ngokukhanya kwayo emthunzini.
Ezi ziye zaba ziintsuku ezilungileyo zobomi bam, Xa uthando lukaThixo lwamsindisa indlu yam;
Ke kaloku uThixo Onamandla onke wayehamba nam, Nabantwana bam babemi ngaphaya kwam;
Xa indlela yam yathi igcwele ubisi, Iinduli zathi zikhupha imilambo yeoli kum.
Xa ndiye emnyango wedolophu, ndahlala kwindawo yomhlaba ovulekileyo,
Amadoda amancinci ambona, asuka ecaleni; amadoda amadala aye phezulu ngenxa yobubele.
Ke kaloku abathetheli bamisa ukuthetha kwabo, bezifihla izandla zabo emlonyeni wabo.
Iindlebe zamadoda aphezulu zanyamalala; iilwimi zabo zazingcwatywa emathunjini amlomo wabo.
Bonke abandivayo bamxelela ngokulungileyo, Bonke abandibonayo bamxelela ngobuhle;
Kuba ndabakhusela abafazi, abo bathandazayo, nabafazi abafileyo, abangabancedisayo.
Abafayo bamsindisa, ndazilungisa intliziyo yabasetyhini abafileyo.
Ndazigqoka ubulungisa njengempahla yam; Umthetho waba ngumqamelo wam, nesigqubuthelo sam.
Ndiye ndaba ngamehlo kulabo bamnyama, nemilenze kwabo bangahamba.
Ndiye ndaba ngumntwana womfazi, Ndathi ndithathe isigqibo sabantu abangaphandle.
Ndazitshisa iinwele zamadoda akhohlakeleyo, Ndazisusa izitha zabo emlonyeni wabo.
Ndathi, Ndiza kufa endlwini yam, emva kokuphila iintsuku ezininzi, njengokuba zininzi iinkuni zesinyithi.
Iingcambu zam ziya kungena emanzini, Inkungu iya kuphumla phezu kweziqhamo zam ngobusuku.
Ndiya kuhlala ndidumileyo, Intliziyo yam iya kuhlala ivuselelwa; Ifana nomtya ongenakulahleka.
Abantu bamxelela, balinde ngoxolo icebiso lam.
Xa ndithe ndathetha, abazange bakwazi ukuqhubeka besithi nantoni na; Ilizwi lam lafika ngamandla ezindlebeni zabo.
Balinde kum, njengokuba kulindeleke ukuba kubekho imvula; Badla amagama am njengemvula yonyaka.
Ke kaloku, xa belahlekile intliziyo yabo, ndabatyhila ubuso bam; Ubuso bam oluhle lwabanceda.
Ndayikhetha indlela yabo, ndahlala ndingumphathi wabo; Ndaphila njengokumkani phakathi kweemfazwe zakhe, njengokuba umntu ozonwabisa abo bathandazela.
Ke mna ke ngoku ndidlalwa ngamadoda amancinci kunam; Abafazi babo andizange ndibabeke phakathi kweenja zam zomthi.
Intliziyo yabo yandinceda ntoni na? Intliziyo yabo ihambe.
Bathe bakhululwa kukutya, nokungabikho kokutya; Bahamba ngobusuku ezweni elimanzi, Ezindaweni ezilahlekileyo nezingcolileyo.
Zazikhupha iziqhamo ezityebileyo phakathi kweentyatyambo, Zazidla iziqu zezityalo ze-broom.
Baqhutywa ngabanye abantu, abathi bayalela kubo, njengokuba babe ngabaphulaphuli.
Bamele bahlale ezibhedini zemilambo ecocekileyo, kwimingxunya yomhlaba naphakathi kweenduli.
Bathi, Njengezinto eziphilayo phakathi kweentyatyambo, Bathe badibana phantsi kweengcambu.
Babantu abangasebenziyo, oonyana bezinto ezingalunganga; baqhutywa ngaphandle kwelizwe ngeengxowa.
Ke mna ke ngoku ndiba ngumbulelo kubo ngeengoma zabo; Ndiye ndaba ngumsindo kubo.
Bamchukumisa, bahamba kude nam; Abayi kuthintela intliziyo yam ukuba ingabikho.
Ngokuba uThixo unqumle intambo yam yomqolo, wandenza ndihlupheke; bangenza kum nantoni na abafunayo.
Kwicala lam lasekunene, iqela lamadoda lindihlasele. Lindikhupha phezulu, liyenza imigangatho yokumhlasela.
Bayivala indlela yam, bafuna ukunibulala; Akukho mntu ubathintela.
Bafika kum, njengokuba kungenxa yomngxunya omde edonga; Bemqula phezu kwam phakathi kweengcango.
Iintloko zam zithe ziqhutywe, Uxolo lwam lutyibilika njengomoya, Ukukhuseleka kwam kudlula njengefu.
Ngoku ke ubomi bam buphuma kum; Iintsuku zoxinzelelo zindithathela.
Ngobusuku iinwele zam zibuhlungu, Intlungu yam encinane ayiyikuphumla.
UThixo uthabathe izihlangu zam ngesandla esinamandla kakhulu, Wanditsala ngomqolo womgqomo wam.
Undibeka emlonyeni womthi, Ndiba ngathi ngumgubo nothuli.
Ndiya kuthandaza kuwe, Thixo, kodwa awuphenduli; Ndiyimile, kodwa ujonge kum.
Utshintshe ubomi bakho kum, Wamhlasela ngamandla akho onke.
Undikhupha phezulu, umphefumlo undithabathe; Undijikelezisa emlilweni womoya.
Ndiyazi ukuba uya kundikhupha phantsi ukuya emfazweni, Kuyo yonke indawo ephilayo.
Ngokuqinisekileyo akukho namnye oza kubetha umntu onqunyiweyo, ekhalayo ngoncedo emntwini wakhe.
Andililele na ngenxa yabo abasengozini? Andilibele na ngenxa yalabo bahlwempu?
Ke kaloku, xa ndithe ndalinde into elungileyo, kwafika okubi; Xa ndithe ndalinde ukukhanya, kwafika ubumnyama.
Intliziyo yam ijikeleza, ayiphumli; Iintsuku zeentlungu zimi phambi kwam.
Ndihamba ngamehlo amnyama, ngaphandle kokukhanya kwelanga; Ndiya kuhlala ebantwini, ndicela uncedo.
Ndiye ndaba ngumzalwana weebhokhwe, Ndibe ngumhlobo weentyatyambo.
Ulusu lwam lumnyama kwaye lunqunyulwa. Isiqu sam sitshisa ngenxa yoxinzelelo.
I-harpa yam idlala ingoma yobuxoki kuphela, I-flaut yam idlala umsindo wokulingisa.
Ndizamile ngamehlo am, ukuba andijongi ngothando ibhinqa elincinci.
UThixo osemazantsi angandinika ntoni na? UThixo Onamandla onke emazulwini angandinika ntoni na njengenxalenye yam?
Ingaba akuyi kubakho intlungu kubantu ababi, nobuhlungu kubo basenza ububi?
UThixo akaboni na zonke izinto endizenzayo, Akabala na imilenze yam?
Ukuba ndaphila ngobuxoki, Nakuba imilenze yam yakhawuleza ukukhohlisa abanye;
UThixo andiqikelele ngemilinganiselo yobulungisa, aze abone ukuba akukho monakalo kum.
Ukuba imilenze yam itshintshe indlela yakhe, Ukuba intliziyo yam yalandela iminqweno yamazinyo am, Ukuba izandla zam zithe tyaba ngenxa yesono;
Ke kaloku, oko ndisithabathayo, kungabikho mnye oza kulidla; imbewu yam ibe yinto eqhutywa.
Ukuba intliziyo yam iqhutywe ngumfazi, Ukuba ndifihle, ndazisela emnyango womhlobo wam,
umfazi wam, ke ngoko, aphe ingqolowa kumntu othile, baphumle naye abantu abathile.
Le nto iya kuba yintlungu yokuyenza, idini elifanele ukuba lihlawulwe ngabagwebi.
Ngumlilo otshisa yonke indlela ukuya ekufeni; Uza kutshisa zonke izinto endizifunayo.
Ukuba ndenze ntoni na, ukuba ndiyivumeli intliziyo yam ukuba icinge ngemithandazo yabakhonzi bam, amadoda nabasetyhini, xa bengenanto kum;
Ndiza kwenza ntoni na, xa uThixo ephuma endiyilungisayo? Ndiza kuthetha ntoni na, xa efuna ukuba ndicacise?
UThixo, owenzayo mna emntwini womntwana wam, akawukhe wazenza nazo? Akawukhe wazenza zonke izidalwa zethu phambi kokuba sizalwa?
Ukuba ndiye ndayeka ukuxhasa abafazi, Ndiya kubangela ukuba iimfama zilahle uthemba;
Ukuba ndenza isonka sam ndisigcine ngokwam, Andiyi kusinikwa ngabantwana abancinci;
Ke kaloku, ukususela ekubeni ndimntwana, ndabakhuthaza oonyana abafileyo, njengokuba kwenza utata; kwaye ukususela ekuzalwa kwam ndabakhokela oomama abafayo.
Ukuba ndabona umntu efa ngenxa yokungabikho kweempahla, okanye umhlwempu ongenakugqoka;
Bathi ke, Akukho mthandazo kum, ukuba ndibafudumeze ngoboya benkomo zam.
Ukuba ndithe ndaphakamisa isandla sam kunyana omncinci, ngenxa yokuba bendiyazi ukuba abagwebi besango ledolophu baya kumxhasa;
ke isandla sam sikhuphe isifuba sam, Siqhutywe ngaphaya komqolo wam.
Ndiye ndakhathazeka ngenxa yobubi bukaThixo; Ngokuba ubukhulu bakhe, andikwazi ukwenza izinto ezinjalo.
Ukuba ndenze ithemba lam kwigolide, Ndithi kwigolide ecocekileyo, Uyindawo yam yokhuselo;
ukuba ndiye ndavuya ngenxa yokuba ndaba mkhulu kakhulu, ndafumana izinto ezininzi;
Ukuba ndeva ilanga elikhanyayo, okanye inyanga eqaqambileyo ehamba phezu kwezulu,
Ke kaloku intliziyo yam yatyhalelwa ngokufihlakeleyo, ukuba ndizihlambulule kuzo; ndazingca ngesandla sam.
Ke kaloku le nto ibe yintlungu kubagwebi, ukuba bayihlawule; mna ke ndiya kwenza isono kuThixo ophezulu.
Ukuba ndenze ntoni na, xa umthunywa wam ephelelwe lithemba; ukuba ndiyenzile ntoni na, xa ubuhlungu bakhe bufika kuye;
Ke mna ke andivumeleni umlomo wam ukuba enze isono, ukuze ndilamle ubomi bakhe.
Ukuba abantu bendlu yam bangathi, Nguwuphi na umntu ongenakutya inyama kaYobhi?
Ke kaloku akukho mntu wangaphandle oza kuhlala endlwini yam; ngokuba ndivula umngxunya wam kubo bahambayo.
Ukuba ndazifihla iimpazamo zam, njengokuthi abanye bazifihla, Ndiyifihla intlungu yam entliziyweni yam;
Kuba ndaye ndimxolela umkhosi, ndimxolela umbono weentsapho; ke ngoko ndathi, Ndihlale phantsi, ndihlala ngaphakathi.
Ndinqwenele ukuba kubekho umntu oza kumxelela! Yabona, ndibhala igama lam, ndimkhusele. UThixo Onamandla onke amphendule; umgwebi wam abhale icala lakhe kum.
Ndiza kuyithabatha ngomqolo wam, Ndiza kuyigqoka njengentyatyambo.
Ndiya kumxelela yonke intshukumo endiyithatheyo; Ndiza kuye njengenkosi.
Ukuba ilizwe lam litsho kum, Nazo zonke iziqhamo zalo zimanzile ngamehlo;
ukuba ndilile iziqhamo zayo, ngaphandle kokuhlawula, okanye ndabangela ukufa kwabanini bayo,
Ke ngoko, zikhule iziqhamo endaweni yengqolowa, neentyatyambo endaweni yesonka. Lo ngukuphela kwamabinzana kaYobhi;
Ke kaloku abo madoda mathathu agqiba ekuphenduleni uYobhi, ngokuba wayeyazi ukuba uJob unelungelo.
Ke kaloku uElihu, unyana kaBarakeli, waseBuzi, ezweni likaRam, waxoka kakhulu. Waxoka kuYobhi, ngenxa yokuba uJob wayemlungisa ngokwakhe ngaphezu kukaThixo;
Ke kaloku wabakhokela abahlobo bakhe abathathu, ngenxa yokuba babengafumani impendulo elungileyo; ke bona batsho ukuba uYobhi ukhohlakeleyo.
Ke kaloku uElihu wayalela ukuba angathethanga noYobhi, ngokuba abo babekhulu kunaye.
Ke kaloku uElihu, xa ebona ukuba aba madoda mathathu akazange baphinde bathethe nantoni na, waxoka.
Waphendula ke uElihu, unyana kaBarakeli, waseBuzi, wathi, Ndimntwana mna, wena ke ungumdala; ngenxa yoko ndazikhusela, ndaxoka ukuba ndikuxelele.
Ndathi, Bathethe abantu abakhulu; Bafundise ubulumko abo baphila iminyaka emininzi.
Ke kaloku ngumphefumlo ongaphakathi komntu, Intliziyo kaThixo Onamandla onke, enika ukuqonda.
Akuba ngabafileyo kuphela abanobulumko, nokuba ngabafileyo kuphela abaqondi into elungileyo.
Ndithi ke, Hlala kum; ndiya kukuxelela nantoni na endiyicingayo.
Ndalinde xa uthethayo, Ndiva izizathu zakho, Xa ukhangela amagama akho.
Ndiya kunika ingqalelo kuni; kodwa akukho namnye kuni owawuxolela uYobhi, okanye owaphendula.
Musani ukuthi, Sifumane ubulumko; uThixo aphendule kuye, hayi umntu.
UYobhi akazange amqwalasele, ke mna ndiya kumphendula ngeengxaki zenu.
Amadoda anjalo, ephazamisekile, akakwazi ukuphendula nantoni na; akuyi kubakho nto bathethayo.
Ndiyilinde ntoni na ngoku, xa bekhala, Xa behlala khona, bengenakuphendula?
Hayi, ndiza kukuphendula na. Ndiza kukuxelela oko ndicingayo.
Ndigcwele amagama, Umphefumlo ongaphakathi kwam uthetha kum.
Ngaphakathi, mna ndifana newayini ethe tyaba kwibhotile, Ndifana neebhegi ezintsha zewayini ezilungiselelwe ukuphuka.
Ndimele ndithethe, ndiphile; Ndimele ndivule umlomo wam, ndiphendule.
Andiyi kuthatha inxaxheba komnye umntu, Andiyi kuxolela umnye.
Andiyazi ukuba ndimxolele. Ukuba ndimxolele, Umenzi wam uya kumsusa ngokukhawuleza.
Ke ngoko, mna uYobhi, thandazani, ndithi, ilizwi lam; Nceda uqaphele amazwi am onke.
Yabona, ndiza kuvula umlomo wam; Ilizwi lam likwicala lelwimi lwam.
Ilizwi lam livela entliziyweni ecacileyo; Imilomo yam ithetha ngokunyanisekileyo into endiyazi.
Umphefumlo kaThixo wamenza mna; Umoya woMntu Onamandla onke uyamnika ubomi.
Ukuba unako, ndiphendule; lungiselela iinyaniso zakho, uhlale ujongene nam.
Yabona, mna ndifana nani ngamehlo kaThixo; mna ke ndadalwa ngokhuni.
Ke ngoko, musa ukumxolela; ndiya kukwenza ukuba uxinzelelo lukhulu kuwe.
Ke kaloku, utsho loo nto phambi kwam; Ndiyiva ilizwi lakho ngokwalo:
Ndicocekile, andizange ndenze ntoni na engalunganga; Ndicocekile, akukho monakalo nam.
Ke kaloku uThixo wafumanisa izizathu zokumhlasela, Wandibeka njengomchasi wakhe.
Wazibeka izinyawo zam emnqamlezweni, wazibona zonke iintshukumo zam.
Ke mna ndithi kuni, Ningalungile kuloo nto; ngokuba uThixo mkhulu kunawo wonke umntu.
Kutheni na ke ukuba ukhathazeke kuye, ngokuba akaphenduli imibuzo yabantu?
UThixo uthetha ngenye indlela, ke ngoko ngenye enye, nakuba abantu bangaliqonda.
Uthetha ngephupha, ngombono wobusuku, Xa abantu bephumla phantsi, xa belala ezibhedini zabo.
Uthetha ngeendlebe zabo, Wabakhathaza ngesilumkiso;
ukuze babuyiselwe ekubeni benze into engalunganga, Bakhuselwe ekubeni bangabi nobuxoki.
Wabakhusela ukuba bangasayi kungena emlonyeni, Wabakhusela amehlo abo ukuba angawafa nge kelosi.
Okanye umntu unokuxolelwa ngeentlungu ebhedini yakhe, eneentlungu eziqhubekayo emathambo akhe.
Akakwazi ukuhlala edla, Nakuba isonka sakhe esithandekayo siyamxolela.
Intliziyo yakhe iphuka ibe yinto engenanto; Amathambo akhe afihlakeleyo aphuma ngoku.
Ufika ekufumaneni umphefumlo wakhe, Umphefumlo wakhe uphakathi kwabo babangela ukufa.
Ke ukuba kukho khona isithunywa ecaleni kwakhe, isinye kumakhulu amabini, umncedisi wakhe, ukuze amxelele into elungileyo;
iinyembezi ziya kumxolela, zithi, Usindise ukuba angasayi kungena emlonyeni; ndifumene intlawulo yokumkhulula.
Ke kaloku umzimba wakhe uza kuphinda ube mhle, njengentliziyo yonyana; uya kuphinda abe mncinci, anamandla.
Uya kuthandaza kuThixo, uThixo uya kuthandazela kuye; Uza kubona ubuso bukaThixo, uza kwenza umsindo; uThixo uya kumbuyisela.
Uza kwenza umculo kubanye, esithi, Ndithe ndaphelelwa nguThixo, nditshixisa into elungileyo, Ndagwetywa ngokungafanelekanga.
UThixo wandikhusela, ukuze ndize ndizakele ekufaneni; ndiya kuba ubomi, ndibone ukukhanya.
Zonke ezi zinto uThixo uzisenza kumntu, ziphinda ziphinde,
Ukumbuyisela emlonyeni wakhe, ukuze ilanga lokuphila likhanyake phezu kwakhe.
Yiva, uYobhi, undixelele; Khumbula, ndiza kuthetha.
Ukuba unayo into oza kuyithetha, ndiphendule; thetha, kuba ndifuna ukukubonisa ukuba ulungile.
Ke ukuba akunjalo, phulaphula mna; uphumle, ndiza kukufundisa ubulumko.
Waqhubeka ke uElihu, wathi,
Yiva amazwi am, nimadoda anengqondo; Niyiqonde intliziyo yam, nina abanolwazi oluninzi.
Indlebe ivavanya amagama, njengokuba ulwimi ludla ukudla.
