Masigqibe ngokuzenzekelayo ukuba yintoni elungileyo, sifunde ndawonye into entle.
UYobhi uthi, Ndinobulungisa; Ke kaloku uThixo unyuse umgwebo kum.
Nakuba ndingumntu olungileyo, ndithiwa ngumxoki; Ndineentlungu ezingapheliyo, nakuba andizange ndenze ntoni na engalunganga.
Ingaba kukho umntu ofana noYobhi? Usela izicaphuno njengamanzi.
Udibana nabantu abazenzayo izinto ezibi, Uchitha ixesha lakhe kunye namadoda akhohlakeleyo.
Uthi, Akukho nto ilungileyo eyenza umntu ukuba athande uThixo.
Ke ngoko, nindixelele, ningamadoda anengqondo: UThixo akazukwenza okubi; Onamandla onke akakaze ayenze into embi.
Uyambuyisela umntu ngomsebenzi wakhe, Wabanika indlela yabo efaneleyo.
Ngokuqinisekileyo uThixo akaze ayenze into engalunganga; UThixo Onamandla onke akaze aguqule umthetho.
Ingaba umntu wambeka engqondweni yehlabathi? Ingaba umntu wammisela ukuba abe ngumlawuli wehlabathi lonke?
Ukuba ke egqibile ukubuyela umphefumlo wakhe, nomoya wakhe,
Zonke izinto eziphilayo ziya kufa ngaxeshanye, abantu baya kubuyela emtyeni.
Ukuba niyazi, thethani le nto; nicinge ngento endisithiyo.
Ingaba uya kulawula lowo uchukumisayo inyaniso? Ngaba uya kumgweba lowo mkhulu, onobulungisa?
Uthi kubo bakumkani, Niyinyama engasebenziyo; kumadoda anamandla, Niyinyama engaqhelekanga.
UThixo akabonisi isandla sakhe kubaphathi, Akayi kwenza umthandi angcono kunabafazi; Kuba izandla zakhe zazenza zonke.
Abantu bafa ngaphaya kwemini, batshisa, baphelelwe lixesha; Abanamandla basuswa ngaphandle koncedo lomuntu.
UThixo ujonge indlela abantu abaphila ngayo, Ubona yonke intshukumo yabo.
Akukho nto imnyama, okanye isithunzi esinzulu, apho abantu ababi bangafihla khona.
UThixo akadingi ukuba ajonge umntu ixesha elide kakhulu, phambi kokuba amnike ityala.
Wabaphula abo banamandla, ngaphandle kokubuza imibuzo; Wabeka abanye endaweni yabo.
Uyazi into abayenzayo; Wabakhupha phantsi ngobusuku, baqhutywa ngamanzi.
Wabaphulaphulisa ngenxa yobubi babo, apho bonke abantu bebona khona.
Kuba batshintshe ukulandela kwakhe, Baze bangaziboni naziphi na iindlela zakhe.
Bakwenza ukuba abafazi batsho kuThixo; Wava uxolo lwabafazi abafunayo.
Ke kaloku, ukuba uThixo ephumle, ngubani na oza kumqwalasela? Ukuba efihla ubuso bakhe, ngubani na oza kumbona? Ngoko ke, yena ujonge izizwe neentlanga,
ukuze abantu abangenabo uThixo bangabi ngabalawuli, babambe abantu.
Ukuba ke umntu ethi kuThixo, Ndinobulungisa, kodwa andizukwenza kwakhona isono.
Ndifundise into endiyibonayo; ukuba ndenze okubi, andizukuyenza kwakhona.
Ingaba uThixo uya kukuhlawula ngokwemimiselo yakho, xa ungathandabuzi ukuguquka? Ufanele ucinge wena, hayi mna; sithi ke ngoko oko uyazi.
Abantu abanengqondo baya kundixhasa, Nawo onke umntu owaziyo uthetha ndithi:
UYobhi uthetha, kodwa akayazi into athethayo; Amazwi akhe angabikho nto.
Ndinqwenele ukuba uYobhi avavanywe ngokugqithiseleyo, Kuba uphendula njengomfazi olungileyo.
Uzalisa ubundlobongela isono sakhe; Uza kutyhala izandla zakhe kuthi, esenza isidumbu sethu, Ethetha ngokuqhubekayo ngoThixo.
Waqhubeka ke uElihu, wathi,
Ingaba ucinga ukuba kulungile kuwe ukuthi, Ndinobulungisa ngaphezu kukaThixo?
Uthi kuye, Yintoni elungileyo endiyifumanayo? Yintoni endiyifumanayo ukuba andizukwenza isono?
Ndiza kukuphendula wena, nabahlobo bakho nawe.
Nciphisa umbono wakho emazulwini, ubone; Nciphisa umbono wakho kumafu aphezulu phezu kwakho.
Ukuba usenza isono, kubangela ntoni na uThixo? Ukuba uqhubeka usenza isono, kubangela ntoni na kuye?
Ukuba usenza okulungileyo, uya kumnika ntoni na? Ufumana ntoni na kuwe?
Izinto zakho ezibi zibulala kuphela abantu abafana nawe; kodwa izinto zakho ezintle zinceda nje abanye abantu.
Amadoda anqumamisa xa eqhutywa yimpucuko, Ecela uncedo ngenxa yobukrelekrele balo mmandla.
Ke kaloku akukho mntu usithi, Ukhona na uThixo umenzi wam, Owenza iingoma ngobusuku,
ngubani na owenza ukuba sifunde ngakumbi kunazo zonke izinto eziphilayo, ukuba sibe nobulumko ngaphezu kweentaka zezulu?
Batsho, akawuphendulanga, ngenxa yobuxoki bomntu ongalunganga.
UThixo akawuva umnxeba wabo ongenantsingiselo; Onamandla onke akayi kujonga kubo.
Ke ngoko, uThixo akawuphulaphuli umsindo wakho, xa uthi, Andikwazi ukumbona; ukuba ityala lakho lingaphambili kwakhe, nilinde kuye.
Ke ngoku nithi, UThixo akagwebi ngobuxoki bakhe, akacaci kakhulu isono.
Wavula ke uYobhi umlomo wakhe, akathethi nto elungileyo; wathetha ulwimi oluninzi, angazi nto.
Waqhubeka uElihu ethetha, wathi,
Wathi ke uYesu kuye, Yiba nomsindo nam kancinci; ndiya kukuxelela ukuba kukho okuninzi okufuneka kuthethe ngalo uThixo.
Ndiza kuqoqa ulwazi lwam ukusuka kude naphezu, Ndiya kubonisa ukuba umenzi wam ulungile.
Yazi ukuba amagama am ayiyo inkohlakalo; kuba kukho umntu owaziyo yonke into, ekho nawe.
UThixo ungumntu onamandla, kodwa akagwebi nabani na; Ngumntu onamandla, uqinisa injongo yakhe.
Akuyi kuzisa ubomi abantu ababi; Ke kaloku ulungisa abo bahluphekileyo.
Akuyi kususa amehlo akhe kubantu abalungileyo; Ubabeka phezu kweendawo eziphakamileyo kunye nabakumkani, Wabanyusa ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku, ukuba abantu bagwetywe ngamakhonkco, babanjwa ziintonga zoxinzelelo,
Wababonisa imisebenzi yabo, Izinto abazenzayo ngenxa yobuxoki babo.
Wabavumela ukuba bavakalise ukunyamezela kwakhe, Wabamisa ukuba bayeke ububi.
Ukuba baya kumthobela, bayamkhonza, baza kuchitha imihla yabo eyonwabisayo, neminyaka yabo entle.
Ke kaloku, ukuba bangaphulaphuli, baya kufa ngekhephu; baya kufa bengenalwazi.
Amadoda akhohlakeleyo anqumle intliziyo yawo; Xa uThixo ewakhonzelisa, akayi kutyhala.
Bafa ebantwini babo, phakathi kwabantu abaxhaphakileyo emakhazeni.
Ke kaloku uThixo ubakhusela abo bahluphekayo, ebantwini babo; Uthetha nabo, xa bekwingxaki.
Wayefuna ukunikhupha emngciphekweni, ukuba nifike kwindawo evulekileyo, engenamda, kwitafile egcwele isonka esihle.
Ke ngoko, ngoku uzele ziingxelo zobuxoki bezinto ezibi; iincwadana nezigqibo zithe zakuthwala.
Khumbula, ukuba ubutyebi abukhokeleleni ekukhanyeni; ukuba umnikelo omkhulu abukhokeleni ekuhambeni.
Ingaba ubutyebi bakho, namandla akho onke akhulu, aya kukunceda njani xa kufika ubunzima?
Musa ukunqwenela ubusuku, Xa abantu bethathwa endlwini yabo.
Nceda uqaphele ukuba awusayi kuguqula umphefumlo wakho, kuba oko kubonakala ngathi kuyinto ofuna ukuyikhethela endaweni yokufa.
Yabona, uThixo mkhulu kumandla akhe; Nguwuphi umfundi ofana naye?
Nguwuphi lowo wamxelela ukuba akwenze ntoni na? Nguwuphi othi kuye, Wakwenza okubi.
Khumbulani ukuba niwuthandaze umsebenzi wakhe, Owawudlalwa ngabantu.
Wonke umntu uyibonayo, abantu bayijonga ukusuka kude.
Ke kaloku, uThixo ungumntu omkhulu, ngaphezu kokuqonda kwethu; Akukho mntu unokulinganisa inani leminyaka yakhe.
Uzisa phezulu iinwele zamanzi, Uziguqula zibe yimvula esuka kumsi.
Amafu akhupha phantsi imvula, Iwela phezu kwamadoda ngamanzi ashushu.
Nguwuphi umntu owaziyo ukuba usasaza njani amafu, nokuba ithutha livela phi kwindawo yakhe yokuhlala?
Yabona, uyasikhupha njani isibhakabhaka sakhe phezu kwakhe, Usigubungela phantsi kolwandle.
Ngoko ke ulawula iintlanga, Ubanika ukudla okuninzi.
Uzalisa izandla zakhe ngomlilo welanga uze umxelele ukuba ahlasele injongo yakhe
Uthundo lwakhe lubonisa ukubuya kwakhe; Iinkomo nazo ziyazi ukuba imvula ifika.
Ngale nto intliziyo yam iqhuma, iphuma kwindawo yayo.
Limbani, libani, ilizwi lakhe eliqhushumbisileyo, Inkulumo ephuma emlonyeni wakhe.
Uthumela umlilo wakhe phezu kwezulu lonke, Nasezipheloni zehlabathi.
Emva komthubi kukho umsindo, Uthetha ngelizwi lakhe elinamandla; Akawuthinteli umthubi, xa kuthiwa ngamazwi akhe.
Ilizwi likaThixo lithutha ngeendlela ezimangalisayo; Ukwenza izinto ezinkulu, asiziqondi.
Uthi ngekhephu, Thoba phezu komhlaba; Uthi ngemvula ukuba iqhume, Uthi ngemvula enkulu ukuba iqhume.
Wamisa wonke umntu ekusebenzeni kwakhe, ukuze bonke abawenzayo bakwazi amandla akhe.
Iintaka ziya kwindawo zabo zokuzikhusela kwaye zihlala kwiindawo zazo.
Imvula iphuma kwigumbi layo, Ubushushu buvela kumoya wasempumalanga.
Umphefumlo kaThixo usenza umkhenkce, Amanzi abanzi enza umkhenkce.
Ubeka amanzi emanzini amafu aqinileyo, Usasaza phakathi kwabo umlilo wakhe.
Zihamba ngaphaya, zijikeleza apho azikhokela khona; zenza zonke izinto azisaziyo phezu kwehlabathi.
Uthumela amafu ukuba agweme abantu, ukuba atshise ilizwe lakhe, ukuze abonakalise ububele bakhe.
Yiva oku, uYobhi; Nqakraza ucinge ngemisebenzi emangalisayo kaThixo.
Uyazi na ukuba uThixo ulawula njani iinkwenkwezi, Uyenza njani imibhiyozo yakhe?
Uyazi na ukuba iinkwenkwezi zithe tyaba emlilweni, Izinto ezimangalisayo zomsebenzi wakhe owaziyo zonke izinto?
Utyhala iinwele zakho, xa isixeko siphumle phantsi komoya oshushu wasempuma.
Ungamnceda na ukuba akhuphe izulu, Eliqinileyo njengengcango eyenziwe ngobhedu?
Siyazi ukuba sithetha ntoni kuye; kuba asikwazi ukuphendula, ngokuba sikwilanga.
Kuthiwa kuye na ukuba ndifuna ukuthetha? Ngaba kukho umntu oza kucela ukuba aphulwe?
Akukho namnye ongazijonga ilanga, xa likhanya ngokuqaqambileyo emlilweni, emva kokuba umoya ukhuphe amafu.
Ukukhanya kwegolide kuvela kumntla, UThixo ufika ngemimandla emangalisayo.
UThixo Onamandla onke, asikwazi ukuwufikelela; Mkhulu kumandla akhe. Ulungile, ugqibelele ekumisweni, Akabikho mntu owenza umsindo.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yobulungisa bakhe, akayi kuthobela abo becinga ukuba banamandla.
Waphendula ke iNkosi kuYobhi, esuka emlilweni, esithi,
Nguwuphi lo mntu ufihla izigqibo zam ngamagama angaziyo nto?
Yilungiselele njengomfazi; ndiza kukubuza, wena ke uya kumphendula.
Ubephi wena, xa ndibeka isiseko sehlabathi? Nceda sithi, ukuba ukuqondayo.
Nguwuphi lowo wagqiba ukuba ibe mkhulu kangakanani na? Ngokuqinisekileyo uyayazi! Nguwuphi loo mbhobho wokulinganisa owenza umgca udlula kuyo?
Kuthini na isiseko sayo? Nguwuphi obeka isinyithi esiphambili sayo,
Xa iinkwenkwezi zemini zidlala ndawonye, Nazo zonke izithunywa zentliziyo zivuya ngothando?
Wayivala ilwandle ngasemva kwamasango, Xa liphuma emntwini.
Xa ndenza amafu ingubo yayo, Ndayigubungela ngokukhanya okuninzi;
Xa ndithi ndamisa imida yayo, Ndabeka izitshixo zayo nezivalo zayo;
Wathi, Uza kufika kude, kodwa awuzukufika kude; apha kuya kuhlala amaza akho anamandla.
Wathi na, ubomi bakho bonke, umyalelo kubusuku, Ubonise ilanga indawo yayo?
ukuze ithabathe iziphelo zehlabathi, ziqhekeze kuyo abo bakhohlakeleyo?
Ihlabathi lifana nodonga phantsi kwesitshixo; Inkangeleko yayo ibonakala ngathi yimisonto yempahla.
Ukukhanya kwabo ababi kususwa kubo, Isandla sabo esiphakamileyo sokubetha silahliwe.
Uthe wahla na kumaza aphantsi kolwandle, Wahamba na ezindaweni ezinzulu zesilwandle?
Ziboniswa kuwe na izivalo zokufa? Ubona na izivalo zesithunzi esiphantsi kakhulu?
Uyazi na ukuba ihlabathi libanzi kangakanani na? Nceda nditsho, ukuba uyazi zonke ezi zinto.
Yintoni indlela eya endlwini yokukhanya? Umnyama uhlala phi na?
Ingaba uya kuzithabatha ziye kwiindawo zazo? Ingaba uyazi iindlela eziya endlwini yazo?
Ngokuqinisekileyo uyazi, kuba wazalwa ngelo xesha, waphila iminyaka emininzi kakhulu.
Ungene na kumagumbi okugcinwa kwekhephu, okanye ubone amagumbi okugcinwa kweqhwa?
endizigcinayo kwixesha lengxaki, kwimihla yokulwa nokulwa.
Yintoni na indlela eya kwindawo apho umlilo usasazeka khona, Nalapho umoya wasempumalanga usasazwa khona phezu kwehlabathi?
Uthini na lowo uvula umjelo wamanzi olwandle, Indlela yomlilo wemvula?
Ukwenza imvula kwilizwe elingenamntu ohlala kulo, kwisiqithi esingenabuhlanga kuyo;
ukuze ubisisele ilizwe elilahlekileyo, elincinane, ukuba likhule imbewu entsha?
Ingaba imvula inenkosikazi? Nguwuphi unyana weentyatyambo zesibhakabhaka?
Umhlaza uvela kuphi emntwini? Nguwuphi ozalise umkhenkce ezulu,
Xa amanzi ethe anzima njengelitye, xa ubuso belwandle olunzulu butshisa?
Ingaba ungayibophelela iqela lenkwenkwezi elibizwa ngokuba yiPleiades, okanye uvule umsesane weOrion?
Ingaba unokuzisa phezulu iinkwenkwezi ezidityanisiweyo kwixesha labo? Okanye ukhokelele intaka neentsapho zayo?
Uyazi na izigwebo zezulu? Ungazibeka zilawula phezu kwehlabathi na?
Ingaba unokubiza iinkungu, ukuze zikugubungele ngamanzi aphumayo?
Ingaba unokuzisa iinkwenkwezi ukuba zihambe? Ingaba ziya kukuxelela, zithi, Namhlanje sikho?
Nguwuphi lowo wamnikayo ubulumko intliziyo? Nguwuphi lowo wamnikayo ukuqonda umphefumlo?
Nguwuphi umntu onobulumko okwaziyo ukulinganisa amafu? Nguwuphi umntu okwaziyo ukubeka phantsi izitya zamanzi eziphakamileyo
Xa uthuli luguquka lube lunzima, Nakuba iziqhoboshi zehlabathi zidityanisiwe?
Ingaba unokuhlasela ukutya kwendoda yelio, Okanye ukufezekisa umnqweno weelio ezincinci?
Xa bethe baphumla emakhayeni abo, Nakuba belinde phakathi kweentyatyambo?
Nguwuphi lowo onika isidlo iintaka, Xa iintlanzi zayo zitshona kuThixo, Zihamba ngaphaya-phaya zingenanto yokudla?
Uyazi na xa iinkomo zenduli zizala? Ujonge na xa amagwebu adala abantwana babo?
Ungazibala njani iinyanga eziya kuzala? Uyazi na ukuba ixesha lifika lini?
Zihlambuluke, zizalise abantwana babo; Iintlungu zabo zokukhulelwa ziphele.
Iinkunzi zawo zikhula zibe namandla ezindaweni ezivulekileyo; Ziya, azibuyeli.
Nguwuphi lowo wakhululayo i-esile, Uwuphi lowo wasusayo intsontelo yayo?
Ndamnika isixeko esingenanto ukuba sibe yindawo yakhe yokuhlala, namachibi e-amafutha ukuba abe yindawo yakhe yokuhlala.
Idlala kwingxolo yedolophu. Ayiyikuva umqhubi etsho.
Ihamba ngeendawo eziphakamileyo ifuna ukutya kwayo, kwaye ikhangela nantoni na eluhlaza ukuze idle.
Ingaba inkunzi yebhokhwe iyakukhonza wena? Ingaba izakuhlala phantsi kwengxowa yakho yokutya ngemini?
Ingaba ungayibophelela ngentambo, ukuba iqulethe izityalo zakho? Ingaba iya kuthutha iqulethe imilambo yakho ngasemva kwakho?
Ingaba uya kuxhomekeka kuyo, ngenxa yokuba inamandla kakhulu? Ingaba uza kuyishiya phantsi kwayo imisebenzi yakho emikhulu?
Ingaba unokuthembela kuyo, ukuba ifikelise iziqhamo zakho, kwaye iqoqe iziqhamo zakho kwindlu yakho yokuhlamba?
I-ostriche iqhuma ngeenyawo zayo ngokuzinikela, kodwa amaphiko ayo awafananga ne-stork ekhathalela abantwana bayo.
Ibeka ii-eggs zayo phantsi komhlaba kwaye ivumela ukuba zifudumeze kumkhenkce.
Ilibala ukuba inyawo lingazitshisa, okanye ukuba intaka emnyama ingazibetha.
Uthi, Abantwana bakhe banzima, njengokuba bangamakhaya akhe; Akuyi kukhathazeka ukuba umsebenzi wakhe ungabi nanto.
Kuba uThixo akazange amnike ubulumko, nokuba nenxalenye yokuqonda okuhle.
Ke kaloku, xa ikhupha iinwele zayo ukuba ihambe, iya kudlala ngebhokhwe nomqhubi wayo.
Unika inkunzi yebhokhwe amandla ayo na? Uyigqoka njani ingqekembe ethe tyaba emlonyeni wayo?
Uyenza njani ukuba ihambe njengentaka? Ukudubula kwayo okukhulu kubuhlungu.
Ihamba ngeenyawo phezu kwehlabathi elunxwemeni, iyavuya ngenxa yobukrelekrele bayo; Iyaphuma ukuhlangabezana nezixhobo.
Idlala ngoxolo, ayikhathazeki nganto; Akayi kubaleka phambi kwekrele.
I-quiver yemiyalelo iqhutywa ngaphaya kwecala layo, kunye ne-flashing spear nejavelin.
Iqhutywa ngamandla phezu komhlaba; Ayikwazi ukuma xa ilizwi lebhokhwe liphuma.
Xa ibhokhwe iqhuma, iya kuphucula, isithi, Ahha! Ifumane umfazwe ukusuka kude; Iva uzuko lwabaphathi, nengoma yomfazwe.
Ingaba yinkcubeko yakho eyenza ukuba ibhokhwe ihambe, Ivule amaphiko ayo emzantsi?
Ingaba ngemiyalelo yakho i-eagle ihamba phezulu, Iyenza intaka yayo emazantsi?
Ihlala kwisiqithi esiphakamileyo kwaye ihlala khona ngemini, kwintlanzi enkulu apho ikhuselekile khona.
Kulapho ifuna khona ukutya kwayo; Amehlo ayo akubona kude.
Iinkunzi zayo zidla igazi; apho kukho khona izidumbu, apho kukho khona i-eagle.
Wathi iNkosi kuYobhi,
Ingaba lowo uthetha noThixo Onamandla onke uya kumxolela na? Nawuphendule yena lowo ephulaphule uThixo.
Waphendula ke uYobhi iNkosi, wathi,
Ndingenanto; ndingakuphendula ntoni na? Ndibeka isandla sam emlonyeni wam.
Ndathetha kathathu, kodwa andiphenduli; ndathetha kabini, kodwa andizukuqhubeka ndithetha.
Waphendula ke iNkosi kuYobhi, esuka emlilweni, esithi,
Mna ndiza kukubuza, wena ke uphendule kum.
Uthi na ukuba imithetho yam ayifanelekanga? Uthi na ukuba ndinyanzeleka, ukuze uqinisekise ukuba ulungile?
Ingaba unesandla esinamandla njengaso uThixo? Ingaba ilizwi lakho lithutha njengelo lakhe?
Ke ngoko, gqoka ubuhle nobuqaqawuli; gqoka ubukumkani nobunkunkqele.
Lahla uxinzelelo lwakho olukhulu, Yabona bonke abadumileyo, Wabakhupha phantsi.
Yabona bonke abaqhelekile, ubakhuphele phantsi; Waphulaphule abo bakhohlakeleyo apho behlala khona.
Yizibele ndawonye emthethweni, Zitshixise ekufumaneni.
Ke mna ke ndiya kukuxelela ukuba isandla sakho esikunene singakusindisa.
Yabona iBehemothi, endiyenzayo njengokuba ndakwenza wena; Idla iziqhamo njengenkomo.
Khangela ubutyebi bomqolo wayo, nobuninzi bemisipha yomqolo wakhe.
Umphumo wayo uqhutywa njengenkomo; Izihlunu zeentloko zayo zidityaniswe ndawonye.
Izihlunu zayo zifana nemibhobho yentsimbi, Imithambo yayo ifana neengxowa zentsimbi.
Inkulu kunazo zonke izinto eziphilayo azenzayo uThixo; Umenzi wayo kuphela okwazi ukudlula kuyo ngekhephu.
Iinduli ziyamnika ukutya, Kulapho zonke iintlanzi zendalo zidla khona.
Ihlala phantsi kweentyatyambo ze-lotus, ifihlakele phakathi kweengcambu elwandle.
Izityalo ze-lotus ziyigubungela ngesithunzi sazo; Izityalo ze-wildwood ecaleni komlambo ziyijikeleza.
Xa umlambo eqhuma, akakhathazeki; Xa umlambo iJordan ephuma emlonyeni wakhe, uhlala ephumle.
Ingaba kukho umntu oza kuyiqhekeza xa ijonge? Ingaba kukho umntu oza kuyiqhobosha, wabeka umsesane emlonyeni wayo?
Ingaba ungayitsala njani iLeviathan ngentambo, Ingaba ungayibophelela intloko yayo ngentambo?
Ingaba ungabeka intsontelo emlonyeni wayo, okanye ikhonkco emlonyeni wayo?
Ingaba iya kuqhubeka icela uxolo kuwe? Ingaba iza kukuxelela ngothando?
Ingaba iya kwenza umnqophiso nawe, ukuba ibe ngumkhonzi wakho ubomi bonke?
Ingaba ungadlalwa ngayo, njengokuba udlala intaka? Ingaba ungayibeka emlonyeni wamabhinqa akho?
Ingaba abarhwebi baya kurhweba ngayo? Ingaba baya kuyihlula phakathi kwabarhwebi?
Ingaba ungazilungisa njani isikhumba sayo ngee-harpoons, okanye intloko yayo ngeenqanawa?
Nceda ubeke isandla sakho ngaphaya kwayo kuqala, uza kukhumbula umfazwe. Awuyi kukwenza kwakhona!
Naliphi na ithemba lokuyibetha alisebenzi. Ukuyibona kuphela kubangela ukuba umntu aphumle emlonyeni.
Akukho mntu unamandla ngokwaneleyo ukuwuvusa; Nguwuphi na ke oza kuhlala phambi kwam?
Nguwuphi lowo wamnikayo nantoni na, ukuze ndiyibuyisele? Zonke izinto phantsi kwelanga ziye zam.
Andiyi kuphumla ngenxa yemilenze yayo, ngenxa yobuchule bayo obukhulu, ngenxa yentamo yayo entle.
Nguwuphi oza kuyisusa intloko yayo? Nguwuphi oza kuqhawula iinwele zayo ezivulekileyo?
Nguwuphi oza kuvula umlomo wayo? Iinwele zayo ezijikelezayo zibuhlungu.
Umva wayo unemigca yezikhuselo, eziqhotyoshelweyo ngokuqinileyo.
Yonke enye ifutshane kakhulu nenye ukuba akukho moya ungadlula phakathi kwazo.
Zidityaniswe ngamnye nomnye. Zihlala ndawonye kwaye azikwazi ukuthabatha ngaphaya.
Xa itshiza, ukukhanya kuvela; Amehlo ayo afana nokukhanya kosuku lokuqala.
Iinqanawa zomlilo ziphuma emlonyeni wayo, Iziqhamo zomnqamlezo ziphuma.
Umphunga uphuma emlonyeni wayo, njengomoya osuka kwibhotile eshushu phezu kweentyatyambo ezitshisayo.
Umphefumlo wayo utshisa iinkuni, Amafu aphuma emlomo wayo.
Intamo yayo inamandla kakhulu; Uxinzelelo luhamba phambi kwayo.
Iziqhoboshi zenyama yayo zidityaniswe ngokuqinileyo nganye nenye; ziqinile, azikwazi ukujika.
Intliziyo yayo inzima njengelitye, Inzima njengelitye eliphantsi lokutshisa.
Xa ivuka, abanamandla bakhathazeka; Bahamba ngenxa yokutyhala kwayo.
Ikrele liyibetha, alibi nantoni na; inqanawa, ibhombu, nemiyalelo ayibi nto.
Uyenza intsimbi ibe yitywina, nobhedu ibe yimithi ephukileyo.
Iilayini aziyi kwenza ukuba ihambe kude; Izityalo ezisuka kumqolo zifana neentyatyambo zomthi.
Icinga ukuba iinqanawa zifana notywala. Idlala ngesandi sombhoxo owela kuyo.
Isibeleko sayo siguquguqukayo, njengezinto zodongwe ezilahlekileyo. Ishiya umkhondo emlonyeni, njengokuba imilenze yokutyisa.
Ukwenza amanzi aphakamileyo ashushu njengebhotile; Ujikelezisa ulwandle njengebhotile yeoli.
Ishiya umkhondo okhanyayo ngasemva kwayo. Ucinga ukuba ulwandle olunzulu luneenwele ezimhlophe.
Akukho nto ehlabathini ifana nayo; Yakhiwa ukuba ingabikho kuyo uxolo.
Ijonge phantsi kuzo zonke izinto ezidumileyo; Yikumkani phezu kwazo zonke iintaka ezidumileyo.
Waphendula ke uYobhi iNkosi, wathi,
Ndiyazi ukuba unokukwenza nantoni na; akukho mnqweno wakho ongayi kuthintelwa.
Wathi, Yintoni le nto ifihla izigqibo zam ngamazwi angaziyo? Ndathetha izinto endingaziyo, Izinto ezimangalisayo ngokwaneleyo ukuba ndikwazi.
Wathi, Nceda, qaphela ngoku, ndiza kuthetha; ndiya kukubuza, uphendule kum.
Ndandikuxelela ngothixo wakho; kodwa ngoku ndikubona ngamehlo am.
Ndimxolela ke mna ngokwam, ngenxa yento endithethayo; Ndabuya ndisuka kwisono sam, Ndihlala emthethweni nenkungu.

Ke kaloku, emva kokuba iNkosi ethetha loo magama kuYobhi, iNkosi wathi kuElifazi umThemani: Ndincinane kakhulu intliziyo yam kuwe, nabahlobo bakho ababini; ngokuba ningatsho nantoni na engalunganga malunga nam, njengokuthi umkhonzi wam uYobu.

Ke ngoko, niyithatheni namhlanje iinkunzi zeenkomo ezisixhenxe nezimvu ezisixhenxe, niye kumkhonzi wam uYobhi, ninikelani isibingelelo esinyukayo ngenxa yenu; umkhonzi wam uYobhi uya kuthandaza kuni; ndiya kuyivuya intliziyo yakhe, ukuze andibeke phezu kwenu ubuxoki benu; kuba ningathetha ntoni na ngokuchanekileyo malunga nam, njengamkhonzi wam uJob.
Wahamba ke uElifazi umThemani, noBhedi umShuhi, noSofari umNaamathi, basenza njengoko wathethayo iNkosi kubo; waphendula iNkosi umthandazo kaYobhi.
Ke kaloku, emva kokuba uYobhi ethandaza kubahlobo bakhe, iNkosi wambuyisela umphefumlo wakhe; iNkosi wamnika uJobha okuphindwe kabini kokuba wayenakho.

Bafika ke bonke abazalwana bakhe, namadodakazi akhe, nabo bonke ababemxelele ngaphambili, badla naye isidlo sakusasa endlwini yakhe; babemxolela, babemthobela ngenxa yezinto zonke ezibi, iNkosi abezibeka phezu kwakhe; babemnika omnye ngamnye isiqwenga sesilivere, nomnye wamnika umqolo wegolide.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wabambisa iziphelo zemihla kaYobhi ngaphezu kwezokuqala; waza wafumana amawaka alishumi elinane eemvu, namawaka amathandathu eeenkomo, namawaka amabini eenkomo, namawaka eesile.
Waba neentombi ezisixhenxe, neentsana ezintathu.
Wathi igama lenkosikazi yakhe, uYemima; lesibini, uKesiya; neyesithathu, uKeren-Haphuka.
Akukho namadoda elizwe lonke afana neentombi zikaYobhi; utata wabo wabanika ilifa phakathi kwabazalwana babo.
Waphila ke uYobhi emva koko iminyaka elishumi elinamashumi mane, wabona oonyana bakhe, neentombi zeentombi zakhe, nezizukulwana ezine zosapho lwakhe.
Wafa ke uYobhi, eneminyaka emininzi, egcwele ubomi.
Ps: Uphile umntu ongahambanga ngeengcebiso zamadoda akhohlakeleyo, angasekho kwindlela yobuxoki, angasekho nomntu othetha ngoonodoli.
Ke kaloku uthanda umthetho kaYehova, Ucinga ngawo busuku nobusuku.
Wayefana nomthi ogqunywe ngaphaya kwemilambo yamanzi, Unika utywala lwakhe ngexesha lakhe, Imbewu yakhe ayitshiyi; Zonke izinto azenzayo zihamba kakuhle.
Abantu ababi abaye banjalo; Bafana neentyatyambo, izulu lizithutha.
Ke ngoko, ababi abaza kuhlala emini yobulungisa; Abafileyo bangabakho phakathi kwabalungileyo.
UYehova ukhusela indlela yabantu abalungileyo; Ke kaloku indlela yababi yenza ukuba baphele.
Kutheni na ke ukuba iintlanga ziqhelekile? Kutheni na ke ukuba iintlanga zilungiselela izinto ezingalunganga?
Abakumkani behlabathi balungiselela ukulwa, namagqwetha athethe ndawonye ngoYehova, noKumkani wakhe owamachitshiswayo; bathi,
Ndithi, Siyakutshisa amakhonkco abo, sisuse iintonga zabo.
Ohlala kwitrone yakhe emlilweni uya kudlala; UYehova uya kubaxolela.
Wathetha nabo ke ngoxolo lwakhe, Wabaphazamisa ngoxinzelelo lwakhe.
Uthi, Ndamisa ukumkani wam eSiyon, entliziyweni yam engcwele.
Ndiya kukuxelela oko iNkosi agqibelayo. Wathi kum, Unyana wam wena; Namhlanje ndiye ndakuba ngumzali wakho.
Mcele mna, ndiza kukunika izizwe zibe yipropathi yakho, Iindawo eziphakamileyo zehlabathi zibe yipropati yakho.
Uya kuzitshisa ngentambo yentsimbi; uya kuzitshisa zibe ziinxalenye, njengezitya zomhlaba.
Ke ngoko, nibe nobulumko, ningakumkani; Niva lo mqondiso, ningamagqwetha ehlabathi.
Nceda nisebenzele iNkosi ngokholo noxolo, Nikhubeke ngoxinzelelo.
Nciphiseni, niwuthande uNyana, ukuze angabi nobuxoki, nakuba nilahlekele endlela yenu; kuba ubuxoki bakhe buyakwazi ukutyhala ngokukhawuleza. Bathe baphelelwe bonke abaya kuye ngokhuselo.
Ingoma kaDavide, xa ebaleka phambi kokumkani uAbhisalom, unyana wakhe. UYehova, ndineenkunzi ezininzi; abantu abaninzi bakhupha phezu kwam.
Baninzi abantu abathi kum, UThixo akawukhuseli. (Sela)
Ke wena, Nkosi yam, ungusikhuseli sam esijikelezayo; Unika uzuko lwam, uphakamisa intloko yam.
Ndiya kuthandaza kuYehova ngelizwi elinamandla, uphendule kum ukusuka entliziyweni yakhe engcwele. (Sela)
Ndilala, ndiphumle, ndavuka kwakhona; Ngokuba iNkosi undikhusela.
Andiyi kukhathazeka ngenxa yamawaka alishumi elinesihlanu abantu, Abamjikelezisayo ukuba ba pondere.
Yiya, Nkosi yam, ndisindise, Thixo wam; Uye wabetha ngamehlo abo bonke abathunywa bam, Watshisa iinwele zababi.
Usindiso luvela kuYehova; Inyaniso yakho ibe ngabantu bakho. (Sela)
Umphathi wengoma, ukuba aqhutywe ngemibhobho. Ipsalme kaDavide. Yiphendule kum xa ndithi, Thixo wam, umlungisa wam; Nceda unciphise iintlungu zam; Ndincede, udibanise umthandazo wam.
Ingaba niza kuqhubeka nini, mna bantu, niguqule uzuko lwam libe ngububi? Ingaba niza kuqhubeka nini nithanda izinto ezingalunganga, nilandele ubuxoki? (Sela.)
Ke ngoko, uyazi ukuba iNkosi wakhetha abantu abathembekileyo kuye; UYehova uya kundiphendula xa ndimbiza.
Khumbula, ungabi nesono; Xa uhlala ebhedini lakho, qaphela, uphumle. (Sela.)
Ninikele izibingelelo ezilungileyo, Nceda iNkosi.
Baninzi abantu abathi, Nguwuphi lowo uza kusibonisa into elungileyo? Ukukhanya kobuso bakho, Nkosi yam, kutyhila kuthi.
Uyigqibile intliziyo yam ngovuyo olukhulu, Ngaphaya kobuninzi bengqolowa newayini entsha.
Ndiya kuhlala, ndiphumle ngoxolo; Kuba wena kuphela, iNkosi, uya kundikhusela.
Lo mlawuli wengoma, ukuba aqhutywe ngeeflethi. Ipsalme kaDavide. UYehova, phulaphule amazwi am, Yazi into endithethayo.
Yiva ukholo lwam, Ukumkani wam, Thixo wam; Kuba ndiya kuthandaza kuwe.
Ngomso, Nkosi yam, uya kuyiva ilizwi lam; ngomso ndiya kukunika izicelo zam, Ndilinde ukuphendula kwakho.
Awunguye uThixo othanda ububi; Akuyi kubakho umntu olungileyo ehlala nawe.
Abantu abadumileyo bangayi kuhlala phambi kwakho; Uwoyika onke akwenzayo ububi.
Uya kucima abo bathetha ubuxoki; UYehova uthobela abantu ababulalayo, nabakhohlisayo.
Ke mna, ngenxa yobundlobongela bakho obukhulu nokholo lwakho, ndiya kungena endlwini yakho; Ndiza kunqunyamisa iTempile yakho engcwele.
UYehova, qhuba mna ngobubele bakho, Kuba ndineenkunzi; Yenza indlela yakho ilungelelaniswe phambi kwam.
Akukho nto bathethayo enokuthethwa ngayo; Intliziyo yabo igcwele ukulimala, Iindlebe zabo zifana nengqungquthela evulekileyo; Basebenzisa izilwimi zabo ukuxolela.
UThixo, babeke phantsi ityala labo; Iingcinga zabo zize zibe yingozi kubo; Bakhuphe ngenxa yobuninzi bomonakalo wabo, Ngokuba bekukhohlisa wena.
Ke bona bonke abathe bafika kuwe, ukuba bakhuselwe, babe mnandi; babe mnandi ngonaphakade, ngokuba uyabakhusela; babe mnandi ngenxa yakho abo bathanda igama lakho.
Ubabalisa abantu abalungileyo, Nkosi yam; Wabagubungela ngobubele bakho njengesikhuselo.
Umphathi wengoma, ukuba adlala ngezixhobo zemibhobho, nge-lyra enemibhobho esixhenxe. Ipsalme kaDavide. UYehova, musa ukundixolela xa ukhokelayo, Musa ukundigweba xa ukhokelayo.
Mncede, Nkosi yam, ngokuba ndilahlekile; Ndiphilise, Nkosi yam, Kuba iinwele zam ziqhutywa.
Umphefumlo wam onke uphambukile kakhulu; UYehova, kuya kuphela nini oku?
UYehova, buyela, usindise; Ndikhusele ngenxa yobubele bakho.
Abafayo abakukhumbulanga wena; Nguwuphi na oza kukubonga ekufumaneni?
Ndilahlekelwe ngumsindo wam; Ngobusuku ngabunye ibhedi yam iqhutywa luloyiko lwam, Ibhedi yam ndiyitshisa ngoxolo lwam.
Amehlo am aphukile ngenxa yoxinzelelo, Amava am aphelelwe lixesha ngenxa yabachasi bam bonke.
Yiyekeni kum, nina bonke abawenza ububi; Kuba iNkosi wava ukuxoka kwam.
UYehova uphendule umnxeba wam wobubele, UYehova wathabatha umthandazo wam.
Baya kuxhaphaka, baya kugwetywa bonke abagxeki bam; baya kubuyela umva, baya kuxhaphazwa ngokukhawuleza.
Ingoma kaDavide, awayeyidlala kuYehova, ngoKushi wesizwe sikaBhenjamin. Nkosi yam, Thixo wam, ndifika kuwe ukuba ndikhuseleke; ndisindise kuwo onke amanyathelayo kum, undixelele.
Ukuba ke awuyi kuyenza loo nto, Ziya kunqunyamisa njengelion, Ziya kunqunyulwa, akukho mntu unokundikhusela.
Nkosi yam, Thixo wam, ukuba ndiyenze loo nto, ukuba izandla zam zisenza okubi;
ukuba ndenze ntoni na embi kumntu ophila ngoxolo nam, okanye ndirhoxe umkhosi wam ngaphandle kwesizathu;
Ke mna umqolo wam, ndimlandele, andifikele; Athabathe ubomi bam emhlaba, Ashiye ubuhle bam kumanzi. (Sela).
UThixouThixo, vuka ngobuxoki bakho, vuka uthabathe inkanuko yabathunywa bam; Khumbula, ndincede! Uwisela umthetho ubulungisa.
Bahlangane nawe abantu bezizwe, Ube ngukumkani wabo ukusuka phezulu.
UYehova ugweba iintlanga; Ndigwebe, Nkosi yam, Ngobuxoki bam, ngobulungisa bam.
UThixo owenzayo ubulungisa, uvavanya iinwele neentliziyo zezinto eziphilayo;
UThixo ngukhuselo lwam, Wabasindisa abo bulungisa ububele babo.
UThixo ungumgwebi olungileyo; Uxoka ngezinto ezibi mihla le.
Ukuba umntu akabuyanga emngciphekweni wakhe, uThixo uya kugqiba ikhephu lakhe; Uya kwenza umbhoxo wakhe ube mfutshane.
Wazilungiselela izithuthi zakhe ezibulalayo, Wazilungiselela iinqanawa zakhe ezinomlilo.
Yabona, umntu ongalunganga ukhulelwe ububi; istisa intlungu, wazala ubuxoki.
Ukhupha umngxuma, waphuma ke emlonyeni wakhe owenzayo.
Intlungu yakhe ibuyela kuye; Ububi bakhe deletela kwiqhosha lakhe.
Ndiya kubulela iNkosi, ngokuba wenza into elungileyo; Ndiza kudlala igama likaThixo oNgcwele.
Umphathi wengoma, ngesixhobo esivela eGathi; Ipsalme kaDavide. UYehova, Nkosi yethu, Kuhle kangakanani na igama lakho kwihlabathi liphela! Wabeka ubukumkani bakho ngaphezu kwezulu.
Kwimilomo yabantu abancinci, nabantwana abakhulelweyo, ukwakha ubutyebi ngenxa yama­lidla akho, Ukwenza ukuba umqolo wakhe ube mkhulu, Ukwenza ukuba umnqamleze umqolo wakhe, Nalowo efuna ukuxolela.
Xa ndizijonga izulu lakho, elizimeleyo ngesandla sakho, Inyanga neenkwenkwezi ozibeke phezulu;
Zithini na izinto eziphilayo, ukuba uzithathele ingqalelo? Zithini na izinto eziphilayo, ukuba uzithathele ingqalelo?
Wakwenza ukuba abe ngaphantsi kweenkwenkwezi ngento encinci, Wamnika umnqamlezo wozuko nobubele.
Wakwenza ukuba abe ngukumkani phezu kwazo zonke izinto ozenzayo; Wazisa yonke into phantsi kweenyawo zakhe.
Zonke iinkomo nezimvu, nazo zonke izinto eziphilayo,
iintaka zezulu, neentlanzi zaselwandle, nazo zonke izinto ezihamba phantsi kweendlela zeelwandle.
UYehova, Nkosi yethu, Lihle kangakanani na igama lakho emhlabeni wonke!
Umlawuli wengoma, Ukufa konyana. Ipsalme kaDavide. Ndiya kubulela iNkosi ngentliziyo yam yonke; Ndiza kuthetha zonke izinto zakho ezimangalisayo ozenzayo.
Ndiya kuphumla, ndivumile ngenxa yakho; Ndiza kudlala igama lakho, Thixo ophezulu.
Xa abathunywa bam bebuyela umva, Bathe baphazamiseka, baphelelwe phambi kwakho.
Uthe wakhusela izigwebo zam, necala lam; Wahlala kwitrone yakho, njengomgwebi olungileyo.
Wazixelela iintlanga, wabulala ababi; Wacima amagama abo ngonaphakade, kude kube sekupheleni.
Iinkunzi zebhokhwe ziqhutywa ngokugqithiseleyo kude kube sekupheleni; Imizi yabo uyikhuphile phantsi, Ukumbulo lwazo alukho.
Ke iNkosi uya kuhlala kude kube sekupheleni, Wabeka isithsaba sakhe ukuba athethe.
Uya kugweba ihlabathi ngenyameko, Uza kugweba iintlanga ngokholo.
UYehova ngudonga lokukhusela labo ababiweyo, Udonga lokukhusela kwixesha lengxaki.
Abayaziyo igama lakho baya kuthemba kuwe; Kuba wena, Nkosi, awuwashiyelanga abo bafunayo.
Nqumleleni iNkosi, ohlala eSiyon; Zixelele iintlanga izinto zakhe azenzayo.
Uyamkhumbula lowo ugweba ababulalayo abo bahluphekayo, Akaze akhohlwe intloko yabo.
UYehova, nceda mna; Yabona ukuba ndinyanzeleka ngabandichukumisayo; Nciphisa mna kumasango okufa,
Ndiya kushumayela uzuko lwakho lonke; Ndiza kukhulisa ukusindisa kwakho, Kwiingcango zeSiyon.
Iintlanga ziwela emngxunyeni wazo, bawuxhathisa; izandla zazo zafunyanwa kwintsontelo yabo.
UYehova waziwa ngomthetho wakhe owenzayo; Abakhohlakeleyo baqhutywa zizinto ezenziwe ngamehlo abo. (Sela).
Izinto ezingenamsebenzi ziya kungena ekufumaneni, nazo zonke izinto ezingenamsebenzi ziya kungena ekufumaneni.
Ke kaloku abantu abafunayo abaye bakhohlwa ngonaphakade; Ithemba leentlanga alizukufa.
Yiya, Nkosi yam, Musa ukuba umntu aphumelele; Zigwetywe iintlanga phambi kwakho.
UThixouThixo, baphoxeke; Ziqonde iintlanga ukuba abantu kuphela. (Sela)
UYehova, kutheni na ukuba uhlala kude kakhulu? Kutheni na ukuba ufihlakala xa kukho intlungu?
Abantu abakhohlakeleyo, abanobukrelekrele, bahlasela abo bancinane; Nceda baqhutywe ziingcinga zabo ezibi.
Umnqamlezo ubhaptiza ngezinto ezifunayo intliziyo yakhe; Ubhaptiza abantu abanobunkunkqele, waphulaphula iNkosi.
Umntu okhohlakeleyo, ngenxa yobubele bakhe, akawukhangelanga uThixo; Akukho sithuba kuThixo ezingqondweni zakhe.
Izinto zonke azenzayo, zibonakala ngathi ziphumelela; Uphakamile, imiyalelo yakho isuka engqondweni yakhe; Waba ngumvuzo kuwo onke amadini akhe.
Uthi engqondweni yakhe, Akuyi kubakho nto iyandikhathazayo; Ndiza kuhlala ndingenakukhathazeka ngonaphakade, phakathi kweentlanga.
Umlomoappeyintloko wakhe uzele ziingxowa-mali, nobuxoki, neengxowa-mali; Ubuhlungu nobubi bukwisiphelo selwimi lwakhe.
Ufihla, uhlala ecaleni kweedolophu; Esuka kwiindawo zakhe ezifihlakeleyo ubulala abantu abangenabulungisa; Amehlo akhe ajonge ngokufihlakeleyo abafayo.
Ulinde ngokufihlakeleyo, njengokuba ilili likwindawo yayo; Ulinde ukuba athabathe abo bakhubazekileyo. Wawathatha, wabatsala ngentambo yakhe.
Baqhutywa, bagwetywa abo bangamandla; Bawela phantsi kobukrelekrele bakhe.
Uthi entliziyweni yakhe, UThixo ukhohliwe; wafihla ubuso bakhe; Akuyi kubakho ukukubona.
Yiya, Thixo kaYehova, uphakamise isandla sakho ukuba usebenze; Musa ukulibala abo bakhubazekile.
Kutheni na ukuba umntu ongalunganga aphucule uThixo? Kutheni na ukuba athethe entliziyweni yakhe, UThixo akazukundiphendula loo nto?
Ke wena ubona ingxaki noxinzelelo. Uyiqaphela kwaye uyithatha kwizandla zakho. Umonakalo ushiya ngokwakhe engqondweni yakho. Unceda abantwana abangenababa.
Utshise isandla somntu okhohlakeleyo, onobubi; Khumbula ububi bakhe bonke, ukuze ungafumani.
UYehova ngukumkani ngonaphakade, ngonaphakade; Izizwe ziya kuphelelwa lilizwe lakhe.
UThixouThixo, uyayiva imithandazo yabantu abancinane; uya kubaqinisa, uya kubaphulaphula.
Ukwenza umthetho kubantwana abangenabazali, nakwabaphelelwe lithemba; ukuze abantu behlabathi bangaphazamisi mntu mkhulu.
Umlawuli wengoma, uDavide. Ndiya kungena kuYehova ukuze ndikhuseleke; Ungandithi njani ke mna, Uhambe njengentombi ukuya entlango yakho?
Bona, abakhohlakeleyo bamisa izithuthi zabo; Babeka amasuntswana abo ezintamboni, ukuba batshise emazulwini abantu abanengqondo elungileyo.
Xa iziseko ziqhutywa, abantu abalungileyo banokwenza ntoni na?
UYehova ukwiTempile yakhe engcwele, Itrone kaYehova isemhlabeni; Amehlo akhe ajonge, Abona abantu bonke.
UYehova uvavanya abantu abalungileyo; Ke yena uyawathanda abo bakhohlakeleyo, nabathandela ububi.
Uza kuthutha phezu kwabo ababi iinkuni ezishushu; umlilo, nesilivere eshushu, nomoya obandayo, kuya kuba ngumsebenzi wabo.
UYehova wenza ubulungisa ngonaphakade, uthanda ubulungisa; Abantu abathembekileyo bayakubona ubuso bakhe.
Lo mlawuli wengoma, ngeentambo ezisibhozo ze-lyra. Ipsalme kaDavide. Nceda, Nkosi yam, kuba akukho bantu bathembekileyo abaseleyo; abantu abathembekileyo balahlekile phakathi kwabantu.
Bathetha ubuxoki ngamnye nomnye, Bemamela ngemilomo yabo; Bathi into enye, becinga into enye.
UYehova athabathe onke umlomo othandekayo, Yonke ulwimi oludumileyo.
Bathi, Siza kuphumelela ngeelwimi zethu; Imilomo yethu iya kuba yethu; Nguwuphi oza kusilawula?
Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Ngokuba abafileyo baqhutywa, nabafazi begula; ngoko ke ndiya kuvuka, ndiza kwenza; ndiya kubakhusela ekubeni bahlaselwe ngabo.
Amabinzana kaYehova acocekileyo, njengesilivere eqhutywa kwifuthe lodonga, ibhajstvolwe izixhenxe.
Uya kubakhusela, Nkosi, uya kubakhusela kuloo mntu ngonaphakade.
Amadoda akhohlakeleyo ahamba ngapha nangapha, Xa into engalunganga ibhalelwa ngabantu.
Umthandazo kaDavide. Kude kube nini, Nkosi yam? Uza kundilibala kude kube nini na? Uza kunifihla njani ubuso bakho kum?
Ingaba ndiya kuphulukana nantoni na ngezinto endizicingayo, Nenza ubuhlungu entliziyweni yam yonke imihla? Ingaba umkhosi wam uya kuhlala ixesha elingakanani emnqamlezweni wam?
Ndijonge, ndiphendule, Nkosi yam, Thixo wam; Nceda unciphise amehlo am, ukuze ndize ndiphumle ngokufa.
Ithi ke inkosi yam, Ndimbetha; Bazithandela oomkhuluwa bam xa ndiwela.
Ke mna ndiyathemba kuthando lwakho; Intliziyo yam iyavuya, Kuba uyandisindisa.
Ndiza kuvuma iNkosi, Kuba mna wandiselela kum.
Umlawuli wengoma, uDavide. Abantu abakhohlakeleyo bathi engqondweni yabo, Akukho Thixo; baphelelwe lithemba, besenza izinto ezibi; akukho namnye owenza kakuhle.
UYehova ujonge emazulwini kubo bonke abantu, ukuba abone ukuba ngaba kukho owaziyo, nokuba ngaba kukho okhangela uThixo.
Bonke baguquka, bonke baphelelwe lithemba; Akukho namnye owenza okulungileyo, akukho namnye.
Ingaba abantu ababi banolwazi na? Badla abantu bam njengokuba bedla isonka, Bangasibizanga iNkosi.
Apha ke, bazele uxinzelelo; Kuba uThixo ungumntu owenzayo okulungileyo.
Ngubani na, mntu olungileyo? Niiashukumisa izigqibo zabafazi; Ke iNkosi uyabakhusela.
Ndiyathemba ukuba usindiso lwakwaSirayeli luza kuvela eZiyon!­lidla iNkosi ebuyisela abantu bakhe, UYakobi uya kubhiyozela, uSirayeli uza kuphumla.
Ingoma kaDavide. UYehova, ngubani na oza kuhlala ekhayeni lakho elingcwele? Ngubani na oza kuhlala emnqamlezweni wakho ongcwele?
Umntu ohamba ngeendlela ezilungileyo, esenza into engalunganga, ethetha inyaniso emphefumlweni wakhe.
Lo mntu akayi kusasaza ubuxoki malunga nabanye, akayi kunyanzelisa umhlobo wakhe, kwaye akayi kuxhaphaza umhlobo wakhe.
Lo mntu ubona ngaphaya kwabo balungileyo, Ke kaloku uyayihlonela iNkosi; Lo mntu ugcina isibhengezo, nokuba sibuhlungu, akayitshintshanga.
Lo mntu udlulisa imali ngaphandle kokuhlawula umvuzo, akathatheli intlawulo ukuxhaphaza abantu abangenanto. Wonke umntu owenza ezi zinto akayi kuqhutywa.
Ingoma kaDavide. Ndikhusele, Thixo wam; Kuba ndifika kuwe ukuba ndikhuselwe.
Ndathi kuYehova, UThixo wam ukho wena; ngaphandle kwakho akukho nto ilungileyo endiyifunayo.
Abangcwele bakaThixo ezweni bayamangalisa; Ndiya kuphumla kubo.
Abathi balandela amadini amanye, baya kuba neentlungu ezininzi; ndiya kuzisusa igazi labo, andiyi kuthetha namagama amadini abo.
Undumnike, Nkosi yam, inxalenye yam, nesiselo sam sokubhaptizwa; Uyikhusela into yam.
Ilizwe elinika wena kum likwindawo entle; Ndinelifa elimnandi, mna.
Ndimthanda iNkosi, umqhubi wam; Nasebusuku intliziyo yam ifundise.
Ndimbeka iNkosi phambi kwam ngonaphakade; Kuba ecaleni lam elikunene, Akuyi kubakho into endinqamla.
Ke ngoko, intliziyo yam iyavuya, ulwimi lwam lubhiyozela; Inyama yam nayo iya kuphumla ekhuselekileyo.
Awuyi kundishiya entolongweni, Akuyi kumvumela ungcwele wakho ukuba aphuke.
Uyandixelela indlela yobomi; Ndiya kuthanda ukuba ndikho kuwe; Ekunene kwakho kukho izihlandlo ezihlala ixesha elide.
Umthandazo kaDavide. UYehova, udibanise umnqweno wam olungileyo; Yiva umthandazo wam, Osuka kumlomo ongenabuxoki.
Inyaniso yam ifike kuwe; Amehlo akho abone into elungileyo.
Uyivavanya intliziyo yam, Uyivavanya ngemini; Uyivavanya, awufumani nantoni na engalunganga. Ndiyaqonda ukuba umlomo wam akazukwenza isono.
Ngezinto abazenzayo abanye abantu, ndizithobela ilizwi lakho, Ndizikhusela kwindlela yabantu abanobuxoki.
Izikhokelo zam zihlala kwiindlela zakho; Amehlo am akayi kuqhutywa.
Ndiza kukubiza, Thixo, ngokuba uya kundiphendula; Nciphisa indlebe yakho kum, Phinde amazwi am.
Nceda, ndibonise ubulumko bakho obungabonakaliyo; Ubakhusela ngesandla sakho esikunene Abaya kukunceda ukuba bakhuseleke ebantwini babo.
Ndikhusele, njengokuba ukhusela amehlo akho; Ndifihlakele kwisithunzi seengalo zakho.
Ebantwini ababi, abandihlaselayo, Kuzo zombini iintshaba zam ezifayo, ezimjikeleza.
Intliziyo yabo iqinile, ingalunganga; Umlomo wabo uthetha amagama aqaqambileyo.
Bathi bathutha phantsi kuthi, basijikeleze; Amehlo abo ajonge ithuba lokusikhupha ehlabathini.
Bafana nelilion elifunayo ukutya kwayo, njengelion encinci efihlakeleyo.
Yiya, Nkosi, ujongene nabo, ubakhuphe phantsi; Nceda ngekhefu lakho, ndisindise kulabo ababi.

UThixouThixo, sebenzisa isandla sakho, usindise ebantwini abanjalo, abantu behlabathi le, abanomsebenzi wokuphila kuphela kuloo mihla; uzele izibeleko zazo zonke izinto zakho ezibalulekileyo; abantwana babo baninzi, bagcina iimpahla zabo zabantwana babo.
Ke mna, ngenxa yokuba ndenze okulungileyo, ndiya kukubona ubuso bakho; Ndiza kuhlala ndiphumle, ndikubone.
UDavide, umkhonzi kaYehova. Wavuma iNkosi amazwi alo ingoma, xa wayemsindisa iNkosi ebantwaneni bakhe bonke, noSawule. Wathi, Ndikuthanda wena, Nkosi yam; uThixo wam, ungumandla am.
UYehova ngudonga lwam, nendlu yam ekhuselekileyo, nomsindisi wam; uThixo wam ngudonga lwam, ndiya kungena kulo; umgquba wam, nokusindisa kwam okunamandla, nophahla lam oluphezulu.
Ndimbiza iNkosi, lowo uthandekayo; Ndasindiswa ngabatshaba bam.
Izibophelelo zomphefumlo zandijikeleza, Iinqanawa zezinto ezinobungozi zandiseka.
Izibonda zesibhedlele zandijikeleza; Iintshukumo zokufa zazi phambi kwam.
Kwingxowa-mali yam ndimbiza iNkosi, KuThixo wam ndeva; Endlwini yakhe waphulaphula ilizwi lam, Uxolo lwam lwafika ezindlebeni zakhe.
Ke kaloku, ihlabathi latshixiwa, latshixiwa; Iziseko zeentaba zatshixiwa, zaqhutywa, ngokuba wayekhatywe.
Umlilo wawuphuma emlonyeni wayo, Umnxeba waphuma emlonyeni wakhe; Iintsimbi ezikhanyayo zazitshisa.
Wazikhupha izulu, wahla; Amafu amnyama aye phantsi kweenyawo zakhe.
Wahamba phezu kweekherubi, wabaleka; Wanyuka phezu kwamaphiko omoya.
Wakwenza ubumnyama bube yindawo yakhe yokufihla; Iimvula ezimnyama, nezivunguvungu zezulu, zaziyitente yakhe ejikeleze kuye.
Ukusuka kukukhanya kwakhe okujikeleze kuye, kwavela amafu akhe aqinileyo, namatye emvula, nezibane zomlilo.
UYehova wavuma ngethutyana ukusuka emazulwini, Ilizwi likaThixo oNkulu laphuma, Intaba-mlilo neengqekembe zomlilo.
Wakhupha amasuntswana akhe, wabaphazamisa abathunywa bakhe; Wathumela iinkwenkwezi ezikhulu zesibhakabhaka, wabaphazamisa.
Ke kaloku kwabonakala phantsi kolwandle, Kwaboniswa iziseko zehlabathi, Xa wazisa, Yehova, ngomoya womoya womlomo wakho;
Wamisa isandla sakhe ukusuka phezulu, wamthabatha; Wamsusa elwandle olukhulu.
Wamkhusela kumnqamlezo wam onamandla, Kubo abandixhaphazayo; Kuba babenamandla kakhulu kunam.
Bendihlasela ngemini yam yoxinzelelo, Ke kaloku iNkosi wandixhasa.
Wamkhupha kwindawo evulekileyo, Wamkhulula ngenxa yokuba wayethandana nam.
UYehova wandihlawula, ngokuba ndenza into elungileyo; Wandibuyisela ngenxa yokuba izandla zam zicocekile.
Ndizigcina iindlela zikaYehova; Andiyi kwenza into elungileyo, Rusika uThixo wam.
Imimiselo yakhe yonke ingaphambili kwam, Ndize ndize ngaphaya kwemimiselo yakhe.
Ndiye ndaba mnene phambi kwakhe, Ndazikhusela kum emnqamlezeni.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wandihlawula, ngokuba ndenze okulungileyo; Kuba izandla zam zicocekile ngamehlo akhe.
Kubo abakholwayo, bonisa ukuba uthembekile; kubo abanetyala, bonisa ukuba awunacala.
Kubo abacocekileyo, ubonisa ukuba ucocekile; Ke kubo abakhohlakeleyo, ubonisa ukuba unayo ingqondo.
Usindisa abantu abaphantsi; Ubakhupha phantsi abo amehlo abo aphakamileyo.
UThixo wam, uguqula ubumnyama bam bube kukhanya.
Ngoncedo lwakho ndiya kuhlasela iqela lemikhosi; NguThixo wam ndiya kukhupha phezu kodonga.
Indlela kaThixo igqibelele, Ilizwi likaYehova licocekile; Uyikhuselo kubo bonke abafikayo kuye ukuze bakhuselwe.
Nguwuphi uThixo, ngaphandle kukaYehova? Nguwuphi umthi, ngaphandle kaThixo wethu?
NguThixo onika amandla am, Owenza indlela yam igqibelele.
Iinyawo zam zenza ukuba ziqiniseke, njengeenyawo zesihlwele; Ndiyimisa pondera.

Amazwe aphelelwe luthando, Asuka ezindaweni zabo eziqinileyo, aphuma entolongweni.

Thixo wam, ndivuya ngemini, kodwa awuphenduli; Ndivuya ngobusuku, kodwa andikwazi ukuphumla.

Abafazi bethu bathembela kuwe; babethembela kuwe, wabakhusela.
Bakubiza wena, basindiswe; Bakuthembela kuwe, bangabikho phantsi koxolo.
Ke mna ndiyintsholongwane, andinguye umntu; abantu bamxelela ngokubi, bajonge phantsi kum.
Bonke abandibonayo bandiseka kum; Bathi, Ndimxolele, batshisa iinwele zabo, besithi,
Wayithemba iNkosi; iNkosi ingusindisi wakhe; iNkosi ingusindisi wakhe, ngokuba uthanda kakhulu kuye.
Ke mna uyandikhupha emntwini wentombi yam, Ukwenza ukuba ndithembe kuwe, Nakuba ndingumntwana engqondweni yentombi yam.
UThixo wam nguwe ukusukela ekuzaliseni kwam; Uye waba nguThixo wam ukusukela ekuphumeni komntwana wam.
Musa ukuhlala kude nam; Kuba intlungu ikufuphi, Akukho mntu unokukunceda.
Iinkunzi zeegusha ezininzi zimi phezu kwam, Iinkunzi zeegusha ezinamandla zaseBhashani zimi phezu kwam.
Bavula imilomo yabo ngokubanzi kum, njengokuba iileyo zivuthayo, ziqhekeza ukutya kwazo.
Ndiqhutywa ngamanzi, Zonke iinwele zam zitshintshile indawo; Intliziyo yam yenziwe njengesilivere, Ixutywe ngaphakathi kwam.
Intliziyo yam itshiziwe njengentsimbi ephukileyo; Ulwimi lwam luthe lwamathela emlonyeni wam; Umimise kumsi wokufa. Uthi, Mhlawumbi mna ndiya kuba nguThixo?
Iinkunzi zeegusha zimi phezu kwam, Iqela lamadoda akhohlakeleyo limile kum; Zazitshixa izandla zam neenyawo zam.
Ndizibala iinwele zam zonke; Abantu bajonge kum, bendijonga.
Bahlula phakathi kwabo izihlangu zam, Bakhupha iinkwenkwezi ngento endiyigqokayo.
Ke wena, Nkosi yam, musa ukuma kude; Umandla wam ukho kuwe; Yiya ngokukhawuleza kumnceda.
Ndikhusele kwikrwada, Ndikhusele umphefumlo wam obalulekileyo Kumandla eenyoka.
Usindise kum emlonyeni welili; Usindisele kum kwiintsontelo zeenkomo zomhlaba.
Ndiya kukuxelela igama lakho bazalwana bam, Ndiya kukuzinikela kuwe phakathi kwabakhoyo.
Nizithandeni iNkosi, nina abawukhathalelayo; nimhlonele yena, bonke abasetyhini bakaYakobi; nimhlonele kuye, bonke abasetyhini bakaSirayeli.
Akayi kubeka iliso lakhe phantsi, ayisayi kubuyela umva ekufumaneni ubuhlungu kwakhe; akawufihla ubuso bakhe kuye; waphulaphula xa wayethandaza kuye.
Uwe nto ndiya kukuxelela ngayo phakathi kweqela elikhulu labantu; Ndiza kuzigcina izibhengezo zam phambi kwalabo abanqwenela.
Abafazi abafileyo baya kudla, baza kuthotywa; Abo bafuna iNkosi baya kumhlonipha. Intliziyo yenu ihlale ubomi obungunaphakade.
Zonke iziphelo zehlabathi ziya kuzikhumbula, ziye kuYehova; Zonke iintsapho zeemfazwe ziya kukuhlangula phambi kwakho.
Ubukumkani buyiNkosi; Ulawula phezu kwezizwe zonke.
Zonke iinkunzi zehlabathi ziya kudla, ziyihlonele; bonke abawela emlilweni baya kumhlangula, abo bangazigcinanga ubomi babo.
Izizukulwana ezizayo ziya kumkhonza; Abantu baya kubaxelela abantwana babo ngoYehova.
Baza kungena, bashumayele kubo bonke abangazalwanga, ukuba yena usenza into elungileyo; ngokuba wayeyenza.
INkosi ngumalusi wam, ngoko andiyi kuswela nto.
Indilalisa ndiphumle emadlelweni aluhlaza. Indikhokelela ngasemanzini azolileyo, athe cwaka.
Iyawuhlaziya umphefumlo wam. Indikhokela kwiindlela zobulungisa, ukuze igama layo lizukiswe.
Nokuba ndihamba entlanjeni emnyama njengokufa, andiyi koyika bubi, kuba wena unam. Intonga yakho yobumalusi nomsimelelo wakho ziyandithuthuzela.
Undilungiselela itafile iintshaba zam zibukele. Uthambisa intloko yam ngeoli njengophawu lokwamkelwa. Indebe yam izele ide iphalale.
Ndiqinisekile ukuba ukulunga kwakho nothando lwakho olungagungqiyo luya kuhlala nam yonke imihla yobomi bam. Kwaye ndiya kuhlala endlwini yeNkosi ngonaphakade.
Intliziyo kaDavide. Ihlabathi liya kuYehova, nazo zonke izinto ezingaphakathi kulo; ihlabathi, nabo bonke abahlali kuyo, nguye.
Wayenza phezu kweelwandle, Yayimisa phezulu emanzini.
Nguwuphi oza kukhupha umnqamlezo kaYehova? Nguwuphi oza kuhlala kwindawo yakhe engcwele?
Abathi izandla zabo zicocekile, intliziyo yabo icocekile; abathe bangatho thandabuzi into engalunganga, abathe besenza izibhengezo ezinobuxoki.
Baya kufumana uzuko kuYehova; UThixo, umsindisi wabo, uya kubanika ubulungisa.
Yiyo loo nto abantu belindela kuye, Belindela ubuso bakho, Thixo kaYakobi. (Sela)
Nciphise intloko zenu, ningamasango; vulani, ningamasango asendulo, ukuze ungene Ukumkani wobubele.
Nguwuphi uKumkani wobubele? UYehova, onamandla onamandla; iNkosi, onamandla emfazweni.
Nciphise intloko zenu, ningamasango; vulani, ningamasango asendulo, ukuze ungene Ukumkani wobubele.
Nguwuphi lo Mlawuli wozuko? UYehova wamaSirayeli nguMlawuli wozuko. (Sela)
UDavide. Nkosi, ndinika wena umphefumlo wam.
Thixo wam, mna ndikuthemba wena; Musa ukuba ndakhutshwa; Musa ukuba abathunywa bam baphumle kum.
Wonke lowo ulindelwe nguThixo, akaze ahlambulule; kodwa baya kuhlambuluka abo bathandazelayo ngaphandle kosizathu.
Ndibonise iindlela zakho, Nkosi yam, Zifundise imizila yakho.
Ndikhokelele enyanisweni yakho, ndifundise; Kuba wena uThixo wosindiso lwam; Ndiya kukulindela yonke imihla.
Khumbula, Nkosi yam, ububele bakho nobuxoki bakho; Ubabonise ukususela ekuqaleni.
Musa ukukhumbula izono zam zexesha lam elincinci, Nazo zonke izinto endizenzayo ezingafanelekanga; Khumbula mna ngenxa yobubele bakho, Kuba ulungileyo, Yehova.
UYehova ulungileyo, ewenza ubulungisa; Ke yena ufundisa abafileyo indlela yabo yokuhamba.
Wabakhokela abancinci ekunene, Wayibafundisa indlela yakhe.
Zonke iindlela zikaYehova zilungileyo, zinyaniso kubo abagcinayo umnqophiso wakhe, namasiko akhe.
UYehova, ngenxa yegama lakho, Yazixolela isono sam; Kuba sikhulu.
Bathini na abantu abamthanda iNkosi? Uya kubafundisa indlela ekufuneka bayikhethe.
Baya kuphila ubomi obulungileyo; abantwana babo baya kuyifumana ilizwe.
UYehova ungumhlobo wabo bonke abamwikelelayo, Wababonisa umnqophiso wakhe.
Amehlo am ajonge kuYehova ngonaphakade; Kuba yena uya kuzikhulula izandla zam emngxuma.
Yiba nam, ube nomsindo kum; Kuba ndisoloko ndizamile, ndigula.
Iingxaki zentliziyo yam zikhula, Ndisindise kumngcipheko wam.
Yabona uxinzelelo lwam, neentlungu zam, Usindise zonke izono zam.
Yabona, baninzi abathunywa bam; Bamchukumisa ngobuxoki obukhulu.
Gcina umphefumlo wam, usindise mna; Musa ukuba ndixhaphake; Kuba ndifika kuwe ukukhuseleka.
Inyaniso yam, nokunyaniseka kwam, ndizikhusele; Kuba ndikulinde wena.
Thixo, usindise amaSirayeli kuzo zonke iingxaki zabo.
UDavide. Nkosi, ndigweme; ngokuba ndahamba ngeendlela ezingenakubi; Ndiyathemba iNkosi, andicingi nto.
UYehova, mvavanye, undixelele; Yabona intliziyo yam neentloko zam.
Inyaniso yakho ndiyibeka phambi kwamehlo am ngonaphakade; Ndiya kuphila ngokuqinisekileyo kwakho.
Andiyi kuphumla kunye nabakhohlakeleyo, Andiyi kuchitha ixesha kunye nabantu abathi balungileyo.
Ndizixolele iintlanganiso zabantu ababi, Andiyi kuphumla ndawonye nababi.
Ndizihlamba izandla zam, ndithi ndingenakubi; Ndiyajikeleza isibingelelo sakho, Nkosi,
bavuma ngeengoma zokubonga, bethetha ngazo zonke izinto ezimangalisayo ozenzayo.
Ndiyayithanda indlu yokuhlala kwakho, Nkosi yam, Indawo ehlala kuyo ubuhle bakho.
Musa ukundisusa kunye nabantu abanesono, Musa ukuthatha umphefumlo wam kunye nababulalayo,
Abazizele izandla zabo ngeminqweno emibi, nezipho.
Ke mna ndiphila ubomi obungenasono; Usindise, uthande.
Izinyawo zam zihlala phantsi ecaleni lomhlaba; Kwiintlanganiso ezinkulu ndiya kubonga iNkosi.
UDavide. UYehova ngukukhanya kwam, ungumsindisi wam; Ndingxolele nani? UYehova yindawo ekhuselekileyo yobomi bam; Ndingxolele nani?
Ke kaloku, xa abantu ababi bendihlasele ukuba bandise ubomi bam, abo mntu-mntu, nabaphulaphuli bam, batshixiwa, bawela.
Nakuba umkhosi unxibelelana nam, intliziyo yam ayiyi kukhathazeka; Nakuba ukulwa luphuma kum, ndiya kuhlala ndiqiniseke.
Into enye ndiyifumene kuYehova, le nto ndiyifunayo: ukuba ndihlale endlwini kaYehova zonke imihla yam yobomi bam, ukuze ndibone ubuhle bukaYehova, ndiye ndimbuze endlwini yakhe.
Xa kufika uxinzelelo, uya kundikhusela emlonyeni wakhe; Uya kundifihla ekhayeni lakhe elingcwele; uya kundibeka abertaba.
Ke ngoko, intloko yam iya kuphakama ngaphezu kwabatshaba bam abajikeleze kum; Ndiya kunikela izibingelelo ezintlanganisweni zakhe ngemibhiyozo, Ndiza kwenza umculo, ndimvulela iNkosi.
Nkosi, ndimva xa ndithi ngelizwi elinamandla; Ndincede, mphendule.
Xa usithi, Bona ubuso bam, intliziyo yam ithi kuwe, Ndiyakubona ubuso bakho, Yehova.
Musa ukufihla ubuso bakho kum, Mna umkhonzi wakho, ungamthubi ngoxolo; Uye waba ngumncedisi wam; Musa ukunishiya, uThixo wosindiso lwam,
Nakuba utata wam nomama wam bendishiya, UYehova uya kundikhathalela.
Ndifundise, Nkosi, indlela yakho; Ndiyiqhube ngendlela ethe nkqo, ngenxa yabachasi bam.
Musa ukundinikela kunqweno lwabathunywa bam; Kuba abakhohlakeleyo baphuma kum, Baphucula ubundlobongela.
Ndiye ndiqinisekile ngaloo nto, ukuba ndiya kubona ubulungisa bukaYehova ngelixa ndiphila.
Lindelani iNkosi, nibe namandla, nibe ngamagosa; Yaye, lindelani iNkosi.
UFUKUZIMBA: KUNZOKA KUYINZIKWA KUNYE, UKUNTUNYA KUNYE, UKUNTUNYA KUNYE, UKUNTUNYA KUNYE?
Liva ilizwi lam, xa ndicela uncedo, Xa ndithandaza kuwe, Xa ndiphakamisa izandla zam kwindawo yakho engcwele.
Musa kunditsala kunye nababi, kunye nabasebenzi bobubi, Abathetha amagama athandekayoi'awo kumakhaya abo, Intliziyo yabo inezinto ezibi.
Yababuyisele ngokwento abayenzayo, ngokwezinto zabo ezibi; Yababuyisele ngokwento eyenziwe ngamehlo abo; Yababuyisele ngokwento abayenzayo.
Bathi bangaziboni izinto azenzayo iNkosi, nantoni na eyenziwe ngamehlo akhe; ngoko ke uya kubaphula, akaze aphinde abenza.
Lincede iNkosi, ngokuba waphulaphula intliziyo yam, Xa ndicela uxolo.
UYehova ngumandla wam, lukhuselo lwam; Intliziyo yam ithemba kuye, yena uya kundinceda; Intliziyo yam iya kwenzakalisa ngothando, Ndiya kumbonga ngengoma yam.
UYehova ngumandla wabo bonke abantu bakhe, Yindawo ekhuselekileyo yokusindisa ukumkani wakhe othambileyo.
Usindise abantu bakho, ubhaptize abakhoyo kuwe; ube ngumbingeleli wabo, uwathabatha ngonaphakade.
Ingoma kaDavide. Nceda niwubule iNkosi, ningamazulu, Niwubule iNkosi ngenxa yobuqaqawuli bakhe nobukrelekrele bakhe.
Nceda ninike iNkosi uzuko lwegama lakhe, Niwukhonze iNkosi ngobuhle obungcwele.
Ilizwi likaYehova lingaphezulu kwamanzi, UThixo wobudumo uthutha umsindo; iNkosi uthutha umsindo phezu kwamanzi anamandla.
Ilizwi likaYehova linamandla, Ilizwi likaYehovahavi likhulu.
Ilizwi likaYehova litshisa izityalo zeediliya, UYehova utshisa izityalo zeediliya zaseLibanoni.
Uzenza iintaba zeLibanoni ziqhume njengenyosi, Intaba kaSiriyon ibe yindodana yenkomo.
Ilizwi likaYehova libetha ngamandla elanga.
Ilizwi likaYehova litshisa isiqithi; UYehova utshisa isiqithi saseKadeshi.
Ilizwi likaYehova libangela ukuba iinkomo zizalise, Likhupha izityalo ezimdaka; Endlwini yakhe batsho bonke, Uzuko.
UYehova wahlala kwitrone yakhe ngaphezu kolwandle; UYehova uhlala etroneni yakhe, njengoKumkani, kude kube kuphela.
UYehova unika amandla abantu bakhe; UYehova ubambisa abantu bakhe ngoxolo.
Ingoma kaDavide, iingoma zokunikela kweTempile. Ndiya kukuxelela phezulu, Yehova, ngokuba uyandikhupha phezulu; Akukho namnye wabaphulaphuli bam oza kunqula kum.
Nkosi yam, Thixo wam, ndakubiza, wandiphilisa.
Mna, Nkosi, uyandikhupha emlonyeni wam; Usindise ubomi bam, Ndize ndize ngaphaya kwengca.
Nqumleleni iNkosi, nibantu bakhe bonke abathembekileyo; Niwubulele, nikhumbula igama lakhe elingcwele.
Inkanuko yakhe ihlala ixesha elifutshane, Uthando lwakhe luhlala ubomi bonke; Kude kube ngobusuku ulilindela, Ke komhla wesithathu kufika uthando.
Ndathi, Xa izinto zihamba kakuhle kum, Akuyi kubakho nto iyandikhathaza.
UYehova, xa ubenenkosi kum, wayenza ndibe namandla njengentaba; Ke kaloku, xa uyifihlayo imilenze yakho, ndaxhalabela.
Ndiya kuthandaza kuwe, Nkosi yam; Ndimcela iNkosi ukuba amthande.
Ingaba kulungile na ukuba ndifa, ukuba ndihla phantsi emngxunyeni? Ingaba uthuli lunokukubonga wena? Ingaba luya kukuxelela ukuba uthembekile?
Ndiphendule, Nkosi yam, undithande; Nkosi yam, ube ngumncedisi wam.
Utshintshe ukholo lwam lube ngumdaniso; Wazisusa izihlangu zam zobuxoki, Wandigqoka ngovuyo.
Ukuba intliziyo yam ibhale ingoma kuwe, Ize ingatshiyi; Ndiya kukubonga ngonaphakade, Yehova, Thixo wam.
Ingoma kaDavid. Nkosi, ndimkele wena ngenxa yokhuselo. Akukho mntu unyuse kum ukuba uxhaphake. Nceda undixelele kuba wenze into elungileyo.
Yihlazise indlebe yakho kum, Yaza ngokukhawuleza usindise; Ube lilitye lam elinamandla, Inqaba yam yokugcina.
Intaba yam, inqaba yam, ukho wena; ngenxa yegama lakho, qhuba mna, uncede mna.
Usindise mna emlonyeni ofihlakeleyo kum, Kuba wena ungumkhuseli wam.
Ezandla zakho ndibeka umphefumlo wam; Ndisindise, Nkosi yam, uThixo othembekileyo.
Ndiwachukumisa abo bakhonza izinto ezingalunganga; Ke mna ndiyathemba iNkosi.
Ndiya kuphumla, ndivumile ngenxa yobulungisa bakho; Ubone ukufa kwam, Wazi ubuhlungu bam obunzulu.
Akundinikezeli kumnqamlezo wam; Ubeka imilenze yam kwindawo evulekileyo.
Mncede, Nkosi yam, ngokuba ndikwingozi; Amehlo am, nomphefumlo wam, nenyama yam, ziphelelwe lithemba.
Ngokuba ubomi bam buphelelwe ngumsindo, Neminyaka yam iphelelwe ziingxowa; Intliziyo yam ilahlekile ngenxa yobulungisa bokwenene; Amathambo am apheliswa.
Ngokungafaniyo nabatshaba bam bonke, Abakumkani bam bengathandabuzeki kum; Abazalwana bam bakhathazekile ngenxa yam; Abandibonayo emaphandleni baya kubaleka.
Bami bandilibala, Ndithi ndifile; Ndiye ndavakala ngathi ngumkhenkce ophukileyo.
Ndiziva iintlanga ezininzi zithetha phantsi ngeendlebe zam, Ubuxoki bumi ngaphaya kwam; Bathe baphikisa ndawonye kum, befuna ukunibulala.
Ke mna, Nkosi yam, ndiya kuthemba kuwe; Ndithi, UThixo wam unguwe.
Intliziyo yam ikwisandla sakho, Ndisindise kumnqamlezo wam, Kubo abandiphazamisayo.
Ubuso bakho buqaqambe kum, ummelo wakho; Ndisindise ngenxa yobubele bakho.
Mna, Nkosi yam, musa ukuba ndixhaphake; kuba ndakubiza wena. Baxabiswe abakhohlakeleyo, baphumle emngcwabeni bengenalutho.
Zivale imilomo yabantu abakhohlakeleyo, Abathethayo ngobukrelekrele nobuxoki abantu abalungileyo.
Yintoni na inkulu ubuhle bakho, obukugcinele abo bakukhathalelayo; Okubunika abo bafikayo kuwe ngoxolo, phambi kwamehlo onke abantu.
Ubafihla kukhuselo lobuso bakho, Ukusuka kubomi behlabathi; Ubakhusela kwindawo yakho efihlakeleyo, Kuzo zonke iilwimi ezichaphazelayo.
Bawubule iNkosi, ngokuba wabonisa kum ububele bakhe obumangalisayo, Ukholo lwakhe oluthembekileyo, Kwidolophu eqhutywa ngumlilo.
Ndathi ke, xa ndimxhalabile, Ndilahlekile phambi kobuso bakho; Ke wena waphulaphula ukholo lwam, Xa ndandithandaza kuwe.
Nithandane noYehova, nibantu bakhe bonke abathembekileyo; UYehova ukhusela abo bathembekileyo kuye; Ke kaloku uya kuhlawulisa ngokugqithisileyo abantu abadumileyo.
Buyisani amandla, nibe namandla, bonke ababeka ithemba labo kuYehova.
Yipsalme kaDavide, enobulumko. Kuye kumnandi umntu oxolelwe ububi bakhe, isono sakhe sikhuselwe.
Kuye kuhlanzekile umntu othi iNkosi akawuhlawulisi umonakalo, Umphefumlo wakhe ongenabuxoki kuwo.
Xa ndathi ndiphumle ngenxa yesono sam, Inyama yam yaphelelwa lixesha, Ngokuba ndizamile yonke imini.
Ubusuku nemini, isandla sakho sancipha phezu kwam; Intliziyo yam yatshisa njengomlilo wonyaka omtsha. (Sela)
Wathi ke, Ndiya kukuxelela isono sam, Andiyi kufihla intlungu yam; Ndathi, Ndiya kuziveza izonzo zam kuYehova; Wamxolela umngcipheko wesono sam. (Sela)
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bakho abathembekileyo baya kuthandaza kuwe, ngelixa sele bekwazi ukukubona; ke xa amanzi emvula anyuka, aya kubakho.
Uyindawo yam efihlakeleyo wena, Undikhusela kumngcipheko; Undijikelezisa ngengoma yokusindisa. (Sela)
Ndiza kukufundisa, ndiya kukuxelela indlela omele uhambe ngayo; ndiya kukuqhuba, ndiya kukubeka iliso lam phezu kwakho.
Musani ukuba ningamakhoboka, nanjengombumbulu, angaziyo nto; kufuneka ziqhutywe ngeentambo neengxowa-mali, ukuze zingafike kuni.
Abantu ababi baneentlungu ezininzi; Ke kaloku ubuxoki bukaYehova bujikeleza abo bafuna uxolo kuye.
Baphileni ngoYehova, nikhubeke, nina abawenzayo ubulungisa; Nqumleleni ngovuyo, bonke abanengqondo ecacileyo.
Nqumleleni ngovuyo iNkosi, nina abawenzayo ubulungisa; Kulungile ukuba abantu abanobulungisa bamxelele.
Nceda iNkosi ngemibhobho, Nceda umculo wakhe ngemibhobho elishumi.
Yibani nengoma entsha kuye, Nceda nidlale ngobuchule, Nitshoni ngovuyo!
Ilizwi likaYehova liyinyaniso nenyaniso; Uthembekile kuwo onke amanyathelo akhe.
Uthanda ukuthanda okulungileyo nobulungisa, Ihlabathi lizele ngothando lukaYehova.
Ngelizwi likaYehova zadalwa iinkwenkwezi; Ngomoya womlomo wakhe zakhiwa zonke iiplanethi.
Uhlanganisa amanzi elwandle abe ngumthi omkhulu; Amanzi aphakamileyo awabeka emagumbini okugcina.
Ihlabathi liphela libe noxolo kuYehova, Umhlaba wonke ube noxinzelelo kuye.
Wathetha, yadalwa ihlabathi; wamisa umyalelo, yathi iya kuba.
UYehova unciphisa izigqibo zeentlanga, Uyimisa into abantu abacinga ukuba bayiyenze.
Kodwa izigqibo zikaYehova zihlala kude kube kuphakade, Intliziyo yakhe ihlala kude kube kusuku nosuku.
Kambo kambo kambo kambo kambo kambo kambo kambo kambo.
UYehova ujonge emazulwini, Ubona wonke umntu.
Kulapho ehlala khona kwitrone yakhe, Ubona bonke abahlali behlabathi.
Uyenza intliziyo yabo yonke, Yazi zonkehavimbi zabo zonke.
Akukho ukumkani okhuselwa kubukhulu bomkhosi wakhe; Akukho mfazi okhuseleka kumandla akhe amakhulu.
Isiphatho asiyiyo indlela eqinisekileyo yokukhuselwa. Intliziyo yayo inkulu ayikwazi ukukhusela nabani.
Ke kaloku iNkosi ubalinda abo bamkhathalelayo, Abo bethemba ubulungisa bakhe.
Wabakhusela ekufaneni, Wabagcina bephila kwixesha lendlala.
Silinde iNkosi; Uncedo lwethu nokhuselo lwethu nguye.
Intliziyo yethu iya kuthandazela kuye, Kuba silinde igama lakhe elingcwele.
Uthando lwakho, Nkosi yam, lube nathi; Kuba thina siyakuthemba wena.
UDavide, xa esenza ukuba abe ngumfana phambi kuka-Abhimeleki, Wathi ke uAbhimeleki wamkhupha, waphuma. Ndiya kumthandazela iNkosi mihla le; Umlomo wam uya kumthandazela ngonaphakade;
Ndiya kubhiyozela ngoYehova; Bathi abantu abancinci bacinge, babe mnandi.
Nxibelelani nam, nitsho ubukhulu bukaYehova; sithandaze igama lakhe ndawonye.
Ndimfuna iNkosi, wamphendula; Wandisindisa kuzo zonke izinto endizenzileyo ukukhathazeka.
Abambonayo kuye bakhanya ngovuyo, Iintloko zabo azigqubuthelenga kunyameko.
Lo mfazi umngcipheko wayalela, UYehova wamphendula, Wawusindisa ezonweni zakhe zonke.
Iingelosi zikaYehova zibekwe etham,ileli ezimhlonelayo, Zibakhusele.
Ncokolani, nibone ukuba iNkosi ungumntu olungileyo; Kuye kuhlanjululwa umntu ohamba kuye ekukhuseleni.
UYehova uThixo wenu, babantu bakhe abangcwele, mna ke ndimthanda kakhulu; Kuba abo bamthandayo baya kufumana konke.
Nakuba iileyo ezimncinci zilahlekile, zinendlala; Ke bona abajonga kuYehova, bangabi nento elungileyo.
Nceda, abantwana bam, nindixelele; Ndiza kunifundisa ukuba ningamkhathali iNkosi.
Ingaba ufuna ukuyonwabela ubomi kwaye uphile ixesha elide ukuze ubone iintsuku ezilungileyo?
Ke ngoko, khusela ulimi lwakho ekubeni lubi, nemilomo yakho ukuba ingathethanga ubuxoki.
Yiyeke into engalunganga, wenze oko kulungileyo; Khangela uxolo, uyilandele.
Iinwele zikaYehova zijonge kubo abazenzayo izinto ezilungileyo; Iindlebe zakhe zivuya ngoxolo lwabo.
Ke ubuso bukaYehova bumele abo basenza okubi; Uya kucima yonke inkumbulo yabo ehlabathini.
Abantu abalungileyo bathandaza, iNkosi ubaphendula; Wabasindisa kuzo zonke iintlungu zabo.
UYehova ufutshane nalabo abaneentliziyo eziphukileyo, Wabasindisa abo banenkathazo yomoya.
Amadoda alungileyo aneentlungu ezininzi; Ke iNkosi umsindisa kuzo zonke.
Uzikhusela zonke iintsontelo zawo; Akukho mnye kubo oza kuvutha.
Ububi luya kubulala ababi; Abamxhalabisayo abantu abalungileyo baya kufumana ityala.
UYehova usindisa abakhonzi bakhe; Wonke umntu ophuma kuye ukuba akhuseleke, akayi kuba necala.
UDavide. Nkosi, uthethe nabathe bathetha nam; Uthini na abathe bathetha nami?
Nciphise izithuthi zenu, ezikhulu nezincinci, niza kumnceda.
Nciphisa isithunywa sakho, uvale indlela yabo abandiphazamisayo; Ndithi kum, Ndiye mna owenza ukuba ndiphile.
Bakhubeke, bagwetywe abo befuna ukufa kwam; Babecinga ukuba bandise umphefumlo wam, babuyele umva, babe phantsi koxolo.
Babe njengeziqhamo eziqhutywa ngumoya, Isithunywa sikaYehova siza kubathutha.
Indlela yabo ibe mnyama, ibe yindawo ethe tyaba; Isithunywa sikaYehova siza kubaphulaphula.
Ngokungasoze kubekho sizathu, bafihla inqanawa yabo kum emngxunyeni; Ngokungasoze kubekho sizathu, baxhaphaza umngxunya ukuba bandise.
Yathi inkunkuma ifike kubo ngokungxamisekileyo; Inqanawa yabo efihlakeleyo yathi iyabatsala; Yathi bathabathe inkunkuma yabo.
Ndiya kuthandazela ke ngoYehova; Ndiza kubhiyozela, ngokuba umsindisile.
Ndiya kuthetha ngemiphefumlo yam yonke, UYehova, ngubani na ofana nawe? Usindisa abafazi abo banamandla kunabo; Usindisa abafazi nabafazi abafunayo abo bayababulala.
Bavuka abashushisi bobubi, bambuza ngezinto endingaziyo.
Bandibuyisele ukungxama ngento elungileyo; Ndishiyeka ndisoloko mna.
Ke kaloku, xa begula, ndazigqoka iimpahla ezingwevu zesithunywa; Ndathi ndimkele ukutya, ukuze ndenze umsindo wam; Amathandabuzo am ayengaphendulwa.
Ndaba ngathi ngabahlobo bam, okanye abazalwana bam; Ndayihlangula intloko yam, ndazixolela, Ngathi umntu otyhala utata wakhe.
Ke kaloku, xa ndandisemngciphekweni, badibana, babhiyozela. Bahlangana nabantwana bam abazange ndibayazi; bathabathela phantsi kum, besiya ngaphaya.
Njengoko abantu abakhohlakeleyo becula emdlalweni, Batshisa iinwele zabo kum.
Nkosi, uya kuba ulinde ixesha elingakanani? Usindise kum ekuhlaselweni kwabo; Usindise umphefumlo wam obalulekileyo kulezi lion.
Ndiya kukubulela ngoko phambi kweqela elikhulu; Ndiya kukuzinikela kuwe phakathi kwabantu abaninzi.
Musani ukubhiyozela phezu kwam abathunywa bam abanobuxoki; Musani ukutyhala iinwele kwabo bathandana nabo, bemchukumisa ngaphandle kwesizathu.
Abangaozuthetha ngoxolo; Bafuna ukuthetha ubuxoki kubo bonke abantu abakhululekileyo ezweni.
Bavula imilomo yabo ngokubanzi kum, besithi, Haha! Haha! Siyabona ngamehlo ethu.
Ukubona, Nkosi yam, musa ukunyamalala; Nkosi yam, musa ukuba kude nam.
UThixo wam, phefumla, uphakame, undikhusele; Nkosi yam, kulwa ityala lam.
UYehova, Thixo wam, ndithi ulungile; Ndithi ulungileyo; Musani ukuba babhiyozele kum.
Musani ukuba bathi engqondweni yabo, Akunjalo na! Le nto siyifumeneyo. Musani ukuba besithi, Siwutshile umlomo wakhe.
Bonke abo bathandazelayo ngengxaki yam, bagwetywe, bagwetywe; Abathi banyuke ngenxa yam, bagwetywe, bagwetywe.
Bonke abo banqwenela ukulunga kwam, babe noxolo, babe nomsindo; Bathi rhoqo, Umkhulu iNkosi, Uthandazela ukuba umkhonzi wakhe akwenze kakuhle.
Ulwimi lwam luza kuthetha ngokwenza kwakho okulungileyo; Ndiya kukubonga yonke imihla.
Umlawuli wengoma, nguDavide, umkhonzi kaYehova. Ndinelizwi entliziyweni yam, Ngesono sabantu ababi; Akubakho ukholo kuThixo kubo bonke.
Bathi baphakame ngokwabo, ukuba bangabonanga isono sabo, basixolele.
Ilizwi labo elithethayo lingalunganga, ligcwele ubuxoki; Baye bamisa ukuqonda kwabo, kwenzeni okulungileyo.
Nakwibhedi yabo bacebisa okubi; Bakhetha indlela engafanelekanga, bangabuyanga ekubeni kubi.
Inyaniso yakho, Nkosi yam, ifike emazulwini; Ubuxoki bakho bufikelele kumazulu.
Ubulumko bakho bufana neentaba ezinamandla; Izigwebo zakho ezilungileyo zifana nelwandle olunzulu. UYehova, wena ukhathalela umntu nenyama.
Yintoni entle, Thixo, inyaniso yakho yobubele! Abantu baya kukhuseleka kwisithunzi samaza akho.
Zidla isonka sazo esimnandi endlwini yakho, Zazisela ubisi lomlambo wakho wezinto ezilungileyo.
Uye umthombo wokuphila; ilanga lakho lisenza sibone ilanga.
Nceda ugcine ububele bakho kubo bayaziyo wena, Nobubele bakho kubo abathembekileyo intliziyo yabo.
Musani ukuba ndiqhutywe ziinyawo zabadumileyo, Musani ukuba izandla zababi ndizikhuphe.
Yabona, bawela njani abantu ababi? Baqhutywa phantsi, bangayi kuvuka.
UDavide. Musani ukuba neentloni ngenxa yabantu ababi, Musani ukuba nobuxoki kubo basenza ububi.
Ngokukhawuleza baya kutshisa njengeentyatyambo, Baya kuphelelwa ngamanzi njengamatye aluhlaza.
Yithembe iNkosi, niyenze into elungileyo; Nihlale ezweni, nidla izityalo ezikhuselekileyo.
Uyonwabele iNkosi; Uya kukunika iimfuno zentliziyo yakho.
Yazisa iNkosi yonke into oyenzayo; Ukholose kuye, yena uya kuyilungisa loo nto.
Uya kwenza ukuba ubulungisa bakho bukhanya njengemini, Nobulungisa betyala lakho bukhanya njengokuba lilanga emini.
Nceda uphumle phambi koYehova, ulinde kuye; Musa ukukhathazeka xa abanye bephumelela, Xa abantu besenza izigqibo zabo ezibi.
Musa ukuba nobuxoki, utshintshe ubuxoki bakho. Musa ukuba nobuxoki, kuba bukhokelela kububi.
Abantu ababi baya kulahleka; Ke bona abalindeli iNkosi baya kuyifumana ilizwe.
Kwixesha elincinci baya kususwa ababi; uya kuwafuna, kodwa abayekho khona.
Ke kaloku abantu abathe nkqo baya kufumana ilizwe, baphile ngoxolo olukhulu.
Abantu ababi bacinga ngezinto ezilungileyo, Bazitshisa iinwele kubo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi unqula ababi; Kuba uyazi ukuba imini yabo iya kufika.
Ababi bakhupha iiklabhu zabo, babambe izithuthi zabo, ukuba bathabathe abafazi nabafileyo, ukuba babulale abo behamba ngokunyanisekileyo.
Ke kaloku izikrweqe zabo ziya kutyhala intliziyo yabo, Amagophe abo aya kuvutha.
Izinto ezincinci abantu abalungileyo abanezo, zingcono kuneziqhamo zababi abaninzi.
Intloko yomntu ongalunganga iya kuqhutywa; Ke iNkosi ugcina abantu abalungileyo.
UYehova ukhusela ubomi bomntu onobulungisa; Izinto abazifumanayo ziya kuba zihlala kude kube kuphela.
Akuyi kubakho ukuxhaphazwa kwabo kwixesha elibi; Nakuba lixesha lendlala, baya kuba nesonka.
Ke kaloku abantu ababi baya kufa; Abachasi bakaYehova baya kuba njengeentyatyambo zesizwe, Baya kuphelisa njengomoya.
Abantu ababi bathatha inxaxheba, bangayibuyiseli; Ke bona abalungileyo baya kunikela.
Abawubhaptizayo iNkosi baya kuyifumana ilizwe; Ke abo ababuselayo baya kulahleka.
UYehova uqinisa imilenze yomntu, Xa ethandazela indlela yokuphila komntu lowo.
Nakuba batshisa, abayi kuphelelwa; ngokuba iNkosi ubamba isandla sabo.
Ndandineminyaka embalwa, ndaba mkhulu; Andizange ndibone abantu abalungileyo beshiyeka, Nabantwana babo becela isonka.
Bahlala benika, banikela ngokukhululekileyo; Abantwana babo bahlala benobubele.
Yiyeke into engalunganga, uyenze into elungileyo; Uza kuhlala ngokukhuselekileyo ngonaphakade.
UYehova uthanda ubulungisa, Akayi kushiya abantu bakhe abathembekileyo; Baza kukhuselwa ngonaphakade; Ke bona oonyana bobubi baya kukhutshwa.
Abantu abalungileyo baya kuyifumana ilizwe, baza kuhlala kulo ngonaphakade.
Abantu abalungileyo bathetha amagama enzululwazi, Intloko yabo ithetha into efanelekileyo.
Umgaqo kaThixo wabo ungaphakathi kwintliziyo yabo; Amehlo abo akayi kuqhutywa.
Abantu ababi bajonge abantu abalungileyo, befuna ithuba lokuwabulala.
Ke kaloku iNkosi akaze ashiye abantu abalungileyo engqondweni yabo, Akaze abonise ukuba bangabikho semthethweni, xa bebekwa kuhlolo.
Ulinde iNkosi, uhambe ngendlela yakhe; uya kukuxelela ngokuzinikela kwakhe ukuba akunike ilizwe; uza kubona ukuba ababi balahliwe.
Ndabona umntu okhohlakeleyo, onamandla, ethe yasasazeka njengentyatyambo emthini wayo.
Ke kaloku waphuma, waphela; ndaye ndimkhangela, kodwa akafumanekanga.
Yabona abantu abalungileyo, ubone abo bathembekileyo; Kuba kukho ixesha elizayo labo abayenzayo inyaniso.
Ke kaloku bonke ababi baya kulahleka; Ixesha elizayo lamadoda akhohlakeleyo liya kususwa.
UYehova usindisa abantu abalungileyo, Nguwo umnqamlezo wabo kwixesha lengxaki.
UYehova ubanceda, wabasindisa; Wabasindisa kulabo ababi, wabakhusela; Kuba baya kuye ukuba bakhuseleke.
Ingoma kaDavide, encedayo ukukhumbula. UYehova, musa ukundicaphukisa xa uxhaphakile; Musa ndamqhobosha xa ucinezela intloko yakho.
Amagosa akho anentliziyo yam; Isandla sakho sitshisa phantsi kum.
Intliziyo yam yonke ibuhlungu ngenxa yobuxoki bakho; Iithambo zam azikhuselekanga ngenxa yesono sam.
Iintsomi zam zifana nolwandle oludlula phezu kwenkophe yam; Ziyinto enzima kakhulu ukuba ndiyithwale.
Iintlungu zam ziphukile, Zigcwele iintsholongwane ngenxa yobuxoki bam.
Mna ndithe nkqo, mna phantsi; Ndihamba ndililila yonke imihla.
Umqolo wam ushushu ngenxa yeentlungu. Isiqu sam sonke sinesifo.
Ndilahlekile, ndiphambukile ngokupheleleyo; Ndinyamezela ngenxa yobuhlungu bengqondo yam.
Uyazi, Nkosi, zonke iimfuno zam; Akukho msindo wam ofihlakele kuwe.
Intliziyo yam iqhutywa, Umandla wam uphelile; Namehlo am aphumile.
Abahlobo bam nabahlobo bam bahlala kude ngenxa yesifo sam; Intsapho yam ihlala kude.
Abamfunayo ukubulala bam, bamisa iintaka kum; Abamfunayo ukunyamezela kwam, bethetha ngento yo abertasa lam; Bacinga ubuxoki mihla le.
Ke mna ndithi, Ndifana nomntu omnyama, angaliva; Ndifana nomntu ongathethanga, angavuli umlomo wakhe.
Ndiye ndaba njengendoda engathethiyo, engenanto yokuphendula.
Ndikulinde wena, Nkosi yam; Uza kuphendula, Thixo wam, Nkosi yam.
Ndithi, Musani ukubhiyozela ngaphezu kwam, Musani ukudumisa ngaphezu kwam, Xa inyawo lam litshisa.
Ndiya kuwela. Iintlungu zam zihlala ndizifumana.
Ndiyazi isono sam, ndinyanzeleka ngenxa yobulungisa bam.
Abathunywa bam banamandla, baninzi; Baninzi abantu abamchukumisayo ngaphandle kwesizathu.
Bandihlawulisa ntoni na elungileyo ngento ebi, Bamhlasela ngenxa yokuba ndifuna ukwenza okulungileyo.
Mna iNkosi, musa kundishiya; Thixo wam, musa ukuba kude nam.
Yiya uncedo lwam, Nkosi, umsindisi wam.

Kuye uJeduthun, umphathi wengoma. Ipsalme kaDavide. Ndithi, Ndiya kucamngca ngobomi bam, ukuze ndingabi nesono ngelwimi lwam; ndiza kuyivala imilomo yam, njengokuba ndiyivale ngomlomo, xa abantu ababi bemijikeleza.
Ndathi ke, Andithethanga nto, Andithethi nantoni na elungileyo; Ke kaloku intlungu yam yakhula.
Intliziyo yam yashushula ngaphakathi kwam; Ndacinga ngaloo nto, umlilo waphuma. Ndathetha ke ndathi,
Ndibonise, Nkosi yam, ukuba imihla yam iya kuphelisa nini, nokuba zininzi kangakanani na iintsuku zam; Ndibonise ukuba ixesha lam lide.
Iintsuku zam uzenza zibe ziinyawo ezincinci; Ubomi bam bonke bufana nokungabakho kuwe; Umntu wonke ngumoya. (Sela)
Umntu ngamnye uhamba njengesithunzi; bahamba ngento engenanto. Bagcina ilifa, bangazi ukuba ngubani na oza kulifumana.
Ke ngoko, Nkosi, ndilinde ntoni na? Ukholo lwam lukho kuwe.
Ndisindise ezonweni zam zonke, Athi abantu abakhohlakeleyo bangandixelela.
Ndiye ndanyamalala, andivuleli umlomo wam; ngokuba wena uwenza loo nto.
Musa ukundibetha; Ndiphelelwe ziintloko zesandla sakho.
Xa ungenzi isono sabantu ngenxa yezono zabo, Udla izityalo zabo njengentaka; Umntu wonke ngumoya. (Sela)
UYehova, udibanise umthandazo wam, Unqulethe ingxolo yam; Musaibhontsindezi yam. Ndingumkhenkethi kuwe, ndinomhlali, njengokuba bonke abazalwana bam babenjalo.
Mhlawumbi ndiya kuba mnandi kwakhona phambi kokuba ndihambe, ndihambe."
Umphathi wengoma. Ipsalme kaDavide. Ndiyathemba iNkosi; Uthe wabuyela kum, Wava umsindo wam.
Wandikhupha kumngxunya woxinzelelo, Emlonyeni womthi nodongwe; Wamisa izandla zam phezu kwelitye, Wamnika indawo eqinileyo yokuhlala.
Wabeka ingoma entsha emlonyeni wam, ingoma yobubele kuThixo wethu; Abaninzi baya kuyibona le nto, baza bakhathazeka, baza kuba nethemba kuYehova.
Uphile umntu othembela kuYehova, Ongazijongi iinyembezi zabo, Nabo babuyela emngciphekweni.

Nkosi yam, Thixo wam, izinto zakho ezimangalisayo zininzi kakhulu, nezigqibo zakho zethu zininzi; akukho namnye onokusifana nawe. Ukuba ndiza kuzichaza zonke, ziya kuba zininzi ngokwaneleyo ukuba zingalinganiswanga.
Iintyatyambo nomnikelo wesono awuwuthandanga; Uvule indlebe yam ukuba ndizixelele. Izithako eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezithembiso zesonka, awazifunayo.
Wathi ke mna, Mna apha, ndiya; kuncwadi lweencwadi libhalwe malunga nam loo nto.
Ndiya kuthanda ukwenza izigqibo zakho, Thixo wam; Umthetho wakho uphakathi kwentliziyo yam.
Ndiya kushumayela iindaba ezilungileyo zobulungisa bakho kwintlanganiso enkulu; Uyazi, Nkosi yam, ukuba andivumeli imilomo yam.
Andiyi kufihla ubuhle bakho entliziyweni yam; Ndithetha ngokholo lwakho, nokusindisa kwakho; Andiyi kufihla ubulumko bakho nobuxoki bakho kumkhosi omkhulu.
Musa, Nkosi yam, ukuwuvala umsindo wakho kum; Uthando lwakho nobuxoki bakho bakhusele mna ngokuqhubekayo.
Iingxaki zam zininzi kakhulu, zijikeleze kum, Andikwazi ukuzilinganisa; Izigwebo zam ziqhekekile kum, Ndingaziboni; Zingaphezulu kuneenwele zentloko yam; Ndilahlekelwe ngumphefumlo.
Nceda, Nkosi, ndisindise; Yiya ngokukhawuleza, Nkosi, undincede.
Bakhutshwe, bagwetywe bonke abafunayo ukufa kwam; Babuyiselwe umva ngobuxoki abo bafunayo ubundlobongela bam.
Abathi kum, Ahha! ahha! Bagwetywe ngubuxoki babo bonke.
Ke bona bonke abakulindelayo, bahlale bevuya ngokuthanda kwakho; Bonke abo bathanda ukusindisa kwakho, bahlale besithi, Ukhulu iNkosi.
Ke mna, ndinomngcipheko, ndinengxaki; UYehova andiqaphele; Uncedo lwam, nomsindisi wam, unguwe; Thixo wam, musa ukulibazisa.
Umlawuli wengoma. Ipsalme kaDavide. Uphila umntu ocinga ngezinto zesihlwele; UYehova uya kumsindisa ngexesha lengxaki yakhe.
UYehova uya kumkhusela, uyamgcina ephilayo; uya kuba ngumsindisi ezweni; iNkosi akawunikezeli emlonyeni wabo bonke abachasi bakhe.
UYehova uya kumxhasa ebhedini yakhe yokugula kwakhe, Uya kumbuyisela ekubeni aphile.
Ndathi, UThixouThixo, ndizalise kum, Ndiphilise; Kuba ndenze isono kuwe.
Abathunywa bam bathetha ngezinto ezibi malunga nam, besithi, Uza kufa nini, lilindelwe igama lakhe?
Ke kaloku, xa efika omnye kubo kumbona, uthetha izinto azifunayo; egcina izilumkiso ezibi entliziyweni yakhe; ke kaloku, xa ephuma, uthetha kubo bonke.
Bonke abandichukumisayo, bathetha ngelizwi lam; Bacinga ngokubi ngam.
Bathi ke, Unesifo esibi kakhulu; ulele, akayi kuvuka kwakhona.
Ke kaloku umhlobo wam othandekayo, owandithembayo, owadla isonka sam, utshintshile kum.
Ke wena, Nkosi yam, uncede kum; Nciphisa umphefumlo wam, ndibahlawule.
Ndiyazi ukuba uthandana nam, Kuba umqolo wam akayi kunikwa amandla kum.
Undixhasa ngenxa yobulungisa bam, Uyigcina phantsi kwakho ngonaphakade.
Lombani iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, ukususela ngoku ukuya kuthi ga: Amen, amen.
Umlawuli wengoma. Ipsalme yokufunda, yaba oonyana bakaKorha. Njengoko iintaka zinqwenela imijelo yamanzi, Ndiyakuthanda wena, Thixo.
Ndimthubi uThixo, uThixo ophilayo; Ndiza kungena nini ndihlale phambi koThixo?
Iintyatyambo zam ziye zaba ngukutya kwam busuku nobusuku, Xa besithi kum, Aphi uThixo wakho?
Ndizikhumbula ezi zinto, ndizikhupha intliziyo yam, ukuba ndahamba neqela elikhulu, ndabakhokela endlwini kaThixo, ngengoma yothando nobubele phakathi kweqela elikhulu elilungiselela iholide.
Uthini na, mphefumlo wam? Uthini na, uxinzelelo lwam ngaphakathi kwam? Yibeke ithemba lakho kuThixo; Ndiya kumvuyisa kwakhona, ngokuba nguThixo wam.
Thixo wam, mna ndineentlungu engqondweni yam; ngoko ke ndiya kukukhumbula ukusuka kwilizwe lomlambo iJordan, ukusuka eziphakameni zentaba iHermon, ukusuka kwintaba iMizar.
Iilwandle eziphakamileyo zibiza izilwandle eziphakamileyo, Ngengxolo yeziqhamo zakho; Zonke iintaka zakho neengqekembe zakho zigqubuthele kum.
Ngemini iNkosi uthumela intliziyo yakhe elungileyo; Ngobusuku ingoma yakhe ihamba nam, Umthandazo kuThixo ophilayo.
Ndithi kuThixo, ilitye lam: Kutheni na ukuba ulilibale? Ngubani na oza kumthabatha ndilele ngenxa yokuba umqolo wam unyamkela?
Iintshaba zam zindixhaphaza, Zithi kum, Nguwuphi u Osikweni lwakho loThixo?
Uthini na, mphefumlo wam? Uthini na, uxinzelelo lwam phakathi kwam? Lindela kuThixo; ndiya kumvuyisa kwakhona, umsindisi wam, uThixo wam.
UThixo, qinisa inyaniso yam; Nciphisa ityala lam kwilizwe elingafanelekanga uThixo; Ndisindise kumntu okhohlakeleyo, nomntu ongenasono.
UThixo, ubutyebi bam, unguwe; Kutheni na ukuba uyandixolele? Ndiya kuhamba ndililila njani ngenxa yokuba umqolo wam unyamkela.
Sebenzisa ukukhanya kwakho nobuxoki bakho, bamkhokelele; bandise kumphezulu wakho ongcwele, kwindawo yakho yokuhlala.
Ndiya kungena ke kwisibingelelo sikaThixo, KuThixo, uxolo lwam olukhulu; Ndiya kukuxelela ngeqhina, Thixo, Thixo wam.
Uthini na, mphefumlo wam? Uthini na, uxinzelelo phakathi kwam? lilidla kuThixo; ndiya kumvuyisa kwakhona, umsindisi wam, noncedo lwam, Thixo wam.
Umlawuli wengoma, oonyana bakaKora. Ipsalme yokuqonda. Thixo, siyiva ngeendlebe zethu; Abafazi bethu bathetha nathi, Ngomsebenzi wakho emini yabo, kwixesha elidlulileyo.
