Wazikhupha iintlanga ngesandla sakho, wabeka oobawo bethu ezweni; wabaphazamisa abantu, wabasasaza oobawo bethu.
Akuyi kuthatha ilizwe ngekrele labo; amandla abo akayi kubakhusela; Isandla sakho esikunene, nobukrelekrele bakho, nokukhanya kobuso bakho, ngenxa yokuba wabathanda.
Thixo, wena ungukumkani wam; Yiba ngumyalelo wokusindisa abantu bakaYakobi.
Ngesithuthi sakho siza kubuyela umva abathunywa bethu, Ngobuchule begama lakho siza kukhupha ngaphaya abo bahlaselayo.
Andiyi kuthembela kumqolo wam; Ikrele lam alindisindisi.
Ke thina usisikhusele kumagosa ethu, Wabakhapha abathutha nathi.
Siza kubhiyozela ngoThixo yonke imihla; Siya kulithanda igama lakho kude kube sekupheleni. (Sela)
Ke kaloku ngoku usisishiya, usixhalabisa; awusayi kuphuma namanye amajoni ethu.
Usenza sihambe emehlweni eemfazwe zethu; Abathuthayo bethu baya kuthutha.
Usenza ukuba sidla njengeenkomo, Usisiphazamisa phakathi kwezihlanga.
Ubathengise abantu bakho ngemali encinci; Akukho nto uyifumeneyo ngokubathengisa.
Ukwenza ukuba sibe ngumxholo kumakhaya ethu; Abantu abajikeleze nathi badlala nathi, besenza isidumbu sabantu.
Usenza ukuba sibe buhlungu phakathi kwezizwe; Abantu batshisa iinwele zabo kuthi.
Ndihlala phantsi kwengxabano yonke imihla; Ubuso bam bugqitywe ngububi.
ngenxa yobuxoki babo abandixhalabisayo, ngenxa yomkhosi ofuna ukunibulala.
Zonke ezi zinto zithe zathiwa kuthi; Ke thina asikulibalanga wena, Asiyi kunyanzelisa imvume yakho.
Intliziyo yethu ayishukunyiswanga, Inyawo lethu aliphazamisi indlela yakho.
Ke thina usisitshisa, Usisishiya kwindawo ehlala kuyo iintaka; Usisigubungela ngokukhanya okunzulu.
Ukuba sibe salisa igama loThixo wethu, ukuba sikhuphe izandla zethu kuThixo othile,
UThixo akazange afumane na? Wazi iimfihlakalo zentliziyo yonke.
Ke thina, ngenxa yakho, siyafa mihla le; sithethwa njengeenkomo ezidlalwayo.
Yivule, Nkosi yam! Uthini na ukuba uphumle? Yivule, musa ukusishiya kude kube sekupheleni.
Ufihla ntoni na ubuso bakho? Ulibala ntoni na ububi bethu, nokuba siqhutywa njani?
Siqhutywa phantsi kumgubo, Intliziyo yethu iqhagamshelana nehlabathi.
Tshintshela, usincede; Sisindise ngenxa yobubele bakho.

Umlawuli wengoma, ngengoma yeLili. Ipsalme yobulumko yabantwana bakaKorha, iingoma zomtshato. Intliziyo yam igcwele amagama amnandi, xa ndithetha umdaniso wam kukumkani; Ulwimi lwam lufana nepensile yombhali owaziyo.
Ugqibelele phakathi kwamadoda; Imilomo yakho ithetha ngothando; Ngoko ke uThixo uya kukubhaptiza kude kube sekupheleni.
Yibeke ikrele lakho ecaleni lakho, mkhululi onamandla; Ugqoke ubuhle nobudumo.
Ngobukumkani bakho, vuka uhambe, uphumelele ngenxa yobuxoki, nobunkunkqele, nobulungisa; Isandla sakho esikunene siyenze izinto ezimangalisayo.
Amagqabantshintshi akho aqaqambileyo, Aphucula intliziyo yabachasi bakakumkani; Izizwe ziwela phantsi kwamadolo akho.
Itrone yakho, Thixo, ihlala ngonaphakade; Ulawula ubukumkani bakho ngesikhephe sobulumko.
Uthanda into elungileyo, uthobela into engalunganga; ngoko ke, Thixo, Thixo wakho, ukhethele wena ngaphezulu kwabanye abahlobo bakho, ukunika ioli yothando.
Zonke iimpahla zakho zinomphunga we-myrrh, ne-aloe, ne-cassia; Ukusuka kwizindlu ezityebileyo zentsimbi engenasici, ingoma yezinto eziqhutywa ngombhoxo iya kukuvuya.
Iinkwenkwezi zabakumkani ziphakathi kwabafazi obazihlonelayo; Ekunene kwakho ukho ukumkanikazi, egqoke igolide yaseOfiri.
Hlala, nkosikazi yam, ucinge ngaloo nto, unqumle; Ushiye abantu bakho, nosapho lukayise wakho.
Ukumkani uya kuphumla ngobuhle bakho; Umhloniphe, ngokuba ngukumkani wakho.
Abahlali baseTire baya kungena nomnikelo; Amatye aya kuzama ukuthanda kwakho.
Unyana kakumkani usezibhedlele zakhe, ebona ubuhle. Igophe lakhe lithengwe ngegolide.
Wayethwa kuye ukumkani, egqoke iingubo ezithe tyaba; Iindodakazi zakhe, abahlobo bakhe abalandelayo, babethunyelwe kuwe.
Ziqhutywa ngovuyo nobulumko, Ziya kungena endlwini yokumkani.
Abantwana bakho baya kuthatha indawo yabafazi bakho; Uza kubabeka babe ngabaphathi behlabathi lonke.
Ndiya kwenza igama lakho liphawulwe phakathi kosuku nosuku; Iintlanga ziya kukuxelela uzuko ngonaphakade.
Umlawuli wengoma, oonyana bakaKora, Ngengoma kaAlamote. UThixo yindawo yethu ekhuselekileyo, Intliziyo yethu inamandla; Uhlala ekhona ukusinceda kwixesha lengxaki.
Ke ngoko, asiyi kukhathazeka, nokuba ihlabathi litshisa, nakuba iintaba ziwela phakathi kolwandle;
Nakuba amanzi ayo anqumle, aphucule, Nakuba iintaba zicinezeleke ngenxa yokunyuka kwamanzi. (Sela)
Kukho umlambo, imijelo yawo ithandazela umzi kaThixo, indawo engcwele yokuhlala komNgcwele.
UThixo uphakathi kwalo mzi, awusayi kuphelelwa; uThixo uya kumnceda xa kuvuka umsi.
Iintlanga zivutha, izikumkani zifa; UThixo ukhupha umsindo wakhe, ihlabathi liqhutywa.
UYehova wamaSirayeli uya kusixhasa; UThixo kaYakobi ngukhuselo lwethu. (Sela)
Nceda, nibone into iNkosi ayenzeyo, Iingqumbo zakhe azenzayo ehlabathini.
Umisa iimfazwe kwihlabathi liphela; Utshisa umbhobho, utshisa isikhephe; Utshisa izithuthi zokulwa ngomlilo.
Uthi, Khumbulani, niyazi ukuba ndinguThixo; Ndiya kuba mkhulu phakathi kwezizwe, Ndiya kuba mkhulu emhlabeni.
UYehova wamaSirayeli uya kusixhasa; UThixo kaYakobi ngukhuselo lwethu. (Sela)
Umlawuli wengoma. Ipsalme yabantwana bakaKora. Nqumlele izandla zenu, nimazwe onke! Nivumile kuThixo ngovuyo olukhulu.
UYehova Ophezulu umangalisayo, Ngukumkani omkhulu phezu kwehlabathi lonke.
Wabeka iintlanga phantsi kwesandla sethu, Nezizwe phantsi kwamadolo ethu.
Wakhetha ilizwe lethu kuthi, Udumo lukaYakobi, owayemthanda. (Sela)
UThixo unyuka ngemibhiyozo yothando, UYehova unyuka ngesandi sebhokhwe.
Nqulethe uThixo, nqulethe, Nqulethe ukumkani wethu, nqulethe.
UThixo ngukumkani wehlabathi liphela; Yibani nengoma yobulungisa kuye.
UThixo ulawula phezu kwezizwe, UThixo uhlala kwitrone yakhe engcwele.
Abalawuli bezizwe bahlangana nabo bonke abantu bakaThixo kaAbraham; Bawo uThixo onke amagunya ehlabathini, Uphakamileyo kakhulu.
Ingoma, ipsalme yabantwana bakaKora. UYehova ungumntu omkhulu, uvumayo kakhulu kumzi kaThixo wethu, Emnxwemeni wakhe ongcwele.
Intaba kaSiyon, iphakamileyo intle kakhulu, Uthando lwehlabathi liphela; Ifana nendawo ephezulu yasempumalanga, Umzi woKumkani omkhulu.
UThixo unezindlu zayo eziqinileyo, Wabonisa ukuba uyinqanawa yayo.
Yabona, abakumkani badibanisa amaqela abo, bahamba ndawonye kuyo.
Ke kaloku, bekubona loo nto, bamangaliswa; bathotywa ke, babaleka.
Bathi ke apho, baqhutywa yintlungu, buhlungu njengokuba umfazi ekhulelweyo.
Wabasusa njengeenqanawa zeTarshishi, Eziqhutywa ngumoya wasempumalanga.
Izinto esizivayo, siyazibona ngoku kumzi kaYehova wamaSirayeli, Um Thixo wethu; uThixo uya kuyiqinisa kude kube sekupheleni. (Sela)
Thixo, kwitempile yakho sicinga ngothando lwakho.
Uthando lwakho, Thixo, luya kufika eziphelweni zehlabathi, Ngokufana negama lakho; Isandla sakho sokunene sigcwele ubuhle.
Intaba kaSiyon ikhuleke, Amadolophu kaYuda aphumle ngenxa yezigwebo zakho ezilungileyo.
Yiya nijikeleze iSiyon, Niyijikeleze yonke indlela; Babala izindlu zayo eziphakamileyo.
Nceda nijonge ngamehlo enu iinqanawa zayo, Nihambe phakathi kweendawo ezikhuselekileyo zazo, ukuze nikwazi ukuzixelela izizukulwana ezizayo.
Lo Thixo nguThixo wethu kude kube sekupheleni kwexesha; Uya kuba ngumqhubi wethu kude kube sekupheleni.
Umlawuli wengoma. Ipsalme yabantwana bakaKora. Yivakeni le nto, nimazwe onke; zinikele ingqalelo, bonke abahlali behlabathi,
bonke abantu abaqhelekileyo, namadoda abalulekileyo, nabasemagunyeni nabancinane.
Umlomo wam uthetha amagama enzululwazi, Intliziyo yam ithetha ngokuqonda.
Ndiya kuphulaphula ngokucothayo ilizwi elinobulumko; Ndiza kuthetha inyaniso yam, ndidlale i-harp.
Kutheni na ukuba ndikhathazeke xa kufika umonakalo, Xa abantu ababi, abafuna ukundiphazamisa, bemijikeleza?
Bathembela kwimali yabo, babhiyozela ukuba ngaba makhulu.
Ke kaloku akukho namnye okwaziyo ukuhlawula, ukuze akhusele umphefumlo womnye umntu; akukho namnye okwaziyo ukuhlawula uThixo intlawulo yomntu.
Ixabiso lokukhusela ubomi liphezulu kakhulu. Akukho mali ethe
Ukwenza umntu aphile ubomi obungunaphakade, ukuba angabonanga igrave.
Kubonakala ngathi abantu abanobulumko bafa; kodwa abantu abakhohlakeleyo, nabanobuxoki, baya kufa, beshiya iimpahla zabo kwabanye.
Bathi, Iindlu zabo ziya kuhlala ngonaphakade, ukuba izindlu zabo ziza kuqhubeka ezinyangeni zonke; Bathi nakwiindawo zabo babiza ngegama labo.
Ke kaloku umntu, nakwimali yakhe yonke, akahlalanga; Ufana nenyama yezinto eziphilayo.
Yiyo loo nto iza kubakho kubo abathembela kubuntu babo, Nabo bakholelwa kwilizwi labo. (Sela).
Bahamba njengeentlanzi ziye emlonyeni, Ukufa kuya kuba ngumlawuli wabo; kusasa abantu abathembekileyo baya kulawula phezu kwabo; Amathambo abo aya kuthotywa emlonyeni, kude nendawo yabo entle.
Ke kaloku, uThixo uya kundikhusela kumngcipheko wokufa; Ngokuqinisekileyo uya kundithabatha kuye. (Sela)
Musa ukukhathazeka, xa umntu ekhula emthethweni, Xa impahla yendlu yakhe ikhula.
Xa befa, abayi kuthatha nantoni na nabo; Imali yabo ayiyi kudlula nabo.
Xa bephila, bacinga ukuba baya kusindiswa; Bakubonga wena xa usenza izinto ezilungileyo kuwe.
Ke kaloku baya kudityaniswa nabafazi babo, Abaya kubona ukukhanya kwakhona.
Abantu abanemali, bengenakuqonda, bafana nezinto eziphilayo ezifa.
Ipsalme kaAsafe. UThixo, iNkosi onamandla onke, uthi; Ubiza ihlabathi ukusuka apho liphuma khona ilanga, ukuya apho lifikelela khona.
UThixo ukhanya eSiyon, Emzini wobuhle obugqibeleleyo.
UThixo wethu uya kufika, akayi kunyamalala; Umnxeba uza kutshabalalisa phambi kwakhe; Imvula enkulu iza kumjikeleza.
Ubiza izulu ngasentla, nomhlaba, ukuze ahukumise abantu bakhe.
Uthi, Nxibelelana nam abantu bam abathembekileyo, Abanikele umnqophiso kum ngomnikelo.
Iizulu zixelela ukuba ulungile; Kuba uThixo ngokwakhe ungumgwebi. (Sela)
Yiva, abantu bam, ndiza kuthetha; Ndiya kutyhila kuwe, Israeli: NdinguThixo, uThixo wakho.
Ndiza kukuxelela ngeempawu zakho; Izibingelelo zakho eziqhutywa ngamandla zihlala phambi kwam.
Andifunanga inkunzi yebhokhwe endlwini yakho, okanye iinkomo endlwini yakho.
Zonke izinto eziphilayo emthini ziye zam, Iinkomo ezintliziyweni zamawaka.
Ndizikwazi zonke iintaka zeentsebenzo, Zonke izithixo ezisemazulwini ziye zam.
Ukuba ndinendlala, andikukuxelela; ngokuba le hlabathi yinyani yam, nazo zonke izinto ezizikhoyo.
Ndidla ntoni na inyama yenkomo, ndisele ntoni na igazi lebhokhwe?
Yinikele uThixo isonka senu sokuzinikela, Nizigcine izibophelelo zenu kuThixo oNkulu.
Nceda mna ngemini yengxaki yakho; ndiya kukusindisa, nawe uya kundihlonipha.
UThixo ke uthi kulowo ukhohlakeleyo, Nguwuphi umyalelo wam owazithethayo wena? Nguwuphi umnqophiso wam owazithethayo?
Unako ukuthobeka kwam, Uthabathe amagama am ngasemva kwakho.
Xa ubona umthixo, uya kudibana naye; uchitha-xesha kunye namadoda aneentloni emtshatweni.
Umlomo wakho ukhawuleza ukuthetha okubi; Ulwimi lwakho luyenza ubuxoki.
Uhlala uthetha nonyana wakho, Uthetha ubuxoki ngonyana womntwana wakho.
Nizenza ezi zinto, mna ke ndanyamalala, ukuze nicinge ukuba ndifana nani; kodwa ngoku ndiya kukuxolela, ndizibeke phambi kwenu izigwebo zenu.
Yiqonozule loo nto, nina balibalayo uThixo, ukuze ndingakucaphukisa wena, akubekho oza kukusindisa.
Umnikeli wesonka sokuba ngumsindisi, uyamnika umnqamlezo wam; Nomntu ohamba ngendlela ethe ngqo, ndiya kumbonisa ukusindisa kukaThixo.
Umlawuli wengoma. Ipsalme kaDavide, xa efika kuye uNathan umprofeti, emva kokuba uDavide esela noBhatshebhi. UThixo, mncede ngenxa yobuxoki bakho; Ngokukhulu komsindo wakho, zicime iinkumbulo zam.
Nciphisa isono sam sonke, Nceda, ndicoceke kwisono sam.
Ngokuba ndiziqonda iimpazamo endizenzayo; Isono sam sihlala lingaphambili kwam.
Uthi, Ndikhe ndenze isono kuwe, kuwe kuphela, Ndakwenza oko kubi ngamehlo akho; Waba ulungile xa uthetha, Waba mkhulu xa unqula.
Ndiye ndaba ngumntu ongenasono ukususela ekuzaliseni kwam, Ndiye ndaba ngumntu ongenasono ukususela ekukhulelweni kwam.
Ufuna inyaniso engqondweni yam; Ufundisa ubulumko kwizinto ezifihlakeleyo zentliziyo yam.
Yandisa mna nge-hysop, ndiza kuba mhlophe; Yamisa mna, ndiya kuba mhle kunekhephu.
Ndiya kuphinda ndiva uxolo noluthando; Iithambo ozityhilayo ziya kubhiyoza.
Khubaza ubuso bakho kwizono zam, Zicime zonke izigwebo zam.
UThixo, yenza kum intliziyo ecocekileyo; Nceda uncede umphefumlo omtsha wokholo lwakho.
Musa ukundisusa phambi kwakho, Musa ukuthabatha kum umphefumlo wakho ongcwele.
Ndibuyisele umvuzo wokusindisa kwakho, Nceda uncede umphefumlo othandazelayo ukuba ndihambe.
Ndiya kuzifundisa ke iziphoso iindlela zakho, Baye babuye kuwe.
UThixo, Thixo womsindiso wam, ndikhusele ekubeni ndenze intlungu yokubulala; Uloyiko lwam luza kukhumbuza ngemisebenzi yakho elungileyo.
Nkosi, vula imilomo yam; Umlomo wam uya kukubiza.
Awuthandanga izibingelelo, ukuba ndizinikezele; Akukho mnqamlezo unqwenelekayo kuwe.
Isibingelelo esinqwenelekayo kuThixo ngumoya ogqityiweyo; Intliziyo egqtyiweyo, uThixo, ayiyi kuphinda uyibeke.
UThixo wam, nceda iSiyon, Yasenzela ukuba iphumelele; Yenza udonga lweYerusalem.
Ke ngoko uya kuyonwabela izibingelelo zobulungisa, nezibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamandla, nezibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamandla; ke ngoko iinkunzi zeenkomo ziya kukhutshwa kwisibingelelo sakho.

Umbhali wengoma. Ipsalme kaDavide, eyabhalwa xa efika uDoeg umEdomi, waxela uSawule, esithi, UDavide waya endlwini ka-Ahileleki. Kutheni na ukuba uthethe ngokubi, mntu onamandla? Inyaniso yothando lukaThixo ihlala yonke imihla.
Ulwimi lwakho lucinga ukufa; Lufana ne-razor eqaqambileyo, luluka ngobubi.
Uthanda okubi ngaphezu kokulungileyo, nobubi ngaphezu kokuthetha inyaniso. (Sela)
Unayo intliziyo ethanda amagama abulalayo, Ulwimi oluthetha ubuxoki.
Ngoko ke uThixo uya kukutyhala phantsi kude kube sekupheleni; uya kukutsala, uya kukuthabatha endlwini yakho; uya kukuzikhupha iziqhamo zakho ezweni labo abaphilayo. (Sela)
Abantu abalungileyo baya kubona, baza kukhathazeka; baya kukucaphukisa, besithi,
Bathi, Yabona lo mntu, owenzanga uThixo ibe yindawo yakhe ekhuselekileyo; ke kaloku wathembela kumatye akhe amakhulu, waba namandla ngokubulala.
Ke mna ndifana nomthi womnquma okhula luhlaza endlwini kaThixo; Ndiyathemba inyaniso kaThixo ngonaphakade.
Ndiya kukubulela ngonaphakade, ngenxa yomsebenzi wakho; Ndiya kuthemba igama lakho phambi kokholo lwakho, Kuba lilungileyo.

Umlawuli wengoma, ngengoma kaMahalathi. Ipsalme yokuqonda kaDavide. Abantu abakhohlakeleyo besithi ngaphakathi kwabo, Akukho Thixo; baphelelwe lithemba, besenza ububi obubi kakhulu; akukho namnye owenza okulungileyo.
UThixo ujonge emazulwini kubo bonke abantu, ukuze abone ukuba ngaba kukho umntu onengqondo, nokuba ngaba kukho umntu ofuna uThixo.
Bonke batshintshile, bonke baguquke; Akukho namnye owenza okulungileyo, akukho namnye.
Ingaba aba bantu ababi bangazi nto? Badla abantu bam njengokuthi badla isonka, Bangasibizanga uThixo.
Ke kaloku, baphoxeka, kuba akukho nto yokuxolela. UThixo usasaza izihlunu zazo zonke iinkunzi zakho; uya kuzihlangula, ngenxa yokuba uThixo wazisabalalisa.
Ndiyathemba ukuba usindiso lwakwaSirayeli luza kuvela eTsiyon!­lidla uThixo ebuyisela abantu bakhe, UYakobi uya kubhiyozela, uSirayeli uza kuphumla.

Umphathi wengoma, ukuba adlala ngezixhobo zentsimbi. Intshumayelo kaDavide, ebhaliweyo xa befika abantu bakaZiphe, besithi kuSawule, UDavide ufihlakele phakathi kwethu. Thixo, ndisindise ngobukrelekrele begama lakho, Nciphise inkundla yam ngobuchule bakho.
Thixo, udibanise umthandazo wam; Nqumle ilizwi lam.
Iintlanga ziye zandihlasela, Abantu abanobungozi bafuna ukunibulala; UThixo abawukhathaleli. (Sela)
Ke kaloku uThixo ungumncedisi wam, UYehova ungumkhuseli wam.
Babuyiselwe ububi babo abathunywa bam; Ubasuse, ngokuba uthembekileyo wena.
Ndiza kukunikela ngeempawu zam; Ndiza kukhumbuza igama lakho, Yehova, Kuba lilungileyo.
Usindise kum kuzo zonke iintlungu zam; Ndibabona abathunywa bam belahleka.
Umphathi wengoma, ukuba adlala ngezixhobo zentsimbi. Ipsalme kaDavide, enengqondo. UThixo, phulaphule umthandazo wam; Musa ukulibala umnxeba wam wobubele.
Yiva mna, uphendule kum; Intlungu yam yenza ukuba ndiphambuke, Ndizamile
Ngelo lizwi lomthandi wam, Nendlela abakhohlakeleyo bendihlasele ngayo; Bamikela kum ubundlobongela, bamchukumisa ngoxolo lwabo.
Intliziyo yam ibuhlungu kakhulu; Iingozi zomphefumlo zimi kum.
Uxolo noxinzelelo lufika kum, Ukungculaza kungenelela kum.
Ndathi, Ndinqwenele ukuba ndibe namaphiko afana nentombi; Ndiya kuwela, ndiphumle.
Ndiya kukhawuleza ndifumane indawo yokuzikhusela ekufumaneni umoya oqaqambileyo nemvula."
UYehova, phulaphulisa ababi, udibanise ilizwi labo; Kuba ndibona ubundlobongela nokulwa kumzi.
Ubusuku nemini bahamba phantsi kweendonga zayo; Ububi noxinzelelo bungaphakathi kuyo.
Ukulimala kungaphakathi komzi. Iintshukumo nobuxoki awazishiyanga izitrato zayo.
Ukuba umqolo wam uyamxolela, ndiya kukwazi ukumelana nalo; ukuba umthubi wam enyuka kum, ndiya kuhlala ndifihlakele kuye.
Kodwa ukho wena, umntu ofana nam, umhlobo wam, nomhlobo wam omde.
Siye sabelana ngothando olumnandi, sahamba ndawonye neqela elikhulu endlwini kaThixo.
Ukufa kuthabathe abathunywa bam; Bahla baphilile ekufumaneni, Kuba ububi buhlala ezindlwini zabo neentliziyo zabo.
Ke mna ndimbiza uThixo, UYehova umsindisa.
Ngomso, nangamanxweme, nangokuhlwa, ndivuya ngoxinzelelo lwam; Uye waphulaphula lizwi lam.
Undikhusela ekungeneni kum, Nakuba kukho abantu abaninzi phakathi kwam.
UThixo, olawula ngonaphakade, uya kuwava, ababukhuphe phantsi. (Sela) Baye bangabuyanga kwiindlela zabo, Baye bangamhlonela uThixo.
Umhlobo wam uhlasele abahlobo bakhe. Uphula izithembiso zakhe.
Amabinzana akhe alula njengepepile, kodwa kukho ukulwa entliziyweni yakhe; A namandla amabinzana akhe kuneoli, kodwa afana nekrele elilungiselelwe ukubetha.
Nceda ubeke iimvakalelo zakho kuYehova, aze akukhathalele; Akuyi kubavumelanga abantu abalungileyo ukuba bagwebe.
Ke wena, Thixo, uya kubakhupha ababi emngxunyeni wokufa; Ababulalayo nababuxoki abaye baphile ishumi leentsuku zabo. Mna ke ndiya kukuthemba.

Kuye umlawuli wengoma, kwingoma ethi, Iintaka ezingenamoya ezindaweni ezide. Intsomi kaDavide, xa amaFilisti amqwalasela eGati. UThixo, nceda kum; kuba abantu bafuna ukundilibazisa; imini yonke bendihlasela, bendiphazamisa.
Iintshaba zam zifuna ukuba ndidlale yonke imihla; Abantu abaninzi babhiyozela ukulwa nam.
Xa ndingoyika, ndiya kuthemba kuwe.
Ndiwubulele uThixo, ngenxa yelizwi lakhe; Ndiyathemba kuThixo, ngoko ke andiyi kukhathazeka. Bangenza ntoni na kum abantu?
Bonke iintsuku baguqula amagama am, Bacinga ngokuqhubekayo ukuba bandise.
Bathe baphikisana, bafihlakele; Ukuhamba kwam bonke bekulindela ukuba ndifa.
Ingaba baya kuphuma nobubi babo? Thixo, phula iintlanga ngoxolo lwakho.
Uyigcina yonke imithwalo yam, Uzihlanganisa zonke iintyatyambo zam kwibhotile yakho; Awuzibhalile na kwincwadi yakho abertasa?
Abathunywa bam baya kubuyela umva, Ngemini endibiza ngayo; Ndiyazi loo nto, ukuba uThixo ungumnye wam.
Ndiya kubonga uThixo, ngenxa yelizwi lakhe; Ndiya kubonga iNkosi, ngenxa yelizwi lakhe.
Ndiyathemba uThixo, andiyi kukhathazekahavi ntoni na loo nto umntu angandiyenzayo?
Thixo, ndiya kuzigcina izithembiso zam; Ndiza kukunika isonka sokuzinikela.
Thixo wam, usindisele ekufaneni; Uyigcine imilenze yam engaqhelekanga, ukuze ndihambe noThixo kukukhanya kokuphila.

Umlawuli wengoma, kwingoma ethi, Musa ukucaphukisa. Ingoma kaDavide, yabhalwa xa esuka kuSawule, wafika entolongweni. UThixo, nceda mna, nceda mna; ngokuba ndiya kuwe ndifuna uxolo; Ndiza kubona uxolo kumthunzi wamaphiko akho, de kube liphelile ilahleko;
Ndiya kuthandaza kuThixo oNgcwele, KuThixo owenza zonke izigqibo zakhe kum.
Wathumela uncedo ukusuka eziphakadeni, wamsindisa; Wathicaphukela abo bengaphaya kwam. (Sela) UThixo wathumela inyaniso yakhe nobubele bakhe.
Ndijikelezwe ziileyo, ndilala phakathi kwamadoda aqhutywa ngumsindo, Amadoda aneentsontelo zesikhephe namaqhosha, Neelwimi ezineekrele ezimdaka.
UThixo, uphakame ngaphezu kwezulu; Uzuko lwakho lube phezu komhlaba onke.
Babeka intambo ukuba bathathe izinyawo zam, Ndiye ndatyibilika ngenxa yoxinzelelo lwam; Bakha umngxunya kwindlela yam, Bawela kuyo. (Sela)
Intliziyo yam iqinisile, Thixo, intliziyo yam iqinisile; Ndiza kuvuma, ndiza kwenza uculo.
Tshintshela, mphefumlo wam! Tshintshela, i-lute ne-harp; Ndiza kuyitshisa imini.
Ndiya kukubulela phakathi kwabantu, Nkosi yam; Ndiya kukubiza phakathi kwezizwe.
Uthando lwakho olukhulu noluthembekileyo luya kufika emazulwini, Nobuxoki bakho buya kufika kumafu.
UThixo, uphakame ngaphezu kwezulu; Uzuko lwakho lube phezu komhlaba onke.
Umlawuli wengoma, kwingoma ethi, Musa ukucaphukisa. Intsomi kaDavide. Nithi na, nina abathetheli, nithetha ntoni na into elungileyo? Nithi na, nigweme abantu ngokuchanekileyo?
Ngoko ke, intliziyo yenu icinga okubi; Izandla zenu zisasaza ububi emhlabeni.
Amadoda angcolileyo aphelelwa lithemba ukususela kumhla wokuzalwa kwabo; Ukusuka ekuzaliseni kwabo bahamba, bethetha ubuxoki.
Iintsholongwane zawo zifana neentlobo zezintsholongwane zebhokhwe, njengokuba i-cobra itshisa izindlebe zayo
ngoko ke ayikwazi ukuva umculo womthandi weentlanzi, nokuba uyayiqonda.
UThixo, phula iinwele zazo emlonyeni wabo; UYehova, uthabathe iintsontelo zeentaka.
Nceda baphelise njengamanzi aphumayo; Xa betyhala amagwebu abo, nceda babe mnyama.
Babe njengentaka ehambayo, iqhutywa phantsi; njengokuba kuzalwa umntwana ofileyo, angabonanga ilanga.
Ngaphambi kokuba izitya zakho zokupheka zifumane ubushushu beentyatyambo ezifudumeleyo, UThixo uya kuzisusa zibe luhlaza nezifudumele.
Abantu abalungileyo baya kuthandazela, xa bebona ukuba umnqamlezo uqhutywa ngumntu ongalunganga; baza bahlamba izandla zabo kwigazi lomnqamlezo.
Ke kaloku abantu baya kuthetha, Ngokuqinisekileyo kukho umvuzo kumadoda alungileyo; Ngokuqinisekileyo kukho uThixo ogweba ihlabathi.

Umlawuli wengoma, kwingoma ethi, Musa ukucima. Ingoma kaDavide, yabhalwa xa uSawule ethumela abantu ukuba bajonge indlu kaDavide, ukuze bagwebe kuye. UThixo wam, ndisindise kumagosa am, Ndikhusele kulabo abandihlaselayo.
Usindise kum ebantwini abasenza ububi, Usindise kum kumadoda abulalayo.
Yabona, bafuna ukundibulala; Abantu abanamandla benxibelelana kum, Nkosi yam, kodwa hayi ngenxa yobulungisa bam, okanye ngenxa yobuxoki.
Andikhe ndenze nto elungileyo, ke bona bakhawuleza kumhlasela. Yiya uncedo lwam! Yabona ntoni na eya kwenzeka!
UYehova, uThixo wamaSirayeli, uThixo wamaSirayeli, vuka, udibanise iintlanga zonke; Musa ukuxolela abo bakhohlakeleyo. (Sela)
Babuya ngemini, behlaza njengeenja, bejikeleza umzi-ndlu.
Khangela izinto eziphuma emlonyeni wabo; Ilizwi labo lifana nekrele elincinane. Bathi, Nguwuphi na oza kusiva?
Ke wena, Nkosi, ziqhelanisa nabo; Uzixolela iintlanga zonke.
UThixo ngumandla wam, ndiya kukubona; Kuba uThixo ngumgangatho wam ophezulu.
UThixo wam uya kumhlangabezana mna ngothando lwakhe; UThixo wam uza kundibona ndiphazanyiswa ngabachasi bam.
Musa ukuwabulala, ukuze abantu bam bangalibali; Bathabathe ngamandla akho, ubakhuphe phantsi, Yehova, isikhuselo sethu.
Umlomo wabo ugcwele ububi, imilomo yabo ithetha ulwimi olubi; bathathelwe emlonyeni wabo, ngenxa yobuxoki babo nobubi obuthethayo.
Khuthaza nabo ngoxolo lwakho, khuthaza nabo, de baphele. Ziyazi zonke izinto, zifike eziphelweni zehlabathi, ukuba uThixo ulawula kuYakobi. (Sela)
Baye babuye ngobusuku, bevutha njengeenja, bejikeleza umzi.
Bahamba ngokujikeleza bekhangela ukutya, kwaye batsho ngobusuku bonke ukuba bangafumananga okuninzi.
Ke mna ndiza kushumayela ngobukrelekrele bakho, Namhlanje ndiza kushumayela ngobubele bakho. Uye waba yinqaba yam ephakamileyo, Uyindawo yokhuselo kum ngexesha loxinzelelo lwam.
Thixo, unamandla am, ndiya kuthandaza kuwe; UThixo, umbhoxo wam ophakamileyo, uThixo owenza ubulungisa kum.

Umlawuli wengoma, ngengoma yeLili lomnqophiso. Ingoma yokufundisa kaDavide, xa ehlasela amaAram aseNaharayim, namaAram aseZoba; xa ebuyela uYowabhi, wabulala kuma Edomu amawaka alishumi elinambini, eNtaba yeSalt. UThixo, usishiye, uthabathe izikhuselo zethu, ube nobuxoki, ke ngoku sibuyisele kwakhona.
Uyenza ihlabathi liqhume, uyenze ibe ziindawo ezivulekileyo; Uzilungisa iziqhamo zayo, ngokuba liqhuma.
Uye wabanika abantu bakho iintsuku ezibuhlungu, Uthi usinikele iwayini eyenza ukuba siphambuke.
Ke wena uphakamisa ibhaso labo abakukhathalelayo, indawo yokudibana ngenxa yobuxoki bakho. (Sela)
Sisindise ngesandla sakho esikunene, Siphendule, ukuze abantu bakho abathandekayo bakhululwe.
UThixo uthe, esuka kwindawo yakhe engcwele: Ndiya kuphumelela; ndiza kuyihlula iShekem, ndiyimise uLwandle lweSukoti.
UGiliyadi ungumyeni wam, noManase ungumkani; uEfrayim ngugqubuthelo lwam; uYuda ngusihlalo wam.
IMowabhi yindawo yam yokuhlambela; ndiya kutyhila isihlangu sam eEdom, ukuba ibe yintsapho yam. Ndiza kwenza umsindo ngeFilisti.
Nguwuphi na oza kundizisa kumzi oqinileyo? Nguwuphi na oza kundiqhuba eEdom?
Akunjalo, Thixo, ukuba usisikhuphile? Akuyi kubakho ukuphuma kwakho, Thixo, kunye nemikhosi yethu.
Nceda uncedo lwethu emfazweni wethu; Kuba uncedo lwabantu alusebenzi.
NgoThixo siza kulwa ngobukrelekrele, Wathi uthabathe ngaphaya abathunywa bethu.
Umlawuli wengoma, udlala ngesixhobo sentsimbi, nguDavide. UThixo, phulaphule intloko yam, udibanise umthandazo wam.
Ukusuka ekugqibeleni kwehlabathi ndiya kuthandaza kuwe, Xa intliziyo yam ibuhlungu; Yandisa kum kwilitye eliphakamileyo ngaphezu kwam.
Uye waba yindawo yam yokhuselo, Inqaba eqinileyo emlonyeni womkhosi.
Ndiya kuhlala endlwini yakho ngonaphakade; Ndiza kubona ukhuselo kumngxunya weengalo zakho. (Sela)
UThixo, uphendule izibingelelo zam; Wandisela' mna izinto ezibakhokelayo igama lakho.
Yenza ubomi bukakumkani bude, Iminyaka yakhe ihlale kwiintsapho.
Uza kuhlala esitsheni sakhe phambi koThixo ngonaphakade; Uthando lwakho nenyaniso yakho iya kumkhusela.
Ndiza kwenza ke ukuba igama lakho libe yingoma yam ngonaphakade; Ndiya kuzigcina izibingelelo zam yonke imihla.
Umlawuli wengoma, nguYeduthun. Ipsalme kaDavide. Ndiya kufumana uxolo kuThixo kuphela; Usindiso lwam luza kuye.
Uye kuphela ilitye lam, umsindisi wam; Inqaba yam, ndiza kuhlala ndingatshiyiphi.
Ingaba niza kuhlala ixesha elingakanani nihlasela umntu omnye? Ingaba niza kumthambisa, ningathi ngudonga oluthe tye, okanye umgca ophukileyo?
Bacinga kuphela ukuwukhupha emlonyeni wakhe ophakamileyo; bathanda ukuthetha ubuxoki; bebhaptiza ngemilomo yabo, kodwa entliziyweni yabo bebulala. (Sela)
Umoya wam, phumla, uphumle kuThixo kuphela; Ithemba lam lisuka kuye.
Uye kuphela ilitye lam, Umsindisi wam; Indlu yam ekhuselekileyo, ndiza kungenakutshisa.
Usindiso lwam nobubele bam kuThixo; Ilitye lam elinamandla, indawo yam ekhuselekileyo. that.
UThixo ngundawo yethu ekhuselekileyo. (Sela) Yithembeni kuye mihla le, nibantu, Nizivule intliziyo yenu kuye.
Amadoda aqhelekileyo ayiyi nto ngaphandle komoya, namadoda abalulekileyo ayiyi nto ngaphandle komlomo; ukuba uwabeke emthethweni, baya kuba ngaphantsi kokuphefumla.
Musa ukuthembela kwizinto ezilahlekileyo, Musa ukuthemba izinto ezilahlekileyo; Nakuba iimpahla zakho zikhula, musa ukuzibeka emlonyeni wakho.
UThixo wathetha into enye, ndiyiva kabini; Intliziyo kaThixo inamandla.
Kuwe, Nkosi, inyaniso yobubele; Uyambuyisela umphefumlo ngamnye ngokwento ayenzeyo.

Ingoma kaDavide, ebhalwe xa wayesemhlabathini waseYuda. UThixo, uThixo wam, wena; ndiya kukufuna wena; umphefumlo wam unethamsanqa kuwe; intliziyo yam yonke ifuna ukuba nawe, kwilizwe elincinane, elilahlekileyo, elingamanzi.
Ndiya kukubona kwindawo yakho engcwele, Ndiya kubona amandla akho nobuhle bakho.
Uthando lwakho lungcono kunabo bonke ubomi; Ngoko ke imilomo yam iya kukubiza.
Ndiya kukuxelela ubomi bam bonke, Ndiza kuphakamisa izandla zam kuwe.
Ndiya kuthotywa, njengokuba ndisele isonka esimnandi; Umlomo wam uya kukubiza ngemilebe eqaqambileyo.
Ndikukhumbula xa ndilala ebhedini, Ndikucinga ngobusuku bonke.
Uye waba ngumncedisi wam; Ndiza kudlala ngothando kumthunzi weempawu zakho.
Ndikubambe ngokuqinileyo; Isandla sakho esikunene sindixhasa.
Ke kaloku abo bafuna ukumbulala, baya kukhupha emazantsi ehlabathi.
Baza kubulawa ngeqhwa; iintaka ziya kuzidla izinyama zabo.
Ke kaloku ukumkani uya kuthandazela kuThixo; Wonke umntu owenza izibophelelo ngegama likaThixo uya kumhlonipha; Umlomo wabakhohlakeleyo uza kuvulwa.
Umlawuli wengoma. Ipsalme kaDavide. Thixo, ndimphendule, xa ndithetha nawe intlungu yam; Ukhusele umphefumlo wam ekuhlaselweni nguoyise wam.
Fihla mna kwiingcamango ezifihlakeleyo zababi, Kwingxowa-mali e ponderayo yabantu ababi.
Bonisa iilwimi zabo njengeekhephu, Bamisa amagama abo amabi njengamaqhosha abulalayo.
Baqhuma ukusuka kwiindawo ezifihlakeleyo kubantu abangenanto. Baqhuma ngaphaya-phaya kwaye abasoyika.
Baye bakhuthazana ngeengcebiso zabo ezibi; Bathetha ngokubeka iintaka ezifihlakeleyo, besithi, Nguwuphi oza kubabona?
Bathi, Sinayo inkqubo egqibeleleyo. Intliziyo yomntu nengqondo yakhe zinikele kakhulu ekukhanyeni,
Ke kaloku uThixo uya kubathutha ngemiyalelo yakhe; Ngokukhawuleza baya kuhlaselwa.
Amabinzana abo aya kuwakhupha phantsi; Wonke lowo ubabonayo uya kutshisa iinwele zakhe.
Baye bakhathazeka bonke abantu; baza kuthetha ngezinto azenzayo uThixo, Baza kucinga ngamandla akhe.
Abantu abalungileyo baya kuphumla eNkosini, baza kufumana uxolo kuye; Bonke abanengqondo ecacileyo baya kumxelela.
Umlawuli wengoma. Ipsalme kaDavide, ingoma. UThixo, uzuko luya kukukulindela eSiyon; Siza kuzigcina izibhengezo zethu kuwe.
Uya kuziva izibingelelo; bonke abantu baya kuza kuwe.
Xa iimpazamo zethu zazininzi kuthi, Wazixolela izigwebo zethu.
Uphila lowo uyikhethileyo, uyamkelayo ukuba ahlale ezindlwini zakho. Sizele ngezinto ezintle zendlu yakho, neTempile yakho engcwele.
Uya kusiphendula ngezinto ezimangalisayo zobulungisa, Thixo wosindiso lwethu; Uyithemba lazo zonke iziphelo zehlabathi, Lawo onke amalwandle asentshona.
Ngobuchule bakho wazenza iintaba, Wazigqoka ubutyebi bakho.
Uyimisa ilwandle elinqumlayo, namaza ayo aqhutywayo, noxolo lwezizwe.
Abahlala kude bamangaliswa zizinto zakho ezimangalisayo; Ukwenza ukuba abantu babhiyozele ngothando, Kuzo zonke iindawo apho ubusuku buphuma khona, Nalapho isidlo sangokuhlwa siphela khona.
Uyilungisa ilizwe, uyitshisa, uyenza ibe namandla kakhulu; Iilwandle zikaThixo zizele ngamanzi; Ubanika abantu iziqhamo, kuba ngoko ke wazenza.
Uzitshisa iziqithi zayo, uziqhelanisa iinqanawa zayo; Uzivalalisa ngeemvula, ubhaptiza iziqhamo zayo.
Unika unyaka umnqamlezo ngobubele bakho; Izithuthi zakho zokuhamba ngeenqwelo zithe ziqhekeka.
Izityalo zesihlabathi zigqitha ngamanzi, Iintaba zigqoke ngothando.
Izityalo zigubungela iinkomo, Iinduli zigqoke ingqolowa; Zivuya ngothando, zinqumle.
Lo mlawuli wengoma, ingoma, ipsalme. Yidlaleni ngovuyo kuThixo, yonke ihlabathi!
Yibani ngobuqaqawuli begama lakhe, Nceda uThixo wakhe ngokumangalisayo.
Nithi kuThixo, Kuhle kakhulu izinto ozisenzayo! Ubukhulu begunya lakho; Abathunywa bakho baya kukhunjulwa kuwe.
Ihlabathi liphela liza kukuhlangula, liza kukubiza ngengoma; Liza kukubiza ngengoma igama lakho. (Sela)
Nceda, nibone izinto azenzayo uThixo, Izinto ezimangalisayo azenzayo kubantu.
Waguqula ilwandle libe yindawo entsundu; Bahamba ngeenyawo phakathi komlambo; Kwakhona siye sabhiyozela ngenxa yakhe.
Ulawula ngobomi bakhe obude; Amehlo akhe ajonge iintlanga, Akuyi kuvuka nabani na osuka emnqamlezweni kuye. (Sela)
Niwubule uThixo wethu, nimazwe onke; Livakele ilizwi lobubi bakhe.
Usisigcinela ubomi, Asivumeli izandla zethu ukuba zihambe.
Thixo, usivavanye wena; Usisihlambulula njengesilivere.
Uthi, Siza kungena emgodini, Nithi nimise izithuthi ezintsonkothileyo engqondweni.
Wakwenza abantu bahambe phezu kweentloko zethu; sadlula phakathi komlilo namanzi, Uthi usisithumelele kwindawo eninzi.
Ndiya kungena endlwini yakho ngeempawu ezitshiswayo; Ndiza kuzilungisa izibingelelo zam,
Iinyembezi zam ziye zathetha, Umlomo wam wathetha, xa ndandikwingxaki.
Ndiya kukunikela ngeenyama ezityebileyo, zibe ziintsontelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, kunye nomlilo weemvu; ndiya kukunikela ngeenkomo nezibhozo. (Sela)
Nceda, nitshoni, bonke abawukhathalelayo uThixo; Ndiza kukuxelela izinto azenzayo kum.
Ndimbiza ngomlomo wam, Uthando lwakhe luye lwaba ngolwimi lwam.
Ukuba ndenza isono entliziyweni yam, UYehova akazange aphendule.
Ke kaloku uThixo waphendula ngokuqinisekileyo, Wava umthandazo wam.
UThixo uya kukhunjulwa, ngokuba akazange ayirhoxise imithandazo yam, Nakuba angayisusa kum inyaniso yakhe.
Umlawuli wengoma, ukuba adlala ngezixhobo zentsimbi. Ipsalme, ingoma. UThixo asithande nathi, asibhalele; Ubuso bakhe bukhanya kuthi. (Sela.)
Ke ngoko ziya kuziwa ehlabathini iindlela zakho, Kuzo zonke iintlanga ukusindisa kwakho.
Zonke iintlanga zingakubonga kuwe, Thixo; Zonke iintlanga zingakubonga wena.
Zithandaze iintlanga, zivuye ngothando; Kuba wena ulawula abantu ngenyameko, Uqhuba iintlanga zehlabathi. (Sela)
Zonke iintlanga zingakubonga kuwe, Thixo; Zonke iintlanga zingakubonga wena.
Ilizwe linika iziqhamo zayo; UThixo, uThixo wethu, usisindise.
UThixo uya kusibhaptiza; Zonke iziphelo zehlabathi ziya kumbona.
Umlawuli wengoma. Ipsalme kaDavide, ingoma. UThixo akhule; baqhutywe abathunywa bakhe; bahambe phambi kwakhe abo bamxhalabisayo.
Yabasusa njengomlilo; njengokuba umgubo uqhutywa emlilweni, bakhululwe ababi phambi koThixo.
Ke kaloku, abantu abalungileyo banqwenele, Bakhubeke phambi koThixo, Bahlambulule ngovuyo.
Nqumleleni uThixo, nqumleleni igama lakhe; Nqumleleni lowo ehamba phezu kwamafu. UYehova ligama lakhe; nizithande phambi kwakhe.
UThixo, entliziyweni yakhe engcwele, ngutata kubo abangenabazali, ungumkhuseli wabafazi.
UThixo uyayinika intsapho abantu abazolileyo, Wabakhupha abagwetywa ngengoma; Ke bona abakhohlakeleyo abertasa ilizwe elincinane.
Thixo, xa waphuma phambi kwabantu bakho, Xa wawuhamba emlilweni, (Sela)
Umhlaba watshisa, izulu lakhupha umhlwa phambi koThixo, uThixo waseSina, phambi koThixo, uThixo wakwaSirayeli.
Uthi, Thixo, unikezele ngemvula eninzi; Wavuselela ilizwe lakho, xa lilahle.
Abantu bakho bahlala khona; Thixo, ngobulungisa bakho walungiselela abafazi.
Ke kaloku iNkosi yathi, Iqela elikhulu lamabhinqa liza kushumayela iindaba ezilungileyo,
Abakumkani namagqwetha abo baphuma, bayaphuma! Amabhinqa asendlwini ahlula izinto ezilahlekileyo.
Ke kaloku abo bahlala phakathi kweengxowa zeentyatyambo, bafumana iimpahla ezibalulekileyo: iintyatyambo ezinemilebe yenziwe ngesilivere, neziqhamo zegolide ekhanyayo.
Ke kaloku, xa uThixo Onamandla onke ephazamisa ookumkani belizwe, Kwathi ke, njengekhephu eliwela emnqamlezweni kaSalmon.
Iintaba zaseBhashani ziintaba ezidumileyo, Intaba zeBhashani ziintaba eziphezulu.
Nizijonge ntoni na, intaba eneempepho ezininzi? Nizijonge ntoni na ngeminqweno entlango apho uThixo ekhetha khona ukuba abe ngukumkani? UYehova uya kuhlala khona ngonaphakade.
Iimoto zikaThixo ziyishumi lamawaka, Ziyizigidi eziliqela lamawaka; UYehova wafika eSinayini, waya kwindawo yakhe engcwele.
Wanyuka waya phezulu, wathabatha abafazi nawe; wathabatha izipho kubantu, nakwabaphulaphuli, ukuze iNkosi uThixo ahlale khona.
Nceda nibulele iNkosi, Owuthwala umthwalo wethu mihla le; UThixo ongumsindisi wethu yena. (Sela)
UThixo wethu nguThixo wokusindisa; UYehova uThixo wethu uya kusikhusela ekufeni.
Ke uThixo uya kuzitshisa iintloko zabachasi bakhe, Iintloko ezimdaka zalabo abaqhubeka besenza ububi.
Wathi iNkosi, Ndiya kubabuyisela ukusuka eBhashani; Ndiya kubabuyisela ukusuka emazantsi olwandle,
ukuze uhambe phantsi kwegazi labathunywa bakho, ukuze iilwimi zeenja zakho zithathe inxaxheba.
Thixo wam, imiyalelo yakho yabonakala, Imiyalelo kaThixo wam, noKumkani wam, kwindawo engcwele.
Abadlali bengoma bangaphambili, abaculi baya ngasemva; phakathi ke kukho amabhinqa amancinci adlala ii-tamburine.
Nceda uThixo enkundleni enkulu, Nceda iNkosi, nibantu bakaSirayeli.
Kukho uBhenjamin omncinane ehamba phambi kwabo, namagqwetha kaYuda neqela labo, namagqwetha kaZebulon noNafetali.
UThixo wakho akuwisela umthetho wokuba ube nobuchule; Thixo, sibonise ubuhle bakho, njengokuba wakwenza kuthi.
Ngenxa yetempile yakho eYerusalem, Abakumkani baya kukunika izipho.
Nqumlele iintaka eziphilayo phakathi kweentyatyambo, Inkunzi yeegusha phakathi kweenkomo zezizwe; Zenza ukuba zihlambuluke ngeebhokhwe zesilivere; Zisasaze izizwe ezithanda ukulwa.
Abaphathi baya kuvela eYiputa; iEthiopi iya kukhawuleza ukuphakamisa izandla zayo kuThixo.
Yibani noThixo, nizizwe zehlabathi; zinikele uzuko kuYehova. (Sela)
Yibani nomculo kuye ohamba phezu kweendawo eziphakamileyo zezulu, iinkwenkwezi zakudala. Lindelani; utsho ngezwi lakhe elinamandla.
Yaziseni amandla kaThixo, Ubukumkani bakhe bungaphezulu kukaSirayeli; Ubutyebi bakhe bukwizulu.
UThixo, uyamangalisa kwindawo yakho engcwele; UThixo kaSirayeli unika abantu bakhe amandla nobukrelekrele. Lola Thixo!
Umlawuli wengoma, kwingoma yamaLiliya kaDavide. Ndisindise, Thixo, ngokuba amanzi afike engqondweni yam!
Ndiya kungena emlonyeni ophakamileyo, Akukho ndawo ndihlala kuyo; Ndiya kungena emanzini aphakamileyo, Ulwandle luza kumsusa.
Ndilahlekelwe lukhulu ngumsindo wam, Intliziyo yam iphukile; Amehlo am alahlekelwe lukhulu ngenxa yokufuna uThixo wam.
Abamchukumisayo ngaphandle kwesizathu baninzi kuneenwele zentloko yam; Baninzi abathunywa abanamandla, befuna ukunibulala ngaphandle kwesizathu; Ndiya kuphinda ndibuyisele oko andiwuthabatha.
Uyazi, Thixo, ukuba ndenze inyaniso; Iintlungu zam azifihlakali kuwe.
UYehova, uThixo wamaSirayeli, abaye baxhaphake ngenxa yam abo balinde wena; OThixo kaSirayeli, abe baxhaphake ngenxa yam abo balindele wena.
Ndinyanzeleka ukuba ndiphambuke ngenxa yakho, Intloko yam iqulethe uxolo.
Ndiye ndaba mxhamli kubazalwana bam, Ndaba mxhamli kubantwana bomntwana wam.
Uthando lwam lwendlu yakho lutshisa phantsi kwam njengomlilo; Iingxowa-mali zabaxhalabisayo kuwe zithe zahla kum.
Ke kaloku, xa ndililila, ndathi ndizamile ukutya, bandiseka ngenxa yam.
Xa ndandigqoka iimpahla ezingwevu zesithunywa, abantu bathetha ngathi ndimxolele.
Abathi behlala emnyango wedolophu, bathetha ngam; Amadoda asela utywala anquma iingoma zam.
Ke mna, Nkosi, ndiya kuthandaza kuwe ngexesha lokuthanda kwakho; UThixo, ngenxa yobuninzi bothando lwakho nobuxoki bakho, ndiphendule ngoxolo oluqinisekileyo.
Ndikhuphe emlonyeni wam, Ndize ndize ngaphaya; Ndisindise kubo abandichukumisayo, Kumanzi aphakamileyo.
Musani ukuba amanzi emvula athabathe phezulu kum, Amanzi aphakamileyo anganditshisa; Musani ukuba umngxunya uvale umlomo wakhe phezu kwam.
Ndiphendule, Nkosi yam; Kuba ubuxoki bakho bulungileyo; Yiya kum ngenxa yobundlobongela bakho obuninzi.
Musa ukufihla ubuso bakho kumkhonzi wakho, Kuba ndikwingozi; Yiva mna ngokukhawuleza.
Nceda ufike, undisindise; Ndisuse kumnqamlezo wam.
Uyazi ukuba ndixhaphakile, ndikhathazwa, ndigxininiswe; Ubona ooyihlo zam zonke.
Intliziyo yam iqhutywe ziinyembezi, ndize ndaphazamiseka; Ndakhangela umntu oza kundikhathalela, kodwa akukho namnye; Ndakhangela umntu oza kundixolisa, kodwa akukho namnye.
Ukutya-kwam bamisa iintsholongwane; Xa ndinomphefumlo, bamnika ubisi olutyebileyo.
Itafile yabo yodwa ibe ngumbulelo kubo; ibe ngumnqamlezo wabo, ibe yintloko yabo.
Amehlo abo amnyama, ukuze bangaboni; Umqolo wabo ujikeleze rhoqo ngenxa yengxaki.
Uthutha inkanuko yakho phezu kwabo; Inkanuko yakho eshushu ifike kubo.
Iindlu zabo zishiyeke zingenanto, Akukho namnye ohlala ezitentileni zabo.
Bahlasele umntu osele ubuhlungu kuye. Bathetha malunga neentlungu zalowo ubuhlungu kuye.
Yongeza ityala elinye emva kwelinye kwincwadi yabo; bangabi ngamalungu enyanzelo yakho.
Igama labo licinywe encwadini yokuphila; Akubakho ukubhalwa kwabo phakathi kwabalungileyo.
Ke mna, Thixo, ndikwingxolo noxinzelelo; Uncedo lwakho luza kumkhusela.
Ndiya kukhumbuza igama likaThixo ngengoma, Ndiya kumxelela ngokubonga.
Le nto iya kwenza iNkosi athandeke kakhulu, kunesonka sebhokhwe, okanye inkunzi yenkomo eneempawu zayo neenyawo.
Amadoda aphantsi azokubona, aze athandeke; Nize nikhuliswe intliziyo yenu, nina abafunayo uThixo.
UYehova ubaphulaphule abo bafunayo; Akubaboni abantu bakhe abasebunjinelini.
Liwuthande izulu nehlabathi, Iilwandle nazo zonke izinto ezihambayo kuzo.
UThixo uya kusindisa iSiyon, ukwakha kwakhona imimandla kaYuda; abantu bakhe baya kuhlala khona, baza kuba yindawo yabo.
Abantwana bomkhonzi wakhe baya kuyifumana; Abathanda igama lakhe baya kuhlala khona.
UThixo, khawuleza usindise kum; Nkosi, khawuleza uncedo lwam.
Bakhutshwe, bagwetywe abo bafuna ukufa kwam; Babuyiselwe umva ngobuxoki labo abafuna ukutshabalalisa kwam.
Abathi, Haha, haha! Baye babuyela umva ngenxa yobuxoki babo.
Ke bona bonke abakulindelayo, bahlale bevuyisana nawe; Bathi ngokuqhubekayo abo bathanda ukusindisa kwakho, UThixo umkhulu.
Ke mna, ndinomngcipheko, ndinengxaki; Yiya kum ngokukhawuleza, Thixo; Uncedo lwam, nomsindisi wam, unguwe. UYehova, musa ukulibazisa.
Ndiya kuwe, Nkosi yam, ukuba ndikhuseleke; Musani ukundixhaphaza ngoku.
Kuba usenza okulungileyo, ndisindise, ndisandise; Nciphisa ilizwi lakho kum, ndisindise.
Yaba lilitye lam elikhuselekileyo, Ndiya kungena kuyo yonke imihla; Nceda ndisindise; Kuba uLitye lam, neNqaku lam nguwe.
Thixo wam, ndisindise kumandla omngcipheko, Kumandla esandla somntu okhohlakeleyo, nomphefumlo womntu ogqwesileyo.
UYehova uThixouThixo wam, wena uyithemba lam; Ndikuthembela kuwe ukususela ebantwini bam.
Hamba ndide ndazalwa, Ndiya kuphumla kuwe; Wamkhupha enyameni yomntwana wam; Ndiza kukuxelela ngothando lwam.
Ubomi bam buyimizekelo kubaninzi, Kuba wena ungummandla wam oqinileyo wokhuseleko.
Umlomo wam uzele luthando lwakho; Ndiza kuthetha ngozuko lwakho yonke imihla.
Musa ukundisusa xa ndineminyaka emininzi ubudala, Musa kundishiya xa amandla am ephelelwe lixesha.
Abathunywa bam bathetha ntoni na kum, Na tolusi abafuna ukundibulala, bathethe ndawonye.
Bathi, UThixo wamshiya; mlandeleni, niwuthathe; kuba akukho namnye oza kumkhulula.
Thixo wam, musa ukuhlala kude nam; Thixo wam, khawuleza kumncede.
Bakhutshwe ngoxolo, bakhululwe abo ndibaxolelayo; Bakhutshwe ngoxolo, bagwetywe abo bathanda ukundiphazamisa.
Ke mna ndiya kuba nethemba ngonaphakade; Ndiza kukuxelela ngokugqithisileyo.
Ndiya kukuxelela yonke imihla ukuba uyenze ntoni na into elungileyo, ukuba uyisindise ntoni na loo nto; kodwa andikwazi ukuyiqonda yonke.
Ndiya kungena, ndizixelele izinto ezinamandla zikaYehova uThixouThixo wam; Ndiza kutyhila ukuba wena kuphela owenza okulungileyo.
UThixo, ufundile kum ukususela ebantwini bam; Nasemini le ndithetha ngezinto zakho ezimangalisayo.
Nakuba ndineminyaka emininzi, Thixo, musa kundishiya; Ndiya kuxela ubutyebi bakho kwixesha elizayo, Nobuchule bakho kubo bonke abaza kuba.
Thixo, ububele bakho bufike emazulwini; Uwenza izinto ezinkulu. Thixo, ngubani na ofana nawe?
Undibonise iintlungu ezininzi ezibuhlungu; Ke wena uya kundisindisa kwakhona, Uya kundikhupha kwakhona ezindaweni ezisezantsi zehlabathi.
Mna ndiya kuba mkhulu kakhulu phambi kwakho, Ndiya kuphumla kwakhona.
Ndiya kukuxelela ngothando, ngenxa yobuxoki bakho, Thixo wam; Ndiya kukuxelela ngothando nge-harp, Mngcwele kaSirayeli.
Imilenze yam iya kutyhila uzuko, Xa ndimthandazelayo; Ndiya kuthandazela ngenxa yokuba undisindise.
Ulwimi lwam luza kuthetha ngomsebenzi wakho olungileyo yonke imihla; Kuba baxhaphakile, bakhatywa abo befuna ubundlobongela kum.
USolomon. Thixo, umnike ukumkani ubulungisa bakho; Umnike unyana kakumkani ububele bakho.
Ke ngoko, uya kugweba abantu bakho ngokunyanisekileyo, Athi agcine abafazi bakho ngobulungisa.
Iintaba zisabele uxolo nobulumko kubantu; Iziqithi zisabele iziqhamo zezinto ezilungileyo.
Uya kubakhusela abafazi phakathi kwabantu, Wabasindisa oonyana bezihlwempu; Ke kaloku uya kuwaphulaphula abo basebenza nabo.
Baya kukuxelela ngoxolo, Kude kube lixesha elikhanyayo ilanga, Kude kube lixesha elikhanyayo inyanga, kusuku nosuku.
Uya kuba njengemvula ehlayo phezu komhlaba ogqityiweyo, njengeemvula ezimanzisa ihlabathi.
Xa elawulayo, abantu abalungileyo baya kwenza okulungileyo; noxolo oluninzi luya kubakho, de kube liphelile ilanga.
Uza kulawula ukusuka elwandle ukuya elwandle, Ukusuka emlanjeni uEfrayim kuya kumazantsi ehlabathi.
Iintsapho zesihlabathi ziya kuphumla phambi kwakhe; Abathunywa bakhe baya kulidla umhlwa.
Abakumkani baseTarshishi, neziqithi, baya kumnika umvuzo; abakumkani baseShebha neSheba baya kumnika isipho.
Abakumkani bonke baya kumhlangula; Zonke iintlanga ziya kumkhonza.
Uya kubakhusela abafazi xa bekhala, Nabo bahlwempu abangabakho mncedisi kubo.
Uya kuba nobubele kulowo uncinane, nomhlwempu; Uza kuzikhusela iintliziyo zalabo abafunayo.
Uya kubakhusela ekufumaneni ubundlobongela nolwaphulo-mthetho; Intliziyo yabo ibalulekile kuye.
Ukumkani uhlale ubomi bakhe bonke; igolide yaseShebha imelwe kuye; abantu bathandazane naye, bayibulele yonke imihla.

Kuza kubakho ubisi oluninzi kulo lonke elasezweni, luza kuqhutywa phezulu kumatye; imbewu yayo iza kuqhutywa njengemithi yeLibanoni. Abahlali bamadolophu baya kwenza kakuhle, njengamaqabunga engqondweni.
Lihlale igama lakhe ngonaphakade, Inkulumo yakhe ibe ngaphezu kokukhanya kwelanga; Zonke iintlanga ziya kubhaptizwa ngaye, Ziya kumbiza ngokuba ungcwele.
Lincede iNkosi iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli; yena kuphela owenza izinto ezimangalisayo.
Livuozuni igama lakhe eliqaqambileyo kude kube ngaphambili; Ihlabathi lizele ngobuhle bakhe. Amen, amen.
Oku kukuphela komthandazo kaDavide, unyana kaYeshaya.
Ingoma kaAsaphu. UThixo, ngokuqinisekileyo, ulungileyo kuSirayeli, kubo bonke abacocekileyo intliziyo yabo.
Ke mna, ndaze ndilahle imilenze yam; zithe zatshisa izinyawo zam.
Ndiye ndaba nezehlo kumadoda anamandla, Xa ndibona ukuba abakhohlakeleyo besenza kakuhle.
Bathi xa befa, abagxeki. Imizimba yabo isempilweni, inamandla.

Iingcambu, isandla sakho sokunene sazifaka, Unyana owenza unamandla kuwe.
Iqhutywa, iqhutywe ngomlilo; Abantu bakho bafa ngenxa yobuxoki bakho obubi.
Isandlaozu siphumle kumntu wesandla sakho esikunene, Unyana womntu owenza unamandla kuwe.
Asiyi kubuya sisuka kuwe; Usindise nathi, siza kulibiza igama lakho.
UYehova, uThixo wamaSirayeli, sibuyisele kwakhona; Ubuso bakho buqaqambe phezu kwethu, sibe noxolo.
Kuye umlawuli wengoma, ngesixhobo esivela eGati; nguAsaphe. Yibani nothando kuThixo, unamandla ethu! Nizeni ngovuyo kuThixo kaYakobi!
Qalisa umculo! Dlala i-tamburine kunye ne-lyre emnandi ne-harp.
Nqumle indlebe yebhokhwe ngomhla wenyanga entsha, nomhla wenyanga egcweleyo, ngemini yosuku lwethu lokubhiyozela.
Lo ngumthetho kaSirayeli, Umyalelo woThixo kaYakobi.
Wayenza ibe ngumthetho kubomi bukaYosefu, Xa wayephuma ezweni laseYiputa. Ndaliva ilizwi endingaziyo, lisithi,
Ndayikhupha imilenze yabo inkunkuma; Izandla zabo zasuswa ekuthwaleni iziqhobosha.
Wayibiza emngciphekweni wakho, ndakusindisa; Ndakuphendula kumthubi womlilo, Ndakuvavanya emanzini eMeriba. (Sela.)
Yibanini, abantu bam, ndiya kukuxelela, uSirayeli, ukuba nje mna nimxelele.
Akuyi kubakho phakathi kwenu uThixo othile; akuyi kubakho uThixo othile omele niwubone.
Ndiye ndinguYehova uThixo wakho, owawukhuphe ezweni laseYiputa. Vula umlomo wakho ngokubanzi, ndiwuphule.
Ke kaloku abantu bam abangeni kumxelela, AmaSirayeli amthandanga.
Ndabavumela ke ukuba bahambe ngeminqweno yobuxoki bentliziyo yabo, Bahambe ngokweenkalo zabo.
Ndiyathemba ukuba abantu bam baya kumxelela, AmaSirayeli aya kuhamba ngeendlela zam!
Ndiya kukhawulezisa ukubetha abathunywa babo, Ndibuyele isandla sam kubo bahlaselayo.
Abamchukumisayo iNkosi baya kuphumla emlonyeni wakhe ngoxolo; Ugwebo lwabo luya kuhlala kude kube sekupheleni.
Ke mna ndiya kukudlalisa ngeengqolowa ezilungileyo, Ndiza kukutyumza ngomxube osuka esityeni.
Ingoma kaAsaphe. UThixo uhlala engqungqutheleni enkulu, Enika ubulungisa phakathi kwamadini.
Uza kuhlala ixesha elingakanani uhukumu ngokungachanekanga, Uthathe isandla somntu ongalunganga? (Sela)
Bakhusele abancinci, nabafazi, nalabo abangamzali; Bakhusele ilungelo labafazi nabafazi, Nabo baphazamisiweyo.
Basindiseni abancinci nabafazi, Nibakhusele kumandla ezinto ezibi.
Abazi nto, bangaqondanga nto; Bahamba emnyama, kwaye zonke iziseko zehlabathi ziqhutywa.
Ndathi, Niyimiphefumlo, nina bonke oonyana bakaThixo oNkulu.
Ke wena uya kufa njengokuba bafa bonke abantu; uza kuphelelwa njengezinye izikhulu.
Nyuka, Thixo, ugweme ihlabathi; Kuba zonke iintlanga ziye zakho.
Ingoma, ipsalme kaAsaphe. Thixo, musa ukunyamalala; Musa ukuphumla; Musa ukuphumla, Thixo.
Yabona, abathunywa bakho banqunyulwa; Abakuxhalabisayo baphakamisa iinwele zabo.
Bonisa ubulumko kubo bonke abantu bakho, Balungiselele ubundlobongela lwakho.
Bathi, Nceda, siyabacima ukuba bangahlanga; ukuze igama likaSirayeli lingaziwa kwakhona.
Bathe bagqiba ngemithandazo yabo ndawonye, Bathe badibanisa iinzame zabo kuwe;
iitente zikaEdom, nama-Ishmayeli, namaMowabhi, namaHagiri;
uGebali, noAmmon, noAmaleki, neFilisti, nabahlali baseTyre.
Ke kaloku uAsiriya wadibana nabo, Ukunika amandla oonyana bakaLote. (Sela)
Yenza kubo njengokuba wenza kuMidiyan, uSisera noYabin emlanjeni waseKishon.
Bathotywa eEndori; iziqu zabo zathi zibe njengenkunkuma phezu kwehlabathi.
Yenza abakhulu babo babe njengeOrebhi noZebhebi; yenza bonke abathetheli babo babe njengeZebha noSalmuna,
abathi, Siyithathele thina izityalo zikaThixo.
Thixo wam, yenza ukuba babe njengeentyatyambo ezityebileyo, Njengengqolowa eqhutywa ngumoya.
Njengomlilo otshisa umthi, njengokuba umlilo utshisa iintaba,
Yaziphulaphule ngemvula yakho, Yazikhathaza ngomlilo wakho.
Zigubungele imilenze yabo ngoxolo, Bafune igama lakho, Yehova.
Baye bagwetywe, babe buhlungu ngonaphakade; Baye baphelelwe lithemba.
Bayazi ke ukuba wena kuphela, igama lakho nguYehova, Ophezulu phezu kwehlabathi lonke.
Umphathi wengoma, ngesixhobo esivela eGati. Ipsalme yabantwana bakaKora. Kuhle kangakanani na indawo yakho yokuhlala, iNkosi wemikhosi!
Ndizithanda, ndizithanda kakhulu izindlu zikaYehova; Intliziyo yam nenyama yam yonke ithandaza kuThixo ophileyo.
Naye intaka ifumane indlu, Intaka ifumane indawo yokuhlala kuyo, apho iya kuzala khona iintlanzi zayo, Kuzo zonke izibingelelo zakho, Yehova wamaSirayeli, Ukumkani wam noThixo wam.
Baya kuba mnandi abo bahlala endlwini yakho; Baya kukuxelela ngokuqhubekayo. (Sela)
Baphelelwe lithemba abo mandla aphuma kuwe, Ababeka intliziyo yabo ekuhambeni ukuya endlwini yakho.
Xa bedlula emlanjeni weentyatyambo, bayenza ibe yindawo yeziqhamo; Iimvula zonyaka omtsha ziyigubungela ngamanzi acocekileyo.
Bakhula benamandla, bakhula benamandla; Babonakala nganye phambi koThixo eSiyon.
UYehova, uThixo wamaSirayeli, udibanise umthandazo wam; Yiva, Thixo kaYakobi. (Sela)
Thixo, isikhuselo sethu, Yabona ngobubele ubuso bukakumkani wakho othambileyo.
Usuku olunye ezindlwini zakho lungcono kuneentsuku elinamakhulu ehlabathini lonke; Ndiyakuthanda ukuhlala kumngxunya wendlu kaThixo wam, Ngelixa ndihlala kwiitente zababi.
UYehova uThixo wethu ngulanga lwethu, lukhuselo lwethu; UYehova unika ububele nobulumko; Akuyi kuthintela nantoni na elungileyo kubo abahamba ngeendlela zabo ezingenakubi.
UYehova wamaSirayeli, Kuye kuhlanjululwa umntu othembela kuwe.
Umlawuli wengoma. Ipsalme yabantwana bakaKora. UThixouThixo, uyayithanda ilizwe lakho; Wababuyisela kwakhona abantu bakaYakobi ekuhambeni.
Wazixolela iimpazamo zabantu bakho, Wazifihla zonke iimpazamo zabo. (Sela)
Wabuyela umva inkanuko yakho yonke, Utshintshe umlilo wobuxoki bakho.
UThixo wosindiso lwethu, sibuyisele kwakhona; Yisuse inkanuko yakho kuthi.
Ingaba uya kuba noxolo nathi ngonaphakade? Ingaba uxolo lwakho luya kuqhubeka phakathi kweentlanga?
Uza kusini na ukusibuyisela ubomi bethu, ukuze abantu bakho bathande ngenxa yakho?
Nceda, Nkosi, sibonise inyaniso yobubele bakho; Sinike uncedo lwakho lokusindisa.
Ndiya kuphulaphula ilizwi likaThixo, iNkosi; Uthetha uxolo kubomi bakhe, kubangcwele bakhe, ukuze bangabuyeli kwindlela yabo engaphazamisi.
Uncedo lwakhe luya kuhlala kufutshane nabangamthobeli, ukuze ubuhle bakhe buhlale ezweni lethu.
Uthando nenyaniso zidibana ndawonye; Ubulungisa noxolo baqhawulana.
Inyaniso iphuma phezulu ehlabathini, Ubulungisa bujonge phantsi emazulwini.
UYehova uya kunika okulungileyo, Ilizwe lethu liza kuvelisa imbewu yalo.
Inyaniso ihamba phambi kwakhe, Ilungiselela indlela yeenyathelo zakhe.
Umthandazo kaDavide. Lindela kum, Nkosi, ndiphendule; Kuba mna ndimncinci, ndinengxaki.
Gcina umphefumlo wam, ngokuba mna ndimthembekile kuwe; UThixo wam ukho wena; Ndisindise umkhonzi wakho, endilithembayo.
Ndincede, Nkosi yam; Kuba ndimbiza wena yonke imihla.
Ndivuyisa mna, umkhonzi wakho; Kuba ndininika wena, Nkosi, intliziyo yam.
Ewe, Nkosi, ulungile wena, ulungele ukuxolela'; ugcwele inyaniso kubo bonke abakubizayo.
UYehova, udibanise umthandazo wam; Yiva ukholo lwam olufuna ububele.
Ngexesha lengxaki yam ndiya kukubiza, Kuba uya kundiphendula.
Nkosi, akukho namnye phakathi kwamadini afana nawe; Akukho namnye owenza izinto zakho.
Zonke iintlanga ozenzayo ziya kuvela, zithi, UYehova, ziwubeke umnqamlezo phambi kwakho; Zizithande igama lakho.
Ukhulu wena, usenza izinto ezimangalisayo; wena kuphela unguThixo.
Ndifundise, Nkosi, indlela yakho, ndiphile ngenyaniso yakho; Nceda undinike intliziyo egqibeleleyo, ukuba ndilinde igama lakho.
Ndiya kukubonga, Nkosi yam, Thixo wam, intliziyo yam yonke; Ndiza kulinika igama lakho igunya ngonaphakade.
Uthando lwakho kum lukhulu kakhulu; Wamkhulula kumhlaba ophakamileyo wokufa,
Thixo, abantu abadumileyo bendihlasela; Iqela labasetyhini abanobuxoki lifuna ukunibulala; Bakukhathalele wena.
Ke wena, Nkosi, uThixo ogcwele inceba nobubele, Okhawulezayo ukucaphukisa, ogcwele ububele nokholo.
Yijonge kum, undithande; Ndinike amandla akho umkhonzi wakho; Ndisindise mna, unyana womkhonzi wakho.
Ndibonise umqondiso wobulungisa bakho, ukuze babone abo bathandazelayo mna, baxhaphake. UYehova, uncedo lwam, uxolo lwam.
Ingoma yabantwana bakaKora. Umzi wakhe wawukwakha iNkosi phezu kwamatye angcwele.
UYehova uthanda izivalo zeSiyon, Ngaphaya kweendawo zonke zokuhlala kwabantu bakaYakobi.
Umzi kaThixo, izinto ezimangalisayo zithethwa kuwe. (Sela)
Utsho uThixo, Ndiya kuzibala iRahabhi neBhabheli phakathi kwabandiziyo; neFilisti, neTyre, neEtiyopiya. Bathi, Lo mntu wazalwa eSiyon.
Kuthiwa ngeSiyon, Lo mntu nolowo bazalwa khona; UThixo Ophezulu yena uya kuyiqinisa.
Xa iNkosi ebhala amagama eemfazwe, uya kuphawula ukuba: Lo mntu wazalwa khona. (Sela)
Bathi abo badlalayo, nabadanisayo, Zonke iziqhamo zam zothando zikho kuwe.
Ingoma, ipsalme yabantwana bakaKora, yomlawuli wengoma, ngelizwi elithi, Ubuhlungu besifo; ingoma yobubele kaHeman umEzrahati. Nkosi, uThixo wam osindileyo, ndiya kuthandaza kuwe busuku nobusuku.
Umthandazo wam ufike phambi kwakho, Unqumle indlebe yakho kwintloko yam.
Ubomi bam bugcwele iintlungu, Ndisekufutshane nokufa.
Ndithethwa phakathi kwabo baphumayo emngxunyeni; Ndifana nomntu ongenamandla.
Ndishiyeke phakathi kwabafayo, njengezibulalayo emfazweni, ezilala ekufumaneni, ongazikhumbulanga ngaphezu koko, ezilahlekileyo ekuthobeni kwakho.
Undibeka kumngxunya ophantsi kakhulu, Kwizinto ezimnyama eziphakamileyo.
Inkanuko yakho inzima kum; Unditshisa ngamanzi akho onke. (Sela.)
Uthabathe kum abahlobo bam, Wababangela ukuba bathandeka kum; Ndiqhotyoshelweyo, andikwazi ukuvuka.
Amehlo am aphelelwe lithemba; Ndikubiza wena, Nkosi, yonke imihla; Ndizikhupha izandla zam kuwe.
Uyenza na imiqondiso kubantu abafileyo? Ingaba abantu abafileyo baya kuvuka bekubonga kuwe? (Sela)
Ingaba kuthethwa ngothando lwakho esihogweni, Nobuxoki bakho kwindawo yokulahleka?
Ingaba iimfihlakalo zakho ziyaziwa emnyama? Ingaba ubulungisa bakho buyaziwa kwilizwe apho abantu belilibaziweyo khona?
Ke mna, Nkosi, ndiya kuthandaza kuwe; Umthandazo wam ufika phambi kwakho ngemini.
Uthini na, Nkosi yam, ukuba undise umphefumlo wam? Uthini na ukuba ufihla ubuso bakho kum?
Ndiye ndaphazamiseka, ndithe ndafa ukususela ekubeni ndimntwana; Iingozi zakho zandiseka kum.
Inkanuko yakho eqhumayo iphule phezu kwam, Iingozi zakho ezidumileyo zandibulala.
Ndizigubungela njengesibhakabhaka imini yonke, Zimcinezele ngokugqithisileyo.
Uthabathe kum abathandekayo bam, nabahlobo bam; Ubumnyama buyindodana yam entle.
Intliziyo ka-Ethan, umEzrayeli. Ndiza kushumayela ngobubele bukaYehova kude kube sekupheleni; Ngombulelo wam ndiya kubonisa ubuxoki bakho kumaxesha onke.
Ndithi, Ububele bakho buhlala ubomi obungunaphakade; Umisele izulu, ukholo lwakho lukhona kulo.
Uthi, Ndizamile umnqophiso nomkhethi wam; Ndizamile isibingelelo kumkhonzi wam uDavide:
Ndiya kwenza ukuba usapho lwakho lube ngonaphakade; ndiya kuqinisa itrone yakho, ibe yiminyaka yonke.
Izulu, Nkosi yam, livuyisa izimanga zakho; Ukholo lwakho luvuyiswa engqungqutheleni yabangcwele.
Nguwuphi na umntu ezulu oza kuthelekiswa noYehova? Nguwuphi na umntu phakathi kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo, Ofana noThixo?
UThixo, engqungqutheleni yabantu abangcwele, uyayixhalabisa kakhulu; Uyingozi kunabo bonke abajikelezayo.
UYehova, uThixo wamaSirayeli, ngubani na onamandla njengawe, Nkosi? Ubuxoki bakho bukukujikeleza.
Ulawula phezu kolwandle oluzimeleyo; Xa amaza alo enyuka, uya kuzimisa.
Wayitshisa iRahabhi, njengendoda ebulalayo emfazweni; Ngesandla sakho esinamandla wayalela abathunywa bakho.
Izulu lilungu lakho, nehlabathi lilungu lakho; Ukwenza ihlabathi kunye nazo zonke izinto zayo.
Umntla nomzantsi uwenza wena; Intaba kaTabhore, intaba kaHermon, zidlale ngegama lakho.
Intamo yakho inamandla, Isandla sakho sinamandla; Isandla sakho sokunene siphakamileyo.
Itrone yakho ibekwe ngomthetho nobulungisa; Uthando nenyaniso zihamba phambi kwakho.
Kuye kube ngonaphakade abantu abafundile ukukubiza ngegama lakho, Behamba emthunzini wobuso bakho, Nkosi.
Zizixelele igama lakho yonke imihla, Ziphakame phezulu, ngokuba usenza okulungileyo.
Uye unamandla abo aqaqambileyo; Ngobubele bakho, amandla ethu aphakamileyo.
Ukhuselo lwethu luya kuYehova; Umngcwele kaSirayeli ngukumkani wethu.
Ngexesha elidlulileyo, uthetha ngomboniso kubazalwana bakho abangcwele; Uthi, Ndimnika amandla umntu onamandla, Ndimkhuphe umntwana okhethiweyo phakathi kwabantu.
Ndiwufumene uDavide, umkhonzi wam; Ndamsusa phezu kwakhe ioli yam engcwele, ukuba abe ngukumkani.
Isandla sam siyamxhasa, Isisu sam siza kumqinisa.
Aku puluh rodaretta stemma, Akukho mntu ongalunganga oya kumkrumba.
Ndiya kutshisa iintshaba zakhe phambi kwakhe, Ndazibulala abo bamxhalabisayo.
Ukholo lwam nothando lwam luya kuba naye; ngenxa yegama lam, isandla sakhe siza kukhutshwa.
Ndiya kuyibeka isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle, Isandla sakhe esikunene phezu kwemilambo.
Uthi kum, Ubaba wam uThixo wam, Ilitye lam lokusindisa, Nguwe.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba abe ngunyana wam wokuqala, Umkhulu kunabo bonke abakumkani behlabathi.
Ndiya kumgcina ububele bam ngonaphakade; Umnqophiso wam naye awuyi kuphelelwa.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba usapho lwakhe luhlale ngonaphakade, Itrone yakhe ibe yimihla yezulu.
Ukuba oonyana bakhe besuka emthethweni wam, Bengahamba ngezigqibo zam,
ukuba baphula imithetho yam, bangayigcinanga imimiselo yam;
Ndiya kuzisa isono sabo ngentsimbi, nobulungisa babo ngotywala.
Ke mna andinakuwususa umphefumlo wam olungileyo kuye, Ndize ndiyishiye inyaniso yam.
Andiyi kuphula umnqophiso wam, Andiyi kuguqula ilizwi lemizi yam.
Ndiya kwenza isibingelelo ngobungcwele bam, kanye kanye, Rusike kude kube sekupheleni; Andiyi kukhohlisa uDavide.
Usapho lwakhe luza kuhlala ngonaphakade, Itrone yakhe ihlala njengelanga phambi kwam.
Iya kuappendwa kwindawo yayo ngonaphakade, njengenyanga, umshushisi othembekileyo emazulwini. (Sela)
Ke ngoko, ngoku uyamkhupha, uyamnyamekela; Uthe waxoka kukumkani wakho owamachityelwa.
Uphumile umnqophiso wakho nomkhonzi wakho, Utyhila ingqolowa yakhe emtyeni.
Waziphula zonke iinqanawa zakhe, Waziguqula izindlu zakhe ezikhuselekileyo zibe ziindawo ezibi.
Wonke lowo udlulayo umrhoxisa; Abakumkani bakhe bamnqula.
Wakwenza abathunywa bakhe babenamandla, Wakwenza bonke abathunywa bakhe babhiyoze.
Uyibuyisela umva intloko yesikhephe sakhe; Awumncedanga emfazweni.
Ugqibile ubuhle bakhe, Wakhupha isithsaba sakhe ehlabathini.
Wazinciphisa iintsuku zobuntwana bakhe, Wawugubungela ngoxolo. (Sela.)
Ingaba uza kuhlala ixesha elingakanani, Nkosi? Uza kufihla wena ngokwakho ngonaphakade na? Ingaba inkanuko yakho iya kutsha njengomlilo?
Khumbula ukuba ubomi bam bufutshane kangakanani na; Ukwenza bonke abantu ngexesha elifutshane kakhulu.
Nguwuphi ophilayo, angafanga na? Nguwuphi ophumayo emlonyeni wokufa? (Sela)
Ikhona na, Nkosi, inyaniso yakho yexesha elidlulileyo, Oyithethelayo uDavide ngokholo lwakho?
Khumbula, Nkosi yam, ukuba abakhonzi bakho baxhatshazwa njani? Ndizithabatha entliziyweni yam iintshaba zazo zonke izizwe ezinamandla.
Abathunywa bakho, Nkosi yam, bandiseka kum; Baze bamxolela wonke umyalelo wokumkani wakho othambileyo.
Lombani iNkosi kude kube sekupheleni. Amen, amen.
Umthandazo kaMoses, umntu kaThixo. Nkosi, ukhe waba yindawo yethu yokuhlala kusuku nosuku.
Phambi kokuba zizalwa iintaba, Phambi kokuba wenze umhlaba nehlabathi liphela, UThixo ukho wena, ukususela ngonaphakade ukuya kunyaka ozayo.
Uyambuyisela umntu emhlabathini; Uthi, Buyele emhlabathini, nibantu.
Kuba iminyaka emininzi ifana njengemini yeveki ephelileyo kuwe, njengeeyure ezimbalwa zobusuku.
Ubasusa abantu njengephupha; Bafana neentyatyambo ezitsha emveni kwemini.
Ngemini ikhula, ikhule; kodwa ngemini itshisa, iphele.
Silahlekile ngenxa yobuxoki bakho, Siyakhathaza ngenxa yobuxoki bakho.
Wazisa iimpazamo zethu phambi kwakho, Iimpazamo zethu ezifihlakeleyo emthunzini wendawo yakho.
Zonke iintsuku zethu zidlula ngenxa yobuxoki bakho; Iminyaka yethu iphela ngoxolo.
Siphila iminyaka emashumi asixhenxe, namashumi asibhozo, ukuba sinamandla; Ke kaloku iminyaka yethu elungileyo igcwele ubunzima noxinzelelo; Idlula ngokukhawuleza, siyawela.
Nguwuphi owaziyo ubunzima bengxabano yakho? Inkanuko yakho ikhulu, njengokuba kufanelekile ukuxolela.
Sifundise ukuba sibala iintsuku zethu ngokucothayo, ukuze sibe neentliziyo ezinolwazi.
UYehova, buyela kuthi; Kude kube nini na? Yiba nobubele kubakhonzi bakho.
Uthixo wethu, sithandazele uxolo lwakho, Sizithobele ngobusuku bonke; Siya kuba nothando, siya kuba nomsindo yonke imihla yethu.
Nceda usithande ngemihla eninzi, njengokuba usenza sihlupheke; Ngeminyaka eninzi, njengokuba sabona ububi.
Babone abakhonzi bakho umsebenzi wakho, Babone oonyana babo ubuhle bakho.
Inyaniso kaYehova, uThixo wethu, ibe nathi; Yenza ukuba siphumelele umsebenzi wezandla zethu; Yaye, yenza ukuba siphumelele umsebenzi wezandla zethu.
Ohlala phantsi kokhuselo loMphakamileyo, Uya kuphumla phantsi kwesithunzi soMmandla onke.
Ndithi kuYehova, Yindawo yam ekhuselekileyo, Inqaba yam, UThixo wam, endiyithembayo.
Uya kukukhusela kwingxowa yomkhweli, Nakwisifo esibulalayo.
Uya kukukhusela ngeenwele zakhe, Uza kubona ukhuseleko phantsi kwamaphiko akhe; Ubuxoki bakhe buza kuba lukhuselo lwakho nodonga lwakho.
Akuyi kukhathazeka ngenxa yobungozi bobusuku, okanye ngenxa yomqolo obalekayo mihla le;
okanye isifo esihamba ngemini emnyama, okanye umonakalo obulalayo kusasa.
